decision_details_body: - The Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996 has been amended 08 times so far, and steps have been taken on several occasions to repeal the said Act and introduce a new Act, but the said task has not been concluded yet. In order to strengthen the legislative framework on the issues related to illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing operations in the country's territorial waters and as well as on the high seas, a preliminary draft has been prepared by a Committee comprising of officials of the Ministry of Fisheries, as well as officials of the Legal Draftsman's Department, the Attorney General's Department and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs with the technical assistance of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations as well. The proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a new Bill, based on the said preliminary draft, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Orders published in the Gazettes under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the following Orders published under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	The Order under section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2384/31 dated 2024 05 17.

*	The Order under sections 2 and 5 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2395/32 dated 2024 07 31.

*	The Order under section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2404/19 dated 2024.10.02.

*	The Order under sections 2 and 5 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2406/02 dated 2024.10.14.

*	The Order under section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2408/15 dated 2024.11.01.

*	The Order under section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2412/38 dated 2024.11.30.

description: Term Contract for the purchase of 06 shipments of Murban Crude Oil during the period from 2025 .04.01 to 2025.08.31
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited from the registered suppliers of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation for the purchase of 06 shipments of Murban Crude Oil during the period from 2025 04 01 to 2025 08 31. Six (06) bids have been submitted for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the relevant procurement to M/s Aditya Birla Global Trading (Singapore) Pte. Ltd., based on the recommendation of the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for Providing Grants for Income Generating Projects of Local Authorities based on performance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government has implemented a programme to evaluate the performance of all Local Authorities, in order to introduce a systematic procedure for minimizing the burden caused to the General Treasury by strengthening the sources of self- generating income of such Authorities. Under this, a program has been implemented to evaluate the performance of all Local Authorities in the years 2022 and 2023, covering the areas of management, delivery of services, governance practices and the contributions made to achieving sustainable development goals.  It has been observed during the said performance evaluation, in particular, that the quantity and quality of services provided to the public by the Pradeshiya Sabhas fluctuate due to disparities occurred depending on the areas concerned. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, to implement a project of providing capital grants to selected Pradeshiya Sabhas for the implementation of income generating projects during the years 2025-2027, as a Medium Term Sustainable Programme, based on the strengths and weaknesses identified in the said evaluation, and under that, to provide capital grants to identified 54 Pradeshiya Sabhas viz. 06 from each province, in the year 2025, to implement those projects.

description: Fulfilling the responsibility of Local Authorities in creating a circular economy by streamlining their solid waste management activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government has planned to implement a project, in line with the “Clean Sri Lanka” programme as approved at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-12-02, with the aim of ensuring the responsibility and commitment of all citizens and Local Authorities to engage in waste management activities, recognizing the importance of community participation and public awareness for sustainable urban solid waste management. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to implement the proposed Projects based on the Local Government authoritative areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval for importation/procurement of rice
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the rice shortage in the local market, measures are being taken to procure 70,000 metric tons of rice by M/s Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation, as per the approval granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024 12 09.  Similarly, private sector importers have also been permitted to import rice up to 2024 12 20 without Import Control License. It has been observed that the shortage of rice in the local market may continue up to the end of January 2025. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to extend the period granted to the private sector importers to import rice without Import Control Licenses, up to 2025 01 10, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Damage caused to agricultural sector of the country due to adverse weather condition and programme for payment of compensation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the adverse weather condition that prevailed during the past few days, houses, highways, paddy fields and cultivated lands were flooded and a large number of tanks, anicuts and irrigation canals were damaged causing numerous inconvenience to the people.  According to the data of the Department of Agrarian Development, approximately 91,300 acres of paddy lands have been totally damaged and about 86,225 acres partially damaged by 2024 12 02. In addition, about 173 minor irrigation systems have been totally damaged and 1,148 partially damaged. Similarly, it has been reported that about 750 acres of vegetable cultivation have been damaged in the Nuwara Eliya District alone. The Department of Agriculture is taking action to provide seed paddy needed for the cultivation of short term paddy varieties aged 2 1/2 or 3 months or seeds for suitable other short terms crops, for re cultivation in the damaged paddy lands. The Cabinet noted the matters submitted by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation stating that ensuing action will be taken under the existing Crop Insurance Scheme to provide compensation amounting to a maximum Rs.40,000 per acre for 02 hectares (05 acres) and up to a maximum of Rs.40,000 per acre for 01 hectare (2.5 acres) for maize, potato, chillies, onion and soya bean through the provisions allocated to the Agricultural and Agrarian Insurance Board for the year 2025.

description: Agreement on Biodiversity of the areas beyond the National Jurisdiction
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Agreement on Biodiversity in Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ Agreement) had been adopted on 2023-06-19 by the Intergovernmental Conference on the Marine Biodiversity in Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction. This is the third Agreement implemented under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). Increasing human activities in developed countries has become a threat to the marine biodiversity, thereby jeopardizing the quality and resilience of the oceans. The need to enter into the said Agreement has been identified based on the matters such as better implementation of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, the protection and conservation of vast geographical areas through better cooperation and coordination of various stakeholders. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the Agreement on Biodiversity in Areas Beyond National Juridiction, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the United Nations Institute for Training and Research and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR) and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism for a period 03 years so as to provide a cooperative framework wherein the parties can develop and implement activities and facilitate for mutual benefit by utilizing the available resources. Under the said Memorandum of Understanding, it is expected to provide training and learning support, training for diplomats, disaster risk reduction, crisis management and  training on the use of geo-information technologies, particularly in relation to the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on implementation of Multisectoral Grant Assistance between India and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It is proposed to sign a Framework Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of India and the Government of Sri Lanka to strengthen the socio economic development and bilateral cooperation. As per the said Framework Memorandum of Understanding, a series of development projects are planned to be implemented in the Eastern Province under the grant assistance of Rs.2,371.83 million provided by the Government of India. Under this, 33 projects related to infrastructure development and enhancement of livelihood have been identified for implementation, especially focusing on the sectors of education, health, agriculture, fisheries, tourism and community empowerment. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to sign the proposed Framework Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the implementation of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - At the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑03‑25, it was decided to repeal the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, where provisions have made for the importation of 64 goods including essential food items under the Special Commodity Levy executed as a single composite levy. However, it has been observed that it is appropriate to further continue with the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, taking into account the likely enforcement of other taxes including Value Added Tax with the repealing of the said Act, on the goods on which the Special Commodity Levy was applicable and the consequent increase of market price of essential goods, and the likely adverse impact on the government policy on facilitating the local farmers. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, not to implement the Cabinet decision dated 2024‑03‑25 to repeal the relevant Tax and to continue to enforce the Special Commodity Levy component on goods falling under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, with effect from 2025‑01‑01, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of salt to address the shortage of salt
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Salt production in Sri Lanka is sufficient to meet the household and industrial demand of the country and the salt harvest depends on weather conditions. It has been observed that there might be a shortage of salt supply  in the domestic market for household and industrial needs, in the first quarter of 2025, owing to the prevailed inclement weather in the country. As a remedy, the salt manufacturers have requested permission to import up to a maximum of 30,000 metric tons of raw non-iodized salt at the prevailing tariff rate for processing and supply to the market. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development and the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to import raw non-iodized salt, subject to a maximum of 30,000 metric tons, by the Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation Ltd., on or before 2025‑01‑31 and supply the same to the market through local salt manufacturers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Trusts Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Financial Action Task Force which is an intergovernmental organization working for developing policies to combat money laundering, has stated the need to amend the provisions of the Trusts Ordinance in order to secure a favorable position in the upcoming Mutual Evaluation of Sri Lanka to be conducted in 2025. The Financial Intelligence Unit of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Registrar General's Department have submitted the proposed amendments for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to amend the Trusts Ordinance incorporating the said proposed amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of an Order published under the Sri Lanka Export Development 	Act, No. 40 of 1979 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - An Order has been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification                No.2400/25 dated 2024‑09‑05 under section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979 by the then Minister of Investment Promotion with the consent of the then Minister in charge of the subject of Finance, to reduce the CESS Levy by Rs.1/- per Kg on the importation of Clinker, Cement in bulk and Cement in retail bags and to export one million MT of rock boulders for construction purposes and to impose and recover a CESS Levy at the rate of Rs. 1,000/- per cubic meter, subject to the recommendation of the Minister in charge of the subject of Environment. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to submit the said Order to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of a New Order under section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In order to preserve the foreign exchange reserves in the country, Orders have been issued from time to time under section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act,    No. 12 of 2017, since 2020‑04‑02, on the recommendations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, to implement Capital Flow Measures by temporarily suspending and limiting outward remittances related to certain capital transactions. Taking into account the improvements in the domestic foreign exchange market and future prospects, 10 Orders have been issued, since June 2023 up to now, with the intention of gradually removing/relaxing certain suspensions/limitations, and the validity period of the existing Order is due to expire on 2024‑12‑19. The Central Bank of Sri Lanka has proposed that it is appropriate to issue a new Order to be effective until June 2025, further amending certain suspensions and limitations imposed under the existing Order. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to issue an Order under section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act,  No.12 of 2017, for a period of six (06) months to be effective 2024‑12‑20, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resurfacing of the Synthetic Running Tracks of the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex in keeping with International Standards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sugathadasa National Sports Complex is an internationally recognized first class sports complex, and is the only sports complex in Sri Lanka, which is equipped with 400, 200 and 80 meter synthetic running tracks with all the facilities of International Standards. The resurfacing of these synthetic running tracks had been carried out in year 2018, and Athletics Association of Sri Lanka has reported that the condition of the tracks is not suitable even for the national level sports competitions due to the numerous damages that exist on those tracks at present. with the aim of providing the necessary facilities to guide athletes to the national and international level, it has been identified that the renovation of these synthetic running tracks in conformity with the international standards should be a task of high national priority. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to resurface the synthetic running tracks of the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex, prepare the football ground located in the middle, install the necessary electronic time machines and to renovate the light towers by following the prescribed procurement process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Administration of Temporary Shelters for providing Protection to Female Victims of Violence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - With a view to providing temporary care and protection to female victims of gender based violence and children, the Ministry of Women and Child Affairs maintains ten (10) shelters viz. one each in Gampaha, Ratnapura, Monaragala, Colombo, Matara, Batticaloa, Mullaitivu and Jaffna Districts and two (02) shelters in Anuradhapura District, and it has been planned to start a temporary shelter in Nuwara‑Eliya District from January 2025. The administration and maintenance cost of some shelters is directly borne by the Ministry of Women and Child Affairs, while the relevant cost of some shelters is borne by women-welfare based Organizations. Protection to 2,852 female victims has been provided from 2020 up to the second quarter of the year 2024 and a cost of Rs.60.35 million has been borne for the same. However, the Ministry of Women and Child Affairs has received only an allocation of Rs.37.69 million for the purpose during the said period and bills amounting to Rs.22 million remain to be settled. Accordingly, taking into consideration to the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, Cabinet approval was granted to allocate Rs.25 million for the year 2025 and for the allocation of the necessary provisions for the ensuing years through the Annual Budgetary Estimates.

description: Programme for providing morning meal to children in Early Childhood Development Centres/Pre-schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Secretariat for Early Childhood Development implements a programme from the year 2017 under the technical guidance of the Ministry of Health, to provide morning meal for children in Early Childhood Development Centres/Pre-schools where there is a high percentage of underweight children. As at present, each child is granted Rs.60/- per day and it is expected to extend the benefits for about 155,000 children in the year 2025. As the current daily allocation of Rs.60/- in insufficient due to the increase of prices of food items, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to increase the sum of Rs.60/- allocated for each child per day up to Rs.100/- and to implement the said programme in future in Early Childhood Development Centres/Pre-schools to be selected based on the criteria of "Pre‑schools with high percentage of underweight children", was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing additional provisions for the completion of the balance works of the Water Supply and Sanitation Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The “Water Supply and Sanitation Improvement Project” has been initiated to increase the access to pipe-borne water services and improve sanitation facilities, focusing 540 Grama Niladhari Divisions in 07 Districts viz. Mullativu, Kilinochchi, Badulla, Monaragala, Rathnapura, Kegalle and NuwaraEliya. For this purpose, a credit amount of USD 165 million has been granted by the International Development Association under the Investment Project Financing Instrument of the World Bank. An additional financing component (second phase) has been approved to expand the scope of the Project, under which the Projects on extension of existing pipelines have been identified and implemented in Matara, Kurunegala, Matale and Gampaha Districts as well. Despite the planning of the Projects to be completed by 2025-06-30, the total cost estimate of the Project has to be increased by Rs. 1,180 million due to the reasons such as price increase in construction materials and the revision of Value Added Tax (VAT). Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to revise the total cost estimate of the Project and allocate necessary additional provisions through the Budget Estimates in year the 2025, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of spare parts, goods and materials required for the Sri Lanka Transport Board for the year 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Procurements for goods and services for the Sri Lanka Transport Board such as purchase of spare parts and accessories, new tyre kits, selection of institutions for the supply of reconditioned tyres for regional depots, procurement of grease and lubricants and for the procurement of new engine kits have to be carried out for the year 2025. Since four (04) of those procurements exceed the authority limit of the Ministry Procurement Committee, the said procurements have to be referred to the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to execute the said procurements separately through the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and to appoint four (04) separate Technical Evaluation Committees for the said four (4) procuments to assist the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of High Bread Bulls to enhance the Local Milk Production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although Rs. 100 million has been allocated for both the years 2023 and 2024 for the acquisition of cattle with high genetic potential, it has not been possible yet to procure the required cattle due to problems that have arisen in following the relevant procurement process. Therefore, information has been sought from several countries regarding the possibility of purchasing suitable cattle as a direct                 Government-to-Government arrangement and the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan, with the mediation of the High Commission of Pakistan, has agreed to supply 07 semen donor stud bulls of Sahiwal and Nili-Ravi breeds to the country. Similarly, it has been decided that it is appropriate to purchase 20,000 doses of Sahiwal bull semen from the National Dairy Development Board of India as a Government-to-Government arrangement until the stud bulls are imported and the bull semen is produced. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to purchase five (05) Sahiwal stud bulls and two (02) Nili-Ravi stud bulls as a transaction between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Pakistan and to purchase 20,000 doses of Sahiwal bull semen from the National Dairy Development Board of India as a Government-to-Government arrangement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Grant provided by the Government of India to fulfill the vehicle requirement of the Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has agreed to provide a financial Grant of 300 million  Sri Lankan Rupees as an assistance to fulfill the vehicle requirement of the Sri Lanka Police. It has been planned to provide Cabs by utilizing the said grant for duty requirements of Police Stations in the Northern Province. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties to obtain the said Grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of India (GoI) and the Government of Sri Lanka (GoSL) on Cooperation in the field of sharing successful Digital Solutions for Digital Transformation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - There is potential to gain expertise knowledge acquired by India as the global leader in information technology and digital innovation, in areas such as            e-governance, fintech, artificial intelligence and digital infrastructure for Digital Transformation in Sri Lanka through multiple engagements. Accordingly, initial consensus has been reached to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Digital Economy of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Electronic and Information Technology of India. This will facilitate the strengthening of the much needed capacity building of officials in digital transformation and promote institutional cooperation between both countries in the implementation of digital transformational solutions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the                Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Review on State-Owned Non-commercial Entities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has been entrusted with the main functions of providing essential public services and national security, maintaining law and order, various regulatory functions,  intervening in instances of market failures to duly provide good and services,  reasonable distribution of resources, disaster management and social welfare etc. The Security Forces and the Police aside, there are 86 Departments, 25 District Secretariats and 339 Divisional Secretariats, 340 State Owned Enterprises and 115 Non-commercial Public Statutory Institutions that perform the said duties at present. Approximately Rs. 140 billion has been allocated through the National Budget in the year 2024 for 115 Non-commercial Public Statutory Institutions coming under the supervision of the Department of National Budget and for 51 institutions falling under the supervision of the Department of Public Enterprises. Due to factors such as the failure of those institutions to adjust to suit the present requirements, inadequacy or misfit of the authority assigned, the functions assigned to such institutions being performed more efficiently by the private sector, and the existence of several institutions performing the same or similar functions, it has become a timely requirement to conduct a review on Non‑commercial State-owned Entities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to appoint an Officials' Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Prime Minister to carry out such a review and submit a Report with recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Procurement Guidelines on Goods, Works and Non-Consulting Services - 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Procurement Commission, established in terms of Article 156B.(1) of the Constitution, is responsible for formulating fair, equitable, transparent, competitive and cost-effective procedures and guidelines for the procurement of goods and services, works, consultancy services and information systems through all Government institutions, in accordance with the powers vested with the said Commission, in terms of  Article 156C.(1) of the Constitution. Accordingly, the Procurement Guidelines on the Procurement of Goods, Works and Non-Consulting Services by the Government Institutions and for matters connected and incidental  thereto - 2024, has been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification      No.2412/01 dated 2024-11-25. The proposal made by the Hon. President to submit the said Guidelines to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting 55,000 MT of Muriate of Potash Fertilizer to the Government of Sri Lanka as a donation under the World Food Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2024-05-06 to obtain 55,000MT of Muriate of Potash Fertilizer to the Government of Sri Lanka as a donation under the World Food Programme. The Tripartite Agreement related thereto has been signed on 2024-09-20 by the World Food Organization, the Uralchem - Uralkali Group and State Fertilizer Company Limited on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka. The vessel carrying the said stock of fertilizer is scheduled to arrive in Sri Lanka on 2024-12-10 and the official ceremony of handing over the stock of fertilizer to the Government of Sri Lanka has been planned to be held in the Colombo Port on 2024-12-12. The Cabinet decided to distribute the said total stock of fertilizer for farmers at the rate of 50% to be utilized for Paddy and other Crops and the remaining 50% for Coconut cultivation, taking into consideration the aforesaid information furnished by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.

description: The draft protocol between Sri Lanka and India for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of India have entered into an Agreement in the year 2013 for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income. Since Sri Lanka and India are members of the Inclusive Framework of the Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) Project, they are committed to implementing the minimum standards of the Group of 20 Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development. Accordingly, the need to revise the Agreement signed in 2013 for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income, has been identified. The concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism and the clearance of the Attorney General have been received for the revised protocol which has been prepared with the necessary amendments. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to sign the revised protocol and to submit the signed protocol, in terms of section 75(1) of the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017, to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Suspension Period of Parate Execution by the Banks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The economic crisis faced by Sri Lanka during the past four (04) years has severely affected the Small and Medium Scale Enterprises (SME) Sector and it has been reported that the Small and Medium Scale Entrepreneurs have encountered difficulties in settling the loans taken from Banks.  Since an environment had been created under this situation, where the properties of a significant number of businessmen have been taken over by Banks and auctioned due to the default of loans, the sale of properties by public auction has been suspended temporarily up to 2024-12-15 through an amendment to the Recovery of Loans by Banks (Special Provisions), Act No.4 of 1990. Requests have been made by Associations related to the SME Sector for further extension of the suspension of the Parate Execution Law.  The Government has observed that it would be more suitable to create the necessary environment whereby a reasonable solution to both parties could be achieved through the introduction of an Action Plan for the repayment of such loans, instead of permitting the auctioning of properties.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to extend the suspension of the implementation of the Parate Law up to 2025-03-31 and for the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, with the active participation of State and Private Banks and all other parties including State Institutions, to formulate a multi-dimensional mechanism to resolve this issue, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining support from the OPEC Fund for International Development for the Economic Stabilization and Recovery Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has made a request to the OPEC Fund for International Development in order to secure funds to finance Sri Lanka's comprehensive reform agenda, in line with the Extended Fund Facility Programme supported by the International Monetary Fund. The said entity has agreed to grant a loan of US$ 50 million under the Policy Based Loan. The International Monetary Fund has also confirmed that the said loan complies with the parameters of the programme which is being implemented in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to enter into a loan agreement with the OPEC Fund for International Development to obtain the said loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing an appropriate methodology to utilize the Government Bungalows, Visumpaya and President’s Houses located in various areas, under the purview of the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - There are 50 government bungalows under the administrative authority of the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, in Colombo 07 and 05. These bungalows have been allocated for former Presidents, Ministers, Deputy Ministers and various government institutions. Similarly, President’s Houses are located in Colombo, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Mahiyanganaya, Anuradhapura, Kataragama, Jaffna, Embilipitiya and Benthota, under the administrative authority of the Presidential Secretariat. However, President’s Houses, except for those in Colombo and Kandy, have not been used frequently. In addition, Visumpaya, located in Colombo 02, which has been used as the Official Residence of many Heads of State, is currently under the administrative authority of the Urban Development Authority. Similarly, there is an Official Residence of the Prime Minister in Nuwara Eliya under the administrative authority of the Prime Minister's Office. A large sum of money has been spent on the maintenance of the said government properties, irrespective of the fact that the said properties have been underutilized. Therefore, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint an Officials' Committee to propose an appropriate methodology, enabling to utilize the said premises and residences more productively to gain economic benefits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of Officers to the Higher Management in the Departments of the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet granted its approval for the following appointments and attachments as per the proposals submitted by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning & Economic Development.*	to appoint Mr. M.K. Pradeep Kumara, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, serving as the Additional Director General of the Comptroller General's Office, to the presently vacant Post of Director General of the Department of Trade and Investment Policy.*	 to appoint Mr. P.M.K. Hettiarachchi, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, serving as a Director of the Department of Development Finance, to act full time in the presently vacant Post of Director General of the Department of Development Finance.* 	to attach Ms. S.H.D. Kaluthanthree, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as the Director General of the Department of Management Services, to the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, enabling to appoint her to another suitable Post and appoint Mr. Wimal S.K. Liyanagama, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving in a Post of Additional Director General of the Department of Trade and Investment Policy, to the Post of Director General of the Department of Management Services which falls vacant accordingly.*	 to attach Mr. U.D.N. Jayaweera, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Inland Revenue Service, presently acting in the Post of Commissioner General of Excise, back to the Department of Inland Revenue and appoint Mr. U.L. Udaya Kumara Perera, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Inland Revenue Service, serving as a Senior Commissioner of the Department of Inland Revenue, to the Post of Commissioner General of Excise.

description: Proceeds of Crime Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has been granted on 2024-08-12 to publish the Proceeds of Crime Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in the Government Gazette and present it in Parliament. However, after publishing the said Bill in the Government Gazette, several observations have been submitted by the International Monetary Fund.  Accordingly, the observations submitted by the International Monetary Fund have been referred to the Committee appointed by the then Minster of Justice, Prison Reforms and Constitutional Reforms under the Chairmanship of a Judge of the Supreme Court to prepare the initial draft relating to this Bill and the said Committee has recommended to amend the already prepared Proceeds of Crime Bill by incorporating certain further provisions. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to instruct the Legal Draftsman to further amend the Proceeds of Crime Bill, based on the recommendations of the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Total Cost Estimate of the Pugoda Court Complex Construction Project and Payment for the Price Escalations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2023-11-13 to make the relevant payments based on the recommendations of the Standing Procurement Committee of the then Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms after the said Committee had reviewed the actual price escalations calculated using the price variation formulas of the Construction Industry Development Authority (CIDA) for the constructions under the Pugoda Court Complex Construction Project. The Report regarding the price escalations submitted by the Sri Lanka State Engineering Corporation, the institution to which the consultancy services and constructions have been entrusted, has been reviewed by the Standing Procurement Committee of the said Ministry. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration, to revise the total cost estimate of the Pugoda Court Complex Construction Project as Rs.681.2 million and pay the relevant price escalations and to allocate the provisions required for completion of the balance works of the project through budget estimates, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of a New Digital Driving License
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approximately 15 years have lapsed by now since the commencement of issuing a driving license as a smart card and the Government has recognized the appropriateness of issuing a digital driving license, which is currently used in many countries in the world in keeping with the new technology, facilitating the exchange of data between related institutions. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to take necessary action to introduce a new digital driving license expeditiously in place of the driving license being used at present and to continue to implement the methodology currently being adopted for the issuance of driving licenses, taking into consideration the proposals made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation.

description: Obtaining 22 ALCO diesel engines for the Department of Sri Lanka Railways as a Grant from the Government of India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Indian Railways has expressed its willingness to provide 20 slightly used and upgraded M10 locomotives and 02 additional locomotives to obtain spare parts required for the maintenance of the said 20 locomotives, as a Grant for the Department of Sri Lanka Railways. RITES, an engineering consultation and infrastructure development company in India, has submitted an unsolicited proposal to provide maintenance services for the said locomotives for a period of 05 years. The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-06-11 to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee and a Project Committee to evaluate the said proposal and submit recommendations. The Project Committee has indicated that the Department of Sri Lanka Railways has the capacity to maintain the relevant locomotives provided as a Grant and that it is appropriate to have the above work attended to by the staff of the said Department. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to sign the relevant Grant Agreement, in the first instance and accept the Grant of 22 locomotives by the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of the Common Wastewater Treatment Plant at the Horana Export Procession Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held 2023-06-05 for the augmentation of the Common Wastewater Treatment Plant at the Horana Export Procession Zone utilizing funds of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka. Bids have been called for the purpose following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure and 11 Bids have been submitted.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to award the contract for the augmentation of the Common Wastewater Treatment Plant at the Horana Export Procession Zone to Luminex PLC, on the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resolution to be submitted to the Conference of Parties of the International Convention on Wetlands (Ramsar) by Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 15th Conference of the Parties of the International Convention on Wetlands or the Ramsar Convention will be held in Zimbabwe in July 2025. Sri Lanka has drafted a Resolution on 'Rights of Nature in Wetlands' to be submitted to the said Conference. By the said Resolution, it is expected that the member countries would recognize the rights of nature in wetlands of their countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to submit the said Resolution to the 15th Conference of the Ramsar Convention by Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Programme for the Revival of Fishery Industry by mitigating the impact caused to it due to the economic crisis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - With a view to reviving the fishery industry by mitigating the impact caused due to the economic crisis, the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2024-08-21 has granted approval to provide a 'fishery industry recovery allowance' of Rs.25/- per diesel liter for vessel owners who use diesel as fuel and Rs.25/- per kerosene liter for fishermen who use kerosene as fuel at the rate of 15 liter per day up to maximum 25 days per month, for a period of 06 months with effect from 2024-10-01. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to grant a 'fishery industry recovery allowance' of Rs.9375/- monthly to the respective owners of active and small fishing vessels using kerosene as fuel, who have registered in the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources, for a period of 05 months from 2024-11-01 with a view to simplifying the method of granting the fuel concession and to continue to provide the concession being granted to diesel vessel owners without change, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the Karainagar Boat Yard of Cey-Nor Foundation Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has agreed to provide a financial grant to complete the renovation work of the Karainagar Boat Yard of Cey-Nor Foundation Limited and to procure the required machinery and office equipment and approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2024-10-21 to sign a Memorandum of Understanding for the same. The said Memorandum of Understanding has not been signed as yet and it was decided to grant policy approval of the Cabinet to sign the said Agreement between the two parties and to utilize the proposed financial grant for the rehabilitation work of the Karainagar Boat Yard, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources.

description: Securing Funds from the Asian Development Bank for the Power System Strengthening and Renewable Energy Integration Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-09-02 to negotiate with the Asian Development Bank to implement the projects identified for strengthening and modernization of electricity transmission network under the Power System Strengthening Reliability Project funded by the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide a loan amounting to US$ 200 million which comprises of US$ 150 million and US$ 50 million, to the Ceylon Electricity Board and Lanka Electricity Company (Private) Limited respectively, under 02 separate loan agreements, on a Treasury Guarantee. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to sign a Guarantee Agreement with the Asian Development Bank in order to obtain the said Loan amount, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Food Policy and Security Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Ensuring the national food and nutrition security and providing the food safely is a key function of the Government and providing the minimum food requirement of every citizen qualitatively and quantitatively at an affordable price is a main objective of the Government. The new Government policy statement has proposed a number of measures for this purpose and the key functions among them have been identified, including the production of all food that can be produced in the country locally, maintenance of buffer stocks of essential food sufficient for at least for 03 months, maintenance of a database on the food stocks available in the country and preparing and implementation of an effective programme with the participation of the private sector as well in the implementation processes of production, storage, distribution, wholesale and retail trade which ensures the food security. It has been decided to coordinate the National Food and Nutrition Security and Safety Programme through the Presidential Secretariat to pay more attention to these tasks and to make efficient the institutional coordination. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to establish the "Food Policy and Security Committee" under the Presidential Secretariat, under the co-chairmanship of the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development, and with the membership of the Secretary to the Prime Minister and other Secretaries to the relevant Ministries, to provide policy guidance through data and information-based scientific analysis with the participation of all institutions involved in ensuring the food security and nutrition, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting permission to import rice without obtaining Import Control Licenses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet considered the suitability of temporarily removing the restrictions currently existing for the importation of rice, taking into consideration the scarcity of Nadu rice and other varieties of rice in the local market and the loss that has  occurred to the paddy cultivation due to the heavy rain persisted in the last few days. Accordingly, it was decided to grant permission with immediate effect to import rice to the country without obtaining import control licenses  until 2024-12-20.

description: Provision of an allowance for School- Age Children to purchase stationery
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- A survey conducted by the Department of Census and Statistics has revealed that the adverse effects of the economic crisis have caused a significant negative impact on the education of 55% of school children. This percentage is higher in rural and estate areas, and it has been revealed that 53.2% of the affected children have either reduced or completely stopped purchasing school stationery, where as 26.1% have resorted to reusing previously used school stationery. Therefore, with the aim of minimizing the adverse impact on the education of school children, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to provide an allowance for school children to purchase school stationery before the commencement of academic activities in the year 2025, as follows, was approved by the Cabinet.

	* Provision of an allowance of Rs.6000/- per child for the children of Aswesuma Beneficiary families to purchase stationery through the Welfare Benefits Board.

	* Provision of an allowance of Rs.6000/- through the Ministry of Education, 	Higher Education and Vocational 	Education for each child who fall into the categories of parentless children not included in the Aswesuma programme, children from families where mother or father is disabled, all 	school age children in orphanages and children who have left 	destitute, due to special circumstances.

description: Vote on Account - 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2024 11 25 to present a Vote on Account for the period of first 04 months of the year 2025, in Parliament and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Resolution for the purpose. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Resolution relating to the Vote on Account drafted by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to move the said Resolution in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of amendments to the Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Scheme has been implemented from 2023 07 01 and has been re-amended by the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2384/30 and implemented from 2024 07 01. Under this Scheme, the Aswesuma welfare beneficiary families are entitled to benefits under 04 categories. As the impact of the economic crisis has not fully subsided, it has been found necessary to provide short-term relief to the families selected in the first round in relation to the transitional and vulnerable categories and the families selected in relation to the applications of second round where the selection process has been commenced. Further, concerns have been raised to the effect that the amount granted at present is not adequate, considering the current cost of living. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to amend the Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Scheme currently in force as follows, was approved by the Cabinet.
* To increase the monthly benefit allowance currently granted to poor and extremely poor categories from Rs.8,500/- to Rs.10,000/- and from Rs.15,000/- to Rs.17,500/- respectively and implement the Aswesuma Welfare Benefits Scheme revised accordingly from the date on which the said Scheme is approved by Parliament.
* To extend the benefit payment period for transitional social category until 2025 03 31.
* To extend the benefit payment period for vulnerable social category until 2025 12 31

description: Implementation of the 'Clean Sri Lanka' Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Considering the fact that Sri Lanka is currently experiencing a significant setback not only economically but also politically, socially, spiritually and environmentally, a programme named "Clean Sri Lanka" has been planned to be implemented as a national mission to achieve the national aspiration by ensuring the well-being, reconciliation and progress of the people of this country. This transformative initiative, guided by the new Government's vision of "A Thriving Nation, a Beautiful Life", will be implemented with the aim of achieving social, environmental and ethical awakening. The proposal made by the Hon. President to implement this programme through the Presidential Secretariat, establish a Presidential Task Force for this purpose, and establish a fund called the "Clean Sri Lanka Fund" under the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, which will be managed by a Board of Governors, to provide the necessary funds for the implementation of the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of super luxury vehicles that incur a heavy burden on the Public 	Institutions following a proper procedure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the high cost of maintenance and fuel in the use of certain luxury vehicles used in Government institutions, it has been found that disposal of such luxury vehicles is more economically effective. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to carry out a formal study on the existing vehicles in all Government institutions, to dispose the vehicles with petrol engine capacity above 1800cc and diesel engine capacity above 2300cc (except Double Cabs/ Single Cabs/ Vans/Buses) that fall under HS Heading No. 87.03, by the relevant Chief Accounting Officer before 2025 03 01, following the proper procurement procedure and to authorize the Secretary to the Treasury to issue the relevant Circular instructions in order to report the Comptroller General of the General Treasury by pursuing action accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making provisions for recalling nominations and for calling fresh nominations for the Local Authorities Election which was due to be held in the year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - At the Cabinet meeting held on 20240902, it was decided to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Local Authorities Elections (Special Provisions) Bill to make provisions for recalling nominations and for calling fresh nominations for the Local Authorities Election which was due to be held in the year 2023.  At the meeting of Party Leaders in Parliament chaired by the Speaker of Parliament on 20241125, with the participation of the leaders of recognized political parties as well, a consensus has been reached to cancel the nominations called in 2023 and conduct the ensuing Local Authorities Election by calling fresh nominations.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the Local Authorities Elections (Special Provisions) Bill, empowering the Election Commission to make provisions to recall the nominations already called for the Local Authorities Election and to call for fresh nominations, enabling to safeguard the right of all voters and the voting right of the youth community, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Identification and resolving of existing issues regarding Development Officers, Officers of Allied Service Categories, and Officers already in various Posts in the Public Service with a degree although the degree is not considered as a basic qualification for entry into the Public Service, and graduates expecting to join the Public Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- More than 150,000 graduates including the Development Officers recruited to the Government service through various schemes  in 07 occasions from the year 1994 to 2020, are employed under the Central Government and Provincial Councils  Recruitment to the public service has been made without a proper evaluation of the skills and professional qualifications of the officers serving as  Development Officers and Officers  of Allied Service Categories. It has not been possible to achieve the expected performance of those officers, as they were not provided   with proper induction and in-service training, neither have they been formally assigned with duties and responsibilities related to the post. Similarly, more than 15,800 Development Officers are engaged in teaching in National and Provincial schools and a problematic situation has also arisen regarding recruiting them to the Teachers' Service. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to appoint a Ministerial Committee under the Chairmanship of the Prime Minister and consisting of the following Ministers/Deputy Ministers to identify the various issues that have arisen regarding the administration as well as the performance of the Development Officers, analyze those issues and present sustainable solutions, and also to appoint an Officials' Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Prime Minister to assist the Ministerial Committee - 
Ministerial Committee:
	* Hon. Prime Minister - (Chairperson)
	* Hon. Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local 	Government
	* Hon. Deputy Minister of Economic Development
	* Hon. Deputy Minister of Education and Higher Education
	* Hon. Deputy Minister of Vocational Education
Officials Committee:
* Secretary to the Prime Minister - (Chairman)
	* Secretary, Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government
* Secretary, Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education
	* Secretary, Finance Commission
* Director General of National Budget
	* Director General of Establishments
* Director General - Department of Management Service
* Director General of Combined Service

description: Appointment to the post of Secretary to the Leader of the Opposition in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to appoint Mr. M.G.C.S. Ranasingha, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as a Senior Assistant Secretary of the Office of the Leader of the Opposition in Parliament, to act full time in the post of Secretary to the Leader of the Opposition in Parliament with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Kandy has fallen vacant from 2024-11-25.  The proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint Mr. U.P. Indika Anuruddha Piyadasa, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as Divisional Secretary, Ampara, to the Post of District Secretary/Government Agent of the Administrative District of Kandy with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointments for the Posts of Additional Secretary in the Prime Minister's	Office
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposals made by the Hon. Prime Minister to make the following appointments for 02 vacancies existing in the Posts of Additional Secretary in the Prime Minister's Office, were approved by the Cabinet. 

	  * 	   Appointment of Mr. J.M.I.R.K. Jayasundara, Special Grade Officer of	   the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as an Additional 	  District Secretary in the Kurunegala District Secretariat, to a post of	   Additional Secretary in the Prime Minister's Office. 

		* 	Appointment of Ms. Chandani Sagarika Bogahawatta, Grade I	Officer  				of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, presently serving as a Director in the				Department of Project Management and Monitoring of	the Ministry of				Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to act full time in a post of 					Additional Secretary in the Prime Minister's Office.

description: Procurement of Essential Medical Supplies from the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation and Local Manufactures
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-10-14 to purchase locally manufactured medicines and medical supplies from the identified local manufacturers for an ensuing period of one year. Accordingly, the Ministry of Health and Mass Media has prepared 04 lists of pharmaceuticals that could be provided by local manufactures who have signed Joint Venture Agreements with the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation, the local manufacturers who have signed Buy Back Agreements with the Ministry of Health and those who have not entered into agreements as of now. As such, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the following procurements, based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, having examined the said 04 lists.

*	To award the procurement for the supply of 42 pharmaceutical items to the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation, for a sum of Rs. 5,398.83 million.
*	To award  the procurement for the supply of 131 pharmaceutical items to the local manufacturers who have signed Joint Venture Agreements with the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation, for a sum of Rs. 16,611.42 million. 
*	To award  the procurement for the supply of 36 pharmaceutical items to the local manufacturers who have signed Buy Back Agreements with the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, for a sum of Rs. 9,022.10 million. 
*	To award the procurement for the supply of 130 pharmaceutical items to 24 newly selected local manufacturers, for a sum of Rs. 13,374.65 million.

description: Request for Supplementary Budget allocation for the year 2024 for the Road Projects under the Ministry of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Since foreign loan disbursements for certain projects which were implemented through foreign debt financing have been temporarily suspended due to the recent economic crisis in the country, the provisions allocated under the foreign debt financing could not be fully utilized. Further, the expenses incurred under domestic financing have also been increased significantly due to the significant increase of prices in raw materials. As a result, a problematic situation has arisen due to the inadequacy of the provisions currently allocated to settle the bills submitted by the contractors. Considering the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation in this regard, it was decided to grant the approval of the Cabinet to present a supplementary estimate in Parliament to secure required additional provisions under local financing, in lieu of the savings in the provisions allocated under foreign debt financing for the Ministry of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation for the year 2024.

description: 77th Independence Day Ceremony falling on February 04, 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-12-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024 10 14 to appoint a Cabinet Committee under the chairmanship of the Hon. President to guide, direct and monitor the organizing of the 77th Independence Day Commemoration Ceremony, which falls on 04-02-2025. The proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee under the chairmanship of the Hon. President and with the participation of the Hon. Prime Minister to provide necessary guidance in organizing the 77th Independence Day Commemoration Ceremony falling on 04 February 2025, including the Ministers in charge of the relevant subjects who have been appointed as Members of the Cabinet after the Parliamentary Election, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Restructuring of International Sovereign Bonds to restore Sovereign Debt Sustainability
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-11-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In June 2024, the Government of Sri Lanka has reached a final agreement on debt restructuring with the members of Official Creditor Committee (OCC) of Sri Lanka's major bilateral lenders. In September 2024, an agreement has initially been reached in principle with the holders of International Sovereign Bonds, following the negotiations with Ad Hoc Bond Holders, a representative group of international investors and the Local Consortium of Sri Lanka on restructuring of approximately US$ 14.2 billion of sovereign debt. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to restructure the Sri Lanka's International Sovereign Bonds by way of exchanging the existing bonds for new bonds, after an analysis carried out by financial and legal advisors of the Government of Sri Lanka pertaining to the impact on the Sri Lanka's economy taking into account the matters on the composition of international sovereign debt of Sri Lanka, investors and settlement and as per the parameters pointed out through the Debt Sustainable Analysis by the International Monetary Fund as per the provisions of the Sri Lanka's IMF-supported Extended Fund Facility Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Statement on financial performance of the Government submitted as stipulated in the provisions of Public Management Act, No.44 of 2024 - 3rd Quarter 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-11-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As stipulated in Section 53(1) of the Public Financial Management Act, No. 44 of 2024, on at least a quarterly basis, the Minister of Finance shall provide a Statement on Financial Performance including the revenue and expenditure, of the Government to the Cabinet of Ministers not later than forty five days after the end of each quarter and thereafter, publish the same in the website of the Ministry in charge of the subject of Finance. Accordingly, the Cabinet has granted its concurrence to the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the Report on Financial Performance including cumulative revenue and expenditure reported by all the Special Spending Units, Ministries, Departments and District Secretariats for the 3rd Quarter ending on 2024-09-30, in the website of the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development.

description: Pre-election Budgetary Position Report - 2024 and the Mid Year Fiscal Position Report - 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-11-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Pre-election Budgetary Position Report is issued in terms of section 52 of the Public Financial Management Act, No.44 of 2024, the Secretary to the Treasury should submit to the public, a Pre-election Budgetary Position Report containing information on the financial position of the country within three weeks of publishing a Declaration or an Order that a General Election be held to elect Members of Parliament. The said Report was published on the website of the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development on 2024 10 14. In terms of section 50 of the Public Financial Management Act, No.44 of 2024, the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development should submit to the public, the Mid Year Fiscal Position Report containing the information used as a basis for evaluating the mid-year fiscal performance of the Government as against the fiscal strategies set out in the Government's fiscal strategy, on the last day of October of the relevant year or on the date on which a period of 10 months from the passage of the Appropriation Act of the relevant year lapses, whichever date occurs later. The said Report was published on the website of the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development on 2024 10 31. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to table the Pre-election Budgetary Position Report - 2024 and the Mid Year Fiscal Position Report -2024 in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of the Budget for the year 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-11-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The new Government anticipates to prepare the budget for the year 2025 as a budget taking the initial steps towards the desired development, in a manner that will strengthen the people's confidence in the Government and fulfill the expectations of the public. Accordingly, Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to prepare the Budget for the year 2025 by obtaining proposals from all ministries, enabling to provide necessary provisions to implement the projects and programs identified by each Ministry under its purview, subject to the expenditure limits specified in the Public Financial Management Act, No. 44 of 2024 and the compliance to the Policy manifesto of the Government, and to present the Appropriation Bill for the year 2025 to Parliament on 2025 01 09 and conduct the Second Reading (Budget Speech) on 2025 02 17 and the Third Reading of the Budget Debate from 2025 02 27 to 2025 03 21.

description: Awarding the Contract for the procurement of 04 shipments of Gas Oil (0.05% M.S)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-11-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called for the purchase of 04 shipments of Gas Oil (0.05% M.S) for the period from 2024 12 15 to 2025 06 14 from the registered suppliers of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation. Accordingly, bids have been submitted by 06 Bidders. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy, to award the relevant procurement to M/s BB Energy (Asia) Pte. Ltd, Singapore, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Nadu Rice shortage in the local market and the importation of rice in order to control the price of rice
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-11-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into account the tendency of price increase of rice and the existing shortage of Nadu Rice in the local market, the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development was requested at the previous Cabinet meeting to submit recommendations to the Cabinet in liaison with the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation and the Minister of Labour, consulting relevant parties. Considering the recommendations so submitted, approval of the Cabinet was granted to immediately import 70,000 metric tons of rice (Swarna variety) which is equivalent to parboiled Nadu variety of rice.

description: Submission of a Supplementary Estimate to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-11-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- It is required to make necessary provisions through a Supplementary Estimate for incurring and accounting certain essential expenditures in the ensuing period of the year 2024.
