description: Providing uniforms for Dhamma school teachers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - An annual teachers' allowance of Rs.5,000/- is currently paid to encourage the Buddhist, Hindu, Islamic, Christian and Catholic Dhamma school teachers in appreciation of their service. In addition to the above allowance, a uniform	has been provided for the Dhamma school teachers till the year 2022, and the	programme of providing uniforms is currently not being implemented. In consideration of a proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs regarding the provision of uniforms for Dhamma school teachers, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted to provide an allowance of Rs.7,500/- annually as an incentive 	teacher allowance of Rs.5,000/- and the uniform allowance of Rs.2,500/- for the Dhamma school teachers representing all the religions in year 2025.

description: Selection of a Handling Agent for SriLankan Airlines Connecting Point	Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited to select a Handling Agent for SriLankan Airlines connecting Point Services by following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the relevant Contract to Lanka Sportreizen, the sole substancially responsive bidder as per the recommedations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting apart of the plot of land located at the Assessment No.135, Perahera Mawatha, Kollupitiya, Colombo 03 belonging to the Urban Development Authority for a mixed development projection a  99-year lease  basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Proposals have been invited from the interested investors to set apart a plot of land of 35.95 perches at Perahera Mawatha, Kollupitiya, Colombo 03 belonging to the Urban Development Authority for a mixed development project on a 99-year lease basis. Accordingly, M/S GLOBAL LEASING LTD, which has been selected, has received the approval of the Board of Management of the Urban Development Authority and the Standing Cabinet appointed Negotiation Committee to set apart the relevant plot of land on a long-term lease basis.The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to provide the said plot of land to the said Company on a 99-year lease basis to implement a mixed development project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a study to improve Tuberculosis preventive therapy among the infected individuals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Tuberculosis is the second leading infectious disease in Sri Lanka and the leading cause of death among infectious diseases. In the year 2021, a guideline has been created for Sri Lanka also in line with the World Health Organization guidelines on TB Preventive Therapy. Accordingly, it is expected to conduct a study in Galle District to monitor the effectiveness of the care model proposed to be implemented under the National Programme for Tuberculosis Control and Chest Diseases, for which the International Union against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease has agreed to provide a financial grant of USD 387,280. The said study will be conducted jointly with the Faculty of Medicine of the University of Sri Jayewardenepura and the National Programme for Tuberculosis Control and Chest Diseases of the Ministry of Health. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Education and the Minister of Health to sign the Memorandum of Understanding among the International Union against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease, the Ministry of Health and the University of Sri Jayewardenepura to conduct the Study, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Designating the IFC Colombo 1 and Gateway International Campus as Primary Businesses of Strategic Importance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been stipulated under the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021 that the approval of the Cabinet must be obtained in order to designate a business as a business of strategic importance and to grant exemptions or incentives to that business. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to designate IFC Colombo 1 (PVT) LTD and Gateway International Campus (PVT) LTD which have been approved as authorized persons under the said provisions, as primary businesses of strategic importance and to grant proposed exemptions or incentives to those businesses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing the Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Export Development Board and the International Trade Centre (ITC) to launch the ITC SheTrades Hub in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Export Development Board of Sri Lanka has proposed to sign a non-financial MoU with the International Trade Centre (ITC) to launch an "ITC SheTrades Hub in Sri Lanka", to increase the participation and competitiveness of Women-Led Businesses (WLBs) in Sri Lanka in international trade. Through this the women entrepreneurs will get training opportunities on topics related to international trade such as markets and investment opportunities and get the required technical assistance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Export Development Board and the International Trade Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Trade Facilitation Roadmap for Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the cabinet has been granted in 2016 to establish a National Trade Facilitation Committee to enforce the Trade Facilitation Agreement of the World Trade Organization and coordinate the inter agency activities associated with the implementation of 36 commitments in the said Agreement. Under that, Sri Lanka is committed to implement the plan for the implementation of trade facilities within the period of 2017 - 2030. Countries in the Region have met a high percentage of the overall commitments of the said plan, but Sri Lanka has fulfilled only 37.4% of the total commitments. Considering the said situation, technical assistance has been requested from the Japan International Cooperation Agency with the technical expertise of the International Trade Center to conduct a complete assessment of the trade facilitation measures and to make independent recommendations so that the priority measures could be implemented on a fast-track basis. Accordingly, the "Trade Facilitation Roadmap for Sri Lanka" and the "Trade Facilitation Action Plan 2025‑ 2028" have been prepared with the participation of about 200 public and private stakeholders. The proposal made by the Hon. President to adopt the said Road Map and implement the action plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion of Benefits under the Agrahara Medical Insurance Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2024‑08‑12 has granted approval to introduce a Medical Insurance Scheme delivering more facilities to the employees in the Public Sector and all pensioners with more attractive benefits from January 2025. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to charge a monthly subscription of Rs.1,000/- from the pension of all pensioners and the salary of all employees in Public Sector and credit the said amount to the National Insurance Trust Fund thereby implementing the Medical Insurance Scheme with proposed more facilities with effect from 2025, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Potential for Sri Lanka's Accession to BRICS
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2024‑01‑24 has decided to appoint an Officials' Committee to examine matters on Sri Lanka's Accession to BRICS and submit appropriate recommendations. The Officials' Committee appointed accordingly has submitted its Report having examined the pros and cons of Sri Lanka in accession to the BRICS and the New Development Bank to be established under the same. All stakeholders who attended to that have positively responded in obtaining membership of BRICS. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to apply for the membership of the BRICS and the New Development Bank to be established under the same by following the relevant diplomatic procedures, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of an integrated electronic solution for implementation of the system of collecting fines charged for the offenses not taken to the courts on the occasions of violation of road traffic rules and the driver demerit point system
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Proposals have been invited under the double cover system to select a suitable supplier for introducing an integrated electronic solution for the implementation of a system of collecting fines charged for the offenses not taken to the courts on the occasions of violation of road traffic rules and the driver demerit point system. 09 bidders have submitted proposals for the same. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to award the relevant procurement to Millenium I.T.E.S.P (Pvt) Ltd. and Metropolitan Technologies (Pvt) Ltd. Joint Venture, based on the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Railway Station Buildings as Commercial Centres
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Expressions of Interest have been invited to identify the investors interested in the development of railway stations in Kolpetty, Bambalapitiya, Wellawatta, Compannavidiya, Dehiwala and Mount Lavinia located in Colombo city under the Public‑Private Partnership Methodology. Since Expressions of Interest have been submitted for the development of Railway Stations located at various places in Sri Lanka, it has been found that there is a capacity to develop  railway stations located island wide. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minster of Transport and Highways to invite proposals on competitive basis to develop other railway stations as well under the Public‑Private Partnership Methodology and to select suitable investors, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Information Technology Strategic Plan for the Inland Revenue	Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Information Technology Strategic Plan to support the digitization of the Inland Revenue Department as a structural benchmark under the IMF supported Extended Fund Facility Programme is required to be prepared by the Inland Revenue Department and approved by the Cabinet by the end of August 2024. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to implement the Information Technology Strategic Plan for the Inland Revenue Department prepared for the period of 2025-2027, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing Mahapola and Bursaries of University Students
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Since the Mahapola and Bursary installments granted for university students have not been increased from 2015 to date, the necessity of revising the said installment amount had been brought to the notice of the Cabinet through a joint Memorandum submitted by the Minister of Education and the Minister Trade, Commerce and Food Security. Taking into consideration the said proposal, the Cabinet granted approval to increase the Mahapola installment up to Rs.7,500/- and the Bursary installment up to Rs.6,500/- with effect from April 2025.

description: Submission of Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No.11 of 2024 issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 for approval of Parliament (Open Account for Colombo Port City)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No.11 of 2024 imposed under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2398/18 dated 2024-08-21. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to present the said Regulations for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Import Duties levied on importation of goods
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The necessity of taking measures as the following has been identified, upon the requests of the stakeholders of the local industries and the trade sector, to be implemented in principle and presented in time in respect of the Customs Import Duty, CESS Levy, Special Commodity Levy and Ports and Airports Development Levy, which are the types of duties levied on importation of goods to the country.

* 	Exemption of certain imported goods which are subject to Special Commodity Levy and to include in the general import tax structure including the Customs Import Duty.

*	Revision of Customs Import Duty for importation of brown sugar.

* 	Revision of Import Duties on footwear, packaging, electrical equipment,	raw materials of plastic and rubber related industry and intermediate	goods under 	225 HS codes based on the recommendations of the 	Ministry of Industry to empower local industries.

* 	Reduction of import duties on infants and adult diapers and its raw materials.

* 	Introducing tax amendments as applicable for minimizing the usage of plastic and recycling in Sri Lanka.

* 	Elimination of existing import tax anomalies in respect of the importation of domestic bicycles and accessories industry, printing and printing ink industry, industries for local manufacturing of washing machines and liters and children's ready-made garments.

* 	Promotion of the export of Palmyra and Palmyra products, introduction of new HS Codes National sub-division customs codes to differentiate electrically operated toys and tippili varieties used for the production of local medicine manufacturing purposes and simplification of the procedure for exemption of CESS Levies on importation of raw materials used in the production of local medicines.

The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to take the following steps to implement the import revisions as stated above, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Issuance of an Order under the Revenue Conservation Act, No.19 of 1962 and the amendment of the Customs Import Duties.

* 	Amendment of CESS Levy under the Export Development Act, No.40 of 1979.

*	 Imposition of Orders under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007.

* 	Taking necessary measures concurrently under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No.18 of 2011 and the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969, relevant to the tax revisions.

description: Establishment of a Financial Stability Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Central Bank of Sri Lanka has identified the Strengthening the bank resolution framework under the crisis management framework in financial institutions regulated by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka as an urgent priority. A Financial Stability Fund should be established to ensure the achievement of the objectives of resolution and the effective implementation of the resolution measures provided for in the Act, under Section 15 of the Banking (Special Provisions) Act, No.17 of 2023. In terms of the Section 15(2) of the Banking (Special Provisions) Act, No.17 of 2023, the Financial Stability Fund should be managed separately from the other assets of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the assets managed by the Central Bank as an independent fund. By 2024-07-31, the Central Bank of Sri Lanka has included the establishment of the Financial Stability Fund using the initial corpus provided by the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies and operationalizing the Financial Stability Fund with comprehensive guidelines to ensure an effective resolution framework as an indicative policy action of the 2nd Sub-Programme of the Financial Sector Stability and Reforms Programme. For that purpose, it is expected to obtain a loan of USD 200 million this year under the Financial Sector Stability and Reforms programme funded by the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to establish the Financial Stability Fund with a nominal amount of Rs.1,000 million provided by the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies and to gradually build the fund by providing provisions from the Annual Budget subject to the prevailing fiscal constraints, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: International Interests in Mobile Equipment (Cape Town Convention) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023-01-02 has granted approval to introduce the necessary legal provisions to access the International Interests in Mobile Equipment (Cape Town Convention) and the Protocol of the International Interests in Mobile Equipment on matters specific to Aircraft Equipment. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal to dredge the sand deposits in the fishery harbour basins	managed by the Ceylon Fishery Harbour Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2024-02-05 has granted approval to call for Expressions of Interest for the purpose of removing sand deposits in 22 Harbours of the Ceylon Fishery Harbour Corporation. Accordingly, the Ceylon Fishery Harbour Corporation has called Expressions of Interest for the project proposals to carry out dredging services in the fishery harbour basins managed by the said Corporation free of charge and for the commercial utilization of dredged raw materials in Kirinda, Chilaw and Valachchenai fishery harbours. For that purpose, 03 companies have submitted proposals and the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries to award the Contract for dredging at Kirinda, Chilaw and Valachchenai fishery harbours free of charge to the Supreme Global Holdings (Pvt) Ltd, based on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of New Regulator for the Petroleum Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2024‑04‑25, to appoint a Committee to examine matters and make recommendations on the establishment of a regulatory mechanism for the Petroleum, Liquefied Petroleum Gas, Liquefied Natural Gas and Lubricant Sectors in Sri Lanka. The Committee appointed accordingly has submitted recommendations to introduce a new regulator for the petroleum sector. The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to implement the said Committee recommendations and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill to regulate the Petroleum Industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ratification of the UNESCO Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions (2005) by Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In 2005, the UNESCO Organization has adopted a convention aimed at protecting and promoting the diversity of cultural expressions created in its member states. So far, 156 member states have accepted the said Convention, and Sri Lanka has not yet ratified the convention. A Committee consisting of Experts has been appointed to consider the ratification of the UNESCO Convention, and the concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the clearance of the Attorney General have been received for the recommendations of the said Committee. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to ratify the UNESCO Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions (2005) by Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the Protocol of exporting Wheat Bran Pellets from Sri Lanka to the Chinese Market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approximately 20% of the wheat seeds imported into Sri Lanka are removed as bran pellets during the processing of wheat flour. There is a possibility of earning a large amount of foreign exchange by exporting the bran so removed as wheat bran pellets, to China. For that purpose, the necessity to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties to follow a specific procedure has been identified. The concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has been received for the drafted Memorandum of Understanding. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Agriculture and Plantation Industries and the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a loan from the Asian Development Bank to implement the Water Supply and Sanitation Reform Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka is planning to obtain 02 credit facilities worth USD 200 million from the Asian Development Bank for the implementation of the Water Supply and Sanitation Reform Programme. Under the said programme, it has been proposed to implement 02 sub-programmes each amounting to USD 100 million by the Government of Sri Lanka. The discussions relating to obtaining the loan amount of USD 100 million for its first programme “Strengthening climate resilience, inclusion, and environmental sustainability of water supply operation”, have been completed. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies pertaining to obtaining the said credit facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing funds from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program (MWSIP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program has been implementing under the Multi-tranche Financing Facility of the Asian Development Bank since 2015 and under the said programme 03 major projects are being implemented. The original estimated cost of the said programme is USD 675, of which USD 453 was agreed to be provided by the Asian Development Bank.  Its first installment has been granted in the year 2015 whereas the second installment has been granted in 2017. Negotiations with the Asian Development Bank to obtain US$ 93 million of the remaining loan amount have been completed, and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the relevant loan Agreement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to enter into a loan Agreement with the Asian Development Bank in order to obtain USD 93 million from the Regular Ordinary Capital Resources of the Asian Development Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a loan facility from the Asian Development Bank for the Financial Sector Stability and Reform Programme of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2023‑09‑25 to  obtain a Policy-Based Loan amounting to USD 400 million from the Asian Development Bank, under 02 sub‑programmes, in order to implement the Financial Sector Stability and Reform Programme of Sri lanka. Accordingly, a loan amounting to USD 200 million has been granted for the first sub‑programme by December 2023. In order to obtain USD 200 million under its second sub-program, 12 pre-policy activities have to be completed and as of now, most of the said policy activities have already been completed or are in the final stages of their completion. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to obtain a loan amount of USD 200 million from the Asian Development Bank under the second sub‑programme of the Financial Sector Stability and Reform Programme of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making necessary provisions to re-call of nominations for protecting the Fundamental Rights of Voters who have been deprived of the Right to Vote and the Election Candidature at the Local Authorities Elections

description: Burial and Cremation Rights Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Clarence of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to make provisions to confer the right to every person to make a decision on the manner of disposing the body of such person after death and in case of death of a person who has not expressed the consent as to the manner of disposal of his body after death, to confer the next of kin of such person the right to decide whether the body of such person shall be buried or cremated, giving due consideration to the known preferences and religious, cultural or personal beliefs of the deceased. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the Bill prepared accordingly in the Government Gazette and to submit the same thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Registration of Persons (Amendment) Bill to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2020‑11‑16 has instructed the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill to amend the Registration of Persons Act No. 32 of 1968 in order to facilitate the implementation of the Unified Digital Identity Framework in Sri Lanka. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman accordingly. The proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and to submit the same, thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka and the Rio Branco Institute of the Ministry of the Foreign Affairs of the Fedarative Republic of Brazil
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka and the Rio Branco Institute of the Ministry of the Foreign Affairs of the Fedarative Republic of Brazil on the cooperation in the areas of mutual interest such as promoting close collaboration in training of diplomats, facilitating them for short and mid-term training programmes, exchange of information and experiences concerning their respective programmes of study and research and exchange of information and views related to international trends. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign the proposed Cooperation Agreement between two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rescue, Rehabilitation and Insolvency Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023-05-22 has granted approval to introduce a new law incorporating the required legal provisions on Rescue, Rehabilitation and Insolvency. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney	General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. The joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provisioning of high-speed satellite internet connection for SriLankan Airlines fleet
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - SriLankan Airlines currently operates a fleet of 13 aircrafts with internet facilities, enabling the passengers to use Wi-Fi facilities and GSM services on mobile phones. Since the air passengers have to experience low internet speed with the existing outdated internet facility, the need of providing a fast internet application facility has been identified. Ka and Ku bands are used for high-end connections and due to the high frequency range available, through Ka-band provides high data transfer at a speed. It has been recognized that the Ka-band connection is more suitable for high-speed Internet access, streaming services and other data-intensive operations. Accordingly, the proposal submitted by Viasat Company, the sole provider of Ka-band connectivity offering hardware, software and internet facilities with global coverage for commercial aircrafts, have been evaluated and recommendations submitted by the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the Contract for the provision of Ka-band high-speed satellite technology Internet connection facilities for seven (07) A330-300 model aircraft of SriLankan Airlines Limited to Viasat Inc. for a period of 07 years, based on the said recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for supply of Soy Bean and Maize for Sri Lanka Thriposha	Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The annual maize and soybean requirement for thriposha production is about 12,000 MT and 6,000 MT respectively. Due to the current shortage of maize and soybeans, the annual supply requirement for thriposha production process cannot be met locally, therefore, the said need has to be met from abroad. Accordingly, bids have been invited for the supply of maize and soybeans under the National Competitive Bidding Procedure. Accordingly, the proposals made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to award the Contracts as follows  to the lowest substancially responsive bidders as per the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, after evaluating the said bids, were approved by the Cabinet.

*	Award of the procurement for supply of 6,000 MT of Maize to M/s KST Evergreen (Pvt) Ltd.

*	Award of the procurement for supply of 3,000 MT of soybeans to M/s SDK United Agri Ventures (Pvt) Ltd.

description: Adoption of the Charter for the Upcountry Plantation Community of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Charter for the Upcountry Plantation Community has been drafted as a preliminary document to guide the Government's efforts to realize the Government's commitment for the full integration of the Upcountry Plantation Community into the wider Socio-Economic Structure of the country. By implementing the said Charter, it will be possible to address the challenges that the plantation community is constantly facing and to build an just society for them in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development to implement the Charter for the Upcountry Plantation Community of Sri Lanka was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the 8th Intake of the Interest Free Student Loans Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- At the cabinet meeting held on 2023‑04‑24, it has been decided to appoint an Officials' Committee under the Chairmanship of a Deputy Secretary to the Treasury to submit recommendations regarding the implementation of the 8th Intake of the Interest Free Student Loans Scheme that has been commenced since 2017 for following Degree Courses in Non-State Higher Education Institutes and revision of  fees to be paid to the said Higher Education Institutes for the relevant courses. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to implement the following recommendations submitted by the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet:

*	Revision of course fees from the 8th Intake of the Interest Free Student Loans Scheme as per the recommendations of the Technical Consultation Committee appointed by the Ministry of Education.

*	Getting involved the National Savings Bank as well, in addition to the Bank of Ceylon and the People's Bank for the above scheme in order to reduce the financial risk that one bank has to bear .

*	Annual review and implementation of the loan interest of the Interest Free 	Student Loans Scheme subject to a minimum rate of 13% and to a interest rate of 6 months AWPLR+1%.

*	Enrollment of 7,000 students for each intake commencing from the 8th intake of the Interest Free Student Loans Scheme.

description: Training of 7,500 Teachers on Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Digital Transformation has been recognized as a very significant component by the National Education Policy Framework, and for this purpose, the assistance  by the public and private sectors has been encouraged in order to use Artificial Intelligence and New Technologies. Accordingly, as per a project proposal submitted by Skills College of Technology (SCOT CAMPUS), an experienced institution  of conducting courses on Information Technology, Mechatronics and Robot Technology,  a pilot project has been successfully carried out. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology and the Minister of Education to train 7,500 teachers in selected schools, covering all the provinces in relation to the STEAM concept including Information Technology, Biotechnology, Engineering Technology, Mathematics, through the Skills College of Technology (SCOT CAMPUS) in three stages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Convention between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Austria for the Elimination of Double Taxation and Prevention of Fiscal Evasion and Avoidance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Convention between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Austria for the Elimination of Double Taxation and the prevention of Fiscal Evasion and Avoidance with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital has been drafted and initialed at staff-level having negotiated with the tax authorities of the two countries. In line with the recent Conventions on Elimination of Double Taxation entered into Sri Lanka, interests and royalties will be taxed at a rate not exceeding 10 percent of the gross amount. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to sign the said Convention at the State level and submit the said Convention and Protocol, to Parliament, in terms of the provisions of the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Strategy to Promote the Commercial Fishing Industry in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-09-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - An Expert Committee has been appointed to explore and recommend possible strategies to promote high impact fisheries and sustainable practices in the Sri Lankan fishing industry. The said Committee has submitted its Report named “A Strategy to Promote Sustainable Export Oriented Commercial Fisheries to Support Sri Lanka's Envisaged Economic Transformation”. The said Strategic Framework has suggested strategic proposals to transform the fishing industry in Sri Lanka as a sector that will provide a major contribution for a sectoral growth of 12% and to earn an export revenue of USD 600 million annually by the year 2030, while ensuring the sustainability in line with the principle of Blue Economy. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Fisheries, to adopt the said Strategic Framework submitted through the said Report as the strategic Framework of the Government pertaining to Sri Lankan Fishing Industry and to implement the said Strategy in keeping with a formal Strategic Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the proposed Skills Development Programme from the year 2025 onwards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Cabinet Appointed Oversight Committee on the implementation of the National Education Policy Framework has submitted the following proposals to implement on priority basis:

(i)	To provide 50,000 job focused training scholarships annually, aiming high-demand industry specific jobs through the network of public or private Vocational Training Centres to be effective from 2025 under a Student Based Funding Scheme.

(ii)	To award 60,000 Opportunities of Vocational Training Courses annually targeting students engaged in secondary education.

Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Chairman of the Cabinet Appointed Oversight Committee on the implementation of the National Education Policy Framework to implement the said proposals and to allocate provisions by the General Treasury for the ensuing period of 05 years from the year 2025 so as to securing the provisions required for the same through the financial investment of Rs. 100 million already agreed and proposed to be implemented by the Asian Development Bank and the Government and to implement the National Education Policy Framework together with the Cabinet Appointed Oversight Committee appointed to implement the said Framework and the Ministry of Education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing the opportunity to the employees attached to the Samurdhi Development Authority to be absorbed into the Department of Samurdhi Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Employees who served attached to the then Samurdhi Development Authority have been provided with the opportunity at several occasions to be absorbed the then Department of Divineguma Development at their option, with a pension during the establishment of the Department of Divineguma Development by the Divineguma Act, No.01 of 2013. Nevertheless, it has been identified that there are approximately 3000 employees who were unable to revise their option on various grounds. Accordingly, the Cabinet granted its concurrence for the proposal made by the Hon. President to provide the opportunity to the said group of employees to be absorbed to the Department of Samurdhi Development in consultation with the Public Service Commission within the existing legal framework.

description: Introduction of a new Legislation on the Rights of the Indigenous People in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by the then Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms and the Minister of Buddhasasana Religious and Cultural Affairs pertaining to introduction of a new legislation on the the rights of the indigenous people in Sri Lanka was taken up for discussion at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑05‑22. In the instance, It has been decided that it would be appropriate to further analyze the Concept Paper submitted for the preparation of the Bill, with the participation of all relevant parties. Accordingly, the relevant preliminary draft has been further improved, having conducted several rounds of discussions under the chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister and with the participation of the officials of the Ministries entrusted with the subjects of lands, wildlife and forest conservation, environment and finance, the officers of the Attorney General's Department and the officers of the Legal Draftsman's Department as well as the parties interested in the relevant field. As such, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms and the Minister of Buddhasasana Religious and Cultural Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill based on the said preliminary draft, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Colombo Port City (Management of Condominium Property) Regulations No.03 of 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to the Master Plan of the Colombo Port City, 51% of the gross floor area has been allocated for residential use which will lead to the development of Condominium Properties. Accordingly, it has been required to establish a regulatory body and to impose regulations to maintain common amenities and elements at an international standard, providing seamless living for owners and tenants of the Condominium parcels. The Colombo Port City (Management of Condominium Property) Regulations No.03 of 2024 have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2394/68 dated 2024‑07‑26 as per the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No.11 of 2021. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotions to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reconstruction of Kurinchakerny Bridge on Kinniya-Kurinchakerny	Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under Single Stage One Envelope method for the contract of reconstructing the Kurinchakerny Bridge on Kinniya-Kurinchakerny Road from the remaining funds of the Project on Development of the Badulla - Chenkalady road under the Road Network Development Project funded by the Saudi Fund for Development. 09 bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to award the said Contract to M/s ELS Construction (Pvt) Ltd, the lowest substantially responsive bidder as per the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Standing Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Printing of School Textbooks required for free distribution in the year	2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2024‑04‑01 has granted approval to print 71 types of textbooks out of the 317 types of textbooks which are to be printed for the year 2025. National Competitive Bids have been invited to print 246 types of remaining school textbooks required to be free distributed to the school children in year 2025.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to get printed the textbooks of the grades other than the Grade 1, 6 and 10 from the Printing Companies who have submitted the lowest substancially responsive bids as per the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Standing Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Administrative Arrangement between the Delegation of the European	Union arriving in Sri Lanka for observation of the Presidential Election -	2024, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Chairman of the Election Commission has invited the European Union to send an Election Observation Mission to the country to observe the Presidential Election 2024. Administrative Arrangements should be signed between the European Union Delegation visiting Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs before starting the Election Observation activities under the regulations of the said Union. Accordingly, the Administrative Arrangements relating to Observation of Presidential Election 2024 have been signed between the two parties on 2024‑08‑05 and the information presented by the Minister of Foreign Affairs in that regard were noted by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Undertanding between the United	Nations Institute for Training and Research and the Ministry of Foreign	Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to enter into a Memorandum of Undertanding between the United Nations Institute for Training and Research and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a period of 03 years with the aim of establishing a cooperative framework necessary for facilitation of mutual benefits in the following areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

* 	Training and learning support related to the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

* 	Training of Diplomats in areas such as conferences, diplomacy and multilateral negotiations, skills development in communication, mediation and leadership, content-based workshops and specialized courses in climate change and human rights.

* 	Conducting Trainings by the UNITAR Operational Satellite Applications Programme (UNOSAT) on the use of Geo‑information technologies (GIS) for disaster risk reduction and crisis management.

description: Purchase of Paddy by the Paddy Marketing Board - Yala 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The harvesting of paddy in the Yala season 2024 has been started by now and the Cabinet has already granted approval to provide pledge loans to the small and medium - scale mill owners for upto a maximum of Rs.6,000 million through commercial banks to purchase paddy in the Yala season at a subsidized interest rate. The approval of the Cabinet has been granted to take action as follows, taking into consideration the proposals presented by the Hon. President and the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries, with the aim of increasing the competitiveness of purchasing paddy and encouraging the paddy production in the upcoming Maha season.

* 	Provision of Rs. 500 million to the Paddy Marketing Board to be able to actively participate in the Government's paddy buying programme in the Yala season 2024.

*	Purchase of Nadu paddy at Rs 105/- per kg, Samba paddy at Rs 115/- per kg and Keeri Samba paddy at Rs 130/- per kg by the Paddy Marketing Board.

* 	Increasing the fertilizer subsidy of Rs.15,000/- paid per hectare up to Rs.25,000/- per hectare, to encourage farmers to cultivate paddy, so that they can get a maximum yield in the upcoming Maha season.

description: Alienation of a plot of Land of the Polonthalawa Farm belonging to the National Livestock Development Board to the Geoffrey Bawa Foundation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Manager's bungalow of the Polonthalawa farm belonging to the National Livestock Development Board has been designed by the renowned Sri Lankan  architect, Deshamanya Geoffrey Bawa. The Geoffrey Bawa Foundation has made a request to vest the said bungalow and the land of 5 acres where the said bungalow is located, on lease basis. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries to vest the said Manager's bungalow of the Polonthalawa farm and the plot of land of 05 acres where the said bungalow is located with the Geoffrey Bawa Foundation, on lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Cooperation Agreement between the Sri Lanka Export Development Board and the International Finance Corporation (IFC) to facilitate Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) to become Exporters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Cooperation Agreement between the International Finance Corporation and the Sri Lanka Export Development Board in order to facilitate the development of new exporters under the New Exporter Development Programme of the Sri Lanka Export Development Board aiming to upgrade the Small and Medium Exporters with export potentiality to the status of  Exporters. The clearance of the Attorney General and the recommendations of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs have been received for the said Cooperation Agreement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as Minister of Investment Promotion to sign the proposed Cooperation Agreement between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer a plot of land for the Rights to Servitude and Services of the buyers of Condominium Units residing in Waterfront Properties (Private) Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Board of Investment of Sri Lanka has granted a land plot of 3.03 acres for a period of 99 years to John Keells Holdings PLC or its nominee on a long term lease basis for the implementation of a mixed development project related to the tourism industry including the development of luxury condominium type housing facilities. Accordingly, an agreement has been reached between Waterfront Properties (Private) Limited, the nominee of John Keells Holdings PLC and the  Board of Investment of Sri Lanka, to implement the relevant project. As of now,  out of the 06 towers expected to be built under the project, 03 towers including 425 residential condominium/apartment units have been completed and commercial operations have also been started, and the construction of remaining 03 towers are being carried out. A land area in extent of 60.5 perches included in the leased land outside the land portion belonging to the condominium property, has been utilized to provide services of the condominium buyers. The said land section has been used for the construction of common facilities such as  television, telephone/telecommunications services, roads etc. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to transfer the rights to Servitude and Services traversing through the said land to the use of residential condominium buyers of Waterfront Properties (Private) Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka’s National Strategy on Artificial Intelligence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Eventhough Sri Lanka has already achieved a significant progress on its digital transformation journey, has yet to make a substantial impact on the global Artificial Intelligence platform. The use of artificial intelligence in key sectors such as agriculture, health services and education has the potential to increase the productivity and enhance the Government services. Thus, it makes a powerful contribution to achieve a sustainable economic growth and eradicate poverty, and also paves the way to equally distribute the benefits of Artificial Intelligence throughout the society. Sri Lanka's National Strategy on Artificial Intelligence has been prepared with the aim of fostering a digitally empowered Sri Lanka through the development and use of Artificial Intelligence. Accordingly, by the year 2030, Sri Lanka is expected to be positioned as a regional hub for artificial intelligence thereby increasing its global competitiveness and economic resilience. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology to implement Sri Lanka's National Strategy on Artificial Intelligence, which has been prepared to achieve these objectives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Financing Agreement for the Second Phase of the Development Policy Financing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The World Bank supports Sri Lanka's comprehensive reform agenda through the Development Policy Financing Programme, in parallel with the International Monetary Fund's Extended Fund Facility. The programme is a two-year programme, and its first phase has been successfully completed in the year 2023. The World Bank has agreed to provide an amount of USD 150.6 million (equivalent to 200 million US dollars) of Special Drawing Rights (SDR) to support the implementation of the Reform Plan of the Government under the second phase of the Development Policy Financing Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to enter into the relevant Agreement with the International Development Association of the World Bank Group in relation to obtaining the said financial facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Programme of mitigating the impact on the Fisheries Industry caused	due to the economic crisis and revival of the Fisheries Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Covid‑19 pandemic followed by the economic crisis and the high fuel prices had an extremely negative impact on the Fisheries Industry in Sri Lanka. The owners of the fishing vessels have to bear a huge working capital for fuel on launching the vessels and as a result engaging the vessels in fishing operations has been limited. Therefore, it has been identified the need to provide relief for the fuel used in the fishing industry and thereby, quickly restoring the said industry. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies and the Minister of Fisheries to grant an allowance of the revival of fisheries industry to the vessel owners who use diesel as fuel to receive a sum of Rs.25/- per litre and to the vessel owners using kerosene as fuel to receive a sum of Rs.25/- per litre, subject to 15 litres per day for a maximum of 25 days per month, for a period of 06 months, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Project implementation period of CHEC PORT CITY	COLOMBO (PRIVATE) LIMITED
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑08‑05 to extend the Project implementation period for CHEC PORT CITYCOLOMBO (PRIVATE) LIMITED with the exemptions applicable under the Strategic Development Projects Act, from 2024-09-07 to 2027-06-30. Accordingly, an order was published through Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2396/60 dated 2024-08-09 as per the provisions of the Strategic Development Projects Act, No.14 of 2008. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to present the said Order for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Term contract for the procurement of 03 shipments (2,100,000 Bbls+/-5%)of Murban Crude Oil during the period from 2024-11-15 to 2025-04-14
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)

Only M/s. Vitol Asia Pte. Ltd., Singapore has submitted bids for this tender. Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended to award the Contract to that Company based on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee. decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited from the registered suppliers of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to purchase 03 shipments of Murban-type Crude Oil (2,100,000 Bbls+/-5%) through a Letter of Credit issued by the Bank of Ceylon on the basis of payment in 30 days during the period from 2024-11-15 to 2025-04-14. 05 Bids were received for this and the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended the Bid submitted by the M/s.Vitol Asia Pte.Ltd., Singapore as the only responsive bid. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the Contract for the procurement of 03 shipments of Murban Crude Oil to M/s.Vitol Asia Pte.Ltd., Singapore, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expert Committee Report on the issuance of Tourists Visas Free-of-Charge
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑04‑25 to appoint an Expert Committee to examine matters on the methodology adopted by other countries pertaining to the issuance of tourist visas free-of-charge and submit a Report with recommendations. The Expert Committee appointed accordingly, has submitted a comprehensive Report, having examined matters on 08 countries competing with Sri Lanka in the tourism sector and the Hon. President brought the said Report to the notice of the Cabinet. Accordingly, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted to implement the recommendations of the said Expert Committee and to issue visas free-of-charge for identified maximum 35 countries to be validated for 30 days, for a period of 06 months commencing from 2024‑10‑01 based on the said recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Orders issued as per the provisions of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No.18 of 2011 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑05‑29 has granted approval to remove the Ports and Airports Development Levy related to the HS Codes of the Tariff Liberalization Programme under the "Sri Lanka - Singapore Free Trade Agreement". Accordingly, the Order made as per the provisions of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No.18 of 2011 has been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2377/39 dated 2024‑03‑28. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the said Order, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing the fertilizer subsidy for farmers cultivating in paddy lands for Maha Season 2024/25
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that there is a possibility to ensure the food security in the country and to enhance the productivity in crops by providing a fertilizer subsidy for farmers for paddy and other field crops cultivating in paddy lands during the Maha Season 2024/25. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries to import fertilizer through State Fertilizer Company Limited, the state-owned fertilizer company, and the private sector for the Maha Season 2024/25 and to sell at a competitive price to the farmers and to provide a financial subsidy of Rs.15,000.00 per hectare for maximum of cultivated two hectares for paddy cultivation and other crops through the Department of Agrarian Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing a Fertilizer Subsidy to the tea growers for rehabilitation of tea cultivation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been found that the facts such as increase of the prices of fertilizer and ban on the chemical fertilizer during the past period have caused to the decrease of use of fertilizer thereby declining the tea production. Therefore, it has been a timely requirement to provide a relief to the tea growers in view of promoting the use of fertilizer to increase the tea production. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries to provide a 50kg bag of chemical fertilizer with a concession of Rs.4,000/- through State Fertilizer Company Limited, the state-owned fertilizer company, to the tea growers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Contract for Rehabilitation and Improvement of Access Roads to Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal (KMTT)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Under the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal Development Project, bids have been invited for the award of the contract for the rehabilitation and improvement of access roads to the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal, following the local competitive bidding procedure. 10 bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to award the relevant contract to Maga Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd, the substantially responsive bidder, as per the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new building for the National Institute of Business Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The head office of the National Institute of Business Management, which operates as a Self-Financing establishment, is located at Vidya Mawatha, Colombo 07, and owing to inadequate room facilities, 02 private buildings located nearby have been acquired on lease basis and courses are being currently conducted for about 3,000 students. A proposal has been made to construct a new building complex with modern facilities for the institute so that more students could be provided educational facilities and new academic courses could also be introduced. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to acquire a plot of Government or private land located nearby the head office of the National Institute of Business Management, using the funds of the Institute and construct a new building complex in the said plot of land, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of “Students' Artificial Intelligence (AI) Clubs” to the Education System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been found that it is appropriate to provide opportunities for school students to engage in studies related to the artificial intelligence in order to achieve the goals of creating citizens who can face future global trends and obtaining their effective contribution to the economic development. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology and the Minister of Education to implement “Students' Artificial Intelligence (AI) Clubs” as a pilot project with the participation of students studying from Grade 6 to 9 in 100 selected schools and to extend this programme in the coming years to the other schools as well, based on the progress of the said project as an initial step, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Application of 'Aswesuma' Welfare Benefits Criteria for the Plantation Worker Families living in Line Rooms
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Welfare Benefits Board currently implements the 'Aswesuma' Benefits Scheme and the selection of the relevant beneficiaries is carried out as per the Welfare Benefit Payment (Selection of Persons Eligible to Receive Payments) Regulations No.1 of 2022 made under the Welfare Benefits Act, No. 24 of 2002. Individuals or families who fulfill the eligible criteria prescribed under the said Regulations are entitled to receive 'Aswesuma' benefits. In the plantation sector, the extended families of plantation workers often reside in shared line rooms due to the unavailability of individual housing within the estates. According to the current practice, all individuals living in the line rooms are treated as one family unit, irrespective of the number of separate families cohabiting in these spaces and this situation seems disadvantageous for the said families. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. President to direct the Welfare Benefits Board to pursue action taking into account the actual plantation worker families living in line rooms in determining the eligible criteria for the 'Aswesuma' Scheme under the Welfare Benefit Payment (Selection of Persons Eligible to Receive Payments) Regulations No.1 of 2022, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposals to revise salaries in the Public Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑05-27 to appoint an Expert Committee to review the salaries, wages, and other allowances in the public sector and submit a Report with recommendations for implementing the proposals to revise the salaries in all sectors of the public service through the Budget 2025. Accordingly, the Expert Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of Mr. Udaya Senevirathne, Former Secretary to the President has negotiated with the Government Officers and major trade unions in the public sector and an Interim Report has been submitted having analyzed the relevant information. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to grant policy approval for the following proposals recommended by the said Report and to implement the said proposals having included them into the Budget 2025, was approved by the Cabinet.

* 	Classification of all posts in the entire public sector under 04 Main levels 	and  classification of recruitment qualifications into sub-categories based on the Sri Lanka Qualification Guide (SLQF) and National Vocational Qualification (NVQ) and taking into account the relevant job role, responsibilities and attracting employees with skills for the special jobs and keeping them in jobs.

* 	Following the Sri Lanka Qualification Guide as basic qualifications for recruitment for the Primary Service categories as well and following the appropriate selection procedures on the service requirement based on the National Vocational Skills.  

* 	Recruitment for all other service categories only through formal competitive examinations and interview methods.

* 	Accordingly, expeditious revision of existing approved recruitment procedures as appropriate.

* 	Payment of Rs. 25,000/- per month as the cost of living allowance to all the Government employees (subject to revision once in every 03 years), adding all the allowances such as, various adjustments made to the cost of living allowances and the allowances already added,  considering 2025 as the base year.

* 	Increasing the minimum Initial monthly salary of the Public service by a minimum percentage of 24% and taking the gross salary with cost of living allowance as Rs.55,000/- and adjusting the basic salary for all other posts accordingly.

* 	Implementation of this new Salary and Allowance Procedure for all the public institutions except Business State Companies and Banks.

* 	Taking measures to limit the total number of employees in the public service to Ten lakhs (1,000,000) or less, by 2030.

* 	Accordingly, introducing a methodology for the administration of the Government (E-Governance) in every possible field of the entire public service , through Digitalization and Automation and giving the priority of investment for that, within 03 years from 2025. 

* 	Implementation of a Medical Insurance Scheme including all the employees and retirees of the public sector, being entitled to the most attractive benefits with a minimum monthly contribution of Rs. 1000/- , from January 2025. 

* 	Obtaining services by following the prescribed methodologies so as to maximize the efficiency and minimizing the cost burden of the Government through methodologies such as Outsourcing whenever possible.

* 	Implementation of the restructuring programme for conversion of the identified Government Departments/Corporations/Statutory Institutions into Public Liability Companies listed in the Stock Market.

* 	Conduct a proper work study and take action to conduct a scientific study on  the entire public sector staff and services in year 2025.

* 	Accordingly, preparing the performance indicators for all the public servants and provide salary increments based on their progress.

* 	Providing salary increments entitled for the public officers retired before year 2020 and revising their pension and resolving the relevant anomalies. 

*   	Providing the Cost of Living Allowance to the retirees, equivalent to 50 % of the Cost of Living Allowance provided for the public officers engaged in active service, from January 2025 onwards. 

* 	Implementation of the Salary System, subject to the management of these expenditures within the existing tax policy and implementation of the proposed Salary System from 2025-01-01 in stages, taking into consideration the fiscal space as well.

description: Designate COLOMBO MARINA DEVELOPMENT (PRIVATE) LIMITED as a Primary Business of Strategic Importance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - COLOMBO MARINA DEVELOPMENT (PRIVATE) LIMITED, a fully owned company of Browns Investment PLC, has been leased out 04 land plots within the Authority Area of the Colombo Port City for the Marina Development Project. The project has been designed with a Capitainerie with a full capacity which can accommodate 243 vessels, club houses for guests, retail outlets including food and beverages, entertainment venues, event spaces and car parking spaces. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion, to designate COLOMBO MARINA DEVELOPMENT (PRIVATE) LIMITED, as a Business of Strategic Importance as per the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021, and to grant exemptions and incentives for the said Business, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proceeds of Crime Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑04‑25 to prepare the Proceeds of Crime Bill in line with the Report of the Committee to develop the Policy and Legal Framework and draft provisions of the proposed law on Proceeds of Crime. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Publishing the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (Amendment)	Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022-05-02 has granted approval to amend the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has also been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development to publish the said (Amendment) Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Pinnawala - Kitulgala Tourism Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A provision of Rs. 750 million has been allocated through a Budget Proposal of 2024 to the Ministry of Tourism and Lands for the development of the Pinnawala-Kitulgala Tourism Zone. The Department of National Planning has recommended to implement several Infrastructure Facilities Development Projects that have been identified under the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to implement the Projects identified with related to the Pinnawala-Kitulgala Tourism Belt Development Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Framework for leasing of lands to develop an internationally	recognized School, University and Hospital in Colombo Port City
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Section 6(1)(c) of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, has entrusted the power to the Commission to lease the lands located within the territory of Colombo Port City and the Government marketable lands which has been vested with the Commission. Accordingly, the Colombo Port City Economic Commission has invited proposals to select the investors for the development of projects of School, University and Hospital in the Colombo Port City. Asiri Port City Hospital (Private) Limited and Gateway International School (Pvt) Ltd. have submitted a proposal to invest approximately USD 100 million for the Hospital,  USD 25 million for the school and  USD 25 million for the University. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to enter into Agreements for the lease of plots of land for the Hospital, School and University as per the provisions of Section 6(1)(c) of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repatriation of Export Proceeds into Sri Lanka Rules No. 01 of 2024 under the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, No. 16 of 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-08-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Exporters, representatives of exporters and certain government agencies have submitted requests to the Central Bank of Sri Lanka to relax the existing Rules of Export Proceeds, i.e. "Repatriation of Export Proceeds into Sri Lanka Rules No. 01 of 2022 (as amended)".
