description: Agriculture  Modernization  Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval  of  the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  at  the  meeting  held  on  2024‑03‑04  to  implement  the  first  stage  of  the  of  the  Agriculture  Modernization  Project.  As  the  second  stage  of  the  said  programme,  it  has  been  decided  to  select  another  03  Divisional  Secretariat  Divisions  from  each  district  and  implement  Agriculture  Modernization  Projects.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  President,  to  implement  the  second  stage  of  the  Agriculture  Modernization  Project  utilizing  Rs.  750  million  from  the  provisions  allocated  in  the  Budget  for  the  year  2024,  to  75  Divisional  Secretariat  Divisions,  Rs.10  million  each  for  a  Divisional  Secretariat  Division,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Amendment  of  the  Constitution  of  the  Democratic  Socialist  Republic  of  Sri  Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Policy  approval  of  the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  on  2024‑07‑09  to  amend  the paragraph (b) of  Article 83 of  the  Constitution of the Democratic Socialist  Republic of Sri Lanka by the substitution  of  the  words  “to  over  six  years”  with  the  words  “to  over  five  years” as  stated in  paragraph  (b)  of  Article  83  of  the  Constitution.  Accordingly,  the  clearance  of  the  Attorney  General  has  been  received  for  the  Bill  drafted  by  the  Legal  Draftsman.  The  joint  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  President  and  the  Minister  of  Justice,Prison  Affairs  and  Constitutional  Reforms,  to  publish  the  said  Bill  in  the  Government  Gazette  and  thereafter,  present  the  same  in  Parliament  for  approval,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Amendments  to  the  Primary  Court's  Procedure  Act,  No.44  of  1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval  of  the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  on  2024‑03‑18  to  amend  the  Primary  Court's  Procedure  Act  in  order  to  overcome  the  issues  faced  by  the  applicants  who  make  applications  under  section  66  of  the  said  Act.  Accordingly,  the  Certificate  of  Constitutionality  of  the  Attorney  General  has  been  received  for  the  Bill  prepared  by  the  Legal  Draftsman.  The  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Justice,  Prison  Affairs  and  Constitutional  Reforms,  to  publish  the  said  Bill  in  the  Government  Gazette  and  thereafter,  present  the  same  in  Parliament  for  approval,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Obtaining  approval  for  the  amendments  proposed  to  the  Animal  Welfare  Bill  by  the  Sectoral  Oversight  Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval  of  the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  on  2022‑01‑10  to  submit  the  Animal  Welfare  Bill,  to  Parliament  and  accordingly,  the  said  Bill  has  been  submitted  to  Parliament.  The  said  Bill  has  been  submitted  to  the  Sectoral  Oversight  Committee  on  Food  Security  and  Agriculture  for  its  recommendations  and  the  said  Committee  has  proposed  several  amendments  to  the  said  Bill.  The  Legal  Draftsman  has  prepared  the  said  amendments  so  that  it  could  be  presented  at  the  Committee  Stage  of  the  said  Bill  in  Parliament  and  the  clearance  of  the  Attorney  general  has  been  received  for  the  same.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Agriculture  and  Plantation  Industries  to  present  the  relevant  amendments  at  the  Committee  Stage  of  the  Animal  Welfare  Bill  in  Parliament,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Procuring  medicinal  Ginger  required  for  manufacturing  purposes  in  the  Sri  Lanka  Ayurvedic  Drugs  Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Medicinal  ginger  is  used  as  an  ingredient  for  87  types  of  medicines  manufactured  by  the  Sri  Lanka  Ayurvedic  Drugs  Corporation,  and  currently  there  is  a  severe  shortage  of  medicinal  ginger  in  the  market.  There  is  a  stock  of  50  tons  of  medicinal  ginger  that  has  been  confiscated  by  the  Sri  Lanka  Customs,  and  the  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Health  to  get  the  said  stock  of  medicinal  ginger  at  concessional  prices  to  the  Sri  Lanka  Ayurveda  Drugs  Corporation,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Launching  the  SMART  Youth  Exhibitions  &  Nights-2024  Programme  implemented  by  the  National  Youth  Services  Council,  islandwide
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  young  community  had  to  face  an  extremely  stressful  situation  due  to  the  restrictions  of  travel,  mutual  relationships,  personal  meetings  and  gatherings  in  groups  amidst  the  severe  impact  of  the  Covid-19  pandemic,  which  prevailed  globally  for  two  years  from  the  year  2019.  It  has  been  found  that  it  is  advisable  to  hold  recreational  programmes  islandwide  aimed  at  preventing  the  youth  from  being  subjected  to  such  pressures,  developing  their  entertainment,  enjoyment  and  mental  wellness,  providing  opportunities  for  the  young  community  to  maintain  social  relationships  physically,  and  giving  them  the  opportunity  to  work  together  as  well.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Sports  and  Youth  Affairs  to  implement  the  SMART  Youth  Exhibitions  &  Nights  -  2024  programme  covering  the  entire  island,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Completion  of  the  work  of  the  Nanu  Oya  Railway  Station  Modernization  Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval  of  the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  at  the  Cabinet  meeting  held  on  2023‑04‑03  to  implement  the  Nanu  Oya  Railway  Station  Modernization  Project  utilizing  the  funds  of  the  Sri  Lanka  Tourism  Development  Authority  and  the  Sri  Lanka  Tourism  Promotion  Bureau.  Due  to  revision  in  the  prices  of  construction  materials,  the  contract  value  of  Rs.74.63  million  for  the  modernization  of  Nanu  Oya  railway  station  has  increased  to  Rs.101.81  million.  Accordingly,  Cabinet  approved  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Tourism  and  Lands  to  complete  the  relevant  modernization  works  under  the  Central  Engineering  Consultancy  Bureau,  on  the  recommendation  of  the  Department  of  Sri  Lanka  Railways  and  to  secure  additional  provisions  required  for  the  purpose  from  the  Sri  Lanka  Tourism  Development  Authority  and  the  Sri  Lanka  Tourism  Promotion  Bureau.

description: Allocation  of  Funds  from  the  Saudi  Fund  for  Development  to  complete  	the  	section  I  of  the  half  completed  work  of  the  Godagama-Homagama  	Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Funds  of  the  Saudi  Fund  for  Development  have  been  utilized  to  implement  the  Kurinchakerny  Bridge  Project  in  Trincomalee  District.  After  completion  of  the  procurement  process  of  the  said  project,  there  is  still  a  loan  balance  of  US$  10.5  and  it  has  been  decided  to  utilize  the  said  balance  amount  for  the  completion  of  Section  I  of  the  Godagama-Homagama  road,  which  is  half  completed.  In  order  to  complete  the  rest  of  the  said  road,  an  amount  of  US$  12  million  is  needed  and  the  Saudi  Fund  for  Development  has  agreed  to  provide  the  remaining  US$1.5  million  from  the  loan  amount  of  the  Road  Network  Development  Project  funded  by  the  Saudi  Fund  for  Development.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Transport  and  Highways,  to  secure  funds  and  complete  section  I  of  the  Godagama-Homagama  road,  which  is  half  completed,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Awarding  the  Contract  for  provisioning  of  Automated  Seat  Upgrade	Bidding  Services  and  Associated  Ancillary  Services  for  SriLankan  	Airlines  	Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - SriLankan  Airlines  Limited  is  currently  using  the  Plusgrade  system  for  Automated  Seat  Upgrade  Bidding  Services  and  Associated  Ancillary  Services.  This  service  increases  the  revenue  of  the  Airline  service  by  providing  an  opportunity  for  a  passenger  holding  an  economy  class  flight  ticket  to  bid  for  a  business  class  ticket  when  there  are  unreserved  seats  available  in  business  class.  Bids  have  been  invited  under  the  International  Competitive  Bidding  Procedure  for  maintaining  this  service,  and  02  bids  have  been  received  for  that.	The  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Ports,  Shipping  and  Aviation  to  evaluate  said  bids  and  thereafter,  to  award  the  Contract  for  provisioning  of  Automated	Seat  Upgrade  Bidding  Services  and  Associated  Ancillary  Services  for	SriLankan  Airlines  to  Plusgrade  Inc.  for  a  period  of  five  (05)  years,  based  on  the  recommendations  of  the  Technical  Evaluation  Committee  and  the  Standing  Cabinet    Appointed  Procurement  Committee,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Implementation  of  Currency  Exchange  Counters  at  Arrival  Post  Customs	Area  at  Bandaranaike  International  Airport  (BIA),  Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- In  terms  of  the  Cabinet  decision  dated  2024-01-08,  Airport  and  Aviation Services  (Sri  Lanka)  (Pvt)  Limited  has  invited  Limited  Competitive  Bids  to implement  the  Currency  Exchange  Counters  at  Arrival  Post  Customs  Area  at Bandaranaike  International  Airport  (BIA),  Katunayake.  05  bids  have  been submitted  for  that.  The  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Ports,  Shipping  and Aviation  to  evaluate  the  said  bids  and  thereafter,  to  award  the  contracts  as  follows  for  a  period  of  three  (03)  years,  based  on  the  recommendations  of  the  Technical  Evaluation  Committee  and  the  Standing  Cabinet Appointed  Procurement  Committee,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Implementation   of  the  Tariff  Policy  and  Formula  to  review  the  tariff  for  	the  National  Water  Supply  and  Drainage  Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  new  Tariff  Policy  and  Formula  of  the  National  Water  Supply  and  Drainage  Board  was  discussed  at  the  Cabinet  meeting  held  on  2024-04-08,  where  it  has  been  directed  to  present  the  new  Tariff  Policy  and  Formula  by  incorporating    the  necessary  revisions  in  consultation  with  all  the  relevant  parties.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Water  Supply  and  Estate  Infrastructure  Development  to  implement  the  revised  Water  Tariff  Policy  and  the  revised  Water  Tariff  Formula  prepared  accordingly,  from  year  2025,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Leasing  out  a  plot  of  land  located  at  Mudun  Ela,  Kelaniya  to  Storight	Logistics  (Pvt)  Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bitsuthra  IT  (Pvt)  Ltd.  has  submitted  a  request  to  provide  a  plot  of  land 	located near  the  Port  of  Colombo  for  logistics  services  and  storage  facilities  	upon the  approval  of  the  Board  of  Investment  of  Sri  Lanka.  Since  the  project	proposal  submitted  by  the  said  company  has  fulfilled  the  relevant  basic 	requirements,  a  new  company  named  Storight  Logistics  (Pvt)  Ltd.  has  been	established  as  per  the  provisions  of  the  Board  of  Investment.  A  plot  of  land  	with  the  extent  of  02  acres  1.08  perches  owned  by  the  Sri  Lanka  Land  	Development Corporation  located  in  Mudun  Ela  area,  Kelaniya  has  been  	identified  as suitable  for  the said  project.  Accordingly,the  proposal  made  by  	the Minister  of  Urban  Development  and  Housing  to  lease  out  the  said  plot  of  	land  to  Storight Logistics  (Pvt)  Ltd.  for  a  period  of  30  years  based  on  the  	current  valuation submitted  by  the  Government  Chief  Valuer,  was  approved  by  	the  Cabinet.

description: Providing  a  land  located  at  Wedamulla,  Kelaniya  to  H.M.K.  Property	Developers  (Pvt)  Ltd.  for  a  Housing  Project  approved  by  Board  of	Investment  of  Sri  Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval  has  been  granted  previously  at  the  Cabinet  Sub-Committee  meeting	on  Investment  Promotion  to  grant  approval  to  provide  a  land  of  about  12  	acres in  extent  located  in  Wedamulla,  Kelaniya  owned  by  the  Sri  Lanka  Land	Development  Corporation  to  H.M.K.  Property  Developers  (Pvt)  Ltd.  However,	due  to  the  company's  failure  to  adhere  with  the  relevant  agreements,  no  steps	have  been  taken  so  far  to  hand  over  the  relevant  plot  of  land  to  the  said  	company.  H.M.K.  Property  Developers  (Pvt)  Ltd.  had  made  a  request  again  	through  the  Board  of  Investment  of  Sri  Lanka  to  obtain  the  relevant  plot  of  	land  in  order  to  implement  a  Housing  Project  under  03  stages  of  that  land.  	Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Urban  Development  and  	Housing  to  provide  a  plot  of  land  with  the  extent  of  08  acres  -  02  roods  -  	16.26  perches  identified  for  the  implementation  of  the  proposed  project,  to  the  	said  company  based  on  the  current  valuation  submitted  by  the  Government  	Chief  Valuer,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Provision  of  facilities  for  the  admission  of  Foreign  Students  to  Degree	Awarding  Institutes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Currently,  a  percentage  of  5%  is  allocated  annually  for  foreign  students  in  17  universities  under  the  University  Grants  Commission.  In  addition,  it  has  been  identified  that  the  aim  of  making  Sri  Lanka  the  Knowledge  Hub  in  Asia  can  be  achieved  by  expanding  the  opportunities  for  admission  of  foreign  students  to  the  26  Degree  Awarding  Institutions  recognized  by  section  25A  of  the  Universities  Act  as  well.  However,  it  is  observed  that  there  is  no  specific  methodology  to  determine  the  ability  to  comply  with  the  recognized  minimum  qualifications  considered  for  university  entrance  by  each  country,  as  a  requirement  for  admission  to  a  degree  in  a  Degree  Awarding  Institution  recognized  under  section  25A  of  the  Universities  Act  in  Sri  Lanka.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Education  to  consider  the  minimum  qualification  used  for  university  admission  in  193  member  countries  of  the  United  Nations  as  the  minimum  qualification  for  entering  into  Degree  courses  offered  by  the  recognized  Degree  Awarding  Institutions  under  section  25A  of  the  Universities  Act  in  Sri  Lanka  and  to  obtain  confirmation  from  the  UK  NARIC  Institution  for  exceptional  occassions  not  disclosed  by  the  said  qualifications,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: The National Traditional Medicine Policy of Sri Lanka 2024-2034
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  Ayurveda  Act,  No.  31  of  1961  amended  by  the  Ayurveda  (Amendment)  Act,  No.  19  of  2023,  has  provided  the  legal  framework  for  the  implementation  of  Traditional  Medicine  System  in  the  country.  However,  no  single  National  policy  has  been  drafted  that  steers  the  direction  of  the  Government  Policy  for  the  Traditional  Medical  Service.  The  need  for  an  Traditional  National  Medical  Policy  has  arisen  in  the  National  Health  Policy  of  the  mainstream  in  order  to  solve  the  problems  that  have  arisen  in  the  current  service  delivery  and  to  present  a  quality  and  strong  medical  system  to  the  future  generation  by  preserving  the  Traditional  Medicine  System.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  President  in  his  capacity  as  the  Minister  of  Finance,  Economic  Stabilization  and  National  Policies  to  implement  the  National  Traditional  Medicine  Policy  of  Sri  Lanka  2024-2034  prepared  through  an  extensive  participatory  process  by  a  panel  of  experts,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Uninterrupted  functioning  of  teaching  in  schools  and  patient  care	services  in  	hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  attention  of  the  Cabinet  was  drawn  to  the  pressure  imposed  and  irregular    actions  carried  out  by  certain  groups,  hindering  the  teaching  in  schools  during  school  hours  and  causing  disruption  to  the  patient  care  services  in  hospitals  and  the  Cabinet  decided  to  take  necessary  action  to  introduce  new  laws  to  prevent  the  injustices  caused  to  school  children  and  patients  through  such  unlawful  acts.

description: Difficulties  encountered  by  certain  Regional  Plantation  Companies	pertaining  to  the  payment  of  a  reasonable  remuneration  to  the	plantation  	workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  Secretary  to  the  Ministry  of  Finance,  Economic  Stabilization  and  National  Policies  was  instructed  at  the  Cabinet  meeting  held  on  2024-05-22  to  estimate  the  salary  to  be  paid  for  a  plantation  worker  per  day,  giving  due  consideration  to  the  cost  of  living  and  the  impact  caused  by  the  economic  crisis  which  has  arisen  in  the  country  recently.  And,  it  was  also  decided  at  the  Cabinet  meeting  to  appoint  a  committee  to  determine  the  capacity  of  each  Regional  Plantation  Company  to  pay  the  said  remuneration.  The  Cabinet  decided  to  expedite  the  process  of  enacting  necessary  legislation  to  cancel  the  Land  Lease  Agreements  entered  into  by  the  Government  with  the  Regional  Plantation  Companies  which  do  not  pay  the  due  remuneration  to  their  plantation  workers,  inspite  of  having  the  capacity  to  do  so  based  on  the  recommendations  of  the  said  committee.

description: Amendment  to  the  Constitution  of  the  Democratic  Socialist  Republic  of  	Sri  	Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It  is  observed  that  there  is  an  inconsistency  among  Article  30(2),  Article  62(2)  and  Article  83(b)  of  the  Constitution  regarding  the  term  of  Office  of  the  President  and  the  duration  of  Parliament.  The  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  President  to  prepare  a  draft  for  the  Constitution  to  amend  Article  83(b)  of  the  Constitution  by  substituting  the  words  “to  over  six  years”  with  the  words  “to  over  five  years”  to  avoid  doubt  and  eliminate  any  inconsistency  in  that  regard,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Appraisal  of  the  Public  Servants  of  Non-Executive  Service  Category	reported  for  duty  on  08th  and  09th  July  2024  without  engaging  in  	Trade	Union  Actions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  Trade  Unions  of  certain  services  of  Non-Executive  Service  Category  of  the  Public  Service  have  announced  trade  union  actions  of  taking  sick  leave  and  enagaging  in  strike  on  2024-07-08  and  09.  However,  it  is  observed  that  some  public  servants  have  understood  the  current  situation  of  the  country  and  performed  their  responsibility  for  the  country  in  a  manner  that  does  not  cause  inconvenience  towards  the  public.  The  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  President  to  grant  a  special  salary  increment  which  is  not  applicable  for  the  calculation  of  pension,  to  the  public  officials  of  the  Non-Executive  Service  categories  who  reported  for  duty  on  both  08th  and  09th  July  2024, without engaging  in  trade  union  actions  causing  inconvenience  towards  the  public and  to  issue  a  special  certificate  of  commendation  to  all  of  them  to  be  used  for  future  promotions,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Establishment  of  new  Settlement  Villages  in  the  Plantation  Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Since  the  communities  living  in  the  existing  housing  settlements  in  the  plantation  areas  are  not  systematically  receiving  the  services  provided  by  the  Government  institutions  at  village  level,  the  necessity  of  converting  the  plantation  housing  settlements  into  settlement  villages  has  been  identified  in  order  to  treat  them  with  respect  and  dignity.  Accordingly,  it  is  expected  to  introduce  a  new  legislation  to  amalgamate  the  plantation  housing  settlements  and  line  rooms  currently  found  in  the  plantation  areas  and  convert  them  into  villages.  The  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  President  to  instruct  the  Legal  Draftsman  to  prepare  a  Bill  for  the  same,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: The  First  Programme  of  Cooperation  in  the  fields  of  Education,  	Science,	Culture,  Mass  Media,  Youth  and  Sports  between  Sri  Lanka  	and  	Romania
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  Government  of  the  Democratic  Socialist  Republic  of  Sri  Lanka  and  the  Government  of  Romania  have  entered  into  an  agreement  in  order  to  promote  cultural  cooperation  between  the  two  countries.  According  to  the  said  agreement,  the  relevant  parties  have  agreed  for  the  First  Programme  of  Cooperation  in  the  fields  of  Education,  Science,  Culture,  Mass  Media,  Youth  and  Sports.  The  proposal  made  by  the  Acting  Minister  of  Foreign  Affairs  to  sign  the  Memorandum  of  Understanding  on  the  implementation  of  the  said  Programme  of  Cooperation  during  the  official  visit  to  Romania  to  be  made  by  the  Minister  of  Foreign  Affairs,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Protection  of  Occupants  Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  approval  of  the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  at  the  meeting  held  on  2023-09-04  to  introduce  a  new  law  with  the  aim  to  protect  the  rights  of  the  tenant  and  the  landlord  equally  after  repealing  the  Rent  Act,  No.  7  of  1972.  Accordingly,  the  Bill  prepared  by  the  Legal  Draftsman  has  received  the  clearance  of  the  Attorney  General.  The  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Justice,  Prison  Affairs  and  Constitutional  Reforms  to  publish  the  said  Bill  in  the  Government  Gazette  and  thereafter  present  the  same  for  approval  in  Parliament,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: An  Act  to  repeal  Rent  Act,  No.  7  of  1972
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  approval  of  the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  at  the  meeting  held  on      2023-09-04  to  prepare  a  Bill  to  repeal  the  Rent  Act,  No.  7  of  1972.  Accordingly,  the  Bill  prepared  by  the  Legal  Draftsman  has  received  the  clearance  of  the  Attorney  General.  The  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Justice,  Prison  Affairs  and  Constitutional  Reforms  to  publish  the  said  Bill  in  the  Government  Gazette  and  thereafter  present  the  same  for  approval  in  Parliament,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Mid  -Year  Fiscal  Position  Report  -  2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In  terms  of  the  Section  10  of  the  Fiscal  Management  (Responsibility)  Act,  No.3  of  2003,  the  Minister  in  charge  of  the  subject  of  Finance  is  required  to  table  the    Mid-Year  Fiscal  Position  Report  in  Parliament  and  release  the  report  to  the  public  by  the  last  day  of  the  month  of  June  in  year  2024.  Accordingly,  Mid-Year  Fiscal  Position  Report  has  been  published  on  the  website  of  the  Ministry  of  Finance,  Economic  Stabilization  and  National  Policies.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  President  in  his  capacity  as  the  Minister  of  Finance,  Economic  Stabilization  and  National  Policies  to  table  the  said  Report  in  Parliament,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Launching  the  "Vidyawardhana/Arivezhchi/Empower  STEM"  Teacher  Training  Programme  for  Teachers  in  the  Plantation  Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  Government  of  India  has  agreed  to  provide  a  grant  of  Rs.3  billion  for  the  implementation  of  projects  identified  to  improve  the  living  conditions  of  the  plantation  community.  As  one  of  the  projects  under  the  same,  it  has  been  identified  to  provide  the  necessary  facilities  to  encourage  to  pursue  the  subjects  of  Science,  Technology,  Engineering  and  Mathematics  (STEM)  among  the  students  in  the  plantation  community.  Accordingly,  the  joint  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Education  and  the  Minister  of  Water  Supply  and  Estate  Infrastructure  Development  to  implement  the  "Vidyawardhana/Arivezhchi/Empower  STEM"  Teacher  Training  Programme  to  meet  the  severe  dearth  of  qualified  STEM  teachers  in    schools  in  the  plantation  sector,  under  the  said  project,    was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Submission  of  Regulations  to  Parliament  for  approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  Money  or  Value  Transfer  Service  Providers  Regulations  No.  1  of  2024  under  section  17  of  the  Payment  and  Settlement  Systems  Act,  No.  28  of  2005  to  be  read  with  section  11  therein  have  been  published  through  the  Gazette  Extraordinary  Notification  No.  2382/11  dated  2024‑04‑30.  The  Proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  President  in  his  capacity  as  the  Minister  of  Finance,  Economic  Stabilization  and  National  Policies  to  submit  the  said  Regulations  to  Parliament  for  approval,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Commemoration  of  the  100th  year  after  the  establishment  of  Berlin  	Buddhist  Centre  in  Germany
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A  centenary  celebration  is  scheduled  to  be  held  in  Berlin  to  mark  the  100  years  of  the  establishment  of  the  Buddhist  Center  in  Berlin,  Germany  by  the  year  2024.  In  parallel  with  the  said  centenary  programme,  arrangements  have  been  made  to  conduct  a  programme  centering  Colombo.  The  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  Prime  Minister  to  launch  the  book  'Das  Buddhistische  Haus  (1924-2024)'  printed  by  Vijitha  Yapa  Publishers  and  to  issue  a  Commemorative  Stamp  by  the  Department  of  Posts  -  Sri  Lanka,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Introduction  of  a  Special  Provisions  Act  to  provide  for  re-registration  of  Companies  incorporated  or  registered  under  the  Companies  Act  No.  7  of  2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  procedures,  operations  and  other  requirements  relating  to  companies  operating  in  Sri  Lanka  are  indicated  under  the  Companies  Act  No.  7  of  2007  and  the  number  of  companies  incorporated  or  registered  under  the  said  Act  is  approximately  199,484  as  at  2024‑03‑31.  Since  there  are  no  provisions  in  the  existing  Act  to  identify  the  active  number  of  companies  out  of  the  companies  which  are  currently  incorporated  or  registered  under  the  said  Act,  it  has  been  identified  that  it  is  appropriate  to  enact  a  new  law  for  that  purpose.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Industries  to  introduce  a  new  law  to  provide  for  re-registration  of  Companies  incorporated  or  registered  under  the  Companies  Act  No.  7  of  2007  and  to  instruct  the  Legal  Draftsman  to  prepare  a  Bill  based  on  the  Concept  Paper  prepared  for  the  same,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Supply  of  Equipment  of  High-Quality  Radiotherapy  with  High  Energy  Radiation  for  Cancer  Patients  in  Sri  Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - An  Agreement  has  been  entered  into  between  Electra  Ltd  UK  and  the  Ministry  of  Health  in  the  year  2013  for  the  supply  of  14  Linear  Accelerators  (LINAC)  machines  under  two  phases,  utilized  for  cancer  treatments.  Accordingly,  the  first  phase  of  the  said  project  has  already  been  implemented  whereas  the  second  phase  of  the  same  has  not  yet  been  implemented.  Since  many  important  features  which  are  standards  of  modern  cancer  treatments  utilized  at  present  are  not  available  in  the  specifications  of  the  Initial  Agreement  signed  in  2013,  a  proposal  has  been  submitted  by  Oncologists  in  Sri  Lanka  to  secure  upgraded  machines.  Accordingly,      the  Cabinet  granted  its  approval  to  upgrade  the  LINAC  machines  provided  to  the  National  Hospital  of  Kandy,  National  Hospital  of  Karapitiya,  Teaching  Hospital  of  Jaffna  and  the  Teaching  Hospital  of  Batticaloa  under  the  first  phase  and  to  secure  the  modern  Radiotherapy  equipment  for  05  Hospitals  of  Rathnapura,  Badulla,  Hambanthota,  Anuradhapura  and  Kurunegala  under  the  second  phase  within  the  Medium  Term  Budgetary  Framework  2024‑2026  on  priority  basis,  taking  into  consideration  the  proposals  submitted  by  the  Minister  of  Health  and  based  on  the  recommendations  submitted  by  the  Oncologists  and  those  of  the  Technical  Evaluation  Committee.

description: Obtaining  Ambulances  for  the  1990  Suwa  Seriya  Foundation  as  Free  	Grants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - "1990  Suwa  Seriya  Foundation"  was  commenced  utilizing  297  Ambulances  obtained  from  TATA  Sons  (Pvt)  Ltd  under  a  grant  of  the  Government  of  India  in  the  year  2016  to  provide  pre-hospital  care  and  emergency  treatments.  At  present,  322  Ambulances  including  25  Ambulances  granted  by  the  Government  of  Sri  Lanka  have  been  deployed  for  the  same.  As  per  the  target  of  the    Suwa  Seriya  Foundation,  450  Ambulances  and  25  Back-up  Ambulances  are  required  to  provide  the  service  expeditiously  and  it  has  been  identified  that  there  is  a  shortage  of  150  Ambulances  at  present.  Accordingly,    TATA  Sons  (Pvt)  Ltd  of  India  has  agreed  to  provide  50  Ambulances  as  a  free  grant  whereas  the  Asian  Development  Bank  is  in  agreement  to  provide  45  Ambulances  as  a  grant.  As  such,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Health  to  take  necessary  action  to  obtain  the  said  Ambulances  to  the  "1990  Suwa  Seriya  Foundation",  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Expansion  of  the  Sisu  Seriya  Service  Project  implemented  by  the  National  Transport  Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  National  Transport  Commission  has  started  the  Sisu  Seria  Project  since  2005,  with  the  aim  of  providing  a  more  reliable  bus  service  under  a  concessionary  fare  system  so  that  school  children  can  come  to  school  punctually  without  mental  or  physical  discomfort  and  go  home  safely  after  completing  their  educational  activities.  Under  that  project,  students  are  transported  by  the  the  Sri  Lanka  Transport  Board  and  private  buses.  1,537  Sisu  Seriya  bus  services  are  currently  operating  covering  all  the  district  in  Sri  Lanka,  providing  transportation  facilities  to  about  one  lakhs  of  school  children  per  day.  As  students  are  charged  only  half  of  the  bus  fare  under  the  project,  subsidy  payments  will  be  made  at  the  rate  of  Rs.105/-  per  kilometer  for  a  maximum  of  110  kilometers  per  day  to  compensate  for  the  loss  incurred  to  the  bus  operator.  The  requests  made  by  the  parents  and  schools  who  have  not  been  able  to  secure  private  transport  facilities  and  are  economically  distressed  owing  to  the  increase  of  fuel  prices,  have  been  increased.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Transport  and  Highways  to  allocate  provisions  amounting  to  Rs.202  million  required  to  start  500  new  Sisu  Seriya  bus  services  in  the  year  2024  from  the  revenue  earned  by  the  National  Transport  Commission,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Establishing  60  smart  classrooms  in  selected  Plantation  Schools  located  in  Nuwara  Eliya,  Kandy  and  Badulla  districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval  of  the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  at  the  meeting  held  on  2023‑12‑18  to  enter  into  a  Memorandum  of  Understanding  with  the  Government  of  India  in  order  to  implement  the  project  of  the  Construction  of  60  smart  classrooms  in  selected  Plantation  Schools  located  in  Nuwara  Eliya,  Kandy  and  Badulla  districts,  under  the  financial  assistance  of  the  Government  of  India  and  the  contribution  of  the  Government  of  Sri  Lanka.  Taking  into  account  the  practical  problems  of  implementing  the  said  project  targeting  only  Advanced  level  students,  it  has  been  decided  at  a  discussion  held  with  the  officials  of  the  Indian  High  Commission,  the  Ministry  of  Education,  the  Department  of  External  Resources  and  the  Department  of  National  Budget  to  remove  the  said  restriction.  Accordingly,  the  Cabinet  noted  the  information  furnished  by  the  Minister  of  Water  Supply  and  Estate  Infrastructure  Development  that  relevant  measures  are  taken  to  implement  the  project  by  amending  the  said  MoU.

description: Providing  a  land  plot  in  Kollupitiya  area  to  Expo  Property  Developers  (Pvt)  Limited  for  a  housing  project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In  the  year  2007,  approval  of  the  Cabinet  has  been  granted  under  the  provisions  of  the  Urban  Development  Authority  Act  for  the  dispossession  of  a  plot  of  land  in  extent  of  40  perches,  at  Sea  Avenue,  Kollupitiya  belonging  to  the  Urban  Development  Authority,  to  Expo  Property  Developers  (Pvt)  Limited,  on  a  long  term  lease  basis  of  50  years  and  an  amount  equivalent  to  25%  of  value  of  the  said  land  has  also  been  charged.  However,  due  to  the  presence  of  an  unauthorized  occupant  of  that  land,  the  land  has  not  been  transferred.  Expo  Property  Developers  (Pvt)  Limited  has  requested  asking  the  entire  land  of  52  perches  also  including  12  perches  located  adjacent  to  the  land,  on  99  years    lease  basis  for  the  implementation  of  a  housing  development  project.  For  the  purpose,  approval  of  the  the  Board  of  Management  of  the  Urban  Development  Authority  has  been  received.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Urban  Development  and  Housing,  to  transfer  the  said  land  plot  to  Expo  Property  Developers  (Pvt)  Limited,  on  99  years  lease  basis,  on  the  current  assessed  value  of  the  Chief  Government  Valuer,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Development  of  a  water  retention  land  portion  located  adjacent  to  Buthgamuwa  Road,  Rajagiriya,  as  an  Urban  Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  Sri  Lanka  Land  Development  Corporation,  under  the  Greater  Colombo  Flood  Control  Project  to  minimize  flooding  in  the  area  around  Colombo  and  Sri  Jayewardenepura  Kotte,  has  acquired  marshy  land  plots  in  Colombo,  Sri  Jayewardenepura  Kotte,  Kolonnawa,  and  Kaduwela  divisional  secretariat  divisions,  to  the  Government  to  keep  them  as  water  retention  areas.  Certain  parties  are  attempting  to  utilize  the  water  retention  lands  located  adjacent  to  Buthgamuwa,  Rajagiriya  road  acquired  accordingly,  for  unauthorized  constructions  and  other  purposes,  and  it  seems  that,  it  is  suitable  to  utilize  such  lands  for  appropriate  development  purposes  under  the  guidance  of  the  Sri  Lanka  Land  Development  Corporation,  without  causing  a  harm  to  the  purposes  behind  taking  them  over  while  preserving  the  same.  Accordingly,  Cabinet  approved  the  proposal  made  by  the  Minister  of  Urban  Development  and  Housing  to  call  for  proposals  to  develop  a  plot  of  land  identified,  as  an  Urban  Park  with  income  generating  sources,  by  obtaining  the  contribution  of  the  private  sector  as  well.

description: Implementation  of  the  Green  Hydrogen  Technology  for  Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  Green  Ammonia  which  is  a  value  added  product  of  Green  Hydrogen  has  been  identified  as  an  eco-friendly  alternative  to  conventional  fossil  fuels  for  the  transportation  of  energy  over  high  seas  for  long  distances.  The  demand  for  merchant  Green  Ammonia  which  can  be  used  to  carry  energy  is  being  significantly  increased  in  the  global  market.  It  has  also  predicted  that  the    demand  will  increase  to  billions  of  tons  by  2030.  Sri  Lanka  has  a  great  potential  to  be  established  as  a  green  energy  producer,  exporter  and  a  regional  energy  hub  due  to  its  unique  geographical  advantages  such  as  the  facts  that,  it  boasts  abundance  of  renewable  energy  resources  and  its  close  proximity  to  East-West  naval  route.  Therefore,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  President  in  his  capacity  as  the  Minister  of  Investment  Promotion  to  appoint  a  project  committee  comprising  of  the  representatives  of  relevant  institutions  to  evaluate  the  investment  proposals  of  the  private  sector  regarding  green  hydrogen/ammonia  production  and  submit  recommendations  to  the  Cabinet,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Multi-Sectoral  National  Action  Plan  to  address  Sexual  and  Gender-based  Violence  in  Sri  Lanka  -  II  (2024  -  2028)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Multi-Sectoral  National  Action  Plan  to  address  Sexual  and  Gender-based  Violence  in  Sri  Lanka  has  been  implemented  with  an  intergrated  approach  during  the  period  of  2012-2020  in  Sri  Lanka,  since  policy  interventions  are  needed  to  ensure  the  right  to  live  in  a  just  and  violence  free  society  for  women,  men,  children  and  all  gender  identities.  During  the  follow  up  and  evaluation  process  carried  out  regarding  the  impact  of  the  said  Action  Plan,  the  need  of  a  new  national  action  plan  has  been  identified.  Accordingly,  the  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  President  in  his  capacity  as  the  Minister  of  Women,  Child  Affairs  and  Social  Empowerment  to  implement  the  Multi-Sectoral  National  Action  Plan  to  address  Sexual  and  Gender-based  Violence  in  Sri  Lanka  -  II  (2024  -  2028)  which  has  been  prepared  seeking  the  views  of  all  relevant  stakeholder  institutions,  was  approved  by  the  Cabinet.

description: Construction  of  the  Historical  Kelani  River  Udakukkepa  Seema  Malaka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The  Kalyani  Samagri  maha  Sangha  Sabha  of  Shyamopali  Maha  Nikaya  of  Mahavihara  ancestry  is  performing  its  rites  of  higher  ordination  for  more  than  150  years  in  the  Udakukkepa  Seema  Malaka  which  has  been  temporarily  constructed  on  the  Kelani  River.  Considering  the  high  cost  and  also  the  labour  that  may  take  in  constructing  the  said  temporary  Seema  Malakaya  in  each  year,  the  Sangha  Sabha  has  decided  to  construct  a  permanent  Uposathagaraya  at  the  Kalyanawanshikaramaya  owned  by  the  said  Sanga  Sbha  located  adjacent  to  the  Kelani  River  in  Wennawatta.  Taking  into  account  the  proposal  made  by  the  Hon.  Prime  Minister  on  this  matter,  Cabinet  decided  to  grant  its  approval  to  construct  the  historical  Kelani  River  Udakukkepa  Seema  Malaka  building,  based  on  the  recommendations  and  consultations  of  the  Department  of  Irrigation.

description: Implementing the “Work Culture” Project to motivate Sri Lankan young	entrepreneurs and workforce
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Youth Services Council has prepared a project proposal for the implementation of the "Work Culture" Project, a national initiative, designed to uplift the economy of Sri Lanka by enhancing the productivity and efficiency among the youth. This project is expected to be implemented from June to August 2024 and aims to promote productivity, recognize excellence, engage youth, encourage a working culture and sustain motivation among Sri Lankan youth. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to implement the “Work Culture” Project to motivate young Sri Lankan entrepreneurs and workforce through the National Youth Services Council from the funds allocated to the Presidential Secretariat under the Youth Development Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Third Amendment of the Assistance Agreement No.383-128 signed with the Government of the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of the United States of	America have entered into an Assistance Agreement on 2022-08-31 to obtain a	Grant to finance the “Programme for a Democratic, Prosperous and Resilient	Sri Lanka” and has granted USD 9.069 million to Sri Lanka accordingly. The	value of the grant has been revised up to USD 28.299 million in 2023, in 02	occassions.The United States Agency for International Development (USAID)	has proposed to further increase the value of the Grant up to USD 52.835	million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity	as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to	amend the Assistance Agreement by increasing the Grant Fund under the	“Programme for a Democratic, Prosperous and Resilient Sri Lanka” up to USD 	52.835 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting “Wigamanika Harasara” Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Migrant workers were requested to contribute at least USD 500 million per month	through legal channels to reduce the trade deficit faced by Sri Lanka in early 2022.	Based on the positive response given by the migrant workers to that request, the	worker remittances have been raised up to USD 11 billion during the period from	June 2022 to May 2024. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and	Foreign Employment to implement a programme named as “Wigamanika Harasara”	in appreciation of the great contribution	made by the migrant workers during the	finance and economic recession.

description: Obtaining Asian Development Bank Funds to implement the Power Sector	Reforms and Financial Sustainability Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Initial discussions have been held between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Asian Development Bank for the implementation of the Power Sector	 Reforms and Financial Sustainability Programme. The proposed programme consists of 03 sub‑programmes and it is expected to receive a loan amount of	USD 300 million by USD 100 million for each sub-programme. The	proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to obtain a USD 100 million loan from the Asian Development Bank to finance the proposed sub‑programme‑01 for the implementation of institutional structural reforms in the Ceylon Electricity Board and the Lanka Electricity Company (Pvt) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Comprehensive Strategies to uplift the Small and Medium Scale Enterprise Sector in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Micro, Small and Medium Scale Enterprises make a direct contribution for generating employment, fostering innovation and for economic growth in Sri Lanka. Due to the economic difficulties faced by Sri Lanka in the past period, the Micro, Small and Medium Scale entrepreneurs were severely affected. Therefore, taking into account the need to province investment and working capital assistance to revitalize those entrepreneurs, the Government has taken steps to implement a number of strategies. Accordingly, the project for re‑empowerment of the Micro, Small and Medium Scale Enterprises sector has been implemented under Asian Development Bank funds, in order to implement the loan projects in the Small and Medium Scale Enterprise sector and about 40 billion rupees have been allocated for the year 2024 for the same. In addition, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑02‑24 for the implementation of an Incentive Loan Scheme worth 20 billion rupees with the aim of re-energizing the Micro, Small and Medium Scale entrepreneurs as well. It is planned to allocate 02 billion rupees from the said provisions and implement a special loan scheme for women entrepreneurs as well by creating a Revolving Fund and the said loan scheme is scheduled to be implemented from 2024‑07‑01. The information presented by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies was considered by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Employees' Provident Fund has been established by the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No. 15 of 1958 for the social security of the private and semi‑government sector employees who are not entitled to a pension. It has been identified the necessity of amending the said Act to increase the number of members covered by the Act in accordance with the current socio-economic changes and to provide quality and efficient service to the members to suit the present. The proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill based on the initial Draft prepared accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Criminal Procedure Amendment Act, No.25 of 2024 has been passed in Parliament on 2024‑05‑31 in order to provide for Judges to take into account the time spent by an accused in custody prior to his conviction as a part of his sentence for the offense for which he is convicted. However, since the above Bill does not apply to persons convicted prior to the passage of the said amendment Act, it has been identified that a mechanism to take into account the time spent in custody prior to their conviction or pending determination of the appeal is needed. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minster of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to introduce a special provisions law to execute the powers vested with the President under Article 34 of the Constitution so as to take necessary action with regard to the said convicted persons as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Orders made under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- As per the Cabinet decisions dated 2024‑03‑25 and 2024‑04‑08, the companies named Codegen Innovation (Pvt) Ltd, Port City BPO (Pvt) Ltd, IVIVA PTE Ltd, Echelon Trade (Pvt) and 99X Technology AS, have been designated as Secondary Businesses of Strategic Importance and the proposed exemptions or incentives to such businesses have been published through Orders in the Government Gazette. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to table the following Orders issued under section 53 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No.11 of 2021 in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	Order published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2378/35 dated 2024‑04‑05.

*	Order published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2380/36 dated 2024‑04‑19.

*	Order published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2380/33 dated 2024‑04‑19.

*	Order published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2380/35 dated 2024‑04‑19.

*	Order published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2380/34 dated 2024‑04‑19.

description: Obtaining additional allocations for youth development activities implemented by the Youth Services Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Youth Services Council has planned to implement programmes such as creating one million young entrepreneurs, guidance on national and global labour market, conducting youth camps at Divisional Secretariat Level and conducting National Youth Conferences in view of empowering patience, self - esteem and a sense of purpose among youth, equipping them with the skills needed to cope with life's challenges successfully and making maximum use of opportunities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs to conduct the said programmes and to grant the provisions required for the same to the National Youth Services Council, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 934 Rainwater Harvesting Tanks in Jaffna District by the Government of India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2016‑10‑25 to sign a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of India to construct 3,000 rainwater harvesting tanks in the District of Jaffna using the funds offered by the Government of India to supply clean potable water in the said District. Even though the project was scheduled to be completed within a period of 03 years, due to the financial and technical problems which have arisen, the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑10‑10 has decided to extend the project period up to June 2024 and to install 1,831 PVC rainwater tanks instead of ferro-cement tanks. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to establish 934 water harvesting tanks using the remaining funds under the Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Quality Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The necessity of establishing a National Quality Council has been pointed out through the National Quality Policy submitted in the year 2016, the National Quality Infrastructure Strategy 2018-2022 and the National Export Strategy of Sri Lanka 2018-2022. At present, National Quality Institutions and other National Quality Regulatory Agencies are functioning as independent institutions under the scopes of various Line Ministries. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security to appoint a Working Committee with the representations of the relevant Line Ministries and National Quality Institutions to implement the proposal for the establishment of the National Quality Council, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Renewable Energy Purchase Tariff under the Standardized Power Purchase Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Standardized Power Purchase Agreement should be entered into under a technology-based, Cost-reflective Feed in Tariff System pertaining to the Renewable Energy Projects with a capacity of 10MW or less as per the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 and its subsequent amendments. Accordingly, although approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2023‑03‑13 to implement a variable renewable energy purchasing tariff, only a few developers have signed the Agreement for that purpose. Therefore, a Committee comprising of representatives from the Ministry of Power and Energy, the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, the Ceylon Electricity Board, the Sustainable Energy Authority of Sri lanka and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka has been appointed in order to obtain recommendations on the renewable energy tariff calculation. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to accept the price calculation formula submitted by the said Committee and to implement the proposed tariff revisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting a portion of Land in Kalmunai with the Urban Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Kalmunai town is one of the main service centres in the Ampara district and it is considered as an administrative, trade and commercial centre of the province. According to the Development Plan for the Kalmunai Municipal Council area, the coastal area of Kalmunai has been designated as a suitable area for tourism and recreational activities, but it has been recognized that the facilities available in the town are not adequate for tourism and recreational activities. Accordingly, in order to meet such requirements, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to take over a plot of land in extent of 01 rood 29.44 perches located in Rest House road in the coastal area of Kalmunai to the Urban Development Authority for a project to construct a Tourism Facility Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Handing over the Henry Pedris Ground to the Isipathana College for Sports Activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Non‑availability of a permanent playground to the Isipathana College, Colombo where there are many talented players, has become a severe impediment to improve the skills of such players. Therefore, an Agreement was reached between the two parties in the year 2016 to use the Henry Pedris Ground owned by the Colombo Municipal Council to the sports activities of the Isipathana College, and the period of the said Agreement has ended in the year 2017. By handing over the Henry Pedris Ground to the Isipathana College, it can be properly improved and maintained and it will pave the way to productively utilize the said ground for the sports activities of the students of the College and also surrounding schools as well as the people of the area. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs to hand over the Henry Pedris Ground to the Isipathana College, keeping the name of the ground unchanged, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project on sustainable and efficient Electric Mobility System in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Environment Programme, an organization accredited by the Green Environment Fund, has granted US$ 1.09 million for the implementation of the project on Sustainable and Efficient Electric Mobility System in Sri Lanka. According to the project implementation plan, the Ministry of Environment has been identified as the National Designated Entity. However, since the scope of the project falls under the Ministry of Transport and Highways, the Ministry of Transport and Highways has the ability to take necessary measures to implement the project more efficiently together with all the relevant parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways, for the Ministry of Transport and Highways to become the executing agency of the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project Agreement between the Sri Lanka Export Development Board and the Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs on Global Textile and Clothing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Project Agreement between the Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs and the Sri Lanka Export Development Board to implement the second phase of the Global Textiles and Clothing Programme for Sri Lankan Textile and Clothing Sector. By entering into the said Agreement, Sri Lanka will be able to obtain the support of the Global Textiles and Clothing Programme for a transformation of Textile and Apparel Industry based on the shift towards quality green products by promoting digitization. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to sign the said agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocating a plot of land for the establishment of the Mahabage Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Mahabage Police Station which serves nearly 50,000 people living in 08 Grama Niladhari Divisions, is currently maintained in a small plot of land in extent of 21.5 perches bordering the Colombo - Negombo main road. Under this backdrop, due to the facts that there is no suitable place for vehicle parking and to keep court productions in safe custody, inadequate barracks and non availability of quarters for the officers, both the general public and the serving police officers encounter severe difficulties. Therefore, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government to allocate a plot of land in extent of 40 perches from the land where the Wattala divisional Secretariat Division has been previously established for the development of required facilities for the said police station, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Economic Empowerment of Women in the Micro, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MSME) Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that, in Sri Lanka, participation of women in economic activities is lower than other regional and Asian countries due to various reasons. According to the Sri Lanka Labour Force Survey conducted in the year 2022, out of the economically active population, 35% is women and it shows a significant disparity in the gender contribution rates of economic participation. Limited financial literacy and the factors such as that women do not have property or other collateral required for obtaining loans and lack of opportunities to access financial resources have been identified as the main obstacles encountered by women entrepreneurs in Sri Lanka. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. President to implement a special loan scheme in order to remove barriers preventing women from entering economic activities, utilizing Rs. 02 billion, out of Rs.20 billion which has been allocated to re-energize Micro, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MSME) Sector by the Cabinet decision dated 2024‑02‑26, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Mediation Boards Act, No.72 of 1988
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2023‑09‑25 to amend the section 7 of the Mediation Boards Act, No.72 of 1988, in order to overcome administrative issues such as unavailability of constituted or functioning mediation boards or delay in issuing the Certificate of Non‑settlement by the Mediation Board and to fulfill the requirement of not preventing the parties from resorting to the Court of Law, in the event both parties accept that there is no settlement. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has prepared the amending Bill and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the same. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the National innovation Agency Act No. 22 of 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - National innovation Agency established in the year 2022 makes national policies and submits recommendations pertaining to social, science and technology, defence, eco and service innovations. According to the present day needs, the necessity of introducing several amendments to the the National Innovation Agency Act No.22 of 2019 has arisen in order to achieve the objectives of the institution. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the said Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the remaining works of the Construction Projects of the Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Although a number of construction projects have been started with the aim of providing the necessary infrastructure for the Sri Lanka Police, the following projects scheduled to be completed in the years 2021 - 2023 could not be completed as expected due to the spread of COVID - 19 pandemic in the year 2020 and the economic crisis which has arisen in the country:

*	Project for the construction of Married Quarters for Junior Police Officers at Kumaran Ratnam Road, Colombo 02.

*	Project for the construction of Resident Building at the Katana National Police Academy.

*	Project for the completion of remaining works of the building in the Kollupitiya Police Station.

	The proposal made by Minister of Public Security to revise the total cost estimate 	and to extend time period of completing projects up to 2024‑2027, so as to 	complete the remaining works of the said projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Term Contract for the procurement of four (04) shipments of Gas Oil (0.05% M.S.)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited from the registered suppliers for the term contract for the purchase of four (04) shipments of Gas Oil (0.05% M.S.) to Ceylon Petroleum Corporation for the period from 2024‑08‑01 to 2024‑12‑31. The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the contract for the purchase of four (04) shipments of Gas Oil 280,000 Bbls+/-5% during the relevant period to M/s Zhongxi Energy Development (Ningbo) Co. Ltd., China, based on the recommendation made by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee after evaluating the bids received accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 200MW Natural Gas Fired Internal Combustion Engine Power Plant with Duel Fuel Capacity at Kerawalapitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Project of 200MW Natural Gas Fired Internal Combustion Engine Power Plant with Duel Fuel Capacity at Kerawalapitiya is a project identified by the Long Term Generation Expansion Plan 2023-2042 approved by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka. The land area adjacent to Kerawalapitiya Sobadhanavi Limited has been allocated for this project and it is expected to develop this power plant as an Independent Power Producer under the built‑own‑operate‑transfer (BOOT) basis for 20 years. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to identify a suitable investor by following the Competitive Bidding Procedure for the relevant task, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renewal of Warranty, Operation and Maintenance Contract at Thambapavani Wind Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Full commercial operations of the Thambapavani Wind Power Station belonging to the Ceylon Electricity Board have been commenced on 2021‑05‑18. The Ceylon Electricity Board has signed a Contract Agreement with Vestas Wind Lanka (Pvt) Limited for securing warranty, operations and maintenance service of the said Power Plant for a period of three (03) years and the contract period of the said Agreement has expired on 2024‑05‑17. As such, a new service supplier is required to be selected for the said activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to select a suitable service supplier, following the Competitive Bidding Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of Diyagama Mahinda Rajapaksa Sports Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2024‑01‑08 to get the construction works of the new sub-projects that are currently being implemented and proposed to be implemented, done by the Sri Lanka Army. Accordingly, it has been planned to construct the roofs of the junior pavilion of the said ground and the second pavilion of the new athletics playground. The proposal made by the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs to get the said construction work done by the Sri Lanka Army, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 75th Anniversary of Sri Lanka UNESCO partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka-UNESCO partnership completes its 75th anniversary in this year, and in order to commemorate the anniversary, the Sri Lanka UNESCO National Commission, the Ministry of Education, other relevant Ministries and Institutions have planned to implement several programmes together. The proposal made by the Minister of Education to conduct the 75th anniversary celebration on 2024‑07‑16 at Nelum Pokuna theatre, with the objectives of commemorating the 75 years partnership and achievements with UNESCO, promoting the tourism industry by making the both local and international community aware on the UNESCO listed cultural heritage in Sr Lanka, further increasing the existing awareness between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the project period of the Gandara Fishery Harbour Construction Project and revision of the Total Cost Estimate
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2019‑07‑07 for the construction of a Fishery Harbour at the existing Gandara landing site. Although the project was supposed to be completed by December 2023, owing to the Covid-19 pandemic and the economic crisis, constructions of the project could not be completed as expected. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries to extend the period of the project from December 2023 to December 2026, enabling to complete all construction works including the shore facilities of the project as well; and to revise the total cost estimate based on price variations, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Introduction of Digital Technology for Pirivena Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Technology together with the Ministry of Education have planned to implement a programme to empower the pirivena education by introducing digital technology for pirivena education. Through this, the teachers affiliated to the Pirivenas and Bhikkus/lay students will be able to utilize digital technology to explore and analyze the Sri Lankan national Buddhist heritage. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology, and the Minister of Education to implement the proposed programme so that at least two computers, a smart board and a printer can be provided for each pirivena, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Hingurakgoda Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity of developing the Hingurakgoda Airport, which is currently operated under the management of Sri Lanka Air Force, in accordance with the International Civil Aviation Standards. Accordingly, a committee consisting of the representatives of Sri Lanka Air Force, Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka, Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Pvt) Ltd. and the Road Development Authority has been appointed for the preparation of the Master plan for the above airport and other related tasks. The joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to take necessary action to develop the Hingurakgoda Airport as a fully-fledged Airport, as per the recommendations of the above Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Leasing out the land located at Rajagiriya which has been leased out to the Ceylon College of Physicians again, for a period of 50 years
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A plot of land with an extent of 30 perches at Welikada, Rajagiriya owned by	 the Urban Development Authority, has been provided to the Ceylon College of Physicians for a period of 30 years with effect from 1999‑05‑13 on a concessionary lease basis for the construction of a building for research purposes. In view of the fact that the Head Office building of the Ceylon College of Physicians, which has been built in the above land, needs to be repaired and a considerable financial investment has to be made for it, the institution has submitted a request to provide the land in concern, back on lease basis for a longer period of time. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Urban Development and Housing to provide the relevant portion of land to the Ceylon College of Physicians for a period	of 50 years on long-term lease basis, based on charging an annual rent determined by the Chief  Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing a plot of land located at Pitipana, Homagama to the Ceylon	Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - With the increase in the electricity requirement for urban development projects related to science and technology cities, the Ceylon Electricity Board has made a request to the Urban Development Authority to provide a portion of land from the land called Mahenawatta in Pitipana, Homagama to construct a grid substation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to provide the portion of land with the extent of 02 acres, 03 roods and 15.41 perches that has been identified, to the Ceylon Electricity Board based on the valuation of the Chief Government Valuer, on 30 year lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an agreement on Educational Cooperation between Sri	Lanka and Vietnam for the period 2024 - 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The need for further development of bilateral cooperation in the field of higher education between Sri Lanka and Vietnam has been identified and serving that purpose, the two parties have agreed to implement the agreement that has been entered into during the period of 2017 - 2020, for the period of 2024 - 2026 with amendments. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to enter into the Agreement on Educational Cooperation between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam as valid for the period of 2024-2026, with the objectives such as exchanging information and experience related to development and innovation in the field of higher education, conducting joint research, promoting bilateral cooperative programmes between universities and research institutes of both parties, exchanging scholarships for bachelor degree or postgraduate degree studies in the fields mutually agreed upon by the two parties and exchanging of students and scholars between universities/research centres of the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Mangrove Conservation projects through donations from the Commonwealth Blue Charter Project Incubator
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In 2023, the Commonwealth Blue Charter Project Incubator has called for project proposals from Commonwealth countries to provide grants for the mangrove conservation. Two (02) project proposals submitted by Sri Lanka for this purpose have been selected by the Commonwealth Blue Charter Project Incubator. Accordingly, that institution has decided to grant donations for the Project of preliminary mangrove carbon stock assessments for Sri Lanka and the Project on a study on faunal pioneers to restore mangroves and mapping sea grass mangrove interphases using satellite and drone technology.
