The proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation to implement the above projects through the Department of Wildlife Conservation and the Department of Forest Conservation under the supervision of the Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation and enter into relevant agreements accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Pledge Loan Scheme at a concessionary interest 	rate	through Banks to purchase paddy for Yala season 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-01-08 to implement a Pledge Loan Scheme at a concessionary interest rate through Banks to purchase paddy for the Maha season 2023/24 and the Yala season 2024. Under this, a discussion has been held pertaining to the implementation mechanism of the Pledge Loan Scheme to purchase paddy for the Yala season 2024 under the chairmanship of a Deputy Secretary to the Treasury with the participation of representatives from relevant Ministries, Departments and State and Private Banks. According to the outcome of the above discussion, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to issue the Pledge Loan of Rs.6000 million to the Small and Medium Scale Paddy Millers, Paddy Storage Owners and Paddy Collectors at a concessionary interest rate through the participatory Banks in Yala season 2024 and take other related actions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing Pre-printed Policarbonate cards for printing National 	Identity Cards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the recommendation of the Cabinet appointed Procurement Committee and the recommendations of the Procurement Appeal Board regarding the procurement carried out for the purchase of 05 million Pre-Printed Polycarbonate cards required for the printing of Identity Cards for the Department for Registration of Persons, it was decided to cancel the said procurement at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-05-06. Further, approval has been granted at that Cabinet meeting to purchase only the amount of cards essential to print National Identity Cards as a reorder from the previous supplier until a new procurement is carried out and a suitable supplier is selected, enabling to continue the process of issuing National Identity Cards without interruption. Accordingly, a Project Committee and a Cabinet appointed Negotiation Committee have been appointed to obtain the relevant recommendations on the quantity of cards to be purchased from the previous supplier and to evaluate the price proposal submitted by the supplier. The proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to purchase 2.3 million Pre-Printed Polycarbonate cards as a reorder from the previous supplier, Just In Time Technologies (Pvt) Ltd. based on the recommendations of the said Committees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-implementation of the continued programmes implemented under the 'Samata Sewana' housing programme during the period 2015-2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Housing programmes, such as the Model Villages Programme, 'Visiri' Loan Programme, Gramashakthi Visiri Assistance, 'Visiri' Loan Assistance, 'Viru Sumithuru', Housing Assistance Programme for Families with Kidney Patients, Flood Relief Programme have been launched by the National Housing Development Authority during the period of 2015-2019 under the "Samata Sewana" housing programme, targeting the low-income community who are in need of a house and could not complete the construction of the houses. The construction continued in 229,580 housing units out of 387,520 housing units of which the constructions have been commenced under the above programmes and some of the said houses have been completed by non-governmental organizations, with various grants and by beneficiaries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to secure necessary provisions to complete the construction work of 45,117 housing units that have not yet been completed, on stage basis on priority, with the intervention of the National Housing Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Paving works of Jaya Container Terminal-V Yard in the Colombo Port
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Plans relating to the paving of the Jaya Container Terminal - V of the Colombo Port have been prepared by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to call for National Competitive Bids and select a suitable institution for this work, and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and a Technical Evaluation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Printing and Supply of computerized draw lottery tickets for the Development Lotteries Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - National Competitive Procurement Process has been followed for printing and supply of lottery tickets of Lagna Wasanawa, Ada Kotipathi, Shanida, Super Boll, Jayoda, Kapruka and Sasiri for computer based draw, to the Development Lotteries Board. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to award the contract for the printing and supply of lottery tickets to Toppan Forms (Colombo) Ltd., DPJ Holdings (Pvt) Ltd. and Grand Export (Pvt) Ltd, for a period of one year, based on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the recommendation of the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Plantation Youth Conference
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development has planned to hold a Youth Conference as a part of the National Programme to mark 200 years for the Sri Lankan Plantation Community(NAAM 200). The said Conference titled "Future Fusion" is scheduled to be held on 2024‑06‑22 at the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology, Kandy with the participation of youth. The Conference is organized by the Ministry of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development in collaboration with AIESEC a voluntary organization comprising stakeholders including the University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology and university students and youths. Simultaneously, the Ceylon Chamber of Commerce has agreed to hold a career fare. Cabinet noted the information submitted by the Minister of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development in this regard.

description: Colombo International Film Festival - 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to hold the 'Colombo International Film Festival' from 08th to 14th July of this year at Colombo, with the main objective of promoting global cinematography in Sri Lanka by creating a revival in the Sri Lankan film industry and also making Sri Lanka a tourist hub in South Asia by gaining high tourist attraction. This film festival will provide the opportunity to Sri Lankan audiences to watch movie masterpieces from many countries including Iran, France, India, South Korea, China, Japan and Germany that are awarded with local and overseas awards and also it paves the way for Sri Lankan students to gain a broad understanding and experience on the global cinematography. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media; and the Minister of Tourism and Lands to hold the said film festival under the initiative of the National Film Corporation and the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Admission of Children for Grade One of Schools - 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Admission of children to Grade One of schools are carried out in accordance with the circulars issued by the Ministry of Education so as to be minimized the malpractices with transparency ensuring the equitable access in education. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to amend the Circular Instructions which are currently in force, based on the experience gained in previous years and to admit children to the Grade One from the year 2025 and onwards as per the said amended Circular Instructions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cooperation between the Virginia Ports Authority and the Sri Lanka Ports 	Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Virginia Ports Authority and the Sri Lanka Ports Authority have agreed to enter into a Cooperation Agreement on cooperation in sharing competences between ports under the 'Port and Maritime Skills Development Programme' jointly implemented by the United States Embassy in Sri Lanka and the Colombo Plan. Accordingly, enhancement of professional capabilities of the executive staff of both parties are mainly expected through the entry into the proposed Cooperation Agreement. The Proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to sign the Cooperation Agreement for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and 	the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on Cooperation of Promotion of Direct 	Investment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia have agreed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with a view to attracting direct investment to the country through policy and legal reforms, provision of advance and integrated infrastructure, process reengineering etc. and improving the investment environment of both countries. Accordingly, the Cabinet noted the information presented by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion that the Minister of Foreign Affairs signed the relevant MoU during the Special Meeting of the World Economic Forum held in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia on 28th and 29th of April, 2024.

description: Agreement on the Maritime Transport Cooperation among the Member Countries of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) has decided to enter into an Agreement on the Maritime Transport Cooperation among its member countries. The proposal regarding the signing of the Cooperation Agreement for the same was submitted to the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑01‑08 by the Minster of Ports, Shipping and Aviation and an Officials' Committee was appointed to further examine the said proposal. Concurrence of the Cabinet was granted for signing the Agreement on the Maritime Transport Cooperation which will be prepared taking also into consideration the recommendations mentioned in the said Officials' Committee Report submitted by the Hon. President.

description: Final Budget Position Report - 2023 of the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Under section 13 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act No. 3 of 2003, the Report on the Final Budget Position is required to be submitted to Parliament and the General public prior to the expiry of 05 months after the end of the financial year by the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies. Accordingly, the Report on the Final Budget Position for the the year 2023 covering the fiscal policy, strategy and challenges in respect of managing the macroeconomy of Sri Lanka in the year 2023, economic trends in the year 2023, fiscal sector, real sector, domestic demand and supply, investment and savings, developments in the external and monetary sectors, inflation and global economic developments has been published on the website of the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies on 2024 05 31. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to table the said Report in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of a new Order under section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - An order has been enforced with effect from 2020 04 02 under section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017 in order to ensure the financial stability of the country by imposing temporary suspensions and limitations on outward remittances related to certain capital transactions made by residents during the period in which the forex reserves were depleting in the country. The said Order has been continuously issued from time to time with a validity period of 06 months, and the Order currently in force is valid until 2024 06 19. Issuance of a new Order for a period of 06 months to be effective from 2024 06 20 under section 22(1) of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017 by further removing/relaxing certain suspensions/ limitations in order to facilitate resident companies to expand their businesses overseas, in particular, has been recommended by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to issue an Order under section 22(1) of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017 in order to implement the said recommendation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the term contract for the procurement of 05 shipments of Gasoline 92 Unl
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited from the registered suppliers of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to secure 1,5000,000 Bbls+/-5% of Gasoline 92 Unl to the said Corporation for a period of 06 months from 2024 07 15 to 2025 01 14. Based on the recommendation of the Standing Technical Evaluation Committee, the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has awarded the said procurement to the M/s Aditya Birla Global Trading (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the relevant procurement to the said company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.07 of 2024 and Standardization and Quality Control Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Even though, importation of vehicles into Sri Lanka has been temporarily suspended in terms of the provisions of the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 02 of 2023, as per a proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Lands, approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2024 04 01 to import 250 mini coaches and 750 vans for tourist transportation. Accordingly, in order to implement the said decision, Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.07 of 2024 have been promulgated under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969.
 
Further, Cabinet has granted approval on 2024 03 11 to impose Regulations enabling to facilitate expeditious, safer and effective trade flows as well as to ensure a level playing field for domestic products and imported products by canceling the Imports and Exports Control (Standardization and Quality Control) Regulations 2017 which had been imposed under the provisions of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 in order to establish standards and quality on importation of 122 categories of goods, classified under 217 HS Codes with a view to safeguarding the national economy, public health and environment. Accordingly, Standardization and Quality Control Regulations under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 have been promulgated. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the said Regulations published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notifications, to Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No.9 of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2023 05 02 to draft a Bill to amend the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No.9 of 2003. The Attorney General has submitted observations for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman accordingly. The proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security to instruct the Legal Draftsman to expeditiously complete the drafting process of the relevant Bill, based on the aforesaid observations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the New Immigration and Emigration Bill to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Even though the Immigration and Emigration Act, No. 20 of 1948 has been amended at many instances, the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022 12 12 has granted approval to introduce a new Act for the same, taking into account the rapid changes taking place in the field covered by the said Act, rapid development of technology as well as the international trends.  Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Penal Code to strengthen the legal provisions to prohibit sexual harassment and sexual assault
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022 12 12 to introduce amendments to the Penal Code by making sexual harassment and all forms of sexual assaults including in public places, a crime. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bill to establish the Institute for Food Science & Technology of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to prepare a Bill to establish the Institute for Food Science & Technology of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has prepared the relevant Bill and the Attorney General has proposed a number of amendments for the same. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries to instruct the Legal Draftsman to expeditiously finalize the task of preparing the Institute for Food Science & Technology of Sri Lanka Bill by incorporating the said amendments as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing the Protocol of Agreement on Accession of the Republic of Uzbekistan to the World Trade Organization (WTO)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Republic of Uzbekistan has been in the process of negotiating with other member countries to become a member of the World Trade Organization. The General Council of the WTO has established a Working Party to examine the application of Uzbekistan and submit to the General Council the relevant recommendations with a draft Protocol of Accession. Sri Lanka also has become a member of the relevant Working Party with the intention of exporting tea to Uzbekistan and the relevant officials in Sri Lanka have negotiated with the Uzbekistan officials in that regard and have reached the initial consensus on the lower binding tariffs for tea products anticipated to be exported to that country. Accordingly, Uzbekistan requires to sign the "Protocol of Agreement on Accession" with Sri Lanka being a member of Working Party, confirming that bilateral discussions were held as per the relevant provisions of the  World Trade Organization. The Proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security to sign the said Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting the Gampola Old Court Complex land with the Urban Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been decided at the Udapalatha Regional Coordinating Committee Meeting to modernize the old Court building located at the land where the Gampola Court Complex had been housed without demolishing it and to develop the said premises as a car park. Approval of the the Board of Management of the Urban Development Authority has also been granted to implement a Mixed Development Project in the said land. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing in that regard, the Cabinet granted approval to vest the land where the Gampola Old Court Complex is located with the Urban Development Authority to implement a Mixed Development Project  and a public car park under the Gampola Town Development Project subject to the payment of the value determined by the Chief Government Valuer by the Urban Development Authority to the Consolidated Fund.

description: Establishment of 'District Industry Promotion Councils'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Regionally established micro, small and medium scale industries have to encounter many conflicts at present and the need for a more suitable, easily accessible and inclusive approach has been identified in order to create an enabling environment to face these challenges. Therefore, it has become essential to establish, network and promote strong linkages among all the relevant institutions enabling to provide quality and efficient institutional assistance and service delivery at the regional level for micro, small and medium scale industries through a multi-sectoral and integrated approach. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to establish 25 "District Industry Promotion Councils" covering the entire island and appoint a Steering Committee consisting of the representatives from the public sector, private sector and other relevant institutions to determine the structure, functions and responsibilities and to oversee the whole process of the above councils, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Tariff Policy of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Existence of a clear, simple, coherent and predictable tariff regime is a critical factor in maintaining a competitive environment for trade and investment within a country. The competitive environment for investments in Sri Lanka has been adversely affected due to the revision of the Tariff Policy according to the various policies introduced by the previous governments from time to time. Taking this situation into consideration, a Technical Committee has been appointed under the Chairmanship of the Director General of the Trade and Investment Policy Department of the General Treasury with the composition of members from the relevant agencies to prepare a National Tariff Policy as per the instructions of the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies. The Committee has prepared a National Tariff Policy under the guidance of trade experts and the Secretaries of the subject related Ministries in consultation with the Business and Industry Community. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to implement the above National Tariff Policy under three (03) phases from January 2025 and publish the same through a Gazette Notification under section 101 of the Customs Ordinance with a view to ensure the stakeholders' awareness and compliance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Import Control Regulations under Imports and Export (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 to enable the import of selected spices for reprocessing and re-exporting for businesses approved by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, the Secretary, Ministry of Investment Promotion and the Secretary, Ministry of Agriculture and Plantation Industries have been informed to re-review the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.03 of 2024 issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 and submit a Comprehensive Report, at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024 03 18. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to implement the following recommendations included in the above Report, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Allow importation of selected spices for processing and re exporting for BOI approved enterprises under the Procedure for Importation and Processing of selected spices and re exporting in the form of oil extracts, Oleoresins and Spent.

*	Promulgate Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations under the provisions of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 for the above purpose.

description: Proposed Sri Lanka - Malaysia Free Trade Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The significance of attracting export-oriented Foreign Direct Investment, diversifying exports and expanding market access for goods and services, has been identified in order to regain the economic stability in Sri Lanka. For that purpose, it is essential for Sri Lanka to further economic integration with countries having strong and strategic economies. Malaysia, a key member of the ASEAN and the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership, stands as the 34th export destination for Sri Lanka and value of the total exports to Malaysia in 2023 is USD 58.3 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to take into consideration the importance of entering into a Free Trade Agreement between Sri Lanka and Malaysia and initiate the negotiations for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to the communities who are affected by the flood situation	in Kolonnawa area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Hon. President has paid a visit to Kolonnawa area during the afternoon on 2024-06-03 to observe the situation faced by the people in Kolonnawa due to the heavy rain in the last few days. Taking into account the matters submitted by the communities of the region during the visit, the approval has been granted for the following proposals made by the Hon. President.

*	Providing food and other essential services to the people who are  affected by the floods in Kolonnawa area as well as to the people who are affected in other parts of the country.

*	Removal of illegal constructions that have caused flooding in the Divisional Secretariat Division, Kolonnawa, suspension of land filling activities and repairing the drainage systems of the area and taking other relevant measures.

* 	To appoint a committee chaired by the District Secretary of Colombo with the representatives from the relevant institutions to identify the possible root causes of the floods in the area and recommend measures to be taken to avoid such recurrences in future and to prepare a comprehensive development plan for the re-planning of the city of Kolonnawa by utilizing the available land within the territory of the Divisional Secretariat Division, Kolonnawa in the most productive manner.

description: Providing relief to the communities who are affected by the SouthWest	Monsoon
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Thousands of families have become temporarily helpless due to heavy rains in many districts of the island, resulting in landslides, tree falls, floods andsevere damage to public infrastructure systems owing to the weather changes that are developing unexpectedly with the activation of the Southwest Monsoon this year. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to provide relief for the families who are affected and implement a prompt programme with immediate effect to restore the damaged public infrastructure facilities to a state of normality by obtaining the service of Triforces and Civil Security Forces and with the fullest  contribution of other relevant Ministries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon.President in his capacity as the Minister ofFinance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002 to prevent the unintended effects of the removal of exemptions from the VAT Act, maintain clarity of the Act, implement the VAT reforms introduced by the Value Added Tax (Amendment) Act, No.32 of 2023 and to incorporate the amendments identified as recommended by the Temporary VAT Committee appointed as per the instructions of the Integrated Committee headed by the Committee on Public Accounts including the Committee on Public Finance, the Committee on Ways and Means, the Sectoral Oversight Committee on National Economic and Physical Plans and the Sectoral Oversight Committee on Alleviating the Impact of the Economic Crisis and other amendments identified from time to time based on various Cabinet decisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Enterprise Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - After a review made with the assistance of experts, taking into account the international best practices, it has been identified the need to establish a consolidated agency for more effective management and development of small and medium scale enterprises. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion and the Minister of Industry to establish the proposed institution called "Enterprise Sri Lanka" as a single entity dedicated for small and medium scale enterprises through re-modeling the institutional and legal frameworks of the Export Development Board, the National Enterprise Development Authority, Industrial Development Board, Sri Lanka Export Credit Insurance Corporation and the Small Enterprise Development Division of the Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs and instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill for that purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Criminal Procedure Code
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑03‑07 has granted approval to amend the Criminal Procedure Code enabling to introduce the plea agreements to the legal framework in Sri Lanka with a view to resolving criminal cases expeditiously, minimizing the backlogs of cases by reducing delays in court proceedings and reducing prison overcrowding. According to the proposed amendment, the accused person and prosecution enter into an agreement where the accused will plead guilty instead of going to trial, in consequence of which, recommendation could be obtained to minimize sentence and reduce fine or restitution amount. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Criminal Procedure Code. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the relevant Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the Technical Assistance of the World Meteorological Organization to improve forecasts on high impact weather, flood, landslides and early warnings in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement the Climate Resilience Improvement Multi-Programmatic Approach funded by the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the World Bank, under three phases over a period of 09 years. Skills, technology and infrastructure facilities are planned to be improved in the relevant institutions so as to forecast whether conditions accurately and early warnings as the first component of the said Programme which comprises of 5 components. By pursuing action accordingly, it is expected to forecast high risk whether and climate conditions swiftly and accurately and to minimize the estimated cost of US$ 313 million incurred annually by the Government for the post-disaster management. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation to obtain the service of the World Meteorological Organization which is an international organization having a wide range of experience in the field of meteorology and hydrology along with the technical skill to upgrade the emergency disaster warning systems in order to implement the said component, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Progress of Mega Scale Development Projects by the end of First Quarter 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Project Management and Monitoring, having reviewed the performance related data and information submitted by the relevant Ministries pertaining to the financial and physical progress of the Mega Scale Development Projects being implemented by the Line Ministries by the end of First Quarter 2024, has submitted the Progress Report of the Mega Scale Developments Projects. According to the said Report, 171 Mega-Scale Development Projects are being implemented in the year 2024 and except 09 projects out of which, all other projects are planned to be completed by the end of the year 2026. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to complete the activities of 58 projects with more than 80% of physical progress in the year 2024 and to refer the currently suspended projects due to the lack of adequate provisions to the National Operations Room to carry out the necessary studies on the same prior to further investing on such projects, taking into consideration the necessity of completing the ongoing projects expeditiously so as to securing fiscal space for new capital projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting a block of land located in the New Town Ratnapura with the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council has made a request to the Urban Development Authority to provide a block of land to establish a Hela Bojun Hala close to the Provincial Council Complex in the New Town Ratnapura. A block of land in extent of 23.10 perches which has been acquired by the Urban Development Authority has been identified for the said purpose. The market value determined by the Chief Government Valuer for the said land has already been paid by the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to the Urban Development Authority. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to release the said block of land to the Commissioner General of Lands enabling to transfer the same to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council through the Divisional Secretary, Ratnapura, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Public Private Partnership Programme on improving 	sport skills of school level athletes targeting the Brisbane Olympic Games 	in 2032
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs have planned to implement a joint programme with the support of the private sector and civil society in view of developing Sri Lanka as a "Medal Winning Country" at the Brisbane Olympics 2032. Similarly, It is expected to provide the opportunity to the talented athletes to participate in the Olympics to be held in Los Angeles in 2028 and achieve a significant level of performance. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Education and the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs to implement the proposed programme to achieve those objectives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reforming the Education Administration System for Drastic Transformative Change in Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The National Education Policy Framework 2023-2033 prepared in accordance with the vision of "a fully developed Sri Lanka by the year 2048" aiming to provide equal opportunities and quality education to each and every student in the country, has presented facts about the transformative change that should take place in education. Accordingly, the need for a new transformation in the organizational structure, curriculum and evaluation method has been identified to ensure a long-term learning methodology. Accordingly Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Education for taking necessary action as follows, with a view to establishing an appropriate administrative structure for the efficient and effective implementation of the overall educational reforms, based on the recommendations of the Cabinet Sub-Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of the Hon. President regarding the preparation of the National Education Policy Framework:

*	Classification of schools in compliance with the international standards.

*	Establishment of 09 Educational Reform Units in the 09 provinces.

*	Increasing the number of Zonal Education Offices from 100 to 122 in stages, based on a scientific and priority order.

*	Establishment of 350 School Boards also including the existing 314 Divisional Education Offices aiming to ensure the school supervision, 	monitoring teachers and verifying the validity of school-based evaluations.

*	Designating one or more selected secondary schools as leading schools and inclusion of the entire school system into 1,220 school clusters of which a single cluster school contains approximately 8‑12 numbers of schools.

*	Recruitment of required officers for the Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service and Teacher Advisors' Service.

description: Implementation of the Article 6 of the Paris Agreement in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Paris Agreement, which is a legally binding international treaty on climate change, has been adopted by 196 parties at the 21st Conference of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP21) held in 2015 in Paris, and Sri Lanka has signed the said Agreement in 2016. The main objective of the Paris Agreement is to maintain the increase in the global average temperature to well below 02 degrees Celsius above the pre-industrial levels and to limit the temperature increase to 1.5 degrees Celsius above the pre-industrial levels. As per the provisions of the said Agreement, the Parties should implement "Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)", for which 02 market mechanisms have been introduced. It paves the way for the countries to bilaterally exchange the outcomes of greenhouse gas mitigation, to report such exchanges of greenhouse gas and to utilize them to achieve the Nationally Determined Contributions of the partner countries. Further, it has been introduced a new international carbon crediting mechanism through this Agreement. Under that situation, Sri Lanka is preparing Carbon Market Strategy and Guiding Principles with the technical support of the Regional Collaboration Centre, Dubai of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change, and it is expected to complete the work by the end of this year. In the meantime, various project developers have submitted project proposals related to the main sectors of electricity, industry, waste management, transport, agriculture and forestry identified by Sri Lanka to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Environment to appoint a Committee chaired by the Secretary, Ministry of Environment to evaluate the said project proposals and reach decisions until the Carbon Market Strategy and Guiding Principles are implemented, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Removal of the requirement of Import Control License for importation of selected edible grains
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-06-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As of 2024‑05‑01, selected edible grains and commodities which have been classified under 126 HS Codes, have been subjected to the Import Control License whereas issuance of import control license relating to 53 HS Codes has been suspended as of now. In this backdrop, it has been found appropriate to remove the requirement of Import Control License for importation of grains in order to achieve the multiple objectives of eliminating black-market operation, illicit importation of grains, preventing the inflated retail price in an unfair and unjust manner and ensuring affordable price to the consumer and protection of domestic production by imposition of appropriate rate of duties and quarantine procedures. Accordingly, taking into account the recommendations made by a Committee chaired by the Secretary to the President and comprising of the Members of the Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka; Secretary to the General Treasury and the Senior Economic Advisor to the President, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to remove the requirement of Import Control License for importation of green gram, black gram, cow peas, kurakkan, flour of soya beans and ground nuts while taking necessary measures so as to protect the local manufacturers, subject to  submission of the National Plant Quarantine Permit of the National Plant Quarantine Service and based on the recommendations of the Ministry of Agriculture and Plantation Industries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Committee to deal with the salary anomalies in the Public Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into account the representations made from time to time by the various employee categories in the Public Service and the relevant Trade Unions pertaining to the prevailing salary anomalies among said employee categories, the Cabinet decided to appoint a Committee of Experts to examine the said salary anomalies and submit a Report enabling to rectify those anomalies through the Budget for the year 2025.

description: Amending the Anti-Dumping and Countervailing Duties Act, No.2 of 2018 and the Safeguard Measures Act, No.3 of 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - During the preparation of the Economic Transformation Bill, it has been found the necessity of introducing consequential amendments to the Anti‑Dumping and Countervailing Duties Act, No.2 of 2018 and the Safeguard Measures Act, No.3 of 2018. The Bills for that purpose have been prepared by the Legal Draftsman and the Attorney General has given clearance for those Bills. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to publish the Amendment Bills for the Anti‑Dumping and Countervailing Duties Act, No.2 of 2018 and the Safeguard Measures Act, No.3 of 2018 in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for the approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Receiving financial Provisions to Construct the General Hospital and the 	Hospital for Children in Biyagama, Gampaha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As the demand for healthcare services in the Gampaha district is increasing day by day, the need to improve the healthcare service system in the said district has been identified. For that purpose, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑02‑12 to construct a general hospital and a hospital for children equipped with all modern facilities under a public - private partnership approach and to take over 02 plots of land called Millagahawatta and Delgahawatta (07 acres and 03 roods) in the Biyagama Divisional Secretariat division, based on the assessed value of the Government. Sontell Group Hong Kong International Limited has submitted a proposal expressing its willingness to provide the necessary funds for the construction of the proposed hospital. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Health to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the said Institution and the Government of Sri Lanka to secure funds for construction of the said hospital, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Compulsory Retirement Compensation Scheme to be implemented with 	the amalgamation of Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited (CFC) and 	Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited (CCFC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Under the Compulsory Retirement Compensation Scheme to be implemented for the employees relating to the amalgamation of Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited, 267 employees have expressed their consent to retire. Accordingly, Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries to implement the Compulsory Retirement Compensation Scheme to be implemented for the employees relating to the amalgamation of Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited and incur Rs.844 million from the funds of the two fertilizer companies in order to implement the proposed Compulsory Retirement Compensation Scheme, subject to the recommendations of the Officials' Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister regarding the retirement of excess employees of State Owned Enterprises under the oluntary Retirement Scheme.

description: Subjecting the Samurdhi Community Based Banks and Samurdhi	Community Based Banking Societies to the Government Audit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - 1,092 Samurdhi Community Based Banks and 335 Samurdhi Community Based Bank Societies are functioning throughout the country for the promotion of microfinance activities. These Community Based Banks and Community Based Bank Societies are audited annually by the Internal Audit Division of the Department of Samurdhi Development as per the provisions of the Samurdhi Act and the provisions mentioning that they should be audited by the National Audit Office are not included in the Samurdhi Act. It has been identified that through auditing the Samurdhi Community Based Banks and Samurdhi Community Based Bank Societies by the National Audit Office as well, will enable them to maintain transparency in their operations and develop credibility and recognition. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment to amend the Samurdhi Act, No.1 of 2013 amended by the Divineguma (Amendment) Act, No.2 of 2017 imposing provisions for that purpose and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Settling the outstanding statutory dues of Sri Lanka State Plantation	Corporation, Janatha Estates Development Board and Elkaduwa	Plantation 	Company Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - More than 2,000 cases are pending in the courts of various provinces due to the non-payment of outstanding statutory dues by Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation, Janatha Estates Development Board and Elkaduwa Plantation Company Limited. Since the earnings of these institutions are not sufficient to pay the said outstanding statutory dues, it has been identified that it is appropriate to provide the required cash amount for that purpose as a loan by the General Treasury and recover the relevant loan in installsments from the earnings of these institutions. After fully settling the total contribution of the Employees' Provident Fund by these institutions, the Commissioner General of Labour has the ability to reduce the surcharge payable with regard to that amount, in accordance with the provisions of the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No. 15 of 1958. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to provide necessary funds from the General Treasury for the payment of outstanding statutory dues of the institutions, Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation, Janatha Estates Development Board and Elkaduwa Plantation Company Limited and to instruct the Commissioner General of Labour to reduce the maximum amount that can be deducted from the surcharges to be paid by the said institutions as per the provisions of the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No. 15 of 1958 after settlement of the outstanding statutory dues, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the 60th Session of the International Coconut Community (ICC) and Ministerial Meeting in Sri Lanka in the year 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to host the 60th ICC Session and Ministerial Meeting in Sri Lanka in this year in order to achieve the objectives of increasing foreign exchange earnings, promoting Sri Lankan Coconut Industry among the member countries and improving collaboration among the key stakeholders of the coconut sector. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries to host the said Session and the Ministerial Meeting in Colombo in November in this year with the contribution of revenue generated by the Coconut Development Authority and of the several private institutions in the coconut sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of infrastructure in the Wildlife Circuit Bungalows belonging 	to the Department of Wildlife Conversations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - There are 52 Circuit Bungalows managed by the Department of Wildlife Conversations at present and it has been found necessary to develop the physical facilities in those Bungalows in order to provide more qualitative services through the said Bungalows. It has been identified that it would be appropriate to physically develop the said Circuit Bungalows so as to provide a high quality service, with the participation of private sector institutions and parties who are interested in voluntarily contributing to those activities, in a manner that does not contravene the provisions of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation to call for Expressions of Interest from the said parties and enter into Memoranda of Understanding with the parties selected accordingly and the Department of Wildlife Conservation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Wages for Plantation Workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Although the Government has recently announced an increase in daily wage for plantation workers, some plantation companies have made representations to the Government on the inability to pay the increased wages. Taking into consideration the said situation, the proposal made by the Hon. President to take the  following measures, was approved by the Cabinet.

(i) 	To estimate the minimum wage be paid to a plantation worker by the 	Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, 	taking 	into account the current cost of living and the impact of the recent 	economic crisis.

(ii)	To appoint a Committee to examine the capacity of each Plantation 	Company 	on the payment of the salary so estimated.

(iii)	Further, if any company fails to pay salaries due to its poor management,	to 	take necessary action to introduce laws enabling to cancel the Land 	Lease 	Agreements entered into with such companies.

description: Amendments to the Anti-Dumping and Countervailing Duties Act No. 2 of 2018 and the Safeguard Measures Act No. 3 of 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024 05 13 to publish the Economic Transformation Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter, to Parliament. During the preparation of the said Bill, it has been found necessary to make consequential amendments to the the Anti-Dumping and Countervailing Duties Act No. 2 of 2018 and the Safeguard Measures Act No. 3 of 2018. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the Anti-Dumping and Countervailing Duties Act No. 2 of 2018 and the Safeguard Measures Act No. 3 of 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Integrated Development Plan for Bingiriya Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bingiriya Export Processing Zone is being developed into a fully-fledged export processing zone complete with industrial and investment zones, common facilities, access roads, internal roads and other relevant infrastructure. 157 acres of land under Phase I and 282 acres of land under Phase II of the said plan will be developed and an additional 666 acres have been identified for development under Phase III. In order to maximize the economic benefits of this Export Processing Zone, it has been planned to develop Iranawila and Chilaw areas as a tourism hub, to construct a Golf Course in Chilaw and to construct a road connecting Bingiriya Export Processing Zone with Iranawila tourism hub in parallel with the said project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to to implement an integrated development plan for the Bingiriya area and to entrust the Task Force which has already been appointed to supervise and coordinate all development activities under the said plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Updating and revising the license fees prescribed by the Firearms Ordinance (Chapter 182) No. 33 of 1916 and the Firearms (Amendment) Act No.22 of 1996
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of the Firearms Ordinance No. 33 of 1916 and the Firearms (Amendment) Act No.22 of 1996, the Ministry of Defence issues firearms on licenses for agricultural and non-agricultural purposes and an annual tax is levied in respect of the same. The number of firearms issued so far by the Ministry of Defence is 34,318 and approximately Rs 45 million is credited to the General Treasury annually as license fees. Although the Ministry of Defence has taken necessary action to fully amend the Firearms Ordinance No. 33 of 1916 and the Firearms (Amendment) Act No.22 of 1996 to suit with timely requirements, it has been found necessary to amend the relevant license fee to suit with the present day needs until the aforesaid amendments are made. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to expeditiously amend subsection (1) of section 24 and section 34 of the Firearms Ordinance so as to pursue action accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Revenue Administration System for Sri Lanka Excise 	Department (RASED)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although the Sri Lanka Excise Department is a revenue-generating Department, inefficiency of the old systems available with the Department to assist for its revenue administration functions has resulted in deficiencies such as the related loss of revenue and irregularities as well as it has led to the difficulty in accessing the information required by public and other relevant parties. Similarly, problematic situations have emerged in working together with information systems of other Institutions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to introduce a Revenue Administration System for Sri Lanka Excise Department with a view to installing more efficient and productive Information Communication Technology System in order to carry out the basic functions such as exchange of all data, risk management and revenue reconciliation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Construction Supervision and Contract Administration Consultancy Contract for 28 sites in Phase II of the Reduction of Landslide Vulnerability by Mitigation Measures Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Reduction of Landslide Vulnerability by Mitigation Measures Project which is implemented by the National Building Research Organization is a project with 5 components. Under its first component, 127 places prone to landslides will be structurally stabilized and construction work has been completed on 24 sites under its Phase I. Under its Phase II, civil works contracts relating to landslide mitigation in 32 places belonging to the Kalutara, Rathnapura and Matara Districts have already been awarded. Out of the remaining 71 places, landslide mitigation civil works have been designed to carry out in 28 places belonging to Kandy, Kurunegala, Kegalle and Matale Districts (under Package number 5) through 5 contracts. Expressions of Interest have been invited following the National Competitive Procurement Procedure to select a Consultant for the construction Supervision and Contract Administration of the civil works in Package No.05. Accordingly, after evaluating all the proposals received, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to award the contract for the provision of consultancy services for Package No. 5 to Resources Development Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd., Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new law on Reciprocal Recognition, Registration and Enforcement of Foreign Judgments
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022 07 18 to prepare a Bill to introduce a new law for Reciprocal Recognition, Registration and Enforcement of Foreign Judgments and to repeal the Reciprocal Enforcement of Judgments Ordinance No. 14 of 1921. Accordingly, the Bill on the Reciprocal Recognition, Registration and Enforcement of Foreign Judgments, incorporating the provisions for recognition and registration of a foreign judgment awarded for the dissolution or annulment of a marriage or separation of the parties to a marriage, has been prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rescue, Rehabilitation and Insolvency Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2023 06 26 to the Law Commission to discuss with the relevant parties and prepare a preliminary draft in order to introduce a unified Insolvency Law. Accordingly, with the technical expertise of the World Bank and in consultation with interested government and private sector stakeholders, the Law Commission has prepared a preliminary draft as a basis for the preparation of the Rescue, Rehabilitation and Insolvency Bill. The joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a bill for the relevant purpose based on the said preliminary draft, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply, Delivery and Construction of 220kV 2nd underground Cable from Kerawalapitiya Grid Sub Station to Colombo Port Grid Sub Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that it is very much essential to construct the 2nd underground Cable from Kerawalapitiya Grid Sub Station to the Colombo Port Grid Sub Station to supply electricity to meet the most essential commercial energy requirements for the Port City Development, Port Terminal Development and Mega scale mixed development projects in the Colombo metropolitan area. Accordingly, approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2021 09 13 to call for bids for the project of Supply, Delivery and Construction of 220kV 2nd underground Cable from Kerawalapitiya Grid Sub Station to Colombo Port Grid Sub Station. Accordingly, after evaluating the bids received, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the relevant procurement to Consortium of Jiangsu ETERN Co. Ltd, China & LS Cable & System Limited (LS Cable) Korea which has been recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee as the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Capacities of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) 	under the Long Term Generation Expansion Plan (LTGEP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In order to achieve the target of meeting 70% of the country's electricity demand from renewable energy resources by 2030, it is imperative to absorb the targeted renewable energy capacities which will be generated through the projects expected to be implemented during the period of 2024-2030 to the National electricity Grid. The Government has focused special attention to develop the wind and solar potentials in the country and with the gradual increase of variable Renewable Energy integration to the power system, a more flexible power system is required to ensure the reliability of the system. As an appropriate method for the purpose, Battery Energy Storage Systems has been identified under the Long Term Generation Expansion Plan. Based on the recommendations of the Committee appointed to examine and submit recommendations regarding the application of that system during the period of 2024-2023, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to develop identified battery capacities to connect to the national electricity grid through private investments or public-private partnership methods, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the Affiliated membership of the Foundation for Environmental	Education for the project of establishing Blue Flag Beaches in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Various programmes have been introduced to protect the environment of the coastal areas crucial for the tourism industry and to ensure the safety and health conditions of the tourists visiting coastal regions. The Blue Flag Beach Certification Programme is one of the prominent programmes out of those programmes and is also a popular eco-friendly brand among the tourists. The Blue Flag Certification is issued under this programme for the beach in concern on meeting 32 criteria under four (04) main elements of water quality, environmental management, environmental education information and the people's safety. The Blue Flag Certification is issued by the Foundation of Environmental Education in Denmark and in order to issue the Blue Flag Certificates in Sri Lanka, it is necessary to have an organization in this country that has obtained the affiliated membership of the said institution. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to obtain the affiliated membership of the Foundation of Environmental Education in Denmark to the Marine Environment Protection Authority for two (02) years and enter into a Collaborative Agreement with the Foundation for Environmental Education for that purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Hospital, Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Teaching Hospital, Karapitiya functions as the main health center that provides tertiary care services except for maternity care services to the patients in the Southern Province and adjacent provinces and the primary and secondary healthcare institutions in those provinces refer patients to this hospital for specialized services. The Professorial Unit has been established at the Teaching Hospital, Karapitiya for teaching purposes of the Faculty of Medicine and the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of University of Ruhuna. Accordingly, this hospital provides teaching and training facilities annually to around 1,100 medical undergraduates of the University Ruhuna, around 500 nursing students of the Nursing Training School, Galle and nearly 100 physiotherapists, pharmacists and medical laboratory technologists. With the increasing of the bed capacity up to 2,858 by the end of this year, the Teaching Hospital, Karapitiya will become the largest tertiary care centre second only to the National Hospital of Sri Lanka in Colombo. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to designate the Teaching Hospital, Karapitiya as National Hospital, Galle, categorizing the same as well as a National Hospital in addition to the National Hospital, Colombo and the National Hospital, Kandy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking over the Base Hospital, Pottuvil by the Central Government and	developing as a specialized hospital for Medical Tourism in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Base Hospital, Pottuvil which had been providing services since early 19th century, is one of the oldest hospitals in Sri Lanka. Considering the current demand for health facilities in the area, it has been identified the appropriateness of converting the above hospital into a Base Hospital providing integrated health care with paying ward facilities for tourists, palliative care services, elderly care services and Ayurvedic treatment facilities for tourism. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to vest the Base Hospital, Pottuvil which is currently under the purview of the Ministry of Health-Eastern Province, with the Ministry of Health with the concurrence of the Governor of the Eastern Province and make the said hospital function as the Integrated Health Care Institution in the South-East region of the country including all the necessary facilities for the promotion of the Medical Tourism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tripartite Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and CHEC 	Port	City Colombo (Pvt) Ltd
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Tripartite Agreement has been signed among the then Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development, Urban Development Authority on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka and CHEC Port City Colombo (Pvt) Ltd in 2016, for implementation of the Colombo Port City Development Project. According to the said Agreement, the target completion date of the Project is 2025-06-05. Since it is observed that the Project will not be completed on the scheduled date due to reasons as However, due to the Covid -19 pandemic that prevailed and financial constraints of the Project company and the inability to generate sufficient revenue to meet its obligations to the creditors, the Project company has submitted a request to extend the time period of completion of the Project by two (02) years. Taking into consideration that request, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to extend the implementation time period of the Colombo Port City Development Project up to 2027-06-05 and sign an Addendum among the current parties to the said Tripartite Agreement; the Ministry of Investment Promotion and Colombo Port City Economic Commission on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka and CHEC Port City Colombo (Pvt) Ltd, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship	Programme - 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan offers Master's Degrees and Doctorate Degree opportunities to the executive level officials in the public sector in Sri Lanka under the Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme. Three Frameworks have been completed under this Programme from year 2010 to 2021 and its Fourth Framework has been started in 2022 and is scheduled to end in year 2025. Under this Programme, 225 and 17 opportunities have been offered up to now to study Postgraduate courses and PhD courses respectively and the Government of Japan has agreed to provide a grant assistance of Japanese Yen 304 million (approximately Rs.578 million) for the third batch of the Fourth Framework. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to sign the relevant Exchange of Notes with the Government of Japan to obtain that grant assistance and enter into an agreement with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Economic Transformation Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval in principle has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑03‑25 for the initial draft of the Economic Transformation Bill and the Legal Draftsman have been instructed to prepare and submit the formal Bill promptly incorporating the amendments submitted by the Attorney General. The Attorney General's clearance has been received for the Bill that has been prepared accordingly. The proposal made by the Hon. President to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project to Grant State lands to war heroes for residential purposes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Circular instructions have been issued from time to time by the Commissioner General of Lands on approval of the Cabinet on the procedure to be followed in allotting State lands for residential purposes to the war heroes of the Tri-Forces, Sri Lanka Police and Department of Civil Security who have sacrificed their lives, gone missing, disabled while serving in the war front, retired and those who are still engaged in active service. It has been observed that the concessions offered to the war heroes with the approved procedures at present are not adequate and the real economic value of the said lands is not depicted due to the restrictive factors prevailing in the legal instruments with conditions for the lands in possession. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. President to take necessary action to revise the existing system by incorporating solutions to the problems that have arisen due to the current system when granting lands to the war heroes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acceleration of Rural Development Programmes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Provision of Rs. 212.59 billion has been allocated through the Budget 2024 to several ministries under 50 proposals for the sectors identified as in need of expeditious development. Projects related to 13 of those proposals are being implemented under the Presidential Secretariat. Due to the economic crisis prevailed in the last few years and having to halt certain development programmes initiated with foreign aids until the completion of debt restructuring process, the rural communities have been deprived of the benefits of the development programmes that had been planned to be implemented at the rural level. In particular, requests have been received from the various parties for the speedy completion of development projects such as rural roads, bridges, small tanks, canals development, rural enterprise development programmes as well as rural schools, hospitals, low-income housing and rural water supply. As a remedy to the above, the proposal made by the Hon. President to submit a proposal to Parliament to use the anticipated funds saved from the programmes that have been allocated under the Presidential Secretariat, to complete the essential development work that are implemented at the rural level and the rural development tasks which have been halted halfway, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Technology Promotion Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2023‑12‑18 to make necessary institutional reforms for digital transformation and to prepare a concept paper to amend the Information and Communication Technology Act, No. 27 of 2003. Accordingly, a concept paper has been prepared to introduce new legislation for digital transformation, and it has been proposed to establish a Technology Innovation Council and a Digital Transformation Agency. The proposal made by the Hon.President to introduce the Technology Promotion Act by repealing the Information and Communication Technology Act No. 27 of 2003 and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill based on the concept paper that has been prepared, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of 1,000 Officers belonging to the Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service, the Sri Lanka Teacher Educators' Service and the Sri Lanka Principals' Service to the Post of Commissioned Officer of the National Cadet Corps
