decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Cadet Corps has been established under the Ministry of Defence as a supplementary force under Part V of the Mobilization and Supplementary Forces Act No. 40 of 1985. Officers in the Ministry of Education and school students are recruited respectively as officers and cadets of the said Corps. In order to further promote the cadet activities in the education sector, it has been intended to conduct a basic training course to recruit officers belonging to the Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service, Sri Lanka Teacher Educators' Service and the Sri Lanka Principals' Service to the  National Cadet Corps and it has been planned to recruit 1,000 officers in Grade I,II and III of the said services and appoint them as Commissioned Officers after a basic training. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and the Minister of Education to formally select 1,000 qualified officers belonging to Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service, Sri Lanka Teacher Educators' Service and the Sri Lanka Principals' Service and appoint them to the Post of Commissioned Officer after providing them with a basic training under 03 batches, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Power Wheeling Facility for Electricity Customers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The approach to collectively utilize the electricity network of electricity transmission and distribution to provide electricity to a place which require electricity is known as Power Wheeling Facility. Under the Power Wheeling Facility, it enables the electricity consumers to utilize their own energy plants situated elsewhere using the existing electricity network by minimizing the electricity cost effectively, subject to payment of a charge. Since there are no legal provisions to implement said system in Sri Lanka, a Committee has been appointed to conduct a detailed study pertaining to the provision of that facility. The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to implement the Power Wheeling Facility only for new renewable energy projects, based on the recommendations of the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commencement of G.C.E (Advanced Level) classes immediately after the completion of the G.C.E (Ordinary Level) Examination
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Following the conclusion of the G.C.E (Ordinary Level) Examination, the Department of Examinations takes at least 03 months to release the results of the said exam. Dropping out of students from school education during this period has resulted a decline in student enrollment to pursue G.C.E (Advanced Level) thereby creating various social problems as well. Taking into account the said matters, it has been identified that it would be appropriate to commence academic activities of Advanced Level in schools just after the completion of the G.C.E (Ordinary Level) Examination in the year 2024, enabling the students to manage their time efficiently and to provide teachers with adequate time period to cover the G.C.E (Advanced Level) syllabus. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to commence G.C.E (Advanced Level) classes for students who sat for the G.C.E (Ordinary Level) Examination for the year 2023 in May 2024 immediately after the said examination, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Giving priority for the students of the Advanced Level Vocational Stream when providing vocational training in National Vocational Qualifications (NVQ level 4)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Students are given the opportunity to study Advanced Level Vocational Stream irrespective of their passing/failing at the G.C.E (Ordinary Level) Examination and at present, the said stream is in operation in 604 schools covering almost all Educational Divisions. Under the said stream, general subjects which develop soft skills should be followed in Grade 12, whereas, in Grade 13, students are provided with the opportunity to follow a NVQ Level 4 course for 06 months and obtain an on-the-job training of 06 months. 17 Vocational Training Institutions operating under 07 ministries have entered into Memoranda of Understanding with the Ministry of Education to continue NVQ level 4 courses for those students. As there are currently about 50,000 students registered to study under the Vocational Stream, it has been found the necessity to give priority to those students by all the Vocational Training Institutions operating under the the Government to provide relevant vocational training. Accordingly, Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Education, to make it a mandatory task of the Vocational Training Institutions operating under all ministries to provide vocational training to the students who study Advanced level Vocational Stream and give priority to Vocational Stream students when enrolling students in the NVQ 4 courses of those Institutions annually and provide facilities required for training.

description: Implementation of a Voluntary Retirement Scheme for the Staff of the Sri Lanka Savings Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Savings Bank, as of now, has decided to acquire the assets of the Sri Lanka Savings Bank which became a fully owned subsidiary of the National Savings Bank in the year 2019, and to absorb its employees. Accordingly, the absorption process of the employees is currently underway and it has been decided to introduce a Voluntary Retirement Scheme as an alternative and to make a payment for the employees who retire voluntarily, taking into account the market factors. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to implement the said Voluntary Retirement Scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Institutionalizing the Results-based Management in the Public Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Project Management and Monitoring in collaboration with Line Ministries have prepared “Ministerial Results Frameworks” of 10 Ministries and institutions coming under their purview, under which a high amount of budgetary provisions is allocated. Said “Ministerial Results Frameworks” will ensure the achievement of development targets within the purview of the relevant institutions in a timely manner and achievement of intended outcomes, while adhering to the responsibilities of the hierarchy of each Ministry. Further, it is expected that this would also pave the way for a result-oriented institutional structure that measures the effectiveness of investments made to address citizen's needs urgently. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to entrust the responsibility of achieving the targets containing in the designed Ministerial Results Frameworks with the Secretaries to relevant Line Ministries and to assign the responsibility of supervising the performance of such activities to the National Operations Room, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the 484 MW of Wind Power Plants in Mannar and Pooneryn
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑03‑07 to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding for the development of Wind Power Plants in Mannar and Pooneryn by M/s Adani Green Energy Limited, India. Accordingly, Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee has been appointed to evaluate the Project Proposal submitted by the above company. The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to determine the value of US$ 8.26 cents per Kilowatt hour as the final tariff (subject to payment in Sri Lankan Rupees as per the actual exchange rate) for the electricity generated under the proposed project and to award the tender to M/s Adani Green Energy SL Limited for purchasing of electricity for a period of 20 years, based on the recommendations of the said committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Medical Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑10‑09 has granted approval to implement the recommendations submitted by the Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to submit recommendations to amend the provisions of the Medical Ordinance to formulate a National Policy including standards and criteria to be based for the recognition of Medical Degree courses of the internationally recognized Universities,  in Sri Lanka and to suit with the present day needs. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Medical Ordinance based on the said recommendations. The proposal made by the Minister of Health to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Teachers Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed through the National Education Policy Framework to establish a National Teachers Council in parallel with other professional service categories and international best practices for the professional advancement and enhancement of quality of teachers through continuous professional development. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Education to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to establish a National Teachers Council based on the initial draft prepared having lengthy discussions with the relevant stakeholders in the field of education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Digitization of the General Education in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-05-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per a project proposal submitted pertaining to the digital transformation of the general education system in Sri Lanka, the Government of China has extended its willingness to provide funds for the said purpose. A feasibility study relating to the implementation of the said project has also been carried out as of now. Through the proposed project, it is expected to provide Delivering Class Rooms, Receiving Class Rooms to schools and a Data Centre, Studio Room and a Conference Room to the Ministry of Education in order to operate those functions. It will enable to get the support of the said equipment to carry out effectively and efficiently the activities of implementing the blended learning systematically, sharing resources, providing the knowledge of teachers with special teaching skills for the students in schools when necessary, avoiding the problematic situations that arise when there is a shortage of teachers and facilitating the proposed education reforms. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to implement the proposed project, based on the relevant feasibility study Report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure Act to	prohibit Corporal punishment in all spheres
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Convention on the Rights of the Child to which Sri Lanka is a party, sets out the Civil, Political, Economic, Social and Cultural Rights of the Child. Article 19(1) of the Convention on the Rights of the Child mentions that the States Parties shall take all appropriate legislative, administrative and educational measures to protect the child from all forms of physical or mental violence, injury or abuse, neglect or negligent treatment, maltreatment or exploitation, including sexual abuse, while in the care of parents, legal guardians or any other person who has the care of the child. The United Nations Committee on the Rights of the Child in its latest observations on Sri Lanka states that a high number of children are subjected to abuse and violence, including corporal punishment at home, alternative care settings, penal institutions and schools due to insufficient legal provisions. Also, by the Supreme Court judgment related to a Fundamental Rights Petition filed by a student recently, who was slapped by a teacher which resulted in a permanent hearing impairment, has determined that the teacher in concern and the State have violated Article 11 of the Constitution. It has also been scientifically proved that such corporal punishment has a long-term effect on a child physically and mentally. Therefore, Legal Amendments to cover any act falling under the category of cruel and/or degrading physical and/or non-physical punishment should be introduced expeditiously. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to amend the Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure Act by incorporating provisions for the prohibition of corporal punishment in all spheres, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act, No.25 of 1991
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2024-01-01 to amend the Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act No. 25 of 1991. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General have been received for the Sri Lanka Telecommunications (Amendment) Bill, which has been prepared in all three languages by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter to submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Designating CHINA HARBOUR ENGINEERING COMPANY (LANKA)	LIMITED as a Secondary Business of Strategic Importance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - CHINA HARBOUR ENGINEERING COMPANY (LANKA) LIMITED has been identified as a Secondary Business of Strategic Importance as a business engaged in business activities of generation of employment opportunities, sustainable development and urban amenity operations in the settlement of a residential community. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to grant the Exemptions or Incentives proposed in the Acts identified under Schedule II of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, to the respective business and to publish the Order for the same through a Gazette Notification, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Project period of the Technological Education Development Programme under the loan from OPEC Fund for International Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although the Technological Education Development Programme was initiated in the year 2018 and was scheduled to be completed by the year 2022, owing to the reasons such as Covid pandemic and the economic adversities arisen in the country, the said project could not be completed within the stipulated time period. Previously, approval of the Cabinet has been granted to extend the project period until 2024‑03‑30. Under the project, it has been planned to construct 36 technology laboratories across the 09 provinces, 04 laboratories designated for each province, and to upgrade 15 existing building laboratories. The physical progress of the project as of now is 65%. Further, it has been planned to utilize the foreign funds expected to be remained under the project to establish and upgrade Mini Technology Units for 135 schools where the technology stream is already in operation as well as to supply essential technical goods and equipment and for the capacity building of the teachers. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to further extend the project period up to 2025‑03‑30, so that anticipated objectives of the project could be achieved, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Self-sustained Culture-based Inland Fisheries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has agreed to provide a grant of US$ 3 million for the Project for Development of Self-sustained Culture-based Inland Fisheries to Ensure Food and Nutrition Security and Livelihood Improvements in Rural Communities to be implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO). The proposed project is planned to be implemented in Anuradhapura, Batticaloa, Mullaitivu and Monaragala Districts and is expected to increase inland fish production in the selected reservoirs and ensure sustainability of the inland fishery industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries to exempt the relevant taxes for goods and equipment to be imported for the implementation of the said Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Utilization of resources of the Sri Lanka Forestry Institute of the Department of Forest Conservation to popularize forestry education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been recognized that, in addition to the regular in-service training courses conducted for officers of the Department of Forest Conservation, conducting training programmes for officers in Government and Non-government institutions as well using the facilities available in the Sri lanka Forestry Institute could develop positive attitudes towards forests among them and their knowledge and skills. Further, providing the facilities of the Sri Lanka Forestry Institute to other Institutions and the public also enables the Government to earn an additional income. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation to provide the Sri Lanka Forestry Institute, Nuwara Eliya and its Inamaluwa Field Training Centre to external parties for conducting short term training programmes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Rwanda and Sri Lanka for exemption of Diplomatic, Official or Service Passport Holders from obtaining Visa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Even though approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2019‑05‑07 to sign a Memorandum of Understanding for exemption of Diplomatic, Official or Service Passport holders from the requirement of obtaining Visa with the objective of developing bilateral relations between Sri Lanka and Rwanda, the said MoU could not be signed as of now. The proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to sign the said MoU between Sri Lanka and Rwanda for exemption of Diplomatic, Official or Service Passport holders from obtaining Visa for a period not exceeding 30 days, as agreed between two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of the Karainagar Boat Yard of Cey-Nor Foundation Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Cey-Nor Foundation Limited established in the year 1967 in Karainagar, Jaffna with aid of NORGES GODTEMPLAR UNGDOMS FORBUND (NGU), a Norwegian Non Governmental Organization, has been incorporated as a Public Company in the year 1990. This Foundation has been engaged in the fiberglass boat manufacturing and operations of the Karainagar Boat Yard has been ceased since 1990 due to the situation which prevailed in that area. Although, Rs. 350 million had been spent for the renovation of this Boat Yard in the year 2016, balance civil works and procurement of machinery have not been completed due to insufficient funds. The Government of India has agreed to provide a grant subject to a maximum of Sri Lankan Rupees 290 million to complete the rehabilitation works of the Karainagar Boat Yard belonging to Cey-Nor Foundation Limited and for several other works. Concurrence of the Department of National Planing and the Department of External Resources has been received for this Project. Clarence of the Attorney General and the concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs have been received for the Memorandum of Understanding to be signed between the two parties to obtain the proposed grant. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries to sign the MoU to obtain the said grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Operation of a Gold Shop at Departure/Transit Area of the Bandaranaike 	International Airport (BIA), Katunayaka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The appropriateness of introducing a gold business at the Departure/Transit Area of the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA), Katunayaka as a new business venture has been considered and proposals in that regard have been submitted by Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited. Since this facility is not available at the Bandaranaike International Airport at present, Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited has planned to establish a "Gold Shop" at the Departure/ Transit area at BIA. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to invite bids following the International Competitive Bidding Procedure to select a suitable operator to operate a Gold Shop at the Departure/ Transit area at BIA, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and Kazakhstan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - 	Although approval had been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2015‑05‑13 	to sign an Air Services Agreement between the aeronautical authorities of the Kazakhstan and Sri Lanka for the purpose of developing Air Services between the two countries, the said Air Services Agreement has not yet been signed. Under the proposed Air Services Agreement, it is expected to operate 07 frequencies per week 	from any point in Sri Lanka to Astana and/ or Almaty in Kazakhstan. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to sign the Air Services Agreement which has been agreed upon by both parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kankesanthurai Harbour Rehabilitation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2017‑05‑02 to implement the Kankesanthurai Harbour Rehabilitation Project under the Indian Credit Line and approval has been granted on 2019‑12‑18 to award project management consultancy services. Owing to exceeding the estimated cost prepared by the consultancy services agency than the relevant loan amount, it has been impossible to proceed with the project activities as expected. Therefore, further discussions have been held with the Government of India regarding the possibility of completing the said project under the Public-Private Partnership Methodology. Accordingly, considering the importance of the said project, the Government of India has agreed to provide its total estimated cost as a Financial Grant. Accordingly, The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to accept the said Financial Grant and enter into the relevant agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transforming the Mirissa Marine Zone into a Blue Flag Coastal Zone that meets international standards and a Marine Wildlife Sanctuary
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The proposal to declare the Mirissa Marine Zone as a Marine Wildlife Sanctuary has been taken into discussion at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023‑05‑22. A Cabinet Sub-Committee has been appointed then under the Chairmanship of the Hon. Prime Minister to further study on the said proposal with the participation of all relevant parties and submit recommendations to the Cabinet. Accordingly, the said Sub-Committee has submitted its recommendations aiming at increasing the tourism economy in the Southern province by five times by transforming the Mirissa Marine Zone into a Blue Flag Zone that meets international standards and a Marine wildlife Sanctuary. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to implement the said recommendations through the relevant ministries and institutions in charge of the subject, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Indonesia - Sri Lanka Preferential Trade Agreement (ISLPTA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2023‑07‑10 to initiate negotiations on a Preferential Trade Agreement with Indonesia. Official discussions related thereto have been conducted on 2024‑03‑14 between the State Minister of Foreign Affairs and the Deputy Minister of Trade in Indonesia and the First Meeting of the Trade Negotiation Committee has been held on 3rd and 4th April 2024, via online. At the said Negotiation Committee,views have been exchanged between the two parties regarding the modality of the negotiations, time frame for the exchange of relevant data, scope and coverage. The two parties have agreed to hold the 2nd meeting of the said Committee on 19th and 20th of June 2024 in Colombo. Accordingly, the Cabinet considered the facts submitted by the Hon. President on the progress so far achieved from the proposed Preferential Trade Agreement as referred to at above.

description: Appointment of Community Advisory Committees at Local Government	Institutions Level to monitor the implementation of Government	Development Programmes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government is implementing various programmmes and projects to improve the quality of life of all citizens of Sri Lanka and it has been observed that it would be suitable to promote the transparency and accountability in governance by having the community involved in monitoring those programmmes and projects. It will also enable to obtain the knowledge and participation of the community in the said programmes and projects and to ensure that the programmes are tailored to meet the specific needs in each region. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to authorize the Provincial Governors to appoint Community Advisory Committees on honorary basis to supervise the implementation of the Urumaya Land Ownership Programme, Urban Housing Ownership Programme, Kandukara Dashakaya Development Programme, Agriculture Modernization Programme and the Rice Distribution Programme in coordination with the respective Divisional Secretaries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Annual Economic Review of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka	and the Financial Statements and Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka	for the year 2023 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to section 80(3) of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, No. 16 of 2023, the Minister in charge of Finance must submit a Report to the Parliament on the state of the economy of the financial year within a period of four months after the close of each financial year. In addition, according to section 99(3) of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, the Financial Statements signed by the Governor of the Central Bank and the Chief Accountant and audited by the Auditor General must also be submitted to the Parliament within four months after the close of each financial year. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to present the Annual Economic Review prepared by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2023 and the Financial Statements and Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proceeds of Crime Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to the Agreement entered into with the International Monetary Fund to obtain the Extended Fund Facility, the Government of Sri Lanka should take steps to introduce a comprehensive asset recovery law. Accordingly, the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms has appointed a committee consisting of experts in the field of justice in March, 2023 to prepare the necessary policy and legal framework and procedure regarding the law on proceeds of crime. The joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to give instructions to the Legal Draftsman to prepare the Proceeds of Crime Bill based on the recommendations indicated in the Report submitted by the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Handing over the Management of Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2023-01-09 to call for Expressions of Interest from the interested parties for the use of facilities of the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport. Expressions of interest have been called accordingly and 05 institutions have submitted their Expressions of interest. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to transfer the management of Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport to M/s Shaurya Aeronautics (Pvt) Ltd and Airports of Regions Management Company of Russia or its joint venture for a period of 30 years as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka Act, No.34 of 2002 and the Civil Aviation Act, No.14 of 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been found essential to amend the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka Act, No.34 of 2002 and the Civil Aviation Act, No.14 of 2010 so as to suit to the Civil Aviation Policy of the country, industry requirements and the emerging global trends in the Civil Aviation, since the applications, boundaries and limitations of the Aviation Industry are rapidly growing day by day. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft Bills to amend the said Acts, based on the recommendations of the Committee appointed to obtain recommendations in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Duties to be performed by Sri Lanka within the year 2024 after accepting the Chairmanship of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka is required to organize several official meetings during the year 2024, after receiving the Chairmanship of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) which consists of 23 member countries bordering the Indian Ocean, for a period of 02 years. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to hold the following official meetings in Sri Lanka and to host the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

i.	Holding the 26th Meeting of the IORA Committee of the Senior Officials (CSO) on 30th and 31st May 2024.

ii.	Holding the 27th Annual Committee of the Senior Officials (CSO) in November 2024.

iii.	Holding the 24th meeting of the Council of Ministers (COM) in November 2024.

description: Introduction of a New Regulator for the Petroleum Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although the importation, refining, distribution and sale of petroleum products including Gasoline, Gas oil, Kerosene, Aviation Fuel Oil, Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) and Lubricants operate within the existing legal framework, this sector lacks a comprehensive regulatory mechanism. As many private entities are also involved in the importation and distribution of petroleum products, the need for an independent, dynamic, effective and efficient regulatory mechanism has been recognized to address the challenges in the said sector, enhance product quality and protect the interests of consumers, investors and other stakeholders. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to appoint a Committee headed by the Secretary, Ministry of Power and Energy to study in that regard and make recommendations and prepare a legal framework for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Two (02) Land Lots located in Pitipana, Homagama to National School of Business Management Limited (NSBM)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The land in extent of 237 Acres which is known as Mahenawatta located at Pitipana in Homagama has been acquired by the Urban Development Authority with the intention of reserving lands for the development of science and technology sectors as per the concept of “Knowledge Based Town” which comes under the Homagama Town Development Plan. The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to grant a portion of 14 Acres 03 Roods and 12.8 Perches and another portion of 20 Acres out of the above land for the construction of Phase II and phase III of National School of Business Management Limited respectively, to the said Institute, on long term lease basis, subject to charging the assessed value of the Chief Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding the First Conference of the Wetland Link International - Asia Oceania at Diyasaru Park, Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Wetland Link International (WLI) is an international support network for Wetland Education Centres which is led by the Wildfowl and Wetlands Trust (WWT) of the United Kingdom. WLI consists of 350 Wetland Education Centres across 06 continents. The Wetland Link International Asia has been established as a subsidiary to the WLI for the improvement of Wetlands in Asia and it comprises 100 member wetlands. In addition, WLI-Asia together with the Wetland Centers of Australia and New Zealand have formed the WLI-Asia Oceania. It has been proposed to hold the First Conference of the WLI - Asia Oceania in Colombo hosted by Diyasaru Park which is managed by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, together with Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions as a MICE Tourism Promotion Programme from 16 to 22 June 2024. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to hold and host the said Conference in Colombo with participation of 100 foreign delegations and 75 local groups, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting the Land where the Negombo Eththukala Beach Park is located with the Urban Development Authority for the development of the said Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Eththukala Beach Park (Browns Beach) with an extent of 06 Acres 01 Rood 9.1 Perches is the only beach park in the Negombo Municipal Council area and it is located in the High-Density Promotional Tourism Zone of the Negombo Development Plan 2021‑2030. The Negombo Municipal Council has decided to vest the management of the said Park with the Urban Development Authority with a view to converting the same as an attractive park for the local and foreign travelers. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to vest the said land with the  Urban Development Authority as a Free Grant as per the provisions of the State Land Ordinance in order to develop the same as a tourist zone in conformity with the relevant development plans, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion of the Mindfulness Training Programme being implemented 	for school children islandwide
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2022‑12‑12 to implement the "Programme for the Introduction of Mindfulness for School Children" with a  view to creating calmness by avoiding the frequent complexity and stress developing in the minds of school children. Accordingly, this programme is being implemented  successfully in each school in the country over a period of one year. The proposal made by the Minister of Education to commemorate the day following the Vesak Day as the National Mindfulness Day annually, to implement the programme called "Towards a Mindfulness Country from the Vesak Week' annually in future coinciding with the Vesak Week and to hold the 'International Mindfulness Conference' at the beginning of the Month of May in each year from the year 2024, as a step forward of the said Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Memoranda of Understanding/Agreements in view of Educational Collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Minister of Education to enter into the following  Memoranda of Understanding/Agreements between Sri Lankan Universities and Foreign Universities/Agencies with the objective of developing the higher educational collaboration, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	The Memorandum of Understanding between the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka and the University of Salford, United Kingdom pertaining to fostering multidisciplinary research for disaster resilience and integrated natural resource management.

*	The Tripartite Agreement among the University of Jaffna and the National University of Singapore and Singapore Health Services Pte. Ltd. to establish a Regional Collaborating Centre with the aim of coordinating global health efforts.

*	The Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Ruhuna and the Southern Health NHS Trust of the United Kingdom and Northern Ireland pertaining to the MARIE Project on the mental health effects of menopause on women globally.

*	The Memorandum of Understanding between the Open University of Sri Lanka and the Tomorrow Technology Education Service Center, China pertaining to the designation and empowerment of Tomorrow Technology Education Service Center as the duly authorized representative for the purpose of endorsing and marketing the academic programmes offered by the Open University of Sri Lanka to the students from China.

*	The Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Sri Jayewardenepura and the Tomas Bata University in the Czech Republic to develop cooperation between the two parties.

*	The Agreement between the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka and the University of Naples Federico II, Italy on capacity building, research collaborations, innovations and use of aquaculture biosystems technology.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Samastha Lanka	Sasanarakshaka Mandalaya and Vietnam Buddhist Sangha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Samastha Lanka Sasanarakshaka Mandalaya and Vietname Buddhist Sangha for further strengthening the existing cultural and religious relationship between Vietnam and Sri Lanka. The Draft Memorandum of Understanding for that purpose, has received the approval of the Minister of Foreign Affairs and the clearance of the Attorney General's Department. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of Indicative Price for selected Essential Food Commodities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that even though the Sri Lankan Rupee is becoming appreciated against the US Dollar and some other foreign currencies, no reduction is observed in the retail price of the imported essential food commodities in the market. Also, there is a significant difference between the landed price and the retail price of the essential	imported food commodities. Under this situation, the Consumer Affairs Authority has taken steps to implement a programme to study the estimated market prices of selected essential food commodities and publish those prices as Indicative Prices weekly, on the guidance of the Ministry of Trade, Commerce and Food Security. Through this, the consumers will be able to buy the said food items by being	vigilant of the market prices of those essential food commodities. The information submitted by the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security regarding the Indicative Prices of so selected 09 essential food commodities, was considered by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Electricity Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2023-11-20 to publish the Sri Lanka Electricity Bill in the Government Gazette and submit it to Parliament for approval. After the promulgation of the said bill accordingly, views and suggestions have been received from the various stakeholders including the general public and it has been identified further amendments to be made to include appropriate provisions in the said Bill after evaluation of the said views and suggestions and to enable better reflection of the Government policy on reforms of the Electricity sector. The Attorney General's clearance has been received for the Electricity Bill which has been re-prepared by the Legal Draftsman incorporating also the amendments identified as such. Accordingly, The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: “Nakathata Pelayak” - National Tree Planting Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to the 2024 Avurudu Nakath Seettuwa, the National Tree Planting Auspicious Time has been set as at 6.16 a.m. on April 18. The information presented by the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries, mentioning that the steps are being taken to apprise the public to plant a perennial crop with an export potential or a perennial crop with a food value at that auspicious time and implement a programme for that purpose, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of Automobile Workshops in Colleges of Technology and	Technical Colleges under the Grant Aid by Korea International Cooperation	Agency of the Republic of Korea (KOICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Korea International Cooperation Agency has provided financial assistance during the period 2013-2015 for the upgrading of 05 Automobile Technology courses in Maradana, Kandy, Bandarawela, Kegalle and Samanthurai Technical Colleges that are operated under the purview of the Department of Technical Education and Training. As the workshops have been in use for about 10 years now, their equipment needs to be repaired, updated and newly supplied. The Korea International Cooperation Agency has agreed to provide a grant assistance of US$ 75,500 for those tasks. The proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the proposed Record of Discussion to be signed between the two parties for that purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the proposed reforms of State-Owned Banks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the weaknesses in the fields of governance, risk management and supervision of the state-owned banks, these banks had to face severe difficulties during the recent economic crisis. Therefore, with the aim of preventing the recurrence of such difficulties, a number of reforms to be carried out in those banks have been identified by an expert committee consisting of the members of the International Monetary Fund, World Bank and Central Bank of Sri Lanka. As a Structural Benchmark of the Extended Fund Facility Programme provided by the International Monetary Fund, as well as the basic activities under the Development Policy Operations implemented by the World Bank, the said reforms have to be implemented promptly. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to implement those reform proposals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Security Deposits at Elections
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- It has been identified that it would be appropriate to update the existing limits of security deposits in a timely manner as per the present social, economic and political background, in terms of the provisions of the Presidential Elections Act, the Parliamentary Elections Act and the Provincial Councils Elections Act. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to revise the relevant security deposits as follows, was approved by the Cabinet.

    • Increasing the security deposit of a candidate from a recognized political party up to Rs. 2.6 million and the security deposit of an independent candidate up to Rs. 3.1 million, as per the the Presidential Elections Act No. 15 of 1981.
      
    • Increasing the security deposit of a candidate from a recognized political party up to Rs. 11,000/- and the security deposit of a candidate of an independent group up to Rs. 16,000/-, as per the Parliamentary Election Act, No. 1 of 1981.

    • Increasing the security deposit of a candidate representing a recognized 	political party up to Rs. 6,000/- and the security deposit of a candidate of an independent group up to Rs. 11,000/-, as per the Provincial Councils Elections Act, No. 2 of 1988.

description: Recruitment of 2,500 English Medium Teachers under the Programme on 	"English for All"
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified at an assessment conducted with regard to 765 schools the fact that although the existing approved cadre of teachers to teach GCE Ordinary Level subjects in English medium is 4,441, there is a requirement of 6,500 teachers for the purpose and many schools have expanded English medium teaching by making necessary arrangements in addition to the number of teachers currently employed. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Education to increase the number of 765 schools where subjects are taught in English medium, up to 1,000 in the year 2024 and to increase the approved cadre of English medium subject teachers up to 6500 and recruit 2500 English medium teachers to fulfill the teacher requirement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Designating as Secondary Businesses of Strategic Importance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposals made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to designate the following Companies as Secondary Businesses of Strategic Importance and grant exemptions or incentives to such Companies from the Acts indicated under Schedule II of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, and to publish the Orders for the same through the Gazette Notifications, was approved by the Cabinet.

    • PORT CITY BPO (PRIVATE) LIMITED - to maintain a business for providing shared Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) services for the overseas entertainment industry.
      
    • IVIVA PTE LTD - to maintain a business for providing Information Technology services that develops Smart City IT - enabled products and solutions to support their diverse portfolio of global clients to transition to low-carbon economy.

    • ECHELON TRADE (PVT) LTD - to maintain a business engaged with global trade of textiles, garments, luxury watches, gold and gems, electronics and cosmetics.

    • 99X TECHNOLOGY AS - to maintain a business in product engineering and innovations and providing services to global independent software vendors to formulate digital solutions to real user problems through web development, mobile development as well.

description: Submission of an Order under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act No. 40 of 1979 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑05‑29 has granted approval to resume the Sri Lanka's Tariff Liberalization Programme under the Sri Lanka - Singapore Free Trade Agreement. Taking into account the implementation of CESS Levy as at 2018‑05‑01, the said programme has been categorized into three categories as 'Category 0', 'Category 10' and 'Category X'. Accordingly, an Order under the provisions of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act No. 40 of 1979 has been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2024‑01‑04 to give effect to remove the first annual installment of 1/5th of CESS Levy applicable on 1,087 HS Codes categorized under the 'Category 10' and for the single point removal of the CESS Levy applicable on 300 HS Codes categorized under the Category of "0". As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to submit the said Order to Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations between the Sri Lanka and the Republic of Chad
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - At present, Sri Lanka has established diplomatic relations with 46 countries in the African continent, and the Republic of Chad also has expressed its consent to establish diplomatic relations with Sri Lanka. The Republic of Chad, as a multilateral partner, has extended its support to Sri Lanka in the United Nations and other multilateral forums. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to establish diplomatic relations with the Republic of Chad, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the establishment of Youth Agri-Entrepreneurship Villages to advance the Agriculture Modernization Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In view of attracting youth community to the agriculture and developing their economic status, it has been planned to implement the Project for establishing the Youth Agri-Entrepreneurship Villages to create a community of youth Agri-Entrepreneurs and to introduce the agriculture modernization to agricultural areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries to implement the Project for establishing the Agri-Entrepreneurship Villages by selecting one village each in the selected Divisional Secretariat Divisions in the year 2024 and to facilitate the young farming community to use new technology and smart technology, as its first phase, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka Institute of Biotechnology Private Limited (SLIBTEC) and the Monash University, Australia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka Institute of Biotechnology (Private) Limited and Monash University, Australia in order to establish collaboration for rsesearch and innovation related activities. The concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the clearance of the Attorney General have been received for the draft MoU which covers a wide range of activities including preparation of joint proposals with research and service collaborations, innovation, technology development and dissemination of knowledge, exchange of research materials, exchange of scholars, scientists and students, conduct of cooperative seminars, workshops and research related activities etc. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of Lands to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority under the provisions of the State Lands Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2017‑12‑12 for the acquisition or purchase of 50 acres of land belonging to the Sri Lanka Cement Corporation for the development of the Kankesanthurai Port by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority. Accordingly, the Sri Lanka Port Authority, as of now, has paid an amount of Rs. 52 million to the Sri Lanka Cement Corporation as an advance payment, based on the valuation of the Chief Government Valuer for the acquisition of the relevant land to the Sri Lanka Port Authority. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to take over some of the identified lands in extent of 23 acres and 12 perches to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority under section 6(1) of the State Lands Ordinance as an absolute free grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Drinking Water and National Policy on Water Safety
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity of a more comprehensive and updated approach to address the evolving trends and challenges in the drinking water supply services sector. Accordingly, having obtained the consultation of the experts in the relevant sector and stakeholders as well as comments of the general public, the 'National Policy on Drinking Water' and the 'National Policy on Water Safety' have been formulated. It is expected thereby to achieve the objectives of ensuring the access to safe and quality drinking water for all citizens, promote sustainable water use and foster economic growth and prosperity of the water sector. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to integrate and implement the 'National Policy on Drinking Water' and the 'National Policy on Water Safety' with other related policies as appropriate, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commencing a Ship in the Box Project in the Advanced Training Institute, Kirinda of the Sri Lanka Coast Guard
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Coast Guard of Sri Lanka has been established by the Department of Coast Guard Act, No.41 of 2009. The department is entrusted with the task of ensuring the security of the territorial waters and the high seas of Sri Lanka, preventing the entry and exit of illegal immigrants and emigrants, providing assistance to ensure maritime traffic safety, protecting the marine environment and preventing and combating maritime disasters. The said department in collaboration with various international organizations and global coast guard forces functions in a way that preserves the professionalism and legality of such duties. Accordingly, the United States of America has expressed its willingness to provide a Ship in the Box Project under the Department of State Export and Border Security of the the United States as a total grant of USD 355,575 (inclusive of all taxes) in order to train Sri Lanka Coast Guards. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to establish and implement the said project within the Advanced Training Institute, Kirinda, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enrollment of Students (Day Scholars) for the Degree in Medicine at the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University, on Payment Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University has been established under the Sir John Kotalawela Defence Academy (Amendment) Act No.27 of 1988. The Faculty of Medicine of this university has been initiated in the year 2011 to train Officer Cadets as Medical Professionals according to the service requirements of the armed services and award them degrees of Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery. Accordingly, as of now, the opportunity of following the Medical degree programme is granted to the local students only on enlisting as Officer cadets to the Tri-Forces or the Police and to the students with foreign qualifications only on the payment basis. Further expanding the said opportunity, it has been planned to enroll duly qualified applicants to the medical degree course, on payment basis from the year 2024 onwards. Accordingly, Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to enroll students to follow the degrees of Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery to the Medical Faculty of the Sir General John Kotelawala Defence University, on payment basis, following a criteria prepared including several other qualifications in addition to the Z-score system presently being followed by the University Grants Commission to enroll students to the National Universities in Sri Lanka.

description: Provision of essential transport facilities for the rapid development in the Tourism Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although it is generally considered as an accepted practice in the tourism industry the fact that the age of vehicles used for the transportation of tourists does not exceed 06 years, it has been found that the condition of vehicles used for the transportation of tourists is unsatisfactory and inadequate due to restriction on importation of vehicles and essential spare parts and the reputation gained by Sri Lanka as a leading tourist destination is somewhat damaged owing to the use of outdated vehicles. Therefore, it has been identified the necessity of importing essential vehicles for the growth of the tourism sector, taking into account the contribution of the tourism sector within the economic revitalization process of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Lands to import 750 vans with 6 -15 seats (including electric and hybrid vehicles) and 250 vehicles including mini coaches with 16-30 seats and coaches with 30-45 seats to be utilized for the transportation of tourists in particular, without granting special duty concessions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting Land Titles to the Plantation Community
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies has presented a proposal titled "Land Ownership for Estate Population" through the Budget Proposals 2024 to implement a special programme to provide freehold lands to the estate community. In order to implement the said proposal, a programme has been planned to be implemented jointly by the Ministry of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development and the New Villagers Development Authority for Plantation Region with the assistance of the Non Cabinet Ministry of State Plantation Enterprises Reforms. Under the said programme, 4,151 beneficiaries living in estates belonging to Regional Plantation Companies and State Plantation Companies have been identified and the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development to grant freehold deeds expeditiously for lands in which the aforesaid families are currently occupying, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Sanitary Pads for School Girls
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The total number of student population in Sri Lanka is approximately 04 million and it has been calculated that out of which 1.2 million school girls have attained puberty. The proposal made by the Minster of Education to implement a programme to provide sanitary pads free of charge annually for 800,000 school girls in most difficult schools, difficult schools, isolated schools, estate schools and urban schools with school girls in poverty, with effect from April 2024, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Cyclotron Based Pharmaceutical Production Facility in Sri Lanka on Build, Own and Operate (BOO) basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑03‑29 has granted approval to implement a Cyclotron Based Pharmaceutical Production Facility in Sri Lanka with loans granted from local banks and donations. Accordingly, Expressions of Interest have been invited to implement this Project on Build, Own and Operate (BOO) basis and 05 proposals have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minster of Power and Energy to award the relevant Contract to Access International (Pvt) Ltd. which has submitted the proposal having fulfilled all technical requirements, based on the recommendations of the Project Committee and the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Identified Scope of Work in the Main Terminal Building (MTB), Pier 02 and Pier 03 of the Bandaranaike International Airport Development Project (BIADP) Phase II Stage 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited for the above constructions from the contractors registered in the Construction Industry Development Authority, under the National Competitive Bidding Procedure in terms of the Cabinet decision dated 2023‑10‑30 and 04 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minster of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the contract for the relevant activities to the Access Engineering PLC, the substantially responsive bidder, based on the recommendations of Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for the Operating Lease of four (04) Wide-body Aircraft for SriLankan Airlines Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑03‑18 to award the contracts for the procurement of two (02) aircraft under operating lease out of the requirement of five (05) wide-body aircraft for SriLankan Airlines Limited. Based on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to obtain four (04) wide-body aircraft including an additional aircraft, was approved by the Cabinet.

* 	Contracts relating to obtain 02 aircraft to a lease rent of USD 360,000 from ORIX Aviation for a period of 06 years.

*	Contracts relating to obtain 02 aircraft to a lease rent of USD 365,000 from Aergo Capital Limited for a period of 08 years.

description: Submission of Orders published in the Gazettes for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)

description: Presentation of Regulations made by the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs under section 34(1) of the Convention Against Doping in Sport Act, No.33 of 2013, in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per the provisions of the Convention Against Doping in Sport Act, No.33 of 2013, the Prohibited List should be annually published in the Gazette. Since, it has been reported that prohibited substances are given to athletes as well as animals used in sports, related Prohibited List for Equestrian Sports and Horse Racing has also been published from this year. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs to present the Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No.09 of 2023 published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2373/14 dated 2024‑02‑27 under the provisions of the Convention Against Doping in Sport Act, No.33 of 2013, for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notifications for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)

description: Establishment of 09MW solar PV Power Plants with 1-5 MW capacity in 	Pallekele
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Cabinet has granted approval on 2023‑05‑22 to call for proposals for the establishment of solar PV power plants with 07 MW capacity. Accordingly, after evaluating the proposals so received, 04 successful project proponents have been identified by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee. Further, after evaluating the proposal of another investor based on the recommendations of the Procurement Appeal Board, the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee has recommended the said investor also as a suitable investor for the implementation of a 05 MW capacity solar PV power plant project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the contracts to build and operate solar PV power plants with a total capacity of 09 MW, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Permission to import Black gram
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The annual black gram requirement in Sri Lanka is about 20,000 MT, but due to the	time durations of the product reaching the market, a shortage of black gram in the	market is observed during the festive months of April and December every year. Accordingly, measures should be taken to prevent the shortage of black gram in the market and control the price increase in black gram during the coming festive	season. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries to lift the temporary ban imposed currently on the importation of black gram and import 2,000 MT of black gram according to the local requirement only through Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation Ltd, the National Food Promotion Board and the Sri Lanka Hadabima Authority, subject to the Special Commodity Levy imposed as per the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Energy Efficiency Testing Laboratory for Air Conditioners in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of Korea has agreed to support the establishment of a laboratory in Sri Lanka to test the energy efficiency of air conditioners under the Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Reduction Project. The establishment of the laboratory and the training of the necessary human resources of the project which is financed through the Korea Energy Agency are planned to be completed in the year 2024. The concurrence 	of the	Department of External Resources, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Attorney General's Department has been received for the Record of Discussion to be 	signed by the Government of South Korea and the Government of Sri Lanka expressing their agreement for the implementation of the proposed project and the Terms of Reference. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to sign the Record of Discussion and the Terms of Reference between the two countries so that the proposed project can be implemented, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: State Vesak Celebration of B.E. 2568
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The State Vesak Celebration of B.E.2568 (2024) is scheduled to be conducted centering the Matale District with the theme of 'Aththanowa Awekkheyya Kathani Akathani Cha (Let's be inquisitive for what we have done, not what others have done)' declaring the period from 2024-05-21 to 2024-05-27 as the Vesak Week. The opening ceremony and the closing ceremony of the State Vesak Celebration are to be held at Dharmaraja Piriwen Premises in Matale and the Sri Sunandarama Vihara premises in Millawana of Pallepola Divisional Secretariat Division respectively. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to implement the series of programmes planned for the State Vesak Celebration and close the animal slaughter houses, meat shops and drug selling places including liquor stores on 22, 23 and 24 May 2024, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Ocean University of Sri Lanka	and the University of Notre Dame, United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ocean University of Sri Lanka and the University of Notre Dame, United States of America to implement a Research Project on Ocean and Atmospheric Science in the Bay of Bengal for a validity period of 05 years from 2024 to 2028. It is aimed to facilitate the skills development of the academics, researchers, undergraduates and postgraduate students at the Ocean University of Sri Lanka and other National Universities and Higher Education Institutes in Sri Lanka through this project. The total cost of the proposed project is USD 62,000 and the University of Notre Dame and the University of Washington, United States of America have agreed to grant USD 60,000 from that amount. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ocean University of Sri Lanka and the University of Notre Dame, United States of America to implement the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting the Ehelepola Walawwa with the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-04-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Secretary to the President had been informed to discuss with all the relevant parties and submit a Report with recommendations to the Cabinet in respect of the vesting of the Ehelepola Walawwa with the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, in terms of a Cabinet decision made at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-02-19. Accordingly, through the Report submitted, a project with related to Ehelepola Walawwa has been set up by the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic to establish a Wax Sculpture Museum in this building reflecting the glory and the environmental background of the Kandyan Kingdom that existed hundreds of years ago, leading the Ehelepola Family and with the aim of presenting the information on that history to the modern society in a more attractive manner and creating local and foreign tourist attraction thereby. Therefore, it has been recommended that it would be appropriate to vest the respective Building with the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to vest the Ehelepola Walawwa and the land belonging to the same with the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic by a Temporality Deed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Economic Transformation Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-03-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2024-03-04 to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the Economic Transformation Bill. The Initial Draft for the Economic Transformation Act has been prepared including the main objectives of the National Policy on Economic Transformation and incorporating necessary provisions enabling the establishment of the key Institutions namely Economic Commission, Investment Zone Sri Lanka, Office for International Trade, Sri Lanka Institute of Economics and International Trade and National Productivity Commission, to support the Government to achieve those objectives.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the Bill and submit expeditiously, incorporating the amendments submitted by the Attorney General, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Digital Economy Strategy for Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-03-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The necessity of National Digital Economy Strategies and implementation plan for the same has been identified in order to achieve the country's vision of becoming a high income economy by 2048 and reach anticipated results. Accordingly, the  “National Digital Economy Strategy for Sri Lanka - 2030” has been prepared with the participation of experts in the field and consultation of the professional bodies and chambers. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology to implement the said strategy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the National Minimum Wage of Workers Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-03-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per the provisions of the National Minimum Wage of Workers Act, No.3 of 2016, the National Minimum Wage has been set as Rs.12,500/-. A triparte subcommittee consisting of trade unions and employees representing Small and Medium Entrepreneurs appointed on the recommendations of the National Labour Advisory Council, has recommended to increase the National Minimum Wage up to Rs.17,500/-. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to amend the National Minimum Wage of Workers Act, No.3 of 2016, enabling to increase the National Minimum Wage by Rs.5000/- from Rs.12,500/- to Rs.17,500/- and National Minimum Daily Wage by Rs.200/- from Rs.500/- to Rs.700/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repeal of the Prevention of Domestic Violence Act, No.34 of 2005
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2024-03-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2023-06-12 to publish the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Prevention of Domestic Violence Act, No.34 of 2005 catering to the current needs in the Government Gazette and submit the same in Parliament for approval.
