Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the Customs Ordinance with regard to the proposed amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for Requests for Proposals for the Mixed Development Project at	Kirimandala Mawatha under the Public Private Partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-11-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - There is a land in extent of 05 acres at Kirimandala Mawatha, Nawala developed by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation and it has been identified that said land is suitable for the implementation of a mixed development project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to take necessary action to invite Requests for Proposals from the interested investors to implement mixed development projects under the Public-Private Partnership in a land area from the said land in extent of 2.67 acres at the first phase and in the remaining land area in extent of 2.33 acres at its second phase, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reconstruction of Pedestrian Bridges across the Marine Drive Road near the Bambalapitiya and Wellawatta Railway Stations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-11-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the risky situation of the pedestrian bridges built across the Marine Drive Road to access the Bambalapitiya and Wellawatta Railway Stations, it has been found the necessity of constructing temporary staircases and immediate reconstruction of pedestrian bridges. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Highways to award the contract for the reconstruction of the said bridges which is an urgent and essential construction, to the State Development and Construction Company, subject to the condition of completing the said contract within a period of six (06) months, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing alternative lands for families who lost houses due to the land acquisition and vesting under the Greater Hambanthota Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-11-06 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Since 97 families have lost their houses due to the Greater Hambanthota Development Project, they should be provided with alternative houses. A State land in extent of 10.11 hectares located at Siribopura, Hambanthota has been identified for that purpose. 126 blocks of land in the said land have been identified for the residential use and at present 84 families out of 97 families who have lost houses have been allocated blocks of land. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal submitted by the Minister of Urban Development and housing, the Cabinet decided to allocate blocks of land from the state land in extent of 10.11 hectares located at Siribopura, Hambanthota to the families who have lost houses due to the Greater Hambanthota Development Project and provide legal Grants for the said blocks of Land under the guidance of the Commissioner General of Lands.

description: The Salary revisions intended to be carry out by the Budget for the year 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet held discussions pertaining to increasing the salaries of public service and the private sector by the Budget for the year 2024. At the ensued discussion, the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, apprised the Cabinet that he intends to present proposals in Parliament pertaining to the revision of salaries of the public service and in the private sector through the forthcoming budget.

description: The revision of the existing General Policy Guidlines in respect of the supply of electricity
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - The Minister in-charge of Electricity has been vested with the power to prepare General Policy Guidelines on supply of electricity subject to the approval of the Cabinet as per the provisions of the Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. Accordingly, as per the existing General Policy Guidelines, the tariff review period has been determined as six (06) months. The joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies and the Minister of Power and Energy to revise the tariff review period as three (03) months taking into consideration the difficulties faced by the general public due to pursuing action accordingly and to revise the existing General Policy Guidelines, enabling to conduct Energy Dispatch Audit of the Ceylon Electricity Board and to improve the predictions of electricity with the assistance of the Department of Meteorology, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tax Policy Reforms to strengthen Revenue-based Fiscal Consolidation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - A number of progressive and broad‑based tax policy proposals have been implemented since June 2022 to achieve revenue-based fiscal consolidation with view to ensuring debt sustainability and as a result of that tax revenue has increased by 51% within the first 9 months in the year 2023 compared to the year 2022. Nevertheless, it has not yet been able to meet the tax collection targets agreed with the International Monetary Fund. Accordingly, the Cabinet granted approval to amend the relevant laws to increase the existing Value Added Tax (VAT) rate up to 18% with effect from 2024‑01‑01 and to implement new tax proposals including the imposition of VAT for certain goods and services to which VAT is not applicable at present, in order to meet tax revenue and primary balance targets as agreed with the International Monetary Fund.

description: Submission of the National Education Policy Framework to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - A Cabinet Sub‑Committee chaired by the Hon. President and a Committee of Experts chaired by the Secretary to the Prime Minister and comprising of 25 members to assist the said Sub-Committee have been appointed to take necessary action to prepare a National Education Policy Framework and submit the same to Parliament and the said Committee of Experts paying attention to the relevant specific areas and subject matters, has drafted the National Education Policy Framework. The "National Education Policy Framework - 2023-2033" has been prepared by further developing the said draft incorporating the observations and recommendations presented by the Cabinet Sub‑Committee to the said Bill. Accordingly, the proposal made by the the Hon. President to refer the said National Education Policy Framework to the Parliamentary Sectoral Oversight Committee on Education and to table the same thereafter, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a Series of Programmes for the full integration of Upcountry Tamils into the Sri Lankan Society
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - The Government has planned to implement a national programme to mark 200 years for the Sri Lankan Plantation Community and several other programmes in the future for the betterment of the said community. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to appoint a Cabinet Sub‑Committee chaired by the Hon. Prime Minister to provide necessary guidance and monitor the effective and efficient implementation of the relevant programmes in collaboration with the Ministry of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development and other relevant Government and Non‑Government Institutions, enabling to develop educational and health facilities, create economic and vocational opportunities and provide a high living standard with permanent residence, towards the betterment of plantation community who are Sri Lankan citizens, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Term Contract for the procurement of 03 shipments of Crude Oil on the basis of payment in 30 days during the period from 2024-01-15 to 2024-06-14
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited to award the term contract for the purchase of 03 shipments of crude oil within the period from 2024‑01‑15 to 2024‑06‑14 on the basis of payment in 30 days and 03 bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the relevant procurement to M/s. Coral Energy DMCC, UAE, based on the recommendation of the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Procurement Committee on the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Term Contract for the procurement of 03 shipments of Crude Oil during the period from 2024-01-15 to 2024-06-14
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited to award a term contract for the purchase of 03 shipments of Crude Oil during the period from 2024.01.15 to 2024.06.14 under the 100% Ex. Storage Modality payment and two bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the relevant procurement to M/s. Vitol Asia Pte. Ltd., Singapore, based on the recommendation of the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee on the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Institute of Economics and International Trade Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to prepare a Bill to establish Sri Lanka	Institute of Economics and International Trade with the objectives of being a platform 	for research and policy formulation related to economics, international finance and	international trade, providing cutting edge research and studies in the said fields, contribution of ideas for invigorating policy and concepts relating to economics, finance and	international trade and the effective promotion of international trade 	and	regional trade integration policies. Accordingly, the proposal made by the	Hon. President to publish the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit it to Parliament for approval, was 	approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon.President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations Act No.14 of 2023 made under the provisions of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 and published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2353/16 dated 2003‑10‑09 to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Placement of Social Security Schemes in Sri Lanka under a Formal Organizational Structure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body:
- According to the Reports of Census and Statistics, it is visible that out of a total of 8.1 million employed workers in Sri Lanka
about 1.2 million are employed in the public sector whereas 3.4 million people in the private sector and 58.4% of the total workforce is employed in the informal sector. However, social security schemes such as the Employees' Provident Fund and the Employees' Trust Fund cover less than 2.5 million workers. In addition, various social security schemes such as Farmer Insurance and Fisheries Insurance are implemented by various Government institutions for the informal sector, and the cost that may incur for the purpose is borne by the Government. Since, the effectiveness and efficiency of these social security systems have been challenged due to the difficulties caused by the implementation of social security schemes by different institutions under different methodologies and the cost burden should be borne by the Government or the Employer and it has been found the appropriateness of operating all social security schemes under single institution. Taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Labor and Foreign Employment, it was decided to grant the approval of the Cabinet to appoint a committee representing all relevant parties to submit recommendations to introduce a mechanism , in order to introduce a system that will enable all the social security schemes currently in operation to be implemented under single institution also studying the international experiences in this regard.

description: National Arts Festival - Sri Lanka Abhiman
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to hold the 'National Arts Festival - Sri Lanka Abhiman' on 30th, 31st December 2023 and 01st January 2024 by bringing various cultural elements together for the enhancement of enjoyment and entertainment of the general public. Accordingly, it has been designed to hold the proposed Arts Festival centering around Ananda Coomaraswamy Mawatha, Colombo 07 and the adjacent premises of Nelum Pokuna Theatre, National Art Gallery, John De Silva Memorial Theatre, Vihara Mahadevi Park, New town Hall and the National Museum. The proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to hold the 'National Arts Festival - Sri Lanka Abhiman' as a joint program of the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs and its affiliated institutions and other public and private institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Joint Statement on the establishment of the International Mediation Organization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - The Government of China has submitted a proposal for the establishment of a treaty-based International Mediation Organization to resolve disputes between States and commercial entities. Accordingly, the Government of China has negotiated with interested countries and Sri Lanka also has participated in some of those preliminary discussions. The preliminary Joint Statement for the establishment of the proposed organization had been issued in July 2022, and the said Joint Statement has been endorsed by about 10 countries, including China. Views have been obtained from other Government institutions including the Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms and the Attorney General's Department regarding the endorsement of the said Joint Statement by Sri Lanka, and it has been observed that any impact is not caused to the Sri Lanka's international commitments by endorsing the said Statement. Accordingly, it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet for the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to endorse the Joint Statement regarding the establishment of the International Mediation Organization.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Room to Read Organization and the Ministry of Education to increase the Literacy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - According to the Constitution, the Government of Sri Lanka is obliged to 'assure all persons' right to universal and equal access to education at all levels to eradicate the illiteracy'. Since providing all the facilities by the Government for the said task is practically difficult, the support of the other parties is also obtained for that. Accordingly, since the year 2005, the Ministry of Education has been implementing the Reading Development Programme and Girls' Education Programme together with the Room to Read organization. As of now, it has been planned to further expand the said programme and implement within a period of five (05) years to be effective from 2023‑12‑01, and for that purpose, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to enter into a new Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Education and the Room to Read organization, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Agreements by the Open University of Sri Lanka on highe education cooperation and on the establishment of the Chinese Language Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - It has been agreed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Shanghai Open University of China and the Open University of Sri Lanka for higher education cooperation aiming to promote international cooperation, scholarly collaboration and cultural interaction and friendship and to sign a tripartite agreement among the Open University of Sri Lanka, Shanghai Open University and the Bank of China Ltd., pertaining to the establishment of a Chinese Language Centre under the fields of collaboration under the said MoU. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to enter into relevant agreements to be valid for a period of five (05) years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting a new Employment Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-30
decision_details_body: - The Concept Paper prepared by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment having discussed with the Trade unions, Employers and relevant stakeholders in order to draft a new Employment Act so as to suit to the current requirements, was taken up for discussion at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2023‑08‑07. At the said Cabinet Meeting, it was decided to refer the said Concept Paper to the Trilateral Committee which is functioning under the Prime Minister's Office representing Employers, Employees and the Government, to further discuss in that regard with all relevant stakeholders and submit recommendations. Accordingly, the said Committee chaired by the Hon. Prime Minister submitted a Report with recommendations regarding the matters that need the attention of the Cabinet having studied the Concept Paper, to the attention of the Cabinet and thereafter, it was decided to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill based on the said recommendations and the Concept Paper submitted by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment pertaining to this matter.

description: Construction of a floating solar photovoltaic (PV) power plant in the water	surface of Samanala Wewa Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - Generation of solar power energy on the surface of reservoirs through the construction of floating solar power plants deemed as a better alternative for land limited countries. Accordingly, it has been identified that there is a good potential on the surface of the reservoirs that are under the purview of Ceylon Electricity Board and the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka, to implement solar energy generation projects and have confirmed that there is a possibility of utilizing approximately 100 Hectares of the water surface of Samanala Wewa Reservoir under Ceylon Electricity Board for the construction of a floating solar photovoltaic (PV) power plant of 150-200 MW.  Accordingly,  the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to call requests for proposals from the interested proponents to construct and implement the proposed solar power plant adhering to National Procurement Guidelines applicable for the implementation of infrastructure projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Grant assistance provided by the Government of Japan for the development of the	Fisheries Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has agreed to provide a grant of Japanese Yen 200 million (approximately LKR 435 Million) under the Economic and Social Development Programme of the Government of Japan, with the objective of developing cold chain facilities and empowering the fisheries sector with modern electrical equipment to ensure a high value addition to the marine products to upgrade the living standard of the fishermen in the Northern and Eastern Provinces of Sri Lanka. It is expected to secure ice making machines for the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources, digital platform scales for Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation, fishing nets for the National Aquaculture Development Authority, prefabricated refrigerators/freezers and refrigerator Cargo trucks for the Ceylon Fisheries Corporation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to obtain the said grant assistance and to enter into the respective agreements thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, No.19 of 1954 to meet the current needs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted its approval at the meeting held on 2022‑08‑08 to amend  the Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, No.19 of 1954 in a manner that enables the women employed at night in offices engaged in information technology based businesses, knowledge process outsoucing businesses, business process outsourcing institutions and offices which handle accounting,	administrative and technical work for the business organizations located in the other	countries.  The Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) (Amendment) Bill prepared  accordingly by the Legal Draftsman has received the clearance of the Attorney General. The proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit it to Parliament for approval,was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Powers of Attorney Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - Steps had been taken to amend the Powers of Attorney Ordinance by the Act, No.28 of 2022, with the objective of preventing fraudulent activities committed by the Power of Attorney holders relating to lands. Subsequent to the enforcement of the said amendments, several legal complications have arisen especially on the foreign Powers of Attorney, cancellation and revocation of Powers of Attorney and the time period given to register a Power of Attorney prepared before the enforcement of the respective amendments.  Therefore, the approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023‑05‑08 to prepare a Bill to further amend the Powers of Attorney Ordinance. The Powers of Attorney (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman as per the said approval,  has received the clearance of the Attorney General. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Sri Lanka Transport Board Act No.27 of 2005
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - The necessity of amending the certain provisions in the Sri Lanka Transport Board Act No.27 of 2005 has been identified taking into consideration the need of making adequate legal provisions to take legal action against offenses committed by passengers and other parties depriving of revenue to be received by the Sri Lanka Transport Board and new reforms and trends which have taken place in the passenger transport service after introducing the Sri Lanka Transport Board Act, No.27 of 2005.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the Sri Lanka Transport Board Act, No.27 of 2005, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Motor Traffic Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑06‑05 has granted approval to implement the recommendations of the Report submitted by the Officials' Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to examine the matters relating to the implementation of the e-Motoring Project and submit recommendations to the Cabinet. It has been identified the necessity of amending the the Motor Traffic Act as appropriate to provide for necessary interim provisions for the implementation of the said Project and for matters incidental. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport and Highways to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Independent Parliamentary Standards Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - Ensuring accountability, credibility, clarity and professionalism of Members of Parliament are essential factors in enhancing the public trust in the efficacy, transparency and equity of the legislature. Therefore, Members of Parliament should, at all times, exercise their powers, privileges, functions and duties with probity and integrity. Taking into consideration that there is a mechanism for the implementation of a Code of Conduct for the Members of Parliament in most countries in the world and and for monitoring such activities, It has been identified the necessity of establishing an independent institution for preparing a Code of Conduct for the Members of Parliament in this country as well and for monitoring the same. Accordingly, the proposal jointly submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister and the Minster of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to obtain the views of the Speaker of Parliament and all Party Leaders on the initial draft prepared for the above purpose and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to formulate a Bill taking also into account the said views, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding between the International Centre for Migration Policy Development and the Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish a Migrant Resource Centre in the Eastern Province for providing adequate, timely, reliable information and guidance to migrants, returned migrants and prospective migrants to enable them to make informed decisions to reduce the risks and challenges they face when traveling, working and living abroad, and the Government of New Zealand has expressed its willingness to grant required assistance for the purpose. Accordingly, the Government of New Zealand has agreed to provide a grant of 350,000 New Zealand dollars for the implementation of the proposed project by the International Center for Migration Policy Development through the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment of New Zealand. The proposal made by the Minister of Labor and Foreign Employment to sign a memorandum of understanding between the International Center for Migration Policy Development in New Zealand and the Ministry of Labor and Foreign Employment of Sri Lanka in order to establish the proposed Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the National 	Archives of 	Sri Lanka and the National Archives of the Netherlands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - Archives of about 310 liner meters consisting of approximately 7,500 volumes created by the Dutch East India Company, which have been included in the Memory of the World Register by UNESCO recognizing the importance of the same for the study of both Asian history and world history are in the custody of the National Archives of Sri Lanka. Under 04 joint Agreements entered into between  the  National Archives of Sri Lanka and the National Archives of the Netherlands during the period from 2001 to 2013, 1,701 copies of negative microfilms of 5066 volumes have been sent to the Netherlands and microfilms made using them have been preserved by the National Archives of Sri Lanka at present. It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding Concerning Archives Cooperation for a period of five years from 2024 to 2028 to continue this cooperation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to sign the relevant Memorandum of Understanding between the National Archives of the Netherlands and the National Archives of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Education and the Peace Corps of the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - The Peace Corps programmes supported by the United States Congress have been implemented in Sri Lanka during the periods from 1962 - 1964, 1983 - 1998 and 2004 - 2006. According to a memorandum of understanding signed between the Ministry of Education and the Peace Corps in 2018, a consensus has been reached between the two parties to implement a programme to improve English language education in Sri Lanka by providing volunteers for a period of five (05) years. However, due to the Easter Sunday attack and the Covid‑19 pandemic situation, Peace Corps has not been able to implement the programme as scheduled. Since the Peace Corps has now agreed to re-implement the said programme in Sri Lanka, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to extend the MoU signed between the two parties for a further period of 05 years with effect from August 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Enhancing Small and Medium-sized Enterprises Finance Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body: - With the financial assistance of the Asian Development Bank amounting to US$ 165 million, the Government has implemented the 'Small and Medium sized Enterprises Line of Credit Project' to provide investment and working capital loans to small and medium sized entrepreneurs, at concessionary interest rates. Also, the necessary steps have been taken to establish the National Credit Guarantee Institution as a solution to the issues faced by small and medium sized entrepreneurs, owing to the banks giving priority to collateral‑based lending rather than cash flow‑based lending. The Government has planned to implement a new project called 'Enhancing Small and Medium‑sized Enterprises Finance Project' for entrepreneurs who have found it more difficult to secure funds for their businesses, and for the purpose, the Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide funds of US$ 100 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to obtain the said loan and to enter into related agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of short term strategies for the promotion of Tourism Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-23
decision_details_body:
- Many Asian tourist destinations have entered into a tough competition to regain the tourism market share diminished in the wake of Covid‑19 pandemic and many countries are taking measures to grant visas to tourists free of charge.  Therefore, several new tourism promotion programmes have been planned to implement for the revival of the tourism industry of Sri Lanka, which experienced a setback owing to the Easter Sunday attack, the Covid‑19 pandemic and the subsequent severe economic downturn. Accordingly, with the objective of increasing the number of tourists visiting Sri Lanka to 05 million during the next 03 years, the Cabinet approved the following proposals jointly submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister, Minister of Tourism and Lands, Minister of Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Public Security.

i. 	immediate implementation of a  programme to issue free visa for the tourists from China, India, Russia, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia and Japan for the period up to 2024‑03‑31, as a pilot project.  

ii. 	Providing the opportunity for tourists to purchase a one-time ticket package at the airport or through online platforms for all locations where fees are levied, enabling them to access the world heritage sites seamlessly and unobstructedly.

iii. 	Providing the opportunity to purchase tickets for tourist compartments of the Sri Lanka Railways via online platforms or at the airport itself as a unified ticket.

description: Extension of Sri Lanka - Australia Trade and Investment Framework	Arrangement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - Australia is an important Foreign Direct Investment partner of Sri Lanka and the 5th source of tourist arrival destinations. The Trade and Invetment Framework Arrangement has been signed between Sri Lanka and Australia on 2017-11-02 with the perspective of enhancing bilateral trade and investment relations between the two countries. The proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security to extend the said Agreement for the next five (05) years from 2023-10-10 enabling the continuous maintenance of trade and investment cooperation as mentioned in the said agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Investment Promotion and the National Development and Reform Commission of the People's Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - The National Development and Reform Commission of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Investment Promotion of Sri Lanka has expressed their concurrence to enter into an Memorandum of Understanding in order to promote production capacity and investment cooperation between the two parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Hydrographic Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023-05-08 has granted approval to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to impose required provisions to develop a Maritime Hydrographic Unit with the objective of improving Sri Lanka as the Marine Center of South Asia region. The Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman accordingly has received the clearance of the Attorney General. The Joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bill titled as 'Secured Transactions'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2018-06-19 has granted approval to repeal the Secured Transactions Act, No. 49 of 2009 and introduce a fresh Act imposing provisions to establish the Secured Transaction Registration Authority and amend the  Acts concurrently as follows. 

    • Prescription (Amendment) Bill
    • Trust Receipts (Amendment) Bill
    • Mortgage (Amendment) Bill
    • Finance Leasing (Amendment) Bill
    • Inland Trust Receipts (Amendment) Bill
    • Companies (Amendment) Bill
    • Registration of Documents (Amendment) Bill

Accordingly, the Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies has been instructed at the Cabinet meeting held on 2021-05-03 to examine further on Bills prepared by the Legal Draftsman along with the relevant authorities. The relevant Bills have been updated by the Legal Draftsman and have received the clearance of the Attorney General. The proposal made by the Hon.President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to publish the said Bills in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit them to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enactment of the Microfinance and Credit Regulatory Authority Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2021‑03‑23 to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill to repeal the Microfinance Act, No.6 of 2016 and enact the Microfinance and Credit Regulatory Authority. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of the National Land Commission Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Appendix II of the List 1 of the Ninth Schedule to the Thirteenth Amendment to the Constitution, provisions have been made that a Land Commission should be established. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Lands to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill, based on the preliminary draft prepared for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: En-route Navigation Facility Charges Regulations No.01 of 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - En-route Navigation Facility Charges Regulations have been promulgated in 1981, 	enabling to impose an En-route Navigation Facility Charge for the aircraft navigating through the Colombo Flight Information Region. Those regulations have not been 	amended during last period of years. Therefore, taking into account the Convention on International Civil Aviation Policies and the current global trends, En-route Navigation Facility Charges Regulations have been amended 	and said new regulations have been published as En-route Navigation Facility Charges Regulations No.01 of 2023 through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2319/64 and dated 2023‑02‑16. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to table the Regulations so published, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting outer boundary survey and preparation of boundary maps of the estates managed under the Regional Plantation Companies, Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation and Janatha Estates Development Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - The project for conducting outer boundary survey and preparation of boundary maps of the estates managed under the Regional Plantation Companies, Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation and the Janatha Estates Development Board has been commenced in 2018 and surveying has been done covering a considerable extent of the relevant lands. The proposal made by the Minister of Industries to extend the said project until 2027, enabling to cover the remaining extent of lands that remains to be surveyed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of compensation for the damaged crops in the Yala Season 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - Approximately 58,770 acres of paddy and other crops have been damaged in the Yala Season 2023 due to the inability to supply of adequate water upon the adverse weather condition which prevailed recently thereby affecting about 53,965 farmers. Accordingly, the Cabinet, taking into consideration a proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture pertaining to the payment of compensations to the farmers so affected, decided to allocate necessary provisions for the payment of compensations, under the Crop Insurance Scheme which is currently in operation, despite the severe financial condition encountered by the country.

description: Providing Housing Units under the Urban Regeneration Project to the 	families occupying in the settlement with less facilities in the land called 	Hathbodhiyawatta, Narahenpita and developing the said land
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - There is a low-income settlement on a land block of Government-owned land called Hathbodhiyawatta located in the Kirula Grama Niladhari Division, Narahenpita in extent of 01 Acres 03 Roods and 10 Perches and those housing units are often subject to disasters during the rainy seasons. It has been proposed to provide the families occupying in the said settlement, with the alternative housing units from the housing schemes constructed by the Urban Development Authority under the Urban Regeneration Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to provide housing units from the housing schemes constructed in the Colombo city under the Urban Regeneration Project, to the occupants of the said land and thereafter to transfer the said land to the Urban Development Authority under section 6(1) of the State Land Ordinance to implement a mixed development project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sale of Housing Units of Lake Crest Residencies Housing Project at Angoda, 	Mandawila on freehold basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - The possession of housing units of the Lake Crest Residencies Housing Project at Angoda, Mandawila comprising of 500 units implemented by the Urban Development Authority, has been handed over to the housing recipients in the year 2018. The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to grant freehold deeds to the housing recipients who have completed the relevant payments, according to the Condominium Property Law and to the other housing recipients after completing the relevant payments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recognition of Medical Degree Courses of Internationally Recognized 	Universities in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-09
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑05‑02 has granted approval to appoint a Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Prime Minster to submit appropriate recommendations to formulate a National Policy with standards and criteria to be based for the recognition of Medical Degree courses of internationally recognized Universities, in Sri Lanka and to amend the provisions of the Medical Ordinance to suit the present day needs. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Health to take necessary action to impose required legal provisions enabling to recognize the Medical Degrees awarded by foreign universities ranked 01 to 1000 as per the international ranking systems, based on the Report containing the recommendations of the Committee so appointed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description:
Appointment of an Advisory Committee to the Department of Community 
	Based Corrections
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - It has been recommended at the Committee on Public Accounts held on 2023‑06‑09	to appoint an Advisory Committee, since a continuous supervision and a follow up is necessary to discharge the duties carried out by the Department of Community Based Corrections coming under the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms. Accordingly, The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to appoint the proposed Advisory Committee under the chairmanship of the Secretary, Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms and consisting of other relevant Heads of Institutions and experts in the relevant field, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Pavithra Wanniarachchi Sahurda Foundation (Incorporation) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - Pavithra Wanniarachchi Sahurda Foundation (Incorporation) Bill has been presented  to Parliament as a Private Member's Bill by Hon. Lalith Ellawala, Member of Parliament. The Preliminary draft in concern has been duly prepared by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. The proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to submit a Report to Parliament recommending the relevant Bill in terms of the provisions of the Standing Order 52(6) of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recognition and Enforcement of International Settlement Agreements resulting from Mediation Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022-10-25 to draft a Bill to prepare laws to give effect to the United Nations Convention on International Settlement Agreements resulting from Mediation (Singapore Convention on Mediation), domestically. The Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman accordingly has received the clearance of the Attorney General. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Mediation Board Act, No.72 of 1988
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-02-27 to amend the Mediation Board Act No.72 of 1988 by amending the provisions pertaining to the appointment of the members of the Mediation Board Commission, jurisdiction of Mediation Boards and by introducing some other relevant amendments.  Accordingly, the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman has received the clearance of the Attorney General. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Shaili Educational Foundation (Incorporation) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - Shaili Educational Foundation (Incorporation) Bill has been presented to Parliament as a Private Member's Bill by Hon. Dr. (Mrs.) Harini Amarasuriya, Member of the Parliament. The Preliminary draft in concern has been properly prepared by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. The proposal made by the Minister of Education to submit a Report to  Parliament recommending the relevant Bill in terms of the provisions of the Standing Order 52(6) of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of 70MW, Alternative Current (AC) ground mounted solar Photovoltanic (PV) power plants with 1-5 MW capacity on build, own and operate basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - Proposals have been called from prospective investors interested in establishing 70MW, Alternative Current (AC) ground mounted solar Photovoltanic (PV) power plants with 1-5 MW capacity on build, own and operate basis  with 20 year operational period so as to connect 11 grid substations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to grant approval to the relevant investors to implement projects for 08 grid substations of Ampara, Anuradhapura, Galle, Habarana, Kurunegala Madampe, Maho and Matara, based on the recommendations submitted by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee after evaluation of their proposals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 1996 housing units for low income families under the Chinese Aid Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - The Government of China has concurred to grant financial aid of Yuan 552 million to the Government of Sri Lanka to construct 1996 housing units as an assistance to the Urban Regeneration Project which is being implemented as per the decision made to relocate residents from settlements with limited facilities in the Western Province and settle them in the housing Units of Urban Housing Schemes with improved amenities. The Government of Sri Lanka, under the entire project, will carry out the land development activities and provide necessary infrastructure up to the boundary of the work sites.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minster of Urban Development and Housing  to sign the implementation Agreement of the relevant project with the Government of China, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a New Commercial High Court
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - Necessary action needs to be taken to maintain more conducive investment atmosphere in the country in achieving the development targets.  Considering the situation, the necessity of establishing a new Commercial High Court has been identified in order to ensure the expeditious resolution of the current high volume of cases pending with regard to commercial matters. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to establish the relevant Commercial High Court at No. 80, Adhikarana Mawatha, Colombo 12, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing inland fish production through stocking of fish seeds in reservoirs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - The inland fisheries and aquaculture sector plays a significant role in the rural economy of Sri Lanka and highly contributes to the increase of food security and nutrition and for providing employment opportunities. In order to carry out  economically effective inland fish production with high growth in the reservoirs of the country, approximately 500 million fish fingerlings should be continuously stocked annually. However, it has not yet been able to fully utilize the potential of the existing reservoirs for culture-based fisheries due to the insufficient fish seed stocking. Although, 230 million fish fingerlings and 80 million freshwater prawn post larvae were initially planned to be stocked in the reservoirs in the year 2023, the said plan had to be changed due to the drying up of the reservoirs owing to the dry weather condition which prevailed in the recent past. Accordingly,  taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries  to secure budgetary provisions required for the implementation of the programme for producing 100 million fish fingerlings and 50 million freshwater prawn post larvae and stocking into the reservoirs during the remaining period of this year, by revising the said plan, the Cabinet approved the provision of additional allocations of Rs. 100 million for the said tasks for the year 2023.

description: Providing facilities at the Oluwil Fishery Harbour to carry out fish 	processing activities by Tess (Pvt) Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has previously been granted to provide facilities at the Oluwil Fishery Harbour to carry out fish processing activities by Tess (Pvt) Ltd. re-activating the fish processing plant which has been idle on the premises of the Oluvil Fishery Harbour. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries to provide the fish processing plant located at the Oluwil Fishery Harbour to Tess (Pvt) Ltd., on lease basis for a period of 10 years, subject to levying the relevant lease rental recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee monthly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Streamlining the inquiries conducted into consumer complaints received 	by the Consumer Affairs Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - Under the provisions of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No.9 of 2003, legal provisions have been provided for the Consumer Affairs Authority to intervene in consumer complaints. Also, the Department of Measurement, Standards and Services established by the Measurement Units, Standards and Services Act, No.35 of 1995 conducts market raids together with the Consumer Affairs Authority with a view to protecting the consumer rights.  Accordingly, the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security having informed the Cabinet on the programme planned to implement to educate consumers and manufacturers regarding the protection of consumer rights and fair trade practices as one of the important steps to reduce the time and effort spent on investigating consumer complaints and giving decisions thereto, to decentralize the investigation procedure and make provisions to conduct them district level in order to make the process of investigating complaints more efficient, and to establish a National Operations Centre aiming to conduct the special raids through an integrated programme, decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet for the same.

description: Granting State owned lands for a Solar Power Project of 100 MW, on lease 	basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal to take over a land in extent of 219.72 hectares located in the Siyambalanduwa Divisional Secretariat Division of the Monaragala District to the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority for a 100 MW solar power project was taken up for discussion at the  Cabinet meeting held on 2023‑08‑07, and a decision was taken to discuss with the Ministry of  Tourism and Lands in that regard and submit information related thereto, to the Cabinet. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to lease out the relevant extent of land to the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority for a period of 25 years, along with the provisions enabling to sub‑lease the said land to the selected renewable energy developer, as per the recommendation of the Ministry of Tourism and Lands.

description: Establishment of a University on Education by upgrading the National 	Colleges of Education to the status of Campuses of Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Cabinet decision dated 2019‑12‑04, a Committee of Experts has been appointed under the chairmanship of Senior Professor Gunapala Nanayakkara for the purpose of submitting recommendations on administrative and legal procedures to be followed in upgrading the existing National Colleges of Education to the status of the campuses of the universities, with the aim of establishing all graduate teacher cadre in Lanka.  As per the recommendations of the said Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to instruct the Legal Draftsman to take necessary action to draft a new Bill for imposing legal provisions to upgrade 19 out of the 20 existing National Colleges of Education to the status of campuses and to establish a new university called Sri Lanka University of Education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulation of Chemical Substances affecting National Security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-10-02
decision_details_body: - A large number of different chemical substances are used in Sri Lanka for peaceful uses such as industrial, agricultural, medical and research purposes. It has been observed that, out of which some chemical substances such as Nitric Acid, Chlorine, Hydrogen Peroxide, Potassium Cyanide, Sodium Cyanide, Nitromethane and Sodium Azide have a dual-use nature that can be used for peaceful as well as illicit purposes. It has been recognized that there is a risk of using those chemicals which are used in various industries such as dairy, beverages, oil related industries, water purification for harmful activities that threaten the national security. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to enact legal provisions to regulate such chemical substances to prevent their misuse, and to vest that regulatory role with the National Authority for Implementation of the Chemical Weapons Convention, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Appropriation Bill for the year 2024 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-25
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2023‑07‑31 to prepare the Appropriation Bill for the financial year 2024. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Appropriation Bill for the financial year 2024 prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Public Debt Management Institution (PDMA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-25
decision_details_body: - The Importance of establishing an independent Public Debt Management Institution as an institutional reform has been emphasized through the Interim Budget of the year 2022 and improving debt management and transparency have also been identified as priority areas under the Extended Fund Facility of the International Monetary Fund. The International Monetary Fund and the World Bank have provided technical assistance for the establishment of the proposed Public Debt Management Institution. After consultation with relevant stakeholders, the debt management reform plan, debt management institutional framework and legal framework have now been designed. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the  Public Debt Management Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining policy based special lending facility from the Asian Development Bank for the Financial Sector Stability and Reform Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-25
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has conducted initial discussions with the Asian Development Bank to obtain 02 policy based lending facilities amounting to US$ 200 million each for implementing two sub-programmes under the  Financial Sector Stability and Reform Programme. Under the said first Sub-programme, it has been proposed to implement immediate reforms to enhance the crisis management regulatory framework and stabilize the financial sector, and under the second Sub-programme, it has been proposed to build a resilient and inclusive financial system. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to enter into a loan agreement with the Asian Development Bank to obtain US$ 200 million for the first Sub-programme at an interest rate of 2% per annum, with a repayment period of 25 years including a grace period of 05 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-25
decision_details_body: - With the objective of ensuring that the well-being of disabled children in the society is  prioritized and they receive comprehensive care, it has been proposed that it is appropriate to make amendments to the Inland Revenue Act so that any charitable organization established as a legal entity or registered under any law enforced for the registration of social service organizations that provides health facilities to children in collaboration with Government health care/education system can claim tax relief. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the Inland Revenue Act by incorporating the necessary legal provisions for that purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 28th Session of the Conference of Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change in Dubai, UAE
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-25
decision_details_body: - The 28th Session of the Conference of Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP 28) is scheduled to be held in Dubai, United Arab Emirates from 2023.11.30 to 2023.12.12. In that Conference, Sri Lanka, together with most vulnerable countries due to climate change, expects to present a proposal to create platform named as "Climate Justice Forum" that will lead developing countries to have a common voice regarding their concerns and unlock the pledges and commitments of developed countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to maintain a Country Pavilion during the conference for the active participation of the delegations participating in the 28th Conference of Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention and showcase the national level initiatives related to climate change in the pavilion, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 04 shipments of Gas oil within the next four (04) months period
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-25
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under term contract basis for procurement of 04 shipments of gas oil for Ceylon Petroleum Corporation within the next four (04) months period from 2023-11-01 to 2024-02-29. It has been received 05 bids for that.  The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the relevant procurement to M/s Petrochina International (Singapore) Pte.Ltd based on the	recommendation of the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Accessories for Buoy Mooring used for offloading petroleum in the sea near Muthurajawela
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-25
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited according to the International Competitive Bidding Procedure to procure 26 marine hoses and relevant accessories required for Buoy Mooring which is used to offload shiploads of petroleum in the sea near Muthurajawela and only one bid has been received. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the relevant procurement to M/s. Industrial Products Asia Pacific (Pte) Ltd. as recommended by the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee that evaluated the said bid, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute and the Levan Mikeladze Diplomatic Training and Research Institute of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Georgia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-25
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute coming under the purview of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Levan Mikeladze Diplomatic Training and Research Institute of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Georgia to establish cooperation pertaining to sharing of expertise, exchange of academic staff, exchange of students, joint research programmes as well as sharing of teaching methodologies and other relevant areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign the said proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties in parallel with the 25th anniversary celebrations of the establishment of diplomatic relations between two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking steps to prevent and control forest fires
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-25
decision_details_body: - Given the man-made fires in the forests, there is a tendency to increase the risk of forest fires rapidly especially during dry whether conditions.  This situation commonly can be seen in the districts of Badulla, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Matale, Monaragala, Polonnaruwa, Kurunegala, Puttalam and Rathnapura.  About 150 forest fires have been reported so far this year and in consequence of that, approximately 2,600 hectares of forests have been destroyed. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation to implement a programme to prevent and extinguish the forest fires with the assistance of the Government mechanism and other relevant parties from national level to village level, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Permission to import Electric Rechargeable Vehicles on duty free basis to attract  investments
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to grant permission to import one electric rechargeable vehicle, brand new with CIF value not exceeding US$ 30,000 on duty free basis for projects fulfilling the following  qualifying criteria in order to attract investments under the "Investor Retention and Expansion Programme for Re-investments of Existing BOI Companies" and 100 "BOI IT/ITES Companies Programme", was approved by the Cabinet.

	1.	Investor Retention and Expansion Programme for Re-investments of 	Existing BOI Companies

    • The relevant Company should be in operation for not less than 05 years having registered under section 17 of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka Act.
  
    • Minimum proposed investment for expansion of the business should be US$ 3 Mn.
  
    • Generation of minimum 50 employment opportunities under the expansion programme of the project.
  
	2.	100 BOI IT/ ITES Companies Programme 

    • An enterprise should generate 50 new local employment opportunities and out of which 15 employees should be technically qualified. 

    • Minimum Investment should be US$ 250,000.

description: Incentivizing assembly of Electric Vehicles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - Many Asian countries have adopted a more favorable approach by imposing a tariff rate of zero per cent (0%) on the assembly and production of Electric Vehicles (EV) and Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEV). Through this attractive incentive, it will be able to attract investors and manufacturers as well as focus on future export potential while also complying with global imperative of environmental protection. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to impose flat zero per cent (0%) tariff on the CIF (Cost, Insurance and Freight) when importing brand new Semi-Knocked-Down (SKD) kits for the assembly of Electric Vehicles with a power rating of up to 500kW, Electric Two‑Wheelers and Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicles with engine capacities of up to 3000cc, by the companies which have already entered into Agreements and new companies entering into Agreements with the Board of Investment of Sri lanka that make a minimum investment of US$ 50 million in the Electric Vehicles and Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicles assembly industry, with a view to promoting  the Electric Vehicle manufacturing locally, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Committee Stage amendments of the Bill of Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of	2002
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to submit the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in Parliament, to amend the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002 as well as the abolition of Simplified Value Added Tax (SVAT) System  from 2024-01-01.  Representations have been made by the relevant parties that if the Simplified Value Added Tax (SVAT) System  is removed without having a robust value added refund system, it will create serious cash flow issues for the present registered persons under the  SVAT system, especially the exporters. Therefore, it seems appropriate to phase out the Simplified Value Added Tax System, until a robust tax refund mechanism is established. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit a proposal to revise the effective date of the relevant provisions relating to removal of the Simplified Value Added Tax System at the Committee Stage of the Value Added Tax (Amendment) Bill in Parliament, as 2025-04-01, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bill on the Establishment of National Women's Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022-09-05 to establish an independent commission named as National Women's Commission through an Act of Parliament, enabling to make necessary recommendations to Parliament through the Minister-in-charge to provide leadership for women's rights and gender equality and intervene for the issues related to gender equity and equality. Accordingly, the said Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman was submitted by the Hon. President in  his capacity as the Minister of Women, Children Affairs and Social Empowerment to the Cabinet and it was decided to grant concurrence of the Cabinet in principle for the same.

description: Bill on Gender Equality
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - It is evident  that Sri Lanka is lagging behind with regard to Gender equality in Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment is taking measures to minimize the gender imbalances. Accordingly, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022-09-05 to prepare a Bill to introduce the necessary legal provisions with the objective of Gender equality and women empowerment. Accordingly, the said Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman was submitted to the Cabinet by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Women, Children Affairs and Social Empowerment and it was decided to grant concurrence of the Cabinet in principle, for the same.

description: Accession to the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting on 2021-12-20 to take necessary action to sign the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign he Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons by Sri Lanka at the Conference held with related to the said Treaty in parallel to the UN General Assembly scheduled to be conducted in New York in September 2023,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the State of Kuwait on the Establishment of a Bilateral Consultation Mechanism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - In the discussions held between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the State of Kuwait, an agreement has been reached regarding the establishment of a bilateral consultation mechanism  between the two countries. Accordingly, aiming to promote friendly relations and cooperation in the political, economic and other fields between the two countries, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on the establishment of a bilateral consultation mechanism in parallel with the 78th Session of the United Nations General Assembly to be held in New York in September 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of an Order published in terms of the provisions of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No.40 of 1979, for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - According to the existing duty structure, the duty levied on the importation of certain raw materials used by local printing ink manufacturers for ink manufacturing is higher  than the printing ink imported as finished products thereby causing a disadvantageous situation to local printing ink manufacturers. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to present the Order published in the Government Gazette dated 2023‑07‑21 in terms of the provisions of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No.40 of 1979 in order to rectify the same, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Term contract for the procurement of 04 shipments of Gasoline of 92 Unl within the next four months period
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited for a term contract from the registered suppliers of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to purchase 04 shipments of Gasoline 92 Unl for a period of 04 months from 2023‑09‑21 to 2024‑01‑21. For the purpose, 04 companies have submitted bids. The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the said procurement to M/s. Vitol Asia Pte. Ltd, as per the recommendation of the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Investment Proposal for a Solar Power/Battery Storage Project at Poonakary Tank in Kilinochchi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has been granted to call for Expressions of Interest from prospective investors to develop renewable energy projects with a capacity of 50 MW or more in order to support the implementation of expeditious renewable energy development programmes in the country. Accordingly, United Solar Energy SL (Pvt.) Ltd. has submitted a proposal to develop a solar power plant of 700 MW with a battery energy storage system, at Poonkari Tank, Kilinochchi enabling to provide a power supply of 134 MW. It has been proposed to implement the proposed project with a total investment of US$ 1,727 million and as a 100% foreign direct investment, out of which US$ 500 million will be allocated to be utilized for local project components. As a part of the proposed project, the project proponent company has proposed to construct 03 barrages around the Poonkari tank at a cost of US $13.5 million to prevent the sea water intrusion and to rehabilitate the tank. Instead, the Northern Provincial Council, the Northern Provincial Irrigation Department and the Department of Agrarian Development have already agreed to provide 1,080 acres of the shallow area of the tank to the said company on a 35-year lease agreement for the installation of the 700 MW solar power plant. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to accept the project proposal submitted by United Solar Energy SL (Pvt.) Ltd. in principle and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee to evaluate the said proposal and submit recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting a plot of land which contains a storied housing complex owned by the Urban Development Authority, with the University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - The Board of Management of the Urban Development Authority has granted approval to vest the land in extent of 0.2761 hectares containing a storied housing complex with 144 housing units located at Kalinga Mawatha, Narahenpita, with the University of Colombo. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to vest the said plot of land with storied housing complex with the University of Colombo, as a free grant, to be utilized to provide hostel facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementing  a Pilot Project for Beire Lake Water Quality Improvement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-11
decision_details_body: - As per a proposal submitted by Groepo Pte Ltd (GPL), a Singapore company with Japanese ownership, approval in principle of the Cabinet was granted at the Meeting held on 2023‑07‑17 to pursue action to implement a Pilot Project together with several Government Institutions to improve the water quality of the Beire Lake using micro-nano bubble technology, carbon fiber biofilm technology and eco‑friendly enzymes. Accordingly, Cabinet approved the joint proposal made by Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies and the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to implement the  proposed pilot project for a period of 05 years, subject to providing necessary guidance to implement the said project by an Experts Committee comprising of experts in the field of water quality in all universities of the country and representatives of all relevant research and other agencies, taking into account the further information presented by the project investor, and thereafter, arrive at a decision regarding the further implementation of the project, based on the outcome achieved.

description: Anti-Terrorism Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-09-04
