decision_details_body: - The Inclusive Connectivity and Development Project is being implemented in order to empower the communities in selected districts in Sri Lanka aiming to supply a safe, efficient and climate resilient connectivity and strengthen the agricultural supply chain. Under the said project, it has been planned to develop 3000 km of rural roads island wide, in its initial stage. Taking into account the existing economic situation, it has been recognized that it is appropriate to exempt the payment of taxes relating to the project  so that the foreign currency component under the project can be fully used for the project activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to declare this project as a Specified Project to be eligible for tax exemption through the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Host Country Agreement between the Government of Sri 	Lanka and the Global Green Growth Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-16
decision_details_body: - The Global Green Growth Institute has been established in the year 2012 as an inter-governmental organization by the agreement of the stakeholder parties at the United Nations Rio +20 summit. The objectives of establishing the said Institute are to promote the green growth strategies of the developing countries, formulation of green growth plans with the participation of stakeholders and provide relevant parties with necessary support. The said institute functions under the major themes such as renewable energy, green cities and sustainable landscapes. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to sign the relevant agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allotment of a plot of land from the Hambantota area for the Ceylon 	Electricity Board on lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-16
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approved the joint proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing and the Minister of Power and Energy for the allotment of a land area of 3 acres 1 rood and 10.65 perches in the Keliyapura area of Hambantota which has been vested with the Urban Development Authority under section 6(1) of the State Land Ordinance, to the Ceylon Electricity Board to be used as an electricity pole yard, for a period of 30 years, on lease basis.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between the Centre for 	Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences (CAOS), affiliated to the Indian 	Institute of Science, India and the National Aquatic Resources 	Research 	and Development 	Agency (NARA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-16
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Centre for Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences, affiliated to the Indian Institute of Science, India and the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency for mutually agreed functions such as research exchange programmes, capacity building of Sri Lankan Scientists in predicting ocean-related disasters and providing training opportunities for forecasting fishing zones. Clearance of the Attorney General and the concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs have been received for the draft Memorandum of Understanding prepared for the purpose. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the International Trade Office
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-16
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet was granted at its meeting held on 2022‑10‑03 to establish the International Trade Office. At the beginning it is expected to establish the said office under the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies and subsequently amalgamate with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the Bill for the International Trade Office, based on the preliminary draft that has already been drafted, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Next 25 Years
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body:
- The Hon. President apprised the Cabinet that the following action is expected to be taken with a view to achieving the progress of economic, social, cultural and political sectors in Sri Lanka within the next 25 years.

	(i)	Establishment of the following Institutions:

		*	Institute of History
		*	Institute of Economics and Trade
		*	Institute for Women and Gender
		*	University of Government and Public Policy
		*	University of Agro Technology
		*	Climate Change University
		*	Sports University

	(ii)	Introducing new legislation for the following:
 
		*	National Commission on Women's Act
		*	Gender Equality Act
		*	Women's Empowerment Act
		*	Child Care Act
		*	Climate Change Act
		*	Social Justice Commission  Act
		*	Reforestation and Tree Cover Act
		*	Living Entity Act
		Mahaweli River
		Sinharaja
		Sripada Adaviya /Peak Wilderness
		Horton Plains
		Knuckles
		Adam's Bridge
		*	Law for Ocean Resources Exploration and Management  			(within the Exclusive Economic Zone/ (EEZ)
		*	Muthurajawela (Preservation) Act
		*	Protection of Persons with Special Needs Act

	(iii)	Implementation of the following New Projects 

		*	75 Urban Forests
		*	1996 Houses in Colombo for Low Income Families 
		*	National Youth Platform Projects and Programmes

description: Balapitiya Sri Rahularama Purana Viharastha Samanera Akalpa Sangwardena  Bhikshu  Vidyalaya  (Incorporation)  Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body: - Balapitiya Sri Rahularama Purana Viharastha Samanera Akalpa Sangwardena Bhikshu Vidyalaya (Incorporation) Bill has been submitted by the Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, Member of Parliament, as a Private Member's Bill. The relevant Bill has properly been prepared by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to submit a Report to Parliament recommending the relevant Bill as per the provisions of the Standing Order 52(6) of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the purchase of Intra Ocular Lens, foldable, hydrophobic (1-7 Items)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for this procurement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the relevant contract to M/s Vision Solutions Lanka (Pvt) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of raw food items to the National Hospital, Kandy for the year 2022/2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body: - National Competitive Bids have been invited for the procurement for the supply of raw food items to the National Hospital, Kandy for the year 2022/2023. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the relevant contract to Janatha Food Suppliers Private Limited as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the National Policy on Management of Chemicals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body: - According to the Environment Programme of United Nations, around 350,000 chemicals exist in the market at present. Exposure to the chemicals causes deaths for about 2 million per year according to the World Health Organization. Further, it has been confirmed that people suffer from various diseases due to improper management of the chemicals. Taking into consideration the negative impact caused to the environment and to health due to the use of chemicals, “Environmentally Sound Management of Toxic Chemicals” has been identified in the Agenda 21 of the United Nations as one of the global priorities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to implement the National Policy on Management of Chemicals prepared after negotiating with the relevant main government institutions and Non Government Organizations giving due consideration to the management of chemicals  in order to pursue action adhering to the International Conventions signed by Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Export Oriented Petroleum Refinery and Associated Product Processing Centre in Hambantota area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that there is a high potential for establishing an  export oriented petroleum refinery and associated product processing center in Hambantota area. Various parties and local and foreign investors are interested in utilizing the said investment opportunity. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to issue calling for Expression of Interest to select a suitable investor to establish a Petroleum Processing Centre and obtain detailed proposals from those investors who fulfill the  basic qualifications, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Liberalization of the Sri Lankan Lubricant Market and Selection of New 	Entrants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body: - The Minister in charge of the subject of Petroleum Resources Development has been vested with powers by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961 and its subsequent amended provisions to select new applicants anticipating to enter to the lubricant oil industry and grant licenses in line with that. Accordingly, the Minister in charge of Petroleum Resources Development has fully opened the lubricant oil market of the country. At present, 26 licensed institutions including the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation are engaged in the lubricant oil industry. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to call for Request for Qualifications for the selection of new entrants to the Lubricant Market of Sri Lanka enabling to provide the opportunity for the high quality, innovative and competitive products to be entered to the domestic market providing the opportunity to the consumers to purchase lubricants at competitive prices, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Community-based Tourism Development Project 	focusing on the Central, Northern and Eastern regions of Sri Lanka 	Under a financial grant of the Korea Tourism Organization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority has proposed to implement a "Community‑based Tourism Project" under the financial assistance of the Korea Tourism Organization, focusing the Kuchchaweli Tourism Development Zone owned by the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority. A delegation of the Korea Tourism Organization has conducted a feasibility study on the relevant project proposal and extended its willingness to grant a financial assistance of  2.172 billion Korean Won for the implementation of the proposed entire project. A consensus has also been reached to provide a sum of  of 400 million  Korean won for preparation of the overall plan of the relevant Tourism Development Project, training program and for the implementation of a pilot training program as its first phase. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Lands to enter into an agreement between the Korea Tourism Organization and the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority for the implementation of the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Invitation for the Expression of Interest to commence business activities  by 	using the facilities of the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body: - According to the layout of the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport, there is a potential for converting the said Airport into a multi-purpose business center by implementing business opportunities related to aviation and as well as non-aviation related activities. Therefore, attention has been focused on taking measures to effectively utilize the facilities and assets in the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport by creating public-private partnership investment opportunities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to invite Expressions of Interest from investors and strategic entrepreneurs in direct and indirect aviation related ventures to carry out aeronautical and non-aeronautical businesses at the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal for the revision of Electricity Tariff 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body:
- Cabinet considered the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies; and the Minister of Power and Energy on the revision of electricity tariff. Cabinet further considered that the General Treasury is no longer possible to provide required funds to the Ceylon Electricity Board within the existing fiscal space and as such there is no alternative other than the revision of the existing electricity tariff in order to cover only the cost incurred for the supply of electricity while minimizing the impact caused to the electricity consumers as much as possible in order to ensure an uninterrupted supply of power in the country. After discussion, it was decided to grant approval:

* 	The Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka to further study on the proposed electricity tariff revision submitted by the Sri Lanka Electricity Board in consultation with the relevant parties, and if any revisions are to be made, submit the same on or before 2023‑02‑15.

* 	Until then, the Ceylon Electricity Board and the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka to take necessary action jointly to implement the Electricity Tariff 	amendment proposed by the Ceylon Electricity Board to be effective from 	01‑01‑2023 as an interim measure in accordance with the amendments of the Policy Guidelines currently in force regarding the electricity industry.

* 	If any amendments will be presented by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka, the Ceylon Electricity Board to take necessary action to implement those amendments and make the necessary adjustments by the next monthly electricity bills.

description: 75th Independence Day Commemoration Ceremony
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body: - The 75th Independence Day commemoration ceremony which falls on February 04, 2023 and the programme organized to be held concurrently, including the tasks and responsibilities to be performed by the respective institutions was submitted to the Cabinet by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government. Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence to implement the said programme.

description: National Energy Potentials, Strategies and the Roadmap for the next 	decade
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-09
decision_details_body: - A Cabinet Sub‑Committee has been appointed under the chairmanship of the Hon. Prime Minister at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022‑08‑30 to identify the policies and strategies to be adopted to develop the Energy sector in a sustainable manner and submit appropriate recommendations to the Cabinet and provide necessary guidance for the expeditious implementation of the decisions to be taken by the Cabinet based on the said recommendations and follow up the same. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to implement the Roadmap inclusive of recommendations and  the milestones relating to the Energy sector stated in the Report submitted by the said Sub‑Committee having conducted several discussions with the stakeholder institutions, professionals and academia in the field, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of Eggs as a remedy to the existing egg shortage in the local 	market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body: - Cabinet decided to import eggs with the intervention of the Government, if necessary, as a solution to the inconvenience faced by the customers due to the current shortage of eggs in the local market and the tendency of hiking the prices of eggs.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) 	Act, No.1 of 1969, for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the following Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969, for approval of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet:

	* Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.23 of 2022  published in	the  	Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2309/40 dated 2022‑12‑09.

	* Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.24 of 2022, published in the 	    Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2311/08 dated 2022‑12‑19.

	* Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No.25 of 2022, published in 	   the  Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2311/18 dated 2022‑12‑21.

description: Carrying out the basic activities of disposal of State lands only by the Divisional Secretaries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body: - Currently, the powers to dispose lands under the Mahaweli Development Project have been vested with the Director General of the Authority of Sri Lanka Mahaweli, whereas the powers to dispose lands belonging to the Land Reform Commission have been vested with the said Commission. As the objectives relating to the Accelerated Mahaweli Development Project and the Land Reform Commission have already been accomplished, a suitable arrangement has to be prepared so that all the basic activities relating to the disposal of all State lands, including the disposal of State lands by the said two institutions, could be carried out only by the divisional secretaries. As such, the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence to appoint a committee under the chairmanship of a Senior Additional Secretary to the President in order to study all the existing rules and regulations relating to the disposal of State lands and formulate a policy related to the disposal of State lands including the new legal amendments to be introduced and prepare and submit the necessary guidelines.

description: Amendments to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act, No.51 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body: - Section 5(1) of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act, No.51 of 1979 states  provisions relating to the appointment of members to the Board of Directors of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority. However, required provisions to appoint a representative from the Ministry in charge of Ports to the said Board have not been provided by the same. Since it is more appropriate to have a representation of the Ministry in charge of the subject when making relevant decisions, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to amend section 5(1) of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act , No.51 of 1979 enabling to act accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 4th Cycle of the Universal Periodic Review of the United Nations Human Rights Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body: - According to a Resolution adopted by the General Assembly of the United Nations Human Rights Council in 2006 all the Member States would be subjected to a Universal Periodic Review. It provides the Member States the opportunity to declare the steps taken at the national level to upgrade the human rights situation of their States and fulfill their human rights obligations. Each Member State should conduct its review every 4 years. Sri Lanka has participated in 3 cycles and the next review is scheduled to be take place on 2023‑02‑01. Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the measures taken by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for conducting a self-assessment regarding the steps taken so far since the last Universal Periodic Review through the Sri Lanka's National Report to be submitted under the 4th Cycle of the Universal Periodic Review.

description: Sale of housing units in Borella Oval View Residencies Housing Project on 	freehold basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body: - Borella Oval View Residencies Housing Project, Palangastuduwa, a 24 storeyed housing project which consists of 608 housing units and 5 commercial units built for government servants has been completed and the possession of those houses has been granted to the house recipients in the year 2020. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Hosing to provide  freehold deeds to the house recipients as per the provisions of the Urban Development Authority Act No. 41 of 1978, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a One-Stop Unit under the Urban Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority has identified the necessity of expediting the approval process of the Development projects carried out by the Urban Development Authority within the urban areas. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to establish a Unit enabling to upgrade the development application processing system implementing at present and obtain overall approval in one-stop unit, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing a new methodology for enrolling students from Grade 2 to Grade 11 in Schools (except Grade 6)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Minister of Education to introduce a new methodology 
	providing fair and equal opportunities to all students by further regulating circular provisions being implemented for the admission of children from Grade 2 to Grade 11 in Schools (except Grade 6) thereby identifying  groups that really need to transfer schools in the intermediate grades and to maintain under the same methodology, the current maximum number of students in each class of Grades 1-5 as 40 and the maximum number of students in each class of Grades 6-11 as 45, without change, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Protocol on Inspection, Quarantine and Veterinary Sanitary Requirements for Wild Marine Fishing Aquatic Products to be exported from Sri Lanka to China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body: - The General Administration of Customs of China has granted approval to export 33 Sri Lankan food products to China. Out of that, 29 products are aquatic products and 38 companies from among Sri Lankan companies registered in the Republic of China operate as exporters of such products. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister Fisheries to sign the  Protocol on Inspection, Quarantine and Veterinary Sanitary Requirements for Wild Marine Fishing Aquatic Products to be exported from Sri Lanka to China between the General Administration of Customs of the Republic of China and the Ministry of Fisheries of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka to support and encourage to export aquatic products to China, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ratification of Cape Town Convention on International Interests in Mobile Equipment and the Protocol to the Convention on International Interests in Mobile Equipment on Matters Specific to Aircraft Equipment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body: - The Cape Town Convention on International Interests in Mobile Equipment and the Protocol to the Convention on International Interests in Mobile Equipment on Matters Specific to Aircraft Equipment was entered into in the year 2001 under the auspices of the International Institute for the Unification of Private Law and the International Civil Aviation Organization. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to take action to rectify the said Convention and to make necessary legislation to implement the relevant provisions within Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: State-Owned Enterprise Restructuring Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal for restructuring the State Owned Enterprises(SOE) was submitted to Parliament by the Hon. President when presenting the Interim Budget - 2022 as well as the Budget 2023. Accordingly, SOEs Restructuring Unit has already been established under the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to provide necessary facilities for the restructuring process of the State Owned Enterprises. Certain institutions from among those to be restructured are  fully state owned companies whereas the government has a majority shares in some other companies. Further, some state owned enterprises operate as corporations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of  Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to incorporate a holding company affiliated to the General Treasury with 100% equity ownership held by the Secretary to the Treasury in order to expedite the restructuring programme of the State Owned Enterprises under the above situation and make necessary provisions for the registration of state enterprises identified for restructuring, as the institutions affiliated to that holding company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appreciation of the Contribution of Upcountry Tamils to the Sri Lankan Economy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body: - Upcountry Tamils who migrated to Sri Lanka from India around 200 years ago, live in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Southern Provinces and they contribute to the national economy in various ways. Their contribution is around 1/3 of the total income of the plantation sector. Accordingly, the Cabinet concurred with the proposal made by the Hon. President to implement the programmes identified with a view to upgrading the living standards of Upcountry Tamil community in collaboration with the Ministry of Plantation Industries and other relevant State institutions to commemorate the completion of 200 years since the arrival of the first generation of the Upcountry Tamil Community to Sri Lanka by February 2023.

description: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2019‑10‑29 has granted approval to prepare the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Bill. The Central Bank of Sri Lanka Bill prepared so has been published in the Government Gazette on 2019‑11‑01 and although it has been submitted to Parliament for approval, it has not been placed on the Order paper. The preliminary draft has been developed incorporating new amendments enabling to fulfill the duties of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka effectively and efficiently to be suited with the present day needs. Accordingly, the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman has been submitted to the Cabinet by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies and it was decided to grant approval to the said Bill.

description: Establishment of an Office for Overseas Sri Lankan Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body: - In the Interim Budget 2022, the Hon. President has proposed to establish an Office for Overseas Sri Lankan Affairs to function as a central point for coordination to obtain the support of Sri Lankans living abroad. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to take necessary action to establish the proposed “Office for Overseas Sri Lankan Affairs” to obtain the service of 03 million Sri Lankans living abroad for the development of this country and to maintain the activities of the said Office properly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 21 of 2022 and Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No. 22 of 2022 issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Institute of Charted Shipbrokers of Sri Lanka (Incorporation) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body: - The Institute of Chartered Shipbrokers of Sri Lanka has been established in the year 1987 under the Ceylon Shipping Corporation with the patronage of the Institute of Charted Shipbrokers of England and it comprises of Fellow Members and Associated Members. The prime objective of this institute is to establish professionalism and uplift professionalism of shipbrokers. Further, providing opportunities to its members through study programmes, seminars and workshops to promote professionalism in the discipline and make training opportunities available for youth who have interest in the said field are among the objectives of the Institute. A private Member's Bill has been submitted to Parliament by the Hon. Buddika Pathirana, Member of Parliament in the Matara District to establish the same through a Parliament Act in order to maintain its activities properly and effectively. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to submit a Report to Parliament recommending the said draft Bill as per the provisions of the Standing Order 52(6), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the validity period of the Loan of the Supporting Electricity Supply Reliability Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body: - Supporting Electricity Supply Reliability Improvement Project is implemented under the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and two grants extended by the Clean Energy Financing Partnership Facility and the Japan Funds for Poverty Reduction. Action has been taken to extend the deadline for the completion of activities under Package - 4, up to 2023‑11‑29.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to extend the validity period of the ADB Loan facility up to 2024‑03‑31 enabling to secure the required funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining additional provisions required for renovation and 	conservation of the National Art Gallery
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body: - Although the renovation works of the National Art Gallery have been planned to complete during this year, owing to the situation prevailed in the country, it has not been possible to finish the expected task. Nearly 80% of the renovation work has been completed at present and related plans and estimates have been prepared by the Project Advisory Unit of the Faculty of Architecture, University of Moratuwa for the completion of remaining works. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to secure required provisions so that the remaining renovation works can be completed in the year 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rural Finance Programme implemented under the Smallholder Tea and 	Rubber Revitalization Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka and the International Fund for Agricultural Development have entered into an agreement for the implementation of the Smallholder Tea and Rubber Revitalization Project. Under the said project, "Rural Finance Program" is being implemented and the program is due to be terminated on 2022‑12‑31. Another amount of Rs.172.35 million out of the money allocated for that program is to be released to the beneficiaries as loans. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries to extend the period of the duration of the said program till 2023‑06‑30, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of new Visa Categories for the Colombo Port City
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body:
- Issuance of visa to the investors and other relevant parties who wish to arrive for miscellaneous services such as international trade, shipping and operations, finance, information technology and tourism to be established in the Colombo Port City and relevant acts incidental thereto have to be accomplished by the Department of Immigration and Emigration. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to take necessary action to take necessary action to introduce following visa categories, based on the recommendations of the Colombo Port City Commission, was approved by the Cabinet: 

*	"Investor Visa" category for investors under the residence visa category
* 	“Employment visa” category for employees
* 	“CPC Residential Property Leaseholder visa" category for foreigners residing in the Colombo Port City on lease basis.

description: Setting up a Training Centre of the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign 	Employment for the Monaragala District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body: - Although Monaragala District is geographically the second largest district, no office of the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment or a training Centre is operated within the district. The closest training centres to the said district are located at Haliela in Badulla District, Tangalla in Hambanthota district and Ampara. It is possible to use the training Centre located in Bibile road, Monaragala which is presently under the custody of the Department of Divineguma to set up a district training centre of the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment thereby providing required training facilities for those who seek foreign employment in low-income earning families. As such the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment; and the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to hand over the training Centre and premises located in Bibile road, Monaragala to the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Institute of Economics and Trade, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-19
decision_details_body: - It is highly important for the Members of Parliament and Senior Public Officials to have a training on Economics and Trade affairs enabling them to reach informed decisions formulating and implementing National Policies. In order to facilitate for the purpose, it has been found appropriate to establish an Institute by the name of "Sri Lanka Institute of Economics and Trade" by an Act of Parliament. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill to establish the Sri Lanka Institute of Economics and Trade, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Parliamentary Elections Act No.1 of 1981
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-12
decision_details_body: - According to section 8(8) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No.1 of 1981, the Election Commission has published a Code of Conduct relating to the conduct of political parties, independent groups and candidates contesting the election, thorough the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2178/25 dated 2020‑06‑03. It has been identified that it would be appropriate to amend the Parliamentary Elections Act, No.1 of 1981 in order to include actions to be taken in the event of violating this Code of Conduct and to include provisions stating that those will be effective during his/her tenure in the office and enable to provide the opportunity to identified persons holding special positions to vote at a special polling station apart from the polling station allocated for them. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a draft Bill to amend the said Act by incorporating provisions thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Legalization of Media Guidelines issued under the Article 104B(5)(a) of the Constitution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-12
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Article 104B(5)(a) of the 1978 Constitution, Media Guidelines have been published by the Election Commission under the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2178/24 dated 2020‑06‑03. Nevertheless, provisions pertaining to action that could be taken in the event of violating such guidelines have not been enacted yet. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to include the provisions which indicate that the violation of media guidelines is an election offence in the Presidential Elections (Special Provisions) Act, the Parliamentary Election Act, Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and the Provincial Councils Elections Act or to draft a Bill incorporating relevant provisions enabling take action treating the violation of media guidelines as an offence under each Act related to elections, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting approval in principal for the Procedural Rules of the Public Service Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-12
decision_details_body: - The Procedural Rules of the Public Service Commission implemented with effect from 2009‑04‑02 have been redrafted to be adopted with the present day needs and rules and regulations. The final draft of the Procedural Rules has been prepared incorporating the proposals submitted after further studying the said draft Procedural Rules by the Officials' Committee appointed by the Cabinet. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to grant approval in principal for the Procedural Rules prepared by the Public Service Commission, in terms of the Article 55(1) of the Constitution and implement the same with effect from 2023‑01‑01, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening legal provisions to prohibit sexual harassment, sexual assault 	and sexual bribery and punish the offenders of such criminal acts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-12
decision_details_body: - Committing sexual harassment violates the fundamental human rights and freedom and provisions related thereto are included in section 345 of the Penal Code. It is observed that this problem continues to exist even though the law provides for the imposition of punishment for such crimes. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a draft Bill enabling to amend the Penal Code by incorporating sections which make sexual harassment and all forms of sexual assaults as criminal acts and provide stringent punishment therefor and include a new section to make sexual bribery an offence, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-12
decision_details_body: - The Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2021‑07‑30 has been issued promulgating relevant Regulations in terms of the provisions of the Judicature Act enabling the Courts in the Northern Province to exercise jurisdictions to enforce financial statutes enacted by the Northern Provincial Council. When the approval of the Council was sought on 2021‑12‑13 to present the said Regulations in Parliament, the Cabinet decided that the enforcement process of the relevant financial statutes should be implemented simultaneously for both Northern and Eastern Provinces. Accordingly, the Hon. Minister of Justice has taken measures to impose Regulations in accordance with the provisions of the Judicature Act, nominating the Magistrates Courts and District Courts within the Eastern Province to hear and determine matters pertaining to all actions, proceeding or matters arising out of any Financial Statute imposed by the Eastern Provincial Council. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to present the Regulations so imposed , for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Water Supply of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Technology of the Republic of Maldives on Technical Cooperation towards Development of Water and Sewerage Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-12
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Technical Cooperation towards Development of Water and Sewerage Sector between Sri Lanka and the Maldives. Agreement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the clearance of the Attorney General have been received for the draft agreement prepared for the purpose. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of "Mindfulness" Programme for School Students
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-12
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Education together with the "Sathi Pasala Foundation" of Ven. Udairiyagama Dhammajeeva Thero, the founder of "Sathi Pasala" have planned to implement the programme of "Mindfulness" for school students. The programme is expected to be implemented in every school in the island as an educational programme that helps to prevent the misbehaviour of students by providing the school students with the skill they need to strengthen their personality while being resilient to complex and dynamic society. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Education to implement a pilot programme on each Wednesday from 2023‑01‑04 to 2023‑03‑24 and thereafter to implement the said program every week on Monday, Wednesday and Friday from 7.30 am to 7.40 am for 10 minutes.

description: Upgrading of Ampara and Mannar Urban Councils as Municipal 	Councils
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-12
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑08‑08 to take necessary action to convert the capital cities which remain as urban councils in several districts, into municipal councils without spending additional allocations while using the existing infrastructure facilities, office facilities and human resources. Taking into consideration the said approval, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Governments to upgrade Ampara and Mannar in order to facilitate the fulfillment of the desired development tasks in the said two cities, which are the main cities of Ampara and Mannar districts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and 	Maldives on immigration purposes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-05
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign an MoU between Sri Lanka and Maldives for the cooperation in immigration purposes at the bilateral relations between the two countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to sign an MoU to develop and strengthen the cooperation in immigration purposes between the two countries with a view to assisting the management of border controlling for mutual benefits, facilitating the mutual cooperation for skill development in the areas of human resource system and technology, exchanging of training facilities among immigration officers in the promotion of human resources, prevention of international crimes such as illegal migration, human trafficking and smuggling of persons and promotion of cooperation on the issues related to blacklisted passengers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Australian Volunteers Programme 2022 - 2027
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-05
decision_details_body: - The Australian Volunteers Programme funded by the Government of Australia is being implemented across 26 countries and grants are provided under the said programme to make change through locally-led work and to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals. A Memorandum of Understanding has been entered into between Australia and Sri Lanka in the year 2017 in order to implement the said programme in Sri Lanka and the time period of the said MoU has expired by now. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to sign a Memorandum of Subsidiary Arrangement (MSA) to implement the said programme for another period of five years in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparing the Bill to establish the Parliamentary Budget Office
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-05
decision_details_body: - The Hon. President submitted a preliminary draft for the establishment of the Parliamentary Budget Office for consideration at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022‑10‑31 for consideration and it was decided to refer the said preliminary draft to all party leaders of Parliament and seek their views on the matters therein. Accordingly, the Hon. Prime Minister has discussed with the party leaders regarding the preliminary draft and the views expressed at that discussion were brought to the notice of the Cabinet. As such, The Cabinet decided to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the draft Bill based on the preliminary draft already prepared, taking also into consideration the said views.

description: Mediation (Settlement of Civil and Commercial Disputes) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-05
decision_details_body: - Although, the Commercial Mediation Center of Sri Lanka Act No.44 of 2000 was passed by Parliament for the establishment of a Commercial Mediation Center, the anticipated functions could not be fulfilled through the said Act due to the various technical reasons and certain limitations. At present, most of countries adopt voluntary mediation to settle disputes and most of such countries have taken action to introduce rules and regulations for voluntary mediation. Further, such countries have made necessary legislation to authorize their Courts to take action against the parties for an unreasonable refusal to voluntary mediation. It has been found necessary to introduce new legislation to the legal system of this country to encourage towards voluntary mediation giving due attention to the said international tendency. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to take necessary action to prepare the Mediation (Settlement of Civil and Commercial Disputes) Bill in order to repeal the Commercial Mediation Center of Sri Lanka Act No. 44 of 2000 and make provisions for legal provisions on voluntary mediation for civil and commercial disputes and incidental maters related thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Mediation Board Act, No.72 of 1988
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-05
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2022‑09‑22 to amend the Mediation Board Act, No.72 of 1988 for introducing provisions pertaining to the appointment of members of the Commission, determining the jurisdiction of Mediation Boards, disputes that can not be settled and filing cases before courts in respect of such disputes, to be suited with the present day needs. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting Legal Powers to Maintain the Sri Lanka Navy Hydrographic Service 	at National Level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal for the vesting of marine hydrographic affairs in Sri Lanka's local waters and Exclusive Economic Zone to the Sri Lanka Navy as a non-naval duty was taken up for consideration at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022‑09‑05 and a Cabinet Sub‑Committee was appointed under the chairmanship of the Minister of Ports Shipping and Aviation to further study the said proposal and make recommendations.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to vest the marine hydrographic affairs in Sri Lanka's local waters and Exclusive Economic Zone to the Sri Lanka Navy as a non-naval duty by a Gazette Notification and to establish a National Hydrography Office so that all the agencies dealing with this subject can work together as per the recommendations of the said Committee , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Environmental Action Plan 2022 - 2030
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-05
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑06‑20 for the National Environmental Policy. In order to implement the said policy, the Ministry of Environment has prepared the National Environmental Action Plan for the period of 2022 - 2030 in collaboration with all relevant parties while adhering to the Sustainable Development Goals of the United Nations and giving consideration to the environmental challenges of the twenty first century. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to implement the said action plan and establish the Committee on Integrated Environment & Development Policy under the chairmanship of the Secretary, to the President in order to take policy decisions at national level and monitor the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of an allotment of land for the College of General Practitioners of 	Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-05
decision_details_body: - The College of General Practitioners of Sri Lanka has been established in terms of the provisions of the Act, No.26 of 1974 in order to promote the education of medical practitioner in Sri Lanka. A request has been made to allocate a plot of land to establish and maintain a new office complex for the said College. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Lands to transfer an allotment of land in extent of 21.30 perches located at the Thimbirigasyaya Divisional Secretariat Division, belonging to the Government to the College of General Practitioners of Sri Lanka, by way of a free grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the assistance of the Asia Foundation to continuously maintain 	the mediation related activities of the Community Mediation Boards and 	Special Land Mediation Boards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-05
decision_details_body: - The Asia Foundation which has supported the mediation programme in sri Lanka since its inception has agreed to grant further financial support to continuously maintain and strengthen the mediation related activities of the Community Mediation Boards and Special Land Mediation Boards. Accordingly, the Asia Foundation has agreed to provide a grant of Rs.127 million for the said purpose. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to sign a Memorandum of Understanding to obtain the aforesaid grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Health of Sri Lanka and the Christian Medical College of Vellore, India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-12-05
decision_details_body: - A bone marrow transplant programme was started in the year 2015 at the Lady Ridgeway Children's Hospital and the Cristian Medical College of Vellore, India has assisted in training the required staff for the said programme in 2017. At present, the basic infrastructure facilities for bone marrow transplant have been established in the Lady Ridgeway Children's Hospital and the said Medical College has agreed to formally provide assistance in the fields of consultation and training in order to maintain its functioning productively. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Health and the Christian Medical College of Vellore, India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the South Asian Sub-Regional Committee Meeting and Project Proposal Development Training Programme of the Asia-Pacific Network for Global Change Research
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - Asia-Pacific Network for Global Change Research is an inter-government network of 22 member countries working towards an Asia-Pacific Region capable of effectively addressing the challenges of global change and sustainability. The prime objective of the said network is to conduct policy-based research required for the global sustainable development in the Asia-Pacific Region and develop the capacity of the region. Accordingly, the Cabinet considered the information submitted by the Minister of Environment on action taken to host to conduct the South Asian Sub-Regional Committee Meeting and Project Proposal Development Training Programme of the Asia-Pacific Network for Global Change Research in Colombo from 2022‑11‑29 to 2022‑12‑01, by the Government of Sri Lanka.

description: Extending the validity period of the Order issued under section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - Orders have been issued from time to time as per the provisions of the Foreign Exchange Act to suspend/restrict the foreign exchange outflow pertaining to the certain capital transactions taking into account the negative impact that may cause to the foreign exchange market. The validity period of the currently issued Order would expire on 2022‑12‑29. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to take necessary action to extend the validity period of the Order issued under section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017 for another period of six (06) months with effect from 2022‑12‑30, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Regulations under the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017, to accommodate Short Term Foreign Loans from overseas to finance payments for the import of raw materials by Local Subsidiaries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to impose Regulations under section 7(1) of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017 to facilitate the payments utilizing the foreign exchange remitted by mother companies of local subsidiaries located outside Sri lanka or companies within the same group of companies, when importing raw materials by the said local subsidiaries to produce goods for the local market, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Imposing Regulations under Section 47(1) of the Antiquities Ordinance No.9 of 1940
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - The Department of Archaeology and other State Institutions have the capacity to take legal action against an individual violating the Antiquities Ordinance by unlawfully damaging a site or property of archaeological importance. Accordingly, the aforesaid State Institutions contribute the protection of the archaeological places in Sri Lanka and conservation of the same on behalf of the future generation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to take necessary action to impose appropriate regulations as per the provisions of the Antiquities Ordinance No.9 of 1940, enabling to grant an allowance from the Antiquities Gift Fund with a view to further motivating the staff members of the said institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance No.19 of 1931 and drafting the Theravada Bhikku Kathikavath (Registration) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - Although action have been taken on several occasions to amend the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance No.19 of 1931, the said amendments could not be completed due to the inability to reach an agreement on the views and suggestions made by several parties. An agreement has been reached between the relevant parties by now pertaining to the proposed proposals. Similarly, it has been decided to draft the Theravada Bhikku Kathikavath (Registration) Bill by further amending the preliminary draft Bill of the same, taking into consideration the views and suggestions made by the various parties to introduce an Act including provisions for enforcing the decision of the relevant Sangha Sabha in an instance where a certain Monk does not act according to a decision arrived by a Sangha Sabha of any Nikaya or Chapter. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to take action to prepare a draft Bill to amend the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance No.19 of 1931 and to draft the Theravada Bhikku Kathikavath (Registration) Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Imposing Regulations for the payment of welfare benefits under the provisions of the Welfare Benefits Act, No.24 of 2002
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - Regulations on payment of Welfare Benefits (Selection of Persons eligible to receive payments) under the provisions of the Welfare Benefits Act, No.24 of 2002 have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2022‑10‑20.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing the Second Additional Protocol to the "Convention on Cybercrime on Enhanced Co-operation and Disclosure of Electronic Evidence" (Budapest Cybercrime Convention)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a signatory in the European Convention on Cybercrime on Enhanced Co‑operation and Disclosure of Electronic Evidence which is called as the "Budapest Cybercrime Convention" and the said Convention is in force from 2015‑09‑01. A signing ceremony for the Second Additional Protocol is scheduled to be conducted in Strasbourg, France on 2022‑11‑30, and as such, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms and the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign the said protocol, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a relevant Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Plantation Industries and Ksapa Company in France for implementation of the Capacity Building Project for 6,000 Rubber Smallholders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - The Ksapa Company in France with the financial assistance of the Ministry of Economy, Finance and Recovery of the Government of France and the Michelin Group in France, under the guidance of the Ministry of Plantation Industries has designed to implement the "Rubber Improvement of Value Chain & Embedded Smallholders Resilience Project" to increase the economic strength of 6,000 rubber smallholders in the rubber growing areas of Badalkumbura and Medagama in the Monaragala district. The proposed project has been recommended by the Department of National Planning and the total cost of the project has been estimated as Euro 726,700. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding for the implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: International Water Conference on Sustainable Development Cooperation, Partnership and Appropriate Technology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - The National Water Supply and Drainage Board has taken steps to organize the "International Water Conference on Sustainable Development, Cooperation, Partnership and Appropriate Technology - 2022" from 2022‑12‑14 to 2022‑12‑16 December 2022. This conference is envisaged to achieve the objectives such as bringing together water professionals, foreign delegates, international organizations, Government Officials and Journalists; share ideas and knowledge for research; create links among water professionals and exchange of experiences and achievements in the water sector of different countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply to conduct the proposed conference involving the relevant local and international institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening Social Cohesion and Peace in Sri Lanka Project (SCOPE) and Green Policy Dialogue Facility Project (GPDF), proposed to be financed under the European Union Grant Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - It has been agreed to provide funds under the Multi-Annual Indicative Programme of the European Union to Sri Lanka for the period from 2021 to 2027 with a view to supporting the 'Green Recovery for Sri Lanka' and 'An Inclusive Peaceful Society'. Accordingly, an indicative grant of Euro 60 million has been allocated for the period of 2021 - 2024 for relevant sectors and support measures. Under that, the European Union has expressed its agreement to provide a grant of Euro 16 million to implement the "Strengthening Social Cohesion and Peace in Sri Lanka (SCOPE) Project" and "Green Policy Dialogue Facility(GPDF) Project". Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to enter into grant agreements with the European Union in order to obtain said grants, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of High Impact Community Development Projects with Indian Grant Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - The project to implement High Impact Community Development under Indian grant assistance has been implementing since 2005. Accordingly, for the implementation of the said project, Memoranda of Understanding have been signed between the two countries for the periods from 2005 - 2010, 2010 - 2015 and 2015 - 2020. Under the said project, priority is given for the provision of infrastructure facilities in the education, health and community development sectors. The cost of a sub-project implemented under the project is limited to Rs.300 million, and the value of the total number of projects executed at any time is subject to a price ceiling of Rs.5 billion. However, owing to the current economic crisis and high inflation prevailing in the country, it has been difficult to implement certain projects within the maximum price ceiling of Rs.300 million and therefore, both parties have agreed to increase the said maximum price ceiling up to Rs.600 million and the total cost of the projects implemented at any time up to Rs.10 billion. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to revise the Memorandum of Understanding signed between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Sri Lanka Export Development Board and the Swiss Import Promotion Programme (SIPPO)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-28
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Swiss Import Promotion Programme which operates under the State Secretariat for Economic Affairs of Switzerland and the Sri Lanka Export Development Board to carry out a comprehensive study for export products such as processed food, sustainable fish and seafood and value added textiles. The purpose of the proposed study is to expand the opportunities for Sri Lankan export goods to access the European market. A sum of 100,000 Swiss Francs is incurred by the Swiss Import Promotion Program for the study. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion, to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Banking (Special Provisions) Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - The Central Bank of Sri Lanka has identified the need to strengthen the bank resolution framework under the crisis management framework of financial institutions regulated by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka as an urgent and priority task. The International Monetary Fund and the World Bank have also indicated the need to strengthen the resolution framework to strengthen financial sector safety nets. In view of the difficulty of enacting a comprehensive new banking law within a short period of time, it has been decided to introduce the proposed Banking (Special Provisions) Act as a supplement to the Banking Act No.30 of 1988 by incorporating provisions for resolution of licensed banks, deposit insurance and safe closure/liquidation of accounts of licensed banks. Accordingly, a preliminary draft has been prepared by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, and the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policy to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill based on the said preliminary draft, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) 	Act, No.1 of 1969 for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to present the Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No.19 of 2022 and Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.20 of 2022, issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969, for approval in Parliament.

description: Introducing a new Act instead of the Police Ordinance No.16 of 1865
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - The Police Ordinance No.16 of 1865 presently in force has been already amended 37 times and approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2014‑11­19 to amend the said Ordinance again. However, depending on the new social trends, the need has been identified to introduce a new Act for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to take necessary action to introduce a new Act instead of the Police Ordinance No.16 of 1865, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the National Archives Act, No.48 of 1973
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Cabinet decision dated 2012‑12‑05, the Legal Draftsman has been directed to draft a Bill to amend the National Archives Act, No.48 of 1973. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has drafted a Bill and further the Legal Draftsman has informed that the policy approval of the present Cabinet is required for the said Bill. However, since audio-video records, cinematograph records and digital records are largely produced for the conservation process in addition to paper records, the need has been identified to further amend the National Archives Act so as to suit to the international standards and national requirements. As such the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs, to appoint a committee consisting of experts on document management, document preservation and digitalized document management and identify appropriate amendments and thereafter, take necessary action incorporate appropriate amendments to further amend the said Bill that has already been drafted by the Legal Draftsman, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Law to make provisions for the control of election expenses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - The Legal Draftsman has drafted a Bill to control the election expenses on the approval of the Cabinet. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the youth representation in Local Government Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - Attention of the Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs has been focused on providing opportunity for youth representation in the decision making process. At present, Colombo District Parliamentarian, Hon. Premnath C. Dolawatte has submitted a Private Member's Bill to Parliament in that regard, and while extending the support for the said Bill, it has been found appropriate to increase the youth representation in Local Government Institutions with a view to creating an environment of which the upliftment of the whole youth community and their aspirations could be achieved. Accordingly, Cabinet approved in principle the proposal made by the Minister of Sports and Youth, to amend the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance making provisions for the appointment of youth representatives tantamount to not less than 25% of the number of members to be elected according to the first nomination paper and not less than 25% of the number of members to be selected according to the second nomination paper, while safeguarding the women's representation , in terms of the existing provisions of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.

description: National Framework on Eco-labeling in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - Producers need to carry out their production activities sustainably and the consumers need to consume products and services responsibly and prudently in order to ensure the long term environmental, social and economic well‑being. For the purpose, scientific methodologies such as standardization and certification to prove the “Assurance of Sustainable Consumption and Production Patterns” have to be introduced as stated under Sustainable Development Goal No.12. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to implement the National Framework on Eco-labeling enabling to ensure the environmental performance of productions to other supply chain stakeholders including their customers and the customers or purchasers to make decisions of purchasing relevant products with credibility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Environmental Sensitive Areas in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - Due to various human activities taking place at present such as certain irregular land use and agricultural practices, informal solid waste disposal and unsustainable use of natural resources, many problems such as ecosystem degradation, soil erosion, drying up of water sources and human-wildlife conflicts have to be encountered. As a result, the biodiversity and base of ecosystem service have been threatened. That situation will lead to a vicious cycle of ecosystem degradation in the long run. Therefore, it is expected through the establishment of the National Policy on Environmental Sensitive Areas to ensure a healthy, safe and conserved environment and economy thereby establishing environmental sensitive areas for social-economic well being and livable environment for all. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to implement the National Policy on Environmental Sensitive Areas in Sri Lanka in order to provide the necessary guidance for the conservation of environmentally sensitive areas and their sustainable utilization by identifying the environmentally sensitive areas across the Island and with the participation of all sectors such as community, private sector, state sector and experts for the land use planning and management of those areas and ensuring a co‑management approach at all levels, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of the “Committee Appointed by the Cabinet of Ministers” in terms of the provisions of the Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act No.27 of 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - Section 5 (1) of the Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) Act No. 33 of 2002 includes provisions pertaining to the effect that Minister in charge could grant licenses for the import, export, sale, supply and distribution of petroleum to any person or company as per the recommendations of the “Energy Supply Committee” constituted in accordance with the provisions of section 02 of the Energy Supply (Temporary Provisions) Act No. 02 of 2002. Nevertheless, the Energy Supply Committee appointed as per the provisions of the Energy Supply (Temporary Provisions) Act No. 02 of 2002 has been abolished due to the enactment of the said Act for a period of two years. Provisions have been made to establish a “Committee Appointed by the Cabinet of Ministers” in lieu of the “Energy Supply Committee” as per the Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act No. 27 of 2022. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to appoint the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Presidential Task Force to avoid the use of poisonous and dangerous drugs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - The Joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence; the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms; and the Minister of Public Security to establish a Presidential Task Force to identify, plan and implement the suitable pragmetic measures to combat dissemination and use of the poisonous and dangerous drugs and avoid their use, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement for the Transfer of Sentenced Prisoners between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Mauritius
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - As per the provisions of the Transfer of Offenders Act, No.5 of 1995, a citizen of another country who has been convicted and imprisoned by a Court in Sri Lanka is able to serve his/her sentence in the country of which he/she claims to be a citizen. Likewise the said Act provides provisions for a Sri Lankan citizen who is imprisoned in a specified country to be transferred back to Sri Lanka to serve his / her balance period of imprisonment. Entering into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and the other relevant country is essential for the above purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to enter into an Agreement for the transfer of sentenced prisoners between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Mauritius, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the National Medicines Policy of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - Since approximately 15 years has lapsed from the declaration of the National Medicines Policy which was prepared in the year 2005, it has been found the necessity of revising the said Policy to suit with the present day needs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to revise the National Medicines Policy through a Committee appointed by the Secretary to the Ministry of Health, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proclamation of the National Day for Biosphere Reserves
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
