decision_details_body: - The UNESCO General Assembly has declared 03rd November in each year as the “Day for Biosphere Reserves”. The UNESCO has indicated that action should be taken by its member states to draw the attention of the people to encourage them for the protection of Biosphere Reserves. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to declare 03rd November in each year as the “National Day for Biosphere Reserves”, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing opportunity to the public to visit National Parks, Entertainment Parks, Botanical Gardens and to watch movies in cinema halls free of charge on the 75th Independence Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-11-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President to provide opportunity to the public to visit National Parks, Botanical Gardens and Entertainment Parks/Places free of charge and also to provide opportunity to watch movies with 50% off for ticket prices of the Cinema Halls located across the country on 75th Independence Day falling on 4th February 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Limiting the overseas leave granted to Ministers, State Ministers and Members of 	Parliament of the Government Group during Parliamentary Sitting days 	and Budget Debate
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to the effect that Ministers, State Ministers and Members of Parliament of the Government Group should not travel abroad during Parliamentary Sitting days and Budget Debate, other than in urgent medical needs or in case of very urgent tasks of the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for the Budget Debate - 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-31

description: Submission of Orders published in the Government Gazette to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-31

description: Bill to amend the Borrowing Limit for the Financial Year 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-31
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑10‑17 has granted approval to prepare a Bill to revise the approved borrowing limit for the year 2022. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman accordingly. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendations submitted to the Hon. President by the Finance Commission relating to the year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-31
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of the Constitution of Sri Lanka, the recommendations for the financial year 2023 have been submitted to the President by the Finance Commission. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposals made by the Hon. President, the Cabinet granted approval to take appropriate measures to implement the said recommendations made by the Finance Commission and to submit the said recommendations to Parliament in terms of Article 154R(7) of the Constitution.

description: Rathanatissa Peace Foundation (Incorporation) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-31
decision_details_body: - The (Incorporation) Bill of Rathnatissa Peace Foundation of which Rev. Eriyawe Rathanathissa Thero, the Chief Incumbent of Sri Vapikaramaya, Palukadawala, Galgamuwa holds the post of Executive Director, has been submitted to Parliament as a Private Member's Bill by Hon. U.K Sumith Udukumbura, Member of Parliament of Kurunegala District. The said Bill has been referred to the Minister of Education as the Minister in charge of the subject, for obtaining a report in that regard in terms of the provisions of the Standing Order 52(6) of Parliament. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, the Cabinet granted its approval for the proposal made by the Minister of Education to submit a report to Parliament recommending the said Bill.

description: Restructuring of SriLankan Airlines Limited and its Subsidiary Companies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-31
decision_details_body: - It has been found appropriate to restructure SriLankan Airlines Limited and its subsidiary companies by transferring a considerable number of shares and management of the company to investors selected through a transparent procurement process. Accordingly, taking into account the proposals made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation, Cabinet decided to assign the task of studying on the manner in which SriLankan Airlines should be restructured and making recommendations to the Cabinet, to the State-Owned Enterprises Restructuring Unit established under the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policy.

description: 55th Annual Meeting of the Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-31
decision_details_body: - Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies attended the 55th Annual Meeting of the of the Asian Development Bank held in Manila, Philippine on 2022‑09‑29 and the Cabinet considered the key points highlighted in the speech made by the President having presided over the Business Forum of the said Meeting as the member representing Sri Lanka at the Board of the Asian Development Bank and the information furnished with regard to the Bilateral discussions conducted with the Chairman of the Asian Development Bank, Minister of Finance of Japan and as well as the President of the Republic of the Philippines.

description: Revision of Solar Rooftop Tariff
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-25
decision_details_body: - Solar Rooftop has added 580MW to the national grid at present and it has been identified the necessity of obtaining another 1800MW through that as per the Long Term Generation Expansion Plan prepared by the Ceylon Electricity Board. As an incentive for that, a Committee has been appointed to submit recommendations for revising the tariff applicable for the purchase of electricity from the presently approved solar power plants. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to revise the tariff as per the recommendation of the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the validity period of the Loan obtained for the National Transmission and Distribution Network Development & Efficiency Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-25
decision_details_body: - The Loan Agreement related to obtaining a loan amounting to JPY 24,930 million from the Japan International Co-operation Agency for this Project has been signed on 2015 08 11. The validity period of the said loan amount is to be expired on 2022 10 28. The validity period of the said loan amount has to be extended as the the project could not be implemented as planned due to the prevailing situation in the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to extend the validity period of the said loan up to 2026 04 28, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Singapore Convention on Mediation Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-25
decision_details_body: - United Nations Convention on International Settlement Agreements resulting from Mediation which is known as the Singapore Convention on Mediation was adopted on 2018 12 20 by the member countries at the United Nation's General Assembly. Sri Lanka also has signed the said Agreement on 2019 08 07. However, domestic legislation is required to be formulated to enact the said Agreement in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to prepare a suitable Bill, taking into consideration the provisions in the relevant Convention, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act (Chapter XXX - Inquests of Death)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-25
decision_details_body: - A committee has been appointed under the chairmanship of Prof. Raveendra Fernando to identify appropriate amendments to the existing legislation, procedures and practices pertaining to the conduct of inquests into deaths and submit recommendations. It has been found necessary to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure Act to make necessary provisions to implement the recommendations of the said Committee. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to take necessary action to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Licensing of Shipping Agent Act No.10 of 1972
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-25
decision_details_body: - The Container Operators' Regulations have been issued in the year 2005 as per the provisions of section 3 and 10 of the Licensing of Shipping Agent Act No. 10 of 1972. The Court has decided that the Regulation 10 of the said Act should be amended and the approval has been granted by the Cabinet decision dated 2022 07 04 to introduce necessary amendments to the Licensing of Shipping Agent Act No. 10 of 1972 by incorporating provisions related thereto. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman accordingly. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Offering incentives to migrant Employees to promote remittance through 	legal channels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-25
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022 08 08 to offer identified incentives for Sri Lankan migrant employees with a view to promoting remittance through legal channels. Accordingly, the Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment has issued relevant circular instructions and eligible migrant workers are facilitated to import a two-wheel electric motor vehicle subject to a maximum value of US$ 25,000 and a four-wheel fully electric motor vehicle subject to a maximum value of US$ 65,000. As such, it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet for the following measures taken with a view to to further promoting the remittance of foreign exchange earned by migrant workers to Sri Lanka, submitted by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment for the attention of the Cabinet:

*	Granting permission to import a two wheel electric vehicle of CIF value up to 50% of the amount of foreign exchange remitted until 2023 04 30 or until the date of applying to import a vehicle.

* 	Granting permission to import a four wheel electric vehicle of CIF value up to 50% of the amount of foreign exchange remitted from 2022 05 01 		 to 2023 12 31.

description: Declaration of the National Supply Chain Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-25
decision_details_body: - The overall process of transforming raw materials into final products, is called Supply Chain Management and it enables to maximize customer value and actively streamline the supply-side activities of a business in order to obtain competitive advantages in the marketplace. The Institute of Supply and Material Management has pointed out the appropriateness of declaring a National Supply Chain Day with the objective of increasing the awareness amongest the domestic businesses and enterprises on the importance of developing supply chains. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to declare 24th October of each year as the “National Supply Chain Day”, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and the Kingdom of 	the Netherlands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-25
decision_details_body: - Diplomatic relations between Sri Lanka and the Kingdom of the Netherlands were established in 1951, and entering into an Air Services Agreement will facilitate the operation of direct passenger and cargo flights between the two countries. It would further enhance tourism, education, trade, investment, agricultural and cultural relations between the two countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to enter into a Bilateral Air Services Agreement, based on the matters agreed upon during the discussions between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Reconciliation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-17
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President on the establishment of the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Reconciliation under the chairmanship of the Hon. President and comprising of the following members in order to promote the reconciliation among different communities in Sri Lanka and to address and resolve issues faced by the people relating to the resettlement, land and issues relating to missing persons in the aftermath of the conflict in the North and East:

	*	Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena,
			Prime Minister;

		*	Hon. Douglas Devananda,
Minister of Fisheries;

		*	Hon. (Dr.) Wijeyadasa Rajapakshe,
	Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms; and

		*	Hon. Ali Sabry, 
		Minister of Foreign Affairs.

description: Establishment of the 'Jathika Jana Sabha Secretariat' in order to build 'Jana 	Sabha' for strengthening the Participatory Democracy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-17
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that, the Representative Democratic System which has been exercising in Sri Lanka does not adequately address the true public issues, the relationship between governing circle and the community of the periphery is drifting apart in this system, public opinions are not sufficiently considered in making policy decisions thereby causing social criticisms and based on the said criticisms, views and protests are being emerged in the society against the representative democracy. Under this circumstance, there is a need for a strong mechanism in an organizational structure that operates with participatory democratic features at the rural level and enables the public officials and the general public to discuss rural issues together, determine development priorities and the rural community to take part in the the decision making process. It will be possible to effectively and efficiently prevent the public distress that may occur through bureaucracy and arbitrary politicization through a mechanism with provisions that enable the community of the periphery to actively raise their opinions for the formulation of public policies and implement those policies with community participation. Accordingly, a concept paper on "Jana Sabha System" has been presented in an initiative of the National Movement for Social Justice with an independent institutional structure that can obtain public participation for the formulation of public policies and the successful implementation of those policies. The said concept paper has proposed the establishment of "Grameeya Jana Sabha" covering each Grama Niladhari division in the island and the establishment of "Jathika Jana Sabha" at the national level. As such, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President to accept the “Jana Sabha System” proposed by the said concept paper by the Government as a basic policy and to establish the “Jathika Jana Sabha Secretariat” as the independent focal institution for the establishment of the “Jana Sabha System”.

description: The Recovery of Possession of Premises Given on Lease (Special 	Provisions) Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-17
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑09‑27 to draft a new Bill for the enactment of a new law in place of the Recovery of Possession of Premises Given on Lease (Special Provisions) Act. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Ayurveda Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-17
decision_details_body: - Ayurveda Act No.31 of 1961 has been previously amended from time to time and it has been found the need to further amend the said Act, enabling to meet the sustainable development goals and the timely requirements. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to amend the Ayurveda Act incorporating appropriate provisions for the expansion of the services of the Ayurveda Department for the advancement of the field of indigenous medicine and for the establishment of Research Herbal Gardens etc, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Public Assets Management Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-17
decision_details_body: - In the Budget Speech made by the Hon. President for the amendment of the Appropriation Act in respect of the financial year 2022, it was pointed out the necessity of introducing several new Acts and revising provisions of several existing Acts with the aim of building a strong economy, increasing the efficiency of the public service and managing the state resources effectively. As such, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill for Public Assets Management, incorporating appropriate provisions enabling to expand the duties of the Comptroller General's Office which is under the purview of the General Treasury and provide legal status to the said office, compile a National Assets Register and introduce a central data base relating to public assets.

description: Increase of the substitute allowance paid to the Female Sub - Postmasters on maternity leave
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - A female Sub-Postmaster is entitled to obtain maternity leave as per the provisions of the Establishments Code, subject to employing a substitute in service at her own expense during her maternity leave period in terms of the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Sub-Postmaster Service and an allowance equivalent only to 30 day daily wage is paid as the substitute allowance during that period. It is observed that most of the female Sub - Postmasters limit their maternity leave only up to 30 days due to the fact that a substitute has to be employed at her own expense during the relevant maternity leave period. According to the recommendations of the World Health Organization and other medical recommendations, breast milk should be provided to infants at least up to six months from their birth. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to pay 84 days allowance instead of the 30 days allowance being paid to female Sub-Postmasters, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Rehabilitation of the Suriyakanda - Rakwana (A017) Road Corridor of the Galle - Deniyaya - Madampe Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - A Loan Agreement has been entered into with the OPEC Fund for International Development for the rehabilitation of the road section up to Suriyakanda - Rakwana of the Galle - Deniyaya - Madampe Road. Rehabilitation activities of the said road section is scheduled to be carried out under three (03) contract packages. Among them, two (02) contract packages fall under the threshold limit of the Ministerial Procurement Committee and the other contract package is under to the threshold limit of the Cabinet. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to award the contract package falling under the threshold limit of the Cabinet, to K.D.A. Weerasinghe & Company (Pvt.) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contract for the construction of the National College of Education for Technological Stream to be established in Narangalla, Kuliyapitiya on a Korean Grant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2017‑01‑18 has granted approval to establish a National College of Education for Technological Stream in the Narangalla area in Kuliyapitiya under a Grant of the Korean Government and local funds. Nevertheless, construction activities entrusted to the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA) could not be initiated until the end of November, 2021 on various reasons. The KOICA has agreed to assign the said construction activities to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau as a direct contract. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to assign the relevant contract to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for providing an Automated Crew Scheduling and Resource Management System for the SriLankan Airlines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - Commercial Airlines across the world implement automated crew scheduling and resource management system for the crew management activities of the Airline. The contract period of the current system of the Srilankan Airlines would expire on 2022‑10‑31. Therefore, the International Competitive Bidding has been followed to procure a suitable service providing agency for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the relevant procurement to the CAE Flight Services USA, Inc for a period of five (05) years as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of 80 Ton Bollard Pull Twin Azimuth Stern Drive Harbour Tug for the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - There are 07 Tugs which are in good condition in the Port of Colombo at present and it has been identified that another Tug with the capacity of 80 Ton should be purchased for future operations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to take necessary action to purchase a Tug, following the International Competitive Bidding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new Legal Deposit Act to replace the old Legal Deposit Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - Systematic management and preservation of public authorities' evidential valuable documents and private documents that reflect the written history and cultural identity of Sri Lanka has been vested with the Department of National Archives. The said Department implements 03 Ordinances viz, the Newspapers Ordinance No. 5 of 1839, the Printers and Publishers Ordinance No.1 of 1885 and the Printing Presses Ordinance No.16 of 1902 pertaining to the legal deposits of such printed publications. Accordingly, legal copies of the relevant documents are deposited in the Department of National Archives. Among the 131 countries in the world, Sri Lanka possess the oldest legal deposit law and it has been identified the necessity of amending the said law to suit with the present day needs. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a draft Bill to introduce a new Legal Deposit Act to Sri Lanka based on the preliminary draft prepared by a Committee of Experts in the relevant field since 2018 in consultation with the relevant parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Civil Procedure Code (Chapter 101) (Section 205)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑01‑18 to draft a Bill to amend the Civil Procedure Code (Chapter 101) (section 205) pertaining to the issuance of certified copies of the judgment or decree to the respective parties to a Case. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No.15 of 2022 have been issued pertaining to the importation of goods under the Open Account System and Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.16 of 2022 have been issued in order to encourage the remittance of foreign exchange by Sri Lankans employed abroad. Accordingly, Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No.15 of 2022 imposed to enact the importation of essential food items including milk powder and red whole lentils and raw materials required for manufacturing poultry feed based under Open Account/Consignment Account Payment System have been promulgated in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2297/79 dated 2022‑09‑16. Further, Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.16 of 2022 imposed to enable the Sri Lankans serving abroad to import fully electric vehicles as an incentive have been promulgated in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2298/55 dated 2022‑09‑23. As such, the proposal made by the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to present the said Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting a block of land belonging to the Urban Development Authority on long term lease basis to implement a Rest House Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to allocate the land located at No.09, Karaitivu Road, Jaffna, belonging to the Urban Development Authority to M/s Grand Mountain Hotel (Pvt.) Ltd., on a 30 year lease basis, to implement a rest house development project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to grant the said land to M/s Grand Mountain Hotel (Pvt.) Ltd., on a 30 year lease basis to implement a rest house development project, subject to the relevant conditions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making a lump sum payment for the revival of families of missing persons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑03‑14 for the payment of an amount of Rs.100,000/- to the next of kin of the missing person, based on the Certificate of Absence issued for the families of missing persons by the Registrar General. However, taking into consideration the matters that it takes a long time to obtain the Certificate of Absence and the amount of Rs.100,000/- being paid is not sufficient, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to dispense with the requirement of obtaining the Certificate of Absence, if the Office for Reparations has confirmed that the person concerned has been missing and increase the allowance being paid up to Rs.200,000/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of land blocks from Infrastructure Developed Regional Industrial Estates to set up industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Industries to allocate 16 land blocks under the Regional Industrial Estates Development Programme for identified 16 investors for 35 years on long term lease basis, as recommended by the Regional Industrial Services Committees which have been established under the Industrial Promotion Act No.46 of 1990 and the Project Evaluation Committee coming under the purview of the Ministry of Industries, was approved by Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2023 to	Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-03
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑08‑22 to draft the Appropriation Bill for the financial year 2023. As such the Appropriation Bill for the year 2023 including the draft budget estimates of each Expenditure Head was considered by the Cabinet. The total Recurrent Expenditure has been estimated as Rs. 4,634 billion whereas the total Capital Expenditure has been estimated as Rs.3,245 billion. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to publish the Appropriation Bill for the Year 2023 in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: School Meal Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-03
decision_details_body: - The Government implements the School Meal Programme targeting 1.08 million students of 7,926 schools at an annual cost of Rs. 4 billion. The Government anticipates to implement Programmes under the Poverty Alleviation Policy expeditiously, aiming to achieve the objective “No-one-leaving-behind-with-no-food”. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by Hon. President to further expand the existing school meal programme based on district level poverty and nutritional data while securing funds through foreign donations and take appropriate action to provide a fully nutritious meal for another one million of school children.

description: Amending the Customs Ordinance and the Protection of Government 	Revenue (Special Provisions) Act, No.1 of 2006
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-03
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend the sections 47 and 57 of the Customs Ordinance and section 3 of the Protection of Government Revenue (Special Provisions) Act, No.1 of 2006. Owing to the provisions of section 153 of the Customs Ordinance, the revenue recovered by the Government by distribution of forfeitures and imposing penalties is very low and therefore the Committee on Public Accounts has pointed out the appropriateness of amending the said section. Further, it has been recognized the necessity of stipulating a statutory period of time to conduct investigations on customs cases and conclude such investigations as a trade facilitation measure for importers and exporters. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to take necessary action to further amend the Customs Ordinance and the Protection of Government Revenue  Act, introducing appropriate provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Muriate of Potash (MOP) Fertilizer required for the Maha Season 2022/23
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑06‑20 has granted approval to procure 40,000 MT of MOP fertilizer required for the Maha season 2022/23, utilizing US$ 50 million provided by the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the relevant procurement process has been followed and the proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation to award the relevant contract to the Ameropa Asia Pte. Ltd as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the Retirement Age of Employees in the State Owned Enterprises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-03
decision_details_body: - The compulsory age of retirement of the employees serving in the State Owned Enterprises has to be revised as 60 years as proposed by the Interim Budget 2022 passed by Parliament. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to issue the relevant Circular instructions imposing relevant provisions for the same with effect from 2023‑01‑01, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the ''Food Policy Committee''
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-10-03
decision_details_body: - The Government has recently established a multi-sector mechanism with a view to empowering rural economic revitalization Centers following a bottom-up strategy  in arriving at decisions pertaining to ensuring food security and nutrition. The entire production and distribution mechanism of essential food commodities will be guided and monitored through this mechanism while ensuring the availability of such commodities to the most vulnerable segments of the society at different administrative levels. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to establish the ''Food Policy Committee'' chaired by the Secretary to the President with participation of the Heads of the relevant Institutions to address the short term problems relating to supply, price and marketing and implement long - term programmes to build confidence among manufacturers, traders and consumers on supply chain operations in the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Limitation of Foreign Travel by Ministers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President to limit the foreign travel of the Cabinet and State Ministers only to the most essentials purposes and limit the accompanying team only to a key officer or to a group consisting of few most essential officers with a view to minimizing the Government expenditure, taking into consideration the difficult economic situation currently faced by the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for selecting Insurance Companies to provide insurance entitlements for Sri Lankan Migrant Workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑05‑17 has granted approval to invite the 
International Competitive Bids to provide insurance coverage for the Sri Lankan Migrant Workers. The Government's funds would not be incurred for the proposed insurance coverage and those insurance coverage should be provided by the employer who provides job opportunities to the Sri lankan Migrant Workers, through an insurance company recommended by the Government of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, The Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended 06 insurance companies out of the 09 companies which have submitted proposals. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to authorize the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment to enter into formal Agreements with the said insurance companies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the limits existing for the importation of Agricultural Inputs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - The agriculture is facing a severe crisis due to the difficulty of importing inputs required for agricultural activities in a timely manner given the current scarcity of foreign exchange, difficulties in opening Letters of Credit and the limitations of making relevant payments on advance payment system as well. Importers of agriculture inputs have brought to the notice of the Government that especially, when importing agricultural inputs, approval should be obtained from various institutions for each order pertaining to relevant importations thereby delaying such importation and incurring additional cost. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to take necessary action to increase the advance payment limit of US$ 50,000 which is applicable in importing identified agricultural seeds, agro chemicals and chemical fertilizers up to US$ 250,000, enabling to carry out the agricultural activities without any hindrance during the upcoming Maha Season, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of Glyphosate for Agriculture Purposes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - A severe impact has caused to all forms of agricultural activities due to the policy decision taken by the Government to ban / restrict the importation of Glyphosate whereby a decrease of the agricultural production and the increase of market price of essential commodities have occurred. Taking into account the said situation, it has been recommended that it would be appropriate to provide the opportunity to use Glyphosate for all agricultural activities as per the requirement so as to carry out the agricultural activities in the Maha Season 2022/23 more productively. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President to take necessary action to import the required quantity of Glyphosate for agricultural purposes for a period of six months, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a Broadcasting Authority Act for Electronic Media
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - There is no fundamental law in Sri Lanka at present to regulate the content of the television, radio and new media and due to this reason, various parties have encountered numerous issues in broadcasting audio -visual content by such media institutions and issuing licenses for such media institutions as well. The unethical actions of certain media institutions by inciting hatred among the people led to various problems in the country recently. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to take into consideration the proposal submitted by the Minister of Mass Media to introduce a new broadcasting law enabling to create a culture accountable to the general public and introduce a code of media ethics to the electronic media taking also into consideration the changes occurring in technical and legal fields while securing the maximum independence of speech and expression, and submit appropriate recommendations in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the National Transport Commission Act No. 37 of 1991
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet of Ministers has been granted previously to amend the National Transport Commission Act No. 37 of 1991 and accordingly an amended draft Bill is being prepared by the Legal Draftsman. It has been identified that it would be appropriate to further amend the said Act by incorporating also the provisions for issuing policies, regulatory regulations and guidelines for public passenger transportation services such as three-wheelers, school vans/buses and office transportation services which are growing at present, to the National Transport Commission Act No. 37 of 1991. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to incorporate the said provisions to the draft Bill being prepared by the Legal Draftsman, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of maize for animal feed production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - Approximately, 600,000 metric tons of maize is annually required for animal feed production and at present, there is a dire scarcity of maize in the market. Although licensees have been issued to import 225,000 metric tons of maize through food manufacturing companies and sellers of animal feed prior to 2022‑12‑31, only 38,000 metric tons of maize have been imported by the end of June, owing to the existing shortage of foreign exchange. The price of one kilogram of maize in the local market has increased up to Rs 220/- resulting a hike in the prices of animal feed also. Accordingly, the prices of chicken and eggs have also increased. It has been observed that there might be a severe crisis in the field of animal husbandry in the near future due to the fact that those involved in poultry farming are attempting to sell eggs without breeding chickens and leaving the industry. As such the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, to grant permission for the Food Promotion Board to import 25,000 metric tons of maize or other suitable grains for animal feed production as recommended by the Department of Animal Production and Health, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Treaty between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and 	Maldives on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to enter into a Treaty on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Maldives enabling to avoid various constrains confronted when conducting joint investigations as well as to further strengthen the mutual relation between the two countries.

description: Accession to the Protocols relating to amendments of Article 50(a) and 	Article 56 of the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago 	Convention)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has agreed to amend the Protocols relating to amendments of Article 50(a) and Article 56 of the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention) at the 39th session of the International Civil Aviation Organization Assembly. Provisions will be provided to increase the number of members of the Council from 36 to 40 by amending Article 50 (a) whereas provisions will be provided to increase the number of members from 19 to 21 of the Air Navigation Commission. At present, 60 Contracting States have ratified these two protocols and both protocols shall come into force on the date of deposit of the 128th Instrument of Ratification. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to accede to both protocols by Sri Lanka as a Contracting State, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Support to Integrated Rural Development in the Most 	Vulnerable 	Districts of the Central and Uva Provinces of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - The European Union has granted EUR 30 million to implement the “Support to Integrated Rural Development in the Most Vulnerable Districts of the Central and Uva Provinces” and the agreement for the purpose has been signed on 2016‑03‑16. Accordingly, the project duration is to be expire on 2024‑06‑15. However, owing to the outbreak of the Covid-19 pandemic and the the prevailing economic crisis in the country, delays have caused in implementing the project. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to extend the project implementation period and the execution period of the grant agreement until 2025‑06‑15, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for Strengthening Socioeconomic Resilience of Communities 	affected by the Covid-19 pandemic in the Central and Uva provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - A project funded by the Korean International Cooperation Agency has been scheduled to be implemented for Strengthening Socioeconomic Resilience of plantation communities affected by the Covid-19 pandemic in Nuwara Eliya district of the Central province and Badulla district of the Uva province. This project which is expected to carry out under 03 main components such as, Hygiene, Health and Agriculture for a period of 04 years from 2022 to 2025, will directly benefit about 72,400 people in 05 divisional secretariat divisions of the Nuwara Eliya district and about 19,350 people in 06 divisional secretariat divisions of the Badulla district. The United Nations Human Settlements Programme on behalf of the Government will implement this project with the US$ 06 million grant provided by the Korean International Cooperation Agency and all the coordination activities thereof will be assigned to the Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government to sign a Tri-party Record of Discussion among the Korean International Cooperation Agency, Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government and the Department of External Resources, in order to implement the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the General Sir John Kotelawala 	Defence University and the University of Calgary, Canada
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-22
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and the University of Calgary of Canada in order to create collaboration in the study sectors such as conducting selected educational activities, exchange of visiting scholars to conduct teaching and research activities, exchange of undergraduate and post graduate students, conducting joint research activities and providing internship/placement opportunities, between the two parties.

description: Reviewing the recruitment process in the public service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-12
decision_details_body: - Arrangements made to filling the vacancies for the approved posts as per the provisions of Service Minutes and Schemes of Recruitment has to be stopped due to the decision made by the Government to temporary suspend the recruitment to the public service under the prevailing economic situation. Although there is a surplus of public servants  in the public service as a whole due to the direct recruitment of graduates and employees under other service categories by following the approved Schemes of Recruitment and under the policy decisions made by the previous governments, it has been reported that there are vacancies in certain service categories. Further, appropriate action need to be taken on  issues which have arisen in the public service as a result of adopting various recruitment methodologies. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint an Officials' Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Prime Minister to identify priorities pertaining to the essential recruitment to be made to maintain the public service efficiently and effectively and determine the time frames for the same and submit appropriate recommendations to the issues which have arisen in the public service at present, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the following Regulations issued under  the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969 to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulation No.12 of 2022 promulgated by the Gazette Notification dated 2022‑08‑23 enabling to import raw materials, equipment and utility vehicles required for some industries to ensure the imports of public sector and the continuation of operations of the selected sectors.

*	the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulation No.13 of 2022 promulgated by the Gazette Notification dated 2022‑08‑23 to suspend the importation of number of selected goods temporarily to manage the available limited forex liquidity as per the recommendation of the Central Bank.

description: Financing the purchase of Essential Pharmaceuticals and Medical Supplies for the Ministry of Health
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-12
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the foreign exchange crisis encountered by the country, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank has agreed to provide US$100 million   expeditiously to import essential pharmaceuticals and medical supplies by revising the scope of Support to Colombo Urban Regeneration Project and the Reduction of Landslide Vulnerability by Mitigation Measures Project implemented under the funds of the said Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to utilize US$70 million from the  Support to Colombo Urban Regeneration Project and US$30 million from the Reduction of Landslide Vulnerability by Mitigation Measures Project to purchase essential pharmaceuticals and medical supplies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Third National Communication Report of Climate Change 	in Sri Lanka to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate 	Change
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-12
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka as a stakeholder party of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change should submit informative reports related to climate change in timely manner. Accordingly, its first and second communication reports have been submitted in the years 2000 and 2012 respectively. Such communication report should contain information such as climate, economic and social circumstances, national greenhouse gas inventory, mitigation options of reducing greenhouse gas emissions, climate change vulnerability and adaptation measures, education, training and capacity building, technology transfer, research and systematic observations etc. Accordingly, the Ministry of Environment has prepared the Third National Communication Report 2018-2021, obtaining the views of the expert committees on climate change and inter-agency coordinating committees. The proposal made by the Minister of Environment to submit the said report to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the National Literary Arts Festival
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-12
decision_details_body: - The State Literary Awards Festival, the National Literary Festival and the National Literary Arts Festival are annually conducted to promote literature, arts, aesthetics and related fields. Owing to the existing economic circumstances in the country, conducting of such festivals during this year would not be appropriate and instead of that, it has been planned to conduct the “National Literary Arts Festival” incorporating all the unique features of those literary festivals. Accordingly, the Cabinet granted its concurrence for the proposal made by the Minister of Budhhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to conduct the said festival at the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall from 27th October to 30th October 2022 jointly with the  State  and private sector institutions.

description: Establishment of the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Economic Revival and 	Growth
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-12
decision_details_body: - Expeditious decisions have to be made on the steps to be taken for the economic revival and growth with high priority, amidsts the current economic crisis. As such, it has been found appropriate to establish a Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Economic Revival and Growth in order to make strategic directions for the national economic management activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to appoint the said Committee under his chairmanship and comprising of 05 Cabinet Ministers including the Hon. Prime Minister, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining approval to formulate a Bill for Gender Equality and Women's Empowerment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment has made several initiatives for empowering women by minimizing the gender imbalances and those programmes are planned to be implemented under the “Liya Sarani” a National Integrated Programme for Women. Not functioning the National Women's Committee which is for the formulation and regulation of women's policies and the Sri Lanka Women's Bureau involving women's empowerment and development, legally at national level has been identified as one of the major weaknesses in the exiting mechanism for women's empowerment. Accordingly, the Cabinet concurred with the proposal made by the Hon. President to request the Women Parliamentarians' Caucus in Parliament to prepare a preliminary draft to be used as a basis for the preparation of the “Gender Equality and Women's Empowerment Bill” incorporating the relevant provisions, with a view to ensuring the gender equality, rights and protection of Sri Lankan women.

description: Introduction of a Comprehensive Legislation on National Security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity of introducing a comprehensive national security legislation to address the gaps of existing counter terrorism legislation to introduce provisions relating to novel and contemporary dimensions of terrorism and violent extremism, preparation for such acts, law enforcement and further strengthening investigative and monitoring tools. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence; the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms and the Minister of Foreign Affairs to appoint a Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to prepare a preliminary draft for a comprehensive legislation on national security taking into consideration the international standards/ recommendations pertaining to the protection of the human rights and paying attention on all relevant matters, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Multi-Sector Combined Mechanism for ensuring food security and nutrition
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - The food security has been identified as the most challenging issue in the wake of the current economic crisis and the decline of domestic agricultural production and the increase of prices internationally have further intensified this issue. In this backdrop, an acute food shortage and the increase of price inflation could be anticipated in future and it will result in further deterioration of the food security. The increase of unemployment and the worst impact caused to the household income in the wake of the current economic crisis has complicated the access to the essential food items and there is a possibility of increasing the prices of food items further due to limited ability to purchase imported supplies given the depreciation of the value of Rupee. Accordingly, it has been planned to implement a short-term national programme within the next two years as an immediate step to ensure the food security and nutrition. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President to establish a National Food Security and Nutrition Council and Multi Sector Combined Mechanism for food security and nutrition at provincial, district, divisional and Grama Niladhari levels in order to implement the said programme efficiently and effectively, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting leave to be spent within the Island for the Public Officers entitled to pension without causing prejudice to seniority and pension
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Cabinet decision dated 2022‑06‑13, a Committee comprising of senior officials has been appointed to submit recommendations pertaining to providing leaves to be spent within the Island to the public officers entitled to pensions without prejudice to their seniority. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government to implement the recommendations submitted by the above Committee pertaining to providing no pay leaves for a maximum period of 05 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - The Criminal Sub-Committee coming under the Special Unit of the Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms has recommended that it would be appropriate to amend the relevant provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979 by incorporating provisions enabling to reckon the time spent by a person in custody or any part thereof as part of the term of office, in considering appeals of such person convicted by the Court. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a draft Bill to amend the section 323(5) of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Malaysia and the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on recruitment, employment and repatriation of workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding has been signed in the year 2016 between the Government of Malaysia and the Government of Sri Lanka for the recruitment, employment and repatriation of workers and the validity period of the said MoU has expired on 2021‑12‑15. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to sign a new Agreement by extending the said MoU enabling to implement the said programme further, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Joint Crediting Mechanism between Japan and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Paris Agreement on Climate Change ratified on 21st September 2016 by Sri Lanka, the Nationally Determined Contributions to reduce Green House Gas (GHG) emissions under the sectors of energy, industry, transport, waste, forestry and agriculture have been submitted to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change. The Joint Crediting Mechanism introduced by Japan in year 2013 reduces the GHG emissions jointly with developing countries and shares the reduced amount proportionally between the agreed party country and Japan. The proposal made by the Minister of Environment to sign a Memorandum of Corporation between Sri Lanka and Japan to implement the said mechanism between two countries as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Policy on Sanitation and Sanitation Master Plan - 2021-2030
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - Sanitation is defined as the safe management of domestic wastewater and human excreta as well as institutional, commercial and industrial wastewater including their safe confinement, treatment, disposal and associated hygiene related practices. The United Nations Organization, in its agenda of Sustainable Development Goals has identified provision of sanitary services as a major requirement in a country's development. Accordingly, in order to achieve the sustainable development goals relating to the provision of sanitary facilities, the Ministry of Water Supply has prepared the National Policy on Sanitation and Sanitation Master Plan in consultation with the relevant parties including the Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government, while ensuring that all stakeholders operate within a common framework with proper coordination and monitoring. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply to implement the proposed policy covering the period from 2021-2030, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Nutrition Policy - 2021-2030
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - The “National Nutrition Policy-2021-2030” has been prepared with the objective of successfully providing solutions to various problems that affect for the proper maintenance of nutritional status of people including the availability of a safe food environment that allows the citizens to consume healthy diets. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to implement the said Nutrition Policy with the vision of optimum nutrition for all Sri Lankans and the strategic framework for implementing the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Agency for Public Private Partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to establish the National Agency for Public Private Partnership under the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies enabling the encouragement of investments by identifying the difficulties and problems faced by investors in investing in Sri Lanka and making proposals to resolve them and identifying public-private partnership projects and taking necessary measures to implement public-private partnership projects under a specific time frame.

description: Establishment of a State - Owned Enterprises Restructuring Unit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - The commercial businesses owned by the Government have not been performing satisfactorily for a long time and some of such businesses are continuously running at a loss owing to different reasons. As this situation has caused a severe pressure on the General Treasury, an alternative mechanism has to be introduced to operate such businesses efficiently and effectively. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to establish the State-Owned Enterprises Restructuring Unit under the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to provide necessary guidance and assist in reforming state-owned enterprises aiming to identifying possible ways to minimize the fiscal burden on the General Treasury and improving the overall performance of those state-owned enterprises.

description: Progress of Mega Scale Development Projects by the end of Second 	Quarter 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - According to the report prepared by the Department of Project Management and Monitoring including cumulative physical progress of the mega scale development projects up to the end of the second quarter 2022, implemented by line ministries and prevailing issues related thereto, 260 mega scale development projects exceeding US $ 1000 million, with a total investment of Rs.5.8 trillion have been carried out. Among them, 125 projects are funded by foreign financing sources and completion of those projects are spread up to the year 2030. Foreign exchange crisis, the country was faced with during the second quarter of the year 2022 and the resultant problems such as import restrictions, shortage of raw materials, fuel crisis, power cuts, price inflation as well as contract management issues related thereto have caused a severe impact on the continuous performance of such development projects. Taking into consideration the information submitted by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, Cabinet decided to appoint an Officials' Committee under the chairmanship of the Prime Minister and comprising of senior officials to obtain the corporation of relevant parties for the smooth functioning of above projects and solve the existing issues expeditiously and achieve expected results.

description: Agreement on Academic Linkage and Collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to sign an Agreement on Academic Linkage and Collaboration between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and the School of Architecture of Tianjin University, China. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the agreement drafted incorporating the observations submitted by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Department of National Budget and the Department of External Resources. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to sign the said agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tripartite Memorandum of Understanding on Collaboration in the field of 	Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-09-05
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding among the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and the Institute for Research & Development in Health and Social Care, Sri Lanka and the University of Keele, United Kingdom, for Collaboration in the field of Education. The proposed tripartite Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has been drafted also including the observations submitted by the Department of External Resources, Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Attorney General and the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Corporation in the field of Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on corporation in the field of tourism between the Ministry of Tourism and Lands of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Heritage and Tourism of the Sultanate of Oman. The clearance of the Attorney general has been received for the draft Agreement for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Lands to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Urea for the Maha Season 2022/23
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Cabinet decision dated 2022‑06‑07, the relevant procurement process has been implemented for the procurement of Urea fertilizer for the Maha Season 2022/23. Although, it was planned to procure 150,000 MT of Urea under the said procurement, the bidder recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has submitted bids for the supply of only 12,500MT of Urea fertilizer. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to award the contract for the purchase of the said stock of urea fertilizer and to re-invite bids to purchase another 125,000 MT of Urea fertilizer expeditiously adopting the Electronic Procurement Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Solar Power Project in the land where Trincomalee Transmission Station of the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation is situated
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑01‑18 has granted approval to utilize the land where the Short Wave Transmission Center of the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation is housed belonging to the Kuchchaveli Divisional Secretariat Division  for a Solar Power Generation Project. Accordingly, project proposals have been invited to select a suitable investor and 07 proposals have been received. The Technical Evaluation Committee appointed to evaluate the said proposals has recommended the 3W Power Management Ltd as the most suitable investor to implement the relevant project.  As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to implement the said project in collaboration with the said investor, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding contracts relating to  the essential civil works and works related to signal works of  the Department of Sri Lanka Railways directly to the State Development and Construction Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - The shortage of labour force essential for the activities of civil construction works and works relating to signal systems of the Department of Sri Lanka Railways has created many issues in the proper maintenance of railway service. As a solution to that, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to award contracts not exceeding Rs 25 million to  the State Development and Construction Corporation comprising of a work force of more than 600 members with good experience in such construction, following the direct procurement process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing uniform materials for school children for the year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - Uniform materials for the year 2023 has to be provided to school children before the end of the term of academic year 2022. As per a request made by the Government of Sri Lanka from the People's Republic of China, it has been agreed to provide a part  of uniform requirement for the year 2023 as a grant. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to purchase the rest of uniform materials from the local textile manufactures required in addition to the grant to be provided by the Government of China and to meet the uniform requirement for the year 2023, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Student Loan Scheme under a concessionary interest basis for teacher trainees in the National Colleges of Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - The National Colleges of Education provide teacher training as two year  institutional training and one year internship for those who have passed the G.C.E A/L examination. The National Colleges of Education will not provide hostel facilities during the internship and trainees have to bear the accommodation and traveling expenses themselves. The sum of Rs 5000 which is currently being paid to a teacher trainee during their institutional training is not adequate. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to take necessary action enabling teacher trainees to obtain a financial provision of maximum of Rs 10,000 per month under a concessionary interest basis through a State bank in addition to the allowance being paid to  them at present, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Bureau of Rehabilitation Bill in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑04‑19 to draft a Bill to establish a Bureau of Rehabilitation in order to carry out treatments, rehabilitation, aftercare and related duties connected thereto for drug dependents, ex-combatants, members of violent extremist groups and any other groups of persons. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the tasks assigned to the State Timber Corporation  Act according 	to the needs of the time
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - The State Timber Corporation has been established by the Gazette Notification dated 1968‑04‑04 under the provisions of the Government Industrial Corporation Act, No.49 of 1957. The need to amend the functions of the said Corporation to cater to the present day requirements has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation to amend the present scope of the State Timber Corporation, to cater to the present day requirements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Carriage by Air Act, No.29 of 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - International civil aviation limits of liability adopted under the Montreal Convention for the International Carriage by Air, was declared by the Gazette Notification dated 2021‑01‑22 and the high limits of liability stated therein, seem to have been appeared a hindrance for the development of the Aviation Industry of Sri Lanka. As such, a committee has been appointed to review the relevant limits of liability of the Carriage by Air Act, No.29 of 2018 so as to be able to consider exemption of the Aviation industry from such limits of liability. The said Committee has recommended that it would be appropriate to introduce amendments to the sections 2, 5 and 8 of the  Carriage by Air Act, No.29 of 2018. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to take necessary action to amend the relevant sections of the said Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding for Cooperation in the Field of 	Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding  between the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries Wealth and Water Resources of the Government of the Sultanate of Oman and the Ministry of Agriculture of Sri Lanka on Cooperation in the Field of Agriculture. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the proposed draft agreement for that purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to sign the relevant Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of the Annual Budget for the year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - The fiscal imbalance caused by decline of Government revenue and escalation of public expenditure in the long run, has turned into a severe economic crisis at present. Amidsts the economic challenges related thereto, the budget for the year 2023 has to be prepared within the medium term budgetary framework, through a more prudent and strategic approach and measures have to be taken to prevent the present economic crisis from being worsened and lay the foundation for future sustainability. Accordingly, based on the Public Finance targets expected to be achieved within the medium term budgetary framework 2023-2025, it is envisaged by the Budget for the year 2023 to accomplish the task of escalating the Government revenue from present 9%  to 11.3% to reduce Government expenditure from present 18.9% to 18.1%, the Primary budget balance from  - 4% to -1% and the budget gap from -9.9% to -6.8% of the GDP. Further, it has been planned to prepare the budget estimates for the year 2023 on Zero-Based Budgeting method. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies pertaining to the preparation of budget estimates for the year 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Information and Cyber Security Policy for Government Organizations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - Although, there is an increased tendancy for the Government Institutions to work on digital systems, the information and information technology systems of such organizations are at a severe risk, owing to the inadequate attention payed on information and cyber security, use of obsolete technologies and the shortage of skilled carder to manage cyber security in the Public Sector. In order to control the said situation, the Sri Lanka Computer Emergency Readiness Team has drafted the Information and Cyber Security Policy for Government Institutions, adhering to the Information and Cyber Security Strategy 2019-2023 and in compliance with the recognized international information security standards.
