description: Employment of an Independent Consultant for the SPMC -Lotus Pharma Project of the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-07
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021 03 08 to establish the SPMC Lotus Pharma Project of the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation, in Millewa, Horana. The Cabinet has granted approval on 2021 10 25 to follow international competitive bidding procedure to select a Consultant/ Consultant Firm to implement that project. Accordingly, bids have been called on international competitive  basis and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended to award the relevant procurement to M/s Meridian Engineers & Consultancy Services, India who is the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to appoint the said firm as the Consultant of the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition of a land to establish a new police station in Nooriya in the Deraniyagala Police Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-07
decision_details_body: - A portion of land called Nooriya Watta at No.110, Dodawatta Grama Niladhari Division in the Deraniyagala Divisional Secretariat Division in Kegalle District, has been identified to establish the Nooriya Police Division. With the establishment of the said police station, it will be able to render an efficient service to the general public in the area while ensuring security by curbing crimes and corruption taking place in the area. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to acquire a land in extent of 02 acres from the Nooriya watta land belonging to the Janatha Estate Development Board under the Ministry of Agriculture, for the establishment of the said police station, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Donation of wheelchairs and other mobility aid to the Rheumatology and Rehabilitation Hospital (RRH), Ragama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-07
decision_details_body: - It has been reported that nearly 1,500 people suffer with spinal injuries per year. The Rheumatology and Rehabilitation Hospital (RRH), Ragama is the national centre where patients in need of such rehabilitation treatment services are referred to. Annually, about 200 wheelchairs, 350 walking aid and 100 prosthetic kits are required for the patients in the said Hospital. A global humanitarian aid organization, Latter Day Saint Charities (LDSC) in the United States of America has agreed to provide a donation of Rs.43.70 million to provide training to the staff of the Hospital and to supply mobility aid comprising 564 wheelchairs, 370 walking aid and 410 prosthetic kits. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to sign an Agreement with the relevant institution to accept the said donation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: BIMSTEC Memorandum of Association (MoA) for the establishment of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) Technology Transfer facility
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-07
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to enter into the Memorandum of Association for the establishment of the BIMSTEC Technology Transfer Facility. As such, the matters submitted by the Foreign Minister that action is being taken by his Ministry to have the said Convention signed by the State Ministry of Skills Development, Vocational Education, Research and Innovation with each member states of the BIMSTEC Organization  during the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economical Co operation (BIMSTEC) summit scheduled to be held on 2022 03 30, were noted by the Cabinet.

description: BIMSTEC Convention on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-07
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to sign the BIMSTEC Convention on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters. As such, the matters submitted by the Foreign Minister that his Ministry has taken necessary action to have the said Convention signed by the Ministry of Justice with each member states of the BIMSTEC Organization  during the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economical Co operation (BIMSTEC) summit scheduled to be held on 2022 03 30, were noted by the Cabinet.

description: Leasing out a land plot belonging to the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, located in the Muthurajawela Industrial Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-07
decision_details_body: - An area of 400 acres belonging to the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, located in the Muthurajawela Industrial Zone has been developed by pumping sea sand. A number of blocks of land out of the said land have been vested with public and private sector investors for the projects of national importance. Emergent Cold (Pvt) Ltd has made a request to allocate a block of land from the said land for cold store facilities and the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka has informed that the said Company has fulfilled the basic qualifications under section 17 of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka Act, to obtain the relevant block of land. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development & Housing to provide a block of land in the extent of 04 Acres 02 Roods that has been identified as appropriate for the proposed project, to the said Company for a period of 30 years on long term lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Economic Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-07
decision_details_body:
- With a view to accelerating the country's economic growth through overall economic management by means of in depth discussions on domestic economic policies including macroeconomic policies, performance of the national economy subsequent to the COVID 19 pandemic situation, restructuring of the economy and the major development projects directly affecting the government's economic and fiscal policies, His Excellency the President has decided to convene the “Economic Council” weekly. It was decided by the Cabinet to grant its concurrence to implement the relevant decisions by the Ministries, Departments and Statutory Institutions as per the said Council's instructions and guidance, on approval of the Cabinet and for the measures intended to be taken by H.E. the President to invite eminent experts in each field for the meetings of the said Economic Council when necessary. As such, the composition of the Economic Council will be as follows:
	
	*	H.E. Gotabaya Rajapaksa, the President (Chairman)
   	*	Hon. Mahinda Rajapaksa, the Prime Minister
	*	Hon. (Dr.) Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Trade
   	*	Hon. Johnston Fernando, Minister of Highways
	*	Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Finance
	*	Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Agriculture
	*	Hon. (Dr.) Ramesh Pathirana, Minister of Plantation
*	Mr. Ajith Nivard Cabral, Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka
*	Mr. Gamini Senarath, Secretary to the President
*	Mr. S.R. Attygalle, Secretary to the Treasury
*	Mr. Dhammika Nanayakkara, Deputy Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka

description: Extension of visa period for the Russian and Ukrainian tourists staying in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-28
decision_details_body: - Currently, 11,463 Russian tourists and 3,993 Ukrainian tourists are staying in the country. Given the political crisis that has been developed between Russia and Ukraine, it has been difficult for them to return to their home countries. Therefore, taking into consideration the prevailing condition, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to extend the visa period of the said tourists for a period of two (02) months free of charge, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of 1.8 million barrels of Gasoline (92 Unl) for a period of eight (08) months from 2022-02-15 to 2022-10-14
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-28
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called from the registered suppliers and the suppliers registered under the provisional category to award the long term contract for importing 1.8 million barrels of Gasoline (92 Unl) for a period of eight (08) months from 2022‑02-15 to 2022‑10‑14. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the said long term contract to M/s. OQ Trading Limited, United Arab Emirates, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of Muriate of Potash (Potassium Chloride) for Paddy Cultivation in the Yala Season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-28
decision_details_body: - Muriate of Potash is a commonly employed Potassium fertilizer and is used by farmers as thicken fertilizer for paddy cultivation. During the Yala season in 2022, farmers expect to cultivate paddy in an area of 600,000 hectares and it has been calculated that 38,500 MT of Muriate of Potash fertilizer will be required for the purpose. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to import the said fertilizer adopting the International Competitive Bidding Procedure and distribute the said fertilizer among farmers under the Government's Subsidized Fertilizer Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Asian Development Bank financed Power System Reliability Strengthening Project - Package 04
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-28
decision_details_body: - Under the Package 04 of the Asian Development Bank financed Power System Reliability Strengthening Project, International Bids have been  invited for Design, Supply and Installation of transmission lines and sections. The Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended to assign the said Contract to the China Machinery Engineering Corporation (CMEC), China. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power to award the relevant Contract, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Methodology of paying the incentive for utilization of Green Agricultural Inputs during Maha Season - 2021/2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-28
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to formulate a suitable methodology in consultation with the General Treasury for the payment of compensation of Rs.25/- per 01kg of paddy with a view to strengthening the income level of farmers who are affected due to the decrease of harvest during the Maha Season 2021/2022. Accordingly, a methodology has been formulated to grant the compensation calculated depending on the relevant criterion to maximum extent of cultivation of 05 acres as an incentive and to provide the same to the small and medium scale farmers as well as the subsistence level small scale farmers. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to implement the said methodology and to provide the funds required for the purpose to the Department of Agrarian Development from the State Ministry of Promoting the Production & Regulating the Supply of Organic Fertilizer, and Paddy & Grains, Organic Foods, Vegetables, Fruits, Chillies, Onion and Potato Cultivation Promoting, Seed Production and Advanced Technology Agriculture, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resumption of Production at Embilipitiya Paper Mill under the Public-Private Partnership Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-28
decision_details_body: - The Embilipitiya Paper Mill, owned by National Paper Company Ltd has been closed since 2012. Even though, approval of the Cabinet has been previously granted to provide the land where the said Factory was located and the buildings thereon to Korean Spa Packaging (Pvt.) Ltd, a local investment company,  for  a period of 30 years, action could not be taken as per the said Cabinet decision since the said land has not been formally handed over to the  National Paper Company Ltd. Arrangements are being made to provide the land in extent of 111 Acres 02 Roods 33 Perches, where the said Factory was located to National Paper Company Ltd on long term lease basis. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to resume the production of the Embilipitiya Paper Mill under the Public-Private Partnership Scheme, after entering into an Agreement with conditions where National Paper Company Ltd and Korean Spa Packaging (Pvt.) Ltd reached a consensus, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Regulations made by the Minister of Youth and Sports  in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-21
decision_details_body: - Anti-Doping Regulations (Prohibited List) No. 07 of 2021 made by the Minister of Youth and Sports under Section 34 (1) of the Convention Against Doping in Sports Act No. 33 of 2013 have been published  in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2022‑01‑18. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth and Sports to submit the said Regulations in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Designing a Court Automation System for Judicial System of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-21
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2020‑02‑05 to implement a project for Design, Supply, Implementation and Maintenance of a Court Automation System for Judicial System of Sri Lanka in collaboration with the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka. Seven (07) bids have been submitted for the proposed project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to award the said procurement to the Joint Venture of Dialog Broadband Networks (Pvt) Limited, Formis Network Services Sdn Bhd and Access International (Pvt) Limited, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Locally Manufactured Pharmaceuticals, Surgical Instruments and Medical Laboratory Consumables
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-21
decision_details_body: - It is the Government policy to promote the production of  all the locally manufactured Pharmaceuticals, Surgical instruments and Medical Laboratory Consumables produced in accordance with the international standards. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to introduce a transparent and efficient mechanism for the procurement of locally manufactured Pharmaceuticals, Surgical instruments and Medical Laboratory Consumables and purchase such items in future, in accordance with the said mechanism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the services of  Youths as “Community Assistants (Voluntary)” at the level of Grama Niladhari Divisions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-21
decision_details_body: - The Community Police Service functioning in the countries such as Japan and Singapore, has been found possible to reduce the rate of minor crimes committed at the community level. Based on the success of such programmes, the Ministry of Public Security together with the State Ministry of Community Police Service and the Sri Lanka Police have taken action to attach two police officers for each Grama Niladhari Division, under the Community Police Service, commencing from May 2021, on full time basis. Accordingly, two young people residing in each Grama Niladhari Division have been planned to attach  as “Community Assistants (Voluntary)”, in order to obtain the required support to have community participation to accomplish the duties of the police officers. Youths over the age of 18 years and permanent residents of  relevant Grama Niladhari Divisions and who have served as prefects in their schools and holding the membership of youth clubs and other volunteer groups can apply for this. They may provide a honorable service whereas they are not entitled to any allowance or any other right. The Sri Lanka Police will issue them a volunteer identity card and after the expiry of 6 months period they will be awarded a service certificate on “Community Leadership”. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the arrangement presented by the Minister of Public Security on the implementation of the proposed programme.

description: Granting a monthly allowance for Athletes and Coaches under the High Performance Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-21
decision_details_body: - Targeting the 2024 and 2028 Olympic Games, the National Sports Council has recommended to implement an encouragement programme so as to grant a financial support to the athletes with special talents who have been selected according to their performance based qualifications, undergoing a long term systematic training, anticipating medals to accomplish their training requirements and also a financial allowance to their coaches.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth and Sports to pay a monthly allowance of Rs.100,000/-  each to the selected athletes in the pool of high talents and Rs.50,000/- each for their coaches, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Market-Oriented Dairy (MOD) Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-21
decision_details_body: - With a view to utilizing the best practices to improve the productivity of the dairy manufacturers and the quality of their products, the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) has agreed to provide financial assistance to implement a Market‑Oriented Dairy (MOD) Project. The said Department has also agreed to provide funds required for this project up to September 2024. It has been planned through the proposed project to continue their capacity building programmes with 38 key stakeholders in the Government and Private Dairy Manufacturing Sector. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the United States Department of Agriculture and the Ministry of Agriculture of Sri Lanka for the implementation of the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Operation of the Weuda Factory owned by the Ceylon Ceramics Corporation through a private investor
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-21
decision_details_body: - Manufacturing activities of the Weuda Tile Factory belonging to the Ceylon Ceramics Corporation, located in Mawathagama in Kurunegala district, have been suspended in the year 2010 due to the issue of securing raw materials. The Sri Lanka Navy has thereafter used this factory to manufacture bricks required for the Sandahiru Seya in Anuradhapura and the said activities have also been suspended since the year 2017. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to call for Expressions of Interest (EoI) from the investors showing an interest to start and maintain a clay related industry in the Weuda factory in the extent of 09 Acres 01 Rood and 31 Perches and provide the same on lease basis to an investor who confirms a higher viability, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Sushma Swaraj Institute of Foreign Service (SSIFS), India and the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute (BIDTI), Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-21
decision_details_body: - In view of improving co‑operation and exchange of training, it has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute (BIDTI), Sri Lanka and the Sushma Swaraj Institute of Foreign Service (SSIFS), India. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the proposed draft MoU. As such, the proposal made by the Foreign Minister to sign the respective MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for construction of a 652 roomed luxury city hotel in Colombo 03
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-21
decision_details_body: - Piyestra Furniture (Pvt.) Ltd. and D R Industries (Pvt.) Ltd. in collaboration with D R Home Appliances (Pvt.) Ltd. belonging to Damro Group of Companies have planned to construct a luxury city hotel with 652 rooms in Colombo 03 with an investment of US$ 70.4 million. The said project has been identified as a Strategic Development Project (SDP) under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No.14 of 2008 and the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka has given its approval to grant the relevant concessions under the said Act. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Economic Policies & Plan Implementation to commence the due process stipulated under the Strategic Development Projects Act to consider the proposed project as a Strategic Development project and publish the Gazette Notification under section 3(2) of the Strategic Development Projects Act, No.14 of 2008 specifying the exemptions/concessions to be granted to Strategic Development Projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Offering Scholarships to the Cadet Officers of the Republic of Seychelles in the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-21
decision_details_body: - The General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University has expanded its services rendered for foreign students and scholarships have already been offered to the Cadet Officers belonging to the Tri‑Forces in several countries. The High Commissioner of the Republic of Seychelles has informed the Foreign Ministry that the Republic is interested in enrolling in the said Scholarships Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to have two Cadet Officers belonging to the Tri‑Forces of the Republic of Seychelles enrolled in the Scholarships Programme of the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: False Propaganda on Subjecting the Employees' Provident Fund and the Employees' Trust Fund to a Surcharge Tax
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body: - Cabinet was apprised by the Minister of Finance that the proposal brought forward by him through the Budget for the year 2022 regarding subjecting the individuals and Companies whose net profit exceeds 2,000 million pertaining to the year 2021, to a Surcharge Tax of 25%, does not involve the Employees' Provident Fund and the Employees' Trust Fund. As such, the Minister of Finance further informed the Cabinet that there is no solid basis for the objections raised by certain parties in this regard.

description: Importation of Essential Food Items and the Raw Materials and Industrial Goods required for Export oriented Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body:
- Cabinet noted the necessity of identifying the alternative methods of importing essential food items and the raw materials and industrial goods required for export oriented industries, when the Cabinet Memorandum on “Economy 2022 and the way forward” submitted by the Minister of Finance was taken up for the discussion at the meeting held on 2022‑01‑03. Accordingly, it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet for the measures taken by H.E. the President to appoint the following Cabinet Sub‑Committees to deliberate with countries from which such Goods are imported to the country: 

(i)	to deliberate with the Government of People's Republic of China:

*	Hon. Foreign Minister - Chairman
*	Hon. Minister of Trade
*	Hon. Minister of Industries
*	Hon. Minister of Plantation

(ii)	to deliberate with the Government of Japan :
*	Hon. Foreign Minister - Chairman
*	Hon. Minister of Health
*	Hon. Minister of Mass Media
*	Hon. Minister of Highways

	(iii)	to deliberate with the Middle Eastern States :

*	Hon. Foreign Minister - Chairman
*	Hon. Minister of Youth & Sports and Minister of Development Coordination and Monitoring
*	Minister of Justice

description: Formalizing the supply of Essential Consumer Goods to the market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body:
- It was decided by the Cabinet to grant its concurrence for the measures taken by H.E. the President to appoint a Committee comprising the following members, to submit policy recommendations and solutions required for ensuring the supply of essential Consumer Goods to the market without shortage:

*   	Hon. Minister of Finance - Chairman
*	Hon. Minister of Trade
*	Hon. Minister of Agriculture
*	Hon. Minister of Ports & Shipping
*	Hon. State Minister of Co-operative Services, Marketing Development and Consumer Protection 
*	Hon. State Minister of Ornamental Fish, Inland Fish  & Prawn Farming, Fishery Harbour Development, Multiday Fishing Activities and Fish Exports 
*	Hon. State Minister of Livestock, Farm Promotion and Dairy & Egg Related Industries.

description: Procurement for the Supply of Face mask Surgical Tie-on Type
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body: - International Competitive bids have been invited for procurement of 89 million of Face mask Surgical Tie-on Type. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the relevant procurement to M/s Sisili Projects Consortium (Pvt.) Ltd., primarily the lowest substantially responsive bidder, as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) and procure 30 million of Face masks initially as recommended by the Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of a Point of Sales System (POS) at the Sales Outlets of Multi-Purpose Co-operative Societies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited for procurement of a Point of Sales System (POS) at the Sales Outlets of Multi‑Purpose Co‑operative Societies and 05 bids have been received for the purpose. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to award the said procurement to Ewis Solutions (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Integrating non-motorized modes of transport with the transport system of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The present active vehicle fleet of Sri Lanka is over 05 million, showing a three-fold increase than the year 2000. It is observed that this is due to the increase in the import of private vehicles particularly Three Wheeler, Motor Bikes and Motor Cars. Further, it appears that there is a great tendency for the use of private vehicles due to the increase of income level and the difficulties encountered when using the existing public transport service and the rapid increase of the use of private vehicles has resulted in decrease of the use of non motorized modes of transport. The use of non-motorized modes of transport will cause a positive impact on minimizing air pollution, the physical health, air quality, environment, climate change and personnel finance. Therefore, it has been identified that integrating the non-motorized modes with the existing transport system would be appropriate  to accrue the economical and environmental benefits.  Accordingly, the Cabinet having taken into consideration the matters submitted by the Minister of Environment, granted its concurrence for the relevant Ministries and Institutes to take the following action  under an integrated approach:

    • Marking bicycle lanes for existing roads in an appropriate manner and upgrading of the existing walking paths.

    • Inclusion of bicycle lanes and walking paths for roads to be constructed in future

    • Taking necessary action to promote the use of bicycles among the government officers; and

    • Providing necessary facilities including bicycle parking facility and accessibility for the bicycle users in the offices.

description: Preparing a Road Map and a Strategic Plan to make Sri Lanka a Carbon Net Zero Country in 2050
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body: - For a country to become a net zero in carbon, it must essentially reduce the  greenhouse gases emitted to the atmosphere and the ecosystems that absorb the carbon should be developed. It has been found the necessity of preparing a Road Map and  a Strategic Plan to convert Sri Lanka a Carbon Net Zero Country by 2050. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to prepare a Road Map and five year Strategic Plan where the progress is reviewed once in five years and amendments are made and to appoint a Committee comprising of experts with expertise in the field, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening Sri Lanka Climate Fund (Private) Limited functioning under purview of the Ministry of Environment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body: - It has been reported through the Nationally Determined Contributions submitted to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change that the Government of Sri Lanka had taken a policy decision to convert Sri Lank a Carbon Net Zero Country by 2050.  Sri Lanka Climate Fund (Private) Limited functioning under purview of the Ministry of Environment  has been established to contribute the tasks of minimizing the greenhouse gas emission. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to take necessary action to structurally strengthen the duties and functions of the said Institute to meet the present-day needs enabling to obtain the maximum contribution to convert Sri Lanka  a Carbon Net Zero Country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Green Sri Lanka- “One Person-One Plant” National Programme - 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body:
- A provision of Rs.2000/- million has been allocated under budget proposals - 2022, to implement a suitable programme to increase the forest cover up to 30% by 2025 while preserving the existing forests in Sri Lanka and to increase the forestation through beneficial plants having removed invasive plants while  protecting water catchment areas. Accordingly, the Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Conservation has taken measures to implement a National Programme  on “One Person-One Plant”. Under the said programme, it is expected to implement following projects.

* 	Establishment of 200 forest villages

* Implementation of Tree Plantation Programms in Schools and National   Educational Institutes in Sri Lanka.

* 	Establishment of Island Wide Herbal Gardens

* 	Implementation of Tree Plantation Programms in Religious Places.

* 	Implementation of Tree Plantation Programms in watersheds of reservoirs, irrigation reserves and catchment areas.

* Implementation of Tree Plantation Programms in the lands owned by Government Institutions, Semi-Government Institutions, Corporations, Boards and Statuary Boards.

*	Implementation of Tree Plantation Programms in the lands owned by Plantation Companies and privately owned lands.

*	Establishment of Island wide Nurseries.

*	Implementation of a series of publicity campaigns to educate school children and the Community on the Wildlife and Forest Conservation.

* 	Identification of suitable plant species for forestation and implementation of a research programme to carry out development programmes together with the Universities.

	It is expected to implement these projects under the guidance of the District Sectaries and Divisional Secretaries. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence to implement the said programme as per the proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Conservation.

description: Providing a wheat flour subsidy for Estate Workers' Families
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2022‑01‑18 has granted approval to the proposals in the memorandum submitted by the Minister of Finance on “To notify the Cabinet of Ministers on implementation of Key proposals to mitigate the impact of the economic difficulties encountered by the people”. Among those proposals, the proposal on the provision of a wheat flour subsidy for Estate Worker's Families was considered by a Committee headed by the Minister of Trade and submitted recommendations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to provide 15 kg of wheat flour per month for 115,867 beneficiary families identified as per the recommendation of the said committee, under concessionary prices, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Mini Super Market Chain (Home Shop) for Women Entrepreneurs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body: - A provision of Rs.15,000 million has been allocated under the budget 2022 for the programme for the Establishment of  a Mini Super Market Chain (Home Shop) for Women Entrepreneurs with the objective of “creating a woman entrepreneur in every village” by offering entrepreneurial guidance and assisting them in finding seed capital, having identified women entrepreneurs in rural family units who are interested in entrepreneurship. The identification of the relevant entrepreneurs is done by the Divisional Secretaries under the guidance of the Divisional Development Committee on the instructions of the Presidential Task Force on Poverty Alleviation. The selected woman entrepreneur will be able to set aside some space for this purpose, under one of the following methods,  either by allocating 200-400 square feet from a part of her home or renovating the house or by getting newly constructed by the Urban Development Authority or the National Housing Development Authority. Relevant Mini Super Markets are to be connected through a computer network and equipment and furniture needed for those shops will be provided by the Government. Plans have been made to supply consumer items for sale to women entrepreneurs through cooperative societies. Relevant beneficiaries will be able to purchase essential commodities including locally produced food items amounting to Rs.2000/- under the proposed Relief Basket Programme through a digital card given for low income earning families selected on special criteria. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to take necessary action to implement the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Home Economy Security (Relief Basket) Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body: - Provisions have been allocated to implement an Extensive Home Economy Security National Programme, through the National Budget proposals 2022.  Home Economy Security (Relief Basket) Programme has been identified as one amongst them. Under the said programme, 40 low income earning families are selected on the recommendation of the Divisional Secretary, based on special criteria, from each Grama Niladhari Division in order to ease the pressure of the hike of cost of living and such beneficiaries are issued a digital card worth of Rs 2000/- enabling to purchase goods thereby paving the way to purchase locally produced essential items and other consumer items, using that digital card, through mini super markets which are established under the Home Economy Security National Programme and operated by women entrepreneurs and. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to take necessary action to implement the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Agreement on Research Collaboration between the University of Sri Jayewardenepura and the Texas A & M University of the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-14
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Material Transfer Agreement between the University of Sri Jayewardenepura and the Texas A & M University of the United States of America in order to implement a Research Project for studying on the relationship between clinical characteristics and bio-chemical profile of Autism. Objectives of this Agreement are Confirmation of the relationship between the clinical phonotypes of Autism and metabolic profile in urine and blood and establishment of collaborations that targets the specific requirements and objectives of each party. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the proposed Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Adaption of the Cabinet decision relating to the removal of salary anomalies of Teachers' and Principals' services also to the Pirivena Teachers, Government Approved Private School Teachers and the Teachers of Government Approved Assisted Special Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Education to adapt the provisions in the Public Administration Circular No.03/2016(IV) issued in terms of the cabinet decision taken with regard to the removal of salary anomalies of Teachers' and Principals' services also to the Pirivena Teachers, Government Approved Private School Teachers and the Teachers of Government Approved Assisted Special Schools.

description: Introduction of a New Arbitration Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-07
decision_details_body: - Commercial Law Reforms Sub-Committee appointed under the Special Unit of the Ministry of Justice has found the need to study on the matters related to the field of arbitration in Sri Lanka and introduce a new Act for arbitration. The said Sub‑Committee has further recommended the necessity of imposing provisions by the proposed Act so as to resolve the current impediments both at the stage of arbitration and at the stage of the enforcement of arbitration decisions, enabling to encourage large scale local and foreign investments, in Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft an Arbitration Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Investment Disputes High Court Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Minister of Justice has instructed the Commercial Law Reforms Sub‑Committee appointed under the Special Unit of the Ministry of Justice to submit recommendations on the legal reforms to be made to create a legal environment in Sri Lanka which is conducive to investment. Accordingly, the said committee has proposed to establish an Investment Disputes High Court with a judicial power to hear and give verdicts relating to the cases of 'disputes' within the financial limits of Rs.50 million which may arise from an initial investment of Rs.100 million or more. Therefore. the the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a bill for the purpose, incorporating relevant provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Organic Fertilizer Manufacturing Yard for the Mahaweli Knuckles Organic Agriculture Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-07
decision_details_body: - Moragahakanda, Kalu Gaga Mahaweli “F” Zone has been declared as a sustainable development zone where the organic agricultural products are produced, through a Gazette Extraordinary Notification as per the provisions of the Mahaweli Authority Act. It is expected to increase the income of farmer community through the production of agricultural crops using non-toxic organic inputs and to achieve the targets of national organic agricultural crops products with the contribution of the farmers with the high knowledge on organic farming.  It has been planned to construct 02 Organic Fertilizer Manufacturing Yards equipped with the necessary laboratory facilities in Wallawaya and Guruwela Mahweli Zones with a view to manufacturing organic fertilizer required for long term crop cultivation within the same zones. As the first phase of the same, the Wallawaya Organic Fertilizer Manufacturing Yard has been planed to be established  and it has been predicted that 2000 MT of fertilizer could be produced from the said yard annually. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation to award the contract for the construction of the said Organic Fertilizer Yard to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau as a direct contract, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Sri Lanka Unique Digital Identity (SL-UDI) Framework
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Government has decided to implement the task of establishing the  Sri Lanka Unique Digital Identity (SL-UDI) Framework prioritizing as a national level programme. Under the said proposed Digital Identity Framework, it is expected to introduce an irrefutable foundation/physical identity instrument based on biometrics, digital credential enabling the representation of persons within the Cyber space and the unique identification within Digital, Physical and hybrid environments by tight coupling of the said two devices. It has been agreed during the bilateral discussions held between the Hon. Prime Minister of India and H.E. the President of Sri Lanka in December, 2019 to provide a grant of the Indian Government for the implementation of the Sri Lanka Unique Digital Identity. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to make the relevant arrangements to sign an MoU for obtaining the said grant and to implement the proposed project under the said grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Agreements for the implementation of a Research Project between the La Jolla Institute, USA and General Sir john Kotelawala Defence University (KDU)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-02-07
decision_details_body: - An education collaboration is maintained  between  the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University (KDU) and La Jolla Institute, USA for the Allergy and Immunology, from 2017 and accordingly, funds amounting to US$ 505,840 have been received to the General Sir john Kotelawala Defence University (KDU) for implementing research projects. Both parties have reached a consensus to develop the existing education collaboration further with a view to promoting research tasks for early detection, understanding and reduction of Tuberculosis and exchanging of students and staff. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to sign a Sub-award Agreement and Material Transfer Agreement pertaining to the implementation of the relevant Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rural Development Programme of “Gama Samaga Pilisandarak (Dialogue with the Village) - Hundred Thousand Works through the Budget”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body: - According to a proposal made by the Budget - 2022 with a view to strengthening the production economy, it has been planned to implement the Rural Development Programme “Gama Samaga Pilisandarak (Dialogue with the Village) - Hundred Thousand Works through the Budget” covering 14,021 Grama Niladhari Divisions in 336 Divisional Secretariat Divisions countrywide.  Under this programme, the projects identification process has been entirely decentralized so as to identify the public requirements by the public itself. Accordingly, the Cabinet noted the matters furnished by the Minister of Finance informing that arrangements have been made to commence the planned programme on 03rd February 2022.

description: Purchase of 40,000 MT of Gas Oil from M/s Indian Oil Company Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Energy has negotiated with M/s Indian Oil Company Ltd. pertaining to the supply of 40,000 MT of Gas Oil and  40,000 MT of Gasoline from the said Company. As such, the said Company has agreed to supply 40,000MT of Gas Oil. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to pursue action to purchase the said stock of Gas Oil, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No. 15 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑05‑31 has granted approval to amend section 442 and 443 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act to make provisions for the issuance of one certified copy of a judgment or final order of the record, free of charge to the Complainant or every Accused of the respective case. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the draft Bill prepared accordingly the by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Surcharge Tax Bill to Parliament for Approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed through the Budget - 2022 to impose one-time Surcharge Tax of 25% on persons or companies with taxable income over Rs. 2,000 million for the  assessment year 2020/2021. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the Surcharge Tax Bill prepared accordingly by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of Crude Oil for the Sapugaskanda Oil Refinery
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body: - Required measures have already been taken to supply crude oil required for the Sapugaskanda Oil Refinery until the month of July 2022, and measures have to be taken for the supply Crude Oil required for the subsequent period. The Terra Navis Group of Cyprus has called an unsolicited proposal for the supply of crude oil for the Sapugaskanda Refinery. The said proposal submitted for the supply of crude oil on 180 days extended credit basis has been evaluated by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and further, a recommendation has been made to obtain a shipment of 450,000Bbls initially. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy for the supply of crude oil as recommended by the said committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contracts under the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body: - The Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme has been scheduled as 21 contract packages in order to implement the said programme more efficiently and expeditiously. Out of 21 packages construction work of 06 packages have already been completed and the construction work of remaining 06 packages are being carried out. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation to award the contracts relating to the remaining 09 contract packages to the contractors selected through the international competitive bidding procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Replacement of two Generator Stators at Samanalawewa Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body: - The Samanalawewa Power Station is in commercial operation since 1992 with an installed capacity of 120 MW and with an annual electricity generation around 276GWh. This power station plays a significant role in catering to the electricity demand in peak hours and maintaining the network voltage in the southern province. The power station is operating with two generators with a life span of 25-30 years. Therefore, the life span of the said generators are nearing at their end and they have to be repaired soon. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power to follow the formal procurement procedure for the purchase of two Generator Stators from the GEC Large Machines Ltd, of United Kingdom, which is the original equipment manufactures of those generators, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Delkanda Luxury Apartment Project with 70 housing units
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement a luxury apartment project with 70 housing units in a land in extent of 100 perches,located at Delkanda  belonging to the Ocean View Development (Pvt) Ltd., which is coming under the State Ministry of Rural Housing and Construction & Building Materials Industries Promotion. This project will be implemented with the investors under the pre-sale method without causing any burden to the Government.  Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing, to implement the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Mobile Service and Reconciliation Programme conducted by the Ministry of Justice
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Justice has scheduled to conduct 04 Mobile Service and Reconciliation Programmes within this year, aiming Jaffna and Kilinochchi districts in the Northern Province, Batticaloa district in the Eastern Province, Matara district in the Southern Province and Nuwara Eliya district in the Central Province. The objectives of these Programmes are to provide assistance to resolve lands, official documents and legal matters related issues and to make the general public and field officers aware of the services offered by the Ministry of Justice and the institutions under the purview of the Ministry. Its first programme has been conducted in Jaffna and Kilinochchi districts in the Northern Province from 2022‑01‑26 to 2022‑01‑30. As such, the above matters submitted by the Minister of Justice regarding the said Mobile Programme, were noted by the Cabinet.

description: Present situation of the MV X-Press Pearl Maritime Disaster
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31

description: Pilot Project on Green Hydrogen Generation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body: - The Government has taken a policy decision to reach carbon neutrality by the year 2050. In view of meeting the said objective, the necessity has been identified to change energy supply value chains and to shift from fossil fuel to cleaner energy production and consumption gradually. As such, action should be taken to reduce air emissions in power and transport sectors as well as in thermal used industries. Within these circumstances, Greenstat Hydrogen India Pvt. Ltd., a subsidiary of Greenstat AS of Norway, has agreed to conduct a feasibility study on a Pilot Project to generate Green Hydrogen using a combination of floating solar and wind. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to enter into an agreement between the Sri Lanka Petroleum Development Authority and Greenstat Hydrogen India (Pvt.) Ltd. to conduct the said feasibility study, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Traditional & Rural Industry Promotion Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-31
decision_details_body:
- With a view to developing traditional cottage industries such as Rattan, Pottery, Brass, Lacquer, masks, coconut shell, jewellery, stone carvings, flax fibre and Dumbara patterns, Rs.1,000 million and Rs.150 million have been allocated through the Budget Proposals‑2022 and the Budget Estimates in the year 2021 respectively, to the State Ministry of Rattan, Brass, Pottery, Furniture and Rural Industrial Promotion. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to continue the following projects that had been inaugurated in the year 2021 and are being implemented under the State Ministry of Rattan, Brass, Pottery, Furniture and Rural Industrial Promotion, in the year 2022 as well by utilizing the said provisions, was approved by the Cabinet: 
	
*	Cultivation Project of raw materials required for Rural Industries
	*	Establishment of the National Raw Material Bank Project
	*	Making One Entrepreneur for One Village Project 
*	Establishing a Timber related Design and Process Innovation Centre Project
*	Promotional Programme of Local and Foreign Markets for Rural Industries
*	Integrated Development Programme of Rural & Traditional Industrial Villages
*	National Blacksmithing Industry Development Programme

description: Entering into Agreements on the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24

description: Amendment to the Drug Dependent Persons (Treatment and Rehabilitation) Act, No. 54 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24
decision_details_body: - The Drug Dependent Persons (Treatment and Rehabilitation) Act, No. 54 of 2007 includes the provisions pertaining to the treatment and rehabilitation of drug dependent persons. It has been identified that the provisions containing in the said Act need to be amended to meet the present day requirements. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and the Minister of Justice to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a draft Bill for the same, was approved  by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of locally produced Sterile Liquid Small Volume Parenterals - SLSVP - Injectables for the State sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24
decision_details_body: - Government spends approximately Rs. 3,000 million (around US$ 15 million) annually for the purchase of  Sterile Liquid Small Volume Parenterals - SLSVP - Injectables. Approval has been granted by the Government for M/s Kelun Lifesciences (Pvt) Ltd to establish an industry in Pallekale area with the capacity of producing 50 million of the said  Sterile Liquid annually. The so called company, the only company possessing the capacity of producing Sterile Liquid Small Volume Parenterals within the Country with the relevant standards is ready to supply its productions from  February 2022. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to enter into an Agreement between the aforesaid Company and the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation of Sri Lanka (SPMC) to secure the said productions for the necessities of the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Paddy Purchasing Programme in the Maha Season 2021/2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24

description: National Project for setting up industrial Zones at District and Divisional Level and providing investment opportunities to new entrepreneurs for business development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to accelerate the local industrialization process regionalizing the programme for the establishing industries which is being implemented through the Budget 2022 thereby establishing industries at divisional and district level. Accordingly, a programme has been planned by the Ministry of Industries and it is expected to establish two types of industries at District and Divisional Secretariat Divisions, under the said programme. It is proposed to establish small scale Industrial estates with 15-35 industries at a land in extent of 5-15 acres and Industrial estates with 35-50 industries at a land in extent of 15-25 acres. A National Committee and a District Operating Committee will be appointed to implement and monitor the said projects in collaboration with the Ministry of Industries. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to implement the proposed programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Healthcare Quality and Safety
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2015‑05‑27 for the existing 'National Policy on Healthcare Quality and Patient Safety'. However, based on the Resolution on 'Global action on patient safety' which was confirmed at the 72nd World Health Assembly held in the year 2019, the  said policy was amended. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to implement the said policy which  assures the quality and safety of the healthcare system, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Organs, Tissues and Cell Transplantation of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24
decision_details_body: - Organ, Tissue and Cell Transplantation is considered as a successful treatment practice to safe guard the lives of the patients with end stage internal organ failures including kidney, liver, heart, lungs and pancreas transplantation. At present, organ transplantation surgeries are done in 09 government hospitals including the two main national centres in Colombo and Kandy. It has been found the necessity of having a national policy on organ transplantation in order to improve the living conditions of the donors, their family members as well as the donor recipients and to preserve their rights. Accordingly, the National Policy on Organs, Tissues and Cell Transplantation of Sri Lanka has been formulated based on the 57th Resolution of the World Health Assembly and the Guiding Principles on Human Organ Transplantation of the world Health Organization. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to implement the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of the Health Institutions in the Estate Sector to the Provincial Health Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24
decision_details_body: - With a view to providing a more productive health service to the estate sector community, it has been found appropriate to transfer the health institutions in the estate sector to the Provincial Health Authorities. Accordingly, an Officials Committee has been appointed to submit recommendations on the measures to be taken in that regard, under the chairmanship of the Director General of Health Services and comprising of the representatives of other relevant institutions. As per the recommendation made by the said committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, to transfer 59 health institutions from among the 450 institutions located in the estate sector to the Provincial Health Authorities, as its firs phase, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a High-Rise Development Project in the land belonging to the Urban Development Authority at Cotta Road, Rajagiriya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24
decision_details_body: - Investment proposals have been invited on competitive basis for the land in extent of 01 acre 01 roods and 9.29 perches, at Cotta road, Rajagiriya which has been transferred to the Urban Development Authority, under Design, Build, Finance, Own Operate and Transfer basis. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing for granting the said land to LOLC Investment Holdings Two (Pvt.)Ltd., which is a subsidiary company of the LOLC Holdings PLC., on long term lease basis, to utilize the said land for implementation of a High-Rise Development Project, based on the recommendation made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiating  Committee of the State Ministry of Urban Development, Waste Disposal and Community Cleanliness and the Board of Management of the Urban Development Authority  to implement.

description: Increasing the grant of 'Obata Geyak - Ratata Hetak' Housing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24
decision_details_body: - This project which is being implemented for low income earning families residing in temporary houses, provides a financial assistance subject to a maximum of Rs.600,000/- per each selected beneficiary family depending on the progress of the construction of the house. This project was started in 2020, and with the considerable increase of the prices of construction materials, it has found difficult to construct a complete house as expected with the grant of Rs.600,000/-. Therefore, the proposal  made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing, to increase the grant provided under the said programe for selected beneficiary families up to Rs.650,000/- from 2022 onwards, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the New Bus Stand in Akuressa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-24
decision_details_body: - The Akuressa Urban Development Project has been commenced in the year 2012 and as its first phase, 4.5 acres of land has been developed and preliminary work has been done for the construction of the main bus stand and for commercial developments. Approval has been received to construct the main bus stand with 20 terminals and other facilities in an area of 1.75 acres, as its second phase. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to implement the said project during 2022-2023 at an estimated cost of Rs.474 million according to the final architectural and engineering plans of the project.

description: Amendments to the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2020‑10‑12 to amend the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003 to suit to the present day requirements. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman and therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to publish the said bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, to present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Workmen's Compensation Ordinance (Chapter 139) No.19 of 1934
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to draft a Bill to amend the Workmen's Compensation Ordinance (Chapter 	139) No.19 of 1934 to update the amount of compensation paid to workmen injured in accidents while on duty to suit to the present day requirements. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman and therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to publish the said bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, to present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 04 new flyovers under the Framework Agreement for Financial Cooperation between the Governments of Hungary and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - An Agreement for Financial Cooperation has been entered into between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Hungary in order to make concessional financing through the Hungarian EXIM Bank to implement the infrastructure development projects in Sri Lanka. Under the said agreement, construction activities of Kohuwala and Getambe flyovers are being carried out at present. In addition to the ongoing projects, the Road Development Authority has identified the necessity to carry out projects to grant solutions for the traffic congestion mostly experienced at Muttettugala Railway Crossing and Hiripitiya Junction, Pasyala Junction, Mari Stella Junction, Negambo and Thalawathugoda junction of the national road network. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Highways to construct 04 flyovers at the said junctions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the duration of the Finance Programme implemented under the Smallholder Tea and Rubber Revitalization (STaRR)Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - A Rural Finance Programme was implemented during the period from 2019‑2021 for the purpose of income generation of target beneficiaries and for the market diversification affairs under the Smallholder Tea and Rubber Revitalization Project which is implemented under the financial assistance of the International Fund for Agriculture Development (IFAD). However, anticipated objectives of the said project have not been accomplished due to the Covid-19 pandemic and therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation to extend the duration of the said loan programme up to 31st December 2022, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting a plot of land to the Macksons Bathware (Pvt)Ltd from the Raigama Green Industrial Estate of the Millaniya Divisional Secretariat Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑06‑07 to implement the special programme of granting investment opportunities to establish industries island wide and to develop businesses in Divisional Secretariat Divisions level. The Macksons Bathware (Pvt.) Ltd., a leading company with 50 years of experience in the field of tile manufacturing has submitted a project proposal to obtain a plot of land to establish an industry of tiles, bathroom sets and sanitary ware manufacturing with an investment of approximately Rs.6,000 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to allocate 20 acres of undeveloped land located adjacent to the New Chattel Estate belonging to the Land Reforms Commission, which is presently being developed to establish an Industrial and Technological High Zone (Raigama Green Industrial Estate) of the  Millaniya Divisional Secretariat Divison of Kalutara district, on 35 years of long term lease basis, to the Macksons Bathware (Pvt.) Ltd., for the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conferring of the land enjoyed by the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation in the Kuchchaveli, Trincomalee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - The “German Voice” short and medium wave transmission centre was established and maintained in Kuchchaveli of Trincomalee in terms of an agreement signed between the Deutsche Welle, the broadcasting service of the German Republic and the Government of Sri Lanka, in 1980. In 2012, the activities of that transmission centre and its possession have been entrusted with the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation and 90% of the said premises is used for the activities of that transmission centre. It is also possible to utilize the said premise for generating solar power, without causing any hindrance to the functioning of the transmission centre. Therefore, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to confer the said land to the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation, enabling to implement a solar power generation project as a source of income earning of the said Corporation.

description: Obtaining the legitimate possession of the land where Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation is located to the Corporation itself
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation operates on a land in extent of 3.37 hectares located at Torrington Square, Colombo and its  legitimate possession has not yet been vested with that Corporation. All the parties including the Urban Development Authority have agreed to vest the said land to the  Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to vest the relevant land  to the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation by a free grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the University of Ruhuna and the Northumbria University, England for Strengthening Academic Collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into an MoU between the University of Ruhuna and the Northumbria University, England for strengthening academic collaboration. This MoU will cover the areas such as exchanging of expertise ideas, obtaining the support of specific subject stream interactions and providing pre-admission to the programmes of  Northumbria University for qualified students from the University of Ruhuna. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the relevant MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Selling Housing Units of 'Metro Homes Residencies'  Housing Project, Slave Island, Colombo 02, on freehold basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - Constructions of residential and commercial units  for the original occupants of the block of land identified under the first phase of the Slave Island Redevelopment Project implemented by the Urban Development Authority have now been completed. A building complex comprising of 626 residential units with three towers  and 115 commercial units have been constructed under that and it has been named as ''Metro Homes Residencie''. Approval of the Board of Management of the Urban Development Authority has been received to sell the rest of 78 units at the valuation of the Chief Government Valuer on the priority basis based on the the current market value after the settlement of the original occupants of the relevant units. Accordingly, the proposal made by the  Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to provide Freehold Deeds to the buyers who have paid due value from among the selected applicants, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of the State land named 'Solaikadu' located in Vavuniya District to the National Housing Development Authority for a Public Servants Housing Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - A Public Servants Housing Project has been implemented on the land in extent of 92.92 hectares (234 acres 02 rood 10 perches) in the Omanthai Grama Niladhari Division of the Divisional Secretariat Division of Vavuniya. Under the said project, 711 land blocks of the said land have been provided to the beneficiaries identified on the recommendation of the Divisional Secretary and out of which the National Housing Development Authority has granted loans of Rs.500,000/- each to 250 families for the construction of houses. Although nearly 09 years have passed since the implementation of the project, the relevant beneficiaries have not yet been issued deeds for the said plots of land. Therefore, the proposal made by the  Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to vest the said land to the National Housing Development Authority so as to provide the relevant beneficiaries with  the Deeds of Freehold, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transferring of a block of land located at Mudun Ela, Kelaniya owned by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation to the Ceylon Electricity Board for the construction of an Electrical Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - A request has been made by the Ceylon Electricity Board and Lanka Electricity Company from the Urban Development Authority to grant a block of land in the Kelaniya area to construct a new Electrical Substation to strengthen the electrical transmission system of Kelaniya and Peliyagoda areas.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to vest a portion of 02 roods 26.5 perches of the land acquired by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation for the Mudun Ela Development Project, to the Ceylon Electricity Board on the valuation of the Chief Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transferring the land located at Ekala, Ja-Ela belonging to the Urban Development Authority for implementing a logistics and a related development project, on long term lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-18
decision_details_body: - Proposals have been invited from the private sector investors on competitive basis for implementing a logistics and a related development project on a land in extent of 36 acres 01 rood and 27.6 perches  located at Ekala, Ja Ela belonging to the Urban Development Authority, on the basis of Design, Build, Finance, Own Operate and Transfer. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to transfer the relevant land to M/s Access Logistics Park Ekala (Pvt.) Ltd. which has been selected after evaluating technical and financial proposals submitted accordingly, on long term lease basis on the valuation of the Chief Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Animal Welfare Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2020‑10‑19 has granted approval to finalize the drafting of the Animal Welfare Bill expeditiously. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of local organic fertilizer for paddy cultivation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to commence the fertilizer procurement process for the provision of local organic fertilizer to the farmers for the Yala season 2022 and to purchase  eco‑friendly local fertilizer provided by the local manufactures for the Yala Season - 2022 as per the prescribed standards, by the two government fertilizer companies utilizing the provisions allocated under the fertilizer subsidy programme for the year 2022, taking into account the eco‑friendly fertilizer recommendations made by the Director General of Agriculture for the paddy cultivation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of Rice required to provide at a reasonable price
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Trade to import 200,000 MT of Nadu rice and 100,000 of GR 11 Short Grain Rice as substitute for samba to ensure that there are sufficient stocks of rice in the open market, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquiring the land belonging to the Department of Sri Lanka Railways where the Haputhale Police Station is Located to the Sri lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - Haputhale Police Station has been established since 1928 on a land in extent of 01 acre 01 rood  and 9.8 perches located in a railway reserve belonging to the Sri Lanka Railway.  Since the said land where the police station is located has not yet been formally vested with the Sri Lanka Police, it has been unable to construct new buildings required for the Police or to carry out renovations spending money. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to vest the said block of land with the Sri Lanka Police, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Industry Support Scheme for Global Promotions by Local Destination Management Companies, Hoteliers and Online Travel Agents
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion Bureau has made arrangements to implement an industry support scheme for global promotions made by  local destination management companies, hoteliers and online travel agents under the post COVID - 19 situation. It is expected to provide the said relief for the institutions qualified under the above programme for a maximum period of 06 months, in the year 2022. The Board of Management of the  Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion Bureau has granted approval to allocate Rs. 400 million for the proposed programme under its funds. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to implement the proposed industry support scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Weli Oya Sugar Factory attached to Lanka 	Sugar Company (Pvt.) Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - Annual requirement of Sugar in the Country is around 600,000 MT.  Approximately 85% out of the same is imported spending about Rs. 45 billion annually. Local sugar production in the year 2020 was 54,000 MT and necessary arrangements have been made to increase that quantity further. Accordingly, it has been proposed to establish a new sugar factory based in Weli Oya at Monaragala district under  Lanka Sugar Company (Pvt.) Ltd. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation to implement the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.
