description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Education of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary to implement a Scholarship Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - With a view to further improving the cooperation between Sri Lanka and Hungary, it has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to grant scholarships to Sri Lankan students during 2022‑2024 under the 'STIPENDIUM HUNGARICUM' Scholarship Program for foreign students implemented under the supervision of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary. Under the said programme, Sri Lankan students will be provided with the opportunity to follow 08 Undergraduate Degrees, 08 Postgraduate Degrees and 04 Doctoral Degrees. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the said MoU between the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland on Healthcare Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - It has been agreed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and the United Kingdom on the mutually agreed matters including enhancing cooperation between both countries in health sector and ensuring the rights of healthcare professionals serving in the United Kingdom. Specially, it will be possible to receive the employment opportunities being generated in the health sector in the said country to Sri Lanka, subsequent to the breaking up of the United Kingdom from the European Union. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Labour, the Foreign Minister and the Minister of Health to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Permanent Houses for families who do not have a house or a land to construct a house and live mainly on rent basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - In view of providing permanent houses at an affordable price for the low middle income families with true housing requirement who reside in rented houses due to not having either a house or a land to construct a house, the State Ministry of Rural Housing and Construction & Building Material Industries Promotion has planned to implement a housing programme named as “Sonduru Mahal Niwasa” through the National Housing Development Authority. Under the programme, the selected beneficiaries should have the ability of making a down‑payment of Rs.500,000/- and the remaining value of the house will be charged in installments within a year. The selected beneficiaries will also be given the opportunity to obtain loans from Banks as found necessary. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to implement the said housing programme and to construct 72 houses in a plot of land at Ranpokunugama, belonging to the National Housing Development Authority as its pilot project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Projects identified for promotion of Buddhist Heritage between Sri Lanka and India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has expressed its concurrence to award a grant of LKR 2.89 billion during a period of five (05) years, to promote cultural and public ties between Sri Lanka and India and to implement projects identified for further strengthening the co‑operation of Buddhist Heritage of both countries. It has been planned to implement projects identified in association with the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious & Cultural Affairs and the High Commissioner of India pertaining to development of infrastructure facilities, capacity building, cultural affairs, archaeological collaboration, exhibition of relics of Lord Buddha in Sri Lanka and promotion of Buddhist tours to India. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious & Cultural Affairs to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of India to implement the proposed programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing houses to the families affected due to overflowing of the Buthgamuwa Canal during rainy season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-10
decision_details_body: - The programme for resettlement of families residing in areas with landslide risks is being implemented in 14 districts and 1,558 families have been resettled under this programme. Also, although there is no risk of landslides, it has been observed the appropriateness of including such families in the resettlement programme to relocate families who are constantly affected by disasters such as coastal erosion, river bank wahsouts and constant submerging with floods. Accordingly, the requirement of resettling 42 families affected by constant floods due to overflowing of the Buthgamuwa Canal in 514 Welikada East Grama Niladhari Division in Sri Jayawardenapura Kotte Divisional Secretariat Division during rainy season, in another location has been identified. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to remove the said 42 families from their residences and provide them with 42 houses from the housing projects implemented by the Urban Development Authority (UDA) for the persons with low‑income, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Economy 2022 and the Way forward
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body:
- Subsequent to the passage of the Budget - 2022 in Parliament, the implementation of the same has been commenced from 01st of January 2022. The following information pertaining to the External Outlook of the Sri Lankan Economy was brought to notice of the Cabinet by the Minister of Finance with a view to achieving the desired objectives of the Budget.

    • Information on estimated foreign exchange that will flow out of the country in the year 2022, including foreign debt servicing payments and expected import costs of goods and services.
      
    • the expected foreign exchange inflows in the year 2022, including export earnings, earnings from tourism industry, remittances by migrant workers, and foreign direct investments.

    • Proposed short term- and medium-term measures to cover the expected foreign exchange deficit.

    • The following reliefs proposed to minimize the economic hardships faced by the people due to the increase in prices of goods and services under the prevailing economic situation.

          (i)	Granting a monthly allowance of Rs. 5000 for the 	Public Servants and pensioners from January.
  
          (ii)	Taking action to provide the above concession to 	private sector employees as well in consultation with 	private sector employers.

          (iii)	providing an additional allowance of Rs. 1,000 / - to 	the Samurdhi beneficiaries entitled the monthly 	allowance of Rs. 3,500/- and giving the same allowance 	to other Samurdhi beneficiaries as well.
  
          (iv)	payment of an additional amount of Rs. 25/- per 1kg of 	paddy in addition to the guaranteed price of Rs.50/- 	currently being paid per 1kg of paddy, in case of any 	reduction in the paddy harvest in the upcoming season.
  
          (v)	bearing the additional amount so paid by the 	Government so as not affecting the price of rice in the 	market.
  
          (vi)	Implementing a home gardening programme to 	encourage the cultivation of vegetables and fruits 	required for their self consumption and providing an 	incentive allowance up to a maximum of Rs. 10,000/- 	depending on the size of the land not more than one 	acre for inputs such as preparing the land, obtaining 	seeds etc. 
  
          (vii)	Providing 15kg of wheat flour at a concessionary 	price of Rs. 80/- per kilogram to a estate sector 	employee's family.
  
          (viii)	fully exempting the all essential food and 	medicine from 	tax, taking action to protect local farmers and 	producers whenever necessary.
  
The Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the implementation of the arrangement including the above proposals submitted by the Minister of Finance.

description: Trincomalee Oil Tank Farm Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body: - Both India and Sri lanka have reached an agreement to review the existing three commitments with India pertaining to the Trincomalee Oil Tank Complex and to implement a joint development project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to allocate 24 Oil tanks for the business activities of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation and to allocate 14 Oil tanks in the lower tank farm which are already being used by the Lanka IOC for its business activities and to provide the rest of 61 tanks to the Trinco Petroleum Terminal (Private) Limited which was established holding 51% of the share entitlement to the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation and 49% of the share entitlement to the Lanka IOC, to implement a development project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for promoting the installment of Battery Energy Storage System for the Roof Top Solar Sites
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body: - The Government has taken a policy decision to take necessary action to generate 70% of the electricity requirement of the country by the renewable energy and to reach carbon neutrality at the electricity generation by the year 2030. The Solar Power Systems installed on roof tops currently provide a capacity of 400 MW to the national grid of the Country. Encouraging consumers to install battery systems for these systems on self-financed investment through a new tariff system will enable the public to secure a more reliable supply of electricity. In this context, An Officials Committee was appointed to identify the technical challenges that could arise in connecting high percentage of electricity receiving from the renewable energy to the national grid and submit recommendation on the same and the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑11‑23 decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee to further study matters on the recommendations of the said Officials Committee. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Power to implement the proposed programme as per the recommendations submitted by the said Cabinet Sub-Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Public Administration Circular No. 03/2016 pertaining to the removal of Salary Anomalies in the Teachers' and Principals' Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval to remove the salary anomalies in the Teachers' and Principals' Services based on the set of proposals submitted to the then National Pay Commission by the Ministry of Education in consultation with the Trade Unions in the year 2018 and action has also been taken to allocate necessary provisions through the Budget proposals for the year 2022 to implement the said proposal. Accordingly, the proposals made by the Minister of Education to amend the Public Administration Circular No. 03/2016 to enable to remove the salary anomalies in the Teachers' and Principals' Services including the salary scales to the Teacher Advisors Service, since the said service had not been established at the time of preparation of the relevant proposals in the year 2018, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Draft Bills for amending the Special Goods and Services Tax Bill and the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed through the Budgets 2021 and 2022 to impose online-managed single Special Goods and Services Tax in place of multiple taxes and levies imposed under several legal statutes to improve the efficiency of tax collection on liquor, cigarette, telecommunication, betting and gaming and vehicles. It has also been proposed by the Budget 2022 to increase Value Added Tax (VAT) charged on financial services and to exempt medical equipment, accessories and chemicals etc. donated to the Government Hospitals and the Ministry of Health to address any pandemic or public health conditions from the Value Added Tax. The clearances of the Attorney General have been received for the Special Goods and Services Tax Bill and the Value Added Tax (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to publish the said draft Bills in the Government Gazette and to submit the same thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of 750 Jeeps for the Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2020‑11‑16 has granted approval to purchase 750 Jeeps for the Sri Lanka Police including 150 Jeeps for the Special Task Force of Police under the Indian Line of Credit. Accordingly, bids have been invited from the Companies recommended by the Indian Export-Import Bank and the proposal made by Minister of Public Security to award the relevant procurement to Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd, India as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of 1,800,000 Meropenem Injection 1g Vials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the purchase of 1,800,000 Meropenem Injection 1g Vials used to treat for wide range of infections including respiratory tract infections caused by bacteria. three (03) bids have been submitted for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the procurement for the supply of 25% of the total injection requirement to Venus Remedies Limited, India, the lowest substantially responsive bidder, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, in the first instance and to decide on awarding the balance quantity of 75% depending on the end-users' comments on the performance of the item, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 75,000 Vials of Human Immunoglobin for IV use BP 5-6g for Intravenous use
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bidding has been invited for the purchase of 75,000 Vials of Human Immunoglobin for Intravenous BP 5-6g used to treat for the patients suffering from life-threatening diseases. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the relevant procurement to the Reliance Life Sciences (Pvt) Ltd., India as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Consultancy Service Contract for the construction of Coop Square
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 02 August 2021 has granted approval to construct a Cooperative Trade Centre named Coop Square. Accordingly, Expressions of Interest have been invited under the National Competitive Bidding to select a consultancy firm to obtain consultancy services pertaining to the all the sectors under the said project and 07 institutes have been shortlisted. Proposals have been submitted by 06 institutes out of those institutes. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to award the relevant Consultancy Service Contract to the M/s Mihindu Keerthiratne Associates as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 500 Nos. of 32 seater new buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board under the Indian Line of Credit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 08 January 2020 has granted approval for the Procurement of 500 Nos. of 32- 35 seater new buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board under the Indian Line of Credit. Accordingly, bids have been invited from three pre-qualified Institutes for the procurement of buses. As such the proposal made by the Minster of Transport to award the procurement for the purchase of 500 Nos. of 32 seater new buses to the Ashok Leyland Limited, India as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee after evaluation of bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Open University of Sri lanka and the International Rice Research Institute (IRRI)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-01-03
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the mutual collaboration has been entered into between the Open University of Sri lanka and the International Rice Research Institute on 19 October 2017 with a view to promoting activities such as developing courses suitable for open and distance learning methods relating to Rice Science and related fields of study, organizing institute member and research member exchange programmes, conducting joint research projects and organizing of seminars, exchanging research, publications and information. Both parties have come to an agreement to sign a new MoU by extending the period of time of the above MoU for 03 years. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the relevant MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Policies and Guidelines for the grant of reparation under the Office for Reparations Act, No. 34 of 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-20
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of the Act, No.34 of 2018, the Office for Reparations has been established to identify the aggrieved persons eligible for reparations and grant individual and collective reparations as found appropriate. As per section 11 of the said Act, the Office for Reparations should formulate policies for grant of reparation and prepare and submit to the Cabinet of Ministers the criteria for determining the eligibility of the aggrieved persons. Accordingly, the said Office has formulated policies and guidelines in consultation with the relevant stakeholders. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to submit the said policies and guidelines in Parliament and publish the same thereafter in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Civil Aviation (Licensing of Personnel and Training Institutions) Regulation No. 01 of 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-20
decision_details_body: - In view of ensuring the international responsibility vested in the Government under the Chicago Convention and the sustainable growth in Civil Aviation in Sri Lanka within a safe and secure environment, the Civil Aviation (Licensing of Personnel and Training Institutions) Regulation No. 01 of 2018 has been published and issued in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2078/22 dated 2018 07 03 as pert the provisions of the Civil Aviation Act, No.14 of 2010. In terms of section 119 of the Aviation Act, every regulation published in the Government Gazette should be presented in Parliament for approval, expeditiously. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to present the said Regulation published in the Government Gazette dated 2018 07 03 in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting a plot of land to the famous Singer Yohani Diloka de Silva
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-20
decision_details_body: - Proposals have been made by various parties and at Parliament to appreciate the artist Yohani Diloka de Silva who has brought fame to Sri Lanka at international level. As such, the proposal made by the  Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to grant a plot of land in the extent of 9.68 perches adjacent to the plots of land provided on 99 year lease basis to the players of the Sri Lanka Cricket team who won the 1996 World Cup, located in Robert Gunawardena Mawatha, Battaramulla, belonging to the Urban Development Authority (UDA), to the artist Yohani Diloka de Silva as a gift of the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief measures for rebuilding the Tourism Industry which was affected due to the COVID-19 Pandemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-20
decision_details_body: - With a view to rebuilding the tourism industry affected by the COVID 19 Pandemic, it was decided at the Cabinet meeting held on 2021 01 18 to provide a concessionary period to tourist accommodation providers up to 2021 02 28 to pay electricity bills. However, as the anticipated growth in the tourism field had not been taken place due to the re-transmission of the COVID 19 pandemic since April 2021, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism, it was decided by the Cabinet to extend the said concessionary period for a further period of two (02) years with effect from 2021 03 01.

description: Revising the number of subsidy installments for rubber replanting and new planting
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-20
decision_details_body: - The subsidy provided per hectare according to the presently functioning investment subsidy scheme for encouraging the Rubber cultivation is paid within a period of seven (07) years in 8 installments for replanting and new planting. Accordingly, Rs.350,000/- per hectare for replanting and Rs.300,000/- per hectare for new planting is paid in 8 installments. In view of encouraging the planters for Rubber plantation by rectifying the existing shortcomings of the scheme currently in operation, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation to pay the subsidy for replanting and new planting of Rubber in 05 installments without amending the respective amount and also to pay an incentive of Rs.14,000/- per hectare to the planters of Rubber who grow Rubber trees up to 50 cm before the end of 05 years after planting, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Moratuwa and the Osaka City University, Japan for Academic Exchange and Collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-20
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Academic Exchange and Collaboration between the University of Moratuwa and the Osaka City University, Japan. Under the said MoU which is effective for a period of five (05) years, it is expected to implement professors and university lecturers exchange programmes, implement student exchange programmes, conduct collaborative research and joint academic meetings and workshops and exchange information, publications and materials for academic purposes between the said universities. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons  (TPNW)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-20
decision_details_body: - The Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons was adopted at the United Nations Organization on 07th July 2017 as the first globally applicable multilateral agreement to prohibiting nuclear weapons, with the support of 122 states. The said Treaty has been effective since 22nd January 2021 and has 86 signatories and 57 ratifications. Sri Lanka supported the adoption of this Treaty by voting in favour at the United Nations Conference and constantly promotes the universal adherence to the same. The said Treaty prohibits the participating states from developing, testing, producing, manufacturing, transferring, possessing, stockpiling nuclear weapons or other nuclear explosive devices and threatening to use them  or allowing to station such nuclear weapons in their territory and assisting, encouraging or inducing anyone to engage in any of such activities as well. Signing this Treaty is entirely consistent with Sri Lanka's principled stance against Weapons of Mass Destruction and in favour of nuclear disarmament. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Foreign Minister to sign the said Treaty by Sri Lanka and initiate the process of reviewing national legislation with a view to completing its ratification processes as soon as possible, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Code of Criminal Procedure Act - Pronouncing Sentence of Death on Minors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-13
decision_details_body: - Action has been taken to amend Section 53 of the Penal Code to the effect that the sentence of death shall not be pronounced on or recorded against any person who, in the opinion of the Court, is under the age of 18 years at the time of commission of the offence and enabling to punish the said person by detaining him, during the President's pleasure, in lieu of the said sentence. However, Section 281 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act does not include provisions to the effect that such sentence of death shall not be pronounced on such person if he was under 18 years of age at the time of commission of the offence. Therefore, it has been identified that necessary amendments should be made to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act also, to remove the existing ambiguity. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to amend Section 281 of the Code of the Criminal Procedure Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Land Development Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-13
decision_details_body: - Since it was observed that it is not possible to make the optimum use of the blocks of lands made on the Grants issued as per the provisions of the Land Development Ordinance due to certain conditions incorporated in the said Grants, approval of the Cabinet of Ministers has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑01‑04 to amend the Land Development Ordinance, enabling to amend said conditions to be favorable to the public. Accordingly, concurrence of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Lands to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of the Land where the Kundasale Hotel School has been established, with the Sri Lanka Institute of Tourism & Hotel Management (SLITHM)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-13
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Institute of Tourism & Hotel Management (SLITHM) maintains training centres covering the nine (09) provinces island‑wide, to provide training to youth in the Hospitality field and for different sectors in the tourism industry. The Kundasale Hotel School governed by the SLITHM, has been set up on a land in the extent of 0.545 hectares in the possession of the Road Development Authority (RDA). Even though the said Hotel School has been constructed in the year 2009 at the cost of Rs.450 million, the SLITHM has not acquired a lawful title to the said land as yet. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to vest the relevant block of land to the SLITHM as a Grant in terms of the State Land Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of blocks of lands from the Regional Industrial Estates to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-13
decision_details_body: - “Regional Industrial Estates Development Programme” is a major programme carried out with the objective of promoting industries at regional level. The “Regional Industrial Services Committee” established under the Industrial Promotion Act, No.46 of 1990 and the “Project Evaluation Committee of the Ministry” identify the suitable investors for the said Programme, subsequent to a full assessment of the project proposals. Accordingly, the above Committees have studied 27 project proposals and recommended the allocation of blocks of lands from 15 Industrial Estates to implement the said Projects. It is expected by the selected investors to invest Rs.4,523.34 million and generate 2,477 direct employment opportunities. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to allocate blocks of lands to the respective investors on long term lease basis for a period of 35 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of the Lunugamvehera National Park as the Yala Zone No. VI
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-13
decision_details_body: - The “Lunugamvehera National Park” has been declared in 1995 as a habitat for migratory elephants between the Eastern Reserve of the Yala and a part in the western area of the Udawalawa National Park in the extent of 23,499 hectares. This National Park possesses the climatic features similar to those in the Yala National Park and the species inhabitant in both National Parks are also similar. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife & Forest Conservation to declare the Lunugamvehera National Park as the Yala Zone No. VI, instead of maintaining them as two separate National Parks with similar climatic features, biodiversity and environmental features, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the University of Ruhuna and Hokkaido Bunkyo University, Japan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-13
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into an MoU between the University of Ruhuna and Hokkaido Bunkyo University, Japan for higher education collaborations between two parties. Under this MoU which is valid for  05 years, it is expected to carry out activities such as exchange of faculty, researchers and other research and administrative staff, implementing students exchange programmes, promotion of joint research activities between two parties, exchange of academic information and materials. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Identification and Declaration of Urban Area Located in Pradeshiya Sabha Limits
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-13
decision_details_body: - “Administrative Unit” is the main criteria used in the classification of  Urban Area. Accordingly, only the Municipal Council and Urban Council have been officially classified as Urban Areas at present. However, due to the weaknesses of the above criteria, many urbanized areas are still identified as rural areas thereby arising the necessity of accurate definition on urbanization. In terms of the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Ordinance No. 13 of 1946 amended by the Act No 49 of 2000, the authority of declaring urban development areas has been entrusted with the National Physical Planing Department. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to identify the urban areas located in Pradeshiya Sabha limits in association with Advisory Committee and to declare the urban areas identified within Pradeshiya Sabha limits as recommended by the said Committee, as per the provisions of the Country Planing Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Use of Community Database of the e-Grama Niladhari (eGN) Project in lieu of previous Household List
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-13
decision_details_body: - Due to non implementing the system of maintaining the Household list at present, various issues have arisen on taking action by Grama Niladharis based on the Electoral Registry and other information in issuing Residence Certificates to persons.  The e-Grama Niladhari (eGN) Project has now been initiated under the State Ministry of Home Affairs and a household and citizen database is being prepared under the same. It has been planned to implement the said project under few stages, covering 14,022 Grama Niladari Divisions. The current residency of a person could be clearly verified through that community based database. Accordingly, the proposal made by the H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence  to recognize the database of the  e-Grama Niladhari (eGN) Project  as the national database in principle  for the requirement of the previous household unit system, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening the Multisectoral Approach for Dengue Prevention and Control
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-13
decision_details_body:
- Dengue has now become a major public health problem in Sri Lanka and by November 2021, 25910 dengue patients and 19 deaths had been reported. Since there is a tendency to further escalate Dengue during this monsoon rainy season, which has reached alarming proportions, an integrated national programme  has been scheduled to be implemented through the Ministries  with the participation of all parties concerned. Accordingly, the following proposals made by H.E. the President, were approved by the Cabinet.

    • to nominate an officer in each institution dedicated to continue dengue prevention and control activities. 

    • to review matters at the District Coordinating Committee and Divisional Coordination Committee meetings and take necessary action.

    • to vest the responsibility of provincial, district, divisional and grassroot level coordinating activities on prevention of dengue with the Provincial Governors.

    • to update the existing rules and regulations pertaining to the prevention of Dengue.

    • to assign the responsibility of  coordinating overall activities on the prevention of Dengue to the National Dengue Prevention Unit.

description: Awarding a finance grant on behalf of Mr. Priyantha Kumara Diyawadana who was brutally assassinated at Sialkot in Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-06
decision_details_body: - Priyantha Kumara Diyawadana who had been serving as a Manager at a factory located in Sialkot area in Pakistan, was brutally assassinated by a group of thugs on 2021‑12‑03. Taking into consideration his immense contribution as an emigrant employee to the Sri Lankan economy for a period of more than 11 years, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to award a grant of Rs.2.5 million on humanitarian basis, to his wife and children who became helpless due to his demise, for their welfare through the Welfare Fund of the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Cardiology Unit in the District General Hospital of Ampara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-06
decision_details_body: - The number of heart patients and deaths due to heart attacks has gradually increased in Ampara district within the past few years. In view of controlling this condition, it is essential to develop the physical resources available at the Ampara General Hospital to provide more effective treatment services to the heart patients arriving to receive treatments. As such, it has been planned to establish a Cardiology Unit with Catheterization Laboratory at the Ampara General Hospital. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the said Project to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) on Design and Build basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project of Strengthening Capacity Building of Forensic Drug Analysis in the Criminal Justice System in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-06
decision_details_body: - The Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA) has agreed to award a Grant of USD 04 Million to implement a Project of Strengthening Capacity Building of Forensic Drug Analysis in the Criminal Justice System in Sri Lanka. Under the said Project, it has been planned to discharge the functions of enhancing laboratory equipment in narcotic drug and forensic toxicology laboratory, providing training on narcotic drugs and forensic toxicology and establishing a Laboratory Information Management System. Accordingly, in view of obtaining the said award, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to sign a ''Record of Discussion'' including the ''Terms of Reference'' between the Department of External Resources, KOICA, Government Analyst Department and the Ministry of Justice, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting lands located in the Mahaweli area to the investors for commercial agriculture projects targeting National Food and Nutrition Security and Exportation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-06
decision_details_body: - In order to minimize the negative impact on the economy of the country due to the foreign exchange outflow through the importation of foods in the wake of the COVID - 19 pandemic situation, it has been planned to encourage investors to cultivate essential food crops domestically. Further, increasing local diary production and producing animal food domestically has been a prime objective of the ''Saubhagya National Food Production and Promotion Policy''. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation to provide lands in extent of 1750 hectares located in Mahaweli area to the selected investors on long term lease basis following the formal procedure for implementing Commercial Agriculture Projects targeting National Food and Nutrition Security and Exportation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding Research Grants to the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University (KDU) from the Association of Commonwealth Universities (ACU)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-06
decision_details_body: - The Association of Commonwealth Universities has been established in the year 1913 with over 500 member institutions in more than 50 Commonwealth countries. Enhancing and supporting the excellence of higher education for the benefit of individuals and societies within the Commonwealth and beyond has been identified as the mission of this Association. Taking into consideration a project proposal submitted by the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University (KDU) under the title of ''Gender awareness among KDU Community'', the Association of Commonwealth Universities has agreed to provide a Research Grant of GBP 1000 to implement the said Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to obtain the said Grant through the Association of Commonwealth Universities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuing of National Birth Certificates with Sri Lanka Identification Number
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-12-06
decision_details_body: - The Registrar General's Department has been vested with the authority to register any child born in Sri Lanka at birth and issue the National Birth Certificate to that child as per the Births and Deaths Registration Act. In terms of the provisions of the Registration of Persons Act No. 32 of 1968, maintenance of National Register of Persons and registration of Sri Lankan citizens who attain the age of 15 years and have attained the said age limit, at their request and issuance of National Identity Cards have been vested with the Department of Registration of Persons. Further, the Department of Registration of Persons has also been empowered to issue the Sri Lanka Identity Number to every Sri Lankan citizen under the Order of Electronic Transactions (Sri Lankan Identity Number) No. 1 of 2019 issued as per the provisions of the the Electronic Transactions Act No. 19 of 2006. Use of the same identification number will enable the Sri Lankans citizens in future to have easy and efficient service during their activities from birth to death and when seeking services from public or private sectors. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to issue the Sri Lankan Identity Number online to the Registrar General's Department through information system of the the Department of Registration of Persons and to issue the Birth Certificate of the relevant person by the Registrar General's Department including the said number, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of Rice from Myanmar (Burma) for stabilizing the price of rice in the local market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑09‑27 has granted approval to import 100,000 MT of rice enabling to provide adequate quantity of rice to the consumers without any shortage and to maintain buffer stocks of rice. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to import 20,000 MT of rice at US$ 460 per one MT from Myanmar through the Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation on Government to Government method based on an Agreement entered into between the Government of Sri lanka and the Government of Myanmar, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Submission of Gazette Notifications to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-29

description: Presenting the Bill for the establishment of Galaha Bhaddrawathi National Bhikkus Care Centre Trust in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2014‑10‑16 has granted approval to draft a Bill for establishing a Trust enabling the Galaha Bhaddrawathi National Bhikkus Centre maintained as a Bhikkus Care Center for sick and helpless monks, to function as a legal entity. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting of laws to provide for the control of Election Expenses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-29
decision_details_body: - Universal suffrage is an integral part of the people's sovereignty of the Sri Lankan citizens. It should be exercised freely and fairly at an election as people's will. If any candidate, a party or a group spends money lavishly at an election for people's vote with no control, it could considerably affect to the people's choice at elections. The need to have some control over the expenses incurred by the candidates or parties contesting for the elections has been taken up for consideration in Sri Lanka and many countries including India have introduced legislation for controlling election expenses. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation for the purpose as per the approval granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2017‑10‑17 to amend the existing laws to provide for minimizing the illegal activities at elections and taking into account the matters agreed by the Parliament Special Committee appointed to identify the reforms pertaining to the electoral system and laws and submit amendments to the same, in consultation with the relevant parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion of the Sewer Collection Network for Phase 2 - Stage 1 of the Ratmalana/ Moratuwa Wastewater Disposal Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-29
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to further expand the existing sewerage facility under the Stage 1 ‑ Phase 2 of the Ratmalana/Moratuwa Wastewater Disposal Project implemented under the funds of the Government of Sri Lanka and the French Agency for Development (AFD). Bids have been called under the International Competitive Bidding procedure for awarding the relevant contract for the implementation of the said project and 07 bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply to award the respective contract to M/s China Geo Engineering Corporation as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Cardiac Care Complex in the Teaching Hospital, Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Teaching Hospital, Ratnapura provides its health services to a population of nearly two million living in the Sabaragamuwa Province. Even though cardiology services are already available at the said Hospital, the unavailability of sufficient physical resources for the purpose have led to numerous difficulties. Hence, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to construct a Cardiac Care Complex with the facilities required for the said Hospital and to award the respective contract to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) on Design, Build and Transfer basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of Phase II of the Contract for the construction of buildings required for the Faculty of Engineering Technology and BioSystems Technology of the University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-29
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2019‑04‑30 to secure funds for the project for the construction of buildings required for the Faculty of Engineering Technology and BioSystems Technology of the University of Jaffna under the World Bank funded Accelerating Higher Education Expansion and Develop (AHEAD) Operation Project. As such, bids have been called for constructing the respective buildings in Kilinochchi under Phase ‑II of the said Project, following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure and 10 bids have been submitted accordingly. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to award the respective contract to M/s Focus Marketing & Engineering Company (Pvt) Ltd., as per the recommendation made thereon by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Capacity Building Project for Construction Courses at Technical Colleges and Colleges of Technology in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-29
decision_details_body: - In view of providing a high quality technical and vocational education and training to meet the labour market demand in the field of construction, the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA) has agreed to award a grant of USD 04 million to implement a project to upgrade training courses in the construction field at selected Colleges of Technology and Technical Colleges. Under the said Grant, it has been planned to improve the capacity of construction courses at the Colleges of Technology in Maradana and Ratnapura and the Technical Colleges in Ratmalana and Matara. The contribution of the Government of Sri Lanka for the project will be approximately USD 441,000. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to implement the proposed project during the period from the year 2021 to the year 2024 and to sign an Agreement with the KOICA to obtain the respective Grant for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendations of the Finance Commission for the Financial Year 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Finance Commission established in accordance with Article 154R of the Constitution of Sri Lanka, shall make recommendations to H.E. the President on the policies to be followed in the disbursement of funds granted by the Annual Budget for the Provincial Councils. Accordingly, the Finance Commission has made recommendations for the Financial Year 2020 to H.E. the President. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President to present the said recommendations in Parliament in terms of Article 154R(7) of the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Mediation Board Act No. 72 of 1988 (as amended)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - Mediation Boards are functioning under the Mediation Board Act No. 72 of 1988 covering most of the Divisional Secretariat Divisions countrywide. The Civil Law Reforms Sub Committee of the Ministry of Justice has identified  the amendments that need to be made to the said Act to further implement this mediation  process  efficiently and effectively. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to take necessary action to amend the Mediation Board Act No. 72 of 1988 incorporating the said amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 	of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - Mediation is now widely accepted in Sri Lanka as a convenient and low-cost mechanism in resolving disputes. The Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act No. 21 of 2003 contains provisions relating to the resolution of disputes which are considered as social and economic issues requiring special expertise and meaningful solutions for the betterment of the community. The said Act empowers the Minister of Justice to appoint mediators with specialized qualifications in considering the nature and the category of the dispute.  It has been identified the necessity to amend certain provisions of the said Act to suit with the present day requirements. Accordingly, the proposal made the Minister of Justice to amend the  Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act No. 21 of 2003 as recommended by the  Civil Law Reforms Sub Committee functioning under the Ministry of Justice and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare an amended draft Bill for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports 	(Control) Act No. 1 of 1969 to Parliament  for Approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - The Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2021‑11‑03 has been issued  promulgating the regulations under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act No. 1 of 1969 to facilitate to meet the domestic demand for rice and to provide the people with rice at affordable prices avoiding the shortage of rice in the market. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to submit the said Regulations in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: East Container Terminal of the Port of Colombo - Phase II- Civil Works
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has previously granted approval to develop the East Container Terminal in phased out manner by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority to operate as a fully owned container terminal.  Accordingly, International Competitive Bids have been called for the civil works of Phase II of the the East Container Terminal of the Port of Colombo and 03 bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping to award the relevant contract to the Joint Venture of Access Engineering PLC and China Harbor Engineering Company Ltd as per the recommendation of the the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee for the said Bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Container Handling Equipment for the East Container Terminal of the Sri lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑03‑29 has granted approval for the procurement of 14 nos. Ship to Shore Cranes, 40 nos. Automated Rail Mounted Gantry Cranes and 30 nos. Straddle Careers for the East Container Terminal of the Sri lanka Ports Authority. Bids have been invited for this by following the International Competitive Bidding Procedure and 6 Bids have been received. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping to award the procurement for the purchase of 12 Ship to Shore Cranes and 40 Automated Rail Mounted Gantry Cranes to the Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries Co Ltd as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Machineries for the proposed two (02) Eco-Friendly Bio-Organic Fertilizer Factories to be constructed at the Pelwatta and Sevanagala Units of Lanka Sugar Company (Pvt.) Ltd
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑09‑13 has granted approval for the implementation of the project for constructing two eco-friendly bio-organic fertilizer factories in Pelwatta and Sevanagala units of Lanka Sugar Company (Pvt) Ltd. Since the proposed organic fertilizer factories have not yet been operated in Sri Lanka, the machinery and plants required for the same have to be secured from a foreign manufacturer. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantations to secure the said machinery and plants from the Dongting Lake International, China following the Direct Procurement Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Green Power Development & Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Project - Development of Ambalangoda and Pannala Grid Substations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - Green Power Development & Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Project is implemented under the funds of the Asian Development Bank and it has been planed to develop the Ambalngoda and Pannala Grid Substations and to provide 02 Spare Transformers under lot B of the Package 8 of the said Project. International Competitive Bids have been invited for this under the Single-Stage Two Envelope procedure and 04 Bids have been received. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Power to award the relevant procurement to the M/s Ceylex Engineering (Pvt) Ltd as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Progress of Mega Scale Development Projects by the end of Third Quarter - 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - 332 Mega Scale Development Projects are being implemented under 47 Ministries exceeding Rs. 1000 million in the year 2021 and their duration will expand up to 2030. The total investment value of these projects is Rs. 6899 billion. 95 projects out of which amounting to Rs. 2642 billion in value are new projects commenced in the year 2021 to achieve the goals of the Government Policy Framework “Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour”. Under this, projects have been commenced pertaining to the fields of health, education, potable water supply, road network development, improvement of irrigation system and township and rural development. The smooth functioning of these projects has been hampered by the shortage of building materials and labours, restrictions on imports as well as  immigration and emigration due to  the COVID-19 pandemic situation prevailing in the country. Nevertheless, an amount of 63% out of the targeted expenditure of Rs 448 billion has been spent for these projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Development Co-ordination and Monitoring to seek the participation of the Ministry of Economic Policies and Plan Implementation, Ministry of Finance and the senior officials of other relevant Government institutions for the progress review meetings conducted monthly with a view to solving the problems which arisen pertaining to the said projects enabling to implement the said projects within the stipulated time frames and to receive the benefits of the same to the General public, was approved  by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Interim Report of the Committee appointed on Digital Banking, Blockchain Technology and Crypto-currency
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet was granted at its meeting held on 2021‑10‑05 to appoint a Committee to submit recommendations to the Cabinet, on the possible laws and regulations for attracting investments to the Digital Banking, Blockchain Technology and Crypto‑currency related Companies. Accordingly, a Committee has been appointed comprising 8 members under the chairmanship of Mr. Sujeewa Mudalige.  The Interim Report submitted by the said Committee was brought to the notice of the Cabinet at this meeting. As such, it was decided to grant its concurrence to the proposals made by the Minister of Development Co‑ordination and Monitoring, to submit the final report of the said Committee by 2022‑06‑30 and to appoint another two technical professionals working in the relevant field as its members to assist the Committee.

description: Establishment of a National Oil & Gas Company
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - It has been confirmed that there are petroleum and natural gas deposits available in the country, according to the explorations conducted in the M2 block of the Mannar Basin during the period from 2011 to 2013. Opportunities may arise in reducing reliance on importation of fossil fuel to meet domestic requirements by producing petroleum and natural gas and in earning foreign currency by becoming an exporter of natural gas in future. It has been declared by the “National Policy on Natural Gas of Sri Lanka” that action will be taken by the Government to establish a National Gas Company under the Public‑Private Partnership Model in respect of storage, construction of pipelines, development, ownership and operation of transport and distribution infrastructure facilities including local gas exploration and production, enabling to engage in exploration and production activities of commercial viability. It has been planned to establish the said Company as a Subsidiary Company of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation and the said Company will be vested with the responsibility of discharging the duties and functions assigned by Part V of the Petroleum Resources Act, No.21 of 2021. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to establish the “National Oil & Gas Company” under the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007.

description: Agreement on Co-operation and Mutual Administrative Assistance in Customs Matters between Sri Lanka and Vietnam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - Consequent to a series of bilateral discussions held between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Vietnam, it has been proposed to enter into an Agreement on Co‑operation and Mutual Administrative Assistance in Customs matters between the two countries. Accordingly, this proposed trade agreement will contribute for reducing trade transaction cost, accurate valuation and collection of border taxes and enforcement of regulations on prohibition, restriction and controlling of movement of restricted goods. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to sign the proposed agreement agreed to between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancement of the National Traffic Database and Capacity Building
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - With the increase in volume of traffic, the necessity has arisen to establish a mechanism for the management of traffic on national highways, especially on roads within the City of Colombo. With a view to updating the existing data at the Road Development Authority for the purpose, a request has already been made through the Department of External Resources to seek the assistance of the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA). Under the proposed programme, the Ministry of Highways intends to formulate a national level Traffic Data Management Plan, establish a foundation for collecting traffic data, design an automated Traffic Database Management System and enhance the Traffic Demand Analysis Capability. For this, the proposal made by the Minister of Highways to implement the “Enhancement of National Traffic Database and Capacity Building Project” by securing a grant from the KOICA and to sign a Record of Discussions between the Ministry of Highways and KOICA confirming the implementation of the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Digitalization of Expressway Manual Toll Collection via LANKAQR
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - With a view to reducing the use of physical currency in Sri Lanka, action is being taken by the Government in association with all licensed financial institutions to popularize the LANKAQR payment method. As one of its steps, it has been proposed to introduce LANKAQR also for the Manual Toll Collection gates of the Expressways managed by the Road Development Authority (RDA). This will enable the drivers using the Expressways to make the relevant payments within 8-10 seconds by entering the respective amount in his mobile phone and scanning the QR Code at the toll collection gate through a LANKAQR enabled mobile payment app of any Bank. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Highways to implement the said payment mechanism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of laws relating to journalists and media institutions and formulation of policies and ethics
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the global growth in the mass media and communication sectors and paying special attention to the existing laws for media standardization in Sri Lanka, international laws and the performance of national and international media institutions and socio‑cultural identity, focus has been paid towards presentation of a Sri Lankan Mass Media Policy, setting up the background for moulding media professionals with esteemed professionalism parallel to that, socialization of knowledge, comprehension and communication strategies on the use and behaviour of new media including social media and facilitating the adaption to digital technology. For this, the necessity of amending the prevailing laws and preparation of the policies and ethics pertaining to journalists and media institutions to suit the present needs, has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to appoint a Committee with the representation of intellects in the Public and Private sectors and in the fields such as media, marketing, education, law, administration and economics, to submit recommendations to the Cabinet for the said purposes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of new boundaries of the Ampara Sanctuary
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-23
decision_details_body: - The Galoya Valley North‑East Sanctuary also known as Ampara Sanctuary with an area of 9,323.96 hectares has been declared as a Sanctuary in the year 1954 as per the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance. The Ampara town, which was thereafter established as a Central City under the Galoya Farmer Colonization Project, has developed extensively by now. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2009‑05‑20 to remove the plots of lands identified as developed in the Ampara Development Plan for having developed the lands located in the Sanctuary for providing various common amenities of the Government and Government Affiliations such as Municipal Council grounds and temples and some plots of lands handed over to private parties under State sponsorship for development and declare new boundaries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife & Forest Conservation to further maintain the densely forested area which is frequented by elephants and other wildlife and identified in the territory pertaining to the Ampara Development Plan as a part of the Sanctuary Zone, remove and declare the densely populated and developed areas in the extent of 46.81 hectares belonging to the Sanctuary and to publish the new boundaries in the Gazette and submit the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Committee to identify the Maritime Law related legal provisions to suit the local and international requirements
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-15
decision_details_body: - In promoting Sri Lanka as a maritime hub considering its strategic location in the middle of the Indian Ocean, it has been identified the necessity of setting up the legal infrastructure facilities, taking into consideration the international requirements in terms of enacting domestic laws in line with the international treaties and ratifying the international treaties. Previously, a Committee has been appointed under the chairmanship of President's Counsel Mr. P.A. Rathnayake, a former Judge of the Supreme Court to study the related matters and action has not been pursued on the recommendations made by the said Committee. When the damages caused by the accidents of the vessels, MT New Diamond and MV X‑Press Pearl within the Sri Lankan waters recently are considered, the necessity of introducing new laws has been highlighted. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Ports & Shipping and the Minister of Justice to appoint a Committee comprising the representatives of the relevant institutions under the chairmanship of President's Counsel Mr. Chandaka Jayasundere, to identify the laws either existing or to be introduced anew or to be amended and submit a Report including recommendations in this regard, also taking into consideration the Report submitted by the former Committee appointed under the chairmanship of Mr. P. A. Rathnayake, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Provincial Councils (Transfer of Stamp Duty) Act, No.13 of 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-15
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet of Ministers has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑02‑15 to amend the Provincial Councils (Transfer of Stamp Duty) Act, No.13 of 2011, incorporating the provisions enabling to refund the Stamp Duty or Penalty payment made in excess or erroneously, when such request is made to refund such Stamp Duty or Penalty remitted by a person in excess or erroneously. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Personal Data Protection Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-15
decision_details_body: - The Personal Data Protection Bill has been drafted to provide for ensuring the security of the personal data of institutions such as Government Institutions, banks, telephone facilities providers and hospitals in accumulating and using such data and developing the digital economy in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity of the Minister of Technology to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Tourism Promotional Campaigns aiming the upcoming Holiday Season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-15
decision_details_body: - In view of restoring tourism affected due to the COVID‑19 pandemic situation, during the tourism season of 2021/2022 and attracting tourists, collective efforts are being taken by all tourism related stakeholders including airlines. Approval of the Cabinet of Ministers has been previously granted to appoint Destination Representation Companies (DRC) and Public Relation (PR) Companies in key tourism markets for a period of 05 years as part of the Global Communication Campaigns to be implemented by the Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion Bureau (SLTPB). As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to implement a tourism promotion campaign targeting the United Kingdom, Germany and France which require special attention as tourism markets and India, the prominent source market in the region of Asia as an interim measure in the said Global Tourism Promotion Campaign, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding procurements for supply of Aviation Fuel for SriLankan Airlines at 21 destination Airports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-15
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called following the Limited International Bidding process to select institutions that supply fuel for the flights of SriLankan Airlines at 21 destination airports, worldwide. The validity period of the relevant procurement is 12 to 24 months and 26 responsive bids have been received for 21 airports. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism, to award the relevant procurements to the  suppliers selected for 21 destination airports, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement on Cooperation and Mutual Administrative Assistance in Customs Matters between Sri Lanka and Russia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-15
decision_details_body: - Following a series of bilateral discussions conducted between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Russia, the two countries are in agreement to enter into a bilateral agreement to facilitate legitimate trade through transparent and predictable customs procedures. The proposed agreement would envisage the reduction of trade transaction cost, accurate valuation and collection of border taxes, ensure enforcement of regulation on prohibitions, restrictions and control of movement of restricted goods. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, to sign the proposed agreement between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Multi - purpose projects in the plots of land reserved for  the construction of post offices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-15
decision_details_body: - Department of Sri Lanka Posts is a network of  654 main post offices and 3,410 of sub post offices while 154 of 654 main post offices are maintained in rented out private buildings. Although a few plots of land have been allotted in several provinces to construct buildings for post offices, the Department has not been able to construct the proposed buildings due to the insufficient funds available. At present, the Department has focused its attention on minimizing the deficit between their income and expenditure, under which the need has been found to identify new income generating sources. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to implement multi-purpose projects in the lands allotted for the department under the Public-Private Partnership mechanism in order to secure required accommodation facilities for the Department of Posts as well as to secure an additional income generating source, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presidential Media Awards Ceremony - 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-15
decision_details_body: - The Government  policy statement “Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour”has identified that it is a responsibility of the Government to secure a clear and independent environment required for the performance of media institutions and the professionals engaged in the media institutions to act for safeguarding the freedom of speech and publication to the most with a view to creating a society that suits to the 21st century. Accordingly, the Presidential Media Awards Ceremony has been planned to conduct more properly with the objective of encouraging media persons for maintaining the exquisite standards of media as well as the electronic, print and web media contents in an accountable and independent manner so that the subscriber expectations could be achieved. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to  conduct the Presidential Media Awards Ceremony- 2022 to evaluate journalists based on their creations made in 2021 in all the three languages, sinhala, Tamil and English, covering six (06) fields of broadcasting, television, printed media, web sites, school media and media researches, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recognition of Cinema as an Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-15
decision_details_body: - Several outstanding films have been produced in the cinema industry of Sri Lanka and many internationally reputed and talented film makers also have been introduced to the world cinema from Sri Lanka. However, due to not being legally declared the local cinema as an industry, its extent and development have been restricted to the small-scale local market. Also, the local cinema industry is facing immense crises amidst the Covid-19 global pandemic situation. It has been identified that development and promotion of cinema industry can bring about several benefits such as  generation of a number of livelihoods, modernization in social, cultural and as well as in economic spheres, and making a contribution to the tourism and education sectors with a considerable contribution to the economy. It has also been observed that, in most of the countries where a developed cinema industry can be found, the development has taken place after the recognition of cinema as an industry by those countries. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs and the Minister of Industries, to register cinema as an industry so as to promote the cinema industry in Sri Lanka and gain international recognition for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Timetable of the Examinations which had been postponed due to Covid-19 pandemic situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-01
decision_details_body:
- Schools were fully opened for grade 5 students on 25th October, 2021, after a 06 months of closing down due to Covid-19 pandemic prevailed in 2021. Further, it has been scheduled to open schools for GCE(O/L) and GCE(A/L) students on 08th November, 2021. Therefore, the students expecting to sit for examinations should be given a sufficient period of time to continue their studies, once the schools are opened. Taking those matters into consideration, the Minister of Education submitted the revised timetable for conducting examinations which had been scheduled to be conducted in the year 2021 to the Cabinet and the Cabinet granted its concurrence for the same. 

* 	Grade 5 Scholarship Examination
   Saturday 22nd of January 2022
	
* 	GCE(A/L) Examination
   From Monday 07th of February 2022 to Saturday 5th of March 2022

* 	GCE(O/L) Examination
   From Monday 23rd of May 2022 to Wednesday 01st of June 2022

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-01
decision_details_body: - With a view to streamlining the importation of boats and vessels, they have been decided to subject to a Import Control Licenses System together with a license fee. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to submit the regulations promulgated and published in the Extraordinary Gazette Notification dated 2021‑10‑12, under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969, for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Eppawala, Giribawa Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-01
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2020‑11‑30 to implement the Rajanganaya-Nochchiyagama section of the Eppawala, Rajanganaya, Nochchiyagama and Giribawa integrated water supply project under domestic funds and the Eppawala and Giribawa section of the said integrated project on the project proposal submitted by the M/s LR Group of Israel and SBI International Holding AG of Switzerland JV. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply to award the contract for the implementation of the Eppawala and Giribawa water supply project to M/s LR Group of Israel and SBI International Holding AG of Switzerland JV to a sum of USD 162.66 as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining direct services from Semi-Government Institutions for the projects identified under “Wari Saubhagya” programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-11-01
decision_details_body: - Rehabilitation of 500 tanks/anicuts was initiated in this year under “Wari Saubhagya” programme in order to stabilize the agricultural economy of the country thereby strengthening the lives of rural population. Under the said programme it is planned to rehabilitate 1000 tanks/anicuts in the year 2021.
