decision_details_body: The Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation (SLLDC) has identified flood mitigation projects to be implemented in the year 2021 in order to minimize floods that occurred in Colombo, suburb areas and out of Colombo and to ensure the environmentally sustainable urbanization. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to implement the said projects through the provisions of Rs.2800 million allocated to the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation for the year 2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'e-Grama Niladari' Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-29
decision_details_body: The e-Grama Niladari (eGN) Project is implemented to formulate a database to store and search information required to day today duties pertaining to the services rendered by the Grama Niladaris to the general public. As per the outcome of a pilot project implemented in 162 Grama Niladari Divisions in 04 Divisional Secretariat Divisions during 2016 and 2017, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement the same in 7000 Grama Niladari Divisions as the Phase II of the said project. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to implement the said project by the State Ministry of Home Affairs with the consultancy support of the Information and Communication Technology Agency of  Sri Lanka (ICTA), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cremation Ceremony of the late , Most Venerable Kotugoda Dammawansa Thero, Maha Nayake Thero of the Sri Lanka Amarapura Maha Nikaya”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approved the proposal made by H.E the president to declare a Day of National Mourning on 2021‑03‑25 the date of conducting the cremation ceremony of late Dharmapala Wansalankara Saddharma Keerthi Sri, Thripitaka Visharadha Pravachana Keerthi Sri, Sasana Shobhana, Sri Sumangala Vidyawathansa, Aggamaha Panditha Most Venerable Mahopadyaya Kotugoda Dammawasa Thero, Maha Nayake Thero of the Sri Lanka Amarapura Maha Nikaya, and close the slaughterhouses and meat and fish shops in the Colombo district where the cremation ceremony is conducted treating the day as a day of mourning and to close liquor shops as well, considering the great service rendered to the nation and the religion by late Thero.

description: Establishment of the “Anuradhapura Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Zone”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish the “Anuradapura Pharmaceutical Manufacturing zone” in Oyamadu where the ‘Deyata Kirula’ was held under the local businessmen and investors encouraging programme with a view to providing high quality pharmaceuticals at a low price for the people by manufacturing all pharmaceuticals in Sri Lanka which could manufacture according to the International Standards. A Committee of Experts has selected 24 investors having called for project proposals from qualified local investors who are interested in this regard. The investors are expected to invest approximately Rs.28,200 million for the project. Accordingly, the land plots will be leased to selected local investors for a period of 35 years with a tax exemption for the first five years. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to implement the proposed pharmaceutical manufacturing zone, as a strategic project under the State Ministry of Production, Supply and Regulation of Pharmaceuticals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Colombo Port City Economic Commission Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑01‑04 to establish a special economic zone called Colombo Port City. Accordingly, in order to make legal provisions for the purpose, the Legal Draftsman has prepared the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Bill. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E the President to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: International Promotion Campagin to attract Foreign Direct Investment to Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - Although foreign direct investments are crucial driving forces of the economic development, the process of attracting foreign direct investments have become weaken with the absence of a focused strategy that could target direct potential investors during the last few years. Although Sri Lanka and other several competitive countries have taken measures to attract foreign direct investments, Sri Lanka could gain only US $ 1.5 billion of foreign direct investment during the year 2019. Therefore, it has been found the necessity to implement a well-orchestrated, coherent and focused marketing and coordination strategy in order to showcase the attractiveness of Sri Lanka as the most suitable investment destination. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to take necessary action to obtain the service of a high level global consultancy firm which contributes for foreign direct investment for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Special Goods and Services Tax Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - Budget proposals for the year 2021 pointed out the necessity of expediting the process of tax collection by introducing a Special Goods and Services Tax Act. Under the provisions to be imposed by the proposed new Act, it has been planned to make more simpler the charging of Goods and Services Tax relating to the fields of alcohol, cigarettes, vehicles, telecommunication and betting. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the Special Goods and Services Tax Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing seven (07) million Sputnik - V Vaccines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Health has planned to vaccinate 14 million of the total population of the Sri Lanka to protect from the Covid-19 virus and as its inception, the Ministry is taking measures to vaccinate 05 million of the population. The National Drug Regulatory Authority has granted permission for the emergency use of Sputnik V vaccine in Sri Lanka. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to purchase 07 million of Sputnik V vaccines to a sum of US $ 69.65 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presentation of Regulations made under section 34(1) of the Convention Against Doping in Sports Act No.33 of 2013, in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Youth and Sports to present the regulations made under section 34(1) of the Convention Against Doping in Sports Act No.33 of 2013 and published in the Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification No 2216/4 dated 2021‑02‑23, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Major Statutes relating to Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Legal Draftsman has formulated the relevant legislation to update the Municipal Councils Ordinance,  Urban Councils Ordinance and the Pradeshiya Sabhas Act, the major Statutes relating to the Local Authorities,which have been enacted decades ago. The Attorney General has pointed out several further amendments to be made to these Bills. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Services, Provincial Councils & Local Government to take necessary action to further amend the said Bills already formulated incorporating the said amendments and to seek the views of the Provincial Councils in terms of the provisions of Article 154G of the 13th Amendment to the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 for the approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to present the Gazette Notification No.2214/56 dated 2021‑02‑11 issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969, incorporating the provisions enabling to permit the importation of ceramic products which had been suspended temporarily, on 180 day Credit basis and to permit the importation of sarees other than Batik, Handloom and Apparels on 90 day Credit basis, in Parliament for approval in terms of Section 20 of the said Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The proposed Assets Utilization Reform Commission Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - In line with the Budget Speech of 2021, expeditious measures have to be taken for ensuring the maximum and effective use of under utilized assets including lands in the national interest and advancement of the national economy. Especially, it has been a priority requirement to introduce an appropriate procedure for the use of under utilized state lands given on long term lease basis, condominium property of which the construction activities have been delayed due to many reasons and under utilized lands including State Enterprises with assets in maximum productive manner. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President to establish an institute as the Assets Utilization Reform Commission and provide for the required legal provisions to the said Commission to take necessary action for effective utilization of the under utilized assets so identified and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to formulate the Assets Utilization Reform Commission Bill incorporating the provisions required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaring the National Sports Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - It was decided by the Cabinet at the meeting held on 2014‑07‑10 to declare 06th April of every year as the National Sports Day of Sri Lanka. However, it is difficult to attract the attention of people towards this day due to the festive season and preparation for the New year celebrations in the country. Since athletes and the entire public should be made aware of and interested in sports by declaring a Sports Day, varied sports related groups have pointed out the necessity of declaring another suitable day as the National Sports Day. Taking into consideration this matter, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth and Sports to declare 31st July, the day Mr. Duncan White won the Silver medal in 400m Hurdles at an Olympics adding a dignity to Sri Lanka, as the National Sports Day, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Youth Enterprise Development Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - A major challenge faced by the community of youth entering the field of business as new entrepreneurs is the dearth of sufficient financial resources for investing in their businesses. And, the young entrepreneurs already involved in the field of business also confront various issues in securing the required financial resources. It has been made clear that the youth entrepreneurs face several difficulties consequent to their attempts to secure the required financial resources through various informal methods. It has been proposed through the national policy framework of the Government, 'Vistas of Prosperity & Splendour', to initiate a Youth Development Fund and a Youth Development Lottery for promoting the said Fund. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth and Sports to establish the said Fund through a Parliamentary Act and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Assistance from Radio Broadcasting Services for continuous implementation of the Learning - Teaching Process in the Education System during the period of COVID-19 pandemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - 'Gurugedara' Educational programmes are telecast through 'Channel Eye' and 'Nethra TV' covering the subjects from Grade 3 to Grade 13 for continuation of education activities of school students without interruption in face of the COVID-19 pandemic situation. Accordingly, it has been made clear that it would be appropriate to use radio channels to broadcast the educational programs which are being telecast through television, to the areas those are not covered. As it is able to listen to the educational programs through smart phones in addition to the radios while such educational programs are aired through radio, a large number of students are able to listen to those programs. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to broadcast such educational programs through national radio channels and regional radio channels of Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a research project for Improved Productivity, Efficiency and Sustainability of the Culture-based Fishery for Fin-fish and Giant Freshwater Prawn in Sri Lankan Reservoirs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-23
decision_details_body: - Rearing of giant freshwater prawns in Sri Lanka has been identified as a field that can be improved as a high potential business and provide benefits to the rural fisheries community. As releasing those freshwater prawn fry to the freshwater reservoirs is not carried out in a scientific manner, it has been identified appropriate to conduct a scientific research in this regard. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to implement the said research project between the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka, University of Ruhuna, University of Jaffna, National Aquaculture Development Authority, National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency (NARA) with the James Cook University of Australia and to enter into a Research Agreement among the said institutes for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of adequate stocks of Rice to the market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-15
decision_details_body: - Attention of the Cabinet was focused on the non availability of adequate stocks of Rice at controlled prices in the market and the Cabinet discussed possible alternatives that can be taken in this regard. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to convert the stocks of paddy purchased from farmers by the Paddy Marketing Board into rice initially and distribute them continuously through the network of sales outlets of Sathosa and to consider alternative measures to be taken further considering the progress of the said arrangement.

description: Procurement of Construction Machines and Equipment and other Logistics and Transport Vehicles and supply of the same to the State Owned Entities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-15
decision_details_body: - The Government has planned to implement many development projects in the fields of Highways, Irrigation, Buildings and other sectors. However, when considering the capacity of the construction industry and the local construction contractors, it has been observed that implementation of such development projects as expected can be difficult. Under this circumstance, a number of important projects identified are expected to be handed over to the government institutions engaged in construction works for implementation. Accordingly, it has been planned to increase the capacity of the Government owned institutions engaged in the construction related work by procuring and supplying earth moving and construction machinery and equipment, road and building construction machinery and equipment, other equipment related to such activities, pre-fabricated buildings and goods transportation and service supply vehicles and maintenance vehicles required to implement these projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Highways to purchase the said machineries by following the relevant procurement procedure under the Supplier’s Credit Facility scheme awarded by such equipment manufactures in collaboration with local counterparts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of New Tax Proposals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-15
decision_details_body: - Bills have been drafted by the legal draftsman to amend the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017 and the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002 in order to implement tax reforms made by the “Economic Revival Initiative” presented to introduce a simple, transparent and an effective tax system as pledged by H.E the President to the people along with the tax reforms and policy decisions relating to the budget proposals for the year 2021. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said bills and therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, to publish the said bills in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enacting an Act for the Preservation of Thripitaka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-15
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has been recognized as the centre of Buddhism and it is a responsibility of the Government to protect and foster Buddhasasana while giving the foremost place for Buddhism. In 1956, the Thripitaka has been printed with sinhala translations to commemorate the Sambudhha Jayanthi of the 2500th year of Buddhist Era. By the Gazette Notification dated 2019‑02‑07, Thripitaka has been declared as a National Heritage whereas by the same Gazette Notification it has been prevented the opportunities of revising, making wrong interpretations and translating Thripitaka without the permission of the Government. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs, to pass an Act for the Preservation of Thripitaka for protecting the same for future generation and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a Cargo Freighter for SriLankan Airlines Limited (SLA) on lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-15
decision_details_body: - The fleet of SriLankan Airlines Limited contained a grater share of economical narrow-body aircraft. In consequence of that, more attention has been drawn on predominantly passenger route network in the recent years which resulted in under utilization of cargo potential due to the non-availability of suitable aircraft to cater to the cargo operations. With the COVID – 19 outbreak, most of the Aviation Companies have paid attention on cargo transportation due to the limitation of passenger transportation. SriLankan Airlines maintains its cargo operations for 26 destinations and it has been found that this is a great opportunity to access to cargo market share on key routes, taking into consideration the present market changes. Accordingly, taking into account the potentiality of cargo operations, it has been planned to strategically change the current business model of SriLankan Airlines Limited. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to obtain a Cargo Freighter for SriLankan Airlines Limited on lease basis, following the International Competitive Procurement Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme to establish a Homeshop in one household in every Grama Niladhari Division, targeting young women entrepreneurs selected from Samurdhi families
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-15
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Highways has planned to implement a programme by the name of Homeshop in every Grama Niladhari division in association with the relevant line ministries and other institutions targeting 25,000 young women entrepreneurs selected from Samurdhi families to strengthen the food distribution network. National level guidance for this project will be provided by the Task Force on Economic Revival and Poverty Elevation while monitoring of the project will be carried out by the State Ministry of Samurdhi, Household Economy, Micro Finance, Self Employment and Business Development. This programme is planned to be implemented through the 100,000 km development pogramme under the Ministry of Highways covering the entire island. The proposed Homeshops will be constructed adjoining the roads those are proposed to be constructed under 100,000 kilo meter of roads development project and are to be constructed with a floor area of 200, 300, 400 and 500 square feets depending on the requirement. Accordingly, the proposal submitted by the Minister of Highways for implementation of the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition of "Anderson Golf Links Ground" where Shalika Stadium and Sports Complex is located, by the Sri Lanka Transport Board through a Free Grant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-15
decision_details_body: - The land called "Anderson Golf Links Ground" in extent of 3.4125 hectares, where the Shalika Stadium and Sports Complex is located, has been in the custody of the Sri Lanka Transport Board since 1966. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence to the joint proposal made by the Minister of Transport and the Minister of Lands to transfer the said land to the Sri Lanka Transport Board through a Free Grant in accordance with the provisions of the State Land Ordinance, subject to non awarding the right of selling the land to another party and charging its unimproved value to the Government.

description: Obtaining assistance of Television Services for continuous implementation of the Learning - Teaching process in the Education System during the period of Covid 19- pandemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-15
decision_details_body: - The 'Guru Gedara' programme, prepared by the National Institute of Education was telecast combining the 'Channel Eye' and 'Nethra TV' of Sri Lanka Rupawahini Corporation to continue the academic activities of the students, sitting for Grade 5 Scholarship Examination, G.C.E (O/L) Examination and G.C.E (A/L) Examination, during the period when schools were closed due to the Covid-19 pandemic from March, 2020. In order to prevent the disruption of students' education due to the delay caused in the commencement of the third school term in 2020, telecasting Sinhala and Tamil medium educational programmes from Grade 3 to Grade 13 under the phase 2 of 'Guru Gedara' programme has been started on 16 November, 2020. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to continue the 'Guru Gedara' educational programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation in the field of Higher Education between the Ministry of Education of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Higher Education Commission of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-15
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Education of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Higher Education Commission of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan in order to implement an Educational and Scientific Knowledge Exchange Scholarship Programme in the field of higher education for a period of five years, enabling to strengthen mutual corporation in the field of education and to enhance the educational opportunities between two countries. The Government of Pakistan has agreed to grant 1000 Scholarships as 800 Full Scholarships and 200 Tuition Fee Waiver Partial Scholarships for undergraduate degrees under this MoU within the relevant period. Further, it is expected to exchange 50 Sri Lankan/Pakistan University Faculty members between two countries for research, seminars and other academic activities for a specific period of time. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Industrial Promotion Act No.46 of 1990
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - It has been found that the provisions of the existing Industry Promotion Act, No.46 of 1990 is inadequate to make industrial policies which assist to fulfil timely requirements of the industrial sector relating to technology, trade, skills and environmental concerns. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to appoint a Steering Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Ministry of Industries and comprising of representatives of relevant government institutions, private sector industry organizations / chamber of industries with a view to preparing a draft Bill to amend the Industry Promotion Act, No.46 of 1990 to suit with the present, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending legislations to require security deposit when filling appeals, revisions and writ applications against grants and decisions granted under the Termination of Employment of Workmen (Special Provisions) Act No. 45 of 1971 and Industrial Disputes Act No. 43 of 1950
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - The Termination of Employment of Workmen (Special Provisions) Act No. 45 of 1971 has been introduced with a view to preventing the termination of employment of employees and it has ensured the job security of workmen by constituting legal action against employers who act deviating from the provisions of the said Act. Similarly, the Industrial Disputes Act, No.43 of 1950 has been introduced with a view to solving industrial disputes between employers and employees expeditiously in a reasonable manner. Further, in the circumstances where orders are made in favour of employers under the above two Acts, it has been observed that there is a tendency of constituting legal action by employers to prevent the enforcement of such orders. In this context, it has been observed that there are instances where nearly 15-20 years have lapsed for the implementation of relevant orders and that the employees could not receive the expected relief due to the death of employers, migration, avoidance of courts and liquidation of companies during the aforesaid period, Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to amend the Termination of Employment of Workmen (Special Provisions) Act No. 45 of 1971and the Industrial Disputes Act, No.43 of 1950, enabling to initiate the litigation process only after furnishing security deposit when employers institute legal actions against an Order of the Commissioner General of Labour under  the Termination of Employment of Workmen (Special Provisions) Act, No.45 of 1971 or a decision of the Magistrate’s Court to enforce such Order or against Industrial Arbitration award or an Industrial Court award under the provisions of the Industrial Disputes Act No.43 of 1950, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting up a Pharma Zone in Millewa, Horana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - In line with the policies of the new government, strategic measures are being used by the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation to manufacture most pharmaceuticals locally. Accordingly, the establishment of pharma zones in Arabokka in the Hambantota District and Oyamaduwa in the Anuradhapura District has now been initiated. In addition, another Pharma Zone is scheduled to be established in Millewa, Horana. Orthopedic and Neuro-Surgical Implants, Oncology drugs, Oral Solid Dosage products and Cardiac Stents and Intra Ocular Lenses are expected to be manufactured in this Pharma Zone. The project is scheduled to be implemented under two phases and the first phase of the project is expected to commence in March 2021 with an estimated investment of Rs. 8 billion. A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has already been entered into between the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation and the Urban Development Authority to allocate a block of land in extent of 64 acres and 83.3 perches in Millewa area belonging to the Urban Development Authority to establish the proposed Pharma Zone. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Housing and Urban Development and the Minister of Health to appoint a Steering Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Ministry of Finance, comprising of the representatives of other relevant Ministries and Institutions enabling to implement the proposed project expeditiously and to appoint a Project Management Committee headed by the Chairman of the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation to provide the necessary technical matters to the said Steering Committee and to appoint Selendiva Investment Company, a fully state-owned company, as the Project Manager to provide pre- and post-contract and financial consultancy services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Police is a leading entity empowered to ensure the safety and security of the public and to maintain law and order. It also provides multiple services to people across the country. It has been found the necessity to modernize the Sri Lanka Police by changing the traditional systems followed at present. In this context, it has been identified that the traffic handling process should be made effective and efficient through modern methods. In particular, priority should be given to streamlining the work of the Police Traffic and Road Safety Division using digitization solutions to reduce existing traffic congestion in urban areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to appoint a steering committee to design a project to monitor the overall modernization process of the Sri Lanka Police and implement the same, giving priority to the aforesaid purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a new company to direct local products to foreign 	markets
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - On a concept of the State Ministry of Batik, Handloom Fabric and Local Apparel Productions, it has been found the necessity of setting up a leading institution to promote Sri Lankan products by establishing overseas showrooms thereby creating a strong international trade network through the selected representatives from those countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to establish a new company with 100% shares of Lanka Salusala Limited for the purpose and to implement a programme to promote local products including Batik products, Handloom Fabric products, and local apparel products through the foreign agents appointed by the said company and showrooms, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Carrying out surveys to mark the reserve boundaries of tanks/ anicuts under the 'Wari Saubhagya' Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - It has been scheduled to rehabilitate approximately 5000 tanks/ anicuts under the 'Wari Saubhagya' Program during the period of next 04 years. The Survey Department has informed that the adequate human resources are not available in the Department at present to complete the surveys of such a large number of tanks within period of 03 years. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation and the Minister of Lands to recruit 70 students who have graduated from Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka or Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and are awaiting for survey training, to the Department of Survey for a period of three years on temporary basis and attach them to the Department of Irrigation with a view to conducting surveys under the supervision of two senior surveyors of the Survey Department, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a block of land for the construction of Rakwana Veterinary Office
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - The Hapugasthenna Plantation Ltd has granted its concurrence to allocate a block of land without compensation to construct a new building to the Rakwana Veterinary Office functioning under the Department of Animal Production and Health of Sabaragamuwa Province, since the building in which the said office maintains is in very dilapilated condition. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Services, Provincial Councils and Local Government to allocate a block of land in extent of 0.15 hectares from Haderly part of Haderly Estate belonging to the Hapugasthenna Plantation Ltd without paying compensation for the construction of Rakwana Veterinary Office, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of Inter-Provincial Passenger bus operations in the face of the COVID-19 pandemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body:
- Approval has been granted by the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2020‑11‑09 to release the permit renewal fees, late fees, tender fees, log fees, entrance fees and Expressway Temporary Permit fees which are charged from bus operators until the end of year 2020, in order to continue the Inter-Provincial Passenger bus operations in the face of the COVID-19 pandemic situation. As it seems that it may take more time for bus operations to return to normal condition, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport to provide the following reliefs out of those mentioned above, further up to 2021‑03‑31, was approved by the Cabinet.

* Charging a 10% of the annual tender fee or a sum of Rs.15,000/-, whichever is higher out of them.

* Charging a 10% of the Expressway Temporary Permit Fee.

* Exemption from log and entrance fees.

description: Implementation of Phase II of the Project for Improving Management of the Marine resources in Sri Lanka with the Technical Assistance from the Government of Norway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - Phase I of the Project for 'Improving Management of the Marine resources in Sri Lanka' has been implemented under the Bilateral Corporation between the Governments of Sri Lanka and Norway, within the period from 2017 to 2020. It has been proposed to implement the Phase II of the said project also under the Norwegian Grant Assistance. Under the proposed project, it has been planned to pursue action in collaboration with the Institute of Marine Research (IMR) of Norway and the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency (NARA) of Sri Lanka for the purpose of improving management of the marine fishery resources in Sri Lanka. Improvement of collection, storage and use of fisheries data and enhancing the capacity of fisheries research for sustainable management of marine fishery resources are to take place under the said Phase of the project. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency (NARA) of Sri Lanka and the Institute of Marine Research (IMR) of Norway for the implementation of the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the 'National Management and Regulatory Committee on Early Childhood Education'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - In terms of the existing legal framework, the Early Childhood Education System of Sri Lanka is steered under the coordination of several institutional layers belonging to the Central Government and Provincial Councils and the need for empowering the process of maintaining and monitoring the standards of the field at national level, has been recognized. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to appoint a Committee titled as the 'National Management and Regulatory Committee on Early Childhood Education' comprising the field experts and decision-making officials, to regulate, monitor and provide guidance for Pre-schools, Early Childhood Development Centres and Day Care Centres at national level, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Institutionalisation of the National Innovation Agency (NIA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - In view of coordinating the Ministries, Institutions and the Private sector for creating, improving and sustaining a national innovation eco-system and providing support required for the relevant innovations from idea to market, the National Innovation Agency (NIA) has been established by the Parliamentary Act, No.22 of 2019. Institutionalisation of the NIA has been recognized as a priority task of the State Ministry of Skills Development, Vocational Education, Research and Innovation, which falls under the purview of the Ministry of Education. Approval has been granted by the Cabinet in 2017 to formulate a Bill for establishing the Coordinating Secretariat for Science, Technology and Innovation (COSTI), which has been set up for the Science, Technology and Innovation related tasks and functions under the said State Ministry, as the National Science Technology and Innovation Coordinating Authority (NASTICA). The aims and functions of the proposed NASTICA are also more similar to the functions of the NIA. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to suspend the establishment of the said Authority and to institutionalise the NIA by using funds and other resources allocated for the COSTI, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishing the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious & Cultural Affairs and the institutions falling under its purview, in one dedicated building
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - Since the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious & Cultural Affairs and the Departments and Institutions under its purview are being maintained at different locations, need has arisen to establish the Ministry and the said institutions in one dedicated building. The 09 storeyed building being constructed for the Department of Muslim Religious and Cultural Affairs at D. R. Wijewardena Mawatha, Colombo 10 has been identified suitable for this purpose. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious & Cultural Affairs to transfer the said building and the land on which it is located, to the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious & Cultural Affairs and to complete its construction activities thereafter and, establish the Ministry and all institutions under its purview in the said building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Document of Understanding between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and COMSATS University, Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - The Interdisciplinary Research Center in Biomedical Materials (IRCBM) of COMSATS University, Pakistan is an institute that sustains a number of international Patent Licenses pertaining to the field of Biomaterials Tissue Engineering. It has been proposed to sign a Document of Understanding to exchange knowledge on the fields such as Biomaterials, Tissue Engineering, Regenerative Medicine, Sensors and Biosensors and to conduct cooperative researches on the sectors that are mutually important to both countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to sign the proposed Document of Understanding between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and the COMSATS University, Pakistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accreditation of the National Defence College under the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-08
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted by the Cabinet at its meeting held on 18‑12‑2019 to draft the 'Sri Lanka National Defence College Act' for the purpose of incorporating the 'National Defence College' through a Parliamentary Act. The academic activities of the College are to commence in May, 2021 and the above Act will provide the legal provisions required for awarding the ndc qualification to the students who complete a full-time course of 11 months successfully. Many countries around the world, through their National Defence Colleges, offer MSc or MPhil degrees in affiliation with the National Universities. As such, taking into consideration this matter, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to accredit the National Defence College under the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University, to enable the University to offer Postgraduate degrees to the students who are taking the course at the National Defence College, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report on the progress of the Development Projects implemented under the Line Ministries by the end of the financial year 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body:
- In terms of the Cabinet decision dated 2018‑04‑25, the Ministry of Finance should submit a report on the physical progress of the projects implemented by the Line Ministries through the Capital budget, to the Cabinet on quarterly basis. As such, the progress report pertaining to the large scale projects implemented in the year 2020 was submitted by the Minister of Finance to the Cabinet. The following information was brought to the notice of the Cabinet through the said report:

* 	289 development projects of which the estimated cost exceeds Rs. 01 billion in the year 2020, have been implemented under the purview of 40 Line Ministries.

*	An allocation of around Rs.710 billion has been made for the said projects and its financial progress amounts to 72%.

*	A further allocation of Rs.2.9 trillion has to be made approximately for future activities of the said 289 development projects.

*	There have been various issues and impediments during the implementation of these projects and although around Rs.08 billion has been spent for the additional staff dedicated for the project, it has been observed in this report that the expected results could not be achieved within the approved cost and duration pertaining to certain projects.

*	Certain weaknesses have been observed since the per-preparatory stage of certain projects and the delay caused in obtaining the required approvals from Public Institutions has sometimes become a problem in the implementation of the projects.

Taking into consideration also the information furnished in the said report by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Cabinet decided to appoint a Committee comprising the Senior Secretaries and headed by the State Minister of Money & Capital Market and State Enterprise Reforms, to resolve the issues regarding the large scale Capital budget projects and to conduct monthly reviews on obtaining the optimum and timely assistance from the relevant parties.

description: Recruitment to Grade III of the Sri Lanka Principals Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - At present, there are 4,600 vacancies in Grades I, II and III of the Sri Lanka Principals Service and it has been observed that, due to the COVID-19 pandemic situation prevailing in the country, it will take more than one year to conduct a competitive examination and structured interviews for the purpose of granting formal appointments. Taking into consideration these matters, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to take necessary action to conduct a structured interview in place of a competitive examination to select the qualified persons and appoint them to Grade III of the Sri Lanka Principals Service, limiting it only to this occasion, providing the opportunity to the qualified officers belonging to the Teachers Service who have been acting and covering the duties in the post of Principal for a long period and also to the other officers belonging to the Teachers Service who fulfill qualifications in terms of the Service Minute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report of the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation held on 2021-01-12
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body:
- The concept papers submitted for the purpose of drafting the following Bills, have been referred to the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Legislation on approval by the Cabinet, to examine and submit its recommendations. Taking into consideration the recommendations of the said Sub‑Committee, the proposals referred to in the Cabinet Memoranda submitted by the Minister of Education in his capacity as the Chairman of the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Legislation to draft the relevant Bills, were approved by the Cabinet.

* 	Enactment of a new legislation in place of the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act 

*	Muslim Marriage and Divorce (Amendment) Bill

*	Amendment to the Penal Code (Chapter 19) (Protection of Human Dignity and Social Harmony, Fake News and Hate Speech)

*	Amendment to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 0f 1979 (Protection of Human Dignity and Social Harmony, Fake News and Hate Speech)

description: Repealing sections 285, 286 and 286A of the Penal Code
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2020‑09‑29 to draft a Bill on Prohibition of Obscene Publications. Upon passing the said Bill, the Obscene Publications Ordinance of 1927 will be repealed and at the same time, sections 285, 286 and 286A of the Penal Code will be redundant. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to draft a Bill for repealing the said sections of the Penal Code, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repealing the Youth Corps Act and establishment of the Youth Corps as an Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2011‑12‑15 to repeal the Youth Corps Act, No.21 of 2002 and draft a Bill for the establishment of the Youth Corps Authority. Although the Legal Draftsman has accordingly drafted a Bill, no further action has been taken in this regard. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth & Sports to instruct the Legal Draftsman to finalise drafting the said Bill incorporating the further amendments to be made to enable to repeal the Youth Corps Act, No.21 of 2002 and to establish the Youth Corps Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repealing the Botanic Gardens Ordinance, No.31 of 1928 and introduction of a new Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - The Botanic Gardens Ordinance, No.31 of 1928 as amended by the Act, No.32 of 1973 applies largely to the functions of the Department of National Botanic Gardens. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to amend the provisions of the said Ordinance which is around 90 years old, to suit the present needs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of six (06) Civil Works Contract Packages for rehabilitation, improvement and maintenance of the Kekirawa - Thalawa - Ganewalpola - Dachchihalmillewa Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - Competitive bids have been invited for six (06) Civil Works Contract Packages for rehabilitation, improvement and maintenance of the Kekirawa - Thalawa - Ganewalpola - Dachchihalmillewa Road in the North Central Province, under the Asian Development Bank funded Integrated Road Investment Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Highways to award the relevant contracts as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the authority limits of the Procurement Committees
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted to provide provisions for the implementation of a large number of projects which provide immediate benefits to the public, within the 2021-2023 Medium Term Budgetary Framework. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to increase the authority limits of the existing contract awarding in respect of the subject matters pertaining to the Ministry of Highways, Ministry of Water Supply, Ministry of Irrigation, Ministry of Power, Ministry of Ports & Shipping and the Ministry of Urban Development & Housing, to enable the implementation of the said projects expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Three Year Plan for the improvement of the infrastructure facilities in the Judicial Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - The undue delay in the mechanism of the administration of justice in Sri Lanka has become a challenge in ensuring the rule of law within the country. This situation depicts in many of the international indicators and it directly affects for the foreign investments as well. Therefore, it is vitally important to supply adequate human and physical resources to the judicial sector, apply of novel technology, strengthen the dispute resolution mechanism alternative to litigation process as well as introducing necessary law reforms in order to resolve this issue. Therefore, it has been proposed to allocate Rs. 20,000 million from the budget for the year 2021 for the implementation of a three – year plan for enhancing infrastructure facilities within the judicial sector. Accordingly, the proposal submitted by the Minister of Justice for the implementation of a project to develop infrastructure facilities in the judicial sector under 06 selected subject areas utilizing the given provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the Swashakthi Loan Scheme to provide loan facilities for the development of Small and Medium Scale Business Sector and generating employments
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2020‑10‑26 to implement the Swashakthi Loan Scheme which is functioning under the Ministry of Youth and Sports, with necessary amendments to provide loan facilities for the development of Small and Medium Scale Business Sector and generating employments. Out of the loans granted under this loan scheme, 58% has been granted for the existing enterprises whereas 42% of the loans has been provided to new enterprises. Accordingly, the Cabinet granted its concurrence to the proposal submitted by the Minister of Youth and Sports for providing opportunity to obtain loan facilities under the Swashakthi loan scheme also for the existing enterprises of small and medium scale entrepreneurs who are looking forward to scaling up their business through new product development or market development and to provide loan facilities not exceeding Rs.2 million.

description: Establishment of the Proposed Mangrove Botanic Gardens in Akmeemana, Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - The Department of National Botanical Gardens has planed to establish a new Mangrove Botanic Garden in a land in extent of 26.71 hectares in close - proximity to the Pinnaduwa Expressway entrance in Nugaduwa Grama Niladhari division of the Akmeemana divisional secretariat division. Since no institution has so far been in operation including the National Botanical Gardens for ex – situ conservation of mangrove in Sri Lanka, this Mangrove Botanic Garden will fulfil that requirement. Furthermore, establishment of this proposed Mangrove Botanic Garden will pave the way for the upliftment of the tourism industry and will assist the national and international researches on mangrove species. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism for the establishment of the proposed Mangrove Botanic Garden, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Committee for development of the rubber cultivation and related industries in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - The global demand for sanitary devices including the gloves that are manufactured using rubber has been tremendously increased due to the prevailing global pandemic situation of COVID – 19 and therefore, there is a national requirement to produce raw rubber locally to meet the requirement of local rubber products. For the purpose, the need to appoint a coordinating committee which will function consolidating planters and industrialists encouraging the local rubber industry together with the public and private sector institutions directly linked with the manufacturing raw rubber as well as rubber manufacturing industries has been identified. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation to appoint a Committee by the name of “Inter-institutional Coordinating Committee for Development of Rubber Cultivation and Industries” under the chairmanship of the Secretary, Ministry of Plantation and comprising of the representatives of other relevant Ministries and Institutions to continue and maintain the value chain of rubber industry in Sri Lanka with a sound performance, to discuss and settle the available issues in the sector, and to submit policy recommendations to the Government.

description: Rename the 'Certification Body for Qualification and Certification of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) personnel' as 'National Certification Body for Qualification and Certification of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) personnel'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - The Certification Body for Qualification and Certification of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) personnel functions as an independent entity under Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Board for the certification of non – destructive testing certification and personnel while promoting non – destructive testing training and testing services. Each country should establish a National Certification Body for Qualification and Certification of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) personnel' to achieve international recognition for NDT training and certification. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Power to rename the already established 'Certification Body for Qualification and Certification of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) personnel' as 'National Certification Body for Qualification and Certification of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) personnel', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Wattegedara Wewa in Matale District, identified under 'Gama Samaga Pilisandara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - It was decided at the programme ‘Gama Samanga Pilisandara’ held at Himbiliyakada in the Divisional Secretariat division of Wilgamuwa in Matale district to open the way for a higher income generation for poor people whose livelihood is Agriculture by taking necessary measures for the supply of water for approximately 1,010 acres of new cultivable lands while making remedies for the prevailing water shortage for land in extent 1,300 acres nourished by Himbiliyakada Wewa. Accordingly, the Department of Irrigation has designed a project to supply water by constructing Wattegedara Wewa and Dodamgolla Wewa across Gemburu Oya and supplying water to both Wattegedara Wewa and Himbiliyakada Wewa through a 1,800 metre long tunnel from the right bank main channel of Kalu Ganga reservoir. The estimated cost for the proposed project will be approximately Rs. 7,155 million while its construction has been planned to be completed within a period of 03 years from 2021 – 2023. The proposals made by the Minister of Irrigation to initiate the construction activities of Watthegedara wewa during the year 2021 with the use of machinery of the Department of Irrigation and labour contribution from the Sri Lanka Army as well as the villagers, and to allocate the provisions required for the project from the medium term budgetary framework 2021-2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of the land and buildings owned by the National Housing Development Authority located at Thammannagama, Anamaduwa with the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - The 'Gam Uda' land in extent of 3.585 hectares and its all buildings located in Thammannagama, Anamaduwa has been vested with the National Housing Development Authority by a special grant. The Ceylon German Technical Training Institute (CGTTI) has made a request for that land and its buildings in order to establish its Aanamaduwa Regional Centre whereas the National Housing Development Authority has given its consent to vest in the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to transfer the said land and buildings back to the Government and to vest the same with the CGTTI on a free grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Administration of temporary shelters for providing protection to female victims of violence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - Temporary protection shelters for female have been constructed in the Northern, Eastern, Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces for the provision of temporary protection for female victims of violence and their children and out of which agreements have been signed with non-governmental organizations Women In Need (WIN) and Jaffna Social Action Centre (JSAC) with effect from the year 2018 for administration of the shelters in Jaffna, Mullaitivu, Batticaloa, Colombo and Matara. The proposal made by the Minister of Education for further obtaining the service of those non – governmental organizations to carry out the administrative activities of the relevant temporary shelters during the year 2021 too, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement on Co-operation and Mutual Administrative Assistance in Customs Matter between Sri Lanka and Turkey
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has already entered into agreements with several selected trade partnership countries including India, Pakistan and China on co‑operation and mutual administrative assistance in Customs matters. A proposal has been made to enter into a similar agreement between Sri Lanka and Turkey with the objective of facilitating for legitimate trade through transparent and predictable procedures, reducing trade cost between the two countries and combating the illicit traffic of narcotic drugs. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance for signing the relevant Agreement between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Final Report of the Presidential Commission of Inquiry to Investigate and Inquire into the Allegations and Frauds considered to have been committed in Public Institutions during the period from 2015-01-14 to 2018-12-31, in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-03-01
decision_details_body: - The final report of the above Commission appointed by the warrant of the President on 2019‑01‑14 under the chairmanship of Upaly Abeyrathne Esquire, Retired Judge of the Supreme Court has been handed over to the then President. The proposal made by H.E the president to submit the said report in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Paddy Purchasing Programme for the Maha Season 2020/21
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet reviewed the progress of the Paddy Purchasing Programme for the Maha Season 2020/21 and granted approval to take necessary action to purchase paddy competitively along with the private sector to ensure the highest price for farmers under the said Programme. Further, if paddy was purchased under a higher price, the Cabinet decided to maintain the price of Nadu rice as Rs. 98/- per kilogramme without change.

description: Implementation of Budget Proposals, Amendments to Tax Legislations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - A simple, transparent and efficient tax system has been introduced for all parties of the economy by the Budget Proposals 2021. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to prepare a draft Bill to implement the said tax proposals and to take other measures related thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Corporation between the Board of Investment of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka  and the Board of Investment of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding has been proposed to be entered into between the Board of Investment of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka  and the Board of Investment of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to promote investment corporation between two countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to enter into the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the International Centre for Chemical and Biological Sciences, University of Karachi of Pakistan and Industrial Technology Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding on Education and Research has been proposed to be entered into between the International Centre for Chemical and Biological Sciences, University of Karachi of Pakistan and the Industrial Technology Institute. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Intent of Cooperation between COMSATS University Islamabad, Pakistan and Industrial Technology Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - An Intent of Cooperation on Education and Research has been proposed to be signed between the COMSATS University Islamabad of Pakistan and the Industrial Technology Institute of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology to sign the said  Intent of Cooperation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of 2000 Three Wheelers for Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - Due to the absence of adequate number of vehicles for the Sri Lanka Police to perform their duties properly as the leading institution assigned the functions of enforcing law and safeguarding law and order in the country, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to purchase 2000 Three Wheelers  as an immediate solution for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Pilot Project for distribution of eco-friendly organic fertilizer - distribution of fertilizer for paddy cultivation in Yala Season 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - A pilot project has been implemented for providing organic fertilizer and and organic liquid fertilizer free of charge to the farmers in selected districts with a view to promoting the use of eco- friendly organic fertilizer during the Yala Season 2020 and Maha Season 2020/21.  It should be cultivated at least 04 Seasons under the same methodology to determine the productivity of the said pilot project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to continue the said pilot project in the Yala Season - 2021 as well and to appoint a Negotiating Committee to purchase  necessary organic fertilizer and organic liquid fertilizer from Licensed Fertilizer Manufactures based on the recommendations made by the Fertilizer Advisory Committee and to provide the selected farmers in the relevant Districts with fertilizer in line with the recommendations of the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: COVID - 19 Vaccine Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body:
- The Ministry of Health has planned to vaccinate 14 million people of the total population of the country against the COVID-19 pandemic. Accordingly, the following proposals made by the Acting Minister of Health, were approved by the Cabinet. 
    • to sign the Standardized Indemnification Agreement forwarded by the COVAX mechanism, enabling to obtain the COVID - 19 Vaccine under the 	COVAX facility expeditiously.
    • to purchase 10 million doses of Oxford AstraZenceca Vaccine from the Serum Institute Life Sciences Private Limited as a direct procurement at a sum of US$ 52.5 million, by the Sri Lanka State Pharmaceuticals Corporation.
    • to enter into an Agreement by the Sri Lanka State Pharmaceuticals Corporation to purchase 3.5 million doses of COVID - 19 Vaccines manufactured by the AstraZeneca Institute of Great Britain.

description: National Action Plan to Monitor and Combat Human Trafficking
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - The Action Plan to Monitor and Combat Human Trafficking to be implemented  during the period from 2021-2025 has been prepared by reviewing the Action Plan operated from 2015-2019 and taking into consideration the experiences gained in the implementation of the said plan and the views expressed by the others parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to implement the National Action Plan to Monitor and Combat Human Trafficking 2021-2025, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of confiscated sand and timber
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted its approval to provide sand and timber confiscated by the Courts located countrywide for construction and renovation purposes of the places of religious worship at concessionary prices and the said approval has lasted on 2020‑12‑31. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to revise the methodology adopted at present under the said Programme and implement further, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion of the Kalutara Industrial Estate
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - The Kalutara Industrial Estate has been set up in a land in extent of 50 acres called “Pullerton Estate” and at present, 33 investors have set up factories and its commercial production activities are successfully being carried out. Those investors have invested at around Rs. 837 million and have provided about 775 job opportunities. Although both local and foreign investors have forwarded to set up industries in the western province, no land blocks remain in any of the 08 industrial estates set up in the western province. Taking these into consideration, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to release the Government owned land in extent of 1.946 hectares located adjacent to the Kalutara Industrial Estate  to expand the said industrial estate and to allocate such lands to the industrialists under the Regional Industrial Estate Development Programme, having fulfilled required infrastructure facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Handing over the office premises of the Ministry of Industries to the Urban Development Authority and shifting the Ministry to a new office premises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - The premises in which the Ministry of Industries is presently being established is in extent of 01 Acre and 7 perches and it is located in a place with high economic and commercial value. According to the estimate of the Government Valuer its current value  amounts to Rs. 2.32 billion. Therefore, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to  hand over the said office premises with the Urban Development Authority, enabling to utilize the land for a more productive task with an economic value and in return, to obtain a furnished building of 50,000 square feet with parking facilities for 75 vehicles to the Ministry of Industries from the said Authority.

description: Proclamation of proposed Hambantota Elephant Management Reserve
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - Ongoing rapid development projects in the Hambantota district have caused a severe impact on the Wildlife habitats including that of wild elephants and their foraging ways and it has resulted in increasing human-elephant conflict. As a remedy for the issue, the Department of Wildlife Conservation has taken initiatives to proclaim  an  Elephant Management Reserve for wild elephants and other creatures, having ensured the expansion of their foraging ways through researches. Accordingly, a land in extent of 23,746.55 hectares belonging to the Department of Forest Conservation and Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka has been identified for the proposed reserve. The Gazette Notification incorporating guidelines and regulations required for the purpose  has been drafted with the concurrence of the Department of Forest Conservation and Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka. Therefore, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation and the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Conservation to publish the said Gazette Notification in the Government Gazette after obtaining  the concurrence of the Legal Draftsman for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Fast Tracking Investment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - Recently few internationally recognized investors have shown their interest to invest in Sri Lanka. However, since the existing mechanism to facilitate such investors seems to be  lengthy, relevant investors themselves have to implement projects through the investment authorities of Sri Lanka. Under these circumstances, the Government has found the immediate necessity to initiate a more formal mechanism to encourage such investments. As such the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, to appoint a Committee called “Cabinet Appointed Management Committee on Investment” under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Treasury and with the participation of relevant secretaries to ministries and the Chairman, Board of Investment of Sri Lanka, and to entrust that Committee with the responsibility of taking necessary measures to grant approval for that investment proposals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations for the approval of Parliament issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - The Gazette Extraordinary Notifications No 2206/5 dated 2020‑12‑14 and No 2207/15  dated 2020‑12‑24 have been issued incorporating the regulations published under  the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 for regulating the importation of local handloom and batik textile, regulating the importation of fishing boats, passenger vessels and boats and relaxing the limitations of importing selected goods which are not locally manufactured  to meet the need of domestic industries. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, to submit such regulations for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendation of the Finance Commission for the Financial Year 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-22
decision_details_body: - The Finance Commission established in accordance with Article 154 R of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka shall make recommendations to H.E the President on the policies to be followed in the disbursement of funds granted by the annual budget for the Provincial Councils. Accordingly, the Finance Commission has submitted those recommendations to H.E the President for the year 2021. As such, the proposal submitted by H.E the President to implement such recommendations made by the said Commission and to present the same in Parliament in terms of Article 154 R (7) of the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979 (Empowering the Magistrate to visit Police Stations)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-15
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure Act. No.15 of 1979, empowering the Magistrate to visit police stations situated within the judicial division to which he is appointed, enabling him to supervise the suspect who is being held in police custody in such police station at least once in every month. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to publish the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in the Government Gazette and to present same thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing special concessions to Mattala Rajapaksha International Airport and Colombo, Rathmalana International Airport to attract airlines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-15
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2020‑12‑21 granted approval to release the landing and parking charges of the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport and the Colombo International Airport as an encouragement for the international charter flight operations implemented according to specific schedules prepared by the Ministry of Tourism and the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the  Minister of Tourism to extend the said concession up to 2021‑07‑19, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Traditional and Rural Industrial Promotion Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-15
decision_details_body:
- An allocation of Rs. 2000 million has been made in the Budget 2021 to assist industrialists engaged in traditional industries to expand their production and to facilitate access to specific commodity markets. Accordingly, the State Ministry of Rattan, Brass, Pottery, Furniture and Rural Industrial Promotion has designed a program to be implemented during the period 2021-2025. The Ministry has identified the following projects under this program and the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to implement the said project, was approved by the Cabinet. 
    • Cultivation of Raw Material Programme for Rural Industries
    • Establishment of Raw Material Bank
    • One Entrepreneur per Village on Rural Industry
    • Establishing a Timber Research and Development Organization
    • Integrated Development on Rural and Traditional Industrial Village
    • Local and Foreign Market Promotion Programme on Rural Industry

description: 100kW Solar Power Generation Programme implementing under private sector investments by connecting to the distribution transformers under the renewable energy promotion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-15
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to obtain maximum amount of energy from the electricity requirement of the country from the renewable energy sources by the year 2030, while adapting the government policy framework “Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour. Further, it is expected to implement the said renewable energy projects mostly under the private sector investments. Accordingly, it has been planned to implement a renewable energy generating project by connecting land based solar power plants to 7000 distribution transformers belonging to the Ceylon Electricity Board and Lanka Electricity Company (Pvt) Ltd. It is expected to implement single solar power project for identified one transformer under this project and to invite bids under competitive procurement process from persons and institutions registered under business names register of the Divisional Secretariat to select investors for this purpose. The investment for the construction of single solar power plant is approximately Rs 12 million and the relevant plant has to be built on a land in extent of 40 perches in close proximity to the transformer. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Power, the Cabinet granted approval to implement the proposed project within 18 months as a rapid project.

description: Introduction of a Transit Card for the Public Transport Service of Sri Lanka and implementation of an Electronic Fare Collection System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2021-02-15
