The project with an investment of US$ 01 billion is proposed to be implemented in two phases comprised of first phase for US$ 400 million and the second phase for US$ 600 million. Considering the strategic importance and the magnitude of the project, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the proposal submitted by the Minister of Industrial Exports and Investment Promotion for the publication of relevant Gazette Notifications under the Strategic Development Projects Act, enabling to provide incentive allowances relevant for the said investments in terms of the provisions of the Strategic Development Projects (Amendment) Act, No.14 of 2008 and the Sri Lanka Board of Investment (Amendment) Act, No.4 of 1978.

description: Temporary suspension of the Tea Promotion and Marketing Levy imposed on the tea exports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: Continuous maintenance of the operational activities of tea factories, relative decline of the procurement power of most of the countries that import tea, supply chain management issues as well as continuous maintenance of quality in the products are the major issues that were faced by the tea industry amidst the COVID 19 pandemic conditions, prevailing within the country at present. Therefore, the Cabinet of Ministers has approved the proposal forwarded by the Minister of Plantation Industries and Export Agriculture to temporarily suspend the tea promotion and marketing tax of  Rs.3.50 already charged on each kilogram of tea exported from the registered exporters, for a period of 06 months as a financial relief granted to stabilize the tea industry amidst the said difficulties.

description: Procurement for the supply of Full Cream Milk Powder to the Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited for the Production of Thriposha for the year 2020/2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: - With the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers, Milco (Pvt.) Ltd. has been awarded the contract for  supplying milk powder required for the manufacturing of Thriposha from the year 2014 to 2019 with the objective of strengthening the economy of the local dairy farmers. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal submitted by the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medical Services for the procurement of 720 metric tons of full cream milk powder required for the production of Thriposha for the year 2020 / 2021 for Sri Lanka Thriposha Ltd., the Cabinet granted approval to procure the said quantity of milk powder from Milco (Pvt.) Ltd. itself.

description: Japanese Yen 800 million Non project Japanese Grant Aid of for supplying medical equipment required for COVID 19 pandemic prevention activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has agreed to provide Japanese Yen 800 million (approximately Rs. 1,360 million) under the Japanese non‑project grant scheme for the supply of medical equipment required for strengthening the activities pertaining to the prevention of COVID-19 pandemic situation within Sri Lanka. Medical equipment such as MRI Scanner, CT Scanner, Bedside X‑Ray Systems, Central Monitors, Bedside Monitors and Defibrillators etc. can be supplied under that. Accordingly, the proposal made by the the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development to obtain the said grant aid as well as to sign the relevant agreements in this regard was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the period of contract awarded to the State Printing Corporation for printing and supplying new Lottery "Daru Diri Sampatha" drawn by the National Lotteries Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: The agreement period of the contract awarded to the State Printing Corporation for the printing of the "Daru Diri Sampatha" lottery ticket by the National Lotteries Board with the objective of raising funds for the "Save the children National Trust Fund" has expired on 12.05.2020. However, the procurement procedure commenced for selecting a suitable printer after the said contract period has not yet been completed due to Corona pandemic. Therefore, the proposal made by  the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development to extend the contract awarded to the State Printing Corporation for the printing of lottery tickets, for a further period of 06 months from 2020.05.13 to 2020.11.12, so as to get the work done by the State Printing Corporation itself under the previously agreed  specifications and price, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme - 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme is being implemented since the year of 2010 for providing opportunities for the executive level public sector officers to undergo postgraduate courses in the recognized Universities in Japan and under the grant the Government of Japan has given their consent to grant an amount of Japanese Yen 269 million (approximately Rs. 457 million) to facilitate the government officials who are to commence their studies from September 2020.  Accordingly, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the proposal submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development for accepting the aforementioned grant and signing the agreements relating to the same.

description: Utilizing the funds allocated under the Contingent Emergency Response Components of the World Bank Group financed investment projects  for the projects to be implemented on priority basis, due to the COVID 19 pandemic situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that it is necessary to provide financial assistance for the  uplifting the agricultural sector, implementing the e-education platform, establishment of an online platform for home-based work , disaster management as well as the prevention of spreading the disease while using public transport sectors,  immediately, since the country is facing a wide range of impacts other than the health sector due to COVID-19 pandemic situation. Therefore, the Cabinet of Ministers has approved the proposal submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development for taking necessary measures to enable to utilize  US$ 56 million that has been included under the Contingent Emergency Response Components of (04) investment projects funded by the World Bank Group in the projects to be immediately implemented in the sectors mentioned above.

description: Granting relief for the tourist industry during the post COVID-19 pandemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body:
As a redress to minimizing the impact on the tourist industry due to the COVID 19 pandemic conditions and normalizing the industry; approval of the Cabinet of Ministers was granted for implementing a relief programme for institutions and individuals engaged in the tourist industry as follows.

- 	Providing loan facilities on the basis of paying back within a period of 05 years with a 2 year grace period under an interest of 4% for payment of salaries of Rs.20,000/- per head for a period of six months for the staffs of tourist hotels, tour management companies/travel agents registered under the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority.

-	Providing loan facilities for the payment of Rs.15,000/- each for a period of six months serving in the other institutions related to tourism including restaurants, cafeterias, spa and wellness centres registered under the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority.

-	One-off payment of Rs.20,000/- per tour guide registered under the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority to be dispensed by the by Sri Lanka Tourist Development Authority.

-	One-off payment of Rs.15,000/- per tourist driver registered under the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority to be dispensed by the Sri Lanka Tourist Development Authority.

-	Providing facilities to pay the electricity and water bills payable from 01st March 2020 to 31st August from 01st September 2020 in 12 equal installments and not to disconnect power or water supply during that period.

-	Extending the grace period of 06 months given for payment of vehicle leasing installments related to the tourism industry up to 12 months without any delayed charges.

description: Allocation of land near the Mirisawetiya Maha Viharaya, Anuradhapura to the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Circuit Bungalow of the Forest Department is located in a 2 Acre 22.6 perch land plot adjoining the Mirisawetiya MahaViharaya. The Department of Archaeology has informed that no new constructions should be done there since this land is situated within the Anuradhapura sacred city and it is an area with archaeological ruins. The Chief Incumbent of the Mirisavatiya Viharaya has requested this land for the Miriswetiya Viharaya for the ease of carrying out religious and social activities of the temple in the future as the relevant land plot is situated adjoining the Mirisawetiya Maha Viharaya. Accordingly, the Cabinet approval was given to allocate this land to the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs to be transferred to the Mirisawetiya Maha Viharaya upon the approval of the Sacred Area Development Committee in future when formally declaring the boundaries of the said sacred area.

description: Release of Pine Plantations belonging to the Department of Forest Conservation and the Land Reforms Commission for Oleoresin extraction on the basis of a charge
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval was granted to take necessary action for the selection of suitable institutions following the competitive bidding procedure, for Oleoresin extraction in the Pine Plantations belonging to the Department of Forest Conservation and the Land Reforms Commission in extent of 6,200 hectares.

description: Implementation of Solar Power Projects under the Indian Lines of Credit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has extended its consensus to grant USD 100 million under Indian Lines of Credit through the EXIM Bank of India in order to accomplish the targets of integrating renewable energy to the energy sector in the Country through implementing solar power projects, in line with 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour' policy framework. Accordingly, Cabinet approval was granted to implement the relevant projects by giving the priority for provision of electricity to the government buildings by installation of solar power generation systems on roofs of those buildings and to selected low income families in the Mannar, Trincomalee, Moneragala, Anuradhapura and Hambantota districts and meet their power requirements by provision of solar power generation systems to their housing units.

description: Obtaining additional provisions for forming infrastructure facilities essential for the e-motoring Project of the Department of the Motor Traffic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The contract to implement the e-Motoring Project, which has been planned to transform the departmental services to public centric nature, has been awarded to Metropolitan Advanced Technologies Pvt Limited and agreement thereof has been signed in July 2018. Even though, the Head Office premises at Narahenpita and the District Office premises of the Department have to be appropriately organized in order to implement to the Project, nonreceipt of allocations needed for such infrastructure facilities has resulted in the delay in implementing the same. Therefore, Cabinet approval was granted to provide the necessary allocations through the forthcoming Budget to accomplish the essential and urgent tasks in order to implement the Project as planned.

description: Tax exemptions for execution of the Railway Track Rehabilitation Project from Maho to Omanthai under the Indian Line of Credit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval was granted to implement the Railway Track Rehabilitation Project from Maho to Omanthai under the Indian Line of Credit, at the meeting held on 2019 04 02. Now, it has been decided by the Cabinet to declare this Project as a special project to allow exemptions from the payment of the relevant taxes.

description: Introduction of minimum specifications for buses used for public passenger transportation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body:
- Nearly, 26,985 buses are presently being used by the Sri Lanka Transport Board and the Private Sector for passenger transportation and almost all of them are made on truck chassis meant for transportation of goods. It has been observed that passengers are jolted and made uncomfortable when brakes are applied as those are made for transportation of goods. Therefore, Cabinet approval was granted to appoint a Cabinet Sub Committee comprising of the following Ministers in order to further consider the matters mentioned in the report submitted by the Committee appointed to prepare the technical specifications and criteria in order to enable the passengers to travel in comfort, to be considered when importing buses to the country in the future, with the participation of the relevant officials and to submit its recommendations to the Cabinet.

*	Minister of Transport Service Management

*	Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management

*	Minister of Education

description: Construction of a new interchange on the Southern Expressway at Bedigama for the Tangalle - Weeraketiya Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - It has been found that, there is a possibility of attracting more expressway users by constructing a new interchange at Bedigama, for the road section of Tangalle - Weeraketiya. As such, approval of the Cabinet has been granted to construct the proposed new interchange and to utilize the balance of the amount used for the construction of the Section II of the Southern Expressway.

description: Purchase of School Uniform Materials - 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body:
- The Ministry of Education has been continuously providing free school uniform materials to the students of the Government schools and Government aided schools and also to the student bhikkus and lay students of Government approved pirivenas, since 1993. Instead of providing uniform materials, a system of providing gift vouchers has been implemented for this purpose during the period from 2015-2020.

Due to the COVID 19 pandemic prevailing in the country, the export income has been reduced and therefore, it has been found appropriate to produce school uniforms locally by encouraging local textile manufacturers, taking into consideration that the cost of foreign exchange to be incurred for the purpose is also very high. Accordingly, Cabinet approval was granted to provide uniform materials in future instead of granting vouchers and to obtain required stock of uniform materials from the local textile manufactures that are registered under the Ministry of Industry and Supply Chain Management.

description: Purchasing three (03) official houses for the Department of Examinations of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Department of Examinations of Sri Lanka annually conducts more than 350 examinations for Government, Semi-Government, Corporations and Boards. The officers serving in the said department have to work until mid night resulting in officers who come from distant places encountering difficulties. Therefore, as a solution to this problem, approval of the Cabinet was granted to purchase three adjoining housing units form the Viyathpura Apartment Complex at Weera Mawatha, Pannipitiya which is being constructed by the Urban Development Authority, to the Department of Examinations and provide accommodation facilities for the said officers.

description: 'Suraksha' Students Insurance Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The agreement with Allianz Insurance Company under the Suraksha Insurance Policy was expired on May 31, 2020. Taking into consideration the recommendations of the Committee appointed to submit recommendations to further strengthen the said insurance scheme, the Cabinet approval was granted to seek the services from a Government owned insurance company when selecting an insurance institute for student insurance coverage and to obtain relevant insurance services from the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation from 2020 06 01 to 2020 09 30, until a suitable insurance institute is selected.

description: Procurement of Goods and Services by Public Sector Institutions from the Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation outside the procurement procedure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2019 10 09 to procure goods, equipment or machinery for the public sector institutions, up to a ceiling of Rs.50 million, from the Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation outside the procurement procedures. The Cabinet approval was granted to extend the same procedure for a period of another one year.

description: Maintenance of the Sri Lanka Poultry Development Company (Private) Limited as a farm owned by the National Livestock Development Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Libyan Agricultural and Livestock (Pvt.) Limited (LANLIB) has been established in 1981 with 51% of its ownership with the National Livestock Development Board and 49% with the Libyan Arab Foreign Investment Company. The share of 49% with the Libyan Arab Foreign Investment Company was purchased by the National Livestock Development Board in 2014 and is being maintained under the name of Sri Lanka Poultry Development Company (Pvt.) Ltd. At present, the company is in critical financial crises that its administration and management activities is in a complicated situation. Under those circumstances, the Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval to liquidate the Sri Lanka Poultry Development Company (Pvt.) Ltd. and to take over the assets of the Mavaththa Farm and the staff which is functioning under the said company to the National Livestock Development Board.

description: Handing over of Matara 'Nilwala Eliya' Development Project - 2018-2020 to the Ministry of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - 	The mangrove swamp named 'Kirala Kele' spread within a land extent of 1,800 hectares planned to be developed under the 'Nilwala Eliya' development project which was inaugurated in the district of Matara in the year 2018 and is presently being implemented by the District Secretary of Matara under the purview of the Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Government and Local Authorities. The proposed project area consists mainly of marshy lands, agricultural channels and mangrove swamps. Therefore, the Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval to further implement the project after handing over the said project to the Ministry of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development since close supervision of the Department of Irrigation is required when developing such an area.

description: Increasing the Upper Ceiling of the loan facilities granted under the Smallholder Agribusiness Partnership Programme (4P) and providing Matching Credit and Matching Grant facilities for Agri Value Chain Project Promoters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Smallholder Agribusiness Partnerships Programme (SAPP) is implemented for uplifting the living standards of rural small-scale farmers through the funding of the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) and the Government of Sri Lanka and with a total investment amounts to US$ 105 million. Implemented throughout 06 years, this programme is to be completed on 30th June 2023. The project targeting 57,500 families including 4,000 families in the Mahaweli region implements value chain projects with the assistance of Public Private and Producer Partnership - 4p. Therefore, approval of the Cabinet of Ministers was granted to increase the upper ceiling of the matching credit granted to beneficiaries of the project under this programme from Rs.300,000/- to Rs.500,000/-, as well as to furnish a matching contribution for those project promoters, subject to a maximum of Rs.1.8 million for obtaining equipment or services required for promoting market or enterprise activities and also a matching credit facility, subject to a maximum of Rs.09 million under an annual loan interest of 10% for procurement of machinery.

description: Payment of Mahapola Scholarship installments to continue the distance educational activities amidst Corona pandemic conditions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - Approximately 60,000 which is around 50% of the University students are eligible for the Mahapola Scholarship. Each student is granted is Rs.5,000/- per month and it costs a monthly total of Rs.160 million. 51% of it is borne by the Mahapola fund while 49% is granted by the General Treasury. Considering that the expenditures such as hostel charges, telephone charges, etc should be borne, since student education is continued using distant education methods although Universities are kept closed, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the payment of allowances to Mahapola scholarship holders precisely after accomplishing the sufficient allocations required.

description: Providing a monthly living assistance to the Low Income Kidney Patients scattered all over Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - A program for providing a living assistance of Rs.5,000/- is being implemented in 82 divisional secretariat divisions in 11 districts with high risk of spreading kidney disease (Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Matale, Trincomalee, Ampara, Vavuniya, Kurunegala, Mullaitivu, Badulla, Moneragala and Hambantota). Accordingly, 25,320 low income kidney patients are being paid the said amount under this program. Further, approval of the Cabinet was granted to provide this monthly assistance for another 13,849 low income kidney patients in the waiting list.

description: Contract for the construction of Mawella and Rekawa Anchorages in the Tangalle Divisional Secretariat, Hambanthota District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - Competitive procurement procedure has been followed for the construction of the Anchorages of Mawella and Rekawa in the Tangalle Divisional Secretariat Division in Hambantota district. Accordingly, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted to award the contracts concerned to Aarking Engineering (Pvt) Ltd joint venture with BPPE Institute and RR Construction Pvt. Ltd respectively, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee.

description: Amendment of the applicable labour legislations to make the minimum age a worker can be employed as 16 years concurrent to the World Day Against Child Labour, 12th June 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body:
- Concurrent to the 'World Day Against Child Labour', which falls on 12th June 2020 and as set out in the policy statement 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour' under the heading of 'An informed and knowledgeable child population', the approval of the Cabinet has been granted to amend the following labour laws so as to increase the minimum age of employment up to 16 years to comply with the compulsory schooling age enabling to ensure that all children in the country are entitled to the privileges and rights as per the International convention on the Rights of the child.

1.	The Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act No.19 of 1954 (Chapter 129)

2.	The Employment of Women, Young Persons and Children Act No 47 of 1956

3.	The Act to amend the Minimum Wages (Indian Labour) Ordinance, (Chapter 135)

4.	The Factories Ordinance No 45 of 1942

5.	The Orders declared by publishing in the Extraordinary Gazette dated 31.10.1958 in accordance with the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958

description: Utilizing video conferencing systems for consideration of a bail applications and for remand extensions in respect of the prison inmates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - There are about 15,000 remand prisoners in 23 prisons across the country. About 5,400 of them have to be produced before courts daily. The Ministry of Justice, Human Rights and Legal reforms has designed a program for the court to consider their bail applications while in prison, using video conferencing systems, taking into consideration the prevailing situation in the country as well as the recent incidents of several attacks on buses on which prison inmates were on board and being transported resulting in the death of both prison inmates and prison officers. As the first phase of the program, the Cabinet approval was granted to implement the proposed program in 23 court houses and 12 locations in 4 prisons in the Colombo District.

description: Rental housing project for middle income earners.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority has planned to implement a project to construct 'studio type' apartments of a maximum of 350 square feet, so as to accommodate middle income earners who come to Colombo from far away areas for their employment. Accordingly, the cabinet approval was granted to implement these housing scheme projects within a distance of 3-5km of the main towns with main highway and railway services.

description: Providing consultancy services for Actuarial Expertise to the Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - 'Sri Lanka - Financial Sector Modernization Project' is implemented under World Bank funds. The Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka works as a partner in implementing the project. Under the project, approximately US$ 9 million has been allocated for the development/modernization of the Insurance Sector. The Commission has planned to recruit 5 consultants for this purpose and the procurement procedures are being carried out to procure the Actuarial Expert Consultancy Services. Accordingly, the Cabinet approval was granted in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed consultant procurement committee, to award the said Consultant Service contract for two years to Mr. Teus Mourik in the Netherlands, subject to the payment of US$ 4 Lakhs including Tax.

description: Compensation for Damaged Vehicles in the Meethotamulla garbage dump Landslide in Kolonnawa Divisional Secretariat Division, Colombo District on 2017 04 14
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - A committee headed by the Additional District Secretary Colombo, has been appointed to assess the damages of 36 vehicles caused by the Meethotamulla garbage dump landslide on 2017 04 14. The compensation was approved by the Cabinet of Ministers for qualified vehicle owners according to the recommendations of the Committee.

description: Managing the Economy and Challenges with the COVID19 hit Global Economy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body:
- With the Novel Corona virus outbreak, the world economy has virtually come to a grinding halt and all the industry sectors of travel, tourism and airlines are almost grounded. Although, China where the disease originated, has shown signs of recovery from the risk of spreading the disease as a result of the measures adopted by the said country for the control and prevention of this disease, the Novel Corona virus has been spread to most countries of the world inclusive of the Advanced Countries. 

In this background, the intervention of the Government has become absolutely necessary for the provision of the public health services in the country, adopting of all possible measures for the prevention of the disease, the provision of services and supplies spread over in a wide range and also for managing the set backs in the fields of tourism, export, foreign employment, information technology and the small enterprises associated with those fields. 

At the time of the dissolution of Parliament on 02nd March 2020, the Appropriation Bill for the year 2020 had not been presented in Parliament and the Government had to pay attention on other alternatives as the support of the opposition was not received for the proposal made by the Government to obtain required funds since the allocations provided by the Vote on Account which had been approved by that time was not sufficient to clear the unpaid bills for the year 2019 pertaining to purchase of pharmaceuticals, procurement of fertilizer, various constructions and for the activities to conduct the General Election 2020 as well. 

Therefore, the provisions to obtain the required allocations for the said purposes have been imposed in terms of the authority vested with H.E. the President by the Constitution and accordingly, the General Treasury has taken the following steps:

*	Release of funds amounting Rs. 10 billion to settle pharmaceutical bills.

*	Release of Rs. 500 million for Corona control measures.

*	Release of Rs 3 billion to settle fertilizer outstanding bills.

* 	Release of Rs.5 billion to settle outstanding bills of the small and medium construction contractors.

* 	Embark Rs. 46 billion to settle elderly deposit interest subsidy which has not paid for two years.

* 	Obtain allocations amounting Rs. 8 billion required for the General Election 2020. 

Many countries are compelled to seek domestic solutions in the medium term, considering the risks at the economy due to the slowdown created in the global economy. Accordingly, the Government has paid its attention to obtain the optimum benefits while considering the current tendency in oil price reduction in the World Market and has planned to implement the following proposals considering the views of the experts in the relevant fields. 

 * 	Maintain the current fuel prices at the domestic market in view of easing traffic congestion and smooth traffic arrangements for both public and private transportation. 

* 	Impose an Import Duty on fuel imports to recover profit margins from Petroleum imports.

* 	Establish a Fuel Price Stabilization Fund to have savings from international oil price reduction and generate a sum of Rs. 200 billion through such savings over six months.

* 	Provide Rs.50 billion from the said Fund to the Ceylon Electricity Board in order to reduce the debt of the Ceylon Electricity Board to the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation and thereby to settle the debt to be paid to the Bank of Ceylon and the Peoples Bank by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation.

* 	Considering the benefit of the oil price reduction, supply heavy oil by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to the Ceylon Electricity Board at the rate of Rs.70/- per litre and thereby to settle the bank debts and interests by reducing thermal power generation cost below Rs.30 billion 

Further, by considering the prevailing drought condition in many parts of the country and the necessity to provide essential food items at a reasonable price under the present situation, it has been planned to reduce the Maximum Retail Price for 1 kg of lentils to Rs. 65/- and 425 g of Canned fish to Rs. 100/-.

It has also been planned to provide following relief for the sustainable continuation in the fields of tourism, apparel and trade which have been affected by the Novel Corona Virus:

*	a 6 month moratorium to repay the loans obtained from banks and financial institutions.

*	flexible working hours and relief for the overtime and holiday payments, specially in the fields of IT and apparel.

*	Working Capital requirement at 4% interest. 

Approval of the Cabinet of Ministers was granted to implement the above programme forwarded by H.E. the President.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer - 2020 (April)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development to award the procurements for the importation of bulk chemical fertilizer for the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited (Lak Pohora) and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited (Commercial Fertilizer) for the month of April in 2020, operating under the Ministry of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development to the following institutions, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

*	27,400+5% MTs of Urea (Granular) to the Valency International Trading (Pvt.) Ltd., at the rate of US$ 270.74 per 1 MT for the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited.	
*	2,040+5% MTs of Urea (Prilled) to the Swiss Singapore Overseas Enterprises Ltd., at the rate of US$ 288.30 per 1 MT for the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited.

*	3,000+5% MTs of Triple Super Phosphate to the Golden Barly International Trading Pvt. Ltd., at the rate of US$263.00 per 1 MT for the  Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited.

description: Parliamentary General Election 2020 - Use of Official Vehicles and Official Residences by the Prime Minister and other Ministers for the promotion of their Party/Candidature and the requirement of making payments to the Government on that behalf
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body:
- H.E. the President, by now, has dissolved the 8th Parliament with a date fixed for holding a Parliamentary General Election.  However, the Prime Minister and the Cabinet of Ministers have to accomplish their official duties and the Speaker and the Leader of the Opposition as Members of the Constitutional Council should participate in the official proceedings of the Council until the Parliamentary General Elections are held. At the same time, the aforesaid persons are also involved in promoting their party and candidature and therefore, it is observed that making a payment to the Government for the use of their official vehicles and official residences is appropriate. Accordingly, it was decided by the Cabinet that the holders of the above positions should adhere to the same system adopted at the time of the Parliamentary General Elections held in the year 2015, as follows. 

*	to pay a monthly fee of Rs.100,000/- per vehicle, if the official vehicles are used for the promotion of their party and candidature.

*	to personally bear the fuel expenses required in addition to the amount of fuel currently provided for the official vehicle.

*	to personally bear all the expenses in the event of using aeroplanes or helicopters for the promotion of their party and candidature.

*	to pay a monthly fee of Rs.100,000/-, if the official residence is used for the promotion of their party and candidature.

description: Supporting Electricity Supply Reliability Improvement Project - Package 7: Lot A2 - Installation of the Static Var System (+100 MVar) at Biyagama Grid Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has granted US$ 115 million to the Ceylon Electricity Board, under the Supporting Electricity Supply Reliability Improvement Project for strengthening the transmission and distribution network of the Ceylon Electricity Board and it has been decided to install a Static Var System (+100 MVar) at Biyagama Grid Substation under the said project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy, to award the contract to M/s Hyosung Heavy Industries Corporation, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing preference to the Local Manufacturers when procuring Cables and Conductors for the Ceylon Electricity Board and its Subsidiaries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body:
- Due to the tariff concessions given to the Ceylon Electricity Board and its subsidiaries in the importation of goods, the Ceylon Electricity Board and its subsidiaries have a tendency to purchase imported productions of foreign manufacturers since their prices have been declined when compared with that of the local productions and this has adversely affected the local cable production industry. 

Under the circumstance, in order to ensure reasonable competition for the domestic manufacturers, in the procurement process of purchasing cables, conductors and galvanized steel manufactured in Sri Lanka for Ceylon Electricity Board and its subsidiaries, the proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy, to provide an extra relief, by considering in the evaluation, all the relevant taxes to be paid by importers at importation of such products in addition to the existing 20% of domestic preference during the technical evaluation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of the Island Wide Telecommunication System for the Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has granted a loan for the development of the Colombo suburban railway improvement project and the Department of Sri Lanka Railways has planned to utilize a part of the said fund for the purchase of the Island Wide Telecommunication System. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport Services Management to award the said contract to JV of M/s Dialog Axiata PLC and M/s Dialog Broadband Network (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resuming the Production activities of Valachchenai Paper Mill of the National Paper Company Limited as a Diversification Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body: - The recommencement of the state enterprises with the potential for resumption has been recognized as a priority activity by the Government. As such, the necessary steps are being taken to recommence the Valachchenai Paper Mill as a diversification project after restructuring it. Accordingly, the concurrence of the Cabinet was granted as a matter of policy for the proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management for the implementation of the diversification project, with the sub projects as such as electricity generation by solar power within the factory premises, establishment of a drinking water bottling plant utilizing part of the excess water being purified after supplying water for the activities in the factory and cultivation of crops suitable to the area and commencing a work site and a holiday resort after selecting a suitable land in extent of 100 acres from the non-utilized lands where the Valachchenai factory is located.

description: Development of the Diyagama International Sports Complex and Sports Academy into a Sports University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body:
- A Sports Academy and an International Stadium is being constructed equipped with all necessary facilities in an extent of 125 acres of land situated at Diyagama in the Homagama Divisional Secretariat Division in the Colombo District. As proposed in the Policy Framework: 'Visas of Prosperity and Splendour', the proposal made by the Minister of Sports & Youth Affairs to take necessary future steps to revise and develop the plans of the said sports complex enabling to establish a National Sports University, was approved by the Cabinet.

Similarly, the proposal made by the said Minister to appoint a Committee of Experts under the Chairmanship of Dr. Chandra Embuldeniya who functioned as the first Vice Chancellor of the Uva Wellassa University to make a study of all matters relating to the process of establishing the proposed Sports University and submit recommendations, was also approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of 45% from the printing of School Text Books distributed free of charge for the year 2021 by the Educational Publications Department to the State Printing Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body: - The printing of a part of school text books in the year 2018 and 2019 has been vested directly with the State Printing Corporation outside the open tender procedure. Accordingly, taking into consideration the capacity of the Corporation and its past performance, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to award the contract for printing a part of the school text books out of the total of text books required for the year 2021 to the State Printing Corporation outside the Open tender Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the Jaffna University and the Birmingham University of the United Kingdom
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body: - The necessity of implementing a Development Strategic Programme towards a knowledge based economy through Human Resource Development, has been recognized in terms of the Government Policy Framework for the prosperity of the country. In line with the said Strategic Plan, it has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Jaffna University and the Birmingham University of the United Kingdom on 'Atrial Fibrillation Management' by the Global Health Research Group implemented by the National Institute for Health Research of the United Kingdom. The proposed MoU will help to improve the research capacity of the undergraduates and the postgraduates of the University of Jaffna. It has been proposed to allocate a sum of British Pounds 209,000 by the Birmingham University in respect of full financial assistance and advisory assistance for this project, as a research grant.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, to enter into the proposed MoU,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of the Proposed Land for constructing the Medical Faculty of the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka and Construction of the Building Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body: - An amount of Rs 70 million has been allocated with the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers, to acquire a plot of land for the construction of the Medical Faculty of the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka. However, an amount of Rs 92 million has been estimated for the said acquisition process according to the present value of the land. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovations to increase the amount allocated for said land acquisition process up to 92 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuing of a 'Skills Passport' for the National Vocational Qualification (NVQ)  Holders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body: - The Tertiary and Vocational Educational Commission having introduced the National Vocational Qualification Framework, maintains a nationally recognized qualification awarding system.  In order to extend the recognition  existing in this regard, the International Labour Organization with the intergration of the Employers Federation of Ceylon has planned to implement  a pilot project to introduce a 'Skills Passport' to the skilled NVQ Holders and the migrant workers. Rapidly growing industries in the fields such as construction, hospitality and domestic/care services have been selected for the first phase of this project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Skills Development, Employment and Labour Relations to issue a 'Skills Passport' as a SMART card by the Tertiary and Vocational Educational Commission for the skilled NVQ Holders with a minimum of one year  experience, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a land at IT park, Malabe to the Mahamewnawa Buddhist College
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body: - As per the request made by the Chief Incumbent of the Seruwila, Wilgamwehera Somawathie Rajamaha Viharaya requesting a plot of land of 04 acres located at Malabe to be granted for the establishment of the Mahamewnawa Buddhist College, on concessionary payment terms, the Urban Development Authority has identified a plot of land in extent of 02 acres, 2 roods and 0.70 perches located within the bounds of the IT park Malabe to be allocated for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities to allocate the said plot of land to the Mahamewnawa Buddhist College, on lease basis for a period of 30 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Winding up of the CFC Founding (Guarantee) Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body: - The CFC Founding (Guarantee) Limited has been established pursuant to a Cabinet decision taken in the year 2016 with the objective of facilitating and carrying out the work for the establishment and operation of the Financial City of the  Colombo Port City Project. A Committee of Experts with special experties in the respective fields has been appointed to review the scope of the functions undertaken by the CFC and the Committee so appointed has observed that the continuation of this Company is no longer necessary. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to take appropriate measures to wind up the Company by adopting the provisions provided for in Section 319(b) of the Companies Act, No.07 of 2007 and to authorize the Secretary to the Treasury to take necessary action in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition of an extent of  200 acres of land to establish an Air Base at Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport (MRIA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-18
decision_details_body: - 	The Sri Lanka Airforce is assigned with the task of ensuring the security concerns of all the Airports in Sri Lanka.  As such, it has become absolutely necessary to establish an Air Base similar to that of Bandaranaike International Airport at Katunayake to provide security to the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport which has been recognized as an Airport with strategic importance in the Indian Ocean Region.  Accordingly, the Cabinet taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development and Minister of Internal Trade, Food Security and Consumer Welfare, decided that an extent of 200 acres of land situated adjoining the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport be allocated for the purpose.

description: Formation of a State Owned Property Development Entity
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body:
- Some of the most valuable hotels and other tourism related assets reside within the General Treasury, Employee's Provident Fund (EPF), Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation (SLIC), Telecommunication Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka (TRCSL) and the Bank of Ceylon. For instance, Hotels such as Grand Hyatt, Grand Oriental, Hilton as well as the Shopping Mall of the Lotus Tower.
	
	It has been proposed to create a most valuable premium real - estate portfolio by bringing all such properties under a single entity and it has also been observed that there is a possibility of expanding the said entity by the inclusion of similar assets. Further, it would be easy to secure required funds for the development of such properties and assets through the proposed entity possessing valuable assets since it would not be optimal to use government revenue or government borrowings for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the  Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to bring Canwill Holdings Pvt. Ltd. (Grand Hyatt), Hotel Developers Pvt. Ltd. (Hilton) and Grand Oriental Hotel under  a single entity jointly owned by the General Treasury, Bank of Ceylon and Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contract for the construction of the proposed Multipurpose Building for the Faculty of Humanities & Social Sciences and Services Department of the University of Sri Jayawardenapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, to award the contract for the construction of the proposed Multipurpose Building, for the Faculty of Humanities & Social Sciences and Services Department of the University of Sri Jayawardenapura, to M/s International Construction Consortium (Pvt.) Ltd. at Kohuwala in Nugegoda, for a sum of Rs.1,183.86 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding Contract for the Construction of the Multi-Purpose Building of the Biksu University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education,Technology and Innovations, to award the contract for construction of the Multi-Purpose Building of the Biksu University of Sri Lanka, to M/s Siridantha Construction Works & Darinton Construction (Pvt.) Limited, Joint Venture at Anuradhapura for a sum of Rs.384.41 million and relevant Value Added Taxes (VAT), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Design and Construction of 300 housing units at Obesekarapura (Arunodaya Mawatha, Rajagiriya)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - Obesekarapura Housing Project which has been designed to  implement under the Colombo Urban Regenaration Programme, with the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank loan facilities, will consist 300 housing units of 550 Sq. ft. each Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities, to award the contract for the purpose, on design and construction basis,  to M/s Subasinghe Contractors (Pvt) Ltd, to a sum of Rs. 1,732.35 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Design and Construction of 1000 Housing Units at the Stadiumgama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - The 'Colombo Urban Regeneration Programme' has been initiated in accordance with a decision taken by the Cabinet in the year 2010, with a view to facilitating the housing requirements of the under served community in the city of Colombo. A part of the funds needed for the project is financed by a loan obtained from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the housing project of the Stadiumgama has been planned to be implemented under same. Accordingly, 1000 houses with a floor capacity of 550 sqft. per house is due to be constructed. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities, to award the contract to Ms/ Access Engineering PLC for a sum of Rs.5,950.95 million to design and build the said 1000 houses as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the contract for Embankment Conservation and De-silting of two Ponds in the Jaffna Peninsula as a Pilot Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - Under the Strategic Cities Development Project, the International Development Association has granted an additional loan of US$ 55 million for improving the selected urban services and the common urban places in the Jaffna Peninsula.  A part of this loan is expected to be used for the payments pertaining to the pilot project of the embankment conservation and de-silting of the 02 ponds of the Jaffna Pilliar Kovil Kulam and Thevar Kulam respectively. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities, to award this contract to the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation for a sum of Rs.113.04 million (without VAT), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Food Security for Low Income Earners
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body:
- At its meeting held on 2020 01 14, the Cabinet granted approval to the proposal made by H.E. the President to implement a programme called 'The National Programme for eradication of Poverty', to ensure the food security of low income earners by the provision of essential food items. Accordingly, it has been planned to implement the said programme expeditiously as follows and the information provided by the Minister of Internal Trade, Food Security and Consumer Welfare in this respect, was noted by the Cabinet.

*	provision of a bag of essential food items to 1,000,000 (one million) beneficiaries including the disabled persons, widows, adults without a permanent source of income and those suffering from chronic diseases.
>br>
*	provision of food items for the current market value of approximately Rs.1,007/- including tea leaves, nadu rice, flovour (normal), dhal and dry fish/sprats/locally canned salmon fish to the selected beneficiaries for a price of Rs.500/- .

*	implementation of the programme with the participation of Lanka Sathosa, cooperative trade network and the selected  franchised sales outlets in the rural areas.

description: Formulation of a National Fertilizer Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - The Fertilizer Act, No.68 of 1988 has provided the necessary legal provision to regulate the importation, production, preparation and distribution of fertilizer. The said Act has not been subject to any amendment so far and although action has already been formulated to upgrade the Act to suite the present needs, the absence of a formal national fertilizer policy declaration up to date, is seen as a major  impediment to the progress of the said field. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development, to appoint a committee comprising of experts in the field to formulate a National Fertilizer Policy and to prepare the final draft, after obtaining the views of the other relevant stakeholders and the general public on the draft so prepared, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving the Master Control Room Complex of the Independent Television Network,  pioneer Television Channel of Sri Lanka with the state of the art technology and relocating it
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - The Independent Television Network has been inaugurated on the 05th of June 1979 as the first ever television channel of Sri Lanka and in the whole of the 40 year period up to the present, its Master Control Room has been housed in the building constructed initially. At present, a new building has been constructed for the Master Control Room Complex with the required facilities.  As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Information and Mass Media, to take appropriate action to establish the said Master Control Room Complex consisting of the equipment with new technology necessary for digital transmission at the new building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulation of the Issuance of Television and Broadcasting Licenses -
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - Presently, license are issued for private broadcasting and telecasting in accordance with the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Act, No.37 of 1966 and the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation Act, No.06 of 1982 for conducting Broadcasting and Telecasting Services. As such, by now 27 private broadcasting licenses and 54 telecasting licenses have been issued. Nevertheless, only 18 broadcasting licenses and 28 telecasting licenses are in use.  A Committee appointed to study the process related to the issuance of licenses, has shown the necessity of having a separate institution to carry out the activities of the broadcasting and telecasting media both and has submitted a draft named as the ''Broadcasting Regulatory Commission''.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Information and Mass Media, to appoint a Committee comprising of experienced intellectuals in the field to review the draft further and make recommendations and to investigate the possibility of amending the provisions of the Sri Lanka Telecommunication Regulatory Commission Act, to enable it to perform the task of the process of issuing Broadcasting and Telecasting Licenses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Permanent Houses with New Technology Concrete Panels for conflict affected people in the Northern and Eastern Provinces of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet had granted approval previously, for the construction of 28,000 concrete panel cost effective permanent houses (at a cost of Rs.1,280,000/- per house) for the conflict affected families in the Northern and Eastern Provinces of Sri Lanka and as at its initial stage to construct 7,000 calicut tile roof houses.

	Nevertheless, due to the inability of securing the required funds for the project as expected, the General Treasury had taken the necessary action to get a term loan facility from the Bank of Ceylon to construct 1,000 houses initially.  Accordingly, the information submitted by the Minister of Community Empowerment and Estate Infrastructure Development, that a commercial agreement has already been signed with the contractor, M/s YAPKA Development (Pvt.) Ltd., selected for the construction of the 1,000 houses utilizing the said loan and that the activities of the relevant project has been commenced on 2020 02 21, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the Sri Lanka International Arbitration Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet had granted approval to establish a Sri Lanka International Arbitration Centre as a regional hub in the year 2012, for resolving disputes arising out of International Commercial Agreements and other International affairs.  Further, the Cabinet had approved to establish the Sri Lanka International Arbitration Centre as a limited guarantee company in the year 2015 and accordingly, the Sri Lanka International Arbitration Centre (Guarantee) Limited Company has been incorporated on 2016 12 20.  

	While certain countries are engaged in generating a colossal sum of income by way of involving in the international arbitration, the establishment of an International Arbitration Centre in Sri Lanka as well and resorting to action to get the international arbitration pertaining to commercial matters in the region attracted to the International Arbitration Centre in Sri Lanka will make it economically beneficial to Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Human Rights & Law Reforms, to continue the International Arbitration Centre independently, was noted by the Cabinet.

	At the same time, the Cabinet further decided that when including the provisions related to arbitration in the agreements entered into in future by the Government Institutions, to include the said provisions as well to the effect that arbitration activities should be carried out by the International Arbitration Centre in Sri Lanka.

description: Allocation of the lands belonging to the Urban Development Authority (UDA) for development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has decided on 2020 02 07 to confer authority on the Board of Management of the Urban Development Authority for leasing out lands not exceeding 1 acre within the District of Colombo and lands not exceeding 2 acres, outside the District of Colombo, belonging to the Urban Development Authority.  Accordingly, the information provided by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities, regarding the progress made on the 23 plots of land disposed during the period from 2016 to 2019 with the approval of the Minister in charge of the subject under section 18(1) of the Urban Development Authority Act, No.41 of 1978, having approved by the Board of Management of the UDA, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Providing of 150,000 Domestic Drinking Water Connections
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - At present, the National Water Supply & Drainage Board (NWSDB) has provided 2.4 million water connections covering 41% of the population of Sri Lanka and the NWSDB provides generally 110,000 domestic drinking water connections annually. However, it has been difficult to provide the consumers of some areas with the domestic drinking water connections even when there is an excess of capacity, because of the need of additional pipe extensions to cover the areas/roads that have not been covered by the existing distribution network, need for the consumers to pay the initial connection fee of around Rs.20,000/- and the road reinstatement charges. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities, to launch an accelerated programme for providing 150,000 domestic drinking water connections during the first 2 quarters of the year 2020, taking necessary action to do away with the aforesaid obstacles, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Celebration of the 175th Anniversary of the Royal Asiatic Society of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body:
- The Royal Asiatic Society of Sri Lanka, established in the year 1845, is an institution set by the then administration of the Grate Britain to fulfill the main objectives of identifying the development and investment feasibility, preparation of the governing structure and launching of the academic research process to get an understanding on the historical and cultural background of the rural community of this country and having analyzed such information has assisted in the matters of the Government by making recommendations in that regard to the Government, during the colonial era. As such, it has functioned as a renowned institution during the colonial times of Grate Britain and the Governor General has functioned as the ex officio patron of the Society.  At the same time, several famous scholars at the time like Sir Ponnambalam Arunachalam, Messers H.C.P. Bell, Pole E. Peiris, P.E.P. Deraniyagala, Senarath Paranawithana, G.C. Mendis, C.E. Godakumbura and G.P. Malalasekara had functioned as active members of the Society.

	The 175th Anniversary of this Society fell on the 07th of February this year and a special programme had been prepared to commemorate it. For the appreciation of the remarkable mission and the functions carried out by of the Society in respect of the progress of this country, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs, to allocate a provision amounting to Rs.15 million to cover the cost pertaining to the celebration of this anniversary, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Setting up of a Permanent Institutional Framework for the Conservation and Promotion of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Sri Lanka'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body:
- 'The International Convention for Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage' has been adopted in the year 2003 with a view to safeguarding the intangible cultural heritage for the future generations and Sri Lanka has given its concurrence to the Convention in the year 2008. Especially, the social customs and formalities, pageants, publications, knowledge, skills, cultural spaces and the items and tools bound thereto, exist as intangible cultural heritage and Sri Lanka is bound, to safeguard these intangible cultural heritage in the face of the challenges posed by westernization, globalization, commercialization and changes, to promote them and to prepare an appropriate approach for same, in terms of the said International Convention.

	Since, the unavailability of a separate institute for this purpose at present has become a barrier in implementing the terms of the above Convention expeditiously and accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs, to establish a special unit to carry out the activities of the intangible cultural heritage, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting lands of the Kalutara Bodhi premises by a free grant to the Kalutara Bodhi Trust Board as a definitive grant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body: - Seven plots of lands in extent of about 7.5 acres, developed by the Kalutara Bodhi Trust Board, have been given over to the said Trust Board by the Land Commissioner General on three long term leases and the Trust Board has made a request to the said Department to grant another plot of land on lease basis. Since all the lands given on lease basis have been developed well and also as granting the lands requested to the Kalutara Bodhi Trust will be of great significance to the development of the 'Pooja Area' it has been found that it is appropriate to vest the said plots of land on a free grant. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs, to grant the said plots of land presently given on lease basis to the Kalutara Bodhi Trust Board as a definitive grant and the remaining plots of land which have been developed and utilized presently to be given to the said Bodhi Trust on a long term lease, subject to taking them back without payment of compensation for the extent so acquired, in the event that such lands are required in the future for the development activities of the area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Developing and implementing the National Financial Inclusion Strategy (NFIS) for Sri Lanka to improve the Financial Inclusiveness in the Country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-03-04
decision_details_body:
- The concept of 'Inclusive Finance' is about making available the formal financial services timely at an affordable cost to all individuals and enterprises of the economy. The proposed national methodology of financial inclusiveness anticipates to provide opportunities to all citizens of the country to gain access to the financial products and services such as payments, savings, credit, insurance and retirement products.

	The Central Bank of Sri Lanka with the technical and financial assistance of the International Finance Corporation, has prepared the National Financial Inclusion Strategy and an Action Plan with the contribution of the relevant stakeholders to improve the financial inclusiveness in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development, to implement the said National Financial Inclusion Strategy in accordance with the Action Plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Elimination of Salary Anomalies in Principals' and the Teachers' Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body:
- Considering the issues prevailing for many years, pertaining to the salaries and service conditions of teachers, principals and other professionals related to the field of education, the National Policy Framework of the Government ''A Reconstructed Country with a Future-Vistas of Prosperity and Splendor'' has pointed out the necessity of formulating a suitable salary structure after preparing a Salary and Service Minute having integrated the Sri Lanka Teacher's Service and all other related services in the field of education.  Even though, the Government has already taken a policy decision to take action accordingly, the Minister of Education has made a detailed clarification to the Cabinet, regarding the situation emerged due to the salary anomalies of the principals and the teachers' services. 

	H.E the President recently has appointed a National Pay Commission to study the salaries in the public sector and formulate a new salary structure enabling  to remove the salary anomalies and the Government anticipates to implement  recommendations of the said Commission through the budget to be submitted in Parliament. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided that action be taken to remove the salary anomalies presently existing in the Principals and the Teachers' Services as well, on the recommendations of the said Commission.

description: Measures adopted by the Sri Lanka Missions  to ensure safety and	welfare of Sri Lankans  in Europe, Middle East East Asia regions in the	context of the new Corona Virus COVID - 19 outbreak
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - The new Corona epidemic has currently spread in 44 countries claiming more than 2,700 lives and infecting over 80,000 people. The Acting Minister of Foreign Relations has made aware the Cabinet that it has not been reported that  any Sri Lankan living in those countries has  been infected by the virus and on action taken by the Sri Lanka Missions of the said countries pertaining to their safety and well being. At the same time, the Cabinet noted the further information furnished by the Minister to the effect that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs continues the monitoring process of the evolving situation with a view to taking necessary steps  on any situation that could arise in future.

description: Revenue Administration Management Information System presently functioning in the Inland Revenue Department - Awarding the Contract  for the software RAMIS 2.0-Part B
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - interface with the Inland Revenue Department through the web services. Taking into consideration the necessity of expediting the implementation of  the New Inland Revenue Act, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development, to award the contract for changing the remaining part of the software RAMIS 2.0 which has been edited into a newer version as RAMIS 2.0 - Part B, to Singapore Cooperation Enterprise (SCE), to a sum of SDG 15,534,364, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Inception Report of the Committee appointed to review the Compact Development Agreement of the Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - In pursuance of a decision made by the Cabinet at its meeting held on 18th  December 2019, a Review Committee chaired by Prof. Lalithasiri Gunaruwan has been appointed to examine the MCC Agreement and submit recommendations to the Cabinet on action to be taken. The said Committee has submitted an Inception Report to the Hon. Prime Minister and it has been pointed out in the Report that although the MCC proposal contains the  opportunities of securing the required financial resources for the investments by avoiding initial economic barriers of Sri Lanka suppressed under the lack of capital resources and pile of debt, without increasing the country's foreign debt burden, some of the projects proposed under the said programme included certain factors that may cause an adverse impact on national, social and economic well being of Sri Lanka. Similarly, It has been further pointed out that the proposed MCC Compact Agreement, Programme Implementation Agreement and the draft Articles of Association of MCA-Sri Lanka also included sections and provisions that may be inconsistent with the Constitution and the legal system of the Country and other conditions which may be detrimental to the national objectives, sovereignty and the national security. Therefore, the Committee has pointed out that appropriate corrections and proper amendments are required to be made for such adverse references and thereafter, to obtain the necessary public opinion and approval of Parliament for same. The Prime Minster has submitted the said Inception Report of the Committee containing the above concerns to the Cabinet for information and the matters, preliminary conclusions and recommendations therein  were noted by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancing the Income of Big Onions Farmers' through the increase of  the Minimum Guaranteed Price of the Government for Big Onions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body:
- By the 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour' Policy Manifesto, a proposal has been made to implement a new programme for the cultivation of big onion and similar crops to convert the huge foreign exchange spent on importation of such crops into an income of the farmers engaged in growing such crops.



	It has been identified that the formulation of a proper mechanism, to increase the Government guaranteed price of big onion in order to encourage the farmers to uplift their cultivation by giving them a reasonable price for the harvest and to utilize the lands more productively for cultivation, are of absolute importance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to increase the minimum government guaranteed price of per kg of big onions from Rs.60/- to Rs.80/- and by the Ministry of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development to implement a special programme expeditiously to enhance the production of big onion by increasing the productivity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entry into a term contract for the import of 1,137,500 barrels of Diesel (0.05% Max Sulphur) and 262,500 barrels of Diesel (0.001% Max Sulphur) within a period of eight months  from 2020.04.01 to 2020.11.30
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy to award the contract for the import of 1,137,500 barrels of Diesel (0.05% Max Sulphur) and 262,500 barrels of Diesel (0.001% Max Sulphur) within a period of eight months  from 2020‑04‑01 to 2020‑11‑30, to M/s Petrochina International Pte. Ltd., Singapore as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SSCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transformation of the railway track between Kandy and Peradeniya  into a double line  track
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - The double line railway track which is being constructed parallel to the existing railway track between Kandy and Peradeniya is approximately 6.0 km in length and by now, it is under construction from Kandy up to the Gatambe level crossing. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport Services Management, to construct an additional line parallel to the existing line from Gatambe level crossing up to Sarasavi Uyana with an upgraded signal system utilizing the provisions of the consolidated fund with a view to reducing the traveling time further more and to construct a bridge at 00 miles 37 chains across the Mahaweli river, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-opening of the Kurunchativu (Elephant Pass North) Saltern under the Public-Private Partnership Methodology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - Although the Cabinet has granted approval previously, to take necessary action to re-commence the production and operational activities of the Kurunchativu (Elephant Pass North) Saltern in the Kilinochchi District which had been closed down due to the conflict situation that prevailed in the past, the said process has not been successful up to date. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management to carry out the operational activities of the said saltern with the Mantai Salt Limited and an investor selected adopting the formal procedure, as a Public‑Private Partnership Project and commence the implementation of same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the Suraksha' Student Insurance Scheme
