decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Education to implement the Suraksha' Student Insurance Scheme existing at present covering all school childrens from the age group of 5 years to 19 years by formalizing it further, with a view to creating a healthy child population ensuring the continuous schooling of the children, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of 'Kurumbettiya' Multifunctional Bicycles with Bucket for the Waste Transportation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - Due to the increase in the density of population and the present day pattern of consumption the disposal of waste to the environment has also increased. Presently, hand carts are used for waste transportation at narrow by-roads where the access of compactors or tractors are difficult. The Nation Eye Pvt. Limited which is a local innovator has manufactured a bicycle with a bucket named 'Kurumbettiya' which could easily enter such by-roads, with the minimum impact on the environment and could carry a weight around 250 - 300 kg. A proposal has been made to purchase 10 such bicycles and provide them to several local authorities as a pilot project and subsequently, distribute among other  local authorities based on its success. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils & Local Government to purchase 10 such multi-functional bicycles at the rate of Rs.180,000/- each for a sum of Rs.1.8 million and to provide them to local authorities where the places of religious and ancient monuments exist, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for Augmentation of Girandurukotte Water Treatment Plant, Mechanical and Electrical Works under the Local Government Enhancement Sector Project funded by the Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - Under the Local Government Enhancement Sector Project implemented with  the Asian Development Bank Financial Assistance, a sum of US$ 46.78 million has been set apart for the improvement of Water Supply Schemes in the areas of kidney affected people living in the Uva, North Central, Central and North Western Provinces. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils & Local Government, to award the contract for the augmentation of the Giradurukotte Water Treatment Plant Mechanical and Electrical Works to M/s Vasiri-Savinda Joint Venture at Kahatuduwa in Polgasowita for a sum of Rs.330.10 million as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The programme to attract Airlines to the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport (MRIA) and the Colombo International Airport in Ratmalana (CIAR)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27

description: Extension of the Moratorium on the Tourism Development Levy (TDL) for the Tourism Institutions Registered with the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - A moratorium of one year has been granted from the 01st of January 2020 to pay the Tourism Development Levy, which has to be paid by the Tourism Institutions registered with the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority up to the 31st of December 2019. However, after the Easter Sunday attack, since the tourism arrivals have not increased to the extent expected, it is found appropriate that the relevant period of relief should be further extended. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Civil Aviation to extend the period of relief for the payment of the Tourism Development Levy by a further period of 04 months up to the 30th of April 2020 and to  recover the unpaid Tourism Development Levy relevant to the said period in 20 equal installments with effect from the 01st of May 2020, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accelerated Programme for State Land Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27

description: The implementation of a Shramadana Programme under the theme, 'A country for you - A future for the country - A clean workplace and A country at work'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - The importance of motivating the staff by creating a productive workplace environment for an efficient people‑centred public service under the theme 'A country for you - A future for the country - A clean workplace and A country at work' as declared in the 'Vistas for Prosperity and Splendour', the national policy framework, has been recognized. Accordingly, the concurrence of the Cabinet was given to the proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy and Minister of Transport Services Management, to hold a one day Shramadana Programme on the 28th of February 2020 without involving any Government expenditure, with the participation of the welfare associations and the productive groups of the Sri Lanka Transport Board, Sri Lanka Railways, Ceylon Electricity Board, Ceylon Petroleum Corporation and as well as the other institutions coming under the purview of the Ministry of Power & Energy and the Ministry of Transport Services Management and to hold the same programme quarterly.

description: Establishment of Business Service Centres (One Stop Shops) for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises which are considered to make a contribution estimated at 52% of the Gross Domestic Product of the country, provide a livelihood to over 3 million people in the country and it is about 45% of the country's total employment. It has been observed that the entrepreneurs have felt uncomfortable due to the provision of the same service through different institutions and consumption of a long time according to the prevailing institutional procedure for providing services. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Small & Medium Business and Enterprise  Development, to establish 25 service centres which provide services from one place based on all 25 districts, to implement these service centres by District Secretariats in collaboration with the other relevant Government Institutions and other stakeholders and to carry out the management of such service centres by a Governing Body, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Self-Relocation Allowances for the persons who were affected due to acquisition of lands for the Southern Expressway Extension Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - A self‑relocation allowance of Rs.150,000 each has been paid before the        18th of November 2016, to persons who were displaced within the Pradeshiya Sabha authority limits, due to the acquisition of lands for the Southern Expressway Extension Project.  This allowance has been revised as Rs.500,000 after the  18th of November 2016.  As such,  the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways, to increase the self‑relocation allowance up to Rs.500,000 for the 175 aggrieved land owners whose lands were acquired at the initial stages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the selected National Highway Road Sections which need urgent improvements by utilizing the savings further available under the Local Banks Funded Project (LBFP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - - The Road Development Authority has implemented a Road Rehabilitation Project from the year 2011 utilizing the funds obtained from the Local Banks on  Treasury guarantees. The project, as of now, has been implemented under 02 Phases and it is estimated that a further saving of an amount of Rs.1,580 million will occur from the loan approved for these 02 Phases. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways to utilize the said balance money to develop the alternative roads which need expeditious improvements under 'the implementation of a 100,000 km alternative road network programme' which has been already approved by the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Hela Suwaya' - Traditional paddy cultivation free from harmful chemical contamination
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - - A paddy cultivation programme utilizing traditional paddy varieties devoid of the use of chemical fertilizer and insecticides is being implemented by the 'Hela Suwaya' Organization centering the Rajangana area of the Anuradhapura District with the mediation of the Government Medical Officers' Association. It has been observed that lives of most of the people suffering from non‑communicable deceases could be saved from the consumption of the rice and the associated food products produced by this paddy. Taking these matters into consideration, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development, to engage 2000 farmers of the Ranjangana area in Anuradhapura within an extent of 10,000 acres to under take  Hela Suwaya  farming, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: INNOTECH 2020 - Technology and Innovation Exhibition
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation  has planned an exhibition named 'INNOTECH 2020' to be held from 11th to 15th March 2020, with the objective of promoting science literacy at all levels of the society as well as to showcase the research and development outcomes of the institutes and universities operating under the purview of  the said Ministry.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, to hold the said exhibition at Pitipana area in Homagama in collaboration with the relevant stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report on Non-enrollment of students as expected for the Interest Free Student Loan Scheme and abandoning of the Study Courses by students
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - The interest free loan scheme has been initiated from the year 2017 for students to pursue a Government recognized Degree Programme at a Non-State  Higher Education Institute. As at present, the said loan facilities have been provided to 3,731 students under 03 stages and  202 students out of them, have dropped out from the courses due to various reasons. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation in respect of taking steps to extend the programme further to provide relief to students who are beset with financial difficulties and also to give priority in future to the courses which generate higher employment opportunities under the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing of the 'Mahapola Scholarship' installment granted to students  selected for the University entrance and expanding the number of such scholarship opportunities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - The 'Mahapola Scholarship' Programme has been initiated in the year 1982  with the objective of granting a monthly financial assistance to the students who gain entrance to universities from the low income families and those who obtain excellent results. The provisions required to the Universities to implement the programme is released monthly by the 'Mahapola Scholarship Trust Fund'. As at present, around 15,000 students are awarded with the  Mahapola Scholarship grant out of the 30,000 students who gain admission to the Universities. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, to implement several special programmes under strategic approaches identified, to increase the present capital of the Mahapola Scholarship Trust Fund which amounts to Rs.10.5  billion to Rs.20 billion by the year 2025, thus enabling to increase the number of Mahapola scholarship recipients  up to 20,000, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The future construction activities of the 'Amaradeva Asapuva
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - Action has already been initiated to establish a 'Sangeeth Ashram' known as 'Amaradeva Asapuva', comprising of an archives, a library and a museum at the 'Ape Gama' complex in Battaramulla in grateful commemoration of the invaluable national service rendered by Dr. Pandith Amaradeva to the field of music. Since the performance of the institution to which the construction activities of the project were entrusted, fell short of expectation, action has been taken to cancel the relevant Agreement. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Information and Mass Media, to select a suitable institution following the Government Formal Procurement Procedure in order to complete the said construction activities expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: St. Jude Global Alliance Medical Institution Membership Agreement  between the Secretary, Ministry of Healthcare & Indigenous Medical Services and St. Jude Children's Research Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - More than 600 new children are diagnosed with cancer in a year by the Department of Pediatrics of the National Cancer Institute of Sri Lanka.  Although the survival of children with cancer in Sri Lanka is much better than the similar regional countries and the other countries in the world, it has been found that there is still a better scope to improve it further. For this purpose, it has been recognized that working in partnership with St. Jude Global Alliance Medical Institution which is a network of the global medical institutions specializing on treatment of pediatric oncology will provide the possibility of enhancing treatment on pediatric oncology. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding to join the St. Jude Global Alliance, as a member institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Point of Service Activation (PSA) from the Sri Lanka Telecom (SLT) to obtain the services of International Maritime Satellite (INMARSAT) to track and monitor the High Sea Fishing Vessels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - In terms of  Regulations of the Indian Ocean Tuna Commission, it has been made compulsory to install a Satellite-Based Vessel Monitoring System on all Multiday Fishing Boats engaged in fishing operations at High Seas. According to the European Regulations, the countries exporting fish to the European Union too should get the Vessel Monitoring Systems installed. As such, 1,500 transponders have been provided for 1,500 multiday fishing boats registered under the Department of Fisheries and are engaged in fishing operations at high seas and with the  intervention of the Government. The contract awarded to supply the satellite services for the said transponders has been terminated by now and as such, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources to set apart a sum of  Rs.13.5 million as the provision required to further obtain the satellite service through the Sri Lanka Telecom, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Social Security Fund for the Sri Lankan migrant workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body: - More than one million Sri Lankans are employed in foreign countries and presently, they have become the main source of foreign exchange to the country. However, it has been observed that they are not motivated in making some saving  at least, for the use of their social security and their dependents and as a result they undergo economic difficulties when they reach their retirement age. As a solution to this, it has been proposed to initiate a contributory pension scheme for the migrant workers by the National Policy, 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendor'.  Accordingly,  the proposal made by the Minister of Skills Development, Employment and Labour Relations to appoint an Experts Committee to prepare the preliminary draft for the draft Bill, for the creation of a contributory social security fund for the migrant workers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the Micro Financing Credit Facility Programme uninterruptedly for indebted people living in the Northern and North Central Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-27
decision_details_body:
- With a view to reliving the low income earners living in the rural sector from the trap of indebtedness as a result of obtaining loans from the various Micro Finance Companies, a loan scheme has been implemented through the Co‑operative Rural Banks and the Thrift and Credit Co-operative Societies. In order to implement the said loan scheme, a sum of Rs.542 million has been released from the General Treasury, as at present and this loan scheme is being implemented as a revolving fund.  

Accordingly, 	the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development, to implement the said loan scheme continuously through the revolving fund  to achieve the basic targets of this project and to increase the present maximum credit limit granted under such programme up to Rs.60,000 per person, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: UNHRC Resolution 30/1 'Promoting reconciliation, accountability and 	human rights in Sri Lanka'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Relations to take following action pertaining to the approach of the Government of Sri Lanka to the upcoming 43rd Session of  the Human Rights Council and to undertake  diplomatic initiatives necessary to realise this strategy, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	To announce Sri Lanka's decision to withdraw from co sponsorship of Resolution 40/1 of March 2019 on 'Promoting reconciliation', accountability and human rights in Sri Lanka', which also incorporates and builds on preceding Resolutions 30/1of Octomber 2015 and 34/1 of March 2017.

*	To continue to work with the UN and its agencies, including the regular human rights mandates/bodies and mechanisms and seek as required, capacity building and technical assistance, in keeping with domestic priorities and policies.

*	To declare the Government's commitment to achieve sustainable peace through an inclusive, domestically designed and executed reconciliation and accountability process, through the appropriate adaptation of existing mechanisms, in line with the Government's policy framework.

To appoint a Commission of Inquiry (COI) headed by a Justice of the Supreme Court, to review the reports of previous Sri Lankan COIs which investigated alleged violations of Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law (IHL), to assess the status of implementation of their recommendations and to propose deliverable measures to implement them keeping in line with the new Government's policy.

*	Through due democratic and legal processes, to address other outstanding concerns and to introduce institutional reforms where necessary, in a manner consistent with Sri Lanka's obligations including the 2030 Sustainable Development Agenda (SDGs).

*	To demonstrate in good faith the policies rooted in the Government's commitment to the people by advancing individual and collective rights and protections under the law, ensuring justice and reconciliation and addressing the concerns of vulnerable sections of society.

*	To announce the intention of the GoSL to work towards the closure of the Resolution, in cooperation with the members of the UN.

description: Signing of Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of India for upgrading the Jaffna International Airport at Palali
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - Measures have been taken at present, to develop the Jaffna International Airport at Palali and operation of regional international flights from that Airport  also has been commenced. The Government of India, extending its willingness for same, has concurred to offer a grant of Sri Lankan Rs.300 million. It is expected to utilize the grant so provided to upgrade the facilities in the fields of terminal modification, supply of power, utility services and navigational services of the Jaffna International Airport. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Aviation, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of India for upgrading the Jaffna International Airport, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Construction of the Proposed Expressway Network in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body:
- It has been designed to construct an expressway network so as to cover the entire island as follows:

*	Implementation of the construction activities expeditiously in the 04 road sections from, Kadawatha - Mirigama, Mirigama - Kurunegala, Pothuhera - Galagedara and Kurunegala - Dambulla under the Central Expressway Project.

*	Implementation of the Ruwanpura Expressway Project under 03 road sections from  Kahathuduwa - Ingiriya, Ingiriya - Ratnapura and Ratnapura - Pelmadulla.

*	Implementation of the Eastern Expressway Project from Mattala Air Port connecting Pothuvil area via Wellawaya and Siyabalanduwa.

	As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways to secure funds for the Central Expressway Project, to obtain a proposal from M/s CNTIC for Section I of the Ruwanpura Expressway Project, to call for Expression of Interest on competitive basis for  constructing part II of the said project, to carry out a feasibility study of the Eastern Expressway project and to take action by the Department of External Resources to secure funds required for construction activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval for the Contract of Supply and Installation of 23 Priority Bridges - Proposal submitted by M/s Ellipse Projects SAS of France
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - With a view to minimizing traffic congestion, accidents and high vehicular operating costs, it has been identified as appropriate to supply and fix 23  priority bridges in selected areas.  A proposal has been submitted by M/s Ellipse Projects SAS of France for same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways to implement the relevant project based on the said proposal and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee to evaluate the proposal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rs.320 million (Japanese Yen 200 million) Grant Aid for improvement of the Anti-Narcotic Activities under the Japanese Non Project Grant Aid - 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the increase of prevalence in the drug related activities in Sri Lanka has become an emerging social problem in the country and that in order to control the situation, the necessity of providing modern equipment to detect large scale drug traffickers and the drug users has been recognized. Accordingly, on a request made by the Government of Sri Lanka, the Government of Japan has agreed to provide a grant of Japanese Yen 200 million (Approximately Rs.320 million) for the provision of the necessary equipment to the Sri Lanka Police to investigate and detect anti-narcotic activities.  In this context, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development  to sign the Exchange of Notes pertaining to same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reinstatement in service of the Police Officers of the Sri Lanka Police and the Special Task Force who have been served with Vacation of Post notice
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Police should maintain a skilled force in order to provide a proper service expected of them by the public. Presently, there is a considerable number of vacancies in the Sri Lanka Police and to make new recruitments, it will take a considerable period of time and need to incur a large amount of  expenditure to engage them in service after providing the necessary training. As such, it has been observed that a considerable number of experienced officers who have had the basic training and issued with vacation of post notices for various reasons could be re engaged in the police service within a short period of time by adopting an appropriate method. Hence, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development and Minister of Internal Trade, Food Security and Consumer Welfare and State Minister of Defence to appoint a Committee to reconsider the appeals of the officers rejected for having not submitted their appeals within the prescribed period adhering to a proper and a transparent procedure and to reinstate the officers, who had vacated their posts, based on the recommendations of the said Committee with the approval of the relevant authorities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendation of the Finance Commission for the financial year 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President for the implementation of the recommendations made by the Finance Commission for the financial year 2020 and to table a resolution in Parliament of the said recommendation in terms of Article 154 R(7) of the Constitution informing that action would be taken to implement the said recommendation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Placement of 50,000 Unemployed Graduates and Diploma Holders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body:
- The approval of the Cabinet has already been granted for the placement of 50,000 inclusive of unemployed graduates and holders of diploma certificates recognized by the University Grants Commission as equivalent to a degree.  Accordingly, approval was granted by the Cabinet for the following proposals made by H.E. the President relating to the implementation of the said programme:

*	issuing of trainee letters of appointment to the graduates and the diploma holders recruited for the training under the supervision of the Secretary to the Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils & Local Government by the District Secretary/Government Agent

*	provide the trainees with the necessary training by attaching them to the institutions identified during the period of training.

*	at the end of the one year satisfactorily training period, to attach them to the institutions of the Central Government and the Provincial Public Service in the rural areas where they have opted to serve.

description: Bandaranaike International Airport Development Project - Phase II Stage 2 Package 'A'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - As it is anticipated that the number of passengers entertained annually at the  Bandaranaike International Airport will be increased up to 20 million by the year 2025, it is imperative that the construction activities for increasing the capacity of the passenger terminal be carried out without delay in order to meet this situation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Civil Aviation to award the contract of the Bandaranaike International Airport Development Project - Phase II Stage 2 Package 'A' to Taisei Corporation at a total cost of Japan Yen 41,553.89 million and Sri Lanka Rs.35,135.84 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Contract for the Construction of 220kV Switching Station at Kerawalapitiya under Package 01 of the Power System Reliability Strengthening Project implemented under the Funds of Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy to award the contract for the  Construction of 220kV Switching Station at Kerawalapitiya under Package 01 of the Power System Reliability Strengthening Project implemented under the funds of Asian Development Bank to M/s KEC International Limited for a sum of Rs.2,774.89 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining approval for the award of one civil work contract package in the Northern Province under the Asian Development Bank (ADB) funded Second Integrated Road Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways to award the contract package - 4 for the Rehabilitation, Improvement and Maintenance of the Marudankerni Road (B 371) in Point Pedro of the Jaffna District in the Northern Province under the Second Integrated Road Investment Programme funded by the Asian Development Bank, to M/s NEM Construction (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.1,684.81 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer - 2020 (End of March)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19

description: Joint Sri Lanka - China Biotechnology Laboratory of Industrial Technology Institute (ITI) to be established at the Modern Research and Development Complex (MRDC) in Malabe
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the approval granted by the Cabinet previously, an agreement has been reached between the Industrial Technology Institute (ITI) and  Yunnan Rural Science and Technology Centre of China with regard to the establishment of a Joint Biotechnology Laboratory in the Modern Research and Development Centre at Malabe. In order to establish the said Technology Laboratory, the construction work in the ground floor of the Modern Research and Development Centre at Malabe should be completed. It has been proposed to carry out the said activities on cost sharing basis by the two Governments. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, to award the procurement for the design and service activities of the ground floor of the proposed Biotechnology Laboratory to M/s Prosperous Industrial Company (Pvt.) Ltd. as recommended by the Departmental Procurement Committee and to sign an Agreement between the two parties in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for design and construction for the completion of the balance work of the 624 Housing Project at Colombage Mawatha in Kirulapona
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - The Urban Regeneration Project has been initiated, with a view to facilitating the housing requirement of the undeserved community in the city of Colombo. In this regard, action is being taken to obtain a US$ 200 million loan facility from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. The proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities to award the contract for design and construction for the completion of the balance work of the 624 Housing Project at Colombage Mawatha in Kirulapona, utilizing a part of these funds, to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt) Limited as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cancellation of the Cabinet approval granted for the liquidation of the National Paper Company Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - Reopening of the state-owned enterprises that have already been closed down without making production activities, has been identified  as a priority activity of the Government and the Ministry of Industries and Supply Chain Management  has decided to reopen all state enterprises that are presently not conducting any production activities and which have the potential to be restructured. As such, it has been planned to reopen the Valachchena and Embilipitiya paper mills under the National Paper Corporation where the production activities have been stopped at present and, the relevant feasibility studies in that regard is in progress. In this context, it is absolutely necessary that the National Paper Corporation being operational and as such, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management to cancel the Cabinet decision made earlier to liquidate this corporation and to implement a voluntary pension compensation scheme in order to terminate the service of the employees serving in same at present, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of Aluminum Powder to Sri Lanka and its distribution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - Prior to commencing the production of aluminum powder by the private sector in the year 2003, the aluminum powder required for the country was imported by the Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation with the approval of the Ministry of Defence. However, with the relaxation of the legal restrictions that existed for the importation of aluminum powder, it is observed that aluminum power is being imported continually by the private sector without producing it locally. As such, the necessity for formulating legislation to prevent such situation has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of   Internal Trade, Food Security and Consumer Welfare, to empower the Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation with the sole authority of importation and distribution of aluminum powder enabling it to import aluminum powder and issue same only to the licensed firework producers, licensed sale agents and for industries which use aluminum powder, as a raw material, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Pilot project for the free issue of environment friendly fertilizer to farmers from the 'Yala' Season of 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - At the Cabinet meeting held on the 02nd of January 2020, it was decided that a methodology should be formulated to induce the farmers to use high quality organic fertilizer.  A Cabinet Sub Committee has been appointed to formulate  such a methodology to submit appropriate recommendations in this regard.  The Committee had pointed out that the standards relevant to the organic liquid fertilizer and bio-fertilizer should also be declared expeditiously, since the Sri Lanka Standard Institution has already declared the standards for organic fertilizer. At present, about 250 organic fertilizer producers are engaged in the production activities, Island wide and standard certificates have been awarded to 36 persons out of them.  Taking these matters into consideration, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development, to implement a pilot project by formulating a methodology to issue solely the environmental friendly types of fertilizer or the same mixed in due proportion with chemical fertilizer instead of chemical fertilizer  free of charge as a subsidy for paddy and other food crops in several selected areas and to extend the said project further, based on the outcome after defining the productivity of same through application of the said fertilizer for a minimum of 04 seasons, in the areas where the pilot project is being implemented with a view to encouraging the farmers to use environment friendly fertilizer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ensuring access to Higher Education Opportunities for the students eligible from the Academic Year 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - It has been predicted that the number of students who will be eligible for the university admission by the year 2024 will be increased up to around 24,000 and in accordance with the new development policy frame work of the Government, the Government expects to provide higher educational opportunities for all students who pass the advance level examination from the academic year 2020. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, to establish a Panel of Experts comprising of experts in the fields of Education, Technology and Information Technology to submit recommendations in regard to the steps to be taken to achieve the said goal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Draft Agreement between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Czech Republic for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and Prevention of Fiscal Evasion 	in respect of the taxes on income
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-19
decision_details_body: - An Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Czech Republic, for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion has been initialed at Officials' level on the 15th of March 2019. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development for signing of the relevant Agreement at Government level and presenting the signed Agreement in Parliament in terms of Section 75(1) of the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting promotions for one instance only to the male and female police 	officers in the post of Police Constable to that of Inspector of Police who 	have not gained promotions for a long period of time
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: Despite fulfilling the requisite qualifications, a large number of male and female police officers in the post of  Police Constable to that of  Inspector of Police could not gain promotions as a proper procedure has not been followed to grant promotions for police officers during the recent past. It is observed that although the relevant Schemes of Recruitment had been approved, the promotions have not been made accordingly. In this context, nearly 50 court cases challenging the promotions granted at several occasions are pending at the Supreme Court, at present. A set of proposals have been made by a Committee appointed by the  Police Headquarters to study this situation and grant the relevant promotions and its first phase has been implemented by now. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development and Minister of Internal Trade, Food Security and Consumer Welfare and State Minister of Defence to grant promotions to Police Constables,  female Police Constables, Police Sergeants, female Police Sergeants, Sub Inspectors of Police, female Sub Inspectors of Police, Inspectors of Police and female Inspectors of Police who had not been promoted for a long time, was approved by the Cabinet treating same as a matter of policy.

description: Implementation of the Value Addition Project for Mineral Sand excavated by Lanka Mineral Sands Ltd. under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) Method
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: A market competition has been created among the other countries in the global market by selling value-added products at present and therefore, it has been found necessary to pay attention on the export of value-added products of mineral sands to the world market rather than export of mineral sands in the Raw Form. In order to achieve the said target, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Supply Management for the implementation of a value addition export programme by starting a Public-Private Partnership project utilizing the Mineral Sand excavated by Lanka Mineral Sands Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Resolution to avail provisions for the settlement of unsettled bills of the year 2019 in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2020-02-05 granted approval to present a Resolution in Parliament in order to amend the Vote on Account - 2020 with a view to availing provisions for the settlement of  the unsettled liabilities amounting to approximately Rs.367 billion pertaining to the projects and programmes commenced by the previous Government within the last year. Accordingly, the proposal made by Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to present the said Resolution prepared by the Legal Draftsman for which the clearance of the Attorney General has been granted, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Funds for the Government Paddy Purchasing Programme of 2019/2020 Maha Season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: In order to ensure a reasonable price for the paddy harvest of farmers, the Government has commenced the Paddy Purchasing Programme of 2019/2020 Maha Season. This Paddy Purchasing Programme is being implemented directly through the Paddy Marketing Board as well as through Divisional Secretaries via small and medium scale paddy millers and cooperative societies under the supervision of the respective District Secretaries/Government Agents. Accordingly, the measures have already been taken to release pledge loans amounting to Rs 3,830 million through the Bank of Ceylon, People's Bank and the Regional Development Bank.  Therefore,the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development, to further release additional funds required for the purpose, to implement the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The proposal for doubling of the track between Kurunegala and Maho under the Indian Line of Credit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: As a result of the congestion between Kurunegala and the Maho section in the Northern railway line, a delay of over one hour of office trains in the mornings and evenings is a very common occurrence.  As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport Services Management, to construct an additional track  of 43KM in length with an upgrading signaling system in addition to the existing line between Kurunegala and Maho utilizing the balance money remaining from the Indian Credit Line with a view to  reducing the travel time of the North bound passenger trains and accrue the full benefit of the re-construction of the Northern railway lines and to obtain the services of the Central Engineering Construction Bureau for the related consultancy services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Asian Development Bank funded Second Integrated Road Investment Programme - awarding of ten civil work contract packages in the Western Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: The proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways, to award 10 civil work contract packages for the rehabilitation, improvement and maintenance of rural roads in the Western Province implemented under the Second Integrated Road Investment Programme to the institutions namely, M/s NCC Limited, Kalika Construction Pvt. Ltd., and Gamini Construction Joint Venture, Hovel Construction Pvt. Ltd., and Senok Trade Combine (Pvt.) Ltd., Joint Venture, Access Engineering PLC and Luxman Metal Crushers & Enterprises, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the selection of a Consultancy Service Firm for Monitoring and Evaluation of the Health System Enhancement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: In accordance with the recommendation submitted by the Consultants' Procurement Committee appointed by the Cabinet regarding the procurement for the selection of a consultant for the Health System Enhancement Project, funded by the Asian Development Bank, the proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services, to award the said contract to the Sri Lanka Business Development Centre for a sum of Rs.94.23 million inclusive of all taxes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of the Manning Market of Pettah at Peliyagoda - Construction of the Super Structure - Improvements to the intersection and development of the access road to the proposed Manning Market Complex from the Expressway Link Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: The construction of the new Manning Market at Peliyagoda has been commenced in January 2016 and it has been planned to complete the construction work and open the market to the public in March 2020. The existing Gnanarathana Mawatha, which is the main access road to the new Manning Market at Peliyagoda when opened for both the Manning Market and the Fish Market complex, it is likely to create a huge road congestion on the existing expressway link road to Katunayake and hence, it will be required to expand a strip of road of 315M of length in that road within a very short time. Accordingly, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities, to award the contract to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., engaged in the construction work of the super structure of the Manning Market complex, to improve and develop the relevant road section in concurrence with the said constructions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the issue of visas free of charge for the tourists visiting Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2019‑07‑30 to implement the programme for issuance of Gratis Visas for tourists visiting Sri Lanka from 48 countries for a period of 06 months from 2019‑08‑01. In respect of this, it has been observed that there has been a growth in tourist arrival from these countries to this country during the period when the free visa programme was in operation. Taking this situation into consideration, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Civil Aviation, to extend this visa free of charge programme for the same 48 countries already approved, for a further period of 03 months from 2020‑02‑01 to 2020‑04‑30, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of blocks of land from the Regional Industrial Estates to set up industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: The Regional Industrial Estates Development Programme implemented by the Ministry of Industries and Supply Chain Management is a major programme implemented with the objective of promoting industries. Under this programme, the 'Project Evaluation Committee of the Ministry' has recommended to allocate blocks of land to 8 investors to commence projects in the industrial estates. A sum of Rs.726.3 million is due to be invested to implement the project proposals presented by these investors and it is anticipated that it will generate 270 direct employment opportunities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management, to allocate the said blocks of land to the identified investors, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Maintenance of a buffer stock of rice for food security and price stabilization in the Market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: As a price hike is seen in the rice market towards November and December in almost every year, a buffer stock of rice is needed for distribution during such period. The Food Commissioner's Department, presently, possesses a stock facility to maintain a buffer stock of rice to a capacity of 24,000MT. In times of price increase of rice, it is anticipated to maintain a level of price stability in rice by releasing the buffer stock of rice at a Government guaranteed price to the market through the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE). Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development, to obtain paddy stocks purchased by the Paddy Marketing Board and maintain a buffer stock of 20,000MT of Samba and Nadu rice, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: International Scientific Cooperation for Food Safety and Security in Sri Lanka under the Sustainable Rice Production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: The Paddy Research Development Institute of the Department of Agriculture is responsible for paddy research in Sri Lanka and breeding of all rice varieties cultivated in Sri Lanka is done in the research stations of the institute. In this process, the International Rice Research Institute in Philippine extends its cooperation by providing the necessary instructions, guidance, genetic resources and technology.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development to implement a programme to work in collaboration with the International Rice Research Institute to produce rice varieties resistant to climatic changes, diseases and pests expected presently as well as in time to come, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Access to the Madrid Protocol for the implementation of the International Registration of Trade and Service Marks under the Madrid Agreement and to make amendments to the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003 accordingly
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: Presently, no legal provision exists for the applicants who submit their applications to the National Intellectual Property Office to register their trade mark or service mark to obtain international registration directly through the said office. In this respect, they have to submit applications separately  through the Intellectual Property Agents operating in each county. Under these circumstances, it has been proposed that Sri Lanka should seek access to the Madrid Protocol administered by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO). The Madrid system provides exporters with a reliable, convenient and cost effective way to protect trade marks in a series of jurisdictions.  Accordingly, 	the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, to access the Madrid Protocol by easing to submit applications internationally under the said system with a view to inducing the commercial community of Sri Lanka and to make the necessary amendments  to the National Intellectual Property Act for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a mobile phone Short Message Service (SMS) which immediately notifies the members of the Employees' Provident Fund of the crediting of their monthly contributions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: The number of permanent employees who hold the membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) currently is around 2.6 million. In accordance with the existing process, it has been found that it takes about a period of 06 to 12 months for the members of the EPF to get to know that their contributions are credited and therefore, the members are constantly confronted with a number of issues. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Skills Development, Employment and Labour Relations to implement a mobile phone short massage service to a mobile number provided by the member that the contribution has been credited to his/her account instantly as it takes place, enabling him/her to receive a monthly confirmation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of the confiscated sand and timber
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: The approval of the Cabinet has been granted in 2016 to provide the sand and timber confiscated by courts throughout the country to ensure construction and renovation of places of religious worship and the Government Institutions at concessionary rates and the period allowed for such concessionary rates have been extended from time to time and finally up to 31st December 2019.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Human Rights & Law Reforms, to extend the procedure for a further period of one (01) year to enable only the places of religious worship to obtain such sand and timber, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling of applications to purchase bricks for the re creation of the Deeghawapi Stupa in Ampara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: Bids have been called for under the National Competitive Bidding System to purchase bricks  for re‑creating the Deegahawapi Stupa in Ampara and accordingly,  Technical Evaluation Committee appointed has evaluated the 08 bids received for the purpose and submitted its recommendations. Taking into consideration the above recommendations made in this regard, 07 suppliers have been selected and the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs to purchase the necessary bricks from the said 07 suppliers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting of the Gazette Notifications under the Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52) for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body:
The proposal made by the  Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to present the following Gazette Notifications issued under the Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52) in relevance to several amendments made to duties levied under the Excise Ordinance in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	the Excise Notification No.07/2019 published in the Gazette (Extra Ordinary) No.2152/11 dated 2019‑12‑03;

*	the Excise Notification No.08/2019 published in the Gazette (Extra Ordinary) No.2152/12 dated 2019‑12‑03; and

*	the Excise Notification No.09/2019 published in the Gazette (Extra Ordinary) No.2152/13 dated 2019‑12‑03.

description: Providing Sri Lanka's contribution to the possible Financing Package for Arrears Clearance and Debt Relief for Somalia to support its reform process in the form of a grant utilizing the International Monetary fund (IMF) Internal Resources apportioned to its Member Countries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-12
decision_details_body: The International Monitory Fund's burden sharing mechanism is a policy approved by the Executive Board of the International Monetary fund (IMF) in 1986 and this methodology has been adopted to reimburse the loss of income due to unpaid charges by members for various reasons. Accordingly, a request has been made to the member countries to contribute part or all of their respective shares in the IMF internal resources to support 'Somaliya - Possible Financing Package for Arrears Clearance and Debt Relief' for Somaliya approved by the Executive Board of the Fund in December 2019. The Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Relations have expressed their concurrence to provide Sri Lanka's contribution. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development, to transfer a sum equalant to Rs.163 million as Sri Lanka's total contribution to the Somaliya Administered Account, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The programme for the placement of unemployed Graduates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body:
- Despite the fact that arrangements had been put in place on several occasions in the past, for the placement of Graduates, it has been found that there are still a considerable number of vacancies in the Government Institutions Island wide. It is also observed that the people living in remote and rural areas are faced with immense difficulties when obtaining Public Services specially due to the dearth of Government Officers in such areas. 

	As such, action has been initiated to bring about a positive transformation in the methodologies presently adopted with a view to evolving a people-centric system of  delivery of Public Services beyond the limits of the administrative culture traditionally followed by mobilizing the skills and competencies of the younger generation with the contribution of nearly 50,000 passed out Graduates from the Universities since the year 2012 and unemployed up to date.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President to recruit unemployed Graduates and the youth who have obtained a Degree or have satisfied such educational qualifications equivalent to a Degree as at 2019‑12‑31 recognized by the University Grants Commission, to the following institutions, as Graduate Trainees subject to one (01) year training period enabling to provide them with an opportunity for transfers at District/Provincial Level after having served five (05) years continuously at the place of the first appointment, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	Ministry of Education 
		
	(Inclusion of the subject 'leadership' in the school curriculum from Grade 6 to Grade 11 in all schools and teach the subject in every school and to fill the vacancies in the Rural and Estate Schools)

*	Department of Irrigation (Maintenance of Rural Irrigation)



*	Department of Agrarian Development (Rural Agricultural Development)

*	Department of Wildlife (Wildlife Conservation and Community Projects)

*	Department of Ayurveda (Indigenous Ayurveda Divisional Hospitals)

*	Ministry of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services (Rural Hospitals/Dispensaries) 

*	Department of Surveyor General 

*	Department of Agriculture (Divisional Agriculture Services and Technological Services) 

*	Department of Export Agriculture (Minor Export Crop Projects)

*	Department of Animal Production and Health (Development of Animal Farms) 

*	Department of Valuation

*	Department of Immigration and Emigration

description: Finance (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - The Debt Repayment Levy which was imposed under the Finance Act, No.35 of 2018, is required to be abolished in line with the Economic Revival Initiative Programme introduced by H.E. the President, as approved by the Cabinet of Ministers by its decision dated 2019‑11‑27. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development to submit the Finance (Amendment) Bill, which has been prepared by the Legal Draftsman incorporating the necessary legal provisions to abolish the Debt Repayment Levy with effect from 2020‑01‑01, for the approval of Parliament subsequent to publishing the same in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Availing provisions for the settlement of unsettled bills of the Year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - Additional budgetary provisions of Rs.367 billion are required to settle bills of completed projects implemented under various Ministries under the previous Government and unsettled so far and to account the expenditure of development projects implemented utilizing funds obtained through foreign sources that are not included within the limits of annual borrowings. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development to take action to submit a resolution in Parliament in order to avail of the said budgetary provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dedicated Access Road to the Passenger Terminal of the Bandaranaike International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that airport access is highly congested at the peak time due to a large number of passengers entering to and exiting from the Bandaranaike International Airport. Therefore, it has been planned to construct a separate Segregate Airport Access Road which contains two lane, dual roads from the Board of Investment and Minuwangoda road to provide with easy access to the airport. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Aviation, to construct the relevant road subject to an estimate  of Rs. 600 million and to make provisions for same from the Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) Ltd, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of the Wildlife Research and Training Centre at Girithale
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body:
- The proposed renovation activities of the Wildlife Research and Training Centre at Girithale has been planned to be implemented under the Eco System Conservation and Management Project, and the duration of the said project is due to be finalized by 2021‑06‑30. It has been observed that, if the proposed renovation activities are implemented as one project, it is not possible to complete the relevant construction activities before the due date of finalization of the project. 

	As such, the concurrence of the Cabinet was granted for the proposal made by the Minister of Environment and Wildlife Resources to carry out the relevant rehabilitation activities after calling for bids as 03 procurements under the 03 main components namely renovation of the existing education and administrative buildings of Wildlife Research and Training Centre at Girithale as  a Research Centre, renovation of the hostel building with modern facilities and construction of the Academic Complex.

description: Consultancy Services for Feasibility Studies and Detailed Engineering Designs for Flood Risk Mitigation in Mundeni Aru River Basin and Batticaloa under the Climate Resilience Improvement Project (CRIP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development to enter into an Agreement with M/s Egis Eau & SCP & Green Tech JV to carry out feasibility studies as the Phase I of the Contract on  Consultancy Services for Feasibility Studies and Detailed Engineering Designs for Flood Risk Mitigation in Mundeni Aru River Basin under the Climate Resilience Improvement Project (CRIP) and  after the completion of Phase I,    to enter into an Agreement with the same Institute for the Consultancy Contract of preparing detailed engineering designs under its Phase II, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract regarding the Supply of Liquefied Petroleum Gas for the year 2020/2022 - Litro Gas Lanka Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - The Litro Gas Lanka Ltd., formed as a Government owned company, is the Liquefied Petroleum Gas supplier with 75% of the market share of Liquefied Petroleum Gas users. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development, to award the contract for the purchase of 740,000  Metric Tons of Liquefied Petroleum Gas to M/s Litro Gas Lanka Ltd., for a period of 02 years from 1st March 2020 to M/s Oman Trading international Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, assuring continuous supply to the market,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entry into term contract for the import of 2,240,000 Bbls of Gas Oil (0.05% Maximum Sulphur) during the period of eight months from 2020-03-01 to 2020-10-31
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy,  to award the term procurement for the import of 2,240,000 Bbls of Gas Oil (0.05% Maximum Sulphur) during the period of eight months from 2020-03-01 to 2020-10-31 to the M/s Swiss Singapore Overseas Enterprises Pte. Ltd., as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entry into a term contract for the import of 520,000 Bbls of Gas Oil (0.05% Maximum Sulphur) and 680,000 Bbls of Gasoline (92 Unl) during the period of eight months from 2020-03-15 to 2020-11-14
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy,  to award the term procurement for the import of estimated 520,000 Bbls of Gas Oil (0.05% Maximum Sulphur) and 680,000 Bbls of Gasoline (92 Unl) during the period of eight months from 2020-03-15 to 2020-11-14 to M/s Petrochina International (Singapore) Pte Ltd., as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Time Charter of Maintenance and Emergency Response Vessel (MERV) for the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - 70% of the fuel requirement of Sri Lanka is supplied by the imported refined petroleum products and for this purpose there are three fuel unloading locations  located outside of the Colombo Port and inside the Colombo Port. Among them, the operation and maintenance of  the single point buoy mooring systems located 9.2 km away from the Colombo Port is done by using a Specially Created Maintenance & Emergency Response Vessel (MERV).  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy, to obtain such a vessel on a hiring basis to perform the relevant services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Consultancy Services for the Project Implementation of the Railway Efficiency Improvement Project (REIP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - Part of a loan received from the Asian Development Bank for the Railway Efficiency Improvement Project (REIF) is to be used for the supply of the consultancy service of the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport Services Management, to award the relevant consultancy services contract with the concurrence of the Asian Development Bank, to the joint venture created by Egis Rail and Egis International and Greentech Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd., as per the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Comprehensive Integrated CCTV Camera Solution for the Port of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been submitted by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority to establish a security camera system covering all entrances to the port premises, cargo, warehouses, terminals, open storage areas, roads, perimeter fences and the break water entrances to the harbour to observe, monitor and record all activities happening in those places. This would result the further assurance of the security of the Colombo Port, increase the productivity and efficiency and create a conducive environment for the commercial activities in the Port of Colombo. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports & Shipping, to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and a Technical Evaluation Committee for same,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 340,000 Vials of Rabies Vaccine (Human Use) (0.5ml / 1ml)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous MedicalServices, to award the procurement for the supply of 340,000 vials of Rabbies Vaccine (Human Use) (0.5 ml/1 ml) used for preventing Rabies to M/s New Arumed (Pvt.) Ltd., at a total cost of Rs.399.84 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee,	was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 950,000 Prefilled Syringe of Epoetin Injection 4,000 IU - 5,000IU
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical	Services, to award the procurement for the supply of 950,000 Prefilled	Syringe of Epoetin Injection 4000 IU - 5000 IU used for the treatment of	kidney patients, to M/s Reliance Life Science, India at a total cost and	freight price of US$ 1.39 	million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet	Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for the construction of the student hostel of the Sri Lanka German Technical Training Institute (SLGTI) at Killinochchi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Skills Development, Employment and Labour Relations, to award the Contract for the construction of the student hostel of the Sri Lanka German Technical Training Institute (SLGTI) at Kilinochchi to M/s Wahid Construction (Pvt) Ltd at 450/4, Lakvil, Puttlam Road, Yanthampalawa, Kurunagala for a sum of Rs. 185.61 million (subject to the payment of the Value added tax, as per the government tax regulations and approved percentages) as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing of facilities to issue Medical Certificates from the Government Hospitals in the process of issuing Driving Licenses for Light Vehicles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - Around 150 Base hospitals and District hospitals are there in the Island,  equiped with facilities for medical tests included in the medical certificates issued by the National Transport Medical Institute for the issuance of Motor Vehicle License, Nevertheless when medical certificates are issued from such hospitals, it is not possible for the clients to obtain all services from the same place. As such, it has been identified that it is appropriate to establish a separate unit at the Government hospitals for this purpose. Accordingly, a proposal has been made by the Minister of Transport Services Management, to the Cabinet, to establish units with facilities at Government hospitals  enabling to provide the service recipients their medical certificates after conducting the relevant tests at  Government hospitals in accordance with  a format prepared by the National Transport Medical Institute and obtain all services in one place. Taking these mattes into consideration, Cabinet approval was granted to take appropriate measures to amend the Motor Traffic Act, No.8 of 2009, in a manner conferring authority, to the medical officers registered under the Medical Ordinance in order to issue the medical certificate considered for the issuance of driving license facilitating the implementation of such programme.

description: Implementation of a value addition project for the graphite mining by the Kahatagaha Graphite Lanka Ltd., on Public-Private Partnership basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - Kahatagaha Graphite Lanka Ltd., is a fully owned Government institution and the Kahatagaha Graphite mine belonging to it where its graphite mining activities are carried out exports around 65 to 70 MT of graphite per month in the form of raw materials. The supply of graphite from Sri Lanka is about 7% of the global requirement. Under the circumstances, there is no way of making an impact felt in the international market and as such, it has been identified that value addition for the graphite obtained through the excavation of Kahatagaha Mine is absolutely necessary. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management,  to call for expressions of interest from both local and foreign investors under the competitive bidding system only in respect of  the activity of value addition process of the graphite supplied after excavation, and to implement the proposed project having selected a suitable investor on evaluation of the proposals submitted by a Project Committee and a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the re-commencement of the Production activities of the Oddusudan Factory under the restructuring of the Ceylon Ceramics Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - In terms of the policy to re-open the state owned enterprises stated in the Government manifesto, it has been decided to restructure the Ceylon Ceramics Corporation functioning under the Ministry of Industries and Supply Chain Management and re-open all factories in a state of defunct under the said Corporation with the restructuring of same. As a pilot project, it has been planned to re-commence the production activities of the tile and brick production factory situated in Oddusudan in the Mullaitivu District and it is anticipated to produce about 04 lakhs of tiles and bricks per month. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management to retain the full ownership of the building and machinery of the said factory with the Ceylon Ceramics Corporation and to implement the production of tiles and bricks in collaboration with the Samson Rajarata Tiles (Pvt.) Ltd. which is a member company of the DSI Samson Group (Pvt.) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a fruit-based processing factory in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - ORANA, one of the World's largest Denmark suppliers of fruit based raw materials which supplies beverages associated with milk and fruit-based raw materials required for bakery manufactures has made a request for a land in extent of 2 acres from the Industrial Zone situated in Pannala for the establishment of a fruit based processing factory. Under Stage I of the proposed project, the investor has planned to invest US$ 1.5 million under which around 30 job opportunities will be newly generated. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management, to give a portion of land from the Pannala Industrial Zone to implement the said project subject to an Agreement being signed between the ORANA institute and the Industrial Development Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Kankesanthurai Harbour Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to vest an extent of about 50 acres of land adjacent to the  Harbour with the Sri Lanka Ports Authority for the development of the Kankesanthurai Harbour. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of  Ports & Shipping to transfer a portion of state land in extent of 15 acres adjacent to the Harbour subject to the payment of Rs.52 million and also to acquire another 35 acres of land under private ownership after payment of compensation subject to the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Programme for the development of a 100,000 km alternative road system
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted by the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2019‑12‑18 to develop a 100,000 km alternative road system to facilitate a higher level of access to main roads and express ways. Accordingly, the roads to be developed will be identified taking into consideration that no renovation work had been carried out at all during the past 10 years and making use of the criteria based on matters pertaining to the number of families utilizing the ability to access, educational, medical and marketing facilities by making use of the roads.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways, to implement the proposed programme with the participation of the Provincial Councils and to implement certain components identified in the ongoing projects for the development of roads  under foreign funds also under the proposed programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the identified projects with the utilization of the  remaining funds of the Climate Resilience Improvement Project (CRIP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body: - The Climate Resilience Improvement Project initiated under the World Bank funds in the year 2014 is due to be completed by 2020‑06‑30. The total value of the project is US$ 152 million. In terms of the Agreements pertaining to the project, the goals anticipated are in the process of being achieved. It has been found that there is a saving of about Rs.2,500 million from the provisions allocated to the project after the completion of the activities of its identified components. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development, to allocate funds out of such saving for the constructions found as essential which were not identified at the time of designing the project and also to utilize the provisions remaining further for designing the preliminary activities identified in the Multi Phased Climate Resilience Programme implemented under the World Bank funds, was approved by the Cabinet.
