description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Human Capacities of Hungary and the Ministry of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on an Educational and Scientific Exchange Scholarship Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body:
- It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the  Government of Hungary with a view to expanding overseas higher education opportunities for the students of this country, in accordance with the Development Strategic Programme for the development of a knowledge based economy through the human resources development in line with the Government's National Policy Framework 'Vistas of Prosperity'. Through the proposed Agreement Sri Lankan Students will be entitled to 20 scholarships annually by the Government of Hungary and  Sri Lanka will have opportunities for altogether 60 scholarships within the 03 year period of valid duration. Similarly the Government of Sri Lanka will award scholarships to 05 Hungarian students, annually, for academic or research activities. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, to sign the Memorandum of Understanding relating to the Educational and Scientific Exchange Scholarship Programme, between the Ministry of Human Capacities of Hungary and the the Ministry of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation of Sri Lanka and to implement the Scholarship Exchange Programme by the Ministry of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation as per the MoU,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presentation of the 205th and 206th Recommendations and the 190th Convention of the International Labour Organization in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Minister of Skills Development, Employment and Labour Relations,  to present the following Recommendations and the Convention adopted at the 108th and 106th session of the International Labour Conference, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet. 

	At the 108th session of the International Labour Conference held in the year 2019 : 

Convention 190	-	Convention concerning the Elimination of Violence and Harassment in the World of Work 

Recommendation 206	-	Recommendation concerning the Elimination of Violence and Harassment in the World of Work

	At the 106th session of the International Labour Conference held in the year 2017 : 

Recommendation 205	-	Recommendation concerning Employment and Decent Work for Peace and Resilience

description: Archaeological Heritage Management of the Rajagala Archaeological Premises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-02-05
decision_details_body:
- It has been identified that there are 593 sites of archaeological importance spread over in extent of about 1,025 acres belonging to the 'Ariyakara Viharaya' premises situated in Rajagala Tenna coming within the Uhana Divisional Secretariat Division. Several highly important sites out of these have already been excavated, conserved and endowed to the nation by now and as a result of which the attraction of tourists to these places have been increased. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs, to implement the Rajagala Restoration Project jointly by the Department of Archaeology and the University of Sri Jayawardenepura until the end of the year 2022, in order to conserve the monuments considered as sensitive archaeologically and as well as historically, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply, Installation and Supervision of 145 kV Double Busbar Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and the modification of 145 kV Double Busbar (GIS) with Control, Protection, Monitoring and Metering under the extension of 132 kV Kelanitissa Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-22
decision_details_body: - Extension of Kelanitissa 132 kv Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) has been initiated to connect the proposed Gas Turbines to the 132 kv Busbar of Kelanitissa Grid Substation. The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the contract for the Supply, Delivery and Installation Supervision of Two Nos. of  145 kV Double Busbar Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and the modification of 145 kV Double Busbar (GIS) with Control, Protection, Monitoring and Metering to the original manufacturer, Asea Brown Bovari Lanka (Pvt) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Consultant for Civil Work Package - 03 under ''Reconstruction of 25 Bridges Project''
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-22
decision_details_body: - Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED) and the Government of Sri Lanka has signed an Agreement to provide 10 million Kuwait Dinars for the implementation the 'Reconstruction of 25 Bridges Project'. Reconstruction of 08 bridges which are week and narrow in condition in the national road network in the Western, Northern and North Eastern Provinces comes under Package 03 of the said project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways, to award the Consultancy Services Contract for the Package 03 of this project to M/s Al-Abdulhadi Engineering consultance (AEC) JV with Consulting Engineers & Architects Associated (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Consultants Procurement Committee,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Policy for the conservation and sustainable use of Mangrove Ecosystems in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-22
decision_details_body: - Although the Mangroves Ecosystems play a crucial role in the protection of the coastal zone by maintaining its ecological equilibrium, at present such ecosystems are being under threat due to various human activities. Taking this situation into consideration, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment and Wildlife Resources, to implement the national policy prepared with a view to ensuring the sustainability of the mangrove ecosystems with the participation of all the stakeholders led by the National Expert Committee on Mangrove Conservation and Sustainable use, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The present situation in the electricity industry of Sri Lanka and the  proposed measures to avert a future power shortage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-22
decision_details_body:
- Due to the delay of the planned power plant projects at present, the Ceylon Electricity Board has to face a serious challenge to meet the electricity demand of the country. As such, with a view to ensuring the Sri Lanka's power security and self-sufficiency and taking into consideration of the proposals made by the Minister of Power & Energy to implement the following measures expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	construction of a power plant unit with a capacity of 300 x 2 MW as an extension to the Coal Power Plant at Norochcholai.

*	establishment of a Liquefied  Natural Gas (LNG) plant in the Kerawalapitiya area with a capacity of 300 MW as a joint enterprise between the Ceylon Electricity Board and India/Japan.

*	accelerating the construction activities of the Liquefied Natural Gas plant with a capacity of 300 MW proposed to be constructed in the Kerawalapitiya area under the Asian Development Bank Funds.

*	accelerating the construction activities of the hydro-power plants and the renewable energy projects being constructed by the Ceylon Electricity Board.

*	implementation of the relevant projects expeditiously with the sum of US$ 100 agreed to be provided by the Government of India for generating solar power electricity generation.

description: Vesting of the land and the buildings with the Postgraduate Institute of Medicine of the University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation to vest the land in extent of 0.2074 hectares, at Prof. Nandadasa Kodagoda Mawatha (Norris Canal Road) in Kurunduwatta Grama Niladhari Division of the Thimbirigasyaya Divisional Secretariat Division where the Postgraduate Institute of Medicine of the University of Colombo is located and the buildings belonging therein, with the said Institution by way of a Free Grant in terms of the provisions of the State Land Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Attraction of foreign and non- resident Sri Lankan students to higher education in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-22
decision_details_body: - Even though legal provisions are in existence to  admit 4.5% of foreign students out of the total number of students expected to be admitted annually to the State Universities Undergraduate Degree Programmes, it has been found that only a limited number of foreign students get registered to study in the Universities of this country.  Considering this situation, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, with the objective of making Sri Lanka an International Knowledge Hub, to initiate promotional activities for admitting foreign students on fee levying within the already allocated percentage for foreign students, to admit the children of Sri Lankan foreign employees to the State Universities on fee levying basis from foreign currency and to initiate necessary action for establishing branches of the world renowned Universities as per the World University Ratings in this country, was approved by the Cabinet as a matter of policy.

description: Expediting the development of infrastructure facilities in the Universities of Sri Jayawardenepura, Wayamba, Ruhuna, Colombo, Sabaragamuwa, Peradeniya, Moratuwa and the Bhikku University of Sri Lnaka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, to implement 13 construction projects identified in the Universities of Sri Jayawardenepura, Wayamba, Ruhuna, Colombo, Sabaragamuwa, Peradeniya, Moratuwa and the Bhikku University of Sri Lnaka, on priority basis within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework of 2020 - 2022, with the objective of increasing their student intake capacity by 20% in the academic year 2021,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Science, Technology and Innovation Coordinating Authority (NASTICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-22
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously for the transition of the Coordinating Secretariat for Science, Technology and Innovation (COSTI)  into the National Science, Technology and Innovation Authority (NASTICA) through an Act, of Parliament. The Legal Draftsman's Department is presently in the process of finalizing the relevant draft Bill. As stated in the 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendor', Policy Statement, with a view to achieving the vision of transforming Sri Lanka into an International Innovation Centre, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation to draft the said Bill introducing the provisions incorporating the functions and the responsibilities of the Sri Lanka Inventors' Commission within the purview of  the National Science, Technology and Innovation Coordinati

description: Appointment of Authorized Representatives to submit visa applications of foreigners visiting and touring in Sri Lanka through the Electronic Travel Authorization System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-22
decision_details_body:
- The Department of Immigration and Emigration has been using the Electronic Travel Authorization System for pre-screening and granting of approval for foreign visitors to visit Sri Lanka since the year 2012.

Even though Sri Lanka is a more attractive country for Chinese tourists, it has been observed that the tourists from China who visit Sri Lanka has to face some delays at times, in obtaining visas since the Electronic Travel Authorization System is presently functioning only in the English language and that as a remedial measure, it is appropriate to have the services of a  private agency to assist them in obtaining their visas. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development,  the Minister of Internal Trade, Food Security and Consumer Welfare and the State  Minister of Defence, to obtain the services of Travelzen International Travel Service (Shanghai) Co. Ltd. of Shanghai, China which has the  experience of providing such services to a number of countries, was approved by the Cabinet as a matter of policy.

description: Accelerated Paddy Purchase Programme during the Maha Season 2019/2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-22
decision_details_body:
- Reaping of the harvest in the Maha Season 2019/2020 has already been commenced and a harvest of about 03 million MT of paddy is anticipated. Although there has been a slight increase in the price of rice, as a result of the non importation of rice by the Government as a matter of policy, it has been possible to save about US$ 100 million in foreign exchange. This situation has made it possible to stabilize the exchange rates and to have an impact on the reduction of the interest rate as well. Accordingly, it was decided by the Cabinet that the Government should intervene in the purchase of the excess stocks of paddy  during the Maha Season 2019/2020, with a view to stabilizing the price of paddy and compelling the rice mill owners of the private sector to purchase paddy at a reasonable price. As such, it was further decided that the following measures should be taken expeditiously.

*	stipulation of a minimum guaranteed price of Rs.50/- per standardized kilogram of paddy (subject to a criterion of moisture content).

*	stipulation of a minimum guaranteed price of Rs.45/- per  kilogram of paddy with the moisture content which is above the anticipated level.

*	implementation of the Government Paddy Purchasing Programme through the District Secretaries/Government Agents and the Paddy Marketing Board.

*	purchasing of the rice required by the Government institutions inclusive of the Tri Forces, the Department of Prisons and the Hospitals, directly.

*	vesting of all the Stores belonging to the Food Commissioner for storing the paddy stocks purchased, immediately, with the Paddy Marketing Board and the District Secretaries/Government Agents.

*	the use of lorries and trucks belonging to the Government institutions for the transportation of stocks of paddy.

*	issuing of pledge loans for an amount of Rs.100 billion at an interest rate of 8% through the Government and private banks to the paddy purchasers inclusive of small, medium and large scale rice mill owners for purchasing paddy under the guaranteed price.
*	vesting of the responsibility of operating the Government Paddy Purchasing Programme with several State Ministers in the major paddy producing districts of Polonnaruwa, Anuradhapura, Kurunegala, Vavuniya, Ampara, Batticaloa, Moneragala and Hambantota.

*	issuing of the required circular instructions by the Secretary to the President to implement the above programme expeditiously.

description: Implementation of the proposal pertaining to wages in the plantation sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - It has been stated in “Saubagyaye Dakma”  that action would be taken for the payment of a minimum wage of Rs.1000/- per day for estate workers. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President for the payment of a minimum wage of Rs.1000/- per day for estate workers with effect from 01st  March 2020, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Measures taken to ensure the continuous supply of petroleum in the country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - The Minister of Power & Energy made the Cabinet aware on the action so far taken by his Ministry together with Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) and Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminals Limited (CPSTL) in order to maintain an adequate storage of fuel in the country to meet possible shortage of fuel in future  due to the international political conflicts prevailing at present.

description: National Programme for the Eradication of Poverty
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14

description: Death of three Sri Lankan Students in Azerbaijan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has been informed by the Minister of Foreign Relations that necessary action is being coordinated by the Sri Lanka Missions in Tehran with the Western Caspian University in Azerbaijan and the Embassy of Azerbaijan in Tehran, to bring the human remains of the female students who had lost their lives as a result of a blaze in an apartment in Baku,  the capital of Azerbaijan, to Sri Lanka treating it as a matter of urgency. Further, the concurrence of the Cabinet was given for the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Relations, to bare the approximate cost of Rs.1.5 million by the Government of Sri Lanka,  to bring those bodies to the country, treating this as a special circumstance on humanitarian grounds.

description: Debt Relief Package Provided by the Government for Reviving the Small and Medium-Sized Entrepreneurial Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body:
- The small and Medium-Sized Entrepreneurs in the country have encountered severe problems due to their inability of obtaining new loans to expand their businesses, various fees and additional interests to be paid on non-performing loans due to the inability of serving loans continuously and the auctioning of the collateralized property by banks.

	A series of proposals has been submitted through the Government policy Framework ''Saubagyaye Dakma'' to re-energize the Small and Medium-Sized Entrepreneurial Sector, which has collapsed due to the complex taxation policies and banking laws and regulations enforced for the past few years, with a special emphasis on it.

	Accordingly, H.E the President has already directed all the Banks to suspend the legal action taken to recover the loans that have already been defaulted. 

	As its second phase, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development, to implement a  'Debt Relief Package' to grant a concessionary period to pay the capital moratorium in respect of the performing term loans as at 2019-12-31 borrowed by the Small and Medium-Sized Entrepreneures from licensed banks until 2020‑12‑31, upon a written request made by the borrower and to extend the tenure after the moratorium period without increasing the value of installments, to suspend all legal action relating to the recovery of non-performing loans as at 2019‑12‑31 and write off the total penal interest thereof, and also to grant new working capital loans, subject to the concessionary conditions, to resume businesses that have been closed due to the inability to pay off the loans, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Closure of the Policy Development Office established under the Prime Minister’s Office
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Government Policy Declaration enunciated as 'Saubagyaye Dakma', a decision has been taken to implement a programme to recruit suitably qualified individuals for each and every sector in the Public  Service and hence, it has been identified that there is no necessity any further to maintain the Policy Development Office established under the Prime Minister's Office in the year 2015. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development, for the closure of the said office, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development, to award the procurement for the supply of 15,000 MT of Urea (Granular) to the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Ltd. and the Colombo Commercial Company Fertilizer Ltd. at the rate of US$ 279.68 per MT at a total cost of US$ 4.40 million to M/s Ameropa Asia Pte Ltd. as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of HLA Molecular Testing Reagents
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services to award the procurement for the supply of HLA Molecular Testing Reagents used for ensuring the  safety in Organ Transplantation, to M/s Emar Pharma (Pvt.) Ltd. at a total cost of Rs.230.69 million (without VAT) as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of Laboratory Consumables Items
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services to award the procurement for the supply of 17 Laboratory Consumable Items used for ensuring the safety in Organ Transplantation, to M/s Emar Pharma (Pvt.) Ltd. at a total cost of Rs.188.82 million (without VAT) as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of the Common Wastewater Treatment Plant at the Seethawaka Export Processing Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - The Seethawaka Export Processing Zone which commenced in the year 1999 has been handed over to the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka in the year 2001. This comprises of 28 enterprises and has generated around 23,300 job opportunities. Although the capacity of the existing common wastewater treatment plant is 9,500 m3 per day, the industries therein discharge wastewater approximately 12,400 m3 per day. As the existing common wastewater treatment plant is not adequate for the treatment of wastewater discharged, it has been found that the capacity of the common wastewater treatment plant should be augmented immediately in order to avoid any adverse environmental and health issues. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industrial Export and Investment Promotion to implement the Augmentation of the Common Wastewater Treatment Plant Project at the Seethawaka Export Processing Zone to develop the capacity to 15,000 m3 per day, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Eco-Park by the Department of National Zoological Gardens at Thalawa in Anuradhapura in a land under the Department of Wildlife Conservation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - The Anuradhapura area, a tourist zone where local and foreign tourists visit all throughout the year is abundant with natural resources like forests and wild animals and has become an extremely attractive environment with large lakes and paddy fields. There is a potential to develop Eco-tourism industry through the sustainable utilization of these resources which will also create an atmosphere conducive to attracting more foreign tourists to the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment and Wildlife Resources for the establishment of an eco‑park of comprising of local wild animals within a 200 acre land at Nachchaduwa, Thalawa and Central Nuwaragam Palatha Divisional Secretariat Divisions in the Anuradhapura District, belonging to the Department of Forest Conservation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Kandy Tunnel Construction Project with funding from the Economic Development Cooperation Fund of Korea
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that it is appropriate to construct a By-Pass Tunnel as a solution to the vehicle congestion in the Kandy urban area. Although, it has been planned to implement the project for the construction of the by-pass tunnel in Kandy with funding from the Economic Development Cooperation Fund of Korea, the activities pertaining to the project have since been delayed. The total estimated cost of the project is US$ 252.30 million and the Economic Development Cooperation Fund of Korea has agreed to provide financial facilities amounting to US$ 199.27 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways to commence the procurement activities pertaining to the project for the construction of the said by-pass tunnel, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund Act, No.66 of 1981
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - The Hon. Chief Justice of the Supreme Court also serves as a member of the Board of Trustees of the Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund which controls the administration, management and its funds. Since the Hon. Chief Justice being a member of the Board of Trustees is an impediment to take an independent decision in the case of a Court proceeding, pertaining to the said fund, the Hon. Chief Justice himself as well as  the Committee on Public Enterprises have suggested that it is appropriate to relieve the Chief Justice from the said Board of Trustees. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation to amend the Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund Act, No.66 of 1981 enabling the appointment of members to the said Trust Fund as appropriate, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking over of the District General Hospital of Negombo by the Central Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body: - The  District General Hospital of Negombo which is situated in a strategic position being close to the Colombo - Katunayake expressway, the Bandaranayake International Airport and the Free Trade Zone of Katunayake provides its services to the hospitals of its catchment area as well as referral hospitals situated around it. Further, the hospital also provides its services to transit passengers, as well as the flight crews and also for tourists arriving at the airport. The Dengue Management Centre of this Hospital is known as the best centre for clinical management of dengue and dengue haemorragic fever. It has been identified that it would be appropriate for this hospital to function under the direct supervision of the Line Ministry in order to further strengthen its existing services. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services to take over the said Hospital  presently under the administration of the Provincial Health Ministry of the Western Province, by the Central Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Winding up of the National Agency for Public Private Partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body:
- The National Agency for Public Private Partnership operates as a unit of the Ministry of Finance with an Advisory Board comprising of the Secretary to the Treasury and other Officials with a cadre of 20 personnel, in accordance with a Cabinet decision taken in the year 2017.

	It has been identified that there is no necessity to maintain this unit any longer since the Government is taking action to streamline its activities and consolidate functions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to authorize the Secretary to the Treasury to undertake the winding up procedures of the said unit, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Intelligence Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-14
decision_details_body:
- The intelligence agencies in Sri Lanka make a significant contribution by predicting activities which would impact the national security, taking appropriate preventive measures and making suitable recommendations in that regard and have prevented terrorist and other threats on predictions made by such agencies, on account of information disclosed and recommendations made by them during national crises which have become vitally important to affirm the national security. 

It has been observed that the activities of certain intelligence agencies are curtailed due to the absence of adequate legal provision required to regulate activities related to intelligence operations and empower the intelligence agencies and support  their operational activities.

As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development, Minister of Internal Trade, Food Security and Consumer Welfare and the State Minister of Defence to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill empowering all fields of intelligence giving priority to the national security, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Inland Revenue (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - Relevant Tax Laws are required to be amended in order to give effect to the income tax policy proposals in the 'Economic Revival Initiative Programme' approved by the Cabinet previously. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation for the Inland Revenue Act incorporating the proposed amendments pertaining to the exemption of interest income from withholding tax, amending the Pay-As-You-Earn (PAYE) tax rates, amending income tax rates applicable on the terminal benefits and exemption of income tax and income tax rate changes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of New Tax Proposals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - Relevant Tax Laws are required to be amended in order to give effect to the tax policy proposals in the Economic Revival Initiative Programme approved by the Cabinet previously. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to publish the Nation Building Tax (Amendment) Bill, the Ports and Airports Development Levy (Amendment) Bill, the Economic Service Charge (Amendment) Bill and the Value Added Tax (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman, in the Government Gazette and  present the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Nourishment of the Coastal Belt from Mount Lavinia to Angulana and the Calido Beach through Mining of Sand from the Deep Ocean
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The Angulana coastal belt extending from Kollupitiya to Moratuwa has been identified as populous. However,  erection of sea walls and groynes with the  severe erosion of the coastal belt has resulted in losing  the beach of the coastal belt in the said area. The sand dune extending 2 kilometers close to the estuary of the Kalu Ganga River has totally eroded and the most well known Calido beach has also eroded. However, approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to commence the project for the nourishment of the beach through  sand mining from the deep ocean to restore the coastal belt of 4 kilometers from Angulana to Mount Lavinia and 2 kilometers in the Calido beach in Kalutara.  As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment and Wildlife Resources, to award the contract pertaining to the Project for the Nourishment of the Coastal Belt, to M/s Rohde Nielsen A/S, at a sum of Euro 4.40 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of New Buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board under the Indian Line of Credit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to purchase 400, 50 54 new seater buses and 100 32-35 new seater buses, utilizing US $ 15.03 million under the Indian Line of Credit. In the meantime, the Sri Lanka Transport Board having re-assessed their requirements in supplying an efficient and comfortable service to the general public has identified the types of buses and number of buses to be deployed in long distance, main routes in the urban and also the by roads in rural areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport Services Management to purchase 500, 30-35 new seater buses and  100,  42-45 high back new seater buses, instead of the buses previously planned to be purchased under the Indian Line of Credit, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal for obtaining a new contract to the State Engineering Corporation (SEC) for the production and supply of 100,000 of broad gauge concrete sleepers within a period of 30 months
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - Although, wooden sleepers have been used mainly for railway tracks from the inception of the Railway Service in Sri Lanka, the Government Timber Corporation has been unable to meet the high demand for wooden sleepers, due to the acute shortage of timber. As such, the Railway Department  has to opt to obtain more concrete sleepers in order to avert the dearth of wooden sleepers for maintaining the existing railway tracks and to meet the requirement of wooden sleepers for various projects in hand.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport  Services Management, to award the contract to the State Engineering Corporation, to supply 100,000 concrete sleepers at the rate of Rs.6,876.00 per sleeper inclusive of the management fees for the next period of 30 months, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining approval for awarding of two civil work contract packages in the North Western Province under the Asian Development Bank (ADB) funded Integrated Road Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways, to award 03 contract packages pertaining to the rehabilitation/improvement and maintenance of 99 km of rural roads in the Kurunegala District and 05 contract packages pertaining to the rehabilitation/improvement and maintenance of 104 km of rural roads in the same District to M/s RR Construction (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.2,165.26 million and to M/s Finite Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.2,296.13 million respectively, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement  for the supply of 32,000,000 Co amoxiclav Tablets BP 625mg or Amoxicillin and Clavulanate Potassium Tablets USP 625mg
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services, to award the procurement for the supply of 32,000,000 Co amoxiclav Tablets BP 625mg or Amoxicillin and Clavulanate Potassium Tablets USP 625mg used widely as an antibiotic, to M/s  Indchemie Health Specialties (Pvt.) Ltd. at a total Cost and Freight price of US$ 1.56 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 11,000,000 bottles of 500ml Sodium Chloride Intravenous Infusion BP 0.9% w/v or Sodium Chloride Injection USP, 0.9% w/v
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services, to award the procurement for the supply of 11,000,000 bottles of 500ml Sodium Chloride Intravenous Infusion BP 0.9% w/v or Sodium Chloride Injection USP, 0.9% w/v, to M/s  Sitchuan Kelun Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., China, at a total Cost and Freight price of US$ 2.92 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 200,000 tests of Nucleic Acid Testing Reagents (Ultrio Plus) for Procleix Tigris NAT System for the detection of HIV 1, Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C infection in blood donors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services to award the procurement for the supply of 200,000 tests of Nucleic Acid Testing Reagents (Ultrio Plus) for Procleix Tigris NAT System for the detection of HIV 1, Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C infection in blood donors, to M/s  Apcot Marketing (Pvt.) Ltd. at a total cost of US$ 3.09 million (without VAT), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 500,000 Prefilled Syringes of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection, 4,000 IU in 0.4ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The Procurement Appeal Board having considered the recommendations made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee of the Ministry of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services, pertaining to the supply of 500,000 prefilled Syringes of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection, 4,000 IU in 0.4ml used for the treatment of heart patients, has submitted its recommendations to the Cabinet in respect of the measures to be taken relating to the said procurement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services, to award the relevant procurement to M/s ABC Pharma Services (Pvt.) Ltd. at a total cost of Sri Lankan Rs.396.74 million, taking into consideration the said recommendations of the  Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 20,000 Vials of Tenecteplase Injection 40mg Vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services to award the procurement for the supply of 20,000 Vials of Tenecteplase Injection 40mg Vial used for the prevention of death of persons suffering from heart attacks, to M/s Boehringer Ingelheim India (Pvt.) Ltd. for a total Cost and Freight price of US$ 8.75 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed activity schedule for the maintenance and follow up activity of the electric fences erected for resolving the human elephant conflict
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - It is reported that around 80 human lives and 250 lives of elephants are lost annually due to the human elephant conflict prevalent in Sri Lanka.  In addition, it has also been identified that a considerable economic loss is caused to the country as a result of the damage caused to property and crops.  As such, the proposal made by the Minister o Environment and Wildlife Resources to set up Regulatory Committees at rural, divisional, district and national level with the representation of Government Officers to take necessary action to minimize and control the human elephant conflict and to provide instructions to the relevant District Secretaries and Divisional Secretaries in that regard, through the Secretary, Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils & Local Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Gazette Notification in which Motor Traffic (Signs, Signals, Symbols and Road Markings) Regulations were published, in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The Gazette Notification No.1940/21 dated 2015 11 12 has been published to publish the regulations on the road signs, signals, symbols and road markings, in terms of the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act. However, 'a sign to show 'a limited halting place for long distance service omnibuses' had not been introduced therein.  Taking into consideration the inconvenience caused by the bus drivers and as well as the passengers due to the non availability of such a sign, the Gazette Notification No.2128/9 dated 2019 06 18 has been published inclusive of a new sign to publish a limited halting place for long distance service omnibuses. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport Services Management to present the said Gazette Notification in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of 'Multi Activity Development Task Force'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President to establish a 'Multi Activity Development Task Force' as a Government Department enabling to provide opportunities to recruit 100,000 youths from the low income families with low educational qualifications, was approved by the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2019 12 10. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development to create a service in the said Department as the 'Development Oriented Supportive Service' under the said Department and to recruit 100,000 youths to the said service who have passed the Grade Eight (08) from a Government School, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Supply of fertilizer free of charge to paddy farmers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - Various approaches have been proposed for the empowerment of the local paddy farmer through the new government policy statement 'Saubhagyaye Dakma'. Under this, it has been planned to make an arrangement to provide the farmers with chemical fertilizer and organic fertilizer free of charge required for cultivation instead of the existing subsidized fertilizer scheme.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development to make an arrangement enabling to supply the recommended quantities of Urea, Triple Super Phosphate (T.S.P.) and  Muriate of potash (MoP) up to a maximum of 02 hectares to farmers cultivating paddy from the commencement of the Yala Season of 2020 and to implement the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Food Production National Programme 2020 - 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - Although the 'Food Production National Programme' was implemented during the period from 2016-2018 with the objective of ensuring food security, it has not been possible to achieve the targets envisaged due to the non availability of sufficient provision and the unexpected climatic conditions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development to implement the projects such as, increasing of crop production and productivity, minimizing of post harvest losses, introduction of value added new products, research and development, minimizing of damages to crops by wild animals, increasing of the production of seeds and planting material through farm development, promotion of environment friendly agriculture through the application of traditional knowledge and practices,  promotion of agro tourism and the establishment of 'Saubhagya' Agro Production Cluster Villages, during the period from 2020-2022 at provincial and divisional level, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re commencement of the construction of the Court Complex at Beligaha Junction in Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Human Rights & Law Reforms to re commence the partly constructed Court Complex at Beligaha Junction where the construction work has been stopped, after assigning the construction work to the State Engineering Corporation under the consultancy of the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau and to establish the Galle Court Complex at the said premises, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Gamata Geyak - Ratata Hetak' - A comfortable house for every family
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body:
- It has been proposed to commence the housing programme 'Gamata Geyak - Ratata Hetak' from the beginning of the year 2020 itself, as an expedient sustainable development programme to pave the way to achieve sustainable development goals through making every family of Sri Lanka to live in a comfortable home as enunciated in the policy statement 'A reconstructed Country with a Future'.

This programme is due to be implemented Islandwide effective from January 2020 through community committees consisting of political leadership, public officials, civil security organizations  and  community at the rural level with the coordination of the political leadership and the public officials at  the District and Divisional Secretariat level.

Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister and Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities, to secure the provision required, to construct 14,022 houses, as the initial stage to provide one poor family from every Grama Niladhari Division selected on priority to provide a grant of Rs.600,000/- in installments on the basis of the construction progress of a house constructed anew or for upgrading, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and the Indonesia Defense University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development; Internal Trade, Food Security and Consumer Welfare; and State Minister of Defence, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and the Indonesia Defense University to work in collaboration, in matters such as, the promotion of academic cooperation, providing of mutual access to libraries, exchange of academic staff, teachers, researchers and visiting lecturers between the Institutes, providing of mutual educational trips, strategic research offers or offering of scholarships, providing of facilities for the training of academic teachers and researchers, facilities for the exchange of published academic books and records and organizing seminars, workshops, symposiums and exhibitions of mutual interest and encouraging the mutual participation at such events etc., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Withdrawal of the proposed Bill on Counter Terrorism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-02
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to present the Bill on Counter Terrorism in Parliament with a view to repealing the Prevention of Terrorism (Temporary Provisions) Act, No.48 of 1979 and enacting new legislation on counter terrorism. The said Bill is under consideration of the Sectoral Oversight Committee on International Relations in Parliament. Taking into consideration of the views expressed by various parties pertaining to certain provisions therein, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Relations to withdraw the said Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Redress to Government and Semi Government employees who were subject to political victimization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-02
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that, in the recent past, charges had been framed targeting several Government and Semi Government officers with the intention of subjecting them to politically harassment and the inquiries concerned have been initiated deviating from the formal legal procedures. Therefore, the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2019-12-10 has granted approval to appoint a Committee under the chairmanship of the retired Supreme Court Judge Mr. Jagath Balapatabendi to examine such situations and report on same. The proposal made by the Prime Minister to appoint Mr. Sumudu K. Wickramarachchi, Attorney-at-law to function as the Secretary to that Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the Contract for the Rehabilitation and Improvement of the Road Section from Kirulapona to Godagama and the Road Section from Pamankada to Pokunuvita under Southern Road Connectivity Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-02
decision_details_body: - Bids  have been invited under the International Competitive Bidding Procedure  for the Rehabilitation and Improvement of the road section from Kirulapona to Godagama and the road section from Pamankada to Pokunuvita, under the Southern Road Connectivity Project funded by the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways, to award the contract to M/s MAGA Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd; which is the substantially responsive evaluated bidder for a sum of Rs.4,215.15 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tea Sector Revival and Modernization Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-02
decision_details_body:
- In view of making the Tea sector a key export industry in the country, it has been scheduled to  implement a programme in association with the Tea Board of Sri Lanka, Department of Commerce and relevant authorities of the Sri Lankan  missions abroad enabling to encourage Ceylon Tea importing countries to increase their imports by at least 10%  per year  from 2020. Nevertheless, difficulties encountered by the tea factory owners who play a vital role in the tea industry, have become an obstacle for the same. It has been observed that specially the restrictive finances, tax procedures implemented over the last couple of years and deregulation of prevalent rules  and regulations permitting the import of tea providing space for re export, have led for the said situation. Under these circumstances, the proposals made by the Minister of Plantation Industries and Export Agriculture pertaining to the implementation of the tea sector revival and modernization programme by converting the tea industry into a stable and competitive export earner in a manner ensuring the job security of a large number of employees engaged connected to the tea sector supply chain, was
 approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the proposed National e Content Development Centre in  Pitipana area in Homagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-02
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to construct a National Content Development Centre for developing subject related contents/software and computer applications at the Narangala Estate in the Kuliyapitiya West Divisional Secretariat Division of the Kurunegala District, to formalize the use of information technology in schools and for education.  Considering the fact that the proposed Centre is situated about 90 km away from Colombo and the practical difficulties to be encountered by establishing the Centre in such a distant place, the proposal made by the Minister of Education, to establish the said Centre at Pitipana in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Homagama, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Pre School Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-02
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the pre‑schools could make a greater contribution towards the development of the early childhood of the children. It has also been observed that the teachers/matrons of certain pre‑schools are devoid of professional competency or adequate educational qualifications. In addition, it has been found that the untrained teachers of pre‑schools are also engaged in a teaching process not in conformity with the development of children in the age group of 3-5 years. Taking all these matters into consideration, the proposal made by the Minister of Education, to implement the National Policy on Pre‑School Education, prepared after obtaining the views of the experts in the field, officials and interested parties in the matter, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expanding of opportunities to enroll in the Interest Free Student Loan Scheme granted for students to pursue Degree Programmes at the Non Governmental Higher Education Institutes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-02
decision_details_body: - Although an Interest Free Student Loan Scheme is in existence at present, in order to follow the Government recognized degree programmes at the Non‑Governmental Higher Education Institutes, it has not been possible to attract students as anticipated. Specially due to the non‑availability of a sufficient demand in the job market for the courses selected under the said programme and as such degree programmes do not make an adequate contribution towards the economic development of the country, the said loan scheme has to be redesigned in a more productive manner. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation to further expand and implement the Interest Free Student Loan Scheme to enable to make 10,000 graduates competent in technology for the job opportunities available in the fields of information technology and technology, in conformity with the five year development strategic policy framework 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drinking Water Quality Testing and Monitoring Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-02
decision_details_body:
- The present pipe borne water supply coverage estimated to be around 51% of which 11% is covered by the water supply schemes managed by community based organizations, protected dug wells, tube wells and a programme has been initiated by the Ministry of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities for water quality testing of such water. The main stakeholders of this programme are the National Water Supply & Drainage Board, the Department of National Community Water Supply, the Water Supply and Sanitation Improvement Project and the China Sri Lanka Research Grant Project.

Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities to initiate the Programme of Water Quality Testing and Monitoring of the water supply schemes managed by the community based organizations, protected dug wells and tube wells from seven districts covered by the World Bank Funded Water Supply and Sanitation Improvement Project and subsequently, to extend it to the other districts as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Updating of the National Physical Plan of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-01-02
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with the new approach in the National Spatial System proposed in the policy declaration 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour', it has become necessary to update the National Physical Plan in order to integrate the proposed policy elements. 

Accordingly, the key objectives of the process are to provide a broader national level framework to all the development agencies to guide the planning and execution of development activities, which will directly impact upon the physical environment of the country and to establish facilities, amenities and service related infrastructure incidental upon the development of the physical environment and to devise a plan for a physical environment that will facilitate Sri Lanka to become a smart nation and a competitive economy of the world by 2030, and to remain so thereafter.

Taking these matters into consideration, the presentation made by the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities to the effect that the necessary measures are being taken by the Department of National Physical Planning to update the National Physical Plan of Sri Lanka, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Review of the Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) Compact Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18

description: Establishment of an Inter Ministerial Task Force for Industrial and Entrepreneur Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management to establish an Inter-Ministerial Task Force for Industrial and Entrepreneur Development under the Chairmanship of H.E. the President and the membership of the Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management and the participation of other relevant Ministers, Secretaries to Ministries and Officers, with a view to minimizing the delays and problematic situations arising in the process of making policy decisions in the manufacturing industry sector which provides a major contribution to the economic development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Policy and Planning Bureau
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President to establish a National Policy and Planning Bureau for the adaptation of economic policies needed to achieve macro economic goals through National Policy and Planning, State Investment Allocation, National Development Planning, the Procurement Process, Project Analysis and Management with transparency and in a strategically oriented manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Sapiri Gamak' Community Based Rural Development Programme 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement a community based rural development programme called 'Sapiri Gamak' during the year 2020 with the objective of promoting employment and livelihood opportunities through the upliftment of rural facilities.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister and Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development, to implement the said programme commencing from the 01st of January in 2020 in each Grama Niladhari Division by implementing projects amounting to Rs.2,000,000/- covering all the 14,021 Grama Niladhari Divisions Island-wide,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notification to fulfill the legal requirement under Import and Export (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 for approval of the Cabinet of Ministers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body:
The Government Policy 'Saubhagyaye Dekma' ('Vistas of Prosperity') has recognized the necessity of encouraging the farmer and the manufacturer to cultivate crops and manufacture products that can be produced within the country as much as possible. It is expected to uplift the farmer's economy within the country and to control the outflow of local foreign exchange to the other countries.

	As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to table the Gazette Notification issued on 2019 12 06 making provisions under the Import and Export (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 to control the importation of crops such as cardamom, clove, turmeric, pepper, cinnamon, nutmeg, mace, arecanut, tamarind and black gram and the products such as kites, lanterns/Vesak lanterns and incense sticks, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of food items for the Tri Forces - Supply Year 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body: - As per the recommendation made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) relating to the Procurement of food items  for the Sri Lanka Army, Sri Lanka Navy and Sri Lanka Air Force for the Supply Year 2020, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development and State Minister of Defence to award the said procurements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Relief for Small Scale Industrialists in Traditional Tile, Brick and Pottery Industries to procure Clay
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body: - Any person or an institution engaged in clay mining should obtain a license for the same in accordance with the Mines and Minerals Act, No.33 of 1992 as amended by Act, No.66 of 2009 and also a license to transport such raw materials to the site of the relevant industry. However, considering the various difficulties the small scale clay industrialists have to undergo, as a result of the complications in the procedure of obtaining the permits, the approval of the Cabinet has already been granted to simplify the process of obtaining permits for the transportation of sand, clay and soil.  As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment and Wildlife Resources, to amend Section 28 and 30 of the Mines and Minerals Act, No.33 of 1992 as appropriate to provide the provision necessary 	to further simplify the existing licensing procedure when obtaining the raw materials and to introduce a more efficient and simple method to facilitate the industrialists engaged in Tile, Brick and Pottery to continue in their production process sustainably and to ensure that no eco sensitive areas such as river banks are affected by the process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of  an Interconnected Modernized Road Network in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body: - In terms of the National Policy Framework named the 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour', the modernization of the Road Network has been identified as a key factor necessary to achieve a high level of economic growth. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways, to implement the priority projects such as the construction of Overtaking Lanes at 3-5 km intervals on the National Highways, minimizing traffic congestion and road traffic crashes in areas identified as bottle necks and re surfacing and modernization of the entire road network in conformity with the international standards, the development of 100,000 km of Alternative Road Network, to facilitate a higher level of access to the main Highways and Expressways and improvement of rural access roads to make access to such an alternative road network, was approved in principle, by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Task Force under the Ministry of Education for the implementation of Proposals for New Educational Reforms
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the establishment of a 'Task Force pertaining to Education' is essential for providing technological and policy guidelines for the implementation of the proposals for educational reforms, in accordance with the Government policy, in a strategical and transparent manner. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education, to appoint a Task Force comprising of a group of experts with the subject specialists in the relevant field in the identification of proposals for educational reforms, programmes and  strategies, and to assist in the implementation of same, provide guidance, monitor and feedback for the relevant institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining 'Govijana Mandiraya' where the Ministry of Agriculture had been established, to re establish the Ministry of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body: - The Government owned building named as 'Govijana Mandiraya' situated at Rajamalwatta Avenue in Battaramulla where the Ministry of Agriculture was previously established, had been given over to the Parliament of Sri Lanka on Cabinet approval with the objective of establishing the Parliamentary Committee System.  However, as of now, the building has not been fully utilized for the purpose. Also, the Government has to incur an expenditure close upon Rs.21 million monthly as rent, as a result of the Ministry of Agriculture being established in another building on a rental basis. Nevertheless, due to the inadequate facilities available in the building both the officers serving in the Ministry and the service recipients have to be subject to various inconveniences. Taking these matters into consideration, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development, to re establish the Ministry of Agriculture and the other institutions coming under purview of the Ministry, in the 'Govijana Mandiraya', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The 72nd National Day Celebrations falling on 04th February, 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils & Local Government to appoint a Ministerial Committee under the Chairmanship of Hon. Prime Minister, to draw up the relevant programme for the 72nd National Day Celebrations falling on the 04th of February, 2020 and to organize the necessary arrangements, was approved by the Cabinet. The Cabinet also decided to hold the 72nd National Day Celebrations at the Independence Square in Colombo 07.

description: Introduction of 1000 Information Technology Certificate / Diploma learning opportunities under the Institution of Technology affiliated to the University of Moratuwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement an expeditious programme for providing training opportunities for Certificate/Diploma/Advanced Diploma courses for the students who have followed the technology subject streams, other subject streams or the students who have passed the Advanced Level Examination  targeting the job market in the IT Sector which is presently in high demand locally and internationally for software production and internet based job opportunities.  The said programme envisages to commence with 1000 training opportunities in the year 2020 and expects to increase the training opportunities up to 3000 by the year 2022. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, to conduct such training courses through the Institute of Technology at Diyagama affiliated to the University of Moratuwa and to get the contribution of a Committee of Experts in the field of Information Technology working in the private and public sectors to design the courses, was approved in principle by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement for the transfer of sentenced persons between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and Czech Republic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body:
- In terms of the provisions of the Transfer of Offenders Act, No.5 of 1995, a citizen of another country convicted and sentenced to imprisonment by a court in Sri Lanka can serve his/her sentence in the country of which he claims to be a citizen and a citizen of Sri Lanka imprisoned in any other country can serve  his/her balance period of imprisonment in Sri Lanka. Nevertheless, in order to make the provisions of the Act to be applicable, it is essential for an Agreement to be entered into between Sri Lanka and the respective country.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Human Rights & Law Reforms to enter into an Agreement on transfer of sentenced persons  between the two countries in conformity with the laws of both the countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting of the Sri Lanka National Defence College Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-18
decision_details_body:
- Due to the absence of  a National Defence College in Sri Lanka for conducting higher level courses on national defence, officers of the Tri-forces have to be directed to National Defence Colleges which conduct such courses, established in China, India, Bangladesh and Pakistan. However, due to the limited number of opportunities for the courses offered by those countries annually, it has not  been possible to train the officers as expected.  In this context, approval of the Cabinet has already been granted for the establishment of a National Defence College in Sri Lanka.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development  and the State Minister of Defence to  draft a Bill for the establishment of a National  National Defence College, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reviewing the Current Scope of the 'Financial City Project'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-10
decision_details_body: - The 'Colombo Port City Project' was commenced in the year 2014, in association with the Sri Lanka Ports Authority and the Chinese investor, CHEC Port City Colombo (Pvt) Ltd., as an investment made by the private sector. After 2015 01 08, changing the original scope of the said project, a project relevant to that has been implemented as the 'Financial City Project'. At present, with the assistance of the external consultants and  under the guidance of the Legal Draftsman, a draft Bill has been prepared to establish a special economic zone by the name of 'Colombo Financial City'. Accordingly, within the current political, social and environmental context, the need has arisen to review the revised scope of the said project and the process followed to revise the said project and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister to appoint a committee comprising of subject specific experts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Assignment of Subjects and Functions to the State Ministers who are not Members of the Cabinet
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal submitted by H.E. the President to assign subjects and functions to the State Ministers who are not Members of the Cabinet, in terms of Article 44(5) of the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Multipurpose Development Task Force
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-10
decision_details_body:
- It has been observed by HE the President that there are large numbers of unskilled employment opportunities in Government and the related agencies which are filled without paying any heed to the low income segment of the society and guided by the political patronage. Taking that matter into consideration, the proposal made by HE the President to set up a Multipurpose Development Task Force as a Government Department to provide employment for 100,000 less educated youth from low income families was approved by the Cabinet.

	Further, it was noted by the Cabinet that it has been planned to commence the recruitment at district level in a transparent manner, to commence the operation of the Department by 15th of January 2020 and the ability of providing services of the said Task Force on a cost recovery basis to the Government, government agencies and the private sector.

description: Appointment of the Cabinet Sub Committee on Cost of Living
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-10

description: Accelerated Programme for State Land Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-10
decision_details_body:
- The Minister of Lands & Land Development presented to the attention of the Cabinet, information in respect of 11 programmes planned to be implemented from the month of December 2019 up to the month of March 2020 by the institutions coming under the purview of the Ministry of Lands & Land Development.  Accordingly, the Minister informed the Cabinet further that the programmes such as issuance of permits, Grants and Leases, in terms of the Land Development Ordinance and the State Land Ordinance after  holding Land Kachcheries, conducting Mobile Days and Field Day programmes, issuance of Title Certificates under the Title Registration Act, regularizing of Land Data System, Launching of the New Edition of the Road Map and the preparation of Land Manual etc. are anticipated to be implemented.

	The Cabinet also decided to appoint an Officials' Committee to make recommendations to prepare a simple and a convenient method in respect of the lands given under lease basis enabling the lessees to make their  payments without causing much inconvenience to them.

description: The proposed programme for the maintenance of the electric fences constructed and follow-up action in order to resolve the Human Elephant conflict
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-10
decision_details_body: - The Human Elephant conflict which has arisen in the country has become a national issue subject to the focus of all stakeholders. The proposal made by the Minister of Environment and Wildlife Resources, to update the existing electric fences and maintaining them, to provide the human and physical resources necessary for the purpose in order to resolve the problem and to implement the programmes planned to resolve the problem with the assistance inclusive of the District Secretaries and all relevant stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new, school based scientific methodology instead of the present district based methodology for selection of students to the State Universities on the Z Score method
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-10
decision_details_body: - Although it is the primary responsibility of the Government to provide equal opportunities of education to each and every child, it has been found that even at present, there exist various disparities in terms of the educational facilities and the quality of education among the Provinces, Districts and Schools as well. In the circumstances, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to appoint an Experts Committee comprising of competent persons on the subject matter to make recommendations for the introduction of a school based new scientific methodology instead of the present district based Z Score methodology for selection of students to the State Universities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of the number of National Schools to be 1,000 within the  school network and the establishment of new Tri lingual Schools covering every District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-10
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Education has planned to implement a programme to increase the number of National Schools to 1,000 by developing 03 schools equipped with all facilities in each Divisional Secretariat Division and upgrading them as National Schools with the objective of providing a free, equitable and qualitative education to every child. The Ministry of Education has also planned to initiate a State of the Art National School in each District with tri lingual educational opportunities and to initiate 20 such schools in the next two year period. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education for the implementation of the proposed programmes, was approved in principle by the Cabinet.

description: Milling the paddy stocks purchased under the Government Paddy Purchase Programme of 2018/2019 Maha Season into rice and issue them to the market through the Lanka Sathosa Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-10
decision_details_body:
- Under the Government Paddy Purchase Programme of 2018/2019 Maha Season, action has been taken during the recent past, to convert a part of the paddy stocks purchased, through the private sector small and medium scale paddy millers. However, since, there is an increasing trend in the price of rice these days, the steps taken to provide relief to the consumer by milling the balance of the paddy stocks of about 42,000 MT out of the paddy stocks purchased and presently remaining in the stores of the Paddy Marketing Board and to provide it to the consumer through the Lanka Sathosa Ltd. outlet network were drawn to the attention of the Cabinet by the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development.

	Similarly, taking into consideration the consent given by the major rice mill owners to supply rice within the period of next 2 - 3 months to the market without a scarcity and also to maintain the maximum retail price of rice as Rs.98/- per kg., it was decided by the Cabinet to fix the maximum price of rice as Rs.98/- per kg.  

	Further, it was also decided by the Cabinet to grant approval to take necessary action for the importation of wheat flour until the crop harvest of the Maha season is had, to enable the people specially living in the estate and urban areas to obtain wheat flour and the products associated with it, at low prices, during the festive season.

description: The removal of the existing requirement on obtaining permits for the transportation of sand, soil and clay necessary for the local industries and the construction industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-12-04
decision_details_body: - Several  Members of the Cabinet pointed out  that difficulties have arisen when securing the necessary raw material for the local industries and as well as the construction industry due to the existing requirement on obtaining permits for the transportation of sand, soil and clay and that various malpractices occur when issuing the relevant permits.
