decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The approval of Cabinet has been granted previously to pay an additional compensation of  50% of the assessed compensation for the persons affected due to Moragahakanda - Kaluganga Project, who were permanently residing in the Naula and Laggala Divisional Secretariat Areas, taking into consideration the demands made by them indicating that valuation of the acquired properties for the project has been lessened due to the lack of development of infrastructure facilities of the area compared to the nearby areas and also due to properties of the residents in the area not being renovated by them consequent to the long time delay in commencing the construction after the declaration of the project and the uncertainty that prevailed in the implementation of same.  The proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment to pay the said 50% additional compensation to the families of the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretariat Division who have not been included in the relevant Review Committee Report but subsequently determined as project affected, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a National Policy and Strategy on Sustainable Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - Considering the importance of achieving Sustainable Development Goals for the development of the country, our commitment towards the global efforts to create a sustainably developed world and the need for every government organization to  act as an arm of one government, the proposal made by H.E. the President, that every Ministry to have a common vision of a 'Sustainably Developed Sri Lanka', that every Provincial Council to have a vision of a 'Sustainably Developed  ............... (relevant name of the province) Province for a Sustainably Developed Sri Lanka', for every Government Institution to prepare its public service delivery strategies giving priority to sustainable development goals, that every government institution to propose programmes and projects under the strategies so identified and for the Sustainable Development Council established by the Sustainable Development Act to formulate a National Policy and Strategies on Sustainable Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Sustainable Development Vision of Sri Lanka 2030
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The Report compiled by a Committee of 41 experts appointed by H.E. the President with the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers as  'Sustainable Sri Lanka 2030 Vision and Strategic Path' and handed over to the Sustainable Development Council, will in future, serve as the strategic guidance for the preparation of the National Policy and Strategy on Sustainable Development.  Accordingly, the recommendation made by H.E. the President that until such time, that the National Policy and Strategy is formulated in conformity with the sustainable development goals and targets, it is appropriate to present  proposals for projects and programmes for the budget 2020, taking cognizance of the sectoral priorities, new initiatives and options described in the 'Sustainable Sri Lanka 2030 Vision and Strategic Path', was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 190,000 Bottles of Human Albumin Solution BP/PH EUR, 20% in 50ml Bottle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine
	to award the procurement for the supply of 190,000 Bottles of Human Albumin Solution BP/PH EUR, 20% in 50ml Bottle to M/s. Baxalta GmbH of Switzerland as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agriculture Sector Modernization Project - Contract for the consultancy services to design, establish, operate, manage Agriculture Technology Demonstration Parks and transfer to the Farmer Producer Organizations supported by the Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development to award the contract for the consultancy services to design, establish, operate, manage  Agriculture Technology Demonstration Parks and transfer to the Farmer Producer Organizations under the Agriculture Sector Modernization Project implemented with the World Bank Financing to the Joint Venture of M/s FCG ANZDEC Ltd, New Zealand and FCG Swedish Development AB, Sweden, was approved  by the Cabinet.

description: Reinsurance covering activities for Maha season 2019/20 and Yala Season of 2020 for compulsory crop cultivation insurance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: Measures have been taken in the year 2018 to enter into a reinsurance coverage to mitigate the financial risk to be born by the Government and the Agricultural and Agrarian Insurance Board in the payment of compensation for loss/damage reimbursement at a natural disaster. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to carry out the reinsurance activities for the compulsory crops for Maha season 2019/2020 and Yala season 2020 under the proper procurement procedures, in order to implement the compulsory cultivation insurance more productively, and to expand the crop insurance coverage subject to charging a suitable insurance premium from the farmers for the damages caused by diseases, pests and wild animals and to include the same to the reinsurance coverage as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the Contract for Supply and Delivery of 35km of 240sqmm 3 Core 11kv XLPE Insulated under ground Copper Cables
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to award the contract for the procurement of 35 km of 240 sq mm 3 Core 11kv XLPE Insulated under ground Copper Cables for the Distribution Division 1 of the Ceylon Electricity Board, to M/s Phelps Dodge International (Thailand) Limited of No.159, MOO 10, Theparak Road, Bangpla, Bangplee District, Samutprakarn, 10540, Thailand, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Transmission Distribution Network Development and Efficiency Improvement Project (NTDN & EIP)- Package 1: Award of Contract for construction of 400kv, 220kv and 132 kv Transmission Lines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the  construction of 400kv, 220kv and 132 kv transmission lines of the National Transmission Distribution Network Development and Efficiency Improvement Project, Package 1 to the joint venture of Mitsubishi Corporation, Sumitomo Electric Industries Ltd. and Ceylex Engineering (pvt.) Ltd., 3-1, Marumouchi, 2 - chome, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo 100-8086, Japan, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dankotuwa Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - Dankotuwa Water Supply Project has been designed by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board to upgrade the drinking water supply in the areas such as Wennappuwa, Dankotuwa and Naththandiya which have been identified as a rapid developing townships in the Puttalam District. As such, the proposal made by  the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to award the relevant contract for the pupose to M/s. BESIX. S.A. of Belgium at a sum of EUR 28 million and Rs. 5,004 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Token Contribution towards Emergency Flood Relief in Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration of the heavy flooding in Bangladesh due to torrential rains experienced from the month of July this year, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to make a donation  of US$ 50,000 to the Government of the People's Republic of the Bangladesh as an emergency flood relief measure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the United Nations Security Council Resolution 1540 in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - According to the Resolution 1540 of the United Nations Security Council, all member states should refrain from providing any form of support to non-state actors that attempt to acquire, to keep the weapons in their possession and to provide, transport and the use of such devices. As such, since it is a timely need to enact appropriate laws and regulations pertaining to the exportation and re exportation, transition, transshipment and also traveling and transit of the persons engaged in activities related to proliferation and Weapons of Mass Destruction from or via this country and also to adapt to such requirements, the proposal made by the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade to use the European Union Military List and the European Union Dual-Use Control List and make changes as appropriate to Sri Lanka and to prepare a National Control List within one year and also to draft amending legislation to change the Acts and Laws in terms of the provisions of the Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification No.2039/31 of 6th October, 2017, for the implementation of Resolution 1540, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting an Interim Relief to the recipients of Certificate of Absence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by the Minister of Finance and the Minister of National Integration, Official Languages, Social Progress and Hindu Religious Affairs to grant a monthly interim relief of Rs.6000 to the recipients of Certificate of Absence by way of a direct credit deposit on the 10th day of each month with effect from 10th October 2019 and to direct to the Department of Registrar General to issue Certificates of Absence for the applications submitted by the affected families taking into account the interim report of the Office of  Missing Persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Producing 10 Documentaries on 10 Ethnic Groups selected from the book titled 'People of Sri Lanka'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to continue the task of reviewing the scripts of documentaries on ethnic groups which are to be produced by the Veteran Filmmaker, Mr Bertram Nihal based on the book titled 'People of Sri Lanka', subject to obtaining the prior approval for same by a formal Committee.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of National Integration, Official Languages, Social Progress and Hindu Religious Affairs to obtain the assistance of a Committee comprising of 05 experts as resource persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal to invest in equity of the Sri Lanka Telecom PLC (SLT) through the State Owned Enterprises and Captive Funds enabling SLT to comply with the Minimum Public Float Requirement of 10% imposed by the Colombo Stock Exchange thereby strengthening the Government of Sri Lanka's stake in SLT
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Telecom (PLC) is the leading telecommunication services provider in the country, with the Government of Sri Lanka controlling 52.92% of the shareholding where 2.1% is held by the general public. According to a new rule introduced in the year 2013 by the Sri Lanka Securities and Exchange Commission for the listed companies to enable the Sri Lanka Telecom to fulfill the requirement of  maintaining 'public free float' of minimum of 10% of their share capital by the Sri Lanka Telecom, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Finance and the Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports, to instruct the State owned enterprises such as the Employees' Provident Fund, the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Ltd., the National Savings Bank, the Bank of Ceylon, Employees' Trust Fund and the Peoples' Bank to invest in the Sri Lanka Telecom share capital subject to the approval of the respective Boards of Director,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Grade 5 selection process of Scholarship holders in order to increase the facilities of Secondary Education to a grater number of Students of the Low-income Families
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - At present, 15,000 students of the low-income families who become eligible at the Grade 5 Scholarship Examination are awarded scholarships amounting to Rs.625/- million annually. Accordingly, the Note to the Cabinet presented by the  Minister of Education to inform the Cabinet that action will be taken to implement the proposals of increasing the aforesaid number of students up to 20,000 from the year 2019 onwards, the increasing of the monthly bursary from Rs.500/- up to Rs.750/-, for them, to revise the monthly income limit of the families of the students being eligible for scholarship bursaries as Rs.15,000/- from the year 2019 and the allocation of scholarships bursaries to children with special needs as recommended by the Department of Examination, so as not to exceed the total number of students receiving bursaries of 20,000, was noted  by the Cabinet.

description: The Governing Council and the Executive Committee Meeting - 2019 of the Centre for Integrated Rural Development in the Asia and Pacific Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The Executive Committee Meeting of the Centre for Integrated Rural Development in the Asia and Pacific Region is scheduled to be held on the 08th and 09th of October 2019 while the Governing Council Meeting is to be held on the 11th of October 2019 in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the estimated cost  pertaining to the said Meetings presented by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Development Projects utilizing the General Treasury Funds allocated by the National Budget to the Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development under the 'Haritha Udyana' Budget Line
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to implement the development projects by utilizing the provisions set apart under the 'Haritha Udyana'  budget line. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to award the new projects of Puttalam and Balangoda and the balance scope of work of 19 projects namely the supply and installation of children's play equipment and gymnasium equipment, landscaping to the Central Engineering Services Limited. within the existing budgetary limits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a Land at the Ratnapura New Town to the Ratnapura Tamil School
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to set apart a land of about 3 acres for the Ratnapura Tamil School Development Project from the Ratnapura New Town precincts, to the Ministry of Education, Information Technology and Cultural Affairs of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, subject to the recommendation of the Secretaries Committee pertaining to the allocation of state lands for development purposes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of 13 Acres - 01 Rood - 00.95 Perches of land in the Muthurajawela Industrial Zone owned by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation (SLLRDC) to the CA Crushing (Pvt.) Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The activities of the Outer Circular Highway Project is at a level nearing completion. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to lease out the land in extent of 13A - 01R - 00.95P situated at the Muthurajawela Industrial Zone now being leased on annual lease basis for the project requirements, to the Metallurgical Corporation of China Ltd., the contract company of the said project to CA Crushing (Pvt.) Ltd., which supplied manufactured sand and aggregates to the said project for a period of 30 years, subject to obtaining the approval of the Central Environmental Authority and also the other relevant institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposals for seeking strategic investors for Government land plots designated for immediate development as an Exhibition & Convention Centre an International School and Hospital within the reclaimed land in the Colombo Port City through a Public Private Partnership (PPP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The reclamation of land in the newly constructed Colombo Port City has now been concluded and the proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to call for proposals from the investors, for the international school, the exhibition and communication centre with the option to invest in the convention hotel in the adjacent plot and the international hospital to be constructed, in the land, with the support of the National Agency for Public Private Partnership according to the Development Master Plan and the Development Control Regulations and also to appoint a Negotiation and Project Committee to review the said proposals in accordance with the procurement methodology, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Universities Act, No.16 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - 	It has been found necessary to amend the Universities Act, No.16 of 1978 for the establishment of the higher educational institutes, maintenance and administration, so as to have a strong legal framework to regulate the private higher educational institutes effectively to cater to the recent developments.  As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to amend the said Act in accordance with the recommendations in the Report of the Officials' Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of the Secretary, Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education on matters focused in the concept paper relating to same by a Board of Experts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kelani Right Bank Water Supply Project - Stage II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to extend the project period of the Kelani Right Bank Water Supply Project - Stage II, which is being implemented for the supply of water to Kelaniya, Wattala, Mahara, Biyagama and Ja-Ela as well as the Katunayake area including the International Airport, the Free Trade Zone and the Air Force Camp, up to 22nd June, 2020, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Waste Management Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to prepare the required legal framework and regulations for the effective implementation of the National Waste Management Policy drafted including the existing and emerging categories of all solid, liquid and gaseous waste and extensively identifying the common but differentiated responsibilities of all stakeholders in managing them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Colombo Lotus Tower Project - the Proposed commercialization process of the Colombo Lotus Tower Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - Colombo Lotus Tower Project is due to be completed and handed over to the Telecommunication Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka, shortly. With a view to providing the opportunity for the people of Sri Lanka to enjoy the facilities of the said Project and using it for commercial purposes and commercialization  process has to be commenced expeditiously, the proposal made by the Minister of Defence to vest authority on the Treasury to form a state owned company for the management of commercialization aspects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a comprehensive joint e-solution for Data and Information Management, Spot Fine Collections and Demerit Point System for drivers in relation to traffic offences
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The implementation of the Report of the the National Agency for Public, Private Partnership established under the Ministry of Finance, inclusive of its observations and recommendations relating to the Implementation of a comprehensive joint e-solution for Data and Information Management, spot fine Collections and Demerit Point System for drivers in relation to traffic offences, has been approved by the Cabinet in principle. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of 	Defence, to get the required feasibility study done by the University of Peradeniya on an estimated sum of Rs.22.2 million (without tax) as proposed by the University, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Management of Public Expenditure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the matters embodied in the  Circular on the “Management of Public Expenditure” issued in the year 2010 by the Secretary to the President, specifying the limits applicable to the personal staff of the Hon. Ministers, Hon. Non-Cabinet Ministers, Hon. State Ministers and Hon. Deputy Ministers and the other facilities, the draft Circular on same prepared inclusive of the appropriate amendments and fresh matters so as to meet the present trends and presented by H.E. the President, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Primary Industries and Social Empowerment, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Maldives with the objective of efficiently and productively carrying out the functions such as, creation of freedom, care, participation and dignity of the elders of Sri Lanka by way of encouraging them, through various programmes to contribute to secure the elders, improve the vocational skills of the persons with disabilities to make them independent persons as well as  safeguarding the promotion of the rights of children, women, elders as well as disabled persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japanese Yen 1 billion Grant Aid for the improvement of the Public Security and Counter-terrorism Activities under Japanese Non Project Grant Aid - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - As an immediate response to the adverse effects caused to the public security of Sri Lanka by the terrorist attack on Easter Sunday,  the Government of Japan has agreed to provide Japanese Yen 1 billion (approximately Rs.1.6 billion) under the Non Project Grant Aids Scheme for the provision of necessary equipment for strengthening of the capacity of Sri Lanka Police and Airport and Aviation Services Sri Lanka Limited on counter-terrorism activities, through the Ministry of Defence and the Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to sign the Exchange of Notes with Government of Japan to obtain the said grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement on the facilitation of Visa arrangements between the Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: The proposal made by the Prime Minister to enter into an Agreement on  the facilitation of visa arrangements  between the Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and to authorize the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to sign the said Agreement on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Vocational Training and Youth Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - Memorandum of Understanding on Vocational Training and Youth Development

description: Procurement of 5000 Rails  for the Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to award the contract for the procurement of 5000 EN 45E1 Rails (45'00") of R 260-EN 13674 to  M/s Angang Group International Panzhihua Co. Ltd. for a sum of US$ 2,320,230 on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the Contract for the appointment of consultants for Planning, Detailed design and Procurement of Urban Upgrading, Heritage Conservation and Capacity Building Component for the Trincomalee, Dambulla, Kurunegala and Ratnapura Towns in Package 02 of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) assisted Sustainable Urban Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of  Megapolis & Western Development to award the consultancy contract for Planning, Detailed Design and Procurement of Urban Upgrading, Heritage Conservation and Capacity Building Component for the Trincomalee, Dambulla, Kurunegala and Ratnapura Towns in Package 02 of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) assisted Sustainable Urban Development Project to Engineering Consultants Ltd., Sri Lanka (Lead Consultants) JV with KEIOS Srl Development Consulting, Italy, on the concurrence of the Asian Development Bank and the recommendation of the Consultancy Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the Contract for the appointment of Consultants for Planning, Detailed design and Procurement of Traffic, Transportation and Mobility Improvements for the Trincomalee, Dambulla, Kurunegala and Ratnapura Towns in Package 01 of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) assisted Sustainable Urban Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of  Megapolis & Western Development to award the consultancy contract for Planning, Detailed Design and Procurement of Traffic, Transformation and Mobility Improvements for Trincomalee, Dambulla, Kurunegala and Ratnapura to SMEC International Pvt. Ltd., Australia JV with Surbana Jurong Infrastructure Pte. Ltd. (SJIPL), Singapore and Sub Consultant as Resources Development consultants Ltd. and Master Hellies's Engineering consultants (Pvt.) Ltd., Sri Lanka on the concurrence of the Asian Development Bank and the recommendation of the Consultancy Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increase of Fines for the Offences of the Penal Code
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - 	Due to the vast increase in the incidence of criminal activities in the country, it is a timely need, to resort to stringent measures to counter them. As such, a Committee has been appointed to study and make recommendations as the fines imposed pertaining to the violation of provisions containing in certain Acts and Ordinances are not at all adequate to prevent such violations.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation in accordance with recommendations of the said Committee to increase the fines for offences of the penal code, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Service Agreement between Sri Lanka and Hungary
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The officials of the two countries have reached an Agreement on the draft Agreement prepared by the aeronautical authorities of the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Hungary on the Air Service Agreement after discussions held by them during the International Civil Aviation Negotiation Conference held in Bali, Indonesia in the year 2014. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to sign the initialed Air Service Agreement between the Governments of Sri Lanka and Hungary by an accredited representative of Sri Lanka and thereafter, to take appropriate measures for the effective implementation of the Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 2000 housing units under the Chinese Aid Programme for the low income people
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The Government of China has agreed to provide a grant for the construction of 2000 housing units under the Chinese aid programme for low income people. Accordingly, work sites have been identified in the Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Moratuwa, Peliagoda, Thimbirigasyaya and Maharagama for the purpose and the land areas in Peliyagoda and Maharagama vested with the   Urban Development Authority have been prepared for constructions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to vest the land called Elumaduwa Watta in extent of 02 Acres 01 Rood 03.77 Perches situated at Dr. Danister De Silva Mawatha in Dematagoda within the Divisional Secretariat Division of Thimbirigasyaya with the Urban Development Authority as a free grant under the State Land Ordinance and to secure provision to acquire the land called  Batary Watta, in extent of 03 Acres 03 Roods 08.84 Perches situated at Thelavala Road within the Divisional Secretariat Division of Moratuwa and for the development of the said lands, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Energy Performance Standards for the LED (Light Emitting Diode) Lights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - Under the Energy Demand Side Management Programme implemented through the Presidential Task Force, performance standards are introduced separately to promote the efficient use of electrical appliances. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to introduce regulations under section 67 of the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority Act, in order to introduce the minimum performance standards required for the LED bulbs being used in the country and improve their quality, to publish the said regulations in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present them in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The 42nd Asia Pacific Dental Congress and Exhibition organized by the Sri Lanka Dental Association
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The 42nd Asia Pacific Dental Congress organized by the Sri Lanka Dental Association is due to be held at the Bandaranayake Memorial International Conference Hall, from 9th to 13th of June, 2020. Dental Professionals and experts including American, Asian, European and most of the countries of the Pacific Region are expected to participate in this Congress and an international dental trade exhibition with the participation of the worldwide premier manufacturers and suppliers of dental equipment and healthcare material will also be held to coincide with the event.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to declare the said conference and the exhibition as a nationally recognized event and to secure provisions for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding entered into between Sri Lanka and Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Maldives for the purposes of higher education and water supply sectors, during the visit of Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister to Maldives in September 2019, to receive foreign exchange to the country through the expansion of higher educational opportunities affiliated to the state and non state sectors of Sri Lanka, for the expansion of higher educational opportunities of Sri Lanka  within the South Asian Region and to accrue benefits through the investment of specialized knowledge in Engineering of the Water Supply Sector in the Maldives with a view to further extending the friendship and mutual cooperation between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief for the affected people due to acquisition of land for the construction of the Demodara Reskuru Reservoir of the Badulla - Hali Ela - Ella Integrated Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to make a payment of compensation based on the replacement cost of the previously occupied house and compensation based on the present market value of their previously occupied land for 5 families with title deeds, affected due to the acquisition of land for the construction of the Demodara Reskuru Reservoir of the Badulla - Halia Ela - Ella Integrated Water Supply Project and to provide a Grant or a permit for the alternative lands given for 20 families inclusive of the above 5 families and the 15 families who were encroachers in the lands belonging to the Land Reform Commission, under the provisions of the Land Development Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulation on Priority of Claims in a winding up of a Licensed Finance Company under the section 33 of the Finance Business Act, No.42 of 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - Regulations on Priority of Claims in a winding up of a Licensed Finance Company approved by the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka,  drafted under section 33 of the Finance Business Act, No.42 of 2011 to facilitate the winding up process of a licensed finance company has been published under the signature of the Minister of Finance in the Gazette (Extraordinary) No.2125/58 of 2019 05 31.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, to present the said Gazette in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Tax Legislations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - In order to implement the tax proposals made in the National Budget of 2019 and include the amendments identified in the discussions and the requests, subsequently, made by the relevant stakeholders, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, to make amendments to the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002, the Nation Building Tax Act, No.9 of 2009, the Economic Service Charge Act, No.13 of 2006, the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017, the Finance Act and the Betting and Gaming Levy Act, No.14 of 1988, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the 'Credit Regulatory Authority'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - Due to the issues which cropped up while accomplishing the objectives anticipated from the Microfinance Act, No.6 of 2016, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to repeal the said Microfinance Act and establish the the 'Credit Regulatory Authority' as an independent entity to be administered by the Ministry of Finance, through an Act of Parliament, to introduce regulations, to regulate and supervise, money lending business in Sri Lanka in a customer protection and regulation of market conduct perspective, for all non public deposits taking institutions to be taken under a single regulator, enabling the unification of the comprehensive data and information on the microfinance industry in Sri Lanka,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining financial assistance for the establishment of a Vocational Training Centre in Matara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish a vocational training centre in Matara similar to the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute in Ratmalana with the Financial support of the Government of Germany aimed at providing institutional and industrial training to youth in Matara and the adjoining Districts in the fields of building and automobile repairs and maintenance, refrigeration and air conditioning, metal and light engineering, electronic and telecommunication and hospitality. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to obtain a financial assistance of Euro 15.7 million from the KfW (Kerditanstalt Fur Weideraifbau) of Germany, to establish the said training centre with the required training facilities and equipment and to direct  the Ministry of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co operative Development and Vocational Training & Skills Development, to grant independent status to the proposed vocational training centre in Matara as well as the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute established in Killinochchi and to manage all the three German Technical Training Institutes in a common Governance structure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of fully and partially damaged Hindu Temples in the conflict affected Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The religious dignitaries and peoples' representatives of the Northern Province has shown the absolute need of the rehabilitation of the Hindu Religious Temples which were fully and partially damaged due to the 30 year conflict. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs, to provide a special allocation of Rs.200 million to implement the said rehabilitation activities under the Rehabilitation Programme of the Ministry of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs through the District and Divisional Administration with the support and the participation of the Department of Hindu Religious and Cultural Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of compensation to the landowners who were affected due to the acquisition of lands to the Moragahakanda Project which were provided to them in lieu of the lands inundated by the Wemedilla Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The land area that includes the alternative lands provided for the people who had lost their properties due to the acquisition of lands for the Wemedilla Reservoir carried out within the Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Naula, Galewela and Dambulla, in the year 2008 under the Kandepitawala Project, has been subsequently, acquired by the Government for the activities of the Moragahakanda, Kaluganga Development Project. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to pay compensation to the remaining 4 landowners of Rs.16 lakhs each, who have been affected due to depriving  of their properties and not received the payment of compensation as an alternative to the loss of their properties, as revealed subsequently, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the name of the 'National Intellectual Property Office of Sri Lanka' as the 'Department of Intellectual Property of Sri Lanka'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The National Intellectual Property Office of Sri Lanka, established under the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003, has been mandated to administer the Intellectual Property system of Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, to amend the name of the 'National Intellectual Property Office of Sri Lanka' as the 'Department of Intellectual Property of Sri Lanka' and to amend the introduction referred to in Section 04(1) of the  Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003, as the 'National Intellectual Property Office of Sri Lanka' to read as the 'Department of Intellectual Property of Sri Lanka' in order to avoid the issues arisen when working along with the international and local institutions to accomplish its tasks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Report of the Presidential Commission of Inquiry to Investigate and Inquire into and Report on Alleged Irregularities in connection with the SriLankan Airlines Limited, SriLankan Catering Limited and the Mihin Lanka (Pvt.) Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President, to table the Report in Parliament, containing 32 recommendations made by the Presidential Commission of Inquiry to Investigate and Inquire into and Report on Alleged Irregularities said to have been committed in connection with the SriLankan Airlines Limited, the SriLankan Catering Limited and the Mihin Lanka (Pvt.) Limited from 2006 01 01 to 2018 01 31, having examined the written and oral complaints made by various parties and other information and to refer the said Report to the Attorney General to take legal action further necessary, as per the recommendations of the Commission, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Muslim Marriage and Divorce Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The Muslim Marriage and Divorce Act and the amendments related thereto provide for the registration of marriages and divorces of Sri Lankan Muslim community. There were some concerns in the Muslim community as well as among human rights activists that certain provisions of the said Act should be amended. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Postal Services & Muslim Religious Affairs and the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to amend  the said Act incorporating amendments to the provisions pertaining to matters such as the Age of Marriage, Registration Procedures and Consent of Marriage etc., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining of 2000 buses for strengthening the bus fleet of the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to call for Expression of Interest and Proposals to invite local / foreign investors  to add 2000 buses to the fleet of the Sri Lanka Transport Board, with a view to providing a comfortable and qualitative service to the public, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Baggage Screening X-Ray Machines with explosive detection capability at the Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to call for bids from the suppliers who have the potential to supply explosive detection systems for supply, installation and commissioning of 09 explosive detection systems at the Katunayake Bandaranaike International Airport with external funding, following procurement guidelines, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations made under section 41 of the Sports Act, No.25 of 1973 in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification No. 2128/8 18th June 2019 has been issued by further amending the Regulations of the National Sports Associations of No.01 of 2016 published in the  Gazette (Extraordinary) No.1990/23 of 27th October 2016 and the (amended) Regulations No.2006/13 of 13th February 2017. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports to present the  Gazette (Extraordinary) No.2128/8 of 18th June 2018 issued with a view to regularizing the administration of the National Sports Associations through conducting Sports Association Elections in a regular and a fair way under the present trends, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Laying of a new Synthetic Running Track at the Bogambara Stadium
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The Bogambara Stadium administered by the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority is a main divisional athletic Training Centre of National Sportsmen and Sportswomen. Presently, there are 2 stadiums with synthetic running tracks in Sri Lanka and they are situated in the Colombo District. Laying a synthetic running track in the Bogambara Stadium situated with less population and averagely attitudinal venue and easily accessible for sports personnel of all Provinces, is a timely need and accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports, to implement same as a new project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Inclusion of Sri Lanka as a founder member of the Coalition on Open Justice under the Open Government Partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka, as a member of the Open Government Partnership (OGP) is presently in the process of implementing its second Open Government Partnership  National Action Plan. The Open Government Partnership Secretariat has formally planed to launch a 'Coalition on Open Justice' with the objective of enhancing OGP Member Country capacity to implement the justice related reforms for the benefit of their citizens.  In this regard, the OGP Secretariat has extended an invitation to OGP Governments to become founder members of this Coalition. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, for Sri Lanka to join as a founder member of the said Coalition, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 10,000 Houses for the Plantation Community under the Indian Grant Assistance Housing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - 	The proposal made by the Minister of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure & Community Development, to invest Rs.150,000/- per house in order to provide water supply, internal access roads, electricity supply from the national grid and construction of earth retaining walls and storm water drainage of the 10,000 houses due to be constructed for the plantation community under the  Indian Grant Assistance Housing Programme under the funds allocated to the Ministry, to pay an implementation fee of 1.5% of the total cost of such 5,000 houses with infrastructure facilities amounting to Rs.86.25 million to the Plantation Human Development Trust and to utilize the fund from the annual budgetary provisions allocated for the Ministry to implement the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Overarching Agricultural Policy (OAP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The agricultural sector policy presently in place, has been developed in the year 2007 largely focusing on the development of crop agriculture sector. As such, action has been initiated to introduce a new Overarching Agricultural Policy to suit the emerging market dynamics and accordingly, the joint Note presented to the Cabinet by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs and the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to improve the said policy draft through a consultative process open for public comments, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of plots of land from the Regional Industrial Estates to setup Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The Regional Industrial Estates Development Programme implemented by the Ministry of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co operative Development and Vocational Training & Skills Development, is a main programme carried out with the objective of promoting industries at regional level.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co operative Development and Vocational Training & Skills Development, to allocate plots of lands from the relevant Industrial Estates on a 35 year lease basis, for the 18 investors recommended by the Project Evaluation Committee of the said Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entrepreneurship Development Programme for 10,000 youths engaged in the Information and Communication Technology Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The Information and Communication Technology sector has been identified as a widely spread and an attractive field among the youth community of the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co operative Development and Vocational Training & Skills Development, to implement a project under the supervision of the National Enterprises Development Authority by selecting 10,000 youths Island-wide, who are inclined towards the Information and Communication Technology and providing them with a special training and by providing Laptop Computers, Internet Connections, the other equipment necessary and financial facilities for 3,000 successful candidates after assessing  the business proposals submitted by them, with a view to providing a special training in the said field and paving the way to have opportunities to reap benefits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Policy on Industrial Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the existing inconsistencies in the related policies, inadequacy of the required technology and the infrastructure facilities, the dearth of skilled human resources, excessive energy cost, environmental challenges associated with industries and the shortcomings existing in the legal system have adversely affected the development and the sustainability of the industrial sector.  Hence, it has become a national need of the hour to formulate a successful industrial strategy which could contribute to the development of the country minimizing the said problems. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co operative Development and Vocational Training & Skills Development to formulate the National Policy on Industrial Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of a land for the development activities of the University of Kelaniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - 	Since the accommodation available at the building and the premises obtained on rental basis, where the new Faculty of Computing and Technology is conducted, is inadequate to provide educational and welfare facilities for the  students and essential facilities for the staff, the proposal made by the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to purchase a land with an extent of 02 acres, 02 roods and 11.60 perches facing the Colombo Kandy Road about 01 km away from the University to enable it to fulfill the said needs, for a sum of Rs.539 million on the Government valuation, from the money earned by the University, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvements of the Mihintale World Heritage Site
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet noted the information provided by the Hon. Prime Minister that the development of the Mihintale World Heritage Site, its renovation and lighting up could be undertaken as a Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Project of the Lanka Electricity Company (Private) Limited under an expenditure of Rs.275 million (without tax).

description: Development Assistance Agreement No.383 126 and No.383 127 signed with the Government of the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has entered into two Assistance Agreements with the Government of the United States of America in the year 2011, in order to obtain grant assistance for financing the programme of 'Strengthened Partnership for Democratic Governance and Social Cohesion' and the programme of 'Sustained and Inclusive Economic Growth'. The proposal made by the Minister of Finance to amend the Agreements increasing the grant made in regard to the said programmes from US$ 35.95 million to 47.81 and US$ 33.86 million to 44.52  respectively, extending the date of completion up to 31st December, 2022 and incorporating the 'Modern Energy Services' as an element to the programme of 'Sustained and Inclusive Economic Growth', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority and the LEPL Georgian National Tourism Administration in the field of Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - 	The proposal made by the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority and the LEPL Georgian National Tourism Administration in the field of Tourism which will be valid for a period of three (03) years and will be automatically renewed for a further period of three (03) years and also to authorize the Chairman of Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Technical and Vocational Education - National Education Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-20
decision_details_body: - The objective of the National Policy on Technical and Vocational Education is to promote access to technical and vocational training and to provide an opportunity for students to gain access from schools to technical and vocational training institutions.  This will pave the way for various training opportunities in the fields which are in demand in the labour market with high level participation by the relevant industry players and to take the necessary steps to increase the operational efficiency of the training institutions and to reap the maximum benefits from the investments made in the said fields. Accordingly, the draft Bill on National Policy on Technical and Vocational Education formulated after having obtained the contributions and expertise on a wide range of matters from the experts of the technical and vocational education fields in the Government, private sector and those in the industrial sector and presented by H.E. the President, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entrusting the printing of School Textbooks required for Distribution Free of Charge in the year 2020 to the Printing Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - The Open Procurement Procedure has been commenced for the printing of textbooks from the printing institutions for the year 2020. Accordingly, it has been recommended to entrust the printing of textbooks to 29 selected printing institutions, having taken into consideration the minimum price tabled by the bidders, the minimum bid price agreed upon by the Department of Educational Publications subsequent to negotiations, the printing capacity of the bidders and the supplying on time as well as the determination of the Cabinet Procurement Committee. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to print 33,712,100 copies from 386 categories of school textbooks at a cost of Rs.3,982,299,535.00 from the said 29 printing institutions to enable them to be distributed among the schools prior to 30th November 2019, according to the procurement time table determined by the Cabinet Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for civil works construction of the Port Access Elevated Highway project funded by the Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to award the civil works of the Port Access Elevated Highway project funded by the Asian Development Bank, to the China Civil Engineering Construction Corporation, Hubei Provincial Road and Bridge Group Co. Ltd. and Henan Proincial Institute of Communications Planning and Design Institute Co. Ltd. JV, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer 2019 (September)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to obtain covering approval to procure 30,000 Urea (Granular) at US$ 315.80 per MT from M/s Agrifert Liven International Pte. Ltd., and 20,000 MTs of Muriate of Potash at US$ 343.10 per MT from M/s Swiss Singapore Overseas Enterprises Pte. Ltd., in order to fulfill the fertilizer requirement of the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company for the month of September, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Moragolla Hydro Power Plant under the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to award the Main Civil Works Tender for the construction of the Moragolla Hydro Power Plant Lot - A 2, to China Gezhouba Group Co. Ltd. of Tower F, Ocean International Centre, 208, Ciyunsi, Beili, Chaoyang District, Beijing of China as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet

description: Construction of new buildings for the branches of the National Transport Medical Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - The functions of the National Transport Medical Institute functioning as an Independent Body under the Ministry of Transport & Civil Aviation have been further widened as a result of the renewal of the Driving Licenses of Light Vehicles, obtained from 2009 being commenced from March 2017. As such, 25 branches have been opened Island Wide to provide a more efficient and a productive service and a large number of clients visit the Gampaha, Werahera, Kurunegala, Kandy and Anuradhapura branches daily. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to construct pre-fabricated buildings for the Werahera, Kurunegala and Anuradhapura branches and permanent buildings for the Gampaha and Kandy branches adopting the formal procurement procedures and utilizing the funds of the National Transport Medical Institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of additional quantity of Maize required for animal feeding
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that there exists the need for the import of 80,000 MT of maize for animal food production as a result of the production in 2019 being insufficient, As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development firstly, for the National Food Promotion Board to import 50,000 MT of maize on the recommendation of the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and distribute on the demand of the companies engaged in animal production, secondly, to grant permission for Animal Food Producers and Poultry Entrepreneurs registered with the Department Animal Production and Health to import by themselves the balance requirement of maize for 2019 before the 31st of January 2020 upon the recommendation made by the Department of Animal Production and Health based on the quantity of animal food produced by each company and the animals to be reared and to impose a Special Trade Levy of Rs.10/- per kg of maize and also to introduce a methodology to induce farmers to undertake maize cultivation and provide them with seeds free of charge, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 17th Steering Committee meeting and Conference of the 'International Network for Water and Ecosystem in Paddy Fields (INWEPF)' - 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - 'The International Network for Water and Ecosystem in Paddy Fields' has been established in the year 2004 with the main objective of maintaining a proper water management focusing on the sustainability of the Eco-system of paddy fields. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to hold the 17th Steering Committee Meeting and the Annual Conference of the said forum in Colombo in November 2020 with the participation of the member countries of the said forum and its relevant agencies and also to secure the provisions required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reducing Anaemia and Anaemia related health issues through fortification of common staple foods with Iron and Folic Acid
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the approval granted by the Cabinet previously, an Officials' Committee has been appointed to study and report pertaining to the implementation of a programme on fortification of rice and wheat  flour by adding iron and folic acid. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to implement the recommendations of the said Committee including fortification of staple foods including rice and wheat flour by adding iron and folic acid, assessing operation of the school mid-day meal programme and conduct an evaluation and for providing fortified seed paddy locally, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: An Act to Incorporate the Sri Lanka Psychological Association
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - Hon. Thilanga Sumathipala, member of Parliament has presented a Private Member's Bill in Parliament to Incorporate the Sri Lanka Psychological Association. Accordingly, the proposal made the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to present the proposed draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in accordance with the recommendations of the Cabinet Sub Committee on Legislation, and to publish it in the Government Gazette in tri languages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Grant Agreements to be entered into with Foreign Institutes by the University of Peradeniya, the University of Sri Jayewardenepura, the University of Colombo and the University of Kelaniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to vest the power with the respective Vice Chancellors of the University of Peradeniya, the University of Sri Jayewardenepura, the University of Colombo and the University of Kelaniya to enter into 02 grant agreements by the University of Peradeniya and the University of Sri Jayewardenepura with the Asian Institute of Technology in Thiland on the Curriculum Development in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, to enter into a grant agreement between the University of Colombo and the University of Graz in Australia on Contemporary Teaching Skills for South Asia and to enter into a grant agreement between the University of Kelaniya and the Imperial College of Science, Technology and Medicine of Research Office, on Transfer of Material, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Flight Kitchen Expansion Project in SriLankan Catering Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - In concurrence with the project for the expansion of the Airport which is in progress, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to implement the project estimated at a cost of Rs.250 million for the expansion of the flight kitchen for fulfilling the need of the catering facilities of the air passengers, having obtained a further 150 perches adjacent to the SriLankan Catering premises from the Airport and Aviation Services Limited, as the need has arisen to expand the ultra-modern flight kitchen which was specially constructed for SriLankan Catering to enable to supply 40,000 meals per day, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Finance (Draft) Bill - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Finance to present the Finance (Draft) Bill in Parliament to amend the Finance Act, No.35 of 2018 to give effect to the amendments including the revenue proposals in the Budget for the amendment of the definition of 'Specified Motor Vehicle' for applicability of the luxury tax on motor vehicles excluding passenger transport vehicles like vans, single cabs, double cabs, motor cycles, motor tricycles, three wheelers, and motor lorries, tractors, hand tractors, trailers for transport of goods, and motor ambulances, motor hearses and to levy on payment on foreign commercial transaction to be charged at the rate of 3.5% on credit or debit card payments made to purchase goods or services from outside Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vote on Account - 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - As a presidential election is to be held towards the end of the year 2019, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to prepare a Vote on Account incorporating the expenditure of the Government needed by the Government for the first 04 months of the year 2020 and to present it in Parliament for approval, by postponing the commencement of the preparation of the annual Budget for the year 2020 to enable the preparation of the Budget for the year 2020 based on the new policies of the Government and the composition of the new Cabinet of Ministers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a System for Licensing of Electrical Technology Workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - The Joint proposal made by the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs; the Minister of Finance; and the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to implement a Licensing Framework for electrical technology workers with effect from August 2019 to provide a safe service for electricity consumers by establishing a proper standard of electrical installations and also with a view to increasing the demand for qualified electrical technology workers for formal recognition as professionals to create more employment opportunities for them, and to authorize the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka and the Construction Industry Development Authority for the implementation of the said licensing system and to appoint the 'Electrician Licensing Enforcement and Review Panel' comprising of the representatives of the relevant institutions to oversee the process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia on Cooperation in the field of Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, for signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Kingdom of Cambodia to strengthen the relationship between the two countries by developing Cooperation in the field of Tourism based on equal and mutual benefits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conservation of the existing mangrove and rehabilitation of the mangrove lands belonging to the State which are presently abandoned having used for the prawn farms and salterns
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to arrive at a decision not to release the mangrove lands which are being administered by the Department of Forest Conservation and the Department of Wildlife Conservation for other development activities and to take a decision to release the lands identified for aquaculture farming after a proper study made by a Committee comprising of the representatives of the relevant Ministries, Departments and other Institutions, to direct the Divisional Secretaries and the Land Commissioner General, to handover the Government lands granted on lease basis for aquaculture and salterns and presently abandoned, without further extending the lease agreement, to the Forest Department to establish mangroves, and to instruct the relevant departments to implement specific mangrove rehabilitation programmes to increase the extent of mangrove lands by 10,000 Hectares, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promoting Drying Technology among the Paddy farmers to be applicable for their earning potential
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-13
decision_details_body: - After milling, although the harvested paddy with high moisture content should be dried properly for safe storage, the delay in drying, incomplete drying or uneven drying will result in the loss of the anticipated standard and hence the paddy farmers will have to sell their paddy stock at a lower price. As such, in accordance with the recommendations of the working committee appointed on the instructions given by the Cabinet Committee on Cost of Living, a proposal has been made to implement a pilot project among the paddy farmers in the Pollonnaruwa District which has a higher production and grows paddy twice a year for popularizing the drying technology. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President at the request of the Non Cabinet Minister of Economic Reforms and Public Distribution, to provide a mobile drier with a capacity of 02 MT valued at Rs.3 million (without tax) and a fixed drier with a capacity of 6 MT valued at Rs.06 million (without tax) for five farmer organizations each in the Pollonnaruwa District selected by the Department of Agrarian Services, with the assistance of the all Island Rice Millers Association adopting a mechanism for recovering the expenditure incurred by the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 2019 Budget Proposal No.143: Acquiring user - Friendly buses with modern facilities for the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to procure a possible number of diesel, low floor air conditioned, user friendly buses with modern facilities by utilizing the allocation of Rs.1500 million set apart from the Budget of 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contracts for five civil work contract packages in the Northern Province under the Asian Development Bank funded Second Integrated Road Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to award the contract package for the rehabilitation/improvement and maintenance of 67.64 km of rural roads in the Jaffna District to WKK Engineering Company (Pvt.) Ltd. in joint venture with World Kaihatsu Kogyo Company Ltd. (Japan), contract package for rehabilitation/improvement and maintenance of 71.81 km of rural roads in the same District for the China State Construction Engineering Corporation Ltd. (China), the contract package for rehabilitation/improvement and maintenance of 60.31 km of rural roads in the Killinochchi District to Sri Ram Construction and the contract packages for rehabilitation/improvement and maintenance of 56.03 km and 61.30 km of rural roads in the Mannar District to K.D.A. Weerasinghe & Company  (Pvt.) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Widening and  Improving the (B275) first two kilometers of the Matara - Hakmana Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to award  the contract for Widening and  Improving the (B275) first two kilometers of the Matara - Hakmana Road, to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing of 25 Local Authorities in Sri Lanka with urban infrastructure facilities under the Secondary Town Sustainable Urban Development Project funded by Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-06
decision_details_body: -The proposal made by the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to award the consultancy services for detailed design and procurement services of urban infrastructure of 25 local authorities,  to the joint venture of the Resources Development Consultants (Pvt.) Limited (Lead Consultants) and IPE Global Limited (IPEG), India (JV partner) at No.55-2/1, Galle Road, Colombo 03, with a view to developing the main towns of the Island with development initiatives as model towns, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Surgical Wards and Operation Theatre Complex in the District General Hospital in Moneragala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-06
decision_details_body: - The limited accommodation available in the District General hospital Moneragala, which is the only hospital which provides a secondary level health service for the population exceeding 500,000 in the Moneragala District, comprising of a number of extremely difficult Divisional Secretariat Divisions,  has become an obstacle for providing a qualitative health service to the people. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, for the construction of Surgical Wards and Operation Theatre Complex in the District General Hospital in Moneragala to enable to overcome the said problem, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Volunteerism in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-06
decision_details_body: - Volunteerism plays a tremendous role in promoting socio economic development activities in the sectors of eradication of poverty, child care, empowerment of women, rehabilitation of drug addicts, community health activities, supporting the persons with disabilities and elders, providing relief in disaster situations and environmental management.  As such, it has become a dire necessity to introduce a National Policy on Volunteerism in Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Primary Industries and Social Empowerment, for the proposed National Policy on Volunteerism drafted in consultation with the civil society, academia, professionals, the general public and the relevant Governmental and non governmental institutions and private sector institutions and to draft appropriate legislation in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet in principle.

description: Establishment of a new Mixed National School of Tri-lingual Education in the Mirigama area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-08-06
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, for the establishment of a new Mixed National School of Tri-lingual Education in the Mirigama area.
