decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement a pilot project for the use of automated peritoneal dialysis in home setting for the patients of the Chronic Kidney Disease of unknown origin and the Chronic Kidney Disease patients. A sum of Rs.500 million has been set apart by the Budget of 2019 for the implementation of this project. It has been observed that this activity has contributed to prolonging the life span of the kidney patients and   bestowing a better outcome of their lives. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to enter into an Agreement with M/s Lucenxia Healthcare (Pvt.) Ltd. for the implementation of the project ,for a period of 08 years at the rate of Rs.103,740/- per patient per month, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report of the Sectoral Oversight Committee on Education and Human Resources Development on the Observations regarding the Batticaloa Campus (Pvt.) Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The observation report of the Chairman of the Sectoral Oversight Committee on Education and Human Resources Development, on the Batticaloa Campus (Pvt.) Limited, which has been presented to the Parliament was submitted to focus the attention of the Cabinet and the Cabinet decided to appoint a Ministerial Sub-Committee comprising of the Ministers of Finance, City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, National Integration, Official Languages, Social Progress and Hindu Religious Affairs and Development Strategies and International Trade, to study the recommendations made by the said Sectoral Oversight Committee and report to the Cabinet.

description: Improving the learning environment of the schools in the Killinochchi District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The Government has taken steps for implementing various projects to conduct the educational activities of the Kilinochchi area in a high qualitative  standard, which has slumped in to a backward position owing to the conflict situation that prevailed there for three decades. Accordingly, a project for the development of the infrastructure in the schools of the Kilinochchi District was implemented since 2011, with a grant of US$ 2 million by the  Korea International Cooperation Agency  and the facts submitted by the Minister of Education to the effect that an extension to the project will be implemented with a grant of US$ 7.5 million to upgrade the educational activities of selected 13 schools in the Kilinochchi District during the period from 2018 to 2022, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Pre-cast Disaster Resilient Houses in the high risk landslide prone areas of the Ratnapura and Kalutara Districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - An account named, 'the Secretary, Ministry of Disaster Management' has been opened for the donors to credit money for providing relief assistance to the people affected due to emergency disaster situations and as at 2019‑03‑31 a balance of Rs.294.72 million has been reported in the account. The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to the proposal made by an active operational institution of China to construct 10,000 Pre‑cast Disaster Resilient Houses for the families who live in disaster prone areas and who should be resettled due to landslides and flood disasters island‑wide.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Disaster Management and Rural Economic Affairs, to construct 230 houses out of the 400 houses due to be constructed in the Ratnapura and Kalutara districts as a pilot project by utilizing the funds in the said account, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Launching a Cable Car Project for the promotion of the Tourism Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - Nuwara Eliya situated at the apex point in Sri Lanka which inherits a splendorous environment with  a star attraction of local and foreign tourists and as a further step towards enhancing its glamour, a project proposal has been submitted by the Outdoor Engineering Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd. and its foreign partner Doppelmayr Cable Car to initiate a Cable Car Project from Nanu Oya to Single Tree and Gregory Lake. The project which is proposed to be implemented with an investment of US$ 50 million, proposes to construct 21 towers connecting Nanu Oya Railway Station, Race Course and Single Tree hill in Nuwara Eliya consisting of 86 cabins where 10 people could travel in each cabin and out of which 43 cabins will be installed under its first phase. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding, to implement the project as a project of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Forming of an Apex Committee as the Task Force to facilitate the implementation of the Pettah Multimodal Transport Hub Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to establish the Pettah Multimodal Transport Hub and to call for Expression of Interest (EOI) from suitable investors who would undertake the activities pertaining to the implementation of the project from the private sector financial assistance. In order to complete the plan of this project, there are several complex problems to be resolved. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to finalize the technological and financial feasible studies pertaining to the project and to appoint a steering committee to act as the task force of the Pettah Multimodal Transport Hub to intervene in the said problems and take decisions , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the mental health services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The impact of the population structure and the diseases of the country is in a changing process and in order to face such situations the health care  delivery system has to be restructured. It has been identified that, at present, around 10% of the total population in the country suffer from any sort of mental illness and only a 40% out of them resort to treatment and it has been assumed that the problems related to mental illness will tend to increase in the future. Considering these facts, the attention of the Government has been drawn to promote mental health services with a view to generating a healthy population. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to construct the new Psychiatric Treatment Unit Complex at the Teaching Hospital in Kandy with an investment of  Rs.503 million and the Psychiatric Treatment Unit at the District Base Hospital in Chillaw with an investment of Rs.213.8 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations pertaining to the International Telecommunication Operators' Levy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Finance to remove the levy payable on Outgoing Local Access Charge with effect from 2019‑06‑01, to extend the validity period of levy payable on Incoming International Calls, Incoming International Calls on Specific Telephone Numbers Charge, Rate of Disbursement of Levy as Incoming Calls, Access Charge, the Rate of Disbursement of Levy as Telecommunication Development Charge and Outgoing Local Access Charge as proposed in the Budget 2019 and to present the Gazette Notification No.2123/19 dated 2019‑05‑14 in Parliament for approval in terms of the Finance Act, No.11 of 2004, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the National Environment Act, No.47 of 1980
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend the National Environment Act, No.47 of 1980 enacted to suit the present trends, with a view to providing a wide Legal Framework required to coordinate all sectors involved in the environment of Sri Lanka at national level. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to amend the National Environment Act, No.47 of 1980 to incorporate further amendments such as the comprehensive responsibility of the manufacturer in respect of the items which generate hazardous waste material, making domestic laws to empower multi‑faceted environmental Agreements, focusing attention on environmental conditions at the preliminary environmental test and evaluation of environmental effects, prevention of environmental pollution by activities which do not require environmental protection permits,  obtaining the authority to take into custody any implement prohibited by the existing Act and its destruction and the increase of the Members of the Environmental Committee etc., when making this amendment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Public Officers' Dress
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - A Circular has been issued on 2019‑05‑29 regarding the Public Officers' Dress by the Secretary to the Ministry in‑charge of the subject of Public Administration by virtue of the powers vested in him by the Establishments Code. However, considering the various representations made to the Minister in‑charge of the subject of Public Administration pertaining to the implementation of the said Circular, it has been proposed to revise the above Circular. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration, Disaster Management and Rural Economic Affairs to issue circular instructions inclusive of the provisions such as that when coming to their office premises during the duty hours, the male officers should wear Trouser and Shirt or the National Dress and the female officers to wear Saree, Osari or a suitable dignified attire to preserve the dignity of the Public Service and such dress should always keep the face of a lady officer open while it should be a dress which do not obstruct the provisions laid down for public security, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Term Contract for the import of Diesel and Petrol within a period of the next eight months
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to award the term contact for the import of the required 420,000 barrels of diesel (0.001% Max Sulphur), 1,040,000 barrels of diesel (0.05% Max Sulphur) and 1,084,000 barrels of petrol (92UNL) for the period of 08 months from 2019‑07‑15 to 2020‑03‑14 to M/s Vitol Asia Pte. Ltd. of Singapore, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Special Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of 845.83 km length of Roads in the Eastern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - With the objective of developing the access routes between the Rural Areas and the Socio-Economic Centres, it is due to develop and maintain 408.62 km length of rural roads in the Ampara District with 05 project packages, 221.28 km length of roads in the Batticaloa District with 03 project packages and 215.93 km length of roads in the Trincomalee District under the Second Integrated Road Investment Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to award the contract package 01 and 02 to NEM Construction (Pvt.) Ltd., the contract for package No.03 to the joint venture of AMSK - CHEC, to award the contract for package No.04 to the Maga Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., to award the contract for package No.05 to Nawloka Construction Company (Pvt.) Ltd., to award the contract for package No.01 and 02 in the Batticaloa District to the joint venture of Chongqing International Corporation (China) and Sun Constructions, to award the contract for package No.03 to the Nawaloka Construction Company (Pvt.) Ltd., to award the contract No.01 and 03 in the Trincomalee District to Edward & Christie and package No.02 to Maga Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accreditation and Strengthening of the Non-State Higher Educational Institutes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - Although, a number exceeding 150,000 students gain eligibility for admission to the state universities, about more than 125,000 students fail to get the opportunity of admission to the said network due to the limited facilities available at the State Universities. As a solution to the problem, various incentive programmes are being implemented by the Government to encourage the students to get their Degrees from the Non‑State Higher Educational Institutes. In this respect, the attention of the Government has been focused to provide the necessary facilities to the Accredited Non-State Higher Educational Institutes, utilizing the savings of the project on 'Accelerating Higher Education Expansion and Development Operation (AHEAD)'. Through this, it is expected to expand the higher educational opportunities of the Advanced Level students who do not qualify to gain admission to the state university network. Taking these matters into consideration, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs and Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to provide financial assistance to the Accredited Non-State Higher Educational Institutes utilizing the savings of the Accelerating Higher Education Expansion and Development Operation under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Programme and to appoint an Officials' Committee to monitor the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the 'Sukithapurawara'Township Development Programme and Appointment of consultants for Consultation Services of the new projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously for the continuation of the projects commenced under the Sukithapurawara Township Development Programme but which have not been completed as yet. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to make necessary facilities for the continuation of the projects which have been implemented under this project in the year 2017, such as construction of the Mahara Commercial Complex, design and construction of infrastructure facilities at Hatton Railway Station, improvement of the Manamendra Road at Awissawella, construction of the proposed building of Sumanakeerthi Maha Piriwena, building of Nalikaramaya at Meevitigammana, the underground cables of Sabaragamuwa Maha Saman Devalaya of Rathnapura, the Urban Park at Kawanthissa Wewa at Embilipitiya and the Public Market at Kalutara, providing sanitary facilities at Anuradhapura sacred city, development of infrastructure facilities at Mulative, preparation of the Kubichchikulama Wewa recreation area and the development of Kottawa Talagala Road and Kirimandala Mawatha, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Carrying out Major Overhaul essential for Engine No.02 of the Sapugaskanda Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the purchase of spare parts for the major overhaul of Engine No.02 of the Sapugaskanda Power Station to be performed in each 24,000 running hours for the proper operation of the generator sets of the said Station, to MAN Energy Solution of France, the original equipment manufacturer, for a sum of Euro 1.8 million, in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of Aviation fuel for SriLankan Airlines at Dammam Airport of 	Saudi Arabia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to award the contract for the supply of Aviation fuel for SriLankan Airlines at the Dammam Airport of Saudi Arabia during the period from 2019 July 01st to December 31st, to M/s Modern Consortium for Refueling Aircraft Co. Ltd (MCRA), for a sum of US $ 2.0 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of a 03 year contract for the supply of catering from London Heathrow for SriLankan Airlines flights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to award the contract for the supply of catering for a period of 03 years, for the SriLankan Airlines flights departing from the London Heathrow Airport to Newrest Catering Services, for a sum of £4.5 million, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka's Participation at EXPO Dubai 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The World Expo is one of the most popular and large international exhibitions conducting once in every year, over a period of six months and it is scheduled to be held in Dubai in the year 2020. As such, considering the fact that  participation in this exhibition will lead the way to develop trade, market share and business and provide opportunities to promote direct foreign investment, sharing technologies, information technology, transport, tourism industry and other services while enhancing the country's image and showing its abilities,  the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade to secure the required provisions to attend  this exhibition and to provide other necessary facilities for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the National Institute of Language Education and Training Act, No.26 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The National Institute of Language Education and Training has been established by the National Institute of Language Education and Training Act, No.26 of 2007 with a view to practically implementing the Language Policy of the Government. The main objectives of this institution are to create  teachers of the Sinhala, Tamil and English languages, translators and interpreters and to train individuals with trilingual proficiency. The proposal made by Hon. Mano Ganesan, the Minister of National Integration, Official Languages, Social Progress and Hindu Religious Affairs, to amend the National Institute of Language Education and Training Act, No.26 of 2007, to widen the objectives of establishing the Institute more broadly for conducting Language Courses to suit the present trends, by developing interrelationships with the Universities and the other Higher Educational Institutes, to conduct Language Classes at Divisional level and to establish Divisional Training Centres, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Tablet Computers to the Advanced Level (A/L) Students and the Teachers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - A proposal had been made in the Budget 2017 to provide tablet computers to the students who follow the Advanced Level Classes and their teachers to  promote the qualitative aspects of their educational activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education to provide tablet computers to the students who have gained admission to Grade 12 in the year 2019 and as well as the Teachers who teach the relevant subjects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: New Legislation to replace the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, has been enacted in the year 2015. The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to present a new draft Bill in Parliament updating the said Act inclusive of the provisions required to comply with the international norms and best practices on the subject of victims of crime and witnesses, and to repeal the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, No.04 of 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Sports Complex and the Indoor Stadium in the Monaragala District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - As a new cross-section in the development of the Moneragala District, it has been planned to construct the Sports Complex and the Indoor Stadium in the plot of land in extent of 10 acres located in the Kumarawatta Estate in Moneragala which has been acquired for the said purpose, with the objective of promoting the health of the community living in the district and also for bestowing sports talents of the future generation. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration, Disaster Management and Rural Economic Affairs and Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports to secure the funds necessary for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Project for 'Cleaning of Beira Lake by Desilting and Flushing'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - Presently, the area around the Beira lake is made use of as a commercial and residence centre and with a view to making the environment around it attractive and protecting the water network of the lake, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to implement a project by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation inclusive of desilting the Beira lake, rehabilitation of the Beira Lake Spillway, monitoring of the water quality and the prevention of solid waste and pollutants diffusing into the water body, with an investment of Rs.800 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Public Service Indoor Sports Complex for the Kuliyapitiya - West Divisional Secretariat
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The Public Officers residing in the District of Kurunegala where the largest number of such officers dwell, make use of the facilities found in the Public Service Indoor Sports Club Premises situated in the Meegahakotuwa area which are of very minimal standards for their sports activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to secure the funds required to develop the said sports club premises as a full fledged sports complex with a Badminton Court, a Tenis Court, Pool/Snooker Tables, a Squash Court, a Swimming Pool, Cafeteria, and Office Complex, conference facilities and an Exercise Hall, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of El Salvador on visa exemption for Diplomatic and Official Passport holders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government for the proposed Memorandum of Understanding to be entered into between Sri Lanka and the Republic of El Salvador for the objectives of facilitating the citizens of both countries mutually for their traveling purposes, simplifying the relevant procedure and visa exemption of diplomatic and official passports holders with a view to strengthening the friendly relation between the two countries and allowing the said tourists entering into the country to stay for a period of 30 days in the territory without visa, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for the development of the Base Hospital in Deniyaya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The Base Hospital in Deniyaya is the only hospital in the area which provides secondary health care services and a population around 350,000 obtain health care services from this hospital. As the hospital is situated in a landslide prone area, it has been recommended to be relocated by the Geological Survey and Mines Bureau. At the same time, the physical and human resources available presently in the hospital is not adequate to provide a quality service for the beneficiaries to their expectation. As such, it has been planned to develop this hospital as a new Base Hospital with 600 beds and other modern facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to acquire the proposed land of an extent of 33 acres agreed to be released to the Government by the Thalawakale Plantation Company, to establish the hospital and also to provide the other necessary facilities in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Outdoor Patient Department (OPD), Theatre and the Ward Complex at the National Eye Hospital of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - It has been recognized the necessity of further development of the Sri Lanka National Eye Hospital, the tertiary health care hospital which provides services to all eye related ailments, in Sri Lanka in accordance with the international standards. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to construct a 14 storey building with adequate accommodation for an OPD, Wards, Clinics, Theatres and facilities for diagnosis of diseases and other supporting services, with an investment of Rs.4,565 million, to provide a better quality eye treatment service to the beneficiaries as a state‑of the art‑hospital in the country, under the 'Hospital Development Master Plan of 2016 - 2025', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Professorial Unit at the Teaching Hospital in Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The Provincial General Hospital in Ratnapura was upgraded as a Teaching Hospital in year 2018 with a view to facilitate the clinical training for Medical Students of the newly established Medical Faculty in the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka, and it has been recognized the requirement of providing necessary facilities for clinical training to the students enrolled at the said Medical Faculty. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to construct the Professorial Unit as a six storey building with an investment of Rs.4,324.22 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute of International Relations and Strategic Studies and the Raul Roa Garcia Institute of International Relations of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Cuba
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute of International Relations and Strategic Studies of Sri Lanka and the Raul Roa Garcia Institute of International Relations of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Cuba, with a view to establish and promote academic and scholastic corporation between the two institutes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding a financial donation of US$ 50,000 to the Republic of Cuba for rebuilding a village affected due to a tornado
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to donate an amount of US$ 50,000.00 to the Government of Cuba to rebuild a village situated in the municipality of Regla in Havana destroyed by the tornado that swept Cuba in January this year, as a token of solidarity and to commemorate the 60th anniversary of establishing diplomatic ties between Sri Lanka and Cuba, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Loan Agreement with the Exim Bank of Hungary for the construction of Flyovers at Kohuwala and Getambe
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The necessary action has been taken to enter into a commercial contract with the relevant contractor for the construction of Flyovers at Kohuwala and Getambe with a view to providing speedy and safe transport facilities to the commuters. The Government of Hungary has expressed its willingness to provide Financial assistace for the said construction activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to enter into an agreement with the Exim Bank of Hungary to obtain a concessionary loan of Euro 52 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowering Police Officers on matters pertaining to Illicit Liquor
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to amend the Excise Ordinance to empower the police officers to institute legal action on matters pertaining to illicit liquor. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to present the draft Bill so prepared, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board Act No.11 of 1984
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The National Dangerous Drugs Control Board Act, No.11 of 1984 provided for the establishment of the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board to prevent the use of illicit drugs, and specifying its powers, has been amended by the Acts No.41 of 1986 and No.21 of 1990. Illicit drug use and spread within Sri Lanka has been increased at present compared to 1980s in which period this Act was formulated and the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board which is the prime institution of creating and reviewing national policy for preventing and controlling of drug abuse, treatment and rehabilitation, has to be strengthened legally. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to amend the The National Dangerous Drugs Control Board Act, No.11 of 1984, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The proposed New Laws on Occupational Safety, Employee Health and Welfare
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, at the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to refer the draft on Laws on Occupational Safety, Employee Health and Welfare, prepared by the Committee appointed by the then Minister of Labour and Manpower with the technical assistance of the International Labour Organization, to the Legal Draftsman to make it a draft Bill, containing the subsequent amendments made thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Strategic Road Map for the Internet of Things (IoT): 2019 - 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The 'Internet of Things' which is the technology of communication of devices and tools via the internet is recognized as the next revolutionary and the transformative technology of the world. The experts of the Institute of Engineering and Technology of the United Kingdom, Sri Lanka Network, under the guidance of the Ministry of Digital Infrastructure and Information Technology has drafted a National Strategic Road Map pertaining to IoT focusing on the period from 2019 to 2022 and it has been subject to a broader dialogue among various stakeholder institutions and further improvements have been made by incorporating those suggestions and recommendations. As such, H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, at the request of the Non-Cabinet Minister of Digital Infrastructure and Information Technology, presented the said National Strategic Road Map for the IoT for the period from 2019 - 2022, so improved, to the Cabinet for information.

description: Implementation of the projects pertaining to the prevention of Kidney Disease by utilizing the funds of the National Kidney Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - Various projects are being implemented at present, with the objective of providing a better facilitated chemical and hospitality service for the welfare of the people of Sri Lankans afflicted with the chronic kidney disease and proposals have also been made to implement 03 other new projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement the project for the research on identification of the aetiology and prevention of the Chronic Kidney disease by the Teaching Hospital Kandy, under the supervision of the Presidential Task Force on the prevention of Kidney disease, to carryout the construction work of an Information and Research Centre on Kidney disease by the University of Kelaniya and to implement a programme of adopting indigenous system of medicine in the treatment of kidney disease and to implement the treatment promotion programme by the Bandaranaike Memorial Indigenous Medical Research Institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Further extending the 'Relief Package' granted for the upliftment of the Tourism Industry adversely affected by the recent terrorist attack
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to grant a Relief Package for the upliftment of the Tourism Industry, taking into consideration the threats posed against its future, due to the recent terrorist attacks. Further, considering the representations also made by other sectors associated with the Tourism Industry and affected by the said attacks, action has been taken to extend the earlier relief provide for, to those sectors as well. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to provide a moratorium in respect of the working capital loan scheme introduced to institutions engaged in the tourism industry and persons up to 31st March 2020 and to extend the coverage of the Credit Guarantee Fund, to grant a two month moratorium for the passenger bus owners, to introduce the working capital loan scheme for the entertainment sectors and individuals engaged in the institutions associated with the tourism industry and other persons and to implement the loan scheme called the 'Sancharaka Poddo' introduced by the Regional Development Banks etc., to support them financially, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Collaborative Agreement to provide facilities to secure foreign employment opportunities in Japan for the skilled workers of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports, to enter into a Collaborative Agreement between the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare and the National Policy Agency of Japan and the Ministry of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports of Sri Lanka regarding the Specified Skilled Workers to provide facilities to secure foreign employment opportunities in Japan for the youth of Sri Lanka who have attained certain specific skills, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report of 2018 submitted in terms of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of section 13 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.3 of 2003, the Minister of Finance should submit an Annual Report (Final Budgetary Position Report) to the parliament and to the public, not later than five months from the end of the relevant financial year. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to submit the report inclusive of the updated information on fiscal management activities for the fiscal year 2018 which has been prepared under four sections to wit; Macro-fiscal Perspectives, Final Budget Position, Functional Performance and Reforms and Financial Statements, in parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a building complex with Advanced Level classes and 	Laboratory facilities in the National School with multi-ethnic students 	and trilingual education in the Polonnaruwa District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The first building complex of the National School with multi-ethnic students and trilingual education in the Polonnaruwa District is being constructed to accommodate the classes from Grade 6 to Grade 9, availing the facilities required for administration activities under the donation of Rs. 300 million of the Indian Government and the necessity has arisen to construct another building complex for class rooms of Grade 12 and Grade 13 and laboratory facilities of the said School. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, Minister of Education to award the construction works of the said building to M/S Central Engineering Services (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.245.9 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Selection of a Solution Provider for the Introduction of the Electronic Government Procurement (e-GP) into the Public Procurement System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously for the implementation of the recommendations of the Working Group appointed for the introduction of e-GP system into the Public Procurement System in Sri Lanka, representing a wider range of stakeholders including the University of Colombo School of Computing (UCSC). Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to select 'Theekshana'; the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) arm of the University of Colombo which is the ICT solution provider for the Government Organizations and which already contributes towards the planning and development activities of this project and to enter in to an Agreement with the said institution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Enterprise Resource Planning System for the Coconut Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The coconut sector contributes to 0.6% of the Gross Domestic Products in Sri Lanka and makes a contribution of 5.2% of the total exports revenue. It has been able to get an increased export revenue from the coconut based products in the first quarter of this year in contrast to the first quarter of the previous year. The Coconut Development Authority has planned to provide its services to the manufactures, cultivators and various government institutions and to various stakeholders duly and qualitatively for the coconut based production and the exportation and the entire coconut based process. This will enable the Coconut Development Authority to provide its services more effectively, accurately and without any delay and also the customers to obtain the required services easily through the internet. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to establish an Enterprise Resource Planning System for the Coconut Development Authority with an investment of Rs.40 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Task Force to monitor the management of the Regional Plantation Companies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The significance of establishing a Task Force for a period of three (03) years in order to submit the recommendations for the implementation of necessary practices to maintain the sustainability of the plantation sector has been identified. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to establish a Task Force comprising of ten (10) experts in the field of plantation for the implementation of this system for a period of three (03) years, aimed at enhancing the standard of plantation sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Active Liability Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The Active Liability Management Act, No.8 of 2018 was approved in Parliament in order to ensure that the financing needs for the re-payment of the public debts are obtained in a more prudent manner with a view to improving Public Debt Management. Accordingly, taking into consideration the Public Debt maturity structure during the period from 2020 to 2029, the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka has recommended to raise a sum not exceeding Rs.480 billion, in or outside Sri Lanka, for such purposes as specified in the provisions of the Active Liability Management Act, No.8 of 2018. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to move a resolution in Parliament to raise a sum not exceeding Rs.480 billion, in terms of the provisions of the Active Liability Management Act, No.8 of 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme has been introduced by the Government of Japan in the year 2010, in order to provide opportunities to the executive level public sector officials of Sri Lanka to undergo Master Degree Programmes in the recognized universities in Japan. The first, second and the third frameworks of this programme were implemented in the years 2010-2013, 2014-2017 and 2018-2021 respectively and the selection process of the second batch of the third framework of the said programme has already been completed. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to enter into an agreement with the Japan International Cooperation Agency to obtain a credit facility of Japanese Yen 263 million to provide facilities for the said batch, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, No.38 of 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The companies listed in the Colombo Stock Exchange with 50% or more foreign shareholding were prohibited to purchase lands in Sri Lanka by the Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, No.38 of 2014 and the prohibition such imposed was removed by the amendment carried out to the said Act in 2018. However, although provisions have been set apart for the land transactions done after 2018‑04-01, no such provisions have been provided for the acquisitions carried out prior to that date. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to draft a Bill for removing the prohibition imposed under Act, No.38 of 2014, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prohibition of the import of Mechanical Chain Saws with a view to preventing deforestation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - By now, the forest cover in the Island is 29.7% of the total landmass and action is already being taken to implement various programmes with a view to increasing the said area up to 32% by the year 2030. Unauthorized felling of trees has been identified as the major cause for deforestation and as has been observed it is the use of the mechanical chain saws which could be carried easily which help largely for deforestation. As such, since more than 82,000 mechanical chain saws have been registered at present, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to take appropriate measures under the Imports and Exports Control Act, No.1 of 1969 to prohibit the importation of mechanical chain saws, with a view to preventing deforestation and increasing the forest cover, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Utilization of the lands, belonging to the Government Institutions, which cannot be used for a productive economic activity, in the expeditious programme of the Department of Forest Conservation for increasing the forest cover
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The forest cover in Sri Lanka is around 29.7% of the total landmass and the Government has aimed at increasing the percentage up to 32% by the year 2030. For this purpose, the Department of Forest Conservation has planned to further extend the forest cover in about 148,000 hectares of land. Since the lands belonging to the Department of Forest Conservation alone are insufficient, the focus of attention has been drawn to make use of other Government and private lands for this programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to take over all the lands of the Land Reform Commission on which there are no economic plantation at present and exceeding 65% of the forest cover and the lands identified according to the progress of the forest expansion programme already initiated by the Department of Forest Conservation with the lands belonging to the Sri Lanka Cashew Corporation, to be used in the expeditious programme to increase the forest cover implemented by the Department of Forest Conservation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making regulations to the Employees Provident Fund enabling the 	members of the Employees Provident Fund to obtain their benefits with 	ease and without delay
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-18
decision_details_body: - The Employees' Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958 was enacted with a view to providing retirement benefits to the employees in the private as well as the semi‑government sector. Although the employer is bound to furnish the information of an employee recruited, to the Department of Labour, in terms of the said Act, no provision has been made in the Act as to the specific time period during which such information is to be furnished. As such, it has been observed that a considerable number of employees are	subject to various types of inconveniences. Taking these matters into consideration, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala	Sirisena, at the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to make regulations under the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958, so as to require the employer to furnish the worker information 	to the Department of Labour within a specific time period given from the date of recruitment of a worker and in the event that the employer fails to furnish such information, to enable the worker himself to provide the information required directly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of compensation to the persons affected by the reason terror attacks and renovation of churches damaged as a result
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to pay Rs.10 lacks for a deceased person and a person who had become totally disabled, and compensation up to a sum of Rs.5 lacks for those who had sustained injuries and to pay compensation in respect of properties damaged up to a sum of Rs.5 million and to renovate the Churches damaged expeditiously. Accordingly, the Office for Reparation has by now paid a compensation of a sum exceeding Rs.198 million for the persons affected and has provided Rs.25 million as an advance for the renovation of sacred places. Similarly, action has been taken to transfer a portion of land in extent of 09 perches belonging to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority, in order to ensure the security of St. Anthony's Church in Kochchikade. However, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs, to appoint a Committee comprising of the officers of the relevant institutions, to build a fund amounting to Rs.500 million with donations from the Public and the Private sector to provide further relief to persons who have become disabled and for children affected due to the attacks and to provide relief having identified the special needs of those affected, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure to enabling to Institute Legal Action for Hate Speech
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - The Sectoral Committee on National Security has requested the Ministry of Justice & Prison Reforms to take action to bring an amendment to the Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, enabling to institute legal action against a person who makes a hate speech in a manner causing disruption to the reconciliation among various ethnic and religious communities and the national security.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management, in his capacity as the Acting Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to amend the Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure to make enable to impose on a person convicted of such offence a fine or a term of imprisonment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure enabling to  Institute Legal Action for disseminating Fake News
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - The Sectoral Committee on National Security has requested the Ministry of Justice & Prison Reforms to take action to bring an amendment to the Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, enabling to institute legal action for  dissemination of fake news in a manner causing disruption to the reconciliation among communities and the national security.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management, in his capacity as the Acting Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to amend the Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure to make enable to impose on a person convicted of such offence a fine up to Rs.01 million or to a term of imprisonment not exceeding 05 years or both, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and Denmark at Government level in respect of taxation on revenue
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - With the expectation of improving the economic relations between the two countries, Sri Lanka and Denmark has entered into an agreement at official level for avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion pertaining to economic activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to sign the agreement so entered into at Government level and present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Railway Level Crossing Protection Systems
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to award the contract to M/s Kernex Micro Systems (India) Ltd. of India for the Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning and Maintenance of 200 Bell & Light Level Crossing Protection Systems to the Sri Lanka Railways, for a sum of US$ 8.18 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee to provide a better service by improving the railway transport services of the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The construction of additional lanes at entry and exit ramps for the south bound traffic at the Ja-Ela interchange on the Colombo - Katunayake Expressway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - There are two lanes at each of the entry and exit ramps for traffic in the Ja-Ela interchange in the Colombo - Katunayake Expressway. One of the lanes is installed with a manual toll collection counter while the other is installed with an electronic toll collection counter. Presently, as a result of Ja-Ela and the area associated with it getting densely populated rapidly, the number of vehicles using the Ja-Ela interchange has increased in an unexpected manner during the busy hours of the day with a heavy traffic congestion of vehicles. Taking these matters into consideration, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to construct an additional lane each at the entry and exit ramp of the Ja-Ela interchange. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to award the contract for the construction of additional lanes at the entry and exist for precipitous roads with the manual toll collection counter facilities, to M/s RR Construction (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.285.4 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Full Cream Milk Power to Manufacture Thriposha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the procurement for the purchase of 600 MT of full cream milk power to Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited for producing Thriposha which is a nutritious food supplement provided to the pregnant mothers with nutrition problems and lactating mothers and also to the children with malnutrition, to Milco (Private) Limited,  as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of an IT system for the foreign reserves management in the Central Bank of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - The license of the existing Treasury Management System used for the management of foreign reserves by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka is due to expire by the year 2021. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to commence the process of procuring to purchase a new foreign reserve management system, to replace the existing IT system, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Laggala - Ilukkumbura  Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - A part of the existing road from Laggala to Ilukkumbura is to be inundated during the construction of the Kaluganga reservoir under the Moragahakanda Kaluganga development projects. Therefore, instead of the said road an alternative road section has to be constructed  at a higher level. Accordingly the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to award the contract for the development of  a road section of 5.48 km on Laggala - Ilukkumbura road for the said purpose to Sri Ram Construction Company for a sum of Rs.457 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving the infrastructure facilities of the plantation schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - The educational requirements of more than 200,000 students living associated with plantations in the Central, Uva, Sabaragamuwa, Western, Wayamba and Southern  Provinces are fulfilled by the plantation schools. Nevertheless, the provision of a qualitative education to the students has become a problem as a result of the lack of adequate basic facilities in those schools. With a view to uplifting the standard of education of the children of the plantation workers to a high level, it has been planned to develop the schools associated with plantations and identified as having inadequate facilities by renovating the school buildings and providing them with the class room facilities, sanitary facilities, drinking water facilities and the supply of school instruments under an investment of Rs 300,000 million granted by the Government of India. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.	Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of India for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Uplifting the living standards of the estate workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - Although projects for providing housing and other facilities have been implemented to upgrade the living standards of the plantation community, it is observed that due to their unnecessary mode of expenditure and weaknesses found in attitudes, the benefits targeted to be achieved by the implementation of  such projects could not be realized as anticipated. As such, launching of an awareness programme has been planned to enhance the living standards of the plantation families, by which it could bring about an impact on the quality and the quantity of green leaves, also with the expectation of minimizing the consumption of alcohol in the plantation sector. Further, attention has also been focused to educate them about the productive management of their earnings as well in order to uplift their living standards. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to implement the said programme as a pilot project in collaboration with the Ministry of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure & Community Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Inclusion of an implementation partner for the project to control Dengue
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - As a result of the weaknesses found in controlling dengue through the traditional methods, the need for the use of a more efficient and environmental friendly bio diversity control method  had been identified and the Cabinet had granted approval previously for the use of the Wolbachia bacteria as a long term methodology for the prevention of the transmission of the dengue virus to be implemented under the Australian aid. As such, a sum of AUD 1.2 million is due to be provided to the National Health Development Fund by the Monash University of Australia under the World Mosquito Programme and out of which a sum of 120,000 AUD has already been provided. Accordingly, in order to expedite the implementation of this programme, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to enter into an Agreement to add the Colombo University College Lanka to be an implementation partner for this project to assist in the National Dengue Control Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Existing Medical Ordinance No.26 of 1927
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - The Medical Ordinance lays down provisions to protect, the health of the public, to enhance the public confidence in the health sector professionals and to promote the professional standards of the health sector professionals. The Medical Ordinance which had been enacted in 1927 has been subject to several amendments and a proposal had been made to amend the Medical Ordinance No.26 of 1927 to suit the present trends to amend  the functions and the responsibilities of the Sri Lanka Medical Council and the Ceylon Medical College Council and also to maintain the disciplinary procedure of the medical professionals at a high level. In this respect, an Experts' Committee which comprises of expertise in the relevant field having identified the components which should be amended had submitted a concept paper in that regard. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to establish a Task Force to submit the required recommendations pertaining to the amendments of the Ordinance and to refer the recommendations of the Task Force to the Legal Draftsman to amend the said Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a plot of land for HIV Care Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - In order  to examine as to whether the persons who have had a relationship with HIV infected persons have been infected, they need to spend at least two days in a Drop-In-Centre where there are facilities available. The Positive Woman's Network, a non-governmental organization which is also a member of the Country Coordinating Mechanism of the Global Fund to fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Maleriya  has been involved with the said services for about a period of ten years. Presently, the institution delivers its services in a rented out house and it  has requested to provide a plot of land to continue its services.   Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to provide a ten perch plot of land for the said institution from the premises of the Mulleriyawa base hospital, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of the existing Analogue X-Ray Systems to Digital X-Ray Systems in the Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - The use of Digital X-Rays to identify the diseases at their initial stages has been recognized as the most productive technological methodology for a more successful diagnosis. As such, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to implement a project for upgrading of the existing Analogue X-Ray Systems to Digital X-Ray Systems at several selected hospitals. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to obtain a comprehensive project proposal from M/s AGFA NV. of Belgium to evaluate the same and to secure the financial facilities required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Phase I of the Climate Resilience Multi-Phase Programmatic Approach
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement a Multi- Phase project on Climate Resilience covering the rivers of Mahaweli, Kelani, Malwathu, Ging, Nilwala, Aththanagalu, Mundeni Aru and the river basins of Kala oya, Deduru Oya, Maha Oya and Gal Oya under three phases during a period of 8-10 years in order  to mitigate the risks caused by adverse weather conditions. It has been planned to carry out the Flood Early Warning and Upper Kelani Flood Mitigation project, which is the first phase of this project, at an investment of US$ 310 million. Through this, it is expected to improve the capacity of weather and climate forecasting and early warning on disaster and to take action to reduce flood risks between Hanwella and Kaduwela in the lower Kelani basin. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to conduct loan negotiations for the purpose and to enter into a Financing Agreement with the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development which has extended its willingness to provide credit facilities required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of the Ma Oya Environmental Sensitive Reserve to solve the  environmental issues in the Dankotuwa area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-04
decision_details_body: - A large number of environmental issues have been arisen in Dankotuwa area due to weather and climatic changes as well as improper clay mining in that area. As a remedial measure, it has been proposed to declare a strip of sufficient width on either side of Ma Oya Catchment area as an Environmental Sensitive Reserve. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to declare the part belonging to the North Western Province in the  Reserve under the Environment Statute No.12 of 1990 and the part belonging to the Western Province under the National Environment  (Amendment) Act, No.47 of 1980 as the Ma Oya Environmental Sensitive Reserve, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of 'Gama Rakuma' organizations at the Grama Niladhari Division level to assist in the maintenance of national security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - The contribution of the security forces as well as every citizen is essential to restore normalcy in the lives of the General Public and their economic situation and assure safety in their minds adversely affected as a result of the terrorist attacks which occurred in the Easter Sunday.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to establish a voluntary peoples' organization known as 'Gama Rakuma' covering every Grama Niladhari Division of the Island which could assist the authorities in fulfilling the  multi-faceted security requirements of the people and to provide the necessary facilities for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowering  Samurdhi Beneficiaries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - Approximately 1.4 million families at present receive benefits under the Samurdhi programme and the Government has planned to provide benefits for about further 600,000 families. As such, it has been proposed to empower 500,000 families and implement 50,000 manufacturing projects within the next three years. Further, 5000 export villages are to be established in the areas where Samurdhi Beneficiaries live and through this action would be taken to increase the production of economic  and exports crops and launch small and medium scale industries. Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Primary Industries and Social Empowerment informed the Cabinet that action has also been taken to conduct awareness programmes countrywide to empower Samurdhi beneficiaries as a work force contributing to the economy and export earnings and to rid them of the dependency mentality.

description: Improvement of the Sanitary Facilities in the Bus Terminals and the Railway Stations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - By the Budget of 2019 it had been proposed to improve the basic sanitary facilities in the bus terminals and the railway stations inclusive of the infrastructure facilities since such adequate facilities are not available in such places. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to accelerate the implementation of the this project having identified the common places where the sanitary facilities should be improved with the coordination of the Ministry of Transport & Civil Aviation, the Ministry of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs and the Ministry of Finance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Accelerated Programme for the Development of Middle Income Housing and the Infrastructure facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - The accelerated Programme for the Development of Middle Income Housing and the Infrastructure facilities was launched as a priority programme of the Government with the objective of providing housing for Middle Income Wage Earners of both the public and private sectors. Under the programme, facilities had been provided for both the public and private sector employees to obtain a maximum credit facility of Rs.5 million under an interest rate of 7% for the purchase of a housing unit. However, according to the present economic trends,  taking into consideration, the requests made by the beneficiaries who hope to obtain loans under this credit scheme, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs and Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs to increase the credit facility given under this scheme up to Rs.10 million and to reduce the interest rate up to 6% and amend the selection criteria enabling the benefits to be provided for a larger group of persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expanding the financial facilities granted under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - Seventeen  interest subsidy loan schemes, 03 re-financing loan schemes and 02 non-financial programme are implemented for small and medium entrepreneurs, youth, female entrepreneurs, self employers,  graduates and migrant workers through the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka', a premier programme of the Government and under this programme, approximately Rs.81 billion has been granted as loans to its beneficiaries. Taking into consideration the requests made by different parties who contribute towards the national development, the loan schemes such as Ran Aswenna, Riya Shakthi, Home Sweet Home, Sihina Maliga, City Ride, Jaya Isuru, Mini Taxi/ Electric Three Wheeler, My Future have been  amended in order to expand the benefits and reliefs provided through the existing loan schemes operating under the budget 2019 and to minimize the technical issues encountered in implementing such loan schemes. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to implement such amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of International Sovereign Bonds  2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to secure funds up to US$ 1,500 million by the issuance of International Sovereign Bonds, initiating action within the approved borrowing limit for the year 2019, by also taking into consideration the international market conditions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining consultancy services for the construction of the new Courts 	Building in Walapane
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - The judicial services pertaining to the police stations of  Walapane, Theripeha, Ragala, Udupussellawa, Maturata, Mandaramnuwara and Hanguranketha are provided by the District/Magistrate's Courts in Walapane. However, severe inconvenience has to be faced due to the limited space available there in the building used for the purpose. As such, it has been planned to construct a new building for the District/Magistrate's Courts in Walapane in the Court premises  itself with an investment of Rs.212.3 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to award the consultancy services contract to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Trincomalee High Court Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - Due to the limited space available in the buildings of the High Court, Civil Appellate High Court, District Court, Magistrate's Court, Additional Magistrate's Court and the Labour Tribunal of Trincomalee housed in the Trincomalee Divisional Court Complex, the general public as well  as the staff face severe inconveniences. As such, with the expectation of providing adequate facilities for the judicial services, it has been planned to construct a new building with an investment of around Rs.250 million and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to award the consultancy services contract of same to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of 51.7 km of National Roads in the Galle District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - It has been planned for the rehabilitation and the improvement of  51.7 km of National Roads in the Galle District, under the Integrated Road Investment Programme implemented with the financial support of the Asian Development Bank, to develop the access roads to improve the connectivity of the rural areas with the major Socio Economic Centres of the Southern, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North Western, North Central provinces and the Kalutara District. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to award the contract for the improvement and the maintenance of the said roads to M/s K.D.A. Weerasinghe & Company (Pvt.) Ltd. in joint venture with the Yunnan Construction and Investment Holding Group Co. Ltd., China for a sum of Rs.6,108.2 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Contract for the piling works of the Maritime Facilitation Centre of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to award the contract for the piling works of the  Maritime Facilitation Centre of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority of the Port Access Elevated Highway Project funded by the Asian Development Bank, to M/S Access Engineering PLC, for a sum of Rs.624 million, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Power Plants of 1MW capacity for the Trincomalee and the Moneragala 02 Grid Substations under the 'Soorya Bala Sangramaya' Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - Seventeen suitable Grid Substations were identified for the construction of 90 small scale solar power plants to be connected to the National Power Grid under the 'Soorya Bala Sangramaya' Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award 03 projects out of the 07 solar power projects of 1MW capacity expected to be connected to the Trincomalee Grid Substation, to M/s Suncor Solar City (Pvt.) Ltd., and the balance 04 projects to M/s Capital City Holdings (Pvt.) Ltd. and 04 projects out of the 05 solar power projects of 1MW capacity to be connected to the Moneragala Grid Substation to M/S Gold Corporation Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd. and the balance project to M/s Nihon Green Power Company (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ensuring the uninterrupted operation of the Sapugaskanda Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-28
decision_details_body: - In order to ensure an uninterrupted operation of the Sapugaskanda Power Station with a capacity of 152MW, the engine types of No.05, 07, 08 and 10  used  for generating electricity are required to be overhauled for every 6,000 hour period of operation and the engine types of No.06, 09, 11 and 12 for every 12,000 hour period of operation. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to award the contract for the purchase of the spare parts required for the said overhaulings to M/s MAN Energy Solution SE, of Germany, the original manufacturer for a sum of Euro 1.1 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgical Consumables
