Ltd., for a sum of Rs.337.8 million and to award the contract for the construction of the South Center for Naval Studies and Shipping with equipment of the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Ruhuna to M/s Central Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.436.3 million, in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Temperature Controlled Warehouse complex in Dambulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to establish a six chamber 5,000 MT capacity Temperature Controlled Warehouse Complex in Dambulla where fresh agri produce could be stored. The Government of India will grant financial assistance amounting to Rs.300 million to cover the cost of the project. The contract for the constructions from the said finances has been awarded to the Joint Venture formed by M/s SAW Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. and LQ Import Export (Pvt.) Ltd. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, at the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Economic Reforms and Public Distribution, to get the balance work of the warehouse complex completed through the said contractor for a sum of Rs.225 million and also to secure the other facilities necessary in this respect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Computer facilities for schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - According to a budget proposal it has been proposed to implement a project for the provision of computer facilities in schools with a view to developing the learning and teaching process in the school educational system. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to secure the funds required for the purchase of 160,000 laptop computers in order to fulfill the requirement of computers in schools with secondary grades, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a new Tri-lingual Mixed National School in the Mirigama Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish a new fully fledged National School in an extent of 20 acres of the land called Dansele Watta located in the Minuwangoda area with a view to providing qualitative educational opportunities for the children living in the areas adjustment to Gampaha which is developing rapidly. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to establish the proposed new school consisting of six parallel classes for each grade as a school where tri-lingual education could be had, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting of legislation to provide a definition for "child and youthful person"
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the various issues due to the varied definitions found in several Acts of Sri Lanka with regard to the definition of 'Child and Youthful person, the proposal made by Hon.(Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to amend the Children and Young Persons Ordinance to define a person less than 18 years of age as a child and to amend the Youthful Offenders (Training Schools) Ordinance to define a person between the ages of 18 and 22 as a youthful person, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting of the 'Chamber of Construction Industry of Sri Lanka Bill' in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The Chamber of Construction Industry of Sri Lanka has been established in the year 2001 and subsequently, it has been incorporated as a company limited by guarantee. Presently, 12 professional institutes and associations are institutional members of this Chamber and nearly 300 private companies join this Chamber directly. The Chamber of Construction Industry of Sri Lanka (Incorporation) Bill has been presented to Parliament as a Private Members Bill and accordingly the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to present the same subsequently taking into consideration the relevant stakeholders associated with the industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a National Building Code
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - In recent times, there has been an increasing trend in Sri Lanka for incidents of building collapses, fire and damages of buildings as a result of natural disasters.  It has been found that most of these incidents have been the result of adoption of non-engineering practices and deploying of non-competent persons in the constructions. Further, attention has also been focused on the non-availability of a proper regulatory system in Sri Lanka to identify the unsafe buildings and to evaluate the conditions of such buildings. As such, the Government has recognized the necessity of preparing a series of regulation of design manuals, construction, deviation and maintenance activities in the form of a National Building Code. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs and Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management, to prepare a National Building Code for the Building Construction Sector of Sri Lanka with the participation of relevant stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of muti-storey houses in the developed area adjoining the Beira Lake (TRCSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to convert the area adjoining the Beira Lake into a commercial city and to generate job opportunities in the area and develop  the houses, vehicle parks and shopping complexes in a proper way so as to attract the tourists. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs to acquire the lands required to carry out a project for the construction of a muti‑storey housing project within the land in extent of 83 perches identified near the Beira Lake from the National Housing Development Authority, as its first phase, and to secure the other facilities necessary, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Climate Resilience Improvement Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement a project called Sri Lanka Climate Resilience Multi-Phased Programme under the assistance of the World Bank, in order to mitigate the risks from extreme weather conditions. As such, the joint proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management, to implement the proposed project through the Department of Irrigation at an estimated cost of US $ 790 million, within a period of 8-10 years under 03 stages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the total cost estimate of the Thalpitigala Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to construct the Thalpitigala Reservoir Project by the China Sino Hydro Corporation Ltd., under the funds of the China EXIM Bank, at a total estimated cost of US$ 174 million. It has been assessed that a further sum of Rs.7,227 million has to be set apart as estimated earlier for the project for the relevant expenditure on taxes, environmental development, land acquisition, payment of compensation, resettlement and for the provision of infrastructure facilities.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to amend the total cost estimate with the inclusion of the said additional sum as well, as US$ 174 million and the local estimate as Rs.7,227 million and to set apart additional financial provision from the General Treasury within the period of 2019 to 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka and the Michigan State University of the United State of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign an MOU between the Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka and the Michigan State University of the United State of America with a view to studying the social and economic conditions of the labourers in the tea sector in various angles, averting the labour shortage and implementing projects for enhancing the labour efficiency. This will provide the necessary facilities to facilitate and enhance the teaching, research and extension  activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to enter into the said MOU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Lender Direct Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka (GOSL), CHEC Port City Colombo (Private) Limited and the China Development Bank in respect of the Colombo Port City Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - A tripartite Lender Direct Agreement has been signed between the Government of Sri Lanka (GOSL), CHEC Port City Colombo (Private) Limited and the China Development Bank in respect of the Colombo Port City Development Project. In accordance with the provisions of the said agreement, the Government of Sri Lanka should provide the necessary assistance for the CHEC Port City Colombo (Private) Limited to enter into an agreement with  the debtors. The CHEC Port City Colombo (Private) Limited has planned to obtain a long term loan facility from the China Development Bank for the development activities of the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by              Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to sign the loan agreement to be entered into with the said Bank,  the Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development and the Project Company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Maintaining the Colombo Port City Land as a special zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The Port City has been created by the reclamation of land using sea sand with the objective of attracting foreign investment of a high value for the purpose of  escalating the development of the national economy. Under this, a land extent of 269 hectares will be added to the land area of Sri Lanka and a sea coast of 2 km in length within an extent of 91 hectares consisting of roads and common vicinities, a central park, a sea belt suitable for swimming and water sports at any time of the year and a water way 70 m wide running across the town will be established within an extent of 91 hectares consisting of roads and common vicinities. This area will also consist of a holiday harbour with facilities for hotels and recreations, a recreation park, a conference hall for international educational and international health services. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to establish a Property Management Company with the necessary authority for the management of this area inclusive of the implementation of the other activities and to publish the Colombo Port City as a state land situated in the Colombo District of the Western Province, in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restructuring the Measurement Units, Standards and Services Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the administration activities, scheme of recruitment, procurement process and the duties related to weight and measures of the Measurement Units, Standard and Services Department which carries out duties under the subject areas of Scientific, Industrial and Legal measurement have to be restructured in order to render its services more effectively and efficiently. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co‑operative Development and Vocational Training & Skills Development to appoint an Experts' Committee to make a study in that regard and submit the necessary recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the District General Hospital in Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The need has been identified for the expeditious refurbishment of most of the buildings in the District General Hospital in Kalutara which are nearly 50 years old, which provides patient care services to a large number of patients in the adjacent districts of Ratnapura and Galle as well.  As such, it has been planned to develop the General Hospital in the Kalutara District with the construction of a building for Common Amenities, a building for the Out-Patient Department, a building complex for Diagnostic activities, a Laundry, a building complex for Surgical Wards and Quarters for the staff with a view to providing a better quality patient care service. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to implement the proposed development programmes with an investment of Rs.6,221 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Multi sectoral Action Plan on the Prevention of Non Communicable Diseases  2016  2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that 70% itself of the diseases which affect the people of Sri Lanka are non-communicable diseases such as Heart attacks, Diabetics, High Blood Pressure, Strokes and Cancers and the development of this trend has also been shown in the surveys conducted recently. In order to control this situation to the minimum, an Action Plan has been prepared with the participation of all the relevant stakeholders to be implemented during the period of 2016 - 2020. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to implement an awareness programme for the general public using the financial  provision set apart for the purpose for the year 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of facilities for the implementation of the Heda Oya Multi Purpose Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement the Heda Oya Multi-Purpose Project for providing drinking water to the Divisional Secretary Divisions of Siyambalanduwa, Madulla, Lahugala and Pothuvil and to control the floods in those areas. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education and Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to establish a Task Force comprising of the relevant stakeholders and the representatives of the relevant institutions to avoid the practical difficulties which could occur when the proposed multi‑sectoral project is implemented and to focus attention on the needs of the affected residents and also the establishment of a Sub‑Committee comprising of the relevant Ministers to overcome the issues that will crop up when implementing the said proposal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of additional financial provisions for the Janatha Estate Development Board and the Sri Lanka State Plantations Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The restructuring activities of the Janatha Estate Development Board and the Sri Lanka State Plantations Corporation which have reported a poor performance for several years, are now being carried out and the payment of salaries of the employees of these institutions have been a financial burden for the Government presently. As it will take a further considerable period of time to generate income to conduct these institutions independently after restructuring them, the proposal made by Hon.	Lakshman Kiriella, Minister of  Public Enterprise, Kandyan Heritage and Kandy Development, to provide a financial provision of Rs.113 million for the Janatha Estate Development Board and Rs.78 million for the Sri Lanka State Plantations Corporation for the payment of salaries and allowances of the employees of these institutions from April to June 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Settlement of Outstanding Liabilities for the Year 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The settlement of the payments to be made for the development activities implemented by the Government in the year 2018, within the said financial year itself was delayed due to the deficit in the Government revenue which did not reach its expected growth. Accordingly, the proposal made by                         Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to secure additional funds for the settlement of the relevant outstanding liabilities in respect of the said development programmes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of funds amounting to Rs.5,000 million for the construction of the 17 Storey Building for the Faculty of Medicine of the University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to award the contract for the construction of the 17 Storey Building for the Faculty of Medicine of the University of Colombo and to provide a funding facility amounting to Rs.5,000 million to the contractor. Accordingly, an Agreement has been reached to provide a fund amounting to Rs.5,000 million through the Bank of Ceylon for the necessary constructions in this regard. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to make the facilities necessary for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of the Administration activities of the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No.13 of 1989 with the Director General of Sri Lanka Customs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The administration activities have been vested with the Director General of Excise in terms of the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No.13 of 1989 and amendments related thereto. Although, the Cabinet had granted approval previously to appoint the Director General of Sri Lanka Customs as the Director General of Excise (Special Provisions) to carry out the provision of the Excise Act and to amend the relevant Acts accordingly, no such amendments to the Act, have been made. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to amend the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, enabling the Director General of Sri Lanka Customs to levy, collect, recover the arrears and refund duties on excisable articles in order to overcome the issues faced when this Act comes into operation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the Anandakuti Maha Viharaya and Ratho Machchnidranath Hindu Kovil in Nepal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to renovate the Anandakuti Maha Viharaya in Swayamboonath and Ratho Machchnidranath Hindu Kovil in Lalitppor in Nepal which were damaged due to the earth quake that took place in Nepal by the Government of Sri Lanka.  As of now, a sum of Rs.293.5 million has been incurred for the renovation activities and a physical progress of about 84% and 43% respectively in the construction work of the Anandakuti Maha Viharaya and the Ratho Machchnidranath Hindu Kovil have been achieved. Accordingly, considering the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana & Wayamba Development, to secure the additional provision required further, for the completion of the project, the Cabinet has granted approval to provide an additional allocation of Rs. 114 million for the purpose.

description: Submission of Recommendations for the Waste Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - Mismanagement of garbage has badly affected the General Public and has become a cause for the destruction of nature. Further, objections have also been leveled against the projects designed to be implemented by the Government on proper disposal of garbage. As such, the Cabinet has decided to appoint a committee comprising of the Ministers of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government; Megapolis & Western Development and the Non-Cabinet Minister of Economic Reforms and Public Distribution to submit recommendations on the measures to be taken on the proper management of garbage, which has become a national issue, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Uninterrupted Power Supply
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to appoint a committee under the chairmanship of Hon. Prime Minister and comprising of the Ministers of Finance; Power, Energy and Business Development; Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development; and Ports & Shipping and Southern Development to submit recommendations on the short term, medium term and long term measures that should be taken to solve the present power crisis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Fixing LED street lights for street lightening
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - A proposal for the implementation of a project for the replacement of conventional street lights with Smart controlled LED street lights had been earlier presented by the Korean Telecom Cooperation. An Officials' Committee had been appointed by the Cabinet to examine the said proposal and submit its recommendations for the same. Taking into consideration the matters submitted by the Officials' Committee pertaining to the benefits that could be accrued by the proposed project such as enabling to install a CCTV system to regulate the security and waste management in main cities including Colombo and providing WIFI facilities that could be used by the public, the proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to implement the project for the replacement of conventional street lights with Smart controlled LED street lights by awarding the same to the Korean Telecom Cooperation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 100 MW additional power capacity for a period of 06 months to ensure the uninterrupted power supply in the Country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to procure 100 MW of additional power capacity to ensure the uninterrupted power supply in the country. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contracts for the procurement of 24 MW power capacity for the Pallekele Grid Sub-station and 10 MW power capacity for the Galle Grid Sub-station to Aggreko International Project Ltd of the United Kingdom at a sum of Rs.30.20 per each 1 MW, 10 MW power capacity for the Mahiyanganaya Grid Sub-station and 8 MW power capacity for the Polonnaruwa Grid Sub-station at a sum of Rs.30.58 and Rs.30.63 respectively, per each 1 MW to Altaaqa Alternative Solution Global FZE of the United Arab Emirates and 24 MW power capacity for the Hambantota Grid Sub-station and 24 MW power capacity for the Horana Grid Sub-station at a sum of Rs.28.43 and Rs.28.70 respectively, per each 1 MW to V Power Holdings Limited of Hong Kong for a period of 06 months, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conversion of the Colombo Stock Exchange into a Company limited by shares
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - Attention has been focused to convert the Colombo Stock Exchange, functioning as a “not for profit” member driven organization into a “for profit” organization which is controlled by the shareholders. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to amend the drafted bill for converting the Colombo Stock Exchange which is functioning as a company limited by guarantee, into a company limited by shares by incorporating the ratio of distributing the shares found to be further amended and changing its legal background was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 33kV Distribution Lines and Gantries under Tranch 2 of the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank under Tranch 2 of the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Project has granted a credit facility of US$ 150 million and Euro 30 million for strengthening the transmission and distribution network of the Ceylon Electricity Board. It has been designed to implement the projects under 06 packages and one consultancy services contract using this credit facility and the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the construction of distribution lines of 33kv and Gantries under its package 4, to M/s Ceylex Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd, at a sum of Rs.2,708 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 33kV Distribution Tower Lines and Gantries under the Supporting Electricity Supply Reliability Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - A loan amounting to US$ million 115 has been granted by the Asian Development Bank to strengthen the transmission and distribution network of the Ceylon Electricity Board, under the Supporting Electricity Supply Reliability Improvement Project. Through this, the projects are being implemented under 9 packages by this Project and accordingly the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to award the contract for the construction of 33kV Tower Lines and Gantries under package 4 to Qingdao Huijintong Power Equipment Co. Ltd. at a sum of Rs.6,781.5 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Surgical Non-consumables used in the surgical treatments
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the contract for purchasing 07 types of items used as Surgical Non-consumables in the surgical treatments to M/s CIC Holdings PLC at a sum of Rs.428.8 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of 400,000 single dose vials of Quadrivalent Human Papilloma Virus Recombinant Vaccine for the prevention of Cervical Cancer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - Cervical cancer has been identified as the the second commonest cancer among women in Sri Lanka. Human Papilloma Virus vaccine has been introduced into the National Immunization Programme to prevent Cervical cancer in future. As such, 	the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the procurement of 400,000 single dose vials of Quadrivalent Human Papilloma Virus Recombinant Vaccine required for that purpose to UNICEF, at a sum of US$ 1.98 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Specialized Maternity Center at the De Zoysa Hospital for Women
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - Pregnant mothers who suffer complications such as heart deceases, diabetic and high blood pressure, visit the De Zoysa Hospital which provides service to the pregnant mothers who come from various parts of the Island for delivery and other treatments. It has been proposed to construct a Specialized Maternity Center in this Hospital in view of providing the said mothers with more qualitative health care facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the contract for the said constructions to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau/Engineering Service (Pvt) Ltd at a sum of Rs. 249.8 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Sports Act, No.25 of 1973
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - The Sports Act, No.25 of 1973, which provides guidance towards the improvements of the sports field, has been amended in the years of 1993, 1998 and 2005, on timely requirements. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports to draft necessary legislation to update the Sports Act, No.25 of 1973, incorporating factors such as granting approval for the accredited Institutes of Charted Auditors recommended by the Auditor General to audit the Annual Reports of National Associations, defining comprehensively the matters which the Minister can make orders under the Sports Act, increasing the fines levied under the Sports Act, making necessary provisions to include at least 02 persons who have earned fame in Track and Field events at International Events and of those who have represented the country in the Olympics or similar games, to the National Sports Council and strengthening the power to take legal action against the offenders under the Sports Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of countermeasures on high risk land slide prone roads
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to construct the countermeasures on 10th km of the Ambepussa- Kurunagala - Trincomalee Road, 27th km of the Wellawaya- Ella - Kumbalwela Road, and 6th, 22nd and 33rd kms of the Beragala - Hali Ela Road identified as the high risk land slide prone locations, utilizing a remaining sum of Yen 2,000 million from Yen 7,619 million allocated for the Landslide Disaster Protection Project of the National Road Network after completion of the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of required medical equipment for selected hospitals under the Korean Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF) Loan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that most of the medical equipment installed in certain hospitals are more than 10 years old, obsolete and in their End of Life (EOL) state. Further, it has been also observed that in some hospitals there is an acute shortage of very essential additional medical equipment required for their day today functioning. Representatives of the Korea Foundation for International Health-care have conducted a feasibility study for a project of supplying new medical equipment and the Korean Economic Development Cooperation Fund has extended its willingness to provide funds under a concessionary loan scheme for a project to replace the existing obsolete and End of Life medical equipment in selected 17 hospitals with the new medical equipments. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to implement the said project at a sum of US $ 80 million granted by the EDCF, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repealing the Revival of Underperforming Enterprises or Underutilized Assets Act, No.43 of 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - The Revival of Underperforming Enterprises or Underutilized Assets Act, No.43 of 2011 has been enacted to vest the Underperforming Enterprises or Underutilized Assets with the Government and making provisions for their proper management, administration or revival and for the payment of relevant compensation. However, since the said Act creates a sense of uncertainty in the minds of the investors and affects adversely on the country's ease of doing business, a proposal has been made to repeal the said Act by the Budget speech 2018. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Public Enterprise, Kandyan Heritage and Kandy Development, to present the draft Bill prepared to repeal the said Act, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments proposed to the Securities Exchange Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - A new draft bill has been presented in Parliament to update the existing Securities Exchange Bill. Accordingly, 	the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to amend the Securities Exchange Bill incorporating amendments with regard to correcting errata needed for effective capital market regulation and to increase the accountability of the Securities and Exchange Commission whilst retaining its enhanced independence, into existing draft bill taking into consideration the further views expressed by those who are interested in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Lady Lochore Loan Fund Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - The Lady Lochore Fund which provides loan facilities for the Government Employees on a concessionary interest rate was initiated in the year 1927 and provides Rs.400 million annually as loans under concessionary interest rates at present. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to amend the relevant sections of the Lady Lochore Loan Fund Act No 38 of 1951 so as to further raise the said fund by enabling to carry out the audit functions under the supervision of the Auditor General, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Integrated Tourism Digital Platform (ITDP) to improve the Sri Lanka Tourism Industry and the Global Security Image
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Tourism Strategic Plan 2017-2020 has been implemented with the objective of achieving the objectives of increasing the current income rate of US $ 3.5 billion received from the Tourism Industry up to US $ 7.0 billion, increasing local job opportunities in the field of tourism up to 600,000 and increasing the daily spending of tourists up to US $ 210 by the year 2020. As such, it has been planned to introduce the Integrated Tourism Digital Platform (ITDP) as a technological platform of national level to improve the traveler experience of Sri Lankan travelers, tourism industry and the Global Security Image. This solution consists of three major components namely, Integrated Tourism & Travel Analytics, Integrated Global Airlines Information Consolidation & Traveler's Security Screening and Integrated Tourist Insurance & Safety Assurance. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, to implement the said Integrated Tourism Digital Platform, under Public-Private Partnership (PPP) basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting compensation for the houses in Kolonnawa area damaged due to the floods in the year 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - Several areas in Kolonnawa Divisional Secretariat Division were affected by floods due to the heavy rainfall in the year 2016 which caused over flowing of the Kelani River and the issues related to the systematic water flows. National Insurance Trust Fund had paid compensations to the houses and properties damaged thereby. Further, compensations have to be made for some more housing units affected by floods which had not been covered by the said compensations. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management to pay compensation for 1070 housing units for which Assessment Reports had been submitted for the damages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Programme on Environmental Conservation - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-09
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously to implement the 'Punarudhaya' three years 2015 - 2018, National Programme on Environmental Conservation under the leadership of Presidential Secretariat. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, to implement the proposed National Programme on Environmental Conservation with a view to creating a sustainable society in Sri Lanka by continuing the scheduled programmes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding of the Enterprise Sri Lanka' Exhibition in Anuradhapura and Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The Enterprise Sri Lanka Programme is implemented with the objective of creating 100,000 new entrepreneurs Island wide and thereby enhancing the national production and export promotion. The first exhibition of this programme was held successfully in the Monaragala area and its second exhibition is expected to be held in Anuradhapura and the third in Jaffna, under 'Government 2025 Vision', respectively in the months of May and July of this year. Accordingly, 	the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to hold these exhibitions with the private sector sponsorship and financial assistance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Indian Ocean: Defining Our Future' Ministerial Conference, 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - 	It has been found that the Indian Ocean has the potential to become the growth  pole of the global economy in the future. Accordingly, a conference was held in Melbourne, Australia under the theme 'Maritime Order in the Indian Ocean' for the benefit of the Ocean Littoral States and the major maritime users to strengthen the freedom of navigating in the Indian Ocean and a conference of the senior representatives from 40 Indian Ocean Littoral States and the Indian Ocean Coastal Belt States was held in Colombo under the theme 'The Indian Ocean: Defining Our Future'. As has been proposed in the conference held in Colombo, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and the Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to hold the conference of the Senior Representatives at the end of 2019 under the theme 'The Indian Ocean: Defining Our Future' in Colombo in collaboration with the Global Maritime Crime Programme of the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of the Railway Track from Maho to Omanthi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously to rehabilitate the railway track from Maho to Omanthe at a length of 128 km with the assistance of the Indian Line of Credit so as to bear higher axle loads and to operate in maximum speed of 100km/hr, in view of safe, efficient and comfortable transportation of passenger and goods to the Northern Province. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to award the contract for the construction of the said railway track, to M/s Ircon International Ltd. for a sum of US$ 91.3 million as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Redesigning of the Deegavapi Stupa in Ampara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to purchase specified bricks required for redesigning of the Deegavapi Stupa in Ampara constructed by the King Saddhatissa and which has been declared as an Archaeological protected Monument since 1947 and to obtain the labour contribution of the Sri Lanka Army for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining International Consultancy Services for the Mundeni Aru River Basin Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The Mundeni Aru River Basin Development Project which is to be carried out with an investment of around Rs.35,500 million, has been planned for implementation aimed at providing irrigation facilities for lands in extent of 13,200 hectares in the Districts of Ampara and Batticaloa in the Eastern Province, supplying drinking water, mitigation of flood risks etc. and the Cabinet has granted its approval previously for the implementation of same. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to call for proposals from both the local and foreign consultancy agencies to select a consultant with experience and expertise for the implementation of this project and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee for the evaluation of the proposals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The development of the land required for the proposed project for providing houses to the low income earners to be constructed in Paliyagoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct 40,000 housing units with an investment of Rs.190 billion under the Urban Regeneration Programme implemented with the objective of providing houses to the underserved community living in Colombo. As at now, 16 projects have been completed under Phase-I of the programme and 8,380 families have been settled in the new apartments. Under Phase II of the programme it has been planned to complete 7,400 housing units under 12 projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to get the construction of the Gabion Wall, cleaning of the stream and carrying out the development activities done by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation Corporation which has shown competency in such work, at a cost of Rs.217.34 million in order to develop the land used for the construction of 600 houses in the Paliyagoda area in a more appropriate manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Hotel with 48 Rooms for Waters Edge Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to award the contract for the construction of a small urban luxury hotel with 48 rooms within the premises in which Waters Edge Hotel - Battaramulla is located to M/s Sathuta Builders (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the building complex for the Faculty of Health - Care Sciences of the Eastern University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct the Faculty of Health - Care Sciences of the Eastern University of Sri Lanka, on a plot of land of 50 acres at Pilleyaradi in Batticaloa, with an investment of Rs.7,978 million with the financial assistance of the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to award the contract for the construction of the building complex to M/s International Construction Consortium (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.2,887.95 million (without VAT), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of four storey building for the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies of the University of Kelaniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct a four storey building for the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies which was commenced in the year 1975 affiliated to the University of Kelaniya, for the purpose of providing sufficient space. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to award the construction activities of its first Stage to M/s Sathuta Builders (Pvt.) Ltd, for a sum of Rs.393 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply and Installation of the Mechanical Ventilation and Air Conditioning System for Bloc 08 of Defence Headquarters Complex (DHQC) Project at Akuregoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to award the contract for the supply and installation of Mechanical Ventilation and Air Conditioning System for Block 08 of DHQC Project at Akuregoda to M/s Frigi Engineering Services (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Merchant Shipping Act, No.52 of 1971 in accordance with the Conventions of the International Maritime Organization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The member states of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) should act in accordance with the very important mandatory conventions imposed by the said organization. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, the Minister of Ports & Shipping and Southern Development to publish the draft Bill prepared to amend the Merchant Shipping Act, No.52 of 1971 which regulates the shipping activities of Sri Lanka and all the activities related thereto, in order to enact legislation to carry out the conventions of the IMO successfully and subsequently, to present the same in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restructuring of the Village Housing Committees
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously to establish District, Divisional and Village Housing Committees for the systematic implementation of “Samata Sewana” National Housing Programme Island wide. Accordingly, Village Housing Committees have been established in 11,192 Grama Niladhari Divisions by now. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs to establish the said Village Housing Committees at sub village level going beyond the Grama Niladhari Division Level and to establish the same in every sub village in the Island designating them as Community Settlement Committees with a view to achieving the expected goals of this project in a productive manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the South Asian Association of Regional Corporation (SAARC) Handicrafts Development Centre in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish Handicraft Villages in every member country of the SAARC Chamber of Commerce and Industry with the assistance of the SAARC Development Fund. Accordingly, it is expected to provide assistance in uplifting the well being of the low income artisans of the SAARC Region. It has been proposed to develop the Polgolla Handicraft Development Centre belonging to the National Crafts Council as the SAARC Handicraft Development Centre, for the implementation of this programme in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co-operative Development and Vocational Training & Skills Development, to establish the SAARC Handicraft Development Centre with the assistance of the SAARC Development Fund, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Approval for the Amendment Bill to increase the authorized share capital of the People's Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend several sections of the People's Bank Act No.29 of 1961 with a view to authorizing the People's Bank to issue debentures to meet its Tier II Regulatory Capital purposes, without the Government guarantee and increasing the share capital of                  Rs.01 billion which is the current approved share capital of the People's Bank up to Rs.50 billion. The amended bill drafted accordingly, has been published in the Government Gazette and the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to present the said bill in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to Regulations issued under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The Regulation of the Insurance Industry Act, No.43 of 2000 was introduced to develop, supervise and regulate the Insurance Industry in Sri Lanka, with the objective of safeguarding the interest of the policy holders by establishing of the Insurance Board of Sri Lanka and ensuring the insurance business to be carried out in a professional and prudent manner. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to present the Gazette Extraordinary No.2104/9 dated 2018-12-31 published in the Government Gazette incorporating the provisions for the payment of annual charges to the Sri Lanka Insurance Regulatory Commission by an insurance holder, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resettlement of Internally Displaced families
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - Due to the conflict situation which existed in the Northern and Eastern areas, around 577 internally displaced families still live in 25 welfare camps. Out of these, 381 families have been identified as landless families. However, allocating state lands to resettle them has become a serious issue due to the scarcity of state lands in the Jaffna area As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs, to secure provisions for purchasing the lands from the private land owners based on the Chief Valuer's valuation in order to resettle these families was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enter into an Agreement with the Asia Pacific Network for Sustainable Forest Management and Rehabilitation (APFNet) for the Conversion of Pine Plantations of Sri Lanka into plantations with Indigenous Species
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to implement a project for the Conversion of Pine Plantations of Sri Lanka into Indigenous Species forests taking into consideration the contribution which could be had to increase the soil and water conservation of the catchment areas in the forest plantations, and to develop the biodiversity by implementing a project for the development of an under plantation through the cultivation of indigenous species associated with pine plantations. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the said institution, to implement this project within the forthcoming 3 year period under the grants of the Asia Pacific Network of Sustainable Forest Management and Rehabilitation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Relief to the householders adversely affected by the water leaks of the Main Tunnel of the Uma Oya Multi Purpose Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to extend the monthly rent being paid to these residents affected due to the Uma Oya Multi Purpose Development Project, until such time that alternative lands are provided to them. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to extend the period of payment of rentals to them for a further period of 03 months, until the preparation of the land identified in Bandarawela area for the resettlement of the displaced persons due to the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of the land where the Unawatuna Treatment and Rehabilitation Centre of the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board is located, to the said Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body: - The Rehabilitation Centre of the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board established in the Unawatuna area of the Galle District conducts special residential treatment and rehabilitation programmes for those who are addicted to drugs and thereby, socialize the drug addicts as worthy citizens. This centre started as a Community Treatment Camp in the year 1990, is now conducted as a Residential Rehabilitation Centre effective from the year 1991. Although, it could accommodate 35 residents at a time, there are more than 50 persons at all instances, in the waiting list. Since the land in which this Centre is situated belongs to the Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, there is no possibility of making new constructions to meet the demands for the services expected through the centre. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to vest the land in which the Treatment and Rehabilitation Centre of the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board is located, to the said Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the National Institute of Labour Studies (NILS) and the Shandong Foreign Trade Vocational College in China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-02
decision_details_body:
- The National Institute of Labour Studies which carries out educational programmes with the coordination of local and foreign educational institutes, conducts diploma and certificate courses, workshops and research in the field of labour for the labour force promoting educational activities among them.

	The Shandong Foreign Trade Vocational College of China which conducts courses on International Bussiness Studies and Human Resources Development has extended its willingness to conduct short term courses for the students of NILS on concessionary basis. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Shandong Foreign Trade Vocational College of China on implementing short term foreign training courses for selected students on concessionary basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of an allowance to the Estate Workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - An Agreement has been reached between the Trade Unions and the Regional Plantation Companies to increase the daily wage of the estate workers up to Rs.750/-. Nevertheless, there is a discontent in the plantation sector to the effect that the increase is inadequate and having considered the representations made in that regard, the proposal made by Hon.Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to secure the funds necessary to grant a further allowance of Rs.50/- in addition to the payment of a daily wage as agreed upon presently, to the estate workers of the Regional Plantation Companies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for supply of 75 Passenger Coaches and 20 Flat Beds for the Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Railway presently, is undergoing a major technological transition to suit the current trends of technology. Accordingly, it is anticipated to develop the condition of the locomotive fleet through this endevour. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to award the contract for the purchase of 75 passenger coaches of 50ft for upcountry railway services and 20 flat beds for the Sri Lanka Railways, to the PT Industry Kerete Api (PT INKA) belonging to the Government of Indonesia, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 37 New Luxury buses to the Sri Lanka Transport Board(SLTB) on lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - With a view to expanding the public transportation facilities and providing a more qualitative service to the general public, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the procurement of 37 new luxury buses to the Sri Lanka Transport Board on lease basis, to M/s Softlogic Automobile (Pvt) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer required for the month of May 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to procure 8,000 MT of Urea at the rate of US$ 302.54 per MT, 8,900 MT of Muriate of Potash at the rate of US$ 343.74 per MT, 2,000 MT of Muriate of Potash (Red/Pinkish) at the rate of US$ 343.74 per MT, to meet the chemical fertilizer requirement of the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Ltd. and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Ltd. for the month of May 2019, from M/s Valency International Trading Pte. Ltd., in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of a Dredger (TSHD) for deep sea mining
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - Due to the scarcity of the river sand used for the construction purposes, the demand for the treated off-shore sea sand which is used as an alternative material is increasing. As a remedial measure the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation & Development Corporation makes treated sand which could be used for construction purposes and provide the required supply to meet the demand. This activity, presently, caters to less than 10% of the total sand requirement of the construction industry. As such,the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to procure a dredger for sand mining in the deep sea to meet the high demand for sand anticipated in the future with the development of the construction industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Water supply schemes in the areas of Bathalayaya, Belaganwewa and Girandurukotte
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to award the contract for the water supply extension to Bathalayaya and Belaganwewa areas and the contract for the augmentation of the Girandurukotte Treatment Plant and the intake, to M/s Squire Mech Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Coal for the Coal Power Plant in Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted for the purchase of coal urgently required for the Coal Power Plant in Puttalam under the Spot Tender Procedure,. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to purchase 300,000 MT of coal for the said Power Plant from M/s Adani Global Pte. Ltd at the rate of US $ 81.87 per  MT of coal, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Agreements with Investors for 03 Grid Substations of Mahiyanganaya, Vauniya and Embilipitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - Under the 'Soorya Bala Sangramaya' programme, grid substations have been identified for the establishment of 90 Solar Power plants connected to the National Grid. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to enter into power purchase Agreements with the selected investors, as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee for the grid substations of Mahiyanganaya, Vauniya and Embilipitiya was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Constructions of Stage II & III of the proposed building for the Faculty of Technology of the Rajarata University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to award the contract for the construction of stage II & III of the proposed building for the Faculty of Technology of the Rajarata University, for a sum of Rs.356.3 million to M/s Central Engineering Services (Pvt.) Ltd, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Trade Adjustment Programme to accrue the benefits of the International Liberalized Trade
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - In order to enhance the benefits which could be accrued to the Sri Lanka's economy through the competitiveness of the international liberalized trade, a comprehensive trade adjustment programme has been prepared with a wide participation of the parties involved in the field. Accordingly, with the objective of enabling the implemention of this programme in a productive manner, the joint proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade to establish the Trade and Productivity Commission and a Joint Steering Committee as independent bodies that recommend the trade adjustments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Boralanda Swimming Pool
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct a swimming pool at a length of 25 meters with 06 lanes in a plot of land belonging to the Boralanda Police Training College, in the close proximity to the Boralanda town in Welimada. The Swimming Pool will be used to conduct the training programmes for the Athletes in the area, School children, Government Servants, Police Officers, School Cadets, Life‑saving Swimming instructors and for the apprentice officers of the police and other services. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports, to implement the said project at an investment of Rs 50 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Updating of the Wakf Act No.51 of 1982 according to the timely needs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, Minister of Postal Services & Muslim Religious Affairs to appoint an experts committee and provide facilities to consider the amendments required to be made to the existing Wakf Act according to the needs of the time for the smooth functioning of the Wakf Board and Wakfs Tribunal and to provide the necessary legal guidance to solve the issues and disputes pertaining to the Mosques and the administration of the Muslim Trusts, located countrywide, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities for the students enrolled under the 13 year Guaranteed Education Programme in Government Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The students who are enrolled under the 13 year Guaranteed Education Programme and follow the vocational training curriculum should have the second year of their education in a selected vocational stream at an accredited Vocational Institute approved for awarding the NVQ 4 Level Certificate. It has been observed that most of such vocational training institutes are established in the main towns and certain other training institutes are situated only in a particular place and this situation has caused the children to incur an enormous expenditure on transport and accommodation. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, Minister of Education, to provide a daily allowance of Rs.500/- for the students enrolled under the school programme to cover their transport and other expenditure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-enacting of the Prescription (Special Provisions) Act, to provide a period of relief to enable the persons affected due to the conflict situation, to resort to legal measures in respect of their properties
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The Prescription (Special Provisions) Act, No.05 of 2016 was enacted with a view to providing special legal provisions in respect of persons who were unable to claim their rights in Courts, for the recovery of immovable property including lands, during the conflict situation which prevailed in the past. This Act, provides to exempt disadvantaged persons from the provisions of the Prescription Ordinance and entitles them to institute an action in Courts within a period of two years from the date of coming into operation of the Act. It has been observed that and adequate period of time has to be given to prepare the misplaced documents during the conflict period or to collect the evidence relevant to the ownership of the lands and to make the relevant persons aware of this Act. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to re‑enact the Prescription (Special Provisions) Act to make legislation to extend the period of operation of this Act, by a further period of three years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovations of the Kandy-Getambe Court Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to renovate the Kandy-Getambe Court Complex consisting of 11 courts, by the State Engineering Corporation at an investment of Rs.303.5 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation and improvement of the Priority Roads
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to rehabilitate and improve the additional roads to be selected on priority basis utilizing a balance of US$16.8 million under the Priority Road Project implemented as per the Memorandum of Understanding made between the Government of Sri Lanka and the China Development Bank to provide financial facilities to the infrastructure development project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and Pakistan on the exchange of Sugarcane Breeding Materials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to enter into an Agreement, between the Sugarcane Research Institute of Sri Lanka and the Sugarcane Research and Development Board and the Sugarcane Research Institute of Faisalabad in Pakistan, taking into consideration, the benefits that could be accrued by both countries mutually by the exchange of sugarcane breeding materials, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Housing Project for Middle income families in the Ceremonial Drive at Rajagiriya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The Government has initiated a project to provide 500,000 housing units for the Middle income families inclusive of the Public and Private sector employees at an affordable price. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to implement a housing project with 177 units and other facilities for Middle income earners in the Ceremonial Drive at Rajagiriya, on the basis of Public Private Partnership, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Protection of the catchment area of the Nanawaladola water source in Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The Nanawaladola water source in Ratnapura supplies water for about 89 acres of paddy lands and the drinking water project operating associated with the same provides water for 140 families. Accordingly, taking into account, the significance to protect and maintain the catchment area of the said water resource, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to vest the aforesaid land which is in the possession of Urban Development Authority with the Department of Agrarian Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formalization and Expedition of the Receipt of Court Fines and Stamp Duties Levied on Transfer of Lands to the Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend section 19 of the Provincial Councils Act, No.42 of 1987, with a view to making the existing system of crediting the revenue accumulated on the Court fines more efficient and stamp duties charged on the deeds certified on transfer of lands within the administrative areas of Local Authorities to the relevant Local Authorities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to publish the Bill prepared accordingly in the Government Gazette and to refer it to the Provincial Councils through H.E the President for their views in terms of Article 154G of the Constitution and present the same in Parliament subsequently with amendments if found necessary, was approved b the Cabinet.

description: The thrift use of electricity to meet the existing power shortage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - Due to the prevailing drought condition, the generation of electricity to meet the demand for the power consumption of the Island, has become a challenge. Considering the possibility of saving a considerable amount of power through the thrift use of electricity, until such time that the generation of electricity returns to normal, the attention of the Government has been focused to make the public aware of the measures to be taken for the thrift consumption of electricity. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to make use of electricity thriftily, during the forthcoming three months by switching off two electric lamps in all houses, reduction of electricity consumption by around 10% in the public institutions and the religious and commercial establishments, switching off the unnecessary street lamps and switching them off one hour prior to the switching off time in a normal day, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of General Policy Guidelines in respect of the Electricity Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of section 5 of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act. No.20 of 2009, the Minister has to issue General Policy Guidelines in respect of the Electricity Industry. Accordingly, with a view to addressing the emerging issues in the power sector, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to issue the new General Policy Guidelines formulated incorporating Fuel diversity and security, Electricity Tariff, Generation, Transmission and Distribution Systems, Financing on Electricity Projects, Environment, Energy Conservation, Consumer Services, Multi-Sector Development, Safety and Exemptions from Licensing, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Laboratory with diagnostic facilities required for handling of harmful and dangerous micro-organism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The Medical Research Institute (MRI) which has a history of around 116 years, conducts research and diagnosis covering many areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to establish a Bio‑Safety Level 3 High Risk Laboratory with an investment of Rs.125 million with a view to developing advance diagnostic facilities for identifying and safe handling of harmful micro-organism in the event of a hazardous outbreak by further expanding the services of the MRI, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Conservation of Traditional Medical Knowledge - Stage II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - There is evidence to prove that our Traditional System of Medicine has been of much help for the cure and prevention of non‑communicable as well as other diseases. As such, the Department of Ayurveda has implemented a project for the conservation of the traditional system of medicine and the medical knowledge which presently is going into oblivion, considering the importance of preserving and disseminating the system of traditional medicine. As the initial step of the project, the preparation of a database by collecting information of about 2,500 Doctors, renovation of the old library and the preservation of the record room, ola leave books, preservation and duplication of about 400 ola leave books, drafting legislation to preserve the knowledge on traditional indigenous medicine and the establishment of the audio visual unit necessary for the digital library, have been commenced. As the second stage of the above project, it has been planned to preserve age old treatment practices, curing methods and various behavioral patterns and to get the traditional medical systems subject to research to ensure their scientific aspects aimed at disseminating such knowledge to the future generation. As such the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to implement the same in the Medium Term Budgetary Framework with an investment of Rs.350 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the National Hospital for Respiratory Diseases at Welisara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-26
decision_details_body: - The National Hospital for Respiratory Diseases situated at Welisara, remains as the only institution solely dedicated for diagnosis and treatment of respiratory diseases in Sri Lanka. This hospital which provides services annually for around 100,000 out door Patients, carries out nearly 1,000 thoracic surgeries annually. As such, the proposal made by Hon.
