decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has previously granted approval to conduct a Presidential Media Awards Ceremony annually, for the encouragement of journalists. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to award a cash price as well, for the prospective  award recipients to be felicitated and the life time award winners, and to admire and award an honorarium to the journalists experts working in the Editorial Board and the journalist who produce academic write-ups and critiques, as a matter of appreciation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of lands for the accelarated implementation of the Kankesanthurai Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - An Agreement has been entered into, for securing of the necessary funds with the collaboration of the Government of India for the development of the  Kankesanthurai Harbour and hence, it is necessary to transfer lands for the implementation of the said project expeditiously. As such, it has been found that it is appropriate to transfer the lands in extent of 15 acres belonging to the Sri Lanka Cement Corporation over to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to transfer the said 15 acres to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reimbursement of the loss incurred by the Super Markets engaged in the Government Programme to make available food commodities at the landed cost
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Government has obtained the cooperation of the Supper Markets and the Lanka Sathosa Limited to sell essential food items such as, rice, sugar, potatoes, onions, lentils, sprats and mackerel at landed cost as a relief measure to the consumers for a period of four months commencing from 14 December 2017 to 15 April 2018. The Government has agreed to meet the loss so incurred for selling of these essential food items to the consumers by the said institutions as computed by an external auditor on his recommendations. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to settle the loss amounting to 203 million incurred by Cargils (Ceylon) PLC and the Lanka Sathosa Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Proposals for the Development of the operational activities of the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport (MRIA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has previously granted approval to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee and a Project Committee to assist in its task to examine the proposal made by the  Airports Authority of India in respect of the operational activities of the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport and make recommendations. Accordingly, the Joint Proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to pursue future action in accordance with the Report prepared by the said Committee containing its recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval for the ratification of the International Labour Organization (ILO) Protocol relevant to the Forced Labour Convention
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has ratified the Forced Labour Convention No.29 of 1930 of the International Labour Organization (ILO) in the year 1950, and the Abolition of the Forced Labour Convention No.105 of 1957 in the year 2003. Considering the trends in regard to the use of forced labour for sexual exploitation, child labour, modern slavery and human trafficking, the Protocol No.29 has been adopted as an additional device to the Forced Labour Convention of 2014. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in accordance with the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to ratify the Protocol No.29 of 2014 pertaining to the Forced Labour Convention of 1930 to be on par with the provisions provided therein, for the existing legal framework in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Integrity Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - In terms of the United Nations Convention Against Corruption (UNCAC) which was ratified by the Government of Sri Lanka it is obligatory to create an adequate legal background and administrative parameters within the country to act against corruption.  Accordingly, the Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously to formulate a National Action Plan to take measures against corruption. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena,  to implement the National Integrity Plan and Actions in colloboration with the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption with a view to fulfilling the objectives of creating a public service characterized by honesty, transparency, responsibility and accountability, raising awareness among the public sector employees on bribery and prevention methods, encouraging the society and the public officers to provide evidence and information, mobilizing citizens as whistle blowers on corruption and defending and appearing on behalf of witnesses, informants and whistle blowers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Digital Economy Strategy for Sri Lanka: 2018-2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - Digital Economy Strategy for Sri Lanka has been designed in collaboration with the international level consultants and the representatives of the relevant institutions. In order to accelerate the economic growth based on the digital technology, this strategy includes a three-part framework with digitization of priority sectors in the economy, accelerating growth and improvement of digital sectors and building the required digital infrastructure. Under, this strategy, three Flagship Programmes of Digitally Enabled Export Promotion Zone and “Logistic Villages”, Centralized Agriculture Nerve Center and Data Exchange Platform are expected to be implemented. Further, it has also been scheduled for 10 priority projects including the digitalized projects to be completed within 03 years. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, on the request made by the Non‑Cabinet Ministry of Digital Infrastructure and Information Technology, for the proposed digital strategy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Furnishing of information related to Cabinet decisions under the provisions of the Right to Information Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body:
- In terms of the provisions of the Right to Information Act, No.12 of 2016, a request made by a citizen for information related to Cabinet decisions was hitherto addressed by the Office of the Cabinet of Ministers. Nevertheless, the recommendation made by the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Legislation to authorize the Secretaries to Ministries, to provide the citizens directly with the information requested by the Line Ministry itself, with a view to providing the Cabinet decisions and the related information in a more efficient and effective manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

	Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to authorize the Secretaries to Ministries and the Secretaries to Non‑Cabinet Ministries to provide the citizens the Cabinet decisions and related documents pertaining to the subject matter within the purview of each Ministry directly, having considered the request made by a citizen in terms of the Right to Information Act, subject to restrictions stipulated therein and the Office of the Cabinet of Ministers to provide only the information not relevant to a particular Cabinet Memorandum or falling within the purview of a Ministry and on which the Cabinet has made a decision under 'Any Other Business'.

description: Tentative Programme for the Budget Debate for the Financial Year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The Budget Speech 	containing the Budget proposals for the year 2019 (the second reading of the Budget) is scheduled to be presented in Parliament on the 5th of March 2019. Accordingly, it is scheduled for the second reading of the Budget debate to be had from 2019‑03‑06 to 2019‑03‑12, the Committee Stage debate to be had from 2019‑03‑13 to 2019‑04‑05 and the Voting on the Budget to be conducted on 2019‑04‑05. The facts presented by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister pertaining to the said Budget programme, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for the water supply extension to Dambulla and Kandalama through the Greater Dambulla Water Scheme in the Central Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to award the contract for the water supply extension to Dambulla and Kandalama through the Greater Dambulla Water Scheme in the Central Province implemented as a sub - project of the Local Government Enhancement Sector Project, to M/s Squire Mech Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.565.39 million as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The contract for the installation of 100Mvar Breaker Switched Capacitor Banks at the Pannipitiya Grid Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the installation of 100Mvar Breaker Switched Capacitor Banks at the Pannipitiya Grid Substation under the Supporting Electricity Supply Reliability Improvement Project, to M/s Seimens Ltd. in India, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Coal required for the Coal Power Plant in Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the purchase of MT 360,000 of coal required for the Coal Power Plant in Puttalam to M/s Trafigura Pte. Ltd. in Singapore at a price of US$ 91.40 per Metric Ton, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The contract for obtaining expertise manpower services for the maintenance of the Boiler, Turbine and Auxiliaries of Unit 03 of the Lakvijaya Power Plant in Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The 'Technical Cooperation Agreement for Overhaul Support' between the China Machinery Engineering Corporation, the main contractor for the construction of the Puttalam Coal Power Plant and the Sri Lanka Electricity Board is valid till the end of September 2019. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the maintenance of the Boiler, Turbine and Auxiliaries of Unit 03 of the Lakvijaya Power Plant in Puttalam to the China Machinery Engineering Corporation, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Mannar Fort
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - With a view to attracting the foreign tourists, it was proposed by the budget proposals in 2018, to develop 06 old Forts situated in Matara, Hambantota, Batticaloa, Trincomalee, Mannar and Kalpitiya with the collaboration of the Department of Archaeology and the Private Sector. Accordingly, the Department of Archaeology has prepared a project proposal for the development of the Mannar Fort. The dredging of the moat around the Fort has been identified as the main task in the proposal. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, for the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation which has shown competency in such activities to carryout the process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Attracting the 'Multi National Players engaged in the Electrical and Electronic Machinery Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body:
- The Electrical and Electronic Machinery Industry is the process of stepping into the Global Electronic Value Added Supply Chain and according to the Economic Cooperation and Development Classification of Manufacturing Industries, the field of Electronic and Electric Machinery Industry in the country falls under the category of the medium‑high technology and high technology industries. Accordingly, this includes the Automobile, Telecommunication, Consumer Electronics, Industrial Automation, Internet of Things (IoT) and many other verticals. The industrialists of this country in this field, have received the ISO certificate and carry on their activities subject to the required labour rules and the regulations. 

The start‑up companies in research and development prototyping in the country are engaged in innovation and generating new products and in this context, it has become essential for the small and middle scale enterprises to integrate with the large companies. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to provide facilities for this type of enterprises to attract the multi‑national companies to integrate with them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Code of Regulations for the formalization of the involvements of the Sports Associations in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports to present the Gazette Notifications dated 2018‑09‑22, 2018‑10‑18 and 2019‑01‑10 including the regulations pertaining to the National Sports Associations, declared by the Minister of Sports in accordance with the provisions of the Sports Act, No.25 of 1973 for the formalization of the involvement of National Sports Associations by conducting elections in a fair and orderly manner, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Convention on the Prohibition of the Use, Stockpiling, Production and Transfer of Anti personnel Mines and on their Destruction (Ottawa Convention) in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has acceded to the convention on the Prohibition of the Use, Stockpiling, Production and Transfer of Anti‑personnel Mines and on their Destruction (Ottawa Convention) in Sri Lanka and it has come into force in Sri Lanka with effect from the 01st of June 2018. In terms of article 9 of the said Convention, Sri Lanka, as a party, is bound to take all appropriate legal, administrative and other measures including the imposition of penal sanctions, to prevent and suppress any activity prohibited to a State Party under the Convention undertaken by persons or on territory under its jurisdiction or control. As such, the Attorney General has given his clearance to the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in accordance with the approval granted previously to implement the provisions of the Convention within Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The special Security Audit Programme regarding the Airport Security Arrangements and the Civil Aviation Security Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a signatory State to the Convention on International Civil Aviation and as such, functions as a Contracting State since 1948. In October 2001, the Declaration on the misuse of civil aircrafts as weapons of destruction and other terrorist activities involving civil aviation was adopted being a resolution at the 33rd Session of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO). In accordance with the said Resolution, a Special Security Audit Programme has been implemented in stages pertaining to the Airport Security Arrangements and the Civil Aviation Security Programmes carried out by the Contracted States since 2002. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and Sri Lanka, to implement the Continuous Monitoring Approach' scheduled to be taken up as phase III of the ICAO under the 'Universal Security Audit Programme - was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Carrying out the development activities of the houses at Usawiyawatta in Moratuwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - Presently, a total of 50 families are living in a land at Usawiyawatta in Moratuwa belonging to the Government and 30 families out of which dwell in temporary houses. The remaining 20 families are living in two walk-up apartments built by a Non Governmental Organization in the year 2010. All these 50 families make use of public sanitation facilities which too are in an extremely dilapidated condition. It has been proposed to construct 30 houses in the same land for the 30 families living in the temporary houses and to upgrade the required sanitary facilities for 20 families living in the apartments with the contribution of the residents. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs to secure provisions for the implementation of this Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Redevelopment of the Wekanda Area of Slave Island
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to implement a redevelopment programme named 'Nawampuraya' in an extent of around 47 acres (19.4 hectares) in the Wekanda area of Slave Island. Since approximately, about 1200 small housing units are situated in the proposed area, it has been found that certain difficulties are bound to arise when implementing development activities pertaining to them. As such, in a manner so as to derive benefits for the land owners of the said area out of a participatory methodology adopted the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to seek Cabinet approval in principle, to implement the 'Nawampura Project' to redevelop the inner city area of the Slave Island, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regularization of Grants and Permits issuing process and Cadastral Registry Modernization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body:
- In terms of the Land Development Ordinance, providing of survey plans in respect of the plots of land alienated to the public for residential, agricultural and other purposes, without formal survey plans and surveying of the plots of land for the issuance of grants and permits with clear titles to ensure clear ownership has to be carried out. Nevertheless, it has been found that a lengthy period of time is required for the purpose due to the limited availability of human and physical resources. As such, the Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval previously to implement a project by stages in order to perform this process efficiently. 

Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs and Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to develop facilities required for surveying around 732,000 plots of land and issue about 696,000 grants and permits under Stage 1 of the project, implement the proposed Stage 1 of the project within a period of 03 years and to secure the funds necessary for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Draft of the Land (Special Provisions) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The Land (Special Provisions) Bill has been drafted incorporating necessary provisions to grant absolute title to state lands held to persons who are holders of Grants or Instruments of Disposition in respect of such lands and the proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Draft National Building Research Institute (NBRI) Bill in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to draft a bill to establish the National Building Research Organization (NBRO) by an Act of Parliament. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management, to publish the draft bill prepared accordingly in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting-up a Committee for the development of the Sugarcane and Sugar Industry in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - Nearly, 9% of the total sugar requirement of the country is locally produced and the balance requirement of 91% is fulfilled by importation. Therefore, by developing the sugarcane and sugar industry in Sri Lanka would be able to save a large amount of foreign exchange. Taking this matter into consideration, attention has been focused to make a search for available new lands suitable for sugarcane cultivation and thereby to expand the cultivation by increasing the sugar production in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to set up the Sri Lanka Sugar Industry Development Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Ministry of Plantation Industries, to take appropriate measures to develop the sugarcane and sugar industry to enable both the growers and the millers engaged in sugarcane industry to enhance their income, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of plots of land from Regional Industrial Estates to set up industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The Regional Industrial Estate Development Programme is carried out at regional level with the objective of promoting industries at regional level. Under this programme, identifying the suitable investors for investment in the industrial estate established at regional level is done in accordance with the recommendations of the Regional Industrial Services Committees. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.	Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons and Co‑operative Development to allocate plots of lands from the industrial estates of Homagama, Kalutara, Millewa, Kuruwita Nalanda Ellawala, Embilipitiya, Galigamuwa, Batticaloa, Trincomalee, Ampara Nawagampura, Polonnaruwa Laksha Uyana, Karandeniya, Udukawa, Ulapane and Puttalam for 25 investors so selected on a 35 year lease basis and to change the business names of investors carrying on their industries presently in the industrial estates, add new industries and to change the existing production of the industry in accordance with the recommendations of the Regional Industrial Service Committees, adding new industries and to make changes in the industries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the existing Visa categories and to revise the relevant fees
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The Legal Draftsman has prepared a draft Bill to amend section 14(1) and section 14(2) of the Immigrants and Emigrants Act, No.20 of 1948 and to add a new section as14(3)(a), to issue visas to the investors who remit US$ 500,000 to reside in Sri Lanka for 10 years, who remit US$ 300,000 to reside in Sri Lanka for 05 years and to provide a visa, in respect of persons who have lost their Sri Lankan citizenship, as a result of obtaining citizenship in foreign countries to live permanently in the country for a period prescribed by the Minister in‑charge of the subject. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to publish the draft Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, to present same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Immigrants and Emigrants Regulations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval previously to amend the Immigrants and Emigrants Regulations in order to amend the existing visa categories and the fees charged, relating to the existing procedure of issuing visas by the Department of Immigration and Emigration. These amendments will enable to introduce a visa system which will induce the investors and to introduce a single fee scheme instead of the diverse schemes prevalent in various countries for tourist visas. It is also proposed to introduce a penalty fee of US$ 500 for those who over stay in the country without visas. In addition, it is also anticipated to extend the duration of tourist visas and to issue multiple entry facilities pertaining to the Visas issued for commercial activities . Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to publish the amended draft regulations of 1956 relevant to the Immigrants and Emigrants Act, No.20 of 1948 in the Government Gazette and subsequently, to present same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the Indian Credit Line facility for the Solar Power Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The Government has decided to support the International Solar Alliance assisted by the Government of India and the Government of France in line with the priority given by Sri Lanka in regard to the solar power development. Sri Lanka obtained its membership in the founding conference of the International Solar Alliance held in March 2018 where the signing of the Framework Agreement of the International Solar Alliance also took place. In order to mark the occasion of the signing of the Framework Agreement of the International Solar Alliance, the Government of India has pledged a credit line facility of US$ 100 million to support the Solar Power Development Programme in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to obtain a credit facility of Rs.100 million from the EXIM Bank of India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Zone in Hambantota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The State Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Corporation (SPMC), presently manufactures pharmaceuticals for a variety of diseases, and the SPMC and the other private manufacturers produce around 2 billion units of pharmaceuticals annually required for the use of the the country, at present. This quantity is adequate only to meet 12% of the market demand and the balance 88% of the required medicinal drugs are imported. The expenditure incurred annually for the purpose is around US$ 500 million.  Around 70% of the cost of production is spent for the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients required for the production of drugs and the establishment of a plant in Sri Lanka for the production of said Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients will make enable to save a large amount of foreign exchange within the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to establish a pharmaceutical zone in an extent of 200 acres in the Hambantota area for the manufacture of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients and finished formulations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities for a National Multi Stakeholder Coordination in respect of Drinking Water and Sanitation Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to provide the necessary facilities to establish a formal mechanism of coordination with the collaboration of the relevant institutions for mobilizing of resources and commitments productively with a view to achieving the national and global goals in respect of the drinking water and sanitation services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Registration/Regulation of the education institutes of the country which offer foreign degree programmes affiliated to foreign Universities/ Degree awarding Institutes.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - Education institutes conducting foreign degree courses affiliated to the foreign universities / degree awarding institutes, are functioning in Sri Lanka and these courses are followed by local students as well as foreign students. Even though, the accreditation and quality assurance of these courses are carried out by the main universities / degree awarding institutions, no regulatory measure is adopted to find out weather these institutions are suitable for conducting such degree courses in the country. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to introduce a methodology for registration and regulation of education institutes in the country awarding foreign degrees affiliated to foreign universities / degree awarding institutions within the ranking of the first 500 places in accordance with the international standards, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Gratis Visas to attract Tourists.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that the tourist arrivals during the period of April to October shows a low rate compared to other months of the year. However, due to the fact that a number Buddhist festivals and cultural events such as Vesak, Poson celebrations and Esala Perahara occur during the period from May to August countrywide, it is anticipated that the Buddhist tourists in Asiatic countries such as Thailand where Buddhism is practiced can be attracted to Sri Lanka. Taking this position into consideration, it has been proposed to issue Gratis Visas for Thailand tourists for a period of six months with effect from 01st April 2019 in order to increase the number of tourist arrivals within the above mentioned period. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs to provide same facility for the tourists from the European Union, United Kingdom, Australia, South Korea, Canada, United State of America, Singapore, Malaysia, New Zealand as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Polpithigama Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously for the construction of the Polpithigama Police Station, but its construction activities have been delayed so far due to various practical issues. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to carry out its construction activities formally, under the guidance of the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovating the Housing Complex of the Sri Lanka Police at Ketawalamulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - There are two housing complexes situated at Ketawalamulla which provide accommodation facilities for the senior officers of the Sri Lanka Police and as one out of those is in a very dilapidated condition and renovation activities should have to be carried out expeditiously. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to provide measures to carry out the essential repairs and renovation activities of the said building expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reconstitution of an Inter-Ministerial Committee in accordance with the provisions of the Information and Communication Act No.27 of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - Provisions required to constitute an Inter-Ministerial Committee to advise the Government in policy formulation pertaining to information technology under the Information and Communication Act No.27 of 2003, are in operation. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, on the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Digital Infrastructure and Information Technology for appointing a Committee comprising of 17 persons including Cabinet Ministers, Non-Cabinet Ministers, State Ministers and Government Officers and reconstitute the same so as to suit the present needs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Science and Technology Human Resources Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - 	It has been planned to establish faculties of technology in the University of Kelaniya, Rajarata University of Sri Lanka and the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka and also a Faculty of Engineering at Sri Jayewardenapura, with a view to widening the higher educational opportunities for the youth of Sri Lanka. By this, 830 students will gain opportunities for higher education in one academic year. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to implement the Science and Technology Human Resources Development Project which is expected to provide building complexes inclusive of modern facilities for the use of students with an investment of Rs.26,400 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Suspension of the importation of spices through different methods for solving the issues affecting the local spices and the related manufacturing industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - With a view to solving the issues affecting the local spices and the related manufacturing industry due to re‑exportation of imported Pepper and Arecanuts to India and imported Nutmeg/Mace and Tamarind to Pakistan and illicit exportation of Sri Lankan Cinnamon, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to suspend the importation for export processing and importation of Pepper, Arecanuts, Nutmeg/Mace, Tamarind and Cinnamon to Sri Lanka tentatively, through the Entreport Trade and Commercial Hub Operations and to establish a mechanism needed for the prevention of the above imported spices being re‑shipped from Sri Lanka to India and Pakistan as Sri Lankan products and to prevent exportation of such spices and recording them as products from Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of expeditious reliefs to the Small and Medium Scale Rice Millers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention to provide reliefs to the small and medium scale rice millers expeditiously to overcome the difficulties faced by such rice millers due to the difficulty in payment of installments on loans they have obtained and the non‑availability of the Working Capital required for the production activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to provide funds to purchase paddy from the farmers through member rice millers of the District Co‑operative Societies and to introduce a loan repayment mechanism through the earnings that could be obtained by fulfilling the working capital requirements by using such funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding of the Regional Conference on Sustainable Sanitation Solutions in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The Regional Conference on Sustainable Sanitation Solutions organized by the Regional Sanitation Centre for the South Asian Regional Collaboration Conference on Sanitation will be held on 21st to 23rd of February, 2019 in Colombo with the sponsorship of Sri Lanka. As such, the submissions made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to the effect that it is scheduled to be held with the participation of the representatives of the countries of the South Asian Region, Experts of the sanitation Sector and representatives of the local and foreign non‑governmental organizations engaged in the Sector, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Upliftment of Rural young men and women through the Youth Farmer Cooperative Village Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - 'The Youn Puraya 2019' National Programme is scheduled to be held in March in the Hambantota District and plans have been made concurrently to get the rural young men and women to participate in the production process. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to grant a land of 15 perches to the unmarried young men and women who can make a contribution to the production process, to build their own house, as a special one-off incentive a farming land of 40 perches in extent for agricultural activities, to provide them with the necessary guidance and to get them to contribute to the national economy through the Youth Farmer Cooperative Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting Airborne Gravity, Gravity Gradiometry and Magnetic Surveys on Multi-Client Basis for Exploration of Oil and Natural Gas around the Mannar and the Cauvery Basin
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to award the contract to carry out the survey, to Bell Geospace Ltd. in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee (CANCP), in compliance with the request for proposals for selecting a competent and experienced geophysical exploration company to carry out Airborne Gravity, Gravity Gradiometry and Magnetic Surveys over the sea coast of Sri Lanka to explore the mineral gas fields said to be situated around the Cauvery Basin and the Mannar Basin, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a bypass road in the Ratnapura Town
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The Colombo - Ratnapura - Wellawaya - Batticaloa Road traverses through the Ratnapura town and immense delays in the traffic movements are experienced due to the traffic congestion. As a result, owing to the wastage of fuel and environmental pollution people are subject to a great pressure. In addition to the traffic congestion the road becomes impassable due to the floods which take place frequently. As a remediable measure a proposal has been made to construct a bypass road above the high flood level avoiding the town area. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to construct a 04 lane bypass road of 2.20 km long, from Weralupe to the Warakatota bridge and to construct 03 bridges of 900 m in length in the said bypass road, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Widening & Improving of the First 02 km Road Section of the Matara - Hakmana road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the decision taken to develop the 24.14 km road section of the Matara - Hakmana road, the improvements to the road have been made but due to various practical difficulties the development of the first 02 km section of the same has been delayed up to date. This road which is due to provide an easy access to the Southern Expressway which is scheduled to be opened in the year 2020, is also expected to minimize the traffic congestion in the Matara town area. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to develop the first 02 km section of the Matara - Hakmana road at a cost of Rs.869 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of sanitary facilities in the Kataragama and Kebilitta Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The Kataragama sacred city which earns the respect of pilgrims and tourists, is a city with a high tourist attraction. Around over 10 thousand people visit this city per day over the weekend and during the Perehera Season it exceeds 05 lakhs per day. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to establish sanitary facilities in the Kataragama and Kebilitta areas for the use of these devotees and tourists at a cost of Rs.50 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building Complex for the Gampaha District Secretariat
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to award the contract for the design and construction of a new building complex for the Gampaha District Secretariat, to M/s Sanken Construction (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.3,054.2 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for upgrading Grid Substations at Anuradhapura and Mannar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to award the contract for the installation of 220kV, 2x50MVAr Variable Shunt Reactors at the new Anuradhapura Grid Substation and 220kV, 50MVAr Variable Shunt Reactor at the Mannar Grid Substation, to the consortium of M/s. Siemens Ltd and DIMO (Pvt) Ltd. as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revamping of Currency Operations at the Central Bank of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - It has been found necessary to revamp the existing currency processing capacity of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka due to the increasing trends in currency in circulation within Sri lanka. As such the proposal made by Hon.Mangala Samaraweera, the 	Minister of 	Finance & 	Mass Media, to implement the project for revamping of 	currency operations at the Central Bank of Sri Lanka to be implemented for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The contract for the construction of the National Tsunami Early Warning Centre and Laboratory Building of the Geological Survey and Mines Bureau
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to award the contract for the construction of the National Tsunami Early Warning Centre and Laboratory Building of the Geological Survey and Mines Bureau to the Central Engineering Services (Pvt.) Ltd., (CESL) for a sum of Rs 383.2 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the Commonwealth Law Ministers' Meeting (CLMM)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made for Sri Lanka to host the Commonwealth Law Ministers' Meeting to be held with the participation of the Law Ministers and the Attorney Generals of the Commonwealth countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to provide the required facilities for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Fines charged for certain Major Offences under the Motor Traffic Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - Although it was proposed previously to increase the fines for violation of some major offences resulting largely in road accidents, H.E. the President taking into consideration the views expressed by various stakeholders appointed an Officials' Committee to make a study regarding the matter prior to the implementation of such proposals. The Committee has identified 10 offences which largely cause traffic accidents and also made recommendations to revise the fines for same. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to publish the draft Bill pertaining to same in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reviewing the procedure of issuing Route Permits and the preparation of a new procedure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to appoint a Committee comprising of relevant stakeholders to introduce a new methodology for issuing Route Permits to buses having studied the problems cropped up after the commencement of bus operation on the expressway, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Low and Middle Income Houses in the Hambantota District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement a housing programme in the densely populated areas in Hambantota in which the fisheries communities occupy where accommodation required for sanitary and recreation facilities are not available. Under this programme, it is due to construct 310 housing units for the low income earner and 56 housing units for the middle income earner in a land area of 7 acres in the Koholankala area and in 60 perches in the Tangalle area identified for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to obtain approval in principle for the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Geological Investigations for the Preliminary Detailed Engineering Designs in the Kelani Flood Protection Bund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to carry out expeditiously, the geological investigations needed for the proposed Kelani Flood Protection Bund under the Climate Resilience Improvement Project (CRIP) for the mitigation of floods around the Kelani River Basin by the National Building Research Organization (NBRO), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Power of Attorney Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet had granted approval previously to amend the Power of Attorney Ordinance for preventing false authentication of documents, carrying out transactions using fraudulent documents and engaging in fraudulent acts and to carry out attestation, registration and ensuring the revocation and nullity of a Power of Attorney, procedure of revocation and nullification of Power of Attorney and ensuring the confidentiality of information etc. in a more productive manner. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government and Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to present the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition of Land for the Weliwita Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The Weliwita Water Supply Project has been identified as a priority project to cater for the future demand of water for the areas such as Athurugiriya, Homagama, Kaduwela, Malabe, Pannipitiya, Maharagama, Dehiwala, Kotte and Battaramulla. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to acquire the lands required for the construction of the water intake and the water treatment plant at Welivita and the Ground Reservoir at Hokandara and the pump house at Jayawadanagama, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for mitigation of the Landslide Vulnerability
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - In recent times, an increase in landslides has been identified and these landslides have resulted in a significant loss of life and damages to properties and has placed obstacles to achieving both economic and social well being. Although, even by now, certain short term strategies have been adopted for the prevention of landslides, it has been planned to implement a project with permanent preventive methodologies to minimize the landslide vulnerability. It is expected to cover 27 critical landslide sites under Phase I and 120 priority sites including 20 sites situated along the upcountry railway line under Phase II. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to secure funds for the implementation of the project with an investment of US$110 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Container Movement Tracking and Monitoring System for the Sri Lanka Customs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The Department of Sri Lanka Customs processes on average about 1,150 to 1450 inbound cargo containers and 350 to 450 outbound cargo containers per working day. Further, these cargo will be checked at different locations before releasing them to the respective importers and some of high-risk cargo will be moved to specific locations for further inspection and clearance. In such instances, physical bottle/ strap locks are placed on the container doors for the safety of these cargo. However, this method has to be modified so as to suit the present day needs. Accordingly, it is anticipated to introduce new technological features to track and monitor container movements to have a persistent monitoring process of their contents and to identify the geographical position of the container, precisely. It is also expected to introduce the new technology with modern security features required to ensure the security of cargo. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.	Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to commence the procurement process of selecting a suitable supplier for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of Kankesanthurai Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention on the development of Kankesanthurai Harbour into a commercial port which would strengthen the country's effort to become a regional maritime hub and contribute to the trade activities in 	the Northern 	Province. Accordingly, plans have also been made to acquire lands required for the said harbour development project and provide infrastructure and other utility facilities for the same. It has also been planned to renovate the Iyannar Kovil to pave the way towards religious and social wellbeing concurrent to the economic development of the area. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to carry out the relevant tasks for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Project for enhancement of indoor air quality of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - Due to the limited space available in the urban and semi-urban areas, it has been found that the people residing in houses, state buildings and business places constantly affected by the air pollutants face serious health issues. Therefore, it is important to take necessary measures to control the emissions of buildings in order to overcome this situation and to increase the quality of atmosphere. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement the three year pilot project during the period from 2019-2021 to minimize the impact caused to the health by air pollutants, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Maintenance of the Dr. Neville Fernando Teaching Hospital as a Line Teaching Hospital of the Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to maintain Dr. Neville Fernando Teaching Hospital as a Line Teaching Hospital of the Government, equivalent to the Sri Jayewardenapura Hospital, equipped with all the required facilities in order to provide health services for the people living in Colombo East, Kaduwela and Malabe, the areas where a high density of population exist. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to maintain Dr. Neville Fernando Teaching Hospital as the Colombo East Teaching Hospital in line with the Colombo East Base Hospital (Mulleriyawa), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Settlement of Payments in respect of Rehabilitation and Reconstruction activities of the areas affected by floods and landslides
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to provide the District Secretaries of the relevant Districts with the necessary funds to enable them to make payment in respect of Rehabilitation and Reconstruction activities of the areas affected by floods and landslides where payments have not been settled up to date, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Sub-Committee to study the recommendations made in the Report of the Special Commission appointed to review the salaries in the Public Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - A Special Commission to review the salaries in the Public Sector was previously appointed by H.E. the President to make the necessary recommendations reviewing the existing salary structure in the Public Sector to rectify the salary anomalies which have arisen at present. Accordingly, the Report containing the recommendations of the said Special Commission for the rectification of the salary anomalies has been presented to H.E. the President. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to appoint a Cabinet Sub‑Committee to study the mode of implementation of the recommendations contained in the Report and present the proposals decided conclusively to the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Programme on the Prevention of Chronic Kidney Disease - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-12
decision_details_body: - The Presidential Task Force on the prevention of Chronic Kidney Disease was established for the prevention of the Chronic Kidney Disease reported from various areas of the Island and in line with it, the programmes for prevention of Chronic Kidney Disease were implemented by adopting an integrated approach enlisting the participation of various Ministries and Departments. In order to further achieve the targets, it has been planned to implement this programme in the year 2019 as well and an Action Plan has also been prepared for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to secure the funds necessary for the implementation of this Annual Action Plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Paddy Purchase Programme within the Maha Season of  2018/2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - Harvesting activities of the Maha Season of 2018/2019 is scheduled to be commenced and it has been planned to implement the Paddy Purchase Programme in this season under the direction of the District Secretaries for maintaining a stable price for paddy and providing a reasonable price for the farmers for their paddy. As such, the Paddy Marketing Board and the District Cooperative Societies are scheduled to purchase paddy of Samba varieties for a certified price of Rs.41/- per Kg and Nadu and other varieties for a certified price of Rs.38/- per Kg. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to provide the required financial provision of Rs.5,000 million, for the implementation of the Paddy Purchase Programme of the Maha Season,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Oil and Lubricant required for the buses of the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to award the contracts for the procurement of Oil and Lubricant required for the buses of the Sri Lanka Transport Board to M/s Lanka IOC PLC, M/s Cheveron Lubricant Lanka PLC and M/s McLarens Lubricants Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation and improvement of 25km road section from  Maradankadawala to Habarana in the Maradankadawala - Habarana-Tirikkondiadimadu Road (A11)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to award the contract for the rehabilitation and improvement including the routine maintenance work for 5 years after its construction, of the 25km road section from  Maradankadawala to Habarana on the Maradankadawala-Habarana-Tirikkondiadimadu Road (A11) under the Integrated Road Investment Programme, to Consulting Engineers and Contractors (Pvt) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Consultancy Services for the Second Integrated Road Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to award the contract for providing consultancy services including construction supervision, contract management and other implementation activities for project implementation in the Eastern Province under the Second Integrated Road Investment Programme funded by the Asian Development Bank to the joint venture of Egis International and Greentech Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Rural Bridges
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct 4,000 bridges in the rural areas with the objective of extending the benefits of the national development to the remote areas of the Island as well through the improvement of transportation connectivity by connecting various areas of the Island. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to award the contract for the construction of 175 bridges of various sizes, so as to cover the 9 Provinces of the Island to Cleveland Bridge UK Limited in the United Kingdom, for a sum of 37.7 million Sterling Pounds, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of spare parts necessary for the major Overhauling of the Plants at the Sapugaskanda Power Station according to the prevailing operational pattern
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - Major Overhauling is required in respect of the Engine Nos. 5 to 8 after 12,000 running hours and the Engine Nos. 9 to 12  after 6,000 running hours of the Sapugaskanda Power Station.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the purchase of the spare parts for the overhauling of the Engines  compulsorily needed after the completion of the said running hours to M/s MAN Energy Solutions SE of Germany, the original manufacturer of these Engines as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Lubricating oil for the Sapugaskanda Power Plant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to award the procurement for purchasing 800,000 litres of lubricating oil Taro 40 XL 40 for Pielstick  plant of Sapugaskanda and 300,000 litres of lubricating oil Taro 40 XL 40 for the MAN plant of Sapugaskanda, to M/s Chevron Lubricants Lanka PLC as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Lubricating Oil for the Barge Mounted Power Plant of the Ceylon Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to award the procurement for the supply of 750,000 liters of Cylinder Lubricating Oil and 175,000 liters of System Lubricating Oil required for the Barge Mounted Power Plant of the Ceylon Electricity Board for the year 2018/2019 to M/s Chevron Lubricants Lanka PLC, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Construction of Buildings for the Outdoor Patients Division, Laboratory, Radiology Unit and Wards at the National Institute of Infectious Diseases (IDH) in Angoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to develop the National Institute of Infectious Diseases in Angoda as a state‑of‑the‑art centre which conducts treatment of infectious diseases and training and research activities. In this context, it is proposed to develop it as a Health Service Centre of Excellence with an Outdoor Patient Division, Wards, Clinics, Laboratories and facilities for Radiological diagnosis facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the Procurement to construct buildings for the Outdoor Patients Division (OPD), Laboratory, Radiology Unit and Wards at the National Institute of Infectious Diseases in Angoda to M/s George Steuart Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the Contract regarding the Supply of Liquefied Petroleum Gas for the year 2019/2020 to the Litro Gas Lanka Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The Litro Gas Lanka Limited is a Government owned company which owns a 70% market share of the Island's Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), engaged in importing, storing, filling, marketing and selling LPG. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media to award the contract for the procurement of 350,000 MT of LPG as to M/s Oman Trading International Ltd. for the said company to fulfill the country's market needs, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Housing Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been previously granted to revise, the National Housing Policy presently being used so as to reflect within the Vision of the present Government and to focus more attention towards  the issues such as urbanization, impacts of natural disasters and implementation of the concept of Sustainable Human Settlements Development. Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, 	Minister of 	Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs on the revised National Housing Policy taking also into account of the assignment of subjects presently to the Ministries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the diploma course conducted by Sri Lanka School of Animal Husbandry at Kundasale to obtain the National Vocational Qualification (NVQ) Level  5 and 6
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - As it is essential to achieve the National Vocational Qualification for all technical courses by the year 2020, all requirements pertaining to the development of syllabi teaching and training modules and the improvement of National Competency Standards have been finalized enabling to upgrade the two year Animal Husbandry Diploma Course conducted by the Department of Animal Production & Health to obtain the National Vocational Qualification (NVQ) Level 5 and 6. Accordingly, it is expected to upgrade the said course as the two and a half year Higher National Diploma in Livestock Production Technology Course. As such, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development to secure funds required for the establishment of an e-learning facility with the required infrastructure and upgrading the training farm and the infrastructure facilities for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Kolonnawa Strom Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The Kolonnawa drainage basin comes under the flood threat annually due to the urbanization that occurred during the last four decades and the absence of an insufficient drainage system in the area. This has become a negative factor  to the future investment planning and for the improvement of infrastructure facilities and economic development. Therefore, measures should be taken to develop Kittampahuwa, Salalihini Mawatha and Danduthota Canals which directly connect to the Kelani river and control the unauthorized constructions and encroachments. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to implement the Kolonnawa Strom Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project during the period from 2019 to 2022, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Projects for the years 2019 - 2021 utilizing the grants provided by the Global Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The Global Fund has been established to provide funds for the programmes carried out with the objective of preventing the three infectious diseases namely, HIV AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria which have become a serious health problem affected globally. The Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine has entered into Agreements to obtain grants worth of US$ 76 million and out of which utilizing US$ 61 million, several projects have been implemented. The Global Fund has allocated a grant of US$ 12.3 million for the period from 2019 - 2021. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to secure the grant, pertaining to the Agreement entered into, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Agreement between Sri Lanka and the Government of Ukraine in respect of Taxation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media to enter into the Agreement at the Government level which is initialed by now at official level, between Sri Lanka and Ukraine for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of Fiscal Evasion on income in line with the Government Policy for enhancing mutual economic relations between Sri Lanka and Ukraine, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Kokilai Bridge and approach roads across Kokilai Lagoon on Mullaitivu - Kokilai - Pulmudai Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to develop  the Mullativu - Kokilai - Pulmudai Road to provide land connectivity on the coastal belt between the Eastern Province and the Northern Province. It is anticipated that the distance between Mullaitivu and Pulmudai will be reduced by around 100 km by the proposed bridge to be constructed across the Kokilai Lagoon. Further, it is proposed to obtain the financial facilities from the CSOB Bank of Czech Republic and a Local Commercial Bank for this project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to conduct loan negotiations with the said Banks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Methodology for the selection of Beneficiaries for Welfare Programmes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish a database on welfare beneficiaries in order to create a more transparent system for the selection of beneficiaries eligible to receive benefits under various welfare programmes implemented within the country.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to refer the Regulations drafted under section 27 of the Welfare Benefits Act, No.24 of 2002 to the Legal Draftsman, including the provisions such as, the mode of application for obtaining benefits, establishment of  Selection Committees and Appeal Committees, eligibility for such appointments, the responsibilities of such committees, the methodologies to be adopted for ensuring the accuracy of the information provided in the applications, the mode of admission of beneficiaries  to the programme and the procedure adopted in dealing with Appeals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing a plot of land to expand the accommodation facilities of the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute (CGTTI)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon German Technical Training Institute initiated in the year 1959 under German Aid, currently offers 11 full time courses in the field of Auto Mobile Engineering and allied fields and enrolls around 600 trainees annually. In addition, 42 short‑term courses are conducted and around 2000 full time course trainees and a number exceeding 2500 part‑time course trainees follow training. This institute is located presently in a land in extent of around 13 acres and it has been planned to provide training opportunities to around further 150 trainees by extending the activities of this institute an establishing new workshops, class rooms and laboratories etc., As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to obtain the plot of land situated adjacent to the said institute in extent of 4 acres and 15.5 perches belonging to the Urban Development Authority on lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to the personnel of the Tri Forces who have retired from service or vacated their posts as a result of the disability due to terrorist activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to provide relief to 1,573 members of the Tri‑Forces who have retired from service after having completed the due period of service as a result of disability caused due to   terrorist activities and due to lowering of the disability to 50%. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to provide relief to a further number of 792 retired similar members of the Tri‑Forces as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvements to the building where  the Police Recruitment Division and the Police Information Technology Division are housed
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The Police Recruitment Division and the Police Information Technology Division are housed in the building at the Sri Sambuddha Jayanthi Mawatha, Kirulapone where the Vilasitha Nivasa was situated earlier. In order to prevent the challenges that have to be faced while being engaged in the disposal of official duties, as a result of this building not being renovated for a long time, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to secure a provision of Rs.126.8 million within the Medium‑term Budgetary Framework for 2020-2022, to improve and carry out a complete revamp of the building inclusive of the construction of a rain water and waste water drainage system and the re‑construction of the water supply system, the sewerage and drainage system and the electric control system, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Drug Prevention Programme 'A Country Free of Drugs'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The drug menace has adversely affected the well-being of the society both economically and socially. The National Drug Prevention Policy and the Action Plan was implemented with a view to providing a lasting solution to the drug menace and 'the Country Free of Drugs' programme to create a Nation Free of Drugs is being successfully implemented with the coordination of the Presidential Task Force on Drug Prevention and the contribution of the Sri Lanka Police, the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board and the other relevant institutions. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to  further expand the activities pertaining to 'the Country Free of Drugs', by the establishment of a National Authority for  Rehabilitation of the Persons addicted to drugs and to import modern technology equipment capable of detecting toxic drugs and usage, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Action Plan for Combating Corruption
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-05
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to formulate a National Action Plan to eradicate corruption, considering the necessity for the implementation of a National Plan applicable in general in regard to all Public Sector Institutions as well as the other institutions for combating bribery and corruption.
