Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement the National Action Plan, during the period of 2019‑2023, formulated for combating bribery and corruption, taking into consideration the views and proposals of all relevant stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of new paddy stores of the Paddy Marketing Board (PMB) and renovation of its existing stores
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The attention of the Government has been focused to develop the infrastructure facilities in the field of agriculture while improving the agricultural sector, for providing relief to the farmers. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, for the construction of 2 State-of-the-Art paddy stores in the Beliatta and Meegahajandura areas with a capacity of 2,000 MT and to renovate 39 old paddy stores spread over the Island, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the Handling Capacity of the Coal Yard of the Lakvijaya Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The usage capacity of the coal yard of the Norochcholai Lakvijaya Power Plant is about 742,421 MT and it is sufficient only to store the coal requirement of 3 months. Therefore, it has been planned to increase the storage capacity of the Plant up to 1.21 million MT enabling it to fulfill the coal requirement for 6 months. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the purpose to M/s China Machinery Engineering Corporation of China, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The contract for the construction of Transmission Lines and Capacity Enhancement under the National Transmission and Distribution Network Development and Efficiency Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The National Transmission and Distribution Network Development and Efficiency Improvement of the electricity Grid has been planned to be implemented under 4 components. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the project for construction of Transmission Lines and Capacity Enhancement planned as its component 3, to M/s Kinden Corporation and M/s Kalpatharu Power Transmission Joint Venture of Japan, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Horana - Padukka and Habarana - Valachchenai Transmission Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contracts for the construction of the Transmission Line of 25 km in length between Horana and Padukka and the Second Circuit Stringing of the Habarana - Valachchenai transmission network, under the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme implemented for the strengthening of the transmission network of the Ceylon Electricity Board, to M/s China National Electric Engineering Co. Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Infrastructure facilities at the Kelaniya, Sri Jayawardenapura, Sabaragamuwa and Moratuwa Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention for the development of the infrastructure facilities of the universities with a view to further enhancing the qualitative aspect of the field of Higher Education. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, for the implementation of the projects for the construction of a 4 storey hostel building for the students of the University of Kelaniya, construction of 3 stories as Stage I of the project for the 7 storey multi-functional building at the University of Sri Jayawardenapura, Stage I of the project for the construction of the faculty building complex of the Faculty of Agriculture of the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka, attending to the balance work left at the lecture hall building of the Faculty of Architecture and at the multi‑functional building of the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Moratuwa, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the High Priority focused Road Development Projects in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention for the rehabilitation of the road network in the area and for further enhancing the livelihood of the people living in the Northern and Eastern Provinces and providing them with the necessary facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to award the contract for the rehabilitation of the roads belonging to the Provincial Road Development Department of the Northern Province to the CEC-NEM Joint Venture, the contract for the rehabilitation of the roads belonging to the Local Government Department of the Northern Province to M/s KDE Weerasinghe & Co. Pvt. LTD., the contract for the rehabilitation of the roads belonging to the Road Development Authority within the Eastern Province to the Consulting Engineers & Contractors Pvt. Ltd., the contract for the rehabilitation of the roads belonging to the Provincial Road Development Department of the Eastern Province to Nawaloka Construction Company Pvt. Ltd. and the contract for the rehabilitation of the roads belonging to the Local Government Department of the Eastern Province to M/s Sinohydro Corporation Limited, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Tamil Medium National School in the Kelaniya	Education Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mano Ganesan, the Minister of National Integration, Official Languages, Social Progress and Hindu Religious Affairs, to establish a Tamil Medium Hindu National School in the name of Arun Maanikkawaasagam Hindu College in the Kelaniya Education Zone utilizing the property to be vested with the Ministry of Education by way of a Deed of Gift by the Arun Prasanth Foundation with a view to uplifting the educational standard of the Tamil medium students in the Wattala area in Gampaha, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to section 45 of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of section 45 of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978, the power to appoint Justices of the Peace to Judicial Zones, Districts and Divisions has been vested with the Minister in charge of the subject of Justice. Accordingly, Justices of the Peace will be appointed to serve in a judicial zone, district or division as appropriate, taking into consideration the place where such person to be appointed to the said post resides. However, taking into account the difficulties faced by Justices of the Peace in identifying their Judicial Zones due to changes that take place from time to time, the Cabinet approval had been granted previously to amend section 45 of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 enabling to appoint Justices 	of the Peace for Administrative Districts in place of Judicial Zones, Districts or Divisions. As such, the proposal made by Hon.(Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to publish the draft bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present it in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Bilateral Air Services Agreements
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - With a view to enhancing the international cooperation in relation to the Air Services, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to sign the initialed Air Services Agreements with Afghanistan, the State of Qatar, the State of Israel, and Zimbabwe by an accredited representative of Sri Lanka thereafter implement the said agreements enabling to contribute to the development process of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancing the food safety through the establishment of a National Level 	Analytical laboratory
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish a laboratory with modern facilities with a view to regulating the inputs and excessive usage of chemical fertilizer, organic manures and pesticides and monitoring the residues and contaminant levels in food, soil and water. At the same time, it has been proposed to improve the  investigative capability of the laboratory by providing laboratory equipment and facilities, conducting laboratory accreditation and quality assurance, educating the safe and correct use of agricultural inputs and to provide training in the use and issue of agro‑chemicals and fertilizers. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to set apart funds required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the mechanism for implementing and regulating the 	Control of Pesticides Act, No.33 of 1980
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The task of regulating the use of pesticides in Sri Lanka is carried out by the Control of Pesticides Act, No.33 of 1980 as amended by the Acts No.06 of 1994 and No.31 of 2011. The number of pesticide products has been increased considerably up to about 700 which prevailed at 70 in the year 1983 when this Act came into operation. Similarly, it has been found necessary to update the management 	of pesticides to coincide with the world trends and the development taking place in the pesticide industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural 	Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development to secure funds required for the purpose of strengthening the process of protecting the quality of pesticides compositions to ensure that they conform to the requirement regarding pesticide residues in food crops, ensuring food safety and protection of the 	consumer from pesticide residues and expanding international recognized conformity analysis facilities, disseminating world trends in agricultural produce and good 	agricultural practices in the country, developing the requisite data systems and administrative structures required for the effective implementation of field monitoring not only the pesticides in agricultural sector but also in other sectors related thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ensuring the quality of Seeds and Planting Materials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the use of quality seeds and planting material will increase the quantity of the harvest from 15% -20%. Therefore, it has been planned to provide the farmers with processing equipment and services necessary for producing quality seeds, facilities required for the improvement and proper maintenance of mother plant gardens, the ways of popularizing new plant varieties and approved imported planting materials, ensuring the quality of seeds and planting materials that are available in the market and adopting the multi-dimensional media propaganda methods to educate the farmers and producers and expanding the activities of planting material production industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to secure funds required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Food safety enhancement through the establishment of a Sustainable Agriculture Development Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The Centre of Excellence for Organic Agriculture (CEOA) at Makandura conducts research and technology transfer on organic agriculture and organic fertilizer while the Regional Agriculture Research and Development Centre (RARDC) at Makandura conducts research in several other sectors such as crop improvement and plant nutrition. It has been found necessary to establish an Eco-friendly Agriculture Development and Research Centre at present and as such, the proposal made by Hon.	P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to secure funds required to establish the Sustainable Agriculture Development Centre amalgamating the said two centres, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of the Seed and Planting Materiel Supply System of the Department of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - Certified seed and planting materiel of paddy, other field crops and vegetables are received from 27 seed farms and the Contract Seed Production Programmes functioning under the Seed and Planting Material Development Centre. However, it has been found difficult to achieve the targets for the production of basic seeds due to the lack of proper irrigation facilities, lack of mechanization, inadequate storage facilities, poor transportation facilities and the limited essential structural facilities available in the farms for production activities. Therefore, a proposal has been made to carry out the functions such as mechanization of seed processing, establishing a combined drying and processing complex at Mahailuppallama, Ampara and Aluttarama farms, purchasing new technical equipment to select other food crop seeds for Palwehera and Bataatha farms, establishing four seed stores in Rahangala, Seethaeliya, Bataatha and Ampara farms, improving of the transportation system in Seed and Planting Material Development Centres and extending the Lak Krushi dealers' network island-wide. As such, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to allocate Rs.335 million required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities to improve the productivity of the Tea and Coconut Smallholder Sectors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that the contribution made by the Tea and Coconut smallholder Sectors to the total tea and coconut production towards the sectors is being increased during the past few years and it has also been identified that there is a tendency for further increasing the said contribution. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to allocate the funds required to increase the productivity of Tea and Coconut smallholder Sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Compensation to the persons affected by the construction of the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The project for the construction of the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal has been identified for implementation under the Strategic Cities Development Project. The project which is to be implemented at an investment of Rs.11,700 million, is expected to contribute towards the establishment of an environmental friendly transport system that enhances the quality of life of the people in the Kandy City and its cultural heritage. However, it has been found that implementation of this project would deprive the livelihood of 820 persons including businessmen engaged in different entrepreneurial activities in the area. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to pay compensation as recommended by the Entitlement Assessment Committee appointed to determine the exact compensation amounts to be paid to the persons affected by the said Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Palaly (Kankesanthurai) Airport for the operation of Regional Commercial Flights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The need to develop the Palaly Airport has been recognized for the operation of internal commercial flights with a view to promoting the tourism industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to make use of the Palaly Airport for the operation of internal commercial passenger flights according to a schedule and to carry out the development activities required for the Palaly Airport expeditiously by the Sri Lanka Air Force at an investment of Rs.1,950 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Adopting the concept of Managing for Development Results (MfDR) as a planning and management technique at the Public institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The developed as well as the developing countries adopt the concept of Managing for Development Results (MfDR) as a modern planning and management technqiue in their public sector management cycle. Through this cycle, the Public management activities are conducted aiming at Key Performance Indicators (KPI) targeted towards the National Sustainable Development. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to institutionalize the process of Managing for Development Results (MfDR) as an initiative in 05 Ministries and 02 Provincial Councils in the form of a pilot project andadopting this concept covering all Public institutions based on its success, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accelerated implementation of the resettlement activities in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention to carry out the resettlement activities expeditiously in the Northern and Eastern Provinces affected due to conflicts by establishing permanent shelter, sanitation facilities, water supply and economic infrastructure facilities such as roads and electricity connections and educational and health facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to construct 4,750 housing units under the owner driven housing programme, to improve the essential economic and social infrastructure facilities in such areas and to upgrade the Thickkam Distilleries for the revival of palmyrah related industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Forest plantation for timber production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - Since the timber requirement in Sri Lanka increases on an annual basis and in order to coincide with this, it has been proposed to increase the productivity of the forest plantation presently carried out for timber and establish new forest plantation. Lands in extent of 500 hectares have been identified in the Districts of Vavuniya, Kilinochchi, Mullaitivu and Mannar for the establishment of the new forest plantation. Through the implementation of this project, it is expected to generate employment opportunities at divisional level and contribute for the control of global warming by upgrading the forest layer, in addition to meeting the demand for timber. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to secure the funds required for the implementation of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Controlling of the quantum of waste accumulated in the coast and the ocean through waterways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - It has been revealed that 90% of the waste accumulated in the coast and the ocean is generated on account of human activities and industries carried out on land and as a result of which, many social, economic and environmental issues have emerged. Action is being taken to obtain the 'Blue Flag' Certificate issued by the Foundation for Environmental Education of Denmark pertaining to the coastal line of Sri Lanka which is treated as an international standard for the assurance of the quality of the coastal line. In addition, it is also necessary to maintain a clean coastal line and ocean for achieving the goal of attracting 4 million of tourists to Sri Lanka by the year 2020 as the coastal and ocean related areas provide around 70% of the contribution to the in‑bound tourism industry while safeguarding the place secured by Sri Lanka as the world's best tourism destination. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement the programmes at District level for the maintenance of waterways free of waste, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of drinking water for model villages and reawakened 	settlements 	in Chronic Kidney Disease of Unknown Etiology (CKDU) 	affected areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to utilize the funds allocated to the model village and reawakened settlements project to provide drinking water to the said villages in the CKDU affected areas. In this respect, the joint proposal made by Hon.Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Wate Supply and Higher Education and Hon.Sajith Premadasa, the	Minister of Housing,  Construction  and  Cultural  Affairs,  to  implement  the	project for improving the Kirindi Oya water treatment plant, enabling to	provide drinking water for 703 families in 18 model villages located   in Lunugamwehera and Thissamaharama Divisional Secretariat Divisions in the Hambantota District, with an investment of Rs. 298 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kalu Ganga Development Project for the prevention of flood and restraining  Salinity intrusion and  for the Supply of Drinking Water to the Hambantota District by diverting Kalu Ganga
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - A feasibility study has been carried out to implement the Kalu Ganga  development project at an investment of Rs 123 billion, with the main objective of preventing the damages caused in the Ratnapura and Kalutara districts due to the overflowing of the Kalu Ganga during the rainy season, restraining salinity intrusion in the supply of drinking water caused by the flowing of salinity up to 18 km upstream from the river mouth and providing drinking water to the Hambantota district, by diverting Kuda Ganga, which is a tributary of the Kalu Ganga. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development to call for proposals for Expression of Interest from the International Construction Companies which can implement the project with foreign investment, to call for project proposals from eligible construction companies and to appoint Cabinet Appointed Committees to evaluate them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of 12,000 MT of Maize required for Thriposha Production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the contract for the purchase of 12,000 MT of Maize, which is one of the main ingredients used for manufacturing Thriposha for Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited, to M/s KST Evergreen (Pvt)Ltd., for a sum of Rs 670.8 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Vehicle and Powertrain Laboratory at the Department of Mechanical Engineering of the Faculty of Engineering, University of Moratuwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct a Vehicle and Powertrain Laboratory at the Department of Mechanical Engineering of the Faculty of Engineering, University of Moratuwa, with a view to facilitating the emerging needs of the local automobile industry, establishing a state of the art and automotive laboratory, producing engineers well equipped with modern knowledge and conducting the research, survey and development capabilities related to the automotive environmental issues. The Raiffeisen Bank International AG of Austria has given its concurrence to provide concessional financing for this project under a soft loan scheme. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to obtain a detailed project proposal from M/s AVL List GmbH who is the sole Austrian Manufacturer and supplier operative in this field, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Plant and Design Build Contract for the Civil, Machinery and Electricity 	(M&E) Work of the Valachchenai Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to award the Plant and Design Build contract for the civil, machinery and electrical work of the Valachchenai Water Supply Project to be implemented covering the 06 Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Koralaipattu, Koralaipattu West, Koralaipattu Central, Koralaipattu South, Koralaipattu North and Eravurpattu to M/s China Geo Engineering Company Limited & M/s China National Aero Technology International Engineering Corporation ‑ JV, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Simplifying the Scheme for Registration of Exporters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - It is observed that a long procedure has to be followed for the registration of Exporters under the registration process currently adopted by the Sri Lanka Export Development Board which has been introduced in 1985 for the registration of Exporters since it has be to operated by collaborating with 06 different agencies and that a period from 01 to 03 weeks is taken for the registration of exporters.  At the same time, studies have shown that a further period of 02 weeks to 04 weeks is required in addition to the period given above for enterprises which need permits or licenses for the Export activities.  In order to make the registration process convenient, the Sri Lanka Export Development Board has already taken steps to prepare a mechanism in collaboration with the institutions such as the Sri Lanka Customs and the  Department of Inland Revenue which operate similar databases with exporter details. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to revoke the registration scheme presently adopted by the Sri Lanka Export Development Board, was approved by the Cabinet.
